Rn 中的一个（可能无界的）盒子。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-b, "gymnasium.spaces.Box", para. 1 Box.sample sample 方法 "Generates a single random sample inside the Box." 在 Box 内部生成一个随机样本。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-b, para. 1 Discrete Discrete（离散空间） "A space consisting of finitely many elements." 由有限个元素组成的空间。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-b, "gymnasium.spaces.Discrete", para. 1 Discrete.sample sample 方法 "Generates a "gymnasium.spaces.MultiBinary.sample", para. 1 MultiDiscrete MultiDiscrete（多离散空间） "This represents the cartesian product of arbitrary Discrete spaces." 它表示任意多个 Discrete 空间的笛卡尔积。 Farama Foundation, "gymnasium.spaces.MultiDiscrete.sample", para. 1 Text Text（文本空间） "A space representing a string comprised of characters from a given charset." 表示由给定字符集中的字符组成的字符串的空间。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-b, "gymnasium.wrappers.vector.FilterObservation", para. 1 FlattenObservation FlattenObservation（观测展平包装器） "Observation wrapper that flattens the observation." 展平观测的观测包装器。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-e, "gymnasium.wrappers.vector.FlattenObservation", para. 1 GrayscaleObservation GrayscaleObservation（灰度观测包装器） "Observation wrapper that converts an RGB image to grayscale." 把 RGB 图像转换为灰度图的观测包装器。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-e, "gymnasium.wrappers.vector.GrayscaleObservation", para. 1 ResizeObservation ResizeObservation（观测尺寸调整包装器） "Resizes image observations using OpenCV to shape." 用 OpenCV 把图像观测调整为 shape。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-e, "gymnasium.wrappers.vector.ResizeObservation", para. 1 ReshapeObservation ReshapeObservation（观测变形包装器） "Reshapes array based observations to shapes." 把基于数组的观测变形为指定形状。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-e, "gymnasium.wrappers.vector.ReshapeObservation", para. 1 RescaleObservation RescaleObservation（观测缩放包装器） "Linearly rescales observation to between a minimum and maximum value." 把观测线性缩放到最小值与最大值之间。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-e, "gymnasium.wrappers.vector.RescaleObservation", para. 1 DtypeObservation DtypeObservation（观测类型转换包装器） "Observation wrapper for transforming the dtype of an observation." 用于转换观测 dtype 的观测包装器。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-e, "gymnasium.wrappers.vector.DtypeObservation", para. 1 NormalizeObservation NormalizeObservation（观测归一化包装器） "This wrapper will normalize observations s.t. each coordinate is centered with unit variance." 这个包装器会归一化观测，使每个坐标居中且方差为 1。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-e, "gymnasium.wrappers.vector.NormalizeObservation", para. 1 TransformAction TransformAction（动作变换包装器） "Transforms an action via a function provided to the wrapper." 通过提供给包装器的函数变换动作。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-e, "gymnasium.wrappers.vector.TransformAction", para. 1 ClipAction ClipAction（动作裁剪包装器） "Clip the continuous action within the valid Box observation space bound." 把连续动作裁剪到合法的 Box 观测空间边界之内。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-e, "gymnasium.wrappers.vector.ClipAction", para. 1 RescaleAction RescaleAction（动作缩放包装器） "Affinely rescales the continuous action space of the environment to the range [min_action, max_action]." 把环境的连续动作空间仿射缩放到 [min_action, max_action] 范围。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-e, "gymnasium.wrappers.vector.RescaleAction", para. 1 TransformReward TransformReward（奖励变换包装器） "A reward wrapper that allows a custom function to modify the step reward." 一种奖励包装器，允许用自定义函数修改 step 的奖励。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-e, "gymnasium.wrappers.vector.TransformReward", para. 1 ClipReward ClipReward（奖励裁剪包装器） "A wrapper that clips the rewards for an environment between an upper and lower bound." 一种包装器，把环境的奖励裁剪到上下界之间。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-e, "gymnasium.wrappers.vector.ClipReward", para. 1 NormalizeReward NormalizeReward（奖励归一化包装器） "This wrapper will scale rewards s.t. their exponential moving average has an approximately fixed variance." 这个包装器会缩放奖励，使其指数移动平均的方差近似固定。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-e, "gymnasium.wrappers.vector.NormalizeReward", para. 1 ArrayConversion ArrayConversion（数组转换包装器） "Wraps a vector environment returning Array API compatible arrays so that it can be interacted with through a specific framework." 包装一个返回兼容 Array API 数组的向量环境，使其能通过特定框架交互。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-e, "gymnasium.wrappers.vector.ArrayConversion", para. 1 JaxToNumpy JaxToNumpy（Jax 转 NumPy 包装器） "Wraps a jax vector environment so that it can be interacted with through numpy arrays." 包装一个 jax 向量环境，使其能通过 numpy 数组交互。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-e, "gymnasium.wrappers.vector.JaxToNumpy", para. 1 JaxToTorch JaxToTorch（Jax 转 PyTorch 包装器） "Wraps a Jax-based vector environment so that it can be interacted with through PyTorch Tensors." 包装一个基于 Jax 的向量环境，使其能通过 PyTorch 张量交互。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-e, "gymnasium.wrappers.vector.JaxToTorch", para. 1 NumpyToTorch NumpyToTorch（NumPy 转 PyTorch 包装器） "Wraps a numpy-based environment so that it can be interacted with through PyTorch Tensors." 包装一个基于 numpy 的环境，使其能通过 PyTorch 张量交互。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-e, "gymnasium.wrappers.vector.NumpyToTorch", para. 1 AsyncVectorEnv 异步向量环境 "Vectorized environment that runs multiple environments in parallel." 并行运行多个环境的向量化环境。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-a, "gymnasium.vector.AsyncVectorEnv", para. 1 AsyncVectorEnv.reset reset 方法 "Resets all sub-environments in parallel and return a batch of concatenated observations and info." 并行重置所有子环境，并返回一批拼接后的观测和信息。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-a, "gymnasium.vector.AsyncVectorEnv.reset", para. 1 AsyncVectorEnv.call call 方法 "Call a method from each parallel environment with args and kwargs." 用 args 和 kwargs 调用每个并行环境的一个方法。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-a, "gymnasium.vector.AsyncVectorEnv.call", para. 1 AsyncVectorEnv.get_attr get_attr 方法 "Get a property from each parallel environment." 从每个并行环境获取一个属性。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-a, "gymnasium.vector.AsyncVectorEnv.get_attr", para. 1 AsyncVectorEnv.set_attr set_attr 方法 "Sets an attribute of the sub-environments." 设置各子环境的一个属性。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-a, "gymnasium.vector.AsyncVectorEnv.set_attr", para. 1 SyncVectorEnv 同步向量环境 "Vectorized environment that serially runs multiple environments." 依次串行运行多个环境的向量化环境。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-b, "gymnasium.vector.SyncVectorEnv", para. 1 SyncVectorEnv.reset reset 方法 "Resets each of the sub-environments and concatenate the results together." 逐个重置子环境，并把结果拼接在一起。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-b, "gymnasium.vector.SyncVectorEnv.reset", para. 1 SyncVectorEnv.step step 方法 "Steps through each of the environments returning the batched results." 让每个环境逐个走一步，返回批量结果。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-b, "gymnasium.vector.SyncVectorEnv.step", para. 1 SyncVectorEnv.call call 方法 "Calls a sub-environment method with name and applies args and kwargs." 按名称调用子环境的方法，并传入 args 和 kwargs。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-b, "gymnasium.vector.SyncVectorEnv.call", para. 1 SyncVectorEnv.get_attr get_attr 方法 "Get a property from each parallel environment." 从每个并行环境获取一个属性。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-b, "gymnasium.vector.SyncVectorEnv.get_attr", para. 1 SyncVectorEnv.set_attr set_attr 方法 "Sets an attribute of the sub-environments." 设置各子环境的一个属性。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-b, "gymnasium.vector.SyncVectorEnv.set_attr", para. 1 Utility functions 工具函数 (No definition) （无定义） Farama Foundation, n.d.-c, "Utility functions" References Farama Foundation. ai/gymnasium/api/wrappers.html.summary: 2.4 Wrappers Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 2.4 Wrappers 包装器 "Wrappers are a convenient way to modify an existing environment without having to alter the underlying code directly." 包装器是一种无需直接修改底层代码就能修改现有环境的便捷方式。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-e, "Wrappers", para. 1 Methods 方法 (No definition) （无定义） Farama Foundation, n.d.-e, "Methods" Wrapper.step step 方法 "Uses the step() of the env that can be overwritten to change the returned data." 调用 env 的 step()，可被重写以改变返回的数据。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-e, "gymnasium.Wrapper.step", para. 1 Wrapper.reset reset 方法 "Uses the reset() of the env that can be overwritten to change the returned data." 调用 env 的 reset()，可被重写以改变返回的数据。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-e, "gymnasium.Wrapper.reset", para. 1 Wrapper.render render 方法 "Uses the render() of the env that can be overwritten to change the returned data." 调用 env 的 render()，可被重写以改变返回的数据。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-e, "gymnasium.Wrapper.render", para. 1 Wrapper.close close 方法 "Closes the wrapper and env." 关闭包装器和 env。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-e, "gymnasium.Wrapper.close", para. 1 Wrapper.wrapper_spec wrapper_spec 方法 "Generates a WrapperSpec for the wrappers." 为包装器生成一个 WrapperSpec。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-e, "gymnasium.Wrapper.wrapper_spec", para. 1 Wrapper.get_wrapper_attr get_wrapper_attr 方法 "Gets an attribute from the wrapper and lower environments if name doesn’t exist in this object." 从包装器及其下层环境获取属性，在该名称不存在于本对象时使用。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-e, "gymnasium.Wrapper.get_wrapper_attr", para. 1 Wrapper.set_wrapper_attr set_wrapper_attr 方法 "Sets an attribute on this wrapper or lower environment if name is already defined." 在本包装器或下层环境上设置属性，在该名称已定义时使用。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-e, "gymnasium.Wrapper.set_wrapper_attr", para. 1 Misc Wrappers 其他包装器 (No definition) （无定义） Farama Foundation, n.d.-b, "Misc Wrappers" TimeLimit TimeLimit（时间限制包装器） "Limits the number of steps for an environment through truncating the environment if a maximum number of timesteps is exceeded." 在超过最大时间步数时截断环境，从而限制环境的步数。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-b, "gymnasium.wrappers.TimeLimit", para. 1 RecordVideo RecordVideo（录制视频包装器） "Records videos of environment episodes using the environment’s render function." 用环境的 render 函数录制环境回合的视频。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-b, "gymnasium.wrappers.RecordVideo", para. 1 RecordEpisodeStatistics RecordEpisodeStatistics（记录回合统计包装器） "This wrapper will keep track of cumulative rewards and episode lengths." 这个包装器会跟踪累计奖励和回合长度。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-b, "gymnasium.wrappers.RecordEpisodeStatistics", para. 1 AtariPreprocessing AtariPreprocessing（Atari 预处理包装器） "Implements the common preprocessing techniques for Atari environments (excluding frame stacking)." 实现 Atari 环境常用的预处理技术（不含帧堆叠）。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-b, "gymnasium.wrappers.AtariPreprocessing", para. 1 Autoreset Autoreset（自动重置包装器） "The wrapped environment is automatically reset when a terminated or truncated state is reached." 被包装的环境在到达终止或截断状态时自动重置。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-b, "gymnasium.wrappers.Autoreset", para. 1 PassiveEnvChecker PassiveEnvChecker（被动环境检查包装器） "A passive wrapper that surrounds the step, reset and render functions to check they follow Gymnasium’s API." 一个被动包装器，包住 step、reset 和 render 函数，检查它们是否遵循 Gymnasium 的 API。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-b, "gymnasium.wrappers.PassiveEnvChecker", para. 1 HumanRendering HumanRendering（人类渲染包装器） "Allows human like rendering for environments that support “rgb_array” rendering." 让支持“rgb_array”渲染的环境能进行 human 式渲染。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-b, "gymnasium.wrappers.HumanRendering", para. 1 OrderEnforcing OrderEnforcing（顺序强制包装器） "Will produce an error if step or render is called before reset." 若在 reset 之前调用 step 或 render，就报错。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-b, "gymnasium.wrappers.OrderEnforcing", para. 1 RenderCollection RenderCollection（渲染收集包装器） "Collect rendered frames of an environment such render returns a list[RenderedFrame]." 收集环境的渲染帧，使 render 返回 list[RenderedFrame]。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-b, "gymnasium.wrappers.RenderCollection", para. 1 ArrayConversion ArrayConversion（数组转换包装器） "Wraps an Array API compatible environment so that it can be interacted with with another Array API framework." 包装一个兼容 Array API 的环境，使其能用另一个 Array API 框架来交互。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-b, "gymnasium.wrappers.ArrayConversion", para. 1 JaxToNumpy JaxToNumpy（Jax 转 NumPy 包装器） "Wraps a Jax-based environment such that it can be interacted with NumPy arrays." 包装一个基于 Jax 的环境，使其能用 NumPy 数组交互。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-b, "gymnasium.wrappers.JaxToNumpy", para. 1 JaxToTorch JaxToTorch（Jax 转 PyTorch 包装器） "Wraps a Jax-based environment so that it can be interacted with PyTorch Tensors." 包装一个基于 Jax 的环境，使其能用 PyTorch 张量交互。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-b, "gymnasium.wrappers.JaxToTorch", para. 1 NumpyToTorch NumpyToTorch（NumPy 转 PyTorch 包装器） "Wraps a NumPy-based environment such that it can be interacted with PyTorch Tensors." 包装一个基于 NumPy 的环境，使其能用 PyTorch 张量交互。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-b, "gymnasium.wrappers.NumpyToTorch", para. 1 Action Wrappers 动作包装器 "Superclass of wrappers that can modify the action before step()." 能在 step() 之前修改动作的包装器的超类。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-a, "gymnasium.ActionWrapper", para. 1 ActionWrapper.action action 方法 "Returns a modified action before step() is called." 在调用 step() 之前返回修改后的动作。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-a, "gymnasium.ActionWrapper.action", para. 1 TransformAction TransformAction（动作变换包装器） "Applies a function to the action before passing the modified value to the environment step function." 先对动作应用一个函数，再把修改后的值传给环境的 step 函数。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-a, "gymnasium.wrappers.TransformAction", para. 1 ClipAction ClipAction（动作裁剪包装器） "Clips the action pass to step to be within the environment’s action_space." 裁剪传给 step 的动作，使其落在环境的 action_space 之内。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-a, "gymnasium.wrappers.ClipAction", para. 1 RescaleAction RescaleAction（动作缩放包装器） "Affinely (linearly) rescales a Box action space of the environment to within the range of [min_action, max_action]." 把环境的 Box 动作空间仿射（线性）缩放到 [min_action, max_action] 范围内。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-a, "gymnasium.wrappers.RescaleAction", para. 1 StickyAction StickyAction（粘滞动作包装器） "Adds a probability that the action is repeated for the same step function." 增加一个概率，使动作在同一 step 函数中被重复。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-a, "gymnasium.wrappers.StickyAction", para. 1 RepeatAction RepeatAction（重复动作包装器） "Repeats the given action for num_repeats steps, accumulating the reward." 把给定动作重复 num_repeats 步，并累加奖励。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-a, "gymnasium.wrappers.RepeatAction", para. 1 Observation Wrappers 观测包装器 "Modify observations from Env.reset() and Env.step() using observation() function." 用 observation() 函数修改 Env.reset() 和 Env.step() 返回的观测。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-c, "gymnasium.ObservationWrapper", para. 1 ObservationWrapper.observation observation 方法 "Returns a modified observation." 返回修改后的观测。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-c, "gymnasium.ObservationWrapper.observation", para. 1 TransformObservation TransformObservation（观测变换包装器） "Applies a function to the observation received from the environment’s Env.reset() and Env.step() that is passed back to the user." 对从环境的 Env.reset() 和 Env.step() 收到、要返回给用户的观测应用一个函数。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-c, "gymnasium.wrappers.TransformObservation", para. 1 DelayObservation DelayObservation（观测延迟包装器） "Adds a delay to the returned observation from the environment." 给环境返回的观测加上延迟。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-c, "gymnasium.wrappers.DelayObservation", para. 1 DtypeObservation DtypeObservation（观测类型转换包装器） "Modifies the dtype of an observation array to a specified dtype." 把观测数组的 dtype 改为指定的 dtype。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-c, "gymnasium.wrappers.DtypeObservation", para. 1 FilterObservation FilterObservation（观测过滤包装器） "Filters a Dict or Tuple observation spaces by a set of keys or indexes." 按一组键或索引过滤 Dict 或 Tuple 观测空间。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-c, "gymnasium.wrappers.FilterObservation", para. 1 FlattenObservation FlattenObservation（观测展平包装器） "Flattens the environment’s observation space and each observation from reset and step functions." 展平环境的观测空间以及 reset 和 step 函数返回的每个观测。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-c, "gymnasium.wrappers.FlattenObservation", para. 1 FrameStackObservation FrameStackObservation（帧堆叠观测包装器） "Stacks the observations from the last N time steps in a rolling manner." 以滚动方式堆叠最近 N 个时间步的观测。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-c, "gymnasium.wrappers.FrameStackObservation", para. 1 GrayscaleObservation GrayscaleObservation（灰度观测包装器） "Converts an image observation computed by reset and step from RGB to Grayscale." 把 reset 和 step 计算出的图像观测从 RGB 转换为灰度。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-c, "gymnasium.wrappers.GrayscaleObservation", para. 1 MaxAndSkipObservation MaxAndSkipObservation（取最大并跳帧观测包装器） "Skips the N-th frame (observation) and return the max values between the two last observations." 跳过第 N 帧（观测），并返回最后两个观测之间的最大值。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-c, "gymnasium.wrappers.MaxAndSkipObservation", para. 1 NormalizeObservation NormalizeObservation（观测归一化包装器） "Normalizes observations to be centered at the mean with unit variance." 把观测归一化为以均值为中心、方差为 1。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-c, "gymnasium.wrappers.NormalizeObservation", para. 1 AddRenderObservation AddRenderObservation（加入渲染观测包装器） "Includes the rendered observations in the environment’s observations." 把渲染出的观测加入环境的观测中。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-c, "gymnasium.wrappers.AddRenderObservation", para. 1 ResizeObservation ResizeObservation（观测尺寸调整包装器） "Resizes image observations using OpenCV to a specified shape." 用 OpenCV 把图像观测调整为指定形状。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-c, "gymnasium.wrappers.ResizeObservation", para. 1 ReshapeObservation ReshapeObservation（观测变形包装器） "Reshapes Array based observations to a specified shape." 把基于数组的观测变形为指定形状。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-c, "gymnasium.wrappers.ReshapeObservation", para. 1 RescaleObservation RescaleObservation（观测缩放包装器） "Affinely (linearly) rescales a Box observation space of the environment to within the range of [min_obs, max_obs]." 把环境的 Box 观测空间仿射（线性）缩放到 [min_obs, max_obs] 范围内。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-c, "gymnasium.wrappers.RescaleObservation", para. 1 TimeAwareObservation TimeAwareObservation（时间感知观测包装器） "Augment the observation with the number of time steps taken within an episode." 用回合内已走的时间步数来扩充观测。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-c, "gymnasium.wrappers.TimeAwareObservation", para. 1 Reward Wrappers 奖励包装器 "Superclass of wrappers that can modify the returning reward from a step." 能修改 step 返回的奖励的包装器的超类。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-d, "gymnasium.RewardWrapper", para. 1 RewardWrapper.reward reward 方法 "Returns a modified environment reward." 返回修改后的环境奖励。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-d, "gymnasium.RewardWrapper.reward", para. 1 TransformReward TransformReward（奖励变换包装器） "Applies a function to the reward received from the environment’s step." 对从环境的 step 收到的奖励应用一个函数。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-d, "gymnasium.wrappers.TransformReward", para. 1 NormalizeReward NormalizeReward（奖励归一化包装器） "Normalizes immediate rewards such that their exponential moving average has an approximately fixed variance." 归一化即时奖励，使其指数移动平均的方差近似固定。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-d, "gymnasium.wrappers.NormalizeReward", para. 1 ClipReward ClipReward（奖励裁剪包装器） "Clips the rewards for an environment between an upper and lower bound." 把环境的奖励裁剪到上下界之间。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-d, "gymnasium.wrappers.ClipReward", para. 1 References Farama Foundation. (n.d.-a). Action Wrappers. Gymnasium Documentation (Version 1.4.0). Retrieved October 31, 2026, from https://gymnasium.farama.org/api/wrappers/action_wrappers/ Farama Foundation. (n.d.-b). Misc Wrappers. Gymnasium Documentation (Version 1.4.0). Retrieved October 31, 2026, from https://gymnasium.farama.org/api/wrappers/misc_wrappers/ Farama Foundation. (n.d.-c). Observation Wrappers. Gymnasium Documentation (Version 1.4.0). Retrieved October 31, 2026, from https://gymnasium.farama.org/api/wrappers/observation_wrappers/ Farama Foundation. (n.d.-d). Reward Wrappers. Gymnasium Documentation (Version 1.4.0). Retrieved October 31, 2026, from https://gymnasium.farama.org/api/wrappers/reward_wrappers/ Farama Foundation. (n.d.-e). Wrappers. ai/gymnasium/environments/mujoco.html.summary: 3.4 MuJoCo Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 3.4 MuJoCo MuJoCo (context) "MuJoCo stands for Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact. It is a physics engine for facilitating research and development in robotics, biomechanics, graphics and animation, and other areas where fast and accurate simulation is needed." （语境）MuJoCo 是 Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact 的缩写。它是一个物理引擎，用于推动机器人、生物力学、图形与动画以及其他需要快速准确仿真的领域的研究和开发。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-h, "MuJoCo", para. 2 Exact reproducibility 精确可复现性 (context) "Note: The exact behavior of the MuJoCo simulator changes slightly between mujoco versions due to floating point operation ordering (more information of their Documentation), if exact reproducibility is need besides using the seed for experiments the same simulator version should be used." （语境）注意：由于浮点运算顺序不同，MuJoCo 模拟器的精确行为在不同 mujoco 版本之间会略有变化（详见其文档）；若需要精确可复现，除了为实验使用 seed 之外，还应使用相同的模拟器版本。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-h, "Exact reproducibility", para. 1 Rendering Backend 渲染后端 "The MuJoCo simulator renders images with OpenGL and can use 3 different back ends “glfw” (default), “egl”, “omesa”, which can be selected by setting an environment variable." MuJoCo 模拟器用 OpenGL 渲染图像，可使用 3 种不同的后端：“glfw”（默认）、“egl”、“omesa”，可通过设置环境变量来选择。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-h, "Rendering Backend", para. 1 GLFW GLFW 后端 "Renders with Window System on GPU" 在 GPU 上借助窗口系统渲染 Farama Foundation, n.d.-h, "Rendering Backend", table, row 1 EGL EGL 后端 "Renders headless on GPU" 在 GPU 上无界面（headless）渲染 Farama Foundation, n.d.-h, "Rendering Backend", table, row 2 OSMESA OSMESA 后端 "Renders headless on CPU" 在 CPU 上无界面（headless）渲染 Farama Foundation, n.d.-h, "Rendering Backend", table, row 3 Ant 蚂蚁 "The ant is a 3D quadruped robot consisting of a torso (free rotational body) with four legs attached to it, where each leg has two body parts." 蚂蚁是一个三维四足机器人，由一个躯干（可自由转动的刚体）和连在上面的四条腿组成，每条腿有两节。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-a, "Ant", para. 2 Half Cheetah 半猎豹 "The HalfCheetah is a 2-dimensional robot consisting of 9 body parts and 8 joints connecting them (including two paws)." 半猎豹是一个二维机器人，由 9 个身体部件和连接它们的 8 个关节组成（包括两只爪子）。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-b, "Half Cheetah", para. 2 Hopper 单腿跳跃者 "The hopper is a two-dimensional one-legged figure consisting of four main body parts - the torso at the top, the thigh in the middle, the leg at the bottom, and a single foot on which the entire body rests." 单腿跳跃者是一个二维的单腿形体，由四个主要部件组成：顶部的躯干、中间的大腿、底部的小腿，以及支撑整个身体的一只脚。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-c, "Hopper", para. 2 Humanoid 人形 "The 3D bipedal robot is designed to simulate a human." 这个三维双足机器人用来模拟人。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-d, "Humanoid", para. 2 Humanoid Standup 人形起立 "The 3D bipedal robot is designed to simulate a human." 这个三维双足机器人用来模拟人。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-e, "Humanoid Standup", para. 2 Inverted Double Pendulum 二级倒立摆 "The cart can be pushed left or right, and the goal is to balance the second pole on top of the first pole, which is in turn on top of the cart, by applying continuous forces to the cart." 小车可以向左或向右推，目标是通过对小车施加连续的力，让第二根杆平衡在第一根杆之上，而第一根杆又立在小车上。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-f, "Inverted Double Pendulum", para. 2 Inverted Pendulum 倒立摆 "The cart can be pushed left or right, and the goal is to balance the pole on top of the cart by applying forces to the cart." 小车可以向左或向右推，目标是通过对小车施力，让杆在小车上保持平衡。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-g, "Inverted Pendulum", para. 2 Pusher 推动臂 "“Pusher” is a multi-jointed robot arm that is very similar to a human arm." “Pusher”是一个与人类手臂非常相似的多关节机械臂。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-i, "Pusher", para. 2 Reacher 伸展臂 "“Reacher” is a two-jointed robot arm." “Reacher”是一个两关节机械臂。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-j, "Reacher", para. 2 Swimmer 游泳者 "The swimmers consist of three or more segments (’links’) and one less articulation joints (’rotors’) - one rotor joint connects exactly two links to form a linear chain." 游泳者由三个或更多的节段（“连杆”）和比节段少一个的关节（“转子”）组成：每个转子关节恰好连接两根连杆，形成一条线性链。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-k, "Swimmer", para. 2 Walker2D 二维行走者 "This environment builds on the hopper environment by adding another set of legs that allow the robot to walk forward instead of hop." 这个环境在单腿跳跃者环境的基础上增加了一组腿，使机器人能向前行走，而不是跳跃。 Farama Foundation, n.d.-l, "Walker2D", para. 2 References Farama Foundation. ai/gymnasium/introduction/basic-usage.ht.summary: 1.1 Basic Usage Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 1.1 Basic Usage 基本用法 (context) "Reinforcement learning is like teaching through trial and error - an agent learns by trying actions, receiving feedback (rewards), and gradually improving its behavior." （语境）强化学习就像通过试错来教学：智能体尝试动作、获得反馈（奖励），逐步改进自己的行为。 Farama Foundation, n.d., "What is Reinforcement Learning?", para. 1 Understanding the Agent-Environment Loop 理解智能体与环境的循环 "In reinforcement learning, the classic “agent-environment loop” pictured below represents how learning happens in RL." 在强化学习中，下图所示的经典“智能体与环境的循环”表示了强化学习中学习是如何发生的。 Farama Foundation, n.d., "Understanding the Agent-Environment Loop", para. 1 Agent observes 智能体观察 "Agent observes the current situation (like looking at a game screen)" 智能体观察当前情况（就像看着游戏画面） Farama Foundation, n.d., "Understanding the Agent-Environment Loop", item 1 Agent chooses an action 智能体选择动作 "Agent chooses an action based on what it sees (like pressing a button)" 智能体选择动作依据它看到的内容（就像按下一个按钮） Farama Foundation, n.d., "Understanding the Agent-Environment Loop", item 2 Environment responds 环境响应 "Environment responds with a new situation and a reward (game state changes, score updates)" 环境响应给出新的情况和一个奖励（游戏状态变化、分数更新） Farama Foundation, n.d., "Understanding the Agent-Environment Loop", item 3 Repeat 重复 "Repeat until the episode ends" 重复直到回合结束 Farama Foundation, n.d., "Understanding the Agent-Environment Loop", item 4 Explaining the Code Step by Step 逐步讲解代码 (No definition) （无定义） Farama Foundation, n.d., "Explaining the Code Step by Step" timestep 时间步 "One such action-observation exchange is called a timestep." 一次这样的动作与观测交换称为一个时间步。 Farama Foundation, n.d., "Explaining the Code Step by Step", para. 4 terminal state 终止状态 "However, after some timesteps, the environment may end - this is called the terminal state." 然而，经过若干时间步后，环境可能会结束，这称为终止状态。 Farama Foundation, n.d., "Explaining the Code Step by Step", para. 5 Action and observation spaces 动作空间与观测空间 "Every environment specifies the format of valid actions and observations with the action_space and observation_space attributes." 每个环境都用 action_space 和 observation_space 属性规定合法动作和观测的格式。 Farama Foundation, n.d., "Action and observation spaces", para. 1 Action Space 动作空间 "Action Space: What can your agent do? (discrete choices, continuous values, etc.)" 动作空间：你的智能体能做什么？（离散选择、连续值等） Farama Foundation, n.d., "Action and observation spaces", para. 2, item 1 Observation Space 观测空间 "Observation Space: What can your agent see? ai/hugging-face-transformers/api/main-cl.summary: 9.1 Main Classes Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 9.1 Main Classes 主要类 (context) "Fast and easy to use: Every model is implemented from only three main classes (configuration, model, and preprocessor) and can be quickly used for inference or training with Pipeline or Trainer." （语境）快速易用：每个模型的实现都只用到三个主要类（配置、模型和预处理器），并能借助 Pipeline 或 Trainer 快速用于推理或训练。 Hugging Face, n.d., "Design", item 1 9.1.1 Auto classes 自动类 (context) "In many cases, the architecture you want to use can be guessed from the name or the path of the pretrained model you are supplying to the from_pretrained() method. AutoClasses are here to do this job for you so that you automatically retrieve the relevant model given the name/path to the pretrained weights/config/vocabulary." （语境）很多情况下，你要用的架构可以从你传给 from_pretrained() 方法的预训练模型的名称或路径猜出来。AutoClasses 替你完成这件事，让你根据预训练权重、配置或词表的名称或路径自动取得相应的模型。 Hugging Face, n.d., "Auto classes", para. 1 9.1.2 Backbones 骨干网络 "A backbone is a model used for feature extraction for higher level computer vision tasks such as object detection and image classification." 骨干网络是一种用于特征提取的模型，服务于目标检测、图像分类等更高层的计算机视觉任务。 Hugging Face, n.d., "Backbone", para. 1 9.1.3 Callbacks 回调 "Callbacks are objects that can customize the behavior of the training loop in the PyTorch Trainer that can inspect the training loop state (for progress reporting, logging on TensorBoard or other ML platforms…) and take decisions (like early stopping)." 回调是可以定制 PyTorch Trainer 中训练循环行为的对象，它们能检查训练循环的状态（用于进度报告、在 TensorBoard 或其他机器学习平台上记录日志……）并作出决定（如提前停止）。 Hugging Face, n.d., "Callbacks", para. 1 9.1.4 Configuration 配置 (context) "The base class PreTrainedConfig implements the common methods for loading/saving a configuration either from a local file or directory, or from a pretrained model configuration provided by the library (downloaded from HuggingFace’s AWS S3 repository)." （语境）基类 PreTrainedConfig 实现了加载和保存配置的通用方法，配置可以来自本地文件或目录，也可以来自库提供的预训练模型配置（从 HuggingFace 的 AWS S3 仓库下载）。 Hugging Face, n.d., "Configuration", para. 1 9.1.5 Continuous batching 连续批处理 (context) "This page documents the classes behind continuous batching inference: submitting prompts, configuring scheduling and memory limits, and retrieving results." （语境）本页说明连续批处理推理背后的类：提交提示、配置调度和内存限制、取回结果。 Hugging Face, n.d., "Continuous batching", para. 1 9.1.6 Data collator 数据整理器 "Data collators are objects that will form a batch by using a list of dataset elements as input." 数据整理器是以一组数据集元素作为输入、把它们组成一个批次的对象。 Hugging Face, n.d., "Data collator", para. 1 9.1.7 Logging 日志 "🤗 Transformers has a centralized logging system, so that you can setup the verbosity of the library easily." 🤗 Transformers 有一个集中式的日志系统，让你可以方便地设置库的日志详细程度。 Hugging Face, n.d., "Logging", para. 1 9.1.8 Models 模型 (context) "The base class PreTrainedModel implements the common methods for loading/saving a model either from a local file or directory, or from a pretrained model configuration provided by the library (downloaded from HuggingFace's Hub)." （语境）基类 PreTrainedModel 实现了加载和保存模型的通用方法，模型可以来自本地文件或目录，也可以来自库提供的预训练模型配置（从 HuggingFace 的 Hub 下载）。 Hugging Face, n.d., "Models", para. 1 9.1.9 Text generation 文本生成 (context) "Each framework has a generate method for text generation implemented in their respective GenerationMixin class:" （语境）每个框架都有一个用于文本生成的 generate 方法，实现在各自的 GenerationMixin 类中： Hugging Face, n.d., "Generation", para. 1 9.1.10 Optimization 优化 (context) "The .optimization module provides: an optimizer with weight decay fixed that can be used to fine-tuned models, and several schedules in the form of schedule objects that inherit from _LRSchedule:" （语境）.optimization 模块提供：一个修正了权重衰减、可用于微调模型的优化器，以及若干以调度对象形式提供的学习率调度，它们继承自 _LRSchedule： Hugging Face, n.d., "Optimization", para. 1 and list items 1 to 2 9.1.11 Model outputs 模型输出 "All models have outputs that are instances of subclasses of ModelOutput. Those are data structures containing all the information returned by the model, but that can also be used as tuples or dictionaries." 所有模型的输出都是 ModelOutput 子类的实例。它们是包含模型返回的全部信息的数据结构，但也可以当作元组或字典使用。 Hugging Face, n.d., "Model outputs", para. 1 9.1.12 PEFT 参数高效微调 (context) "The PeftAdapterMixin provides functions from the PEFT library for managing adapters with Transformers." （语境）PeftAdapterMixin 提供来自 PEFT 库的函数，用于在 Transformers 中管理适配器。 Hugging Face, n.d., "PEFT", para. 1 9.1.13 Pipelines 管道 "The pipelines are a great and easy way to use models for inference." 管道是一种很好用、很简单的用模型做推理的方式。 Hugging Face, n.d., "Pipelines", para. 1 9.1.14 Processors 处理器 "Any multi-modal model will require an object to encode or decode the data that groups several modalities (among text, vision and audio). This is handled by objects called processors, which group together two or more processing objects such as tokenizers (for the text modality), image processors (for vision) and feature extractors (for audio)." 任何多模态模型都需要一个对象，来编码或解码组合了多种模态（文本、视觉和音频中的几种）的数据。这由称为处理器的对象负责，它把两个或更多处理对象组合在一起，如分词器（文本模态）、图像处理器（视觉）和特征提取器（音频）。 Hugging Face, n.d., "Processors", "Multi-modal processors", para. 1 9.1.15 Exporters 导出器 (context) "New export backends can be added to Transformers by subclassing HfExporter." （语境）可以通过继承 HfExporter 给 Transformers 添加新的导出后端。 Hugging Face, n.d., "Exporters", para. 1 9.1.16 Quantization 量化 "Quantization techniques reduce memory and computational costs by representing weights and activations with lower-precision data types like 8-bit integers (int8)." 量化技术用更低精度的数据类型表示权重和激活值，从而降低内存和计算成本，如 8 位整数（int8）。 Hugging Face, n.d., "Quantization", para. 1 9.1.17 Tokenizer 分词器 "A tokenizer is in charge of preparing the inputs for a model." 分词器负责为模型准备输入。 Hugging Face, n.d., "Tokenizer", para. 1 9.1.18 Trainer 训练器 "The Trainer class provides an API for feature-complete training in PyTorch, and it supports distributed training on multiple GPUs/TPUs, mixed precision for NVIDIA GPUs, AMD GPUs, and torch.amp for PyTorch." Trainer 类提供一个在 PyTorch 中进行功能完整训练的 API，它支持在多个 GPU 或 TPU 上的分布式训练，以及面向 NVIDIA GPU、AMD GPU 的混合精度和 PyTorch 的 torch.amp。 Hugging Face, n.d., "Trainer", para. 1 9.1.19 DeepSpeed DeepSpeed "DeepSpeed, powered by Zero Redundancy Optimizer (ZeRO), is an optimization library for training and fitting very large models onto a GPU." DeepSpeed 以零冗余优化器（ZeRO）为核心，是一个用于在 GPU 上训练和容纳超大模型的优化库。 Hugging Face, n.d., "DeepSpeed", para. 1 9.1.20 ExecuTorch ExecuTorch "ExecuTorch is an end-to-end solution for enabling on-device inference capabilities across mobile and edge devices including wearables, embedded devices and microcontrollers." ExecuTorch 是一个端到端的解决方案，让移动设备和边缘设备具备在设备上推理的能力，包括可穿戴设备、嵌入式设备和微控制器。 Hugging Face, n.d., "ExecuTorch", para. 1 9.1.21 Feature extractor 特征提取器 "A feature extractor is in charge of preparing input features for audio models." 特征提取器负责为音频模型准备输入特征。 Hugging Face, n.d., "Feature extractor", para. 1 9.1.22 Image processor 图像处理器 "An image processor is in charge of loading images (optionally), preparing input features for vision models and post processing their outputs." 图像处理器负责加载图像（可选）、为视觉模型准备输入特征，并对其输出做后处理。 Hugging Face, n.d., "Image processor", para. 1 9.1.23 Video processor 视频处理器 "A Video Processor is a utility responsible for preparing input features for video models, as well as handling the post-processing of their outputs." 视频处理器是一个工具，负责为视频模型准备输入特征，并处理其输出的后处理。 Hugging Face, n.d., "Video processor", para. 1 9.1.24 Kernels 内核 (context) "This page documents the kernels configuration utilities." （语境）本页说明内核配置工具。 Hugging Face, n.d., "Kernels", para. 1 References Hugging Face. (n.d.). Transformers documentation (Version 5.20.2). Retrieved October 30, 2026, from https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/v5.20.2/en/index

ai/hugging-face-transformers/index.html.summary: Hugging Face Transformers Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source Hugging Face Transformers Hugging Face Transformers "Transformers acts as the model-definition framework for state-of-the-art machine learning models in text, computer vision, audio, video, and multimodal models, for both inference and training." Transformers 充当最先进的机器学习模型的模型定义框架，覆盖文本、计算机视觉、音频、视频和多模态模型，既用于推理也用于训练。 Hugging Face, n.d., "Transformers", para. 1 1 Get Started 入门 (context) "Transformers is designed to be fast and easy to use so that everyone can start learning or building with transformer models." （语境）Transformers 的设计目标是快速、易用，让每个人都能开始学习或用 transformer 模型构建应用。 Hugging Face, n.d., "Quickstart", para. 1 2 Base Classes 基础类 (context) "Transformers provides many pretrained models that are ready to use with a single line of code." （语境）Transformers 提供许多只需一行代码就能使用的预训练模型。 Hugging Face, n.d., "Loading models", para. 1 3 Inference 推理 (context) "The Pipeline is a simple but powerful inference API that is readily available for a variety of machine learning tasks with any model from the Hugging Face Hub." （语境）Pipeline 是一个简单而强大的推理 API，可以直接搭配 Hugging Face Hub 上的任何模型，用于各种机器学习任务。 Hugging Face, n.d., "Pipeline", para. 1 4 Training 训练 (context) "Trainer is a complete training and evaluation loop for Transformers models." （语境）Trainer 是一个面向 Transformers 模型的完整训练与评估循环。 Hugging Face, n.d., "Trainer", para. 1 5 Hardware 硬件 "Transformers runs on CPUs, NVIDIA GPUs, AMD GPUs, Apple Silicon, Google TPUs, AWS Trainium instances, and more through their PyTorch backends." Transformers 通过各自的 PyTorch 后端运行在 CPU、NVIDIA GPU、AMD GPU、Apple Silicon、Google TPU、AWS Trainium 实例等硬件上。 Hugging Face, n.d., "Hardware", para. 1 6 Quantization 量化 "Quantization lowers the memory requirements of loading and using a model by storing the weights in a lower precision while trying to preserve as much accuracy as possible." 量化通过以更低精度存储权重，降低加载和使用模型的内存需求，同时尽量保留准确率。 Hugging Face, n.d., "Overview" (Quantization), para. 1 7 Ecosystem Integrations 生态集成 (context) "Transformers models are compatible with inference engines like vLLM and SGLang." （语境）Transformers 模型与 vLLM、SGLang 等推理引擎兼容。 Hugging Face, n.d., "Building a compatible model backend for inference", para. 1 8 Resources 资源 (context) "This glossary defines general machine learning and 🤗 Transformers terms to help you better understand the documentation." （语境）本术语表定义一般的机器学习术语和 🤗 Transformers 术语，帮助你更好地理解文档。 Hugging Face, n.d., "Glossary", para. 1 9 API API (context) "In many cases, the architecture you want to use can be guessed from the name or the path of the pretrained model you are supplying to the from_pretrained() method. AutoClasses are here to do this job for you so that you automatically retrieve the relevant model given the name/path to the pretrained weights/config/vocabulary." （语境）很多情况下，你要用的架构可以从你传给 from_pretrained() 方法的预训练模型的名称或路径猜出来。AutoClasses 替你完成这件事，让你根据预训练权重、配置或词表的名称或路径自动取得相应的模型。 Hugging Face, n.d., "Auto classes", para. 1 References Hugging Face. (n.d.). Transformers documentation (Version 5.20.2). Retrieved October 30, 2026, from https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/v5.20.2/en/index

ai/mujoco/computation/collision-detectio.summary: 2.5 Collision detection Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 2.5 Collision detection 碰撞检测 (context) "Collision detection operates on geoms, which are geometric entities rigidly attached to the underlying bodies." （语境）碰撞检测作用于 geom，即刚性附着在底层刚体上的几何实体。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Collision detection", para. 1 Selection 选择 "MuJoCo has flexible mechanisms for deciding which geom pairs are checked in detail." MuJoCo 有灵活的机制来决定哪些 geom 对要做详细检查。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Selection", para. 1 Generation 生成 "First we generate a list of candidate geom pairs by merging from two sources: pairs of bodies that might contain colliding geoms and the explicit list of geom pairs defined with the pair element in MJCF." 首先，我们合并两个来源，生成候选 geom 对列表：可能包含碰撞 geom 的刚体对，以及用 MJCF 中 pair 元素定义的显式 geom 对列表。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Selection", item 1 Broad-phase collision detection 粗阶段碰撞检测 "The body pairs are generated via broad-phase collision detection based on a modified sweep-and-prune algorithm." 刚体对通过基于改进的扫掠剪枝算法的粗阶段碰撞检测生成。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Selection", item 1 Mid-phase collision detection 中阶段碰撞检测 "Then, for each body pair, mid-phase collision detection is performed using a static bounding volume hierarchy (a BVH binary tree) of axis-aligned bounding boxes (AABB)." 然后，对每个刚体对，用由轴对齐包围盒（AABB）构成的静态包围体层次结构（BVH 二叉树）进行中阶段碰撞检测。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Selection", item 1 Filtering 过滤 "Next we apply four filters to the list generated in the previous step." 接下来对上一步生成的列表应用四个过滤器。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Selection", item 2 Checking 检查 "Detailed collision checking, also known as near-phase or narrow-phase collision detection, is performed by functions that depend on the geom types in the pair." 详细的碰撞检查，也称为近阶段或窄阶段碰撞检测，由依赖于 geom 对类型的函数完成。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Checking", para. 1 Convex collisions 凸碰撞 "All collisions involving pairs of geoms that do not have an analytic collider (e.g., meshes), are handled by one of two general-purpose convex collision detection (CCD) pipelines:" 所有涉及没有解析碰撞器的 geom 对（例如网格）的碰撞，由两条通用凸碰撞检测（CCD）流水线之一处理： Google DeepMind, n.d., "Convex collisions", para. 1 native pipeline 原生流水线 "The native CCD pipeline (“nativeccd”) is implemented natively in MuJoCo, based on the Gilbert-Johnson-Keerthi and Expanding Polytope algorithms (GJK / EPA)." 原生 CCD 流水线（“nativeccd”）在 MuJoCo 中原生实现，基于 Gilbert-Johnson-Keerthi 算法和扩展多胞体算法（GJK / EPA）。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Convex collisions", item 1 libccd pipeline libccd 流水线 "This legacy pipeline is based on the libccd library, and uses Minkowski Portal Refinement (MPR)." 这条旧版流水线基于 libccd 库，使用闵可夫斯基入口细化（MPR）。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Convex collisions", item 2 Multiple contacts 多接触点 "Both of MuJoCo’s CCD pipelines can return multiple points per contacting pair (“multiccd”)." MuJoCo 的两条 CCD 流水线都能为每个接触对返回多个点（“multiccd”）。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Multiple contacts", para. 1 multi-run pipeline 多次运行流水线 "Multiple contact points are found by rotating the two geoms by ±1e-3 radians around the tangential axes and re-running the collision routine." 多个接触点的求法是把两个 geom 绕切向轴旋转 ±1e-3 弧度，然后重新运行碰撞例程。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Multiple contacts", item 1 single-shot pipeline 单次流水线 "The single-shot pipeline is used in conjunction with the native CCD pipeline, i.e., when the nativeccd flag is enabled." 单次流水线与原生 CCD 流水线配合使用，即在启用 nativeccd 标志时。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Multiple contacts", item 2 Geom distance geom 距离 (context) "The narrow-phase collision functions described above drive the mj_geomDistance function and associated collision sensors." （语境）上面介绍的窄阶段碰撞函数驱动 mj_geomDistance 函数及相关的碰撞传感器。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Geom distance", para. 1 Convex decomposition 凸分解 "In order to model a non-convex object other than a height field, the user must decompose it into a union of convex geoms (which can be primitive shapes or meshes) and attach them to the same body." 要建模高度场以外的非凸物体，用户必须把它分解为若干凸 geom 的并集（可以是基本形状或网格），并把它们附着到同一个刚体上。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Convex decomposition", para. 1 Pair-wise colliders 成对碰撞器 (context) "The table below provides information about the colliders used for different geom pairs." （语境）下表给出不同 geom 对所用碰撞器的信息。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Pair-wise colliders", para. 1 References Google DeepMind. ai/mujoco/computation/constraint-model.h.summary: 2.3 Constraint model Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 2.3 Constraint model 约束模型 (context) "MuJoCo has a very flexible constraint model, which is nevertheless handled in a uniform way by the solver described later." （语境）MuJoCo 有一个非常灵活的约束模型，但它由后面介绍的求解器统一处理。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Constraint model", para. 1 Equality 等式约束 (context) "There are five types of equality constraints described next." （语境）接下来介绍五种等式约束。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Equality", para. 3 Loop joints 环路关节 "Among other applications, equality constraints can be used to create “loop joints”, i.e., joints that cannot be modeled via the kinematic tree." 在其他用途之外，等式约束可用于构造“环路关节”，即无法通过运动学树建模的关节。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Equality", para. 2 connect 连接约束 "This constraint connects two bodies at a point, effectively creating a ball joint outside the kinematic tree." 这种约束在一点上连接两个刚体，相当于在运动学树之外创建一个球关节。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Equality", item 1 weld 焊接约束 "This constraint welds two bodies together, suppressing all relative degrees of freedom between them." 这种约束把两个刚体焊在一起，消除它们之间的所有相对自由度。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Equality", item 2 joint 关节约束 "This constraint applies only to scalar joints: hinge and slide. It can be used to lock one joint into a constant position, or to couple two joints via a quartic polynomial." 这种约束只适用于标量关节：铰链关节和滑动关节。它可用于把一个关节锁定在固定位置，或通过四次多项式耦合两个关节。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Equality", item 3 tendon 肌腱约束 "This constraint is very similar to the joint constraint above, but applies to the length of tendons instead of the position of joints." 这种约束与上面的关节约束非常相似，但作用于肌腱的长度，而不是关节的位置。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Equality", item 4 distance 距离约束 (context) "Distance equality constraints were removed in MuJoCo version 2.2.2." （语境）距离等式约束已在 MuJoCo 2.2.2 版中移除。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Equality", item 5 Friction loss 摩擦损失 "Friction loss is also known as dry friction, or static friction, or load-independent friction (in contrast with Coulomb friction which scales with normal force)." 摩擦损失也称为干摩擦、静摩擦或与载荷无关的摩擦（与随法向力变化的库仑摩擦相对）。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Friction loss", para. 1 joint 关节摩擦损失 "Friction loss can be defined not only for scalar joints (slide and hinge), but also for ball joints which have 3 degrees of freedom, and free joints which have 6 degrees of freedom. When defined, it is applied independently to all degrees of freedom of the affected joint." 摩擦损失不仅可以为标量关节（滑动关节和铰链关节）定义，也可以为有 3 个自由度的球关节和有 6 个自由度的自由关节定义。定义后，它独立地作用于所涉关节的所有自由度。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Friction loss", item 1 tendon 肌腱摩擦损失 "Tendons are scalar quantities, thus defining friction loss for a tendon always adds one scalar constraint." 肌腱是标量，因此为肌腱定义摩擦损失总是增加一个标量约束。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Friction loss", item 2 Limit 限位 "Limits as well as contacts have a well-defined spatial residual, but unlike equality constraints they are uni-lateral, i.e. they introduce inequality rather than equality constraints." 限位和接触一样有明确定义的空间残差，但与等式约束不同，它们是单边的，即引入的是不等式约束而不是等式约束。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Limit", para. 1 joint 关节限位 "Limits can be defined for scalar joints (hinge and slide) as well as for ball joints." 限位可以为标量关节（铰链关节和滑动关节）定义，也可以为球关节定义。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Limit", item 1 tendon 肌腱限位 "Tendon are scalar quantities and their limits are treated as described above." 肌腱是标量，它们的限位按上述方式处理。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Limit", item 2 Contact 接触 "Contacts are the most elaborate constraint type, both in terms of specifying them in the model and in terms of the computations that need to be performed." 接触是最复杂的约束类型，无论是在模型中指定它们，还是在需要进行的计算方面。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Contact", para. 1 Point contacts 点接触 "MuJoCo works with point contacts, defined geometrically by a point between two geoms and a spatial frame centered at that point, both expressed in global coordinates." MuJoCo 使用点接触，它在几何上由两个 geom 之间的一个点和以该点为中心的空间坐标系定义，两者都用全局坐标表示。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Contact", para. 2 margin and gap 余量与间隙 "Together they define three regimes of contact detection and force generation, illustrated in the figure below." 它们一起定义了接触检测和力生成的三种状态，如下图所示。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "margin and gap", para. 1 No contact 无接触 "No contact (distance > margin + gap): The geom surfaces, including their gap buffers, are not overlapping. No contact is generated." No contact（distance > margin + gap）：geom 表面（包括其间隙缓冲）没有重叠。不生成接触。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "margin and gap", item 1 Inactive contact 非活动接触 "Inactive contact (margin < distance ≤ margin + gap): A contact is detected and included in mjData.contact, but no contact force is generated (efc_address = -1)." Inactive contact（margin < distance ≤ margin + gap）：检测到接触并纳入 mjData.contact，但不生成接触力（efc_address = -1）。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "margin and gap", item 2 Active contact 活动接触 "Active contact (distance ≤ margin): The contact is active and constraint forces are generated." Active contact（distance ≤ margin）：接触处于活动状态，并生成约束力。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "margin and gap", item 3 condim 接触维数 "The condim parameter determines the contact type, and has the following meaning:" condim 参数决定接触类型，含义如下： Google DeepMind, n.d., "condim", para. 1 condim = 1 condim = 1 "This corresponds to a frictionless contact and adds only one scalar constraint." 这对应于无摩擦接触，只增加一个标量约束。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "condim", item 1 condim = 3 condim = 3 "This is a regular frictional contact, which can generate normal force as well as a tangential friction force opposing slip." 这是常规的摩擦接触，可以产生法向力以及阻碍滑动的切向摩擦力。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "condim", item 2 condim = 4 condim = 4 "In addition to normal and tangential force, this contact can generate torsional friction torque opposing rotation around the contact normal, corresponding to a torque generated by a contacting surface patch." 除了法向力和切向力，这种接触还能产生阻碍绕接触法线转动的扭转摩擦力矩，对应于接触面片产生的力矩。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "condim", item 3 condim = 6 condim = 6 "This contact can oppose motion in all relative degrees of freedom between the two geoms." 这种接触可以阻碍两个 geom 之间所有相对自由度上的运动。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "condim", item 4 Friction cones 摩擦锥 (context) "Now we describe the friction cones and the corresponding Jacobians more formally." （语境）现在更形式化地介绍摩擦锥及相应的雅可比矩阵。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Friction cones", para. 1 References Google DeepMind. ai/mujoco/computation/constraint-solver..summary: 2.4 Constraint solver Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 2.4 Constraint solver 约束求解器 (context) "First, the constraint forces are defined as the unique global solution to a convex optimization problem." （语境）首先，约束力被定义为一个凸优化问题的唯一全局解。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Constraint solver", para. 1 2.4.0 Introduction 介绍 (No definition) （无定义） Google DeepMind, n.d., "Constraint solver" Gauss principle of least constraint 高斯最小约束原理 (context) "The primal formulation is based on a generalization of the Gauss principle of least constraint." （语境）原问题的表述基于高斯最小约束原理的一种推广。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Constraint solver", para. 3 Lagrange dual 拉格朗日对偶 "The dual is a convex optimization problem over constraint forces, which also play the role of Lagrange multipliers for the primal problem." 对偶问题是一个关于约束力的凸优化问题，这些约束力同时也充当原问题的拉格朗日乘子。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Constraint solver", para. 2 Primal problem 原问题 "We first formulate the optimization problem whose solution yields the constrained acceleration" 我们先写出其解给出受约束加速度的优化问题 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Primal problem", para. 1 Huber “norm” Huber“范数” "The Huber “norm” is based on the Huber function from robust statistics: it is a quadratic around zero, and transitions smoothly to a linear function when the absolute value of the argument crosses a threshold – in this case given by the friction loss parameters." Huber“范数”基于稳健统计中的 Huber 函数：它在零附近是二次的，当自变量的绝对值越过某个阈值（这里由摩擦损失参数给出）时，平滑地过渡为线性函数。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Primal problem", para. 5 Reduced primal problem 约化原问题 "It turns out that the primal problem can be reduced to unconstrained optimization over accelerations." 事实证明，原问题可以约化为关于加速度的无约束优化。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Reduced primal problem", para. 1 Dual problem 对偶问题 "We then transform the primal problem over accelerations into its Lagrange dual. The dual is a convex optimization problem over constraint forces, which also play the role of Lagrange multipliers for the primal problem." 然后把关于加速度的原问题转换为它的拉格朗日对偶。对偶问题是一个关于约束力的凸优化问题，约束力同时充当原问题的拉格朗日乘子。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Constraint solver", para. 2 Algorithms 算法 "Here we describe the numerical algorithms (or “solvers”) for solving the above convex optimization problems." 这里介绍求解上述凸优化问题的数值算法（即“求解器”）。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Algorithms", para. 1 CG 共轭梯度法 "This algorithm uses the non-linear conjugate gradient method with the Hager-Zhang formula." 该算法使用带 Hager-Zhang 公式的非线性共轭梯度法。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Algorithms", item 1 Newton 牛顿法 "This algorithm implements the exact Newton method, with analytical second-order derivatives and Cholesky factorization of the Hessian." 该算法实现精确的牛顿法，使用解析二阶导数和 Hessian 矩阵的 Cholesky 分解。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Algorithms", item 2 PGS 投影高斯-赛德尔法 "Unlike gradient-based methods which improve the solution along oblique directions, Gauss-Seidel works on one scalar component at a time, and sets it to its optimal value given the current values of all other components." 与沿斜方向改进解的基于梯度的方法不同，高斯-赛德尔法每次处理一个标量分量，在其他所有分量取当前值的条件下把它设为最优值。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Algorithms", item 3 NoSlip 无滑移后处理 "This is not a standalone solver but a post-processing step, enabled by setting noslip_iterations to a positive value in option." 它不是独立的求解器，而是一个后处理步骤，通过在 option 中把 noslip_iterations 设为正值来启用。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Algorithms", item 4 Warmstart 热启动 "Before solving, the solver warmstarts the constraint forces from the previous time step." 在求解之前，求解器用上一个时间步的约束力进行热启动。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Algorithms", item 5 Constraint islands 约束岛 "A constraint island is a disjoint sub-graph which can be solved for independently, because constraint forces cannot propagate between islands." 约束岛是一个可以独立求解的不相交子图，因为约束力不能在岛之间传播。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Constraint islands", para. 1 Islanding 分岛 "Constraint island discovery and construction (“islanding”) involves finding these disjoint subgraphs and reordering both the DOFs and constraints to make them memory-contiguous." 约束岛的发现与构建（“分岛”）包括找出这些不相交子图，并对自由度和约束重新排序，使它们在内存中连续。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Constraint islands", para. 1 Parameters 参数 "To summarize, the constraint behavior is determined by three per-constraint quantities" 总之，约束行为由每个约束的三个量决定 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Parameters", para. 9 Impedance 阻抗 "It is then natural to introduce a model parameter which directly controls the interpolation. We call this parameter impedance and denote it" 于是很自然地引入一个直接控制这种插值的模型参数。我们把这个参数称为阻抗，记作 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Parameters", para. 3 Diagonal approximation 对角近似 "The approximation (which is limited to the diagonal) is constructed using the “end-effector” inertias of all bodies, joints and tendons when the model is in the initial configuration mjModel.qpos0." 这种近似（仅限于对角线）用模型处于初始构型时所有刚体、关节和肌腱的“末端执行器”惯量构造，即 mjModel.qpos0。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Parameters", para. 4 Reference acceleration 参考加速度 "Next we explain how the reference acceleration is computed. As already mentioned, we use a spring-damper model parameterized by damping and stiffness coefficients element-wise:" 接下来说明参考加速度如何计算。如前所述，我们使用一个逐元素地由阻尼系数和刚度系数参数化的弹簧阻尼模型： Google DeepMind, n.d., "Parameters", para. 7 Adhesion 黏附 "the feasible force set is the friction cone translated down the contact normal" 可行力集合是沿接触法线向下平移后的摩擦锥 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Parameters", item 2 Friction cones 摩擦锥 "As explained above, MuJoCo allows both elliptic friction cones and pyramidal approximations to them; the selected solver determines which type of friction cone is used." 如前所述，MuJoCo 允许椭圆摩擦锥以及对它的棱锥近似；所选求解器决定使用哪种摩擦锥。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Friction cones", para. 1 References Google DeepMind. (n.d.). Computation. MuJoCo Documentation (Version 3.17.0). Retrieved October 31, 2026, from https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/computation/index.html

Google DeepMind, n.d., "Inertia model", para. 3 Viscous resistance 黏性阻力 "scale linearly with the body velocity, and approximate the fluid forces at low Reynolds numbers" 随刚体速度呈线性变化，近似低雷诺数下的流体力 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Inertia model", para. 4 Ellipsoid model 椭球模型 "In this section we describe and derive a stateless model of the forces exerted onto a moving rigid body by the surrounding fluid, based a reference frame aligned with the sides of the ellipsoid and moving with it." （语境）问题在一个与椭球各边对齐并随其运动的参考坐标系中描述。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Notation", para. 1 Reynolds number 雷诺数 "The Reynolds number is the ratio between inertial and viscous forces within a flow" 雷诺数是流动中惯性力与黏性力之比 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Notation", para. 2 Circulation 环量 "to denote circulation, which is the line integral of the 对于刚体运动，涡量是角速度的两倍。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Notation", para. 3 Ellipsoid projection 椭球投影 "the area projected by the ellipsoid onto the plane normal to" 椭球在法向平面上的投影面积 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Ellipsoid projection", lemma Added mass 附加质量 "For a body moving in a fluid, added mass or virtual mass measures the inertia of the fluid that is moved due to the body’s motion." 对于在流体中运动的物体，附加质量或虚拟质量度量因物体运动而被带动的流体的惯性。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Added mass", para. 1 Viscous drag 黏性拖曳 "The drag force acts to oppose the motion of the body relative to the surrounding flow." 拖曳力阻碍物体相对于周围流体的运动。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Viscous drag", para. 1 Viscous resistance 黏性阻力 "Finally the viscous resistance terms, also known as linear drag, well approvimate the fluid forces for Reynolds numbers around or below" 最后，黏性阻力项（也称线性阻力）能很好地近似雷诺数在某量级附近或以下时的流体力 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Viscous drag", para. 7 Viscous lift 黏性升力 (context) "In the next subsections we define two sources of circulation and the resulting lift forces." （语境）在接下来的小节中，我们定义两种环量来源以及由此产生的升力。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Viscous lift", para. 1 Kutta-Joukowski theorem 库塔-茹科夫斯基定理 "The Kutta-Joukowski theorem calculates Google DeepMind, n.d., "Magnus force", para. 2 Stagnation point 驻点 "A stagnation point is a location in the flow field where the velocity is zero." 驻点是流场中速度为零的位置。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Kutta condition", para. 1 Kutta condition 库塔条件 "A moving body with a sharp trailing (rear) edge will generate in the surrounding flow a circulation of sufficient strength to hold the rear stagnation point should be measured in the parent rather than child frame." jointinparent 传动专用于球关节和自由关节，规定转动应在父坐标系而不是子坐标系中度量。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Transmission", item 2 slider-crank 曲柄滑块传动 "slider-crank transmissions transform a linear force to a torque, as in a piston-driven combustion engine." slider-crank 传动把线性力转换为力矩，就像活塞驱动的内燃机那样。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Transmission", item 3 body 刚体传动 "body transmission corresponds to applying forces at contact points belonging to a body, in order to model vacuum grippers and biomechanical adhesive appendages." body 传动对应于在属于某个刚体的接触点上施加力，用于建模真空吸盘和生物力学中的黏附附肢。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Transmission", item 4 site 站点传动 "Site transmissions correspond to applying a Cartsian force/torque in the frame of a site." site 传动对应于在某个 site 的坐标系中施加笛卡尔力/力矩。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Transmission", item 5 Stateful actuators 有状态驱动器 "Some actuators such as pneumatic and hydraulic cylinders as well as biological muscles have an 被动力定义为只依赖于位置和速度的力，在正向动力学中不依赖于控制，在逆向动力学中不依赖于加速度。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Passive forces", para. 1 Spring-dampers 弹簧阻尼器 "MuJoCo can compute three types of passive forces: Spring-dampers in joints and MuJoCo 可以计算三种被动力：关节和肌腱中的弹簧阻尼器。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Passive forces", item 1 Gravity compensation forces 重力补偿力 (No definition) （无定义） Google DeepMind, n.d., "Passive forces" Fluid forces 流体力 "Fluid 阻尼多项式使用反对称化的偶次幂单项式 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Polynomial forces", item 1 Sign-preservation 保号 "In both cases, sensible choices of coefficients often satisfy the sign-preservation condition" 在两种情况下，合理选择的系数通常满足保号条件 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Polynomial forces", item 2 Numerical integration 数值积分 (context) "Four numerical integrators are available, three single-step integrators and the right-hand side of the velocity update is evaluated at the next time step" 速度更新右侧的加速度在下一个时间步上求值 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Numerical integration", para. 5 Implicit-in-velocity Euler 速度隐式欧拉法 "When the expansion is only with respect to velocity (and not position), the integrator is known as implicit-in-velocity Euler." 在展开只针对速度（而不针对位置）的情况下，这种积分器称为速度隐式欧拉法。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Numerical integration", para. 5 Gyroscopic derivatives for free bodies 自由刚体的陀螺导数 "Therefore for standalone free bodies (free bodies with no jointed descendants), these derivatives are reinstated." 因此，对于独立自由刚体（没有带关节后代的自由刚体），这些导数会被恢复。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Numerical integration", item 1 Standalone free bodies 独立自由刚体 "Therefore for standalone free bodies (free bodies with no jointed descendants), these derivatives are reinstated." 因此，对于独立自由刚体（没有带关节后代的自由刚体），这些导数会被恢复。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Numerical integration", item 1 Integrators 积分器 "MuJoCo supports five integrators: four MuJoCo 支持五种积分器：四种单步积分器和多步的四阶龙格-库塔积分器。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Integrators", para. 1 Semi-implicit with implicit joint damping (Euler) 带隐式关节阻尼的半隐式法（Euler） "only includes derivatives of joint damping" 只包含关节阻尼的导数 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Integrators", item 1 Implicit-in-velocity (implicit) 速度隐式法（implicit） "includes derivatives of all forces except the constraint forces" 包含除约束力以外所有力的导数 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Integrators", item 2 Fast implicit-in-velocity (implicitfast) 快速速度隐式法（implicitfast） "includes derivatives of all forces used in the implicit method, with the exception of the centripetal and Coriolis forces" 包含隐式方法所用的所有力的导数，但向心力和科里奥利力除外 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Integrators", item 3 Discrete-time (discrete) 离散时间法（discrete） "This integrator gives up that separation, in the tradition of the velocity-stepping schemes: the constraint solve and the implicit update are one operation whose solution is the step itself" 这种积分器沿袭速度步进格式的传统，放弃了这种分离：约束求解和隐式更新是同一个运算，其解就是这一步本身 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Integrators", item 4 4th-order Runge-Kutta (RK4) 四阶龙格-库塔法（RK4） "MuJoCo implements the fixed-step 4th-order Runge-Kutta method, though users can easily implement other integrators by calling mj_forward and integrating accelerations themselves." MuJoCo 实现了定步长的四阶龙格-库塔法，不过用户可以通过调用 mj_forward 并自行积分加速度，轻松实现其他积分器。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Integrators", item 5 The State 状态 "The state is entirely encapsulated in the mjData struct and consists of several components." 状态完全封装在 mjData 结构体中，由若干组成部分构成。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "The State", para. 2 References Google DeepMind. ai/mujoco/computation/simulation-pipelin.summary: 2.7 Simulation pipeline Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 2.7 Simulation pipeline 仿真流水线 (context) "Here we summarize the sequence of computations involved in forward and inverse dynamics respectively." （语境）这里分别概述正向动力学和逆向动力学所涉及的计算顺序。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Simulation pipeline", para. 1 Forward dynamics 正向动力学 (context) "The source file engine_forward.c contains the high-level forward dynamics pipeline." （语境）源文件 engine_forward.c 包含高层的正向动力学流水线。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Forward dynamics", para. 1 Top level 顶层 (context) "The top-level function mj_step invokes the entire sequence of stages below 1-26." （语境）顶层函数 mj_step 调用下面的全部阶段序列，即 1-26。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Top level", item 1 Stages 阶段 (context) "Below we describe the pipeline stages and API functions corresponding to each stage." （语境）下面介绍流水线的各个阶段以及与每个阶段对应的 API 函数。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Stages", para. 1 Position 位置阶段 "The stages below compute quantities that depend on the generalized positions mjData.qpos." 下面这些阶段计算依赖于广义位置的量，即 mjData.qpos。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Position", para. 1 Velocity 速度阶段 "The stages below compute quantities that depend on the generalized velocity mjData.qvel." 下面这些阶段计算依赖于广义速度的量，即 mjData.qvel。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Velocity", para. 1 Control callback 控制回调 "Invoke the user-defined control callback if defined" 如果定义了用户自定义的控制回调，就调用它 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Control callback", item 1 Force/acceleration 力/加速度阶段 "The stages below compute quantities that depend on user inputs." 下面这些阶段计算依赖于用户输入的量。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Force/acceleration", para. 1 Consistency in mjData mjData 的一致性 "The MuJoCo computation pipeline is entirely imperative, nothing happens automatically." MuJoCo 的仿真流水线完全确定且可复现：如果把轨迹中的某个状态保存后重新加载，再次调用 mj_step，得到的下一个状态将完全相同。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Reproducibility", para. 1 Inverse dynamics 逆向动力学 (context) "The top-level function mj_inverse invokes the following sequence of computations." （语境）顶层函数 mj_inverse 调用下面的计算序列。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Inverse dynamics", para. 1 References Google DeepMind. ai/mujoco/computation/sleeping-islands.h.summary: 2.6 Sleeping islands Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 2.6 Sleeping islands 休眠岛 (context) "Sleeping is a performance optimization whereby movable elements of the simulation that are detected to be stationary are temporarily removed from the pipeline (“put to sleep”)." （语境）休眠是一种性能优化：检测到静止不动的可动仿真元素会被暂时移出计算流水线（“使其休眠”）。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Sleeping islands", para. 1 Automatic 自动休眠 "A tree whose maximum velocity in absolute value is less than the tolerance for mjMINAWAKE time steps is marked as “ready to sleep”. If all trees in an island are ready to sleep, they are put to sleep during state advancement." 一棵树如果其最大速度的绝对值在 mjMINAWAKE 个时间步内都小于容差，就被标记为“准备休眠”。如果一个岛中的所有树都准备休眠，它们会在状态推进时进入休眠。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Sleeping islands", item 1 Initialized asleep 初始化为休眠 "By setting the body/sleep attribute of a tree root to “init”, it is marked as “initialized-asleep” and put to sleep during mjData initialization." 把树根的 body/sleep 属性设为“init”，它就会被标记为“初始化为休眠”，并在 mjData 初始化时进入休眠。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Sleeping islands", item 2 References Google DeepMind. ai/mujoco/computation/soft-contact-model.summary: 2.1 Soft contact model Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 2.1 Soft contact model 软接触模型 (No definition) （无定义） Google DeepMind, n.d., "Soft contact model" 2.1.0 Introduction 介绍 (No definition) （无定义） Google DeepMind, n.d., "Soft contact model" Linear complementarity (LCP) 线性互补（LCP） (context) "In the following sections we discuss its benefits, while clarifying the differences from the linear complementarity (LCP) family of contact models which are the de facto standard." （语境）在接下来的几节中，我们讨论它的优点，同时说明它与线性互补（LCP）这一族接触模型的区别，后者是事实上的标准。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Soft contact model", para. 1 Physical realism and soft contacts 物理真实性与软接触 "So the deviations from LCP actually increase physical realism in the presence of soft contacts." 因此，在存在软接触时，对 LCP 的偏离实际上提高了物理真实性。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Physical realism and soft contacts", para. 2 Convex models 凸模型 "Many of the advantages of our contact model can be traced to the fact that we drop the strict complementarity constraint at the heart of the LCP formulation. We will call this family of models convex; see References for related work." 我们接触模型的许多优点可以归因于我们去掉了 LCP 表述核心的严格互补约束。我们把这一类模型称为凸模型；相关工作见参考文献。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Physical realism and soft contacts", para. 1 Continuous time 连续时间 "The present model is defined in continuous-time, in terms of forces and accelerations." 本模型是在连续时间中、用力和加速度定义的。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Continuous time", para. 2 Inverse dynamics and optimization 逆向动力学与优化 "The objective of inverse dynamics is to recover the applied force and contact force given the position, velocity and acceleration of the multi-joint system." 逆向动力学的目标是在已知多关节系统的位置、速度和加速度时，求出施加力和接触力。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Inverse dynamics and optimization", para. 1 Space-time optimization 时空优化 "They make it possible to treat the sequence of positions (or a parametric representation thereof) as the object being optimized. This is interchangeably called space-time optimization, spectral method, direct collocation." 它们使得可以把位置序列（或其参数化表示）当作被优化的对象。然后通过对位置求导得到速度和加速度；用逆向动力学计算施加力和接触力；最后构造一个可以依赖上述所有量的目标函数。这种做法也称为时空优化、谱方法、直接配点法。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Inverse dynamics and optimization", para. 2 References Google DeepMind. (n.d.). Computation. MuJoCo Documentation (Version 3.17.0). Retrieved October 31, 2026, from https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/computation/index.html
