ai/mujoco/modeling/mjcf-mechanisms.html.summary: 3.1 MJCF Mechanisms Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 3.1 MJCF Mechanisms MJCF 机制 (context) "MJCF uses several mechanisms for model creation which span multiple model elements." （语境）MJCF 使用若干跨越多个模型元素的模型创建机制。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "MJCF Mechanisms", para. 1 Kinematic tree 运动学树 "The main part of the MJCF file is an XML tree created by nested body elements." MJCF 文件的主体是由嵌套的 body 元素构成的 XML 树。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Kinematic tree", para. 1 worldbody 世界刚体 "The top-level body is special and is called worldbody." 顶层刚体很特殊，称为 worldbody。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Kinematic tree", para. 1 Default settings 默认设置 "MJCF has an elaborate mechanism for setting default attribute values." MJCF 有一套精细的机制来设置属性默认值。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Default settings", para. 1 Defaults classes 默认类 "MuJoCo supports unlimited number of defaults classes, created by possibly nested default elements in the XML." MuJoCo 支持数量不限的默认类，它们由 XML 中可以嵌套的 default 元素创建。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Default settings", para. 4 Dummy elements 虚拟元素 "The dummy elements contained in the defaults classes are not part of the model; they are only used to initialize the attribute values of the actual model elements." 默认类中包含的虚拟元素不是模型的一部分；它们只用来初始化实际模型元素的属性值。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Default settings", para. 5 Active defaults class 当前默认类 "There is always an active defaults class, which can be determined in one of three ways." 总有一个当前生效的默认类，它可以用三种方式之一确定。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Default settings", para. 5 Undefined state 未定义状态 "Some attributes, such as body inertia, can be in a special undefined state. This instructs the compiler to infer the corresponding value from other information, in this case the inertias of the geoms attached to the body." 有些属性（例如刚体惯量）可以处于一种特殊的未定义状态。它指示编译器从其他信息推断相应的值，在这个例子中是附着在刚体上的 geom 的惯量。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Default settings", para. 6 Coordinate frames 坐标系 "The positions and orientations of all elements defined in the kinematic tree are expressed in local coordinates, relative to the parent body for bodies, and relative to the body that contains the element for geoms, joints, sites, cameras and lights." 运动学树中定义的所有元素的位置和朝向都用局部坐标表示：刚体相对于父刚体，geom、关节、site、相机和光源相对于包含它们的刚体。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Coordinate frames", para. 1 Frame orientations 坐标系朝向 "Specifying 3D positions is straightforward, but specifying 3D orientations can be challenging. This is why MJCF provides several alternative mechanisms." 指定三维位置很简单，但指定三维朝向可能很困难。这就是为什么 MJCF 提供了几种可选的机制。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Frame orientations", para. 1 Spatial frame 空间坐标系 "A spatial frame is defined by its position and orientation." 空间坐标系由它的位置和朝向定义。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Frame orientations", para. 1 Solver parameters 求解器参数 "The constraint solver finds forces that satisfy soft constraints, parameterized by three quantities" 约束求解器求出满足软约束的力，软约束由三个量参数化 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Solver parameters", para. 1 Impedance 阻抗 "corresponds to a constraint’s ability to generate force" 对应于约束产生力的能力 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Impedance", note Reference 参考加速度 "determines the motion that constraint is trying to achieve in order to rectify violation" 决定约束为纠正违反而试图实现的运动 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Reference", note Time constant 时间常数 "By “time constant” we mean the inverse of the natural frequency times the damping ratio." 所谓“时间常数”，我们指的是固有频率与阻尼比乘积的倒数。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Reference", item 1 Friction 摩擦 "Friction loss constraints (in joints and tendons) and friction dimensions of elliptic contact cones have zero position violation" 摩擦损失约束（关节和肌腱中的）和椭圆接触锥的摩擦维度位置违反为零 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Friction", para. 1 Contact parameters 接触参数 (context) "In that case we use the geom attributes solmix and priority to decide how to combine them." （语境）此时我们用 geom 属性 solmix 和 priority 决定如何组合它们。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Contact parameters", para. 1 Contact override 接触覆盖 "In order to facilitate this process, we provide a mechanism to override some of the solver parameters, without making changes to the actual model." 为了方便这个过程，我们提供了一种覆盖部分求解器参数的机制，而无需修改实际模型。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Contact override", para. 1 User parameters 用户参数 "A number of MJCF elements have the optional attribute user, which defines a custom element-specific parameter array." 许多 MJCF 元素有可选属性 user，它定义一个元素专属的自定义参数数组。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "User parameters", para. 1 Solver settings 求解器设置 "MuJoCo has three algorithms for solving this optimization problem: Newton, CG, PGS." MuJoCo 有三种求解这个优化问题的算法：Newton、CG、PGS。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Solver settings", para. 1 Actuators 驱动器 (context) "This section describes various aspects of using actuators in MuJoCo." （语境）本节介绍在 MuJoCo 中使用驱动器的各个方面。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Actuators", para. 1 Group disable 分组禁用 "The actuatorgroupdisable attribute, which can be changed at runtime by setting the mjOption.disableactuator integer bitfield, allows the user to disable sets of actuators according to their group." actuatorgroupdisable 属性可以在运行时通过设置 mjOption.disableactuator 整数位域来改变，它让用户按分组禁用若干组驱动器。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Group disable", para. 1 Shortcuts 快捷方式 "In addition, MJCF provides shortcuts for configuring common actuators." 此外，MJCF 提供了用于配置常见驱动器的快捷方式。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Shortcuts", para. 1 Force limits 力限制 "Actuator forces are usually limited between lower and upper bounds." 驱动器的力通常被限制在下界和上界之间。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Force limits", para. 1 Control clamping with ctrlrange 用 ctrlrange 截断控制量 "If this actuator attribute is set, the input control value will be clamped." 如果设置了这个驱动器属性，输入的控制值会被截断。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Force limits", item 1 Force clamping at actuator output with forcerange 用 forcerange 在驱动器输出端截断力 "If this actuator attribute is set, the actuator’s output force will be clamped." 如果设置了这个驱动器属性，驱动器的输出力会被截断。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Force limits", item 2 Force clamping at joint input with joint/actuatorfrcrange 用 joint/actuatorfrcrange 在关节输入端截断力 "This joint attribute clamps input forces from all actuators acting on the joint, after passing through the transmission." 这个关节属性在经过传动之后，截断所有作用在该关节上的驱动器输入力。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Force limits", item 3 Force clamping at tendon input with tendon/actuatorfrcrange 用 tendon/actuatorfrcrange 在肌腱输入端截断力 "This tendon attribute clamps input forces from all actuators acting on the tendon." 这个肌腱属性截断所有作用在该肌腱上的驱动器输入力。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Force limits", item 4 Length range 长度范围 "The field mjModel.actuator_lengthrange contains the range of feasible actuator lengths (or more precisely, lengths of the actuator’s transmission)." 字段 mjModel.actuator_lengthrange 包含驱动器可行长度的范围（更准确地说，是驱动器传动的长度）。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Length range", para. 1 Stateful actuators 有状态驱动器 "As described in the Actuation model section of the Computation chapter, MuJoCo supports actuators with internal dynamics whose states are called “activations”." 如计算一章的驱动模型一节所述，MuJoCo 支持具有内部动力学的驱动器，其状态称为“激活”。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Stateful actuators", para. 1 Activation limits 激活限制 "In the case of integrated-velocity actuators, it is often desirable to clamp the activation state, since otherwise the position target would keep integrating beyond the joint limits, leading to loss of controllabillity." 对于积分速度驱动器，通常希望截断激活状态，否则位置目标会一直积分到超出关节限位，导致失去可控性。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Activation limits", para. 2 Integrated-velocity actuator 积分速度驱动器 "Different from the pure velocity actuators, which implement direct feedback on transmission target’s velocity, integrated-velocity actuators couple an integrator with a position-feedback actuator." 与对传动目标速度直接反馈的纯速度驱动器不同，积分速度驱动器把一个积分器与一个位置反馈驱动器耦合起来。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Activation limits", para. 1 Muscles 肌肉 "We provide a set of tools for modeling biological muscles." 我们提供了一套建模生物肌肉的工具。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Muscles", para. 1 Muscle-tendon actuator 肌肉-肌腱驱动器 "In biomechanics, a muscle and a tendon are attached in series and form a muscle-tendon actuator." 在生物力学中，肌肉和肌腱串联连接，构成肌肉-肌腱驱动器。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Muscles", para. 4 Optimal resting length 最优静息长度 "Another important constant is the optimal resting length of the muscle" 另一个重要常数是肌肉的最优静息长度 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Muscles", para. 5 Force-Length-Velocity (FLV) function 力-长度-速度（FLV）函数 "The behavior is captured by the Force-Length-Velocity" 这种行为由力-长度-速度函数刻画 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Muscles", para. 7 Muscle activation 肌肉激活 "Coming back to our muscle model, there is the muscle activation act. This is the state of a first-order nonlinear filter whose input is the control signal." 回到我们的肌肉模型，还有肌肉激活 act。它是一个以控制信号为输入的一阶非线性滤波器的状态。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Muscles", para. 13 Pennation angle 羽状角 "Pennation angle (i.e., the angle between the muscle and the line of force) is not modeled in MuJoCo and is assumed to be 0." 羽状角（即肌肉与力作用线之间的夹角）在 MuJoCo 中不建模，假定为 0。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Muscles", Relation to OpenSim, para. 5 Inverse wrap 反向缠绕 "We also allow “side sites” to be placed inside the sphere or cylinder, which causes an inverse wrap: the tendon path is constrained to pass through the object instead of going around it." 我们还允许把“侧 site”放在球体或圆柱体内部，这会造成反向缠绕：肌腱路径被约束为穿过物体，而不是绕过它。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Muscles", Relation to OpenSim, para. 6 Sensors 传感器 "Sensors do not affect the simulation. Instead their outputs are copied in the array mjData.sensordata and are available for user processing." 传感器不影响仿真。它们的输出被复制到数组 mjData.sensordata 中，供用户处理。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Sensors", para. 1 Delays 延迟 "Both actuators and sensors support time delays via a ring buffer that stores timestamped samples." 驱动器和传感器都通过一个存储带时间戳样本的环形缓冲区支持时间延迟。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Delays", para. 1 Sensor Modes 传感器模式 "Sensors support both delay and interval/period attributes. The combination determines behavior:" 传感器同时支持 delay 和 interval/period 属性。二者的组合决定其行为： Google DeepMind, n.d., "Delays", para. 5 History-only 仅历史 "History-only: computed every step, written to sensordata , pushed into history buffer" 仅历史：每步计算，写入 sensordata，推入历史缓冲区 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Delays", table, row 1 Delayed 延迟 "Delayed: computed every step, sensordata contains delayed reading (read from buffer)" 延迟：每步计算，sensordata 包含延迟读数（从缓冲区读取） Google DeepMind, n.d., "Delays", table, row 2 Periodic 周期 "Periodic: computed on period, sensordata contains last computed value (no delay)" 周期：按周期计算，sensordata 包含最近一次计算的值（无延迟） Google DeepMind, n.d., "Delays", table, row 3 Periodic + Delayed 周期 + 延迟 "Periodic + Delayed: computed on period, sensordata contains delayed reading (read from buffer)" 周期 + 延迟：按周期计算，sensordata 包含延迟读数（从缓冲区读取） Google DeepMind, n.d., "Delays", table, row 4 Initialization 初始化 (context) "History buffers are initialized by mj_resetData as follows:" （语境）历史缓冲区由 mj_resetData 初始化，方式如下： Google DeepMind, n.d., "Delays", para. 6 Causality and interpolation 因果性与插值 (context) "The most common positive delay value is delay = timestep * nsample, which implements a simple history buffer, with no causality issues." （语境）最常见的正延迟值是 delay = timestep * nsample，它实现一个简单的历史缓冲区，不存在因果性问题。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Delays", para. 8 Cameras 相机 "Besides the default, user-controllable, free camera, “fixed” cameras can be attached to the kinematic tree." 除了默认的、用户可控的自由相机之外，还可以把“固定”相机附着到运动学树上。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Cameras", para. 1 Extrinsics 外参 "By default, camera frames are attached to the containing body." 默认情况下，相机坐标系附着在包含它的刚体上。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Cameras", item 1 Projection 投影 "Cameras use perspective projection by default. Setting projection to orthographic switches to an orthographic projection, where the fovy attribute is interpreted as the vertical extent in length units rather than degrees." 相机默认使用透视投影。把 projection 设为 orthographic 会切换到正交投影，此时 fovy 属性被解释为以长度单位表示的垂直范围，而不是角度。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Cameras", item 2 Intrinsics 内参 "Camera intrinsics are specified using ipd (inter-pupilary distance, required for stereoscopic rendering and VR) and fovy (vertical field of view, in degrees)." 相机内参用 ipd（瞳距，立体渲染和 VR 需要）和 fovy（垂直视场角，以度为单位）指定。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Cameras", item 3 Composite objects 复合物体 "Composite objects are collections of existing elements originally designed to simulate particle systems, ropes, cloth, and soft bodies." 复合物体是现有元素的集合，最初设计用来仿真粒子系统、绳索、布料和软体。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Composite objects", para. 1 Element bodies 单元刚体 "Composite objects are made up of regular MuJoCo bodies, which we call “element bodies” in this context." 复合物体由常规的 MuJoCo 刚体组成，在这里我们称之为“单元刚体”。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Composite objects", para. 2 Cable 缆绳 "The cable simulates an inextensible elastic 1D object having twist and bending stiffness." 缆绳仿真一个具有扭转刚度和弯曲刚度、不可伸长的一维弹性物体。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Composite objects", para. 5 Deformable objects 可变形物体 "In MuJoCo 3.0 we have introduced true deformable objects involving new model elements." 在 MuJoCo 3.0 中，我们引入了涉及新模型元素的真正可变形物体。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Deformable objects", para. 1 Flex 柔性体 "A flex is a collection of MuJoCo bodies that are connected with massless stretchable elements." flex 是一组由无质量可拉伸单元连接起来的 MuJoCo 刚体。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Deformable objects", para. 2 flexcomp flexcomp 元素 "To aid with modeling, we have further introduced the element flexcomp which automates the creation of the low-level flex, similar to how composite automates the creation of (collections of) MuJoCo objects needed to emulate a soft body." 为了辅助建模，我们进一步引入了元素 flexcomp，它自动创建低层的 flex，类似于 composite 自动创建模拟软体所需的（一组）MuJoCo 对象。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Deformable objects", para. 1 Rigid flex 刚性柔性体 "It is also possible to create a rigid flex, by assigning all vertices to the same body." 也可以创建刚性 flex，方法是把所有顶点都分配给同一个刚体。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Deformable objects", para. 3 Deformation model 变形模型 "Instead, the design philosophy is to use a single set of parameters and provide two modeling choices: a new (soft) equality constraint type that applies to all edges of a given flex, which permits large time steps, or a discretized continuum representation, where each element is in a constant stress state, which is equivalent to piecewise linear finite elements and achieves improved realism and accuracy." 设计思路是使用同一组参数，并提供两种建模选择：一种新的（软）等式约束类型，作用于给定 flex 的所有边，允许较大的时间步；或一种离散化的连续体表示，其中每个单元处于常应力状态，等价于分段线性有限元，可以提高真实性和精度。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Deformable objects", para. 4 Edge-based model 基于边的模型 "The edge-based model could be seen as a “lumped” stiffness model, where the correct coupling of deformation modes (e.g. shear and volumetric) is averaged in a single quantity." 基于边的模型可以看作一种“集总”刚度模型，变形模式（例如剪切和体积）之间的正确耦合被平均为单个量。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Deformable objects", para. 4 Continuum model 连续体模型 "The continuum model enables instead to specify shear and volumetric stiffnesses separately using the Poisson’s ratio of the material." 连续体模型则可以利用材料的泊松比分别指定剪切刚度和体积刚度。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Deformable objects", para. 4 Parametrization types 参数化类型 "While the default behavior of flexcomp produces a “full” flex where every node corresponds to a MuJoCo body, it also supports specialized parametrizations for volumetric objects: trilinear and quadratic." flexcomp 的默认行为生成“完全”flex，其中每个节点对应一个 MuJoCo 刚体，但它也支持针对体积物体的专门参数化：三线性和二次。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Deformable objects", para. 5 Full flex 完全柔性体 "While the default behavior of flexcomp produces a “full” flex where every node corresponds to a MuJoCo body, it also supports specialized parametrizations for volumetric objects: trilinear and quadratic." flexcomp 的默认行为生成每个节点都对应一个 MuJoCo 刚体的“完全”flex，但它也支持针对体积物体的专门参数化：三线性和二次。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Deformable objects", para. 5 Trilinear 三线性 "Trilinear flexes use 8-node hexahedral cells with linear interpolation along each axis, while quadratic flexes use 27-node cells with quadratic interpolation, allowing for curved deformation modes." 三线性 flex 使用 8 节点六面体单元，沿每个轴线性插值，而二次 flex 使用 27 节点单元和二次插值，允许弯曲的变形模式。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Deformable objects", para. 5 Quadratic 二次 "Trilinear flexes use 8-node hexahedral cells with linear interpolation along each axis, while quadratic flexes use 27-node cells with quadratic interpolation, allowing for curved deformation modes." 三线性 flex 使用 8 节点六面体单元，沿每个轴线性插值，而二次 flex 使用 27 节点单元和二次插值，允许弯曲的变形模式。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Deformable objects", para. 5 Including files 包含文件 "MJCF files can include other XML files using the include element." MJCF 文件可以用 include 元素包含其他 XML 文件。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Including files", para. 1 Naming elements 元素命名 "Most model elements in MJCF can have names. They are defined with the attribute name of the corresponding XML element. When a given model element is named, its name must be unique among all elements of the same type." MJCF 中的大多数模型元素都可以有名称。名称用相应 XML 元素的 name 属性定义。当某个模型元素有名称时，它的名称必须在同类型的所有元素中唯一。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Naming elements", para. 1 URDF extensions URDF 扩展 "In addition to standard URDF files, MuJoCo can load files that have a custom (from the viewpoint of URDF) mujoco element as a child of the top-level element robot." 除了标准 URDF 文件，MuJoCo 还能加载这样的文件：它有一个（从 URDF 的角度看是自定义的）mujoco 元素，作为顶层元素 robot 的子元素。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "URDF extensions", para. 1 Unified Robot Description Format (URDF) 统一机器人描述格式（URDF） "The Unified Robot Description Format (URDF) is a popular XML file format in which many existing robots have been modeled." 统一机器人描述格式（URDF）是一种流行的 XML 文件格式，许多现有机器人都用它建模。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "URDF extensions", para. 1 MoCap bodies 动作捕捉刚体 "mocap bodies are static children of the world (i.e., have no joints) and their mocap attribute is set to “true”." mocap 刚体是世界的静态子刚体（即没有关节），并且其 mocap 属性设为“true”。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "MoCap bodies", para. 1 Weld group 焊接组 "Mocap bodies and their dof-less descendants form their own weld group, rooted at the mocap body" mocap 刚体及其无自由度的后代构成自己的焊接组，以该 mocap 刚体为根 Google DeepMind, n.d., "MoCap bodies", para. 2 Memory allocation 内存分配 "MuJoCo preallocates all the memory needed at runtime in mjData, and does not access the heap allocator after model creation." MuJoCo 在 mjData 中预先分配运行时所需的全部内存，模型创建之后不再访问堆分配器。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Memory allocation", para. 1 Assets by reference 按引用的资源 "An asset in mjModel is embedded when its payload is in the model buffer, which is the default, or by reference when the model holds a resolved path and the parameters a consumer needs to load it, and no payload." mjModel 中的资源，如果其载荷在模型缓冲区中，就是嵌入的，这是默认情况；如果模型持有一个已解析的路径和使用方加载它所需的参数，而没有载荷，就是按引用的。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Assets by reference", para. 1 Embedded 嵌入 "An asset in mjModel is embedded when its payload is in the model buffer, which is the default, or by reference when the model holds a resolved path and the parameters a consumer needs to load it, and no payload." mjModel 中的资源，如果其载荷在模型缓冲区中，就是嵌入的，这是默认情况；如果模型持有一个已解析的路径和使用方加载它所需的参数，而没有载荷，就是按引用的。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Assets by reference", para. 1 References Google DeepMind. (n.d.). Modeling. MuJoCo Documentation (Version 3.17.0). Retrieved October 31, 2026, from https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/modeling.html

ai/mujoco/mujoco-warp/batch-rendering.ht.title: 9.3 Batch Rendering | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
ai/mujoco/mujoco-warp/batch-rendering.ht.summary: 9.3 Batch Rendering Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 9.3 Batch Rendering 批量渲染 "MJWarp provides a batch renderer for high-throughput ray tracing built on Warp’s accelerated BVHs for rendering worlds with multiple cameras in parallel." MJWarp 提供一个用于高吞吐光线追踪的批量渲染器，它基于 Warp 加速的 BVH，可用多个相机并行渲染多个世界。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Batch Rendering", para. 1 Key features 主要特性 (No definition) （无定义） Google DeepMind, n.d., "Batch Rendering" Mesh rendering with textures 带纹理的网格渲染 "Mesh rendering with textures: BVH-accelerated mesh rendering with full texture support." 带纹理的网格渲染：BVH 加速的网格渲染，完整支持纹理。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Batch Rendering", item 1 Heightfield rendering 高度场渲染 "Heightfield rendering: Optimized rendering for heightfields." 高度场渲染：针对高度场优化的渲染。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Batch Rendering", item 2 Flex rendering 柔性体渲染 "Flex rendering: Render flex objects." 柔性体渲染：渲染柔性体对象。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Batch Rendering", item 3 Lighting and shadows 光照与阴影 "Lighting and shadows: Dynamic lighting with configurable shadows; domain randomizable: light_active, light_type, light_castshadow, light_xpos, light_xdir." 光照与阴影：可配置阴影的动态光照；可做域随机化：light_active、light_type、light_castshadow、light_xpos、light_xdir。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Batch Rendering", item 5 Heterogeneous multi-camera 异构多相机 "Heterogeneous multi-camera: Multiple cameras per world and each camera can have a different resolution (cam_resolution), field of view (cam_fovy, cam_sensorsize, cam_intrinsic), and output mode (cam_output)." 异构多相机：每个世界有多个相机，每个相机可以有不同的分辨率（cam_resolution）、视场（cam_fovy、cam_sensorsize、cam_intrinsic）和输出模式（cam_output）。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Batch Rendering", item 6 Domain Randomization 域随机化 "Domain Randomization: Per-world mjw.Model fields (see Batched Model Fields above): geom_matid, geom_size, geom_rgba, mat_texid, mat_texrepeat, mat_rgba." 域随机化：按世界区分的 mjw.Model 字段（见上文的批量模型字段）：geom_matid、geom_size、geom_rgba、mat_texid、mat_texrepeat、mat_rgba。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Batch Rendering", item 7 BVH-accelerated ray/rays API BVH 加速的 ray/rays API "BVH-accelerated ray/rays API: Ray casting: Accelerated mjw.ray, mjw.rays, and rangefinder sensors via Warp’s BVHs." BVH 加速的 ray/rays API：光线投射：借助 Warp 的 BVH 加速 mjw.ray、mjw.rays 和测距传感器。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Batch Rendering", item 8 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) 三维高斯泼溅（3DGS） "MJWarp supports rendering 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) scenes composited with simulated physical MuJoCo objects." MJWarp 支持渲染与仿真的 MuJoCo 物理对象合成在一起的三维高斯泼溅（3DGS）场景。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS)", para. 1 Physical Occlusion 物理遮挡 "If a camera ray hits a physical body (such as a mesh, primitive, or flex), splats located behind the hit distance (dist) are occluded by the physical object, while splats in front of the hit distance are blended over the physical object’s surface color." 如果相机光线击中一个物理刚体（如网格、基本几何体或柔性体），位于击中距离（dist）之后的泼溅点会被该物理对象遮挡，而位于击中距离之前的泼溅点会混合到该物理对象的表面颜色之上。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Physical Occlusion", para. 1 Per-World Splat Groups 按世界区分的泼溅组 "Similar to per-world meshes, MJWarp supports heterogeneous per-world 3DGS scenes." 与按世界区分的网格类似，MJWarp 支持异构的、按世界区分的 3DGS 场景。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Per-World Splat Groups", para. 1 Dynamic Splat Refitting 动态泼溅重拟合 (context) "If splat positions, rotations, or scales change dynamically during simulation (e.g., splats attached to moving rigid bodies), call mjw.refit_splat_bvh before rendering:" （语境）如果泼溅点的位置、旋转或尺度在仿真中动态变化（例如附着在运动刚体上的泼溅点），应在渲染前调用 mjw.refit_splat_bvh： Google DeepMind, n.d., "Dynamic Splat Refitting", para. 1 Performance & Raycasting Thresholds 性能与光线投射阈值 (No definition) （无定义） Google DeepMind, n.d., "Performance & Raycasting Thresholds" BVH Response Cutoff BVH 响应截断 "BVH Response Cutoff: Splat bounding boxes are sized to contain density responses down to SPLAT_MIN_RESPONSE = 0.01." BVH 响应截断：泼溅点包围盒的大小足以包含低至 SPLAT_MIN_RESPONSE = 0.01 的密度响应。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Performance & Raycasting Thresholds", item 1 Bounded Compositing 有界合成 "Bounded Compositing: Raycasting accumulates up to the first _MAX_SPLAT_HITS = 32 BVH intersections per ray ordered by depth." 有界合成：光线投射对每条光线最多累积按深度排序的前 _MAX_SPLAT_HITS = 32 个 BVH 交点。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Performance & Raycasting Thresholds", item 2 Early Termination 提前终止 "Early Termination: Compositing stops early once remaining ray transmittance drops below 0.005 or individual splat alpha is below 8-bit quantization (1 / 255)." 提前终止：一旦剩余的光线透射率降到 0.005 以下，或单个泼溅点的 alpha 低于 8 位量化精度（1 / 255），合成就提前停止。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Performance & Raycasting Thresholds", item 3 References Google DeepMind. (n.d.). MuJoCo Warp (MJWarp). MuJoCo Documentation (Version 3.17.0). Retrieved October 31, 2026, from https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/mjwarp/index.html

ai/mujoco/mujoco-warp/differences-from-m.title: 9.4 Differences from MuJoCo | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
ai/mujoco/mujoco-warp/differences-from-m.summary: 9.4 Differences from MuJoCo Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 9.4 Differences from MuJoCo 与 MuJoCo 的差异 (No definition) （无定义） Google DeepMind, n.d., "Differences from MuJoCo" Warmstart 热启动 (context) "If warmstarts are not disabled, the MJWarp solver warmstart always initializes the acceleration with qacc_warmstart." （语境）如果没有禁用热启动，MJWarp 求解器的热启动总是用 qacc_warmstart 初始化加速度。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Warmstart", para. 1 Inertia matrix factorization 惯性矩阵分解 "MJWarp performs a per-tree factorization of the inertia matrix that is stored in qLD where the size of the tree determines if Warp’s U'U Cholesky factorization wp.tile_cholesky, MuJoCo’s sparse reverse-mode L'DL routine, or a simple diagonal inverse routine is employed." MJWarp 对惯性矩阵进行按树的分解，结果存放在 qLD 中，由树的大小决定采用 Warp 的 U'U Cholesky 分解 wp.tile_cholesky、MuJoCo 的稀疏反向 L'DL 例程，还是简单的对角求逆例程。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Inertia matrix factorization", para. 1 Options 选项 (context) "mjw.Option fields correspond to their mjOption counterparts with the following exceptions:" （语境）mjw.Option 的字段与 mjOption 中的对应字段一一对应，但有以下例外： Google DeepMind, n.d., "Options", para. 1 SDF plugins SDF 插件 (context) "SDF collisions support plugins." （语境）SDF 碰撞支持插件。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "SDF plugins", para. 1 Physics callbacks 物理回调 (context) "MJWarp supports a similar mechanism, but callbacks are Python functions set per-model on the mjw.Model instance via Model.callback rather than as global function pointers." （语境）MJWarp 支持类似的机制，但回调是通过 Model.callback 按模型设置在 mjw.Model 实例上的 Python 函数，而不是全局函数指针。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Physics callbacks", para. 1 Pair-wise colliders 成对碰撞器 (context) "The table below provides information about the colliders and maximum number of contacts generated for different geom pairs in MJWarp." （语境）下表给出了 MJWarp 中不同 geom 对所用的碰撞器以及生成的最大接触数。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Pair-wise colliders", para. 1 Box-box collisions 盒盒碰撞 (context) "By default, box-box collisions use the general-purpose convex collision pipeline (GJK/EPA)." （语境）默认情况下，盒与盒的碰撞使用通用的凸碰撞流水线（GJK/EPA）。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Box-box collisions", para. 1 Rendering 渲染 (context) "The MJWarp batch renderer is a single hit raycaster optimized for high throughput and low fidelity." （语境）MJWarp 批量渲染器是一个针对高吞吐、低保真优化的单次命中光线投射器。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Rendering", para. 1 References Google DeepMind. (n.d.). MuJoCo Warp (MJWarp). MuJoCo Documentation (Version 3.17.0). Retrieved October 31, 2026, from https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/mjwarp/index.html

MuJoCo Warp Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 9 MuJoCo Warp MuJoCo Warp "MuJoCo Warp (MJWarp) is an implementation of MuJoCo written in Warp and optimized for NVIDIA hardware and parallel simulation." MuJoCo Warp（MJWarp）是用 Warp 编写、针对 NVIDIA 硬件和并行仿真优化的 MuJoCo 实现。 Google DeepMind, n.d.-a, "MuJoCo Warp (MJWarp)", para. 1 9.1 Feature Parity 功能对等 (context) "MJWarp supports most of the main simulation features of MuJoCo, with a few exceptions." （语境）MJWarp 支持 MuJoCo 的大部分主要仿真功能，只有少数例外。 Google DeepMind, n.d.-a, "Feature Parity", para. 1 9.2 Batched Model Fields 批量模型字段 (context) "To enable batched simulation with different model parameter values, many mjw.Model fields have a leading batch dimension." （语境）为了支持用不同模型参数值进行批量仿真，许多 mjw.Model 字段带有一个前置的批量维度。 Google DeepMind, n.d.-a, "Batched Model Fields", para. 1 9.3 Batch Rendering 批量渲染 "MJWarp provides a batch renderer for high-throughput ray tracing built on Warp’s accelerated BVHs for rendering worlds with multiple cameras in parallel." ai/mujoco/overview/index.html.title: 1. Overview | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
ai/mujoco/overview/index.html.summary: 1. Overview Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 1 Overview 概述 (context) "MuJoCo is a C/C++ library with a C API, intended for researchers and developers." （语境）MuJoCo 是一个提供 C API 的 C/C++ 库，面向研究人员和开发者。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Introduction", para. 2 1.1 Model elements 模型元素 (No definition) （无定义） Google DeepMind, n.d., "Model elements" Key features 主要特性 (context) "MuJoCo has a long list of features. Here we outline the most notable ones." （语境）MuJoCo 有一长串特性。这里概述其中最值得注意的几项。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Key features", para. 1 Generalized coordinates combined with modern contact dynamics 广义坐标结合现代接触动力学 "MuJoCo pioneered the combination of simulation in generalized coordinates with optimization-based contact dynamics." MuJoCo 开创了在广义坐标中仿真与基于优化的接触动力学相结合的做法。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Key features", item 1 Soft, convex and analytically-invertible contact dynamics 软的、凸的、可解析求逆的接触动力学 "MuJoCo is based on a different formulation of the physics of contact which reduces to a convex optimization problem, as explained in detail in the Computation chapter." MuJoCo 基于一种不同的接触物理表述，它归结为一个凸优化问题，计算一章对此有详细说明。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Key features", item 2 Tendon geometry 肌腱几何 "MuJoCo can model the 3D geometry of tendons – which are minimum-path-length strings obeying wrapping and via-point constraints." MuJoCo 可以建模肌腱的三维几何：肌腱是服从缠绕约束和途经点约束的最短路径长度的绳索。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Key features", item 3 General actuation model 通用驱动模型 "MuJoCo achieves this goal by adopting an abstract actuation model that can have different types of transmission, force generation, and internal dynamics (i.e., state variables which make the overall dynamics 3rd order)." MuJoCo 通过采用一个抽象的驱动模型来实现这一目标，它可以有不同类型的传动、力生成和内部动力学（即使整体动力学成为三阶的状态变量）。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Key features", item 4 Reconfigurable computation pipeline 可重新配置的计算流水线 "To this end MuJoCo provides a large number of flags which can be set in any combination, allowing the user to reconfigure the pipeline as needed, beyond the selection of algorithms and algorithm parameters via options." 为此 MuJoCo 提供了大量可以任意组合设置的标志，让用户按需重新配置流水线，这超出了通过选项选择算法和算法参数的范围。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Key features", item 5 Model compilation 模型编译 "This model is then compiled by the built-in compiler into the low-level data structure mjModel, which is cross-indexed and optimized for runtime computation." 然后这个模型由内置编译器编译成低层数据结构 mjModel，它经过交叉索引，并针对运行时计算做了优化。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Key features", item 6 MJCF MJCF "As mentioned above, the user defines a MuJoCo model in an XML file format called MJCF." 如上所述，用户用一种名为 MJCF 的 XML 文件格式定义 MuJoCo 模型。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Key features", item 6 MJB MJB "The compiled model can also be saved in a binary MJB file." 编译后的模型也可以保存为二进制 MJB 文件。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Key features", item 6 Separation of model and data 模型与数据分离 "MuJoCo separates simulation parameters into two data structures (C structs) at runtime:" MuJoCo 在运行时把仿真参数分到两个数据结构（C 结构体）中： Google DeepMind, n.d., "Key features", item 7 mjModel mjModel "mjModel contains the model description and is expected to remain constant." mjModel 包含模型描述，预期保持不变。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Key features", item 7 mjData mjData "mjData contains all dynamic variables and intermediate results." mjData 包含所有动态变量和中间结果。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Key features", item 7 Performance 性能 "MuJoCo’s runtime performs zero memory allocations after initialization – all working memory is preallocated in mjData." MuJoCo 的运行时在初始化之后不做任何内存分配：所有工作内存都预先分配在 mjData 中。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Key features", item 8 Interactive simulation and visualization 交互式仿真与可视化 "The native 3D visualizer provides rendering of meshes and geometric primitives, textures, reflections, shadows, fog, transparency, wireframes, skyboxes, stereoscopic visualization (on video cards supporting quad-buffered OpenGL)." 原生三维可视化器提供网格和几何基元、纹理、反射、阴影、雾、透明、线框、天空盒和立体可视化的渲染（在支持四缓冲 OpenGL 的显卡上）。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Key features", item 9 Powerful yet intuitive modeling language 强大而直观的建模语言 "MuJoCo has its own modeling language called MJCF. The goal of MJCF is to provide access to all of MuJoCo’s compute capabilities, and at the same time enable users to develop new models quickly and experiment with them." MuJoCo 有自己的建模语言 MJCF。MJCF 的目标是提供对 MuJoCo 全部计算能力的访问，同时让用户能快速开发新模型并用它们做实验。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Key features", item 10 Automated generation of composite flexible objects 复合柔性物体的自动生成 "The modeling language has high-level macros which are automatically expanded by the model compiler into the necessary collections of standard model elements." 建模语言有高层宏，由模型编译器自动展开成所需的标准模型元素集合。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Key features", item 11 Constraint islands and sleeping 约束岛与休眠 "The constraint solver automatically discovers independent constraint islands – groups of bodies coupled by constraints that can be solved independently." 约束求解器会自动发现独立的约束岛：由约束耦合、可以独立求解的刚体组。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Key features", item 12 Plugin system 插件系统 "Plugins are dynamically loaded shared libraries that register themselves with the engine and are instantiated per model element." 插件是动态加载的共享库，它们向引擎注册自己，并按模型元素实例化。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Key features", item 13 GPU-accelerated backends GPU 加速后端 "In addition to the C engine, MuJoCo has GPU-accelerated backends for large-scale parallel simulation: MJX (JAX) and MuJoCo Warp (NVIDIA Warp)." 除了 C 引擎，MuJoCo 还有用于大规模并行仿真的 GPU 加速后端：MJX（JAX）和 MuJoCo Warp（NVIDIA Warp）。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Key features", item 14 Model instances 模型实例 "The user defines the model in an XML file written in MJCF or URDF. The software can then create multiple instances of the same model in different media (file or memory) and on different levels of description (high or low)." 用户在用 MJCF 或 URDF 编写的 XML 文件中定义模型。然后软件可以在不同介质（文件或内存）中、在不同描述层次（高层或低层）上创建同一模型的多个实例。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Model instances", para. 1 High level 高层 "The high level exists for user convenience: its sole purpose is to be compiled into a low level model on which computations can be performed." 高层是为了方便用户而存在的：它的唯一用途是被编译成可在其上进行计算的低层模型。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Model instances", para. 2 Low level 低层 "The high level exists for user convenience: its sole purpose is to be compiled into a low level model on which computations can be performed." 高层是为了方便用户而存在的：它的唯一用途是被编译成可在其上进行计算的低层模型。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Model instances", para. 2 MJZ MJZ (context) "The resulting mjModel can be loaded and saved into a binary file (MJB), however those are version-specific and cannot be decompiled, thus models should always be maintained as XML files or packaged into MJZ archives." （语境）得到的 mjModel 可以加载和保存为二进制文件（MJB），但这些文件与版本相关且无法反编译，因此模型应始终以 XML 文件维护，或打包成 MJZ 归档。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Model instances", para. 2 mjSpec mjSpec "The mjSpec C struct is in one-to-one correspondence with the MJCF file format." mjSpec C 结构体与 MJCF 文件格式一一对应。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Model instances", para. 3 References Google DeepMind. (n.d.). Overview. MuJoCo Documentation (Version 3.17.0). Retrieved October 31, 2026, from https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/overview.html

ai/mujoco/overview/model-elements.html.title: 1.1 Model elements | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
ai/mujoco/overview/model-elements.html.summary: 1.1 Model elements Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 1.1 Model elements 模型元素 (No definition) （无定义） Google DeepMind, n.d., "Model elements" Options 选项 "Each model has three sets of options listed below. They are always included." 每个模型都有下面列出的三组选项。它们总是包含在模型中。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Options", para. 1 mjOption mjOption "This structure contains all options that affect the physics simulation." 这个结构体包含所有影响物理仿真的选项。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "mjOption", para. 1 mjVisual mjVisual "This structure contains all visualization options." 这个结构体包含所有可视化选项。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "mjVisual", para. 1 mjStatistic mjStatistic "This structure contains statistics about the model which are computed by the compiler: average body mass, spatial extent of the model etc." 这个结构体包含由编译器计算的模型统计量：平均刚体质量、模型的空间范围等。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "mjStatistic", para. 1 Assets 资源 "Assets are not in themselves model elements. Model elements can reference them, in which case the asset somehow changes the properties of the referencing element." 资源本身不是模型元素。模型元素可以引用它们，此时资源会以某种方式改变引用它的元素的属性。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Assets", para. 1 Mesh 网格 "MuJoCo can load triangulated meshes from OBJ files and binary STL." MuJoCo 可以从 OBJ 文件和二进制 STL 加载三角网格。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Mesh", para. 1 Skin 蒙皮 "Skinned meshes (or skins) are meshes whose shape can deform at runtime." 蒙皮网格（或蒙皮）是形状可以在运行时变形的网格。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Skin", para. 1 Height field 高度场 "A height field is a rectangular grid of elevation data." 高度场是一个由高程数据组成的矩形网格。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Height field", para. 1 Texture 纹理 (context) "Textures can be loaded from PNG or KTX files or synthesized by the compiler based on user-defined procedural parameters." （语境）纹理可以从 PNG 或 KTX 文件加载，或由编译器根据用户定义的程序化参数合成。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Texture", para. 1 Material 材质 "Materials are used to control the appearance of geoms, sites and tendons." 材质用于控制 geom、site 和肌腱的外观。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Material", para. 1 Kinematic tree 运动学树 "MuJoCo simulates the dynamics of a collection of rigid bodies whose motion is usually constrained. The system state is represented in joint coordinates and the bodies are explicitly organized into kinematic trees." MuJoCo 仿真一组运动通常受约束的刚体的动力学。系统状态用关节坐标表示，刚体被显式地组织成运动学树。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Kinematic tree", para. 1 World body 世界刚体 "The top-level “world” body always exists (with id 0) and is its own parent, thus body_parentid[0] == 0 and body_parentid[i] < i for all other i." 顶层的“世界”刚体总是存在（id 为 0），并且是它自己的父刚体，因此 body_parentid[0] == 0，且对其他所有 i 有 body_parentid[i] < i。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Kinematic tree", para. 1 Static tree 静态树 "Note that the world body and other static (joint-less) child bodies form a unique “static tree” with no associated degrees of freedom." 注意，世界刚体和其他静态（无关节）子刚体构成一棵唯一的、没有关联自由度的“静态树”。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Kinematic tree", para. 1 Body 刚体 "Bodies have mass and inertial properties but do not have any geometric properties." 刚体有质量和惯性属性，但没有任何几何属性。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Body", para. 1 Inertial frame 惯性坐标系 "Each body has two coordinate frames: the frame used to define it as well as to position other elements relative to it, and an inertial frame centered at the body’s center of mass and aligned with its principal axes of inertia." 每个刚体有两个坐标系：一个用来定义它并相对于它定位其他元素，另一个是以刚体质心为中心、与其惯性主轴对齐的惯性坐标系。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Body", para. 1 Joint 关节 "Joints are defined within bodies. They create motion degrees of freedom (DOFs) between the body and its parent." 关节定义在刚体内部。它们在刚体与其父刚体之间创建运动自由度（DOF）。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Joint", para. 1 Free joint 自由关节 "There are four types of joints: ball, slide, hinge, and a “free joint” which creates floating bodies." 关节有四种类型：球关节、滑动关节、铰链关节，以及一种创建浮动刚体的“自由关节”。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Joint", para. 1 Joint reference 关节参考 "The reference pose is a vector of joint positions stored in mjModel.qpos0." 参考位姿是存放在 mjModel.qpos0 中的关节位置向量。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Joint reference", para. 1 Spring reference 弹簧参考 "This is the pose in which all joint and tendon springs achieve their resting length." 这是所有关节弹簧和肌腱弹簧都处于静止长度时的位姿。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Spring reference", para. 1 DOF 自由度 "Degrees of freedom are closely related to joints, but are not in one-to-one correspondence because ball and free joints have multiple DOFs." 自由度与关节密切相关，但并非一一对应，因为球关节和自由关节有多个自由度。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "DOF", para. 1 Tree 树 "A kinematic tree or “tree” is a movable body and all of its descendants." 运动学树或“树”是一个可动刚体及其所有后代。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Tree", para. 1 Subtree 子树 "Note that while trees are indeed subtrees of the global tree (whose root is the world), this should not be confused with the specific term subtree, which is reserved for per-body partial trees, thus mjModel.body_subtreemass gives the total mass of the partial tree under each body, for all bodies." 注意，虽然树确实是全局树（其根是世界）的子树，但这不应与专门术语 subtree 混淆，它专指以每个刚体为根的部分树，因此 mjModel.body_subtreemass 给出所有刚体各自下方部分树的总质量。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Tree", para. 2 Geom 几何体 "Geoms are 3D shapes rigidly attached to the bodies." geom 是刚性附着在刚体上的三维形状。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Geom", para. 1 Site 站点 "Sites are essentially light geoms. They represent locations of interest within the body frame." site 本质上是轻量的 geom。它们表示刚体坐标系内值得关注的位置。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Site", para. 1 Camera 相机 (context) "However it is often convenient to define additional cameras that are either fixed to the world, or are attached to one of the bodies and move with it." （语境）不过，定义另外的相机往往很方便：它们要么固定在世界中，要么附着在某个刚体上并随它移动。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Camera", para. 1 Light 光源 (context) "Lights can be fixed to the world body or attached to moving bodies." （语境）光源可以固定在世界刚体上，或附着在运动的刚体上。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Light", para. 1 Stand-alone 独立元素 "Here we describe the model elements which do not belong to an individual body, and therefore are described outside the kinematic tree." 这里介绍不属于单个刚体的模型元素，因此它们在运动学树之外描述。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Stand-alone", para. 1 Tendon 肌腱 "Tendons are scalar length elements that can be used for actuation, imposing limits and equality constraints, or creating spring-dampers and friction loss." 肌腱是标量长度元素，可用于驱动、施加限位和等式约束，或构造弹簧阻尼器和摩擦损失。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Tendon", para. 1 Fixed tendons 固定肌腱 "Fixed tendons are linear combinations of (scalar) joint positions." 固定肌腱是（标量）关节位置的线性组合。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Tendon", para. 1 Spatial tendons 空间肌腱 "Spatial tendons are defined as the shortest path that passes through a sequence of specified sites (or via-points) or wraps around specified geoms." 空间肌腱定义为穿过一系列指定 site（即途经点）或缠绕指定 geom 的最短路径。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Tendon", para. 1 Actuator 驱动器 "MuJoCo provides a flexible actuator model, with three components that can be specified independently." MuJoCo 提供一个灵活的驱动器模型，它有三个可以独立指定的组成部分。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Actuator", para. 1 Transmission 传动 "The transmission specifies how the actuator is attached to the rest of the system; available types are joint, tendon, slider-crank, site and body." 传动指定驱动器如何连接到系统的其余部分；可用类型有 joint、tendon、slider-crank、site 和 body。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Actuator", para. 1 Activation dynamics 激活动力学 "The activation dynamics can be used to model internal activation states of pneumatic or hydraulic cylinders as well as biological muscles; using such actuators makes the overall system dynamics 3rd-order." 激活动力学可用于建模气缸、液压缸以及生物肌肉的内部激活状态；使用这类驱动器会使整个系统动力学成为三阶的。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Actuator", para. 1 Force generation 力生成 "The force generation mechanism determines how the scalar control signal provided as input to the actuator is mapped into a scalar force, which is in turn mapped into a generalized force by the moment arms inferred from the transmission." 力生成机制决定作为驱动器输入的标量控制信号如何映射为标量力，该力再由从传动推出的力臂映射为广义力。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Actuator", para. 1 Sensor 传感器 "MuJoCo can generate simulated sensor data which is saved in the global array mjData.sensordata." MuJoCo 可以生成仿真的传感器数据，保存在全局数组 mjData.sensordata 中。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Sensor", para. 1 User sensor type 用户传感器类型 "There is also a user sensor type, allowing user code to insert any other quantity of interest in the sensor data array." 还有一种用户传感器类型，允许用户代码把任何其他感兴趣的量插入传感器数据数组。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Sensor", para. 1 Equality 等式约束 "Equality constraints can impose additional constraints beyond those already imposed by the kinematic tree structure and the joints/DOFs defined in it." 等式约束可以在运动学树结构及其中定义的关节/自由度已施加的约束之外，再施加额外的约束。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Equality", para. 1 Flex 柔性体 "Flexes represent deformable meshes that can be 1, 2 or 3 dimensional (thus their elements are capsules, triangles or tetrahedra)." flex 表示可以是一维、二维或三维的可变形网格（因此其单元是胶囊体、三角形或四面体）。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Flex", para. 1 Contact pair 接触对 "Geom pairs that are checked for contact can come from two sources: automated proximity tests and other filters collectively called “dynamic”, as well as an explicit list of geom pairs provided in the model. The latter is a separate type of model element." 要做接触检查的 geom 对有两个来源：自动邻近测试和其他过滤器（统称为“dynamic”），以及模型中提供的显式 geom 对列表。后者是一种单独的模型元素类型。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Contact pair", para. 1 dynamic 动态机制 "Geom pairs that are checked for contact can come from two sources: automated proximity tests and other filters collectively called “dynamic”, as well as an explicit list of geom pairs provided in the model." 要做接触检查的 geom 对有两个来源：自动邻近测试和其他过滤器（统称为“dynamic”），以及模型中提供的显式 geom 对列表。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Contact pair", para. 1 Contact exclude 接触排除 "This is the opposite of contact pairs: it specifies pairs of bodies (rather than geoms) which should be excluded from the generation of candidate contact pairs." 它与接触对相反：它指定应从候选接触对的生成中排除的刚体对（而不是 geom 对）。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Contact exclude", para. 1 Custom numeric 自定义数值 "There are three ways to enter custom numbers in a MuJoCo simulation." 有三种方式可以在 MuJoCo 仿真中输入自定义数值。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Custom numeric", para. 1 Custom text 自定义文本 "Custom text fields can be saved in the model. They can be used in custom computations – either to specify keyword commands, or to provide some other textual information." 自定义文本字段可以保存在模型中。它们可用于自定义计算：指定关键字命令，或提供其他文本信息。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Custom text", para. 1 Custom tuple 自定义元组 "Custom tuples are lists of MuJoCo model elements, possibly including other tuples." 自定义元组是MuJoCo 模型元素的列表，其中可能包含其他元组。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Custom tuple", para. 1 Keyframe 关键帧 "A keyframe is a snapshot of the simulation state variables." 关键帧是仿真状态变量的一个快照。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Keyframe", para. 1 References Google DeepMind. (n.d.). Overview. MuJoCo Documentation (Version 3.17.0). Retrieved October 31, 2026, from https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/overview.html

ai/mujoco/programming/extensions.html.summary: 5.9 Extensions Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 5.9 Extensions 扩展 (context) "At present, extensibility is provided by via engine plugins, decoders, and resource providers." （语境）目前，可扩展性由引擎插件、解码器和资源提供者提供。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Extensions", para. 1 Engine plugins 引擎插件 "Engine plugins allow user-defined logic to be inserted into various parts of MuJoCo’s computational pipeline." 引擎插件允许把用户定义的逻辑插入 MuJoCo 计算流水线的各个部分。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Engine plugins", para. 1 Thread safety 线程安全 "Plugin instances (see below) are thread-local, avoiding collisions." 插件实例（见下文）是线程局部的，避免冲突。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Engine plugins", item 1 Statefulness 有状态性 "Plugins can be stateful, and their state will be (de)serialized correctly." 插件可以是有状态的，它们的状态会被正确地序列化和反序列化。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Engine plugins", item 2 Interoperability 互操作性 "Different plugins can coexist without interference." 不同的插件可以共存而互不干扰。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Engine plugins", item 3 Plugin 插件 "A plugin is a collection of functions and static attributes that implement its capabilities, bundled into an mjpPlugin struct." 插件是实现其功能的一组函数和静态属性，打包在一个 mjpPlugin 结构体中。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Engine plugins", para. 4 stateless 无状态 "Plugin functions are stateless: they depend only on the arguments passed to them." 插件函数是无状态的：它们只依赖传给它们的参数。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Engine plugins", para. 4 Plugin instance 插件实例 "A plugin instance represents the self-contained runtime state that is operated on by the plugin: when the plugin logic is executed, the instance state is passed in by the engine." 插件实例表示由插件操作的自包含运行时状态：执行插件逻辑时，引擎把实例状态传进去。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Engine plugins", para. 5 one-to-one 一对一 "In this simplest case, each instance is referenced once in the model." 在这种最简单的情况下，每个实例在模型中只被引用一次。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Engine plugins", item 1 one-to-many 一对多 "Alternatively, the behavior of multiple elements can be backed by a single plugin instance." 或者，多个元素的行为可以由单个插件实例支撑。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Engine plugins", item 2 Plugin capabilities 插件能力 (context) "The capabilityflags member is an integer bitfield describing the plugin’s capabilities, where bit semantics are defined in the enum mjtPluginCapabilityBit." （语境）capabilityflags 成员是一个描述插件能力的整数位域，各位的含义在枚举 mjtPluginCapabilityBit 中定义。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Plugin capabilities", para. 1 mjpPlugin 插件结构体 mjpPlugin "A plugin is described by the contents of its associated mjpPlugin struct." 插件由其关联的 mjpPlugin 结构体的内容描述。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Plugin capabilities", para. 1 mjtPluginCapabilityBit 插件能力位枚举 mjtPluginCapabilityBit (context) "The capabilityflags member is an integer bitfield describing the plugin’s capabilities, where bit semantics are defined in the enum mjtPluginCapabilityBit." （语境）capabilityflags 成员是一个描述插件能力的整数位域，各位的含义在枚举 mjtPluginCapabilityBit 中定义。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Plugin capabilities", para. 1 Actuator plugin 执行器插件 (No definition) （无定义） Google DeepMind, n.d., "Plugin capabilities" Sensor plugin 传感器插件 (No definition) （无定义） Google DeepMind, n.d., "Plugin capabilities" Passive force plugin 被动力插件 (No definition) （无定义） Google DeepMind, n.d., "Plugin capabilities" Signed distance field plugin 有符号距离场插件 (No definition) （无定义） Google DeepMind, n.d., "Plugin capabilities" Declaration in MJCF 在 MJCF 中声明 (context) "First, a plugin dependency must be declared through ." （语境）首先，插件依赖必须通过 声明 。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Declaration in MJCF", para. 1 Configuration in MJCF 在 MJCF 中配置 "Plugins can declare custom attributes that represent specialized configurable parameters." 插件可以声明表示专门可配置参数的自定义属性。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Configuration in MJCF", para. 1 Plugin state 插件状态 "The term plugin state refers to the time-dependent state of the plugin instance that consists of floating point values, while the term plugin data refers to arbitrary data structures consisting of memoized payload that should be considered implementation detail for the plugin’s computation." 术语“插件状态”指插件实例中由浮点数值构成的、随时间变化的状态，而术语“插件数据”指由记忆化负载构成的任意数据结构，应被视为插件计算的实现细节。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Plugin state", para. 1 plugin data 插件数据 "The term plugin state refers to the time-dependent state of the plugin instance that consists of floating point values, while the term plugin data refers to arbitrary data structures consisting of memoized payload that should be considered implementation detail for the plugin’s computation." 术语“插件状态”指插件实例中由浮点数值构成的、随时间变化的状态，而术语“插件数据”指由记忆化负载构成的任意数据结构，应被视为插件计算的实现细节。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Plugin state", para. 1 Actuator states 执行器状态 (context) "When writing stateful actuator plugins, there are two choices for where to save the actuator state." （语境）编写有状态的执行器插件时，执行器状态可以保存在两个地方之一。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Actuator states", para. 1 Registration 注册 "Plugins must be registered with MuJoCo before they can be referenced in MJCF models." 插件必须先向 MuJoCo 注册，才能在 MJCF 模型中被引用。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Registration", para. 1 actuator actuator 插件目录 "The plugins in the actuator/ directory implement custom actuators, so far only a PID controller." actuator/ 目录中的插件实现自定义执行器，目前只有一个 PID 控制器。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "actuator", para. 1 elasticity elasticity 插件目录 "The plugins in the elasticity/ directory are passive forces based on continuum mechanics for 1-dimensional and 2-dimensional bodies." elasticity/ 目录中的插件是基于连续介质力学、作用于一维和二维物体的被动力。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "elasticity", para. 1 sensor sensor 插件目录 "The plugins in the sensor/ directory implement custom sensors." sensor/ 目录中的插件实现自定义传感器。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "sensor", para. 1 sdf sdf 插件目录 "The plugins in the sdf/ directory specify custom shapes in a mesh-free manner, by defining methods computing a signed distance field and its gradient at query points." sdf/ 目录中的插件以无网格的方式指定自定义形状，做法是定义在查询点计算有符号距离场及其梯度的方法。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "sdf", para. 1 sdf_distance sdf_distance 方法 "Returns the signed distance of the query point given in local coordinates." 返回以局部坐标给出的查询点的有符号距离。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "sdf", item 1 sdf_staticdistance sdf_staticdistance 方法 "This is the static version of the previous function, taking config attributes as additional inputs." 这是前一个函数的静态版本，把配置属性作为额外输入。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "sdf", item 2 sdf_gradient sdf_gradient 方法 "Computes the gradient in local coordinates of the SDF at the query point." 计算SDF 在查询点处的局部坐标梯度。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "sdf", item 3 sdf_aabb sdf_aabb 方法 "Computes the axis-aligned bounding box in local coordinates." 计算局部坐标下的轴对齐包围盒。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "sdf", item 4 Decoders 解码器 "Decoder plugins extend asset loading capabilities beyond MJCF and URDF." 解码器插件把资源加载能力扩展到 MJCF 和 URDF 之外。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Decoders", para. 1 OBJ decoder OBJ 解码器 "OBJ decoder (plugin/obj_decoder) – Wavefront OBJ." OBJ 解码器（plugin/obj_decoder），对应 Wavefront OBJ。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Decoders", item 1 STL decoder STL 解码器 "STL decoder (plugin/stl_decoder) – STL" STL 解码器（plugin/stl_decoder），对应 STL。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Decoders", item 2 USD decoder USD 解码器 "USD decoder (plugin/usd_decoder) – Universal Scene Description." USD 解码器（plugin/usd_decoder），对应 Universal Scene Description（通用场景描述）。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Decoders", item 3 Decoder interface 解码器接口 (context) "A decoder is described by the mjpDecoder struct, which has the following fields:" （语境）解码器由 mjpDecoder 结构体描述，它有以下字段： Google DeepMind, n.d., "Decoder interface", para. 1 mjpDecoder 解码器结构体 mjpDecoder "A decoder is described by the mjpDecoder struct, which has the following fields:" 解码器由 mjpDecoder 结构体描述，它有以下字段： Google DeepMind, n.d., "Decoder interface", para. 1 mjfCanDecode 可解码回调类型 mjfCanDecode "A callback of type mjfCanDecode that determines whether the decoder can handle a given resource." 一个 mjfCanDecode 类型的回调，判断解码器能否处理给定的资源。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Decoder interface", item 3 mjfDecode 解码回调类型 mjfDecode "A callback of type mjfDecode that performs the actual decoding." 一个 mjfDecode 类型的回调，执行实际的解码。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Decoder interface", item 4 Encoders 编码器 "Encoder plugins extend asset serialization and model saving capabilities beyond native formats (XML, MJB, TXT)." 编码器插件把资源序列化和模型保存能力扩展到原生格式之外（XML、MJB、TXT）。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Encoders", para. 1 Zip encoder Zip 编码器 "MuJoCo ships with a built-in Zip encoder for .mjz archives (src/xml/mjz/mjz_encoder.cc)." MuJoCo 自带一个用于 .mjz 归档的内置 Zip 编码器（src/xml/mjz/mjz_encoder.cc）。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Encoders", para. 2 Encoder interface 编码器接口 (context) "An encoder is described by the mjpEncoder struct, which has the following fields:" （语境）编码器由 mjpEncoder 结构体描述，它有以下字段： Google DeepMind, n.d., "Encoder interface", para. 1 mjpEncoder 编码器结构体 mjpEncoder "An encoder is described by the mjpEncoder struct, which has the following fields:" 编码器由 mjpEncoder 结构体描述，它有以下字段： Google DeepMind, n.d., "Encoder interface", para. 1 mjfEncode 编码回调类型 mjfEncode "A callback of type mjfEncode that performs the actual serialization." 一个 mjfEncode 类型的回调，执行实际的序列化。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Encoder interface", item 3 Resource providers 资源提供者 "Resource providers (mjpResourceProvider) extend MuJoCo to load assets (XML files, meshes, textures, and etc.) that don’t necessarily come from the OS filesystem or the Virtual File System (mjVFS)." 资源提供者（mjpResourceProvider）扩展 MuJoCo，使其能加载不一定来自操作系统文件系统或虚拟文件系统的资源（XML 文件、网格、纹理等）（mjVFS）。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Resource providers", para. 1 mjResource 资源结构体 mjResource (context) "These extensions are handled abstractly in MuJoCo via the mjResource struct." （语境）这些扩展在 MuJoCo 中通过 mjResource 结构体以抽象方式处理。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Resource providers", para. 1 Overview 概述 (context) "Creating a new resource provider works by registering a mjpResourceProvider struct via mjp_registerProvider in a global table." （语境）创建新的资源提供者的方法是通过 mjp_registerProvider 把一个 mjpResourceProvider 结构体注册到全局表中。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Overview", para. 1 Resource prefix 资源前缀 "Resources are identified by prefixes in their name." 资源通过其名称中的前缀来识别。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Overview", item 1 Callbacks 回调 "There are three callbacks that a resource provider is required to implement: open, read, and close." 资源提供者必须实现三个回调：open、read 和 close。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Overview", item 2 Data Pointer 数据指针 "Lastly, there’s an opaque data pointer for the provider to pass data into the callbacks." 最后，还有一个不透明的数据指针，供提供者把数据传给各个回调。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Overview", item 3 mjfOpenResource 打开资源回调类型 mjfOpenResource "The open callback takes a single parameter of type mjResource. The name field of the resource should be used to verify that the resource exists and populate the resource data field with any extra information needed for the resource." open 回调接受一个 mjResource 类型的参数。应当用资源的 name 字段验证资源存在，并把该资源所需的任何额外信息填入资源的 data 字段。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Overview", item 4 mjfReadResource 读取资源回调类型 mjfReadResource "The read callback should point the buffer pointer to the location of where the bytes of the resource can be read and return the number of bytes pointed to in the buffer." read 回调应当把 buffer 指针指向可以读取资源字节的位置，并返回 buffer 中所指的字节数。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Overview", item 5 mjfCloseResource 关闭资源回调类型 mjfCloseResource "This callback takes a single parameter of type mjResource, and should be used to free any memory allocated in the data field in the supplied resource." 这个回调接受一个 mjResource 类型的参数，应当用来释放所给资源的 data 字段中分配的任何内存。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Overview", item 6 mjfGetResourceDir 获取资源目录回调类型 mjfGetResourceDir "This callback is optional and is used to extract the directory from a resource name." 这个回调是可选的，用于从资源名称中提取目录。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Overview", item 7 mjfResourceModified 资源已修改回调类型 mjfResourceModified "This callback is optional and is used to check if an existing opened resource has been modified from its original source." 这个回调是可选的，用于检查一个已打开的资源相对其原始来源是否已被修改。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Overview", item 8 References Google DeepMind. (n.d.). Extensions. MuJoCo Documentation (Version 3.17.0). Retrieved October 31, 2026, from https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/programming/extension.html

mjtNum)." 定义基本类型和枚举，包括取值为 double 或 float 的浮点类型 mjtNum（见 mjtNum）。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Header files", item 8 mjtNum 浮点类型 mjtNum "Defines primitive types and enums, including the mjtNum floating-point type to be either double or float (see mjtNum)." 定义基本类型和枚举，包括取值为 double 或 float 的浮点类型 mjtNum（见 mjtNum）。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Header files", item 8 mjspec.h mjspec.h 头文件 "Defines enums and structs used for procedural model editing." 定义程序化模型编辑所用的枚举和结构体。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Header files", item 9 mjplugin.h mjplugin.h 头文件 "Defines data structures required by engine plugins." 定义引擎插件所需的数据结构。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Header files", item 10 mjmacro.h mjmacro.h 头文件 "Defines C macros that are useful in user code." 定义在用户代码中有用的 C 宏。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Header files", item 11 mjxmacro.h mjxmacro.h 头文件 "This file is optional and is not included by mujoco.h. It defines X Macros that can automate the mapping of mjModel and mjData into scripting languages, as well as other operations that require accessing all fields of mjModel and mjData." 此文件是可选的，不被 mujoco.h 包含。它定义了可将 mjModel 和 mjData 自动映射到脚本语言的 X 宏，以及其他需要访问 mjModel 和 mjData 全部字段的操作。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Header files", item 12 mjspecmacro.h mjspecmacro.h 头文件 "This file is optional and is not included by mujoco.h. It defines X Macros that can automate the mapping of mjSpec and its element structs into scripting languages, as well as other operations that require accessing all fields of mjSpec during procedural model editing." 此文件是可选的，不被 mujoco.h 包含。它定义了可将 mjSpec 及其元素结构体自动映射到脚本语言的 X 宏，以及程序化模型编辑中其他需要访问 mjSpec 全部字段的操作。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Header files", item 13 mjexport.h mjexport.h 头文件 "Macros used for exporting public symbols from the MuJoCo library." 用于从 MuJoCo 库导出公共符号的宏。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Header files", item 14 mjsan.h mjsan.h 头文件 "Definitions required when building with sanitizer instrumentation." 使用 sanitizer 插桩构建时所需的定义。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Header files", item 15 mjassert.h mjassert.h 头文件 "Compile-time size assertions verifying MuJoCo ABI stability across C and C++ compilers." 编译期的大小断言，用于验证 MuJoCo 的 ABI 在 C 和 C++ 编译器之间的稳定性。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Header files", item 16 References Google DeepMind.
