ai/mujoco/programming/model-editing.html.title: 5.8 Model Editing | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
ai/mujoco/programming/model-editing.html.summary: 5.8 Model Editing Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 5.8 Model Editing 模型编辑 (context) "It is possible to create and modify models using the mjSpec struct and related API." （语境）可以用 mjSpec 结构体和相关 API 创建和修改模型。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Model Editing", para. 1 Overview 概述 "The API augments the traditional workflow of creating and editing models using XML files, breaking up the parse and compile steps." 这套 API 扩充了用 XML 文件创建和编辑模型的传统工作流程，把解析和编译两个步骤拆开。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Overview", para. 1 Model Parsing & Loading 模型解析与加载 "As summarized in Model instances, model description files (MJCF, MJZ, URDF, USD) are parsed into an mjSpec using mj_parse (or mjSpec.from_file() / mjSpec.from_string() in Python)." 如“模型实例”一节所概述，模型描述文件（MJCF、MJZ、URDF、USD）用 mj_parse 解析为 mjSpec（在 Python 中用 mjSpec.from_file() 或 mjSpec.from_string()）。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Model Parsing & Loading", para. 1 Model Compilation 模型编译 "Once a high-level mjSpec is created—by parsing a file, loading an archive, or constructing it programmatically—it is compiled into an mjModel using mj_compile." 高层的 mjSpec 一旦创建（通过解析文件、加载归档或以编程方式构建），就用 mj_compile 编译成 mjModel。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Model Compilation", para. 1 Model Encoding & Saving 模型编码与保存 "Model specs and compiled models can be serialized to files using mj_encode, or directly saved to XML strings using mj_saveXMLString or mj_saveXML." 模型 spec 和编译后的模型可以用 mj_encode 序列化到文件，或用 mj_saveXMLString 或 mj_saveXML 直接保存为 XML 字符串。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Model Encoding & Saving", para. 1 MJCF XML MJCF XML 格式 "Flattens the spec into a single MJCF XML file using mj_saveXML." 用 mj_saveXML 把spec 展平为单个 MJCF XML 文件。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Model Encoding & Saving", item 1 MJZ Archive MJZ 归档 "Bundles the spec and all associated external assets (meshes, textures, included XMLs) into a self-contained Zip archive via the built-in mjz_encoder." 通过内置的 mjz_encoder 把spec 及所有关联的外部资源（网格、纹理、被包含的 XML）打包成一个自包含的 Zip 归档。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Model Encoding & Saving", item 2 MJB Binary MJB 二进制 "Serializes the compiled mjModel in MuJoCo binary format via mj_saveModel." 通过 mj_saveModel 把编译后的 mjModel 序列化为 MuJoCo 二进制格式。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Model Encoding & Saving", item 3 TXT TXT 文本 "Writes a human-readable text dump via mj_printModel." 通过 mj_printModel 写出人类可读的文本转储。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Model Encoding & Saving", item 4 MJZ Archives MJZ 归档 "The MJZ format (extension .mjz or .zip) provides a convenient way to bundle an entire model and all of its referenced assets into a single Zip archive." MJZ 格式（扩展名 .mjz 或 .zip）提供了一种方便的方式，把整个模型及其引用的所有资源打包成单个 Zip 归档。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "MJZ Archives", para. 1 Root XML Discovery 根 XML 查找 (context) "When decoding an .mjz archive, MuJoCo searches for the root model XML file in the following order:" （语境）解码 .mjz 归档时，MuJoCo 按以下顺序查找根模型 XML 文件： Google DeepMind, n.d., "Root XML Discovery", para. 1 Custom formats 自定义格式 (context) "Adding support for new file formats can be done with mjp_registerDecoder and mjp_registerEncoder." （语境）可以用 mjp_registerDecoder 和 mjp_registerEncoder 添加对新文件格式的支持。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Custom formats", para. 1 Usage 用法 (context) "Here we describe the C API for procedural model editing, but it is also exposed in the Python bindings." （语境）这里介绍用于程序化模型编辑的 C API，它也在 Python 绑定中提供。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Usage", para. 1 Model elements 模型元素 "Model elements corresponding to MJCF are exposed to the user as C structs with the mjs prefix." 对应 MJCF 的模型元素以带 mjs 前缀的 C 结构体提供给用户。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Model elements", para. 1 Memory management 内存管理 "The library takes ownership of all elements and frees them when the parent mjSpec is deleted using mj_deleteSpec." 库拥有所有元素的所有权，并在用 mj_deleteSpec 删除父 mjSpec 时释放它们。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Memory management", para. 1 Attachment 附加 "Attachment allows the user to move or copy a subtree from one model into another, while also copying or moving related referenced assets and referencing elements from outside the kinematic tree (e.g., actuators and sensors)." 附加允许用户把一个子树从一个模型移动或复制到另一个模型中，同时复制或移动相关的被引用资源，以及运动学树之外引用它的元素（例如执行器和传感器）。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Attachment", para. 1 shallow copy 浅复制 "The default behavior (“shallow copy”) is to move the child into the parent while attaching, so subsequent changes to the child will also change the parent." 默认行为（“浅复制”）是在附加时把子模型移入父模型，因此之后对子模型的修改也会改变父模型。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Attachment", para. 1 Attribute Merging 属性合并 "A conflict occurs when both the parent and child specify authored values for the same field and those values differ." 当父模型和子模型对同一字段都指定了显式设置的值，且这些值不同时，就发生冲突。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Attribute Merging", para. 1 warning (default) warning（默认） "Parent values take precedence. Whenever a conflict is detected, a warning is emitted but the parent value is not modified." 父模型的值优先。每当检测到冲突时，发出一个警告，但父模型的值不被修改。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Attribute Merging", item 1 merge merge（合并） "Attribute values are merged using a per-field strategy as described in the table below." 属性值按逐字段策略合并，见下表。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Attribute Merging", item 2 error error（报错） "Any conflict results in a compile error." 任何冲突都会导致编译错误。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Attribute Merging", item 3 Default classes 默认类 "As explained in the Default settings section, default classes are first loaded as a tree of dummy elements, which are then used to initialize elements which reference them." 如“默认设置”一节所述，默认类先被加载为一棵由虚元素组成的树，再用来初始化引用它们的元素。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Default classes", para. 1 In-place recompilation 就地重新编译 "In contrast, mj_recompile updates an existing mjModel and mjData pair in-place, while preserving the simulation state." 相比之下，mj_recompile 就地更新已有的一对 mjModel 和 mjData，同时保留仿真状态。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "In-place recompilation", para. 1 References Google DeepMind. (n.d.). Model Editing. MuJoCo Documentation (Version 3.17.0). Retrieved October 31, 2026, from https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/programming/modeledit.html

ai/mujoco/programming/naming-convention..title: 5.3 Naming convention | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
ai/mujoco/programming/naming-convention..summary: 5.3 Naming convention Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 5.3 Naming convention 命名约定 (context) "All symbols defined in the API start with the prefix “mj”." （语境）API 中定义的所有符号都以前缀“mj”开头。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Naming convention", para. 1 mj mj 前缀 "Core simulation data structure (C struct), for example mjModel." 核心仿真数据结构（C 结构体），例如 mjModel。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Naming convention", item 1 mjt mjt 前缀 "Primitive type, for example mjtNum and mjtGeom. Most types in this family are enums." 基本类型，例如 mjtNum 和 mjtGeom。这一族中的大多数类型是枚举。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Naming convention", item 2 mjf mjf 前缀 "Callback function type, for example mjfGeneric." 回调函数类型，例如 mjfGeneric。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Naming convention", item 3 mjs mjs 前缀 "Data structure related to procedural model editing, for example mjsJoint." 与程序化模型编辑相关的数据结构，例如 mjsJoint。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Naming convention", item 4 mjv mjv 前缀 "Data structure related to abstract visualization, for example mjvCamera." 与抽象可视化相关的数据结构，例如 mjvCamera。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Naming convention", item 5 mjrf mjrf 前缀 "Data structure related to filament rendering, for example mjrfContext." 与 Filament 渲染相关的数据结构，例如 mjrfContext。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Naming convention", item 6 mjr mjr 前缀 "Data structure related to OpenGL rendering, for example mjrContext." 与 OpenGL 渲染相关的数据结构，例如 mjrContext。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Naming convention", item 7 mjui mjui 前缀 "Data structure related to UI framework, for example mjuiSection." 与 UI 框架相关的数据结构，例如 mjuiSection。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Naming convention", item 8 mj_ mj_ 前缀 "Core simulation function, for example mj_step." 核心仿真函数，例如 mj_step。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Naming convention", item 9 mju_ mju_ 前缀 "Utility function, for example mju_mulMatVec. These functions are self-contained in the sense that they do not have mjModel and mjData pointers as their arguments." 工具函数，例如 mju_mulMatVec。这些函数是自包含的，即它们的参数中没有 mjModel 和 mjData 指针。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Naming convention", item 10 mjv_ mjv_ 前缀 "Function related to abstract visualization, for example mjv_updateScene." 与抽象可视化相关的函数，例如 mjv_updateScene。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Naming convention", item 11 mjrf_ mjrf_ 前缀 "Function related to filament rendering, for example mjrf_render." 与 Filament 渲染相关的函数，例如 mjrf_render。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Naming convention", item 12 mjr_ mjr_ 前缀 "Function related to OpenGL rendering, for example mjr_render." 与 OpenGL 渲染相关的函数，例如 mjr_render。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Naming convention", item 13 mjui_ mjui_ 前缀 "Function related to UI framework, for example mjui_update." 与 UI 框架相关的函数，例如 mjui_update。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Naming convention", item 14 mjcb_ mjcb_ 前缀 "Global callback function pointer, for example mjcb_control." 全局回调函数指针，例如 mjcb_control。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Naming convention", item 15 mjd_ mjd_ 前缀 "Functions for computing derivatives, for example mjd_transitionFD." 用于计算导数的函数，例如 mjd_transitionFD。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Naming convention", item 16 mjs_ mjs_ 前缀 "Functions for procedural model editing, for example mjs_addJoint." 用于程序化模型编辑的函数，例如 mjs_addJoint。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Naming convention", item 17 mjb_ mjb_ 前缀 "Functions for batched simulation, declared in mujoco/mjbatch.h, for example mjb_step." 用于批量仿真的函数，声明在 mujoco/mjbatch.h 中，例如 mjb_step。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Naming convention", item 18 References Google DeepMind. (n.d.). Programming. MuJoCo Documentation (Version 3.17.0). Retrieved October 31, 2026, from https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/programming/index.html

ai/mujoco/programming/rendering.html.title: 5.6 Rendering | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
ai/mujoco/programming/rendering.html.summary: 5.6 Rendering Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 5.6 Rendering 渲染 (context) "MuJoCo provides two built-in 3D rendering backends that support both interactive onscreen viewers and headless offscreen rendering:" （语境）MuJoCo 提供两个内置的三维渲染后端，既支持交互式屏幕查看器，也支持无界面的离屏渲染： Google DeepMind, n.d., "Rendering", para. 1 Filament rendering Filament 渲染 "MuJoCo provides a renderer based on Filament, Google’s real-time physically based rendering engine." MuJoCo 提供一个基于 Filament（Google 的实时基于物理的渲染引擎）的渲染器。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Filament rendering", para. 1 retained-mode 保留模式 "It uses a retained-mode, asynchronous architecture in which meshes, textures, lights, and renderables are created once from mjModel and updated in place from mjData each frame." 它采用保留模式的异步架构，其中网格、纹理、灯光和可渲染对象从 mjModel 创建一次，然后每帧根据 mjData 就地更新。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Rendering", item 1 Core concepts 核心概念 (context) "The mjrf C API revolves around seven opaque object types" （语境）mjrf C API 围绕七种不透明对象类型展开 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Core concepts", para. 1 mjrfContext Filament 上下文 mjrfContext "mjrfContext is the entry point to the Filament renderer." mjrfContext 是Filament 渲染器的入口。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Core concepts", item 1 mjrfScene Filament 场景 mjrfScene "A mjrfScene is a container of lights, renderables, and an optional skybox texture;" mjrfScene 是容纳灯光、可渲染对象和一个可选天空盒纹理的容器； Google DeepMind, n.d., "Core concepts", item 1 mjrfMesh Filament 网格 mjrfMesh "mjrfMesh stores vertex attributes (positions, packed tangent-frame orientations, UVs) and indices uploaded via mjrf_uploadMesh, along with bounding boxes used for frustum culling." mjrfMesh 存储顶点属性（位置、打包的切线坐标系朝向、UV）和索引，它们通过 mjrf_uploadMesh 上传，还存储用于视锥剔除的包围盒。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Core concepts", item 2 mjrfTexture Filament 纹理 mjrfTexture "mjrfTexture stores 2D, cubemap, or KTX-compressed image data uploaded via mjrf_uploadTexture." mjrfTexture 存储二维、立方体贴图或 KTX 压缩的图像数据，它们通过 mjrf_uploadTexture 上传。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Core concepts", item 2 mjrfRenderable 可渲染对象 mjrfRenderable "An mjrfRenderable is a persistent drawable entity in a scene, combining surface geometry, material appearance, and a 3D transform:" mjrfRenderable 是场景中一个持久的可绘制实体，组合了表面几何、材质外观和三维变换： Google DeepMind, n.d., "Core concepts", item 3 Geometry 几何 "A renderable can reference either a custom mjrfMesh (via mjrf_setRenderableMesh) or a built-in geometric primitive such as a sphere, capsule, cylinder, box, or ellipsoid (via mjrf_setRenderableGeomMesh, which caches and shares underlying mesh buffers across renderables with matching quality parameters)." 可渲染对象可以引用一个自定义的 mjrfMesh（通过 mjrf_setRenderableMesh），或一个内置几何图元，如球、胶囊、圆柱、长方体或椭球（通过 mjrf_setRenderableGeomMesh，它会缓存底层网格缓冲区，并在质量参数相同的可渲染对象之间共享）。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Core concepts", item 3 Material 材质 "mjrf_setRenderableMaterial applies an mjrfMaterial struct, which selects between three shading models: metallic-roughness PBR, legacy specular-glossiness (Phong), or unlit rendering for UI and decorative overlays (decor, which also places the object on the decor layer and disables shadows)." mjrf_setRenderableMaterial 应用一个 mjrfMaterial 结构体，它在三种着色模型之间选择：金属度-粗糙度 PBR、旧式镜面-光泽度（Phong），或用于 UI 和装饰叠加层的无光照渲染（decor，它还会把对象放到装饰层并关闭阴影）。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Core concepts", item 3 mjrfMaterial Filament 材质 mjrfMaterial (context) "Plain structs such as mjrfMaterial and mjrfRenderRequest describe how these objects are configured and drawn." （语境）像 mjrfMaterial 和 mjrfRenderRequest 这样的普通结构体描述这些对象如何配置和绘制。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Core concepts", para. 1 Pose and size 位姿与尺寸 "On each frame, mjrf_setRenderablePose updates the renderable’s 3D position and rotation matrix in place, and mjrf_setRenderableSize updates its scale (handling non-uniform primitive scaling such as keeping capsule end-caps spherical)." 每一帧，mjrf_setRenderablePose 就地更新可渲染对象的三维位置和旋转矩阵，mjrf_setRenderableSize 更新它的缩放（处理图元的非均匀缩放，例如保持胶囊端帽为球形）。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Core concepts", item 3 mjrfLight Filament 灯光 mjrfLight "mjrfLight represents directional, spot, point, or image-based (IBL environment cubemap) light sources added to a scene via mjrf_addSceneLight." mjrfLight 表示平行光、聚光灯、点光源或基于图像的（IBL 环境立方体贴图）光源，它们通过 mjrf_addSceneLight 添加到场景中。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Core concepts", item 4 headlight 头灯 "Note that the camera-aligned headlight is specified on mjrfRenderRequest (with intensity in lux) rather than as a scene light, so rendering the same scene from multiple cameras does not cross-illuminate views." 注意，与相机对齐的头灯在 mjrfRenderRequest 上指定（强度单位为勒克斯），而不是作为场景灯光，因此从多个相机渲染同一场景时各视图不会相互照亮。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Core concepts", item 4 mjrfRenderTarget 渲染目标 mjrfRenderTarget (context) "Each mjrfRenderRequest pairs an mjrfScene with a camera (mjrCamera), viewport, optional offscreen mjrfRenderTarget (or NULL for the native window), draw mode (mjrDrawMode: default, no-textures, wireframe, depth, solver islands, or segmentation by ID/color), and per-view flags (shadows, reflections, post-processing, headlight)." （语境）每个 mjrfRenderRequest 把一个 mjrfScene 与相机（mjrCamera）、视口、可选的离屏 mjrfRenderTarget（为 NULL 时表示原生窗口）、绘制模式（mjrDrawMode：默认、无纹理、线框、深度、求解器岛，或按 ID/颜色分割）以及逐视图标志（阴影、反射、后处理、头灯）配成一组。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Core concepts", item 5 mjrfRenderRequest 渲染请求 mjrfRenderRequest "Each mjrfRenderRequest pairs an mjrfScene with a camera (mjrCamera), viewport, optional offscreen mjrfRenderTarget (or NULL for the native window), draw mode (mjrDrawMode: default, no-textures, wireframe, depth, solver islands, or segmentation by ID/color), and per-view flags (shadows, reflections, post-processing, headlight)." 每个 mjrfRenderRequest 把一个 mjrfScene 与相机（mjrCamera）、视口、可选的离屏 mjrfRenderTarget（为 NULL 时表示原生窗口）、绘制模式配成一组（mjrDrawMode：默认、无纹理、线框、深度、求解器岛，或按 ID/颜色分割），并带有逐视图标志（阴影、反射、后处理、头灯）。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Core concepts", item 5 mjrfReadRequest 读取请求 mjrfReadRequest "Offscreen pixel readbacks are requested alongside render requests via mjrfReadRequest." 离屏像素回读通过 mjrfReadRequest 与渲染请求一起提交。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Core concepts", item 5 mjrfFrameHandle 帧句柄 mjrfFrameHandle "mjrf_render dispatches work to a dedicated render thread and returns an mjrfFrameHandle, which the caller synchronizes on with mjrf_waitForFrame." mjrf_render 把工作分派给一个专用渲染线程，并返回一个 mjrfFrameHandle，调用者用 mjrf_waitForFrame 在它上面同步。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Core concepts", item 5 Support layer 支持层 (context) "most MuJoCo applications use the support layer in src/render/filament/support" （语境）大多数 MuJoCo 应用使用 src/render/filament/support 中的支持层 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Support layer", para. 1 ModelResources 模型资源类 ModelResources "Creates and owns all mjrfMesh (meshes, convex hulls, and heightfields) and mjrfTexture resources from an mjModel, and supports re-uploading modified assets dynamically." 根据 mjModel 创建并持有所有 mjrfMesh（网格、凸包和高度场）和 mjrfTexture 资源，并支持动态重新上传修改过的资源。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Support layer", item 1 ModelLights 模型灯光类 ModelLights "Populates and updates the scene’s mjrfLight instances from mjModel and mjData, and automatically configures fallback environment and directional lighting when a model does not define photometric light intensities." 根据 mjModel 和 mjData 填充并更新场景中的 mjrfLight 实例，并在模型未定义光度学灯光强度时自动配置后备的环境光和平行光照明。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Support layer", item 2 ModelRenderables 模型可渲染对象类 ModelRenderables "Creates persistent mjrfRenderable entities for all model geoms, sites, skins, flexes, and spatial tendons." 为所有模型 geom、site、蒙皮、柔性体和空间肌腱创建持久的 mjrfRenderable 实体。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Support layer", item 3 ModelDecorations 模型装饰类 ModelDecorations "Bridges the abstract visualizer for transient decorative geometry." 为临时的装饰性几何桥接抽象可视化器。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Support layer", item 4 Authoring scenes 场景制作 (context) "The Filament renderer supports both models." （语境）Filament 渲染器同时支持这两种模型。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Authoring scenes", para. 2 Phong lighting model Phong 光照模型 "The classic renderer implements a traditional Phong lighting model: surface color is a sum of ambient, diffuse, specular and emissive terms, and light intensities are dimensionless values tuned by eye." 经典渲染器实现了传统的 Phong 光照模型：表面颜色是环境光、漫反射、镜面反射和自发光各项之和，灯光强度是凭眼睛调节的无量纲值。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Authoring scenes", para. 1 physically-based rendering (PBR) 基于物理的渲染（PBR） "Modern physically-based rendering (PBR) engines describe surfaces with empirically measurable properties and lights with photometric units." 现代基于物理的渲染（PBR）引擎用可经验测量的属性描述表面，用光度学单位描述灯光。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Authoring scenes", para. 1 Materials 材质 "A material is shaded with the PBR lighting model if it defines any physical property: a non-negative metallic or roughness coefficient, or texture layers with PBR roles (metallic, roughness, packed occlusion-roughness-metallic, normal, emissive, occlusion)." 如果一个材质定义了任何物理属性，它就用 PBR 光照模型着色：非负的金属度或粗糙度系数，或具有 PBR 角色的纹理层（金属度、粗糙度、打包的遮蔽-粗糙度-金属度、法线、自发光、遮蔽）。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Materials", para. 1 Lighting 光照 "Physical lighting is enabled by the lights themselves: if any light in the model has positive intensity, all lights are assumed to be photometric, with intensities measured in candela." 物理光照由灯光本身启用：只要模型中有任何灯光强度为正，所有灯光就都被视为光度学灯光，强度以坎德拉计量。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Lighting", para. 1 image-based lighting 基于图像的光照 "Lights of type image provide image-based lighting: the referenced texture illuminates the scene as an environment map." image 类型的灯光提供基于图像的光照：被引用的纹理作为环境贴图照亮场景。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Lighting", para. 1 Rendering options 渲染选项 "The Filament renderer provides a set of options for controlling how the final image is rendered." Filament 渲染器提供一组用于控制最终图像如何渲染的选项。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Rendering options", para. 1 Shadows 阴影 (No definition) （无定义） Google DeepMind, n.d., "Rendering options" Screen-space ambient occlusion 屏幕空间环境光遮蔽 (No definition) （无定义） Google DeepMind, n.d., "Rendering options" Bloom 泛光 (No definition) （无定义） Google DeepMind, n.d., "Rendering options" Color grading 调色 (No definition) （无定义） Google DeepMind, n.d., "Rendering options" Exponential height fog 指数高度雾 (No definition) （无定义） Google DeepMind, n.d., "Rendering options" Vignette 暗角 (No definition) （无定义） Google DeepMind, n.d., "Rendering options" Background 背景 (No definition) （无定义） Google DeepMind, n.d., "Rendering options" OpenGL rendering OpenGL 渲染 "The classic OpenGL renderer (mjr) takes the mjvScene data structure populated in the Visualization stage and renders it." 经典 OpenGL 渲染器（mjr）接收在可视化阶段填充好的 mjvScene 数据结构并渲染它。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "OpenGL rendering", para. 1 immediate-mode 立即模式 "It uses an immediate-mode scene architecture in which mjv_updateScene populates an mjvScene with all geometric objects and lights on every frame, and mjr_render draws it." 它采用立即模式的场景架构，其中 mjv_updateScene 每帧都用全部几何对象和灯光填充一个 mjvScene，再由 mjr_render 绘制它。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Rendering", item 2 Using OpenGL 使用 OpenGL (context) "MuJoCo uses OpenGL 1.5 in the compatibility profile with the ARB_framebuffer_object and ARB_vertex_buffer_object extensions." （语境）MuJoCo 使用兼容性配置下的 OpenGL 1.5，并使用 ARB_framebuffer_object 和 ARB_vertex_buffer_object 扩展。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Using OpenGL", para. 1 Context and GPU resources 上下文与 GPU 资源 (context) "The first step in the rendering process is to create the model-specific GPU context mjrContext." （语境）渲染过程的第一步是创建特定于模型的 GPU 上下文 mjrContext。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Context and GPU resources", para. 1 OpenGL context OpenGL 上下文 "An OpenGL context is what enables the application to talk to the video driver and send rendering commands." OpenGL 上下文是让应用能够与显卡驱动通信并发送渲染命令的东西。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Context and GPU resources", para. 2 mjrContext GPU 上下文 mjrContext "mjrContext is specific to MuJoCo. After creation, it contains references (called “names” in OpenGL) to all the resources that were uploaded to the GPU by mjr_makeContext." mjrContext 是 MuJoCo 特有的。创建之后，它包含对 mjr_makeContext 上传到 GPU 的所有资源的引用（在 OpenGL 中称为“名字”）。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Context and GPU resources", para. 3 Buffers for rendering 渲染缓冲区 "In MuJoCo we provide systematic support for two framebuffers: the default window framebuffer, and one offscreen framebuffer." 在 MuJoCo 中，我们系统地支持两个帧缓冲区：默认的窗口帧缓冲区和一个离屏帧缓冲区。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Buffers for rendering", para. 1 framebuffer objects (FBOs) 帧缓冲区对象（FBO） (context) "In addition to the default window framebuffer, OpenGL can support unlimited framebuffer objects (FBOs) for custom rendering." （语境）除了默认的窗口帧缓冲区，OpenGL 还可以支持任意数量的用于自定义渲染的帧缓冲区对象（FBO）。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Buffers for rendering", para. 1 mjtFramebuffer 帧缓冲区枚举 mjtFramebuffer (context) "They are referred to by the constants in the enum type mjtFramebuffer, namely mjFB_WINDOW and mjFB_OFFSCREEN." （语境）它们用枚举类型 mjtFramebuffer 中的常量来指代，即 mjFB_WINDOW 和 mjFB_OFFSCREEN。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Buffers for rendering", para. 1 active buffer 活动缓冲区 "At any time, one of these two buffers is active for the purposes of MuJoCo rendering, meaning that all subsequent commands are directed to it." 在任何时刻，这两个缓冲区中有一个对 MuJoCo 渲染而言是活动的，意思是之后的所有命令都发往它。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Buffers for rendering", para. 1 window framebuffer 窗口帧缓冲区 "The window framebuffer is created and managed by the operating system and not by OpenGL." 窗口帧缓冲区由操作系统而不是由 OpenGL 创建和管理。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Buffers for rendering", para. 3 offscreen framebuffer 离屏帧缓冲区 "In contrast, the offscreen framebuffer is managed entirely by OpenGL, and so we can create that buffer with whatever properties we want, namely with the resolution and multi-sample properties specified in mjModel.vis." 相比之下，离屏帧缓冲区完全由 OpenGL 管理，因此我们可以按需要的任何属性创建它，即使用 mjModel.vis 中指定的分辨率和多重采样属性。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Buffers for rendering", para. 3 Drawing pixels 绘制像素 (context) "The main rendering function is mjr_render." （语境）主渲染函数是 mjr_render。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Drawing pixels", para. 1 mjtRndFlag 渲染标志枚举 mjtRndFlag (context) "The array mjvScene.flags contains flags indexed by the enum type mjtRndFlag and include options for enabling and disabling wireframe mode, shadows, reflections, skyboxes and fog." （语境）数组 mjvScene.flags 包含由枚举类型 mjtRndFlag 索引的标志，包括启用和禁用线框模式、阴影、反射、天空盒和雾的选项。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Drawing pixels", para. 2 mjtStereo 立体模式枚举 mjtStereo (context) "The possible values are given by the enum type mjtStereo and are as follows:" （语境）可能的取值由枚举类型 mjtStereo 给出，如下： Google DeepMind, n.d., "Drawing pixels", para. 3 References Google DeepMind. (n.d.). Rendering. MuJoCo Documentation (Version 3.17.0). Retrieved October 31, 2026, from https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/programming/rendering.html

ai/mujoco/programming/simulation.html.summary: 5.4 Simulation Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 5.4 Simulation 仿真 (No definition) （无定义） Google DeepMind, n.d., "Simulation" Initialization 初始化 (context) "mjModel and mjData should never be allocated directly by the user. Instead they are allocated and initialized by the corresponding API functions." （语境）mjModel 和 mjData 绝不应由用户直接分配，而是由相应的 API 函数分配和初始化。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Initialization", para. 1 virtual file system (VFS) 虚拟文件系统（VFS） "The virtual file system (VFS) allows disk resources to be loaded in memory or created programmatically by the user, and then MuJoCo’s load functions search for files in the VFS before accessing the disk." 虚拟文件系统（VFS）允许把磁盘资源加载到内存中，或由用户以编程方式创建，然后 MuJoCo 的加载函数会先在 VFS 中查找文件，再访问磁盘。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Initialization", para. 4 Simulation loop 仿真循环 (context) "There are multiple ways to run a simulation loop in MuJoCo. The simplest way is to call the top-level simulation function mj_step in a loop such as" （语境）在 MuJoCo 中运行仿真循环有多种方式。最简单的方式是在循环中调用顶层仿真函数 mj_step，例如 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Simulation loop", para. 1 control callback 控制回调 (context) "The default way to control the system is to implement a control callback, for example" （语境）控制系统的默认方式是实现一个控制回调，例如 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Simulation loop", para. 2 single-step integrators 单步积分器 (context) "There is one complication however: this only works with the single-step integrators (Euler, implicit, implicitfast)." （语境）不过有一个复杂之处：这只适用于单步积分器（Euler、implicit、implicitfast）。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Simulation loop", para. 8 State and control 状态与控制 "MuJoCo has a well-defined state that is easy to set, reset and advance through time." MuJoCo 有一个定义明确、易于设置、重置并随时间推进的状态。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "State and control", para. 1 State components 状态组成部分 "The state is composed of distinct components, described in the mjtState bitfield enum, which enumerates both individual components and combinations of components." 状态由不同的组成部分构成，它们在 mjtState 位域枚举中描述，该枚举既列出单个组成部分，也列出组成部分的组合。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "State components", para. 1 mjtState 状态枚举 mjtState "The state is composed of distinct components, described in the mjtState bitfield enum, which enumerates both individual components and combinations of components." 状态由不同的组成部分构成，它们在 mjtState 位域枚举中描述，该枚举既列出单个组成部分，也列出组成部分的组合。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "State components", para. 1 Physics state 物理状态 "The physics state (mjSTATE_PHYSICS) contains the main quantities which are time-integrated during stepping." 物理状态（mjSTATE_PHYSICS）包含在步进过程中进行时间积分的主要量。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Physics state", para. 1 Position: qpos 位置 qpos "The configuration in generalized coordinates" 广义坐标下的位形 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Physics state", item 1 Velocity: qvel 速度 qvel "The generalized velocities" 广义速度 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Physics state", item 2 Actuator activation: act 执行器激活 act "For a second-order mechanical system, the state contains only position and velocity, but MuJoCo also models stateful actuators (such as biological muscles) that have their own activation states assembled in mjData.act" 对二阶机械系统而言，状态只包含位置和速度，但 MuJoCo 还对有状态的执行器（如生物肌肉）建模，它们有自己的激活状态，汇集在 mjData.act 中 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Physics state", item 3 History buffer: history 历史缓冲区 history "When actuators or sensors have a positive nsample attribute (actuators, sensors), this buffer stores timestamped samples of previous control or sensor values." 当执行器或传感器的 nsample 属性为正时（执行器、传感器），这个缓冲区存储以前的控制值或传感器值的带时间戳样本。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Physics state", item 4 Full physics state 完整物理状态 "t, x above correspond to the full physics state (mjSTATE_FULLPHYSICS) – everything which advances in time." 上面的 t、x 对应完整物理状态（mjSTATE_FULLPHYSICS），即一切随时间推进的量。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Full physics state", para. 1 Time: time 时间 time "The time t (mjData.time) is therefore a state component with dt/dt == 1." 因此时间 t（mjData.time）是一个满足 dt/dt == 1 的状态组成部分。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Full physics state", item 1 Plugin state: plugin_state 插件状态 plugin_state "mjData.plugin_state are states declared by engine plugins." mjData.plugin_state 是由引擎插件声明的状态。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Full physics state", item 2 User inputs 用户输入 "These input fields (mjSTATE_USER) are set by the user and affect the physics simulation, but are untouched by the simulator." 这些输入字段（mjSTATE_USER）由用户设置并影响物理仿真，但仿真器不会改动它们。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "User inputs", para. 1 Control: ctrl 控制 ctrl "The control vector u mostly corresponds to the array mjData.ctrl, containing the actuation signal set by the user." 控制向量 u 主要对应数组 mjData.ctrl，其中包含用户设置的驱动信号。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "User inputs", para. 2 Auxiliary Controls: qfrc_applied and xfrc_applied 辅助控制 qfrc_applied 和 xfrc_applied "mjData.qfrc_applied are directly applied generalized forces.mjData.xfrc_applied are Cartesian wrenches applied to the CoM of individual bodies." mjData.qfrc_applied 是直接施加的广义力。mjData.xfrc_applied 是施加在各个刚体质心上的笛卡尔力旋量。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "User inputs", item 2 MoCap poses: mocap_pos and mocap_quat 动捕位姿 mocap_pos 和 mocap_quat "mjData.mocap_pos and mjData.mocap_quat are special optional kinematic states described here, which allow the user to set the positions and orientations of static bodies in real-time, for example when streaming 6D poses from a motion-capture device." mjData.mocap_pos 和 mjData.mocap_quat 是特殊的可选运动学状态（见此处说明），允许用户实时设置静态刚体的位置和朝向，例如从动作捕捉设备流式传入 6D 位姿时。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "User inputs", item 3 Equality constraint toggle: eq_active 等式约束开关 eq_active "mjData.eq_active is a byte-valued array that allows the user to toggle the state of equality constraints at runtime." mjData.eq_active 是一个字节值数组，允许用户在运行时切换等式约束的状态。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "User inputs", item 4 User data: userdata 用户数据 userdata "mjData.userdata acts as a user-defined memory space untouched by the engine." mjData.userdata 充当引擎不会改动的用户自定义内存空间。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "User inputs", item 5 Warmstarts 热启动 (No definition) （无定义） Google DeepMind, n.d., "Warmstarts" Warmstart accelerations: qacc_warmstart 热启动加速度 qacc_warmstart "mjData.qacc_warmstart are the previous step’s accelerations used to warmstart the constraint solver." mjData.qacc_warmstart 是上一步的加速度，用于热启动约束求解器。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Warmstarts", item 1 Integration state 积分状态 "The integration state (mjSTATE_INTEGRATION) is the union of all the above mjData fields and constitutes the entire set of inputs to the forward dynamics." 积分状态（mjSTATE_INTEGRATION）是以上所有 mjData 字段的并集，构成正向动力学的全部输入。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Integration state", para. 1 Simulation state 仿真状态 "The simulation state is the entirety of the mjData struct and associated memory buffer." 仿真状态是整个 mjData 结构体及其关联的内存缓冲区。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Simulation state", para. 1 State manipulation 状态操作 (context) "Manipulation of the state is facilitated by the mjtState bitfield enum, which enumerates the state components documented above." （语境）状态操作借助 mjtState 位域枚举来实现，该枚举列出了上面介绍的各个状态组成部分。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "State manipulation", para. 1 Forward dynamics 正向动力学 "The goal of forward dynamics is to compute the time-derivative of the state, namely the acceleration vector mjData.qacc and the activation time-derivative mjData.act_dot." 正向动力学的目标是计算状态的时间导数，即加速度向量 mjData.qacc 和激活量的时间导数 mjData.act_dot。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Forward dynamics", para. 1 Inverse dynamics 逆向动力学 (context) "The computation of inverse dynamics is a unique feature of MuJoCo, and is not found in any other modern engine capable of simulating contacts." （语境）逆向动力学的计算是 MuJoCo 的一项独有功能，在其他任何能模拟接触的现代引擎中都没有。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Inverse dynamics", para. 1 Recursive Newton-Euler algorithm 递归牛顿-欧拉算法 (context) "The result mjData.qfrc_inverse is obtained by using the Recursive Newton-Euler algorithm to compute the net force acting on the system, and then subtracting from it all internal forces." （语境）结果 mjData.qfrc_inverse 是这样得到的：用递归牛顿-欧拉算法计算作用在系统上的合力，再从中减去所有内力。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Inverse dynamics", para. 5 computed torque control 计算力矩控制 "It can also be used to compute the joint torques needed to drive the system along a given reference trajectory; this is known as computed torque control." 它还可以用来计算沿给定参考轨迹驱动系统所需的关节力矩，这称为计算力矩控制。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Inverse dynamics", para. 6 Physics violation 物理违背 "Physics violation can be quantified as the norm of any unexplained external force computed by inverse dynamics." 物理违背可以量化为逆向动力学计算出的任何无法解释的外力的范数。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Inverse dynamics", para. 6 Multi-threading 多线程 "MuJoCo has support for within-step multi-threading." MuJoCo 支持步内多线程。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Multi-threading", para. 1 Batched simulation 批量仿真 "The batch API in mujoco/mjbatch.h packages this multi-threading scheme." mujoco/mjbatch.h 中的批量 API 封装了这种多线程方案。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Batched simulation", para. 1 mjBatch 批量结构体 mjBatch "An mjBatch holds nsim simulations of one model and runs them on a thread pool of its own." 一个 mjBatch 保存同一模型的 nsim 个仿真，并在自己的线程池上运行它们。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Batched simulation", para. 1 State rows 状态行 "The batch keeps these states in a table returned by mjb_state, an nsim x nstate array whose row i is simulation i’s state, where nstate is mjb_nstate." 批量对象把这些状态保存在 mjb_state 返回的表中，这是一个 nsim x nstate 数组，其第 i 行是第 i 个仿真的状态，其中 nstate 是 mjb_nstate。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Batched simulation", para. 2 Calls 调用 "A call such as mjb_step runs on the simulations selected by ids, or on all of them." 像 mjb_step 这样的调用在由 ids 选中的仿真上运行，或在全部仿真上运行。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Batched simulation", para. 3 Outputs 输出 "mjb_output registers an mjData field as an output: after every call, the batch copies it out of each simulation’s mjData into an nsim x size array that the batch owns." mjb_output 把一个 mjData 字段注册为输出：每次调用之后，批量对象把它从各个仿真的 mjData 中复制到自己拥有的 nsim x size 数组里。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Batched simulation", para. 4 Shared and persistent mjData 共享与持久的 mjData "By default, a batch keeps one mjData per thread, which each thread reuses for the simulations it runs, so memory scales with threads rather than simulations." 默认情况下，批量对象为每个线程保留一个 mjData，每个线程在它运行的各个仿真之间复用它，因此内存随线程数而不是仿真数增长。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Batched simulation", para. 5 Stages 阶段 "To observe the new state, the calls that step or reset take a stage argument (an mjtStage): when the call is done, the batch runs the stages of mj_forward up to stage at the new state." 为了观察新状态，步进或重置的调用接受一个 stage 参数（一个 mjtStage）：调用完成时，批量对象在新状态上运行 mj_forward 直到 stage 为止的各个阶段。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Batched simulation", para. 6 Continuation 续接 "In a persistent batch, the simulation’s mjData still holds those stages at the next call, so the next step skips them and continues with mj_step2, and fresh observations cost nothing extra." 在持久批量中，下一次调用时该仿真的 mjData 仍保有这些阶段，因此下一步跳过它们，直接续接 mj_step2，新的观测不需要额外开销。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Batched simulation", para. 7 Per-simulation models 逐仿真模型 "To give simulations different model or option values, for example to randomize masses, friction or gravity, mjb_expand expands a field." 为了给各个仿真不同的模型值或选项值，例如随机化质量、摩擦或重力，mjb_expand 会扩展一个字段。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Batched simulation", para. 8 Trajectories and queries 轨迹与查询 "mjb_rollout records open-loop trajectories: it applies a given control sequence and records chosen states or fields after every substep." mjb_rollout 记录开环轨迹：它施加给定的控制序列，并在每个子步之后记录选定的状态或字段。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Batched simulation", para. 9 Threads and callbacks 线程与回调 "The batch’s threads run across simulations, while those of mju_threadpool run within one simulation." 批量对象的线程跨仿真运行，而 mju_threadpool 的线程在一个仿真内部运行。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Batched simulation", para. 10 mjModel changes mjModel 修改 (context) "The general rule is that real-valued parameters are safe to change, while structural integer parameters are not because that may result in incorrect sizes or indexing." （语境）一般规则是：实数值参数可以安全修改，而结构性的整数参数不行，因为那可能导致大小或索引出错。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "mjModel changes", para. 1 Data layout 数据布局 "All matrices in MuJoCo are in row-major format." MuJoCo 中的所有矩阵都采用行主序格式。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Data layout", para. 1 compressed sparse row (CSR) format 压缩稀疏行（CSR）格式 (context) "Sparse matrices are stored in the compressed sparse row (CSR) format." （语境）稀疏矩阵以压缩稀疏行（CSR）格式存储。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Data layout", para. 4 uncompressed 非压缩稀疏布局 "Furthermore, in operations that can change the sparsity pattern, it is more efficient to spread out the data so that we do not have to perform many memory moves when inserting new data. We call this sparse layout “uncompressed”." 此外，在可能改变稀疏模式的运算中，把数据分散存放，使插入新数据时不必做大量内存移动会更高效。我们把这种稀疏布局称为“非压缩”布局。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Data layout", para. 5 unit quaternions 单位四元数 "To represent 3D orientations and rotations, MuJoCo uses unit quaternions – namely 4D unit vectors arranged as q = (w, x, y, z)." 为了表示三维朝向和旋转，MuJoCo 使用单位四元数，即按 q = (w, x, y, z) 排列的四维单位向量。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Data layout", para. 6 6D spatial vectors 6D 空间向量 "MuJoCo also uses 6D spatial vectors internally. These are quantities in mjData prefixed with ‘c’, namely cvel, cacc, cdot, etc. They are spatial motion and force vectors that combine a 3D rotational component followed by a 3D translational component." MuJoCo 内部还使用 6D 空间向量。它们是 mjData 中以 ‘c’ 为前缀的量，即 cvel、cacc、cdot 等。它们是空间运动向量和空间力向量，由一个三维转动分量接一个三维平移分量组成。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Data layout", para. 7 Internal stack 内部栈 "Most top-level MuJoCo functions allocate space on the mjData stack, use it for internal computations, and then deallocate it." 大多数顶层 MuJoCo 函数在 mjData 栈上分配空间，用于内部计算，然后再释放。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Internal stack", para. 3 arena arena 内存区 "MuJoCo allocates and manages dynamic memory in an “arena” space in mjData.arena." MuJoCo 在 mjData.arena 中以“arena”空间分配和管理动态内存。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Internal stack", para. 1 Errors, warnings, logging 错误、警告与日志 "MuJoCo has a unified logging system for errors, warnings and informational messages." MuJoCo 有一个统一的日志系统，用于错误、警告和信息性消息。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Errors, warnings, logging", para. 1 mjfLogHandler 日志处理器类型 mjfLogHandler "All log output is routed through a single callback of type mjfLogHandler, which receives a structured mjLogMessage containing the severity level, message text, and optional source location." 所有日志输出都经由一个 mjfLogHandler 类型的回调传递，它接收一个结构化的 mjLogMessage，其中包含严重级别、消息文本和可选的源代码位置。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Errors, warnings, logging", para. 1 mjLogMessage 日志消息结构体 mjLogMessage "All log output is routed through a single callback of type mjfLogHandler, which receives a structured mjLogMessage containing the severity level, message text, and optional source location." 所有日志输出都经由一个 mjfLogHandler 类型的回调传递，它接收一个结构化的 mjLogMessage，其中包含严重级别、消息文本和可选的源代码位置。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Errors, warnings, logging", para. 1 Installing a handler 安装处理器 (context) "Users who want to intercept and process MuJoCo’s log output should install a log handler using mju_setLogHandler." （语境）想要截获并处理 MuJoCo 日志输出的用户应当用 mju_setLogHandler 安装一个日志处理器。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Installing a handler", para. 1 Save/restore 保存与恢复 "A library or subsystem can temporarily install its own handler and later restore the previous one." 库或子系统可以临时安装自己的处理器，之后再恢复先前的处理器。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Installing a handler", item 1 Chaining 链式调用 "A custom handler can act as a pure observer by calling the previous handler at the end of its callback to preserve existing behavior." 自定义处理器可以充当纯观察者，做法是在其回调末尾调用先前的处理器，以保留原有行为。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Installing a handler", item 2 Default handler 默认处理器 (context) "If no custom handler is installed (or if NULL is passed to mju_setLogHandler), MuJoCo uses a default handler that provides the following behavior:" （语境）如果没有安装自定义处理器（或向 mju_setLogHandler 传入 NULL），MuJoCo 使用一个默认处理器，其行为如下： Google DeepMind, n.d., "Default handler", para. 1 Error recovery 错误恢复 (context) "One situation where it is desirable to continue even after an error is an interactive simulator that fails to load a model file." （语境）需要在出错后仍然继续运行的一种情形，是交互式仿真器加载模型文件失败。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Error recovery", para. 1 Informational messages 信息性消息 "MuJoCo provides two levels of opt-in diagnostic logging: informational messages (mjLOG_INFO) and debug traces (mjLOG_DEBUG)." MuJoCo 提供两个级别的可选诊断日志：信息性消息（mjLOG_INFO）和调试跟踪（mjLOG_DEBUG）。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Informational messages", para. 1 mjtLogTopic 日志主题枚举 mjtLogTopic (context) "Both use topic identifiers from the mjtLogTopic enum, but have a subtle architectural distinction in how filtering is applied:" （语境）两者都使用来自 mjtLogTopic 枚举的主题标识符，但在如何过滤上有细微的架构差别： Google DeepMind, n.d., "Informational messages", para. 1 INFO messages INFO 消息 "Emitted unconditionally by the engine. Filtering happens on the consumer side inside the default handler." 由引擎无条件发出。过滤发生在默认处理器内部的消费者一侧。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Informational messages", item 1 DEBUG messages DEBUG 消息 "Designed for tight, high-frequency simulation loops where constructing strings would be a performance bottleneck. Therefore, filtering happens on the producer side." 为紧凑的高频仿真循环设计，在这种循环中构造字符串会成为性能瓶颈。因此，过滤发生在生产者一侧。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Informational messages", item 2 Legacy handlers 旧版处理器 (context) "The global function pointers mju_user_error and mju_user_warning are still supported for backward compatibility, but are deprecated in favor of mju_setLogHandler." （语境）全局函数指针 mju_user_error 和 mju_user_warning 为向后兼容仍受支持，但已被弃用，改用 mju_setLogHandler。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Legacy handlers", para. 1 Memory handlers 内存处理器 (context) "When MuJoCo allocates and frees memory on the heap, it always uses the functions mju_malloc and mju_free." （语境）MuJoCo 在堆上分配和释放内存时，总是使用函数 mju_malloc 和 mju_free。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Memory handlers", para. 1 Diagnostics 诊断 "MuJoCo has several built-in diagnostics mechanisms that can be used to fine-tune the model." MuJoCo 有若干内置诊断机制，可用于微调模型。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Diagnostics", para. 1 warning 警告 "When the simulator encounters a situation that is not a terminal error but is nevertheless suspicious and likely to result in inaccurate numerical results, it triggers a warning." 当仿真器遇到并非致命错误、但可疑且很可能导致数值结果不准确的情形时，它会触发一个警告。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Diagnostics", para. 2 mjtWarning 警告枚举 mjtWarning (context) "There are several possible warning types, indexed by the enum type mjtWarning." （语境）可能的警告类型有好几种，由枚举类型 mjtWarning 索引。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Diagnostics", para. 2 mjWarningStat 警告统计结构体 mjWarningStat "The array mjData.warning contains one mjWarningStat data structure per warning type, indicating how many times each warning type has been triggered since the last reset and any information about the warning (usually the index of the problematic model element)." 数组 mjData.warning 中每种警告类型对应一个 mjWarningStat 数据结构，表示自上次重置以来每种警告被触发的次数以及关于该警告的信息（通常是出问题的模型元素的索引）。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Diagnostics", para. 2 profiling mechanism 性能剖析机制 (context) "MuJoCo provides an extensive profiling mechanism." （语境）MuJoCo 提供一套全面的性能剖析机制。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Diagnostics", para. 3 mjtTimer 计时器枚举 mjtTimer (context) "It involves multiple timers indexed by the enum type mjtTimer." （语境）它包含由枚举类型 mjtTimer 索引的多个计时器。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Diagnostics", para. 3 mjTimerStat 计时统计结构体 mjTimerStat "The array mjData.timer contains one mjTimerStat data structure per timer." 数组 mjData.timer 中每个计时器对应一个 mjTimerStat 数据结构。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Diagnostics", para. 3 mjSolverStat 求解器统计结构体 mjSolverStat "The array mjData.solver contains one mjSolverStat data structure per iteration of the constraint solver, with information about the constraint state and line search." 数组 mjData.solver 中约束求解器的每次迭代对应一个 mjSolverStat 数据结构，包含关于约束状态和线搜索的信息。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Diagnostics", para. 5 Jacobians 雅可比矩阵 "The derivative of any vector function with respect to its vector argument is called Jacobian." 任意向量函数对其向量自变量的导数称为雅可比矩阵。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Jacobians", para. 1 moment arms 力臂 "In the case of tendons and actuator transmissions the corresponding quantities are mjData.ten_moment and mjData.actuator_moment; we call them moment arms but mathematically they are Jacobians." 对于肌腱和执行器传动，相应的量是 mjData.ten_moment 和 mjData.actuator_moment；我们称之为力臂，但在数学上它们是雅可比矩阵。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Jacobians", para. 2 Contacts 接触 (context) "Here we further clarify contact processing from a programming perspective." （语境）这里进一步从编程的角度说明接触处理。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Contacts", para. 1 mjContact 接触结构体 mjContact (context) "The collision detection stage finds contacts between geoms, and records them in the array mjData.contact of mjContact data structures." （语境）碰撞检测阶段找出 geom 之间的接触，并把它们记录在由 mjContact 数据结构组成的数组 mjData.contact 中。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Contacts", para. 2 mjfCollision 碰撞函数类型 mjfCollision (context) "The collision function type is mjfCollision." （语境）碰撞函数的类型是 mjfCollision。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Contacts", para. 3 friction cone 摩擦锥 (context) "Keep in mind that the contact friction cone can be pyramidal or elliptic, depending on which solver is selected in mjModel.opt." （语境）请记住，接触摩擦锥可以是棱锥形或椭圆形，取决于 mjModel.opt 中选择了哪种求解器。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Contacts", para. 4 contact frame 接触坐标系 (context) "This force and torque are expressed in the contact frame given by mjContact.frame." （语境）这个力和力矩表示在由 mjContact.frame 给出的接触坐标系中。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Contacts", para. 4 Sleeping islands 休眠岛 "If all trees in an island are ready to sleep, they are put to sleep during state advancement and their associated values in tree_asleep are set to a (non-negative) index cycle: the “sleeping island”." 如果一个岛中的所有树都已准备好休眠，它们就会在状态推进时进入休眠，其在 tree_asleep 中的对应值被设为一个（非负的）索引环，即“休眠岛”。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Sleeping islands", para. 2 Sleep policy 休眠策略 "The ability of a kinematic tree to sleep is governed by a policy determined at model compile time." 运动学树能否休眠由模型编译时确定的策略决定。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Sleep policy", para. 1 Sleeping 进入休眠 (context) "Sleeping can happen in one of two ways:" （语境）进入休眠有两种方式： Google DeepMind, n.d., "Sleeping", para. 1 Automatic 自动休眠 "The velocity threshold described above is w.r.t. the infinity norm (largest absolute value) of all velocities associated with an island." 上面所说的速度阈值针对的是与岛相关的所有速度的无穷范数（最大绝对值）。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Sleeping", item 1 Initialized asleep 初始即休眠 "By setting the body/sleep attribute of a tree root to “init”, it is marked as “initialized asleep” and put to sleep during mjData initialization." 把树根的 body/sleep 属性设为“init”，它就被标记为“初始即休眠”，并在 mjData 初始化时进入休眠。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Sleeping", item 2 Waking 唤醒 "Waking happens at the beginning of the timestep, either during mj_kinematics or soon thereafter during the position stage of the simulation pipeline." 唤醒发生在时间步的开始，要么在 mj_kinematics 期间，要么紧随其后在仿真流水线的位置阶段。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Waking", para. 1 Sleeping actuators 休眠的执行器 "As explained in the body/sleep documentation, trees with actuators are by default not allowed to sleep, but this can be overridden by the user." 如 body/sleep 文档所述，带执行器的树默认不允许休眠，但用户可以覆盖这一设置。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Notes", item 1 Sleeping sensors 休眠的传感器 "For most sensors, we can skip the computation of their values when their associated objects are asleep, reporting the value that was computed when those objects were last awake." 对大多数传感器，当其关联对象处于休眠时可以跳过其值的计算，而报告这些对象上次醒着时计算出的值。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Notes", item 2 Static bodies 静态刚体 "Besides the main optimization of allowing kinematic trees to sleep, the sleep feature also includes another, related optimization: the skipping of computation related to static bodies." 除了允许运动学树休眠这一主要优化之外，休眠功能还包含另一项相关的优化：跳过与静态刚体有关的计算。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Notes", item 4 Coordinate frames and transformations 坐标系与变换 (context) "There are multiple coordinate frames used in MuJoCo." （语境）MuJoCo 中使用多种坐标系。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Coordinate frames and transformations", para. 1 forward kinematics 正向运动学 "The mapping from the vector of joints coordinates to the Cartesian positions and orientations of all bodies is called forward kinematics and is the first step in the physics pipeline." 从关节坐标向量到所有刚体的笛卡尔位置和朝向的映射称为正向运动学，它是物理流水线的第一步。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Coordinate frames and transformations", para. 1 inverse kinematics 逆向运动学 "The opposite mapping is called inverse kinematics but it is not uniquely defined and is not implemented in MuJoCo." 相反方向的映射称为逆向运动学，但它的定义不唯一，MuJoCo 中没有实现。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Coordinate frames and transformations", para. 1 joint coordinates 关节坐标 (context) "In joint coordinates, the only complication is that the position vector mjData.qpos has different dimensionality than the velocity and acceleration vectors mjData.qvel and mjData.qacc due to quaternion joints." （语境）在关节坐标中，唯一的复杂之处是：由于四元数关节，位置向量 mjData.qpos 与速度和加速度向量的维数不同（mjData.qvel 和 mjData.qacc）。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Coordinate frames and transformations", para. 2 Cartesian coordinates 笛卡尔坐标 "Cartesian coordinates are more complicated because there are three different coordinate frames that we use: local, global, and com-based." 笛卡尔坐标更复杂，因为我们使用三种不同的坐标系：局部坐标系、全局坐标系和基于质心的坐标系。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Coordinate frames and transformations", para. 3 local coordinates 局部坐标 "Local coordinates are used in mjModel to represent the static offsets between a parent and a child body, as well as the static offsets between a body and any geoms, sites, cameras and lights attached to it." 局部坐标在 mjModel 中用来表示父刚体与子刚体之间的静态偏移，以及刚体与附着其上的 geom、site、相机和灯光之间的静态偏移。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Coordinate frames and transformations", para. 3 global coordinates 全局坐标 (context) "The job of forward kinematics is to accumulate the joint transformations and static offsets along the kinematic tree and compute all positions and orientations in global coordinates." （语境）正向运动学的任务是沿运动学树累积关节变换和静态偏移，并在全局坐标中计算所有位置和朝向。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Coordinate frames and transformations", para. 3 pose 位姿 "A pose is a grouping of a 3D position and a unit quaternion orientation." 位姿是一个三维位置与一个单位四元数朝向的组合。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Coordinate frames and transformations", para. 4 com-based frame 基于质心的坐标系 "Finally, there is the com-based frame. This is used to represent 6D spatial vectors containing a 3D angular velocity or acceleration or torque, followed by a 3D linear velocity or acceleration or force." 最后是基于质心的坐标系。它用来表示 6D 空间向量，其中先是三维角速度、角加速度或力矩，后接三维线速度、线加速度或力。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Coordinate frames and transformations", para. 5 References Google DeepMind. (n.d.). Simulation. MuJoCo Documentation (Version 3.17.0). Retrieved October 31, 2026, from https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/programming/simulation.html

ai/mujoco/programming/user-interface.htm.summary: 5.7 User Interface Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 5.7 User Interface 用户界面 (context) "MuJoCo has a native UI framework." （语境）MuJoCo 有一个原生的 UI 框架。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "User Interface", para. 1 Design overview 设计概述 (No definition) （无定义） Google DeepMind, n.d., "Design overview" Native OpenGL rendering 原生 OpenGL 渲染 "We do not use any helper tools or libraries. Instead we provide C code for rendering all UI elements directly in OpenGL." 我们不使用任何辅助工具或库，而是提供直接用 OpenGL 渲染所有 UI 元素的 C 代码。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Design overview", item 1 Platform abstraction 平台抽象 "The software design has 3 layers: OpenGL rendering of UI elements working in conjunction with the MuJoCo renderer (which is fully cross-platform); abstract functions for access to windows, keyboard and mouse, defined as pure virtual functions in the PlatformUIAdapter class; and an implementation of those functions in the derived class GlfwAdapter." 软件设计分为 3 层：与 MuJoCo 渲染器协同工作的 UI 元素 OpenGL 渲染（完全跨平台）；访问窗口、键盘和鼠标的抽象函数，定义为 PlatformUIAdapter 类中的纯虚函数；以及这些函数在派生类 GlfwAdapter 中的实现。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Design overview", item 2 PlatformUIAdapter 平台 UI 适配器类 PlatformUIAdapter "The software design has 3 layers: OpenGL rendering of UI elements working in conjunction with the MuJoCo renderer (which is fully cross-platform); abstract functions for access to windows, keyboard and mouse, defined as pure virtual functions in the PlatformUIAdapter class; and an implementation of those functions in the derived class GlfwAdapter." 软件设计分为 3 层：与 MuJoCo 渲染器协同工作的 UI 元素 OpenGL 渲染（完全跨平台）；访问窗口、键盘和鼠标的抽象函数，定义为 PlatformUIAdapter 类中的纯虚函数；以及这些函数在派生类 GlfwAdapter 中的实现。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Design overview", item 2 GlfwAdapter GLFW 适配器类 GlfwAdapter "The software design has 3 layers: OpenGL rendering of UI elements working in conjunction with the MuJoCo renderer (which is fully cross-platform); abstract functions for access to windows, keyboard and mouse, defined as pure virtual functions in the PlatformUIAdapter class; and an implementation of those functions in the derived class GlfwAdapter." 软件设计分为 3 层：与 MuJoCo 渲染器协同工作的 UI 元素 OpenGL 渲染（完全跨平台）；访问窗口、键盘和鼠标的抽象函数，定义为 PlatformUIAdapter 类中的纯虚函数；以及这些函数在派生类 GlfwAdapter 中的实现。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Design overview", item 2 Themes and appearance 主题与外观 "Instead, we use themes for colors and spacing, and arrange all UI elements automatically." 取而代之的是，我们用主题来规定颜色和间距，并自动排列所有 UI 元素。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Design overview", item 3 Layout and rectangles 布局与矩形 "Each UI is one virtual rectangle, whose width is determined by the theme and whose height is determined by the sections, items within each section, and also the expand/collapse state of each section." 每个 UI 是一个虚拟矩形，其宽度由主题决定，高度由各分区、每个分区中的条目以及各分区的展开或折叠状态决定。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Design overview", item 4 Static allocation and creation 静态分配与创建 "Rather than allocating and deallocating a large number of objects corresponding to UI elements and linking them together, we create a single C struct (type mjUI) with static allocation supporting some maximum number of sections and elements; and then keep a record of how many are in use." 我们不分配和释放大量对应 UI 元素的对象再把它们链接起来，而是创建单个静态分配的 C 结构体（类型 mjUI），支持一定的最大分区数和元素数，再记录实际用了多少。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Design overview", item 5 Minimal state 最小状态 "The UI is designed to be as stateless as possible, so as to simplify development." UI 设计为尽可能无状态，以简化开发。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Design overview", item 6 Automated enable and disable 自动启用与禁用 "Each UI item can be assigned an integer category. Then a mjfItemEnable callback determines whether each category should be enabled or disabled, based on some program-specific conditions." 每个 UI 条目可以被赋予一个整数类别。然后由一个 mjfItemEnable 回调根据程序特定的条件决定每个类别应启用还是禁用。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Design overview", item 7 mjfItemEnable 条目启用回调类型 mjfItemEnable (context) "Then a mjfItemEnable callback determines whether each category should be enabled or disabled, based on some program-specific conditions." （语境）然后由一个 mjfItemEnable 回调根据程序特定的条件决定每个类别应启用还是禁用。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Design overview", item 7 Main API 主要 API (context) "Click on the links below for detailed API reference of the main UI data structures and functions." （语境）点击下面的链接可查看主要 UI 数据结构和函数的详细 API 参考。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Main API", para. 1 mjUI UI 结构体 mjUI "An entire UI." 一个完整的 UI。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Main API", item 1 mjuiState UI 状态结构体 mjuiState "Global UI state." 全局 UI 状态。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Main API", item 2 mjuiDef UI 定义结构体 mjuiDef "One entry in the definition table used for UI construction." 用于构建 UI 的定义表中的一项。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Main API", item 3 References Google DeepMind. (n.d.). User Interface. MuJoCo Documentation (Version 3.17.0). Retrieved October 31, 2026, from https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/programming/ui.html

ai/mujoco/programming/visualization.html.title: 5.5 Visualization | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
ai/mujoco/programming/visualization.html.summary: 5.5 Visualization Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 5.5 Visualization 可视化 (context) "MuJoCo has a native 3D visualization layer that is independent of any graphics library." （语境）MuJoCo 有一个不依赖任何图形库的原生三维可视化层。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Visualization", para. 1 Cameras 相机 "There are two types of camera objects: an abstract camera represented with the stand-alone data structure mjvCamera, and a low-level camera represented with the data structure mjvGLCamera (also aliased as mjrCamera) which is embedded in mjvScene or computed directly via mjv_camera2GLCamera." 相机对象有两种类型：一种是用独立数据结构 mjvCamera 表示的抽象相机，另一种是用数据结构 mjvGLCamera（别名 mjrCamera）表示的底层相机，它嵌在 mjvScene 中，或直接通过 mjv_camera2GLCamera 计算得到。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Cameras", para. 1 mjvCamera 抽象相机 mjvCamera "mjvCamera and mjvGLCamera represent high-level interactive cameras and low-level frustum cameras." mjvCamera 和 mjvGLCamera 分别表示高层交互式相机和底层视锥相机。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Visualization", item 1 mjvGLCamera 底层相机 mjvGLCamera "The low-level mjvGLCamera is what determines the actual rendering." 底层的 mjvGLCamera 决定实际的渲染。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Cameras", para. 3 mjtCamera 相机类型枚举 mjtCamera (context) "The abstract camera can represent three different camera types as determined by mjvCamera.type. The possible settings are defined by the enum mjtCamera:" （语境）抽象相机可以表示三种不同的相机类型，由 mjvCamera.type 决定。可能的取值由枚举 mjtCamera 定义： Google DeepMind, n.d., "Cameras", para. 2 Selection 选取 "In many applications we need to click on a point and determine the 3D object to which this point/pixel belongs." 在许多应用中，我们需要点击一个点，并确定这个点或像素所属的三维物体。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Selection", para. 1 Perturbations 扰动 (context) "Interactive perturbations have proven very useful in exploring the model dynamics as well as probing closed-loop control systems." （语境）交互式扰动已被证明在探索模型动力学以及检验闭环控制系统方面非常有用。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Perturbations", para. 1 mjvPerturb 扰动结构体 mjvPerturb "All objects needed to implement interactive perturbations are grouped into the data structure mjvPerturb." 实现交互式扰动所需的全部对象都归集在数据结构 mjvPerturb 中。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Perturbations", para. 2 Visualization options 可视化选项 "The data structure mjvOption controls what is shown, independently of how it is rendered." 数据结构 mjvOption 控制显示什么，而与如何渲染无关。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Visualization options", para. 1 mjvOption 可视化选项结构体 mjvOption "mjvOption controls which element categories, geom groups, and diagnostic overlays are visible." mjvOption 控制哪些元素类别、geom 分组和诊断叠加层可见。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Visualization", item 2 mjtVisFlag 可视化标志枚举 mjtVisFlag (context) "flags, indexed by mjtVisFlag, enable the decorative and diagnostic elements: contact points and forces, joint and actuator axes, constraint violations, inertia boxes, convex hulls, skins, tendons, perturbation forces, and so on." （语境）flags 由 mjtVisFlag 索引，用来启用装饰性和诊断性元素：接触点和接触力、关节轴和执行器轴、约束违背、惯性盒、凸包、蒙皮、肌腱、扰动力等。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Visualization options", item 1 mjtLabel 标签枚举 mjtLabel (context) "label (mjtLabel) and frame (mjtFrame) select which category of objects is labeled with text and which spatial frames are drawn." （语境）label（mjtLabel）和 frame（mjtFrame）选择哪一类对象加文字标签，以及绘制哪些空间坐标系。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Visualization options", item 3 mjtFrame 坐标系枚举 mjtFrame (context) "label (mjtLabel) and frame (mjtFrame) select which category of objects is labeled with text and which spatial frames are drawn." （语境）label（mjtLabel）和 frame（mjtFrame）选择哪一类对象加文字标签，以及绘制哪些空间坐标系。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Visualization options", item 3 Scene update 场景更新 (context) "Finally, we bring all of the above elements together and explain how mjvScene is updated." （语境）最后，我们把上述所有元素结合起来，说明如何更新 mjvScene。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Scene update", para. 1 mjvScene 抽象场景 mjvScene "mjvScene and mjvGeom hold a complete per-frame geometric description of the 3D scene and its decorations." mjvScene 和 mjvGeom 保存三维场景及其装饰的完整逐帧几何描述。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Visualization", item 4 mjvGeom 抽象几何体 mjvGeom "Note that mjvGeom is an abstract geom, and is not in one-to-one correspondence with the simulation geoms in mjModel and mjData." 注意 mjvGeom 是一个抽象 geom，它与 mjModel 和 mjData 中的仿真 geom 并非一一对应。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Scene update", para. 2 mjtCatBit 类别位枚举 mjtCatBit (context) "Importantly, the user can select which geom categories will be added, via a bitmask of enum type mjtCatBit:" （语境）重要的是，用户可以通过枚举类型 mjtCatBit 的位掩码选择添加哪些 geom 类别： Google DeepMind, n.d., "Scene update", para. 4 Virtual reality 虚拟现实 (context) "While MuJoCo does not provide a built-in VR application, it provides data structures and functions to support VR integration in user code." （语境）虽然 MuJoCo 不提供内置的 VR 应用，但它提供在用户代码中支持 VR 集成的数据结构和函数。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Virtual reality", para. 3 model transformation 模型变换 "If anything can be moved by the user (with a mouse or other input device) it is the position, orientation and scale of the model relative to the room. This is called model transformation, and is represented in mjvScene." 如果有什么能被用户（用鼠标或其他输入设备）移动，那就是模型相对于房间的位置、朝向和缩放。这称为模型变换，在 mjvScene 中表示。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Virtual reality", para. 1 model space 模型空间 "Everything accessible by the simulator lives in the model space." 仿真器能访问的一切都位于模型空间中。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Virtual reality", para. 2 room space 房间空间 "The room space is only accessible by the visualizer." 房间空间只有可视化器能访问。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Virtual reality", para. 2 Head tracking and cameras 头部跟踪与相机 "In a typical VR application, a tracking device provides the positions and orientations of the user’s eyes in real-time." 在典型的 VR 应用中，跟踪设备实时提供用户双眼的位置和朝向。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Virtual reality", item 1 Controllers and mocap bodies 控制器与动捕刚体 (context) "Hand-held spatial controllers are also tracked in room space." （语境）手持空间控制器同样在房间空间中被跟踪。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Virtual reality", item 2 mocap bodies 动捕刚体 "Mocap bodies are treated as fixed from the viewpoint of physics, yet the user is expected to move them programmatically at each simulation step." 从物理的角度看，动捕刚体被视为固定的，但用户应在每个仿真步以编程方式移动它们。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Virtual reality", item 2 References Google DeepMind. (n.d.). Visualization. MuJoCo Documentation (Version 3.17.0). Retrieved October 31, 2026, from https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/programming/visualization.html

ai/mujoco/python/index.html.title: 7. Python | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
ai/mujoco/python/index.html.summary: 7. Python Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 7 Python Python "MuJoCo comes with native Python bindings that are developed in C++ using pybind11." MuJoCo 自带用 pybind11 在 C++ 中开发的原生 Python 绑定。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Python", para. 1 7.1 Interactive viewer 交互式查看器 "An interactive GUI viewer is provided as part of the Python package in the mujoco.viewer module." 一个交互式图形界面查看器作为 Python 包的一部分，在 mujoco.viewer 模块中提供。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Interactive viewer", para. 1 7.2 Model editing 模型编辑 (No definition) （无定义） Google DeepMind, n.d., "Model editing" 7.3 Modules 模块 (context) "The mujoco package contains two sub-modules: mujoco.rollout and mujoco.minimize" （语境）mujoco 包包含两个子模块：mujoco.rollout 和 mujoco.minimize Google DeepMind, n.d., "Modules", para. 1 7.4 Utilities 工具脚本 (context) "The python/mujoco directory also contains utility scripts." （语境）python/mujoco 目录中还包含工具脚本。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Utilities", para. 1 Structs 结构体 "The bindings include Python classes that expose MuJoCo data structures." 绑定包含提供 MuJoCo 数据结构的 Python 类。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Structs", para. 1 MjModel MjModel 类 (context) "The mujoco.MjModel class does not have a Python constructor. Instead, we provide three static factory functions that create a new mjModel instance: mujoco.MjModel.from_xml_string, mujoco.MjModel.from_xml_path, and mujoco.MjModel.from_binary_path." （语境）mujoco.MjModel 类没有 Python 构造函数。取而代之，我们提供三个创建新 mjModel 实例的静态工厂函数：mujoco.MjModel.from_xml_string、mujoco.MjModel.from_xml_path 和 mujoco.MjModel.from_binary_path。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Structs", para. 5 MjData MjData 类 (context) "In order to conform to PEP 8 naming guidelines, struct names begin with a capital letter, for example mjData becomes mujoco.MjData in Python." （语境）为了符合 PEP 8 命名规范，结构体名称以大写字母开头，例如 mjData 在 Python 中变为 mujoco.MjData。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Structs", para. 2 MjOption MjOption 类 "For structs that have an mj_defaultFoo-style initialization function, the Python constructor calls the default initializer automatically, so for example mujoco.MjOption() creates a new mjOption instance that is pre-initialized with mj_defaultOption." 对于有 mj_defaultFoo 式初始化函数的结构体，Python 构造函数会自动调用默认初始化函数，例如 mujoco.MjOption() 创建一个用 mj_defaultOption 预先初始化的新 mjOption 实例。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Structs", para. 3 MjvScene MjvScene 类 "Structs with a mj_makeFoo-style initialization function have corresponding constructor overloads in Python, for example mujoco.MjvScene(model, maxgeom=10) in Python creates a new mjvScene instance that is initialized with mjv_makeScene(model, [the new mjvScene instance], 10) in C." 有 mj_makeFoo 式初始化函数的结构体在 Python 中有相应的构造函数重载，例如 Python 中的 mujoco.MjvScene(model, maxgeom=10) 创建一个新的 mjvScene 实例，它在 C 中用 mjv_makeScene(model, [新的 mjvScene 实例], 10) 初始化。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Structs", para. 4 MjVisual MjVisual 类 (context) "Likewise, the sub-struct attributes of MjModel (opt, vis, stat) and MjVisual (global_, quality, headlight, map, scale, rgba) can be assigned to, for example model.opt = new_opt, which copies the fields of new_opt into the model’s own mjOption struct in place." （语境）同样，MjModel 的子结构体属性（opt、vis、stat）和 MjVisual 的子结构体属性（global_、quality、headlight、map、scale、rgba）可以被赋值，例如 model.opt = new_opt，它把 new_opt 的字段就地复制到模型自己的 mjOption 结构体中。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Structs", para. 6 Enums and constants 枚举与常量 (context) "MuJoCo enums are available as mujoco.mjtEnumType.ENUM_VALUE, for example mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_SITE." （语境）MuJoCo 枚举以 mujoco.mjtEnumType.ENUM_VALUE 的形式提供，例如 mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_SITE。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Enums and constants", para. 1 Named access 按名称访问 "For convenience and code readability, the Python bindings provide “named access” API on MjModel and MjData." 为了方便和代码可读性，Python 绑定在 MjModel 和 MjData 上提供“按名称访问”API。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Named access", para. 1 name category 名称类别 "Each name_fooadr field in the mjModel struct defines a name category foo." mjModel 结构体中的每个 name_fooadr 字段定义一个名称类别 foo。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Named access", para. 1 accessor object 访问器对象 "The accessor object contains attributes whose names correspond to the fields of either mujoco.MjModel or mujoco.MjData but with the part before the underscore removed." 访问器对象包含一些属性，其名称对应 mujoco.MjModel 或 mujoco.MjData 的字段，但去掉了下划线之前的部分。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Named access", para. 2 aliases 别名 "Additionally, the Python API define a number of aliases for some name categories corresponding to the XML element name in the MJCF schema that defines an entity of that category." 此外，Python API 为某些名称类别定义了若干别名，对应 MJCF 模式中定义该类别实体的 XML 元素名。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Named access", para. 3 Rendering 渲染 (context) "MuJoCo provides two rendering APIs: the classic rendering API (which uses OpenGL 1.5) and the filament rendering API (which provides more modern physically-based rendering capabilities)." （语境）MuJoCo 提供两套渲染 API：经典渲染 API（使用 OpenGL 1.5）和 Filament 渲染 API（提供更现代的基于物理的渲染能力）。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Rendering", para. 1 Filament Rendering Filament 渲染 "The Python mjrf module exposes the mjrf_ C API to python." Python 的 mjrf 模块把 mjrf_ C API 提供给 Python。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Filament Rendering", para. 1 Basic structs 基本结构体 "Basic structs (e.g. mjrRect, mjrCamera, etc.) are considered to be simple POD data types and are bound directly as python types allowing copies to be made as needed." 基本结构体（例如 mjrRect、mjrCamera 等）被视为简单的 POD 数据类型，直接绑定为 Python 类型，可以按需复制。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Filament Rendering", item 3 Objects 对象 "mjrf types that have explicit create/destroy functions in the C API (e.g. mjrfContext, mjrfTexture, etc.) are treated as “Objects”." 在 C API 中有显式创建或销毁函数的 mjrf 类型（例如 mjrfContext、mjrfTexture 等）被当作“对象”。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Filament Rendering", item 4 ModelScene ModelScene 类 "We also provide a ModelScene helper class under mujoco.rendering.filament. This class can be used to add and update mjrfRenderable and mjrfLight objects in an mjrfScene based on the contents of an mjModel and mjData." 我们还在 mujoco.rendering.filament 下提供 ModelScene 辅助类。这个类可用来根据 mjModel 和 mjData 的内容，在 mjrfScene 中添加和更新 mjrfRenderable 与 mjrfLight 对象。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Filament Rendering", para. 2 Renderer Renderer 类 "Similarly, we also provide a Renderer class under mujoco.rendering.filament. This class can be used to manage the lifetimes of key objects (such as the mjrfContext and mjrfScene) and provides useful functions for controlling the camera and reading pixels." 类似地，我们还在 mujoco.rendering.filament 下提供 Renderer 类。这个类可用来管理关键对象（如 mjrfContext 和 mjrfScene）的生命周期，并提供控制相机和读取像素的实用函数。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Filament Rendering", para. 3 Classic Rendering 经典渲染 (context) "The MuJoCo classic renderer expects users to set up a working OpenGL context before calling any of its mjr_ rendering routines." （语境）MuJoCo 经典渲染器要求用户在调用其任何 mjr_ 渲染例程之前建立一个可用的 OpenGL 上下文。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Classic Rendering", para. 1 mujoco.GLContext mujoco.GLContext 类 "The Python bindings provide a basic class mujoco.GLContext that helps users set up such a context for offscreen rendering." Python 绑定提供一个基础类 mujoco.GLContext，帮助用户为离屏渲染建立这样的上下文。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Classic Rendering", para. 1 make_current() make_current() 方法 (context) "Once the context is created, it must be made current before MuJoCo rendering functions can be called, which you can do so via ctx.make_current()." （语境）上下文创建之后，必须先把它设为当前上下文，才能调用 MuJoCo 渲染函数，可以通过 ctx.make_current() 完成。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Classic Rendering", para. 1 free() free() 方法 (context) "The context is freed automatically when the ctx object is deleted, but in some multi-threaded scenario it may be necessary to explicitly free the underlying OpenGL context." （语境）删除 ctx 对象时上下文会自动释放，但在某些多线程场景中，可能需要显式释放底层的 OpenGL 上下文。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Classic Rendering", para. 2 Error handling 错误处理 "The Python bindings utilizes longjmp to allow it to convert irrecoverable MuJoCo errors into Python exceptions of type mujoco.FatalError that can be caught and processed in the usual Pythonic way." Python 绑定利用 longjmp，把不可恢复的 MuJoCo 错误转换为 Python 异常（类型为 mujoco.FatalError），可以按通常的 Python 方式捕获和处理。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Error handling", para. 2 Callbacks 回调 "MuJoCo allows users to install custom callback functions to modify certain parts of its computation pipeline." MuJoCo 允许用户安装自定义回调函数，以修改其计算流水线的某些部分。 Google DeepMind, n.d., "Callbacks", para. 1 References Google DeepMind. (n.d.). Python. MuJoCo Documentation (Version 3.17.0). Retrieved October 31, 2026, from https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/python.html

ai/mujoco/python/interactive-viewer.html.summary: 7.1 Interactive viewer Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 7.1 Interactive viewer 交互式查看器 "An interactive GUI viewer is provided as There comes the FAST algorithm, which is really "FAST"." （语境）但它们不够快，无法用于 SLAM 等实时应用。于是有了 FAST 算法，它真的很“快”。 OpenCV team, n.d.-a, "Feature Detection and Description", item 6 3.7 BRIEF (Binary Robust Independent Elementary Features) BRIEF（二进制稳健独立基本特征） (context) "SIFT uses a feature descriptor with 128 floating point numbers." （语境）SIFT 使用一个由 128 个浮点数组成的特征描述子。 OpenCV team, n.d.-a, "Feature Detection and Description", item 7 3.8 ORB (Oriented FAST and Rotated BRIEF) ORB（定向 FAST 与旋转 BRIEF） (context) "SIFT and SURF are good in what they do, but what if you have to pay a few dollars every year to use them in your applications? ai/opencv/feature-detection-and-descript.title: 3.4 Introduction to SIFT (Scale-Invariant Feature Transform) | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
ai/opencv/feature-detection-and-descript.summary: 3.4 Introduction to SIFT (Scale-Invariant Feature Transform) Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 3.4 Introduction to SIFT (Scale-Invariant Feature Transform) SIFT（尺度不变特征变换）简介 (context) "Lowe developed a breakthrough method to find scale-invariant features and it is called SIFT" （语境）Lowe 提出了一种寻找尺度不变特征的突破性方法，称为 SIFT OpenCV team, n.d.-a, "Feature Detection and Description", item 4 Theory 理论 "In 2004, D.Lowe, University of British Columbia, came up with a new algorithm, Scale Invariant Feature Transform (SIFT) in his paper, Distinctive Image Features from Scale-Invariant Keypoints, which extract keypoints and compute its descriptors." 2004 年，不列颠哥伦比亚大学的 D.Lowe 在论文 Distinctive Image Features from Scale-Invariant Keypoints 中提出了一种新算法：尺度不变特征变换（SIFT），它提取关键点并计算其描述子。 OpenCV team, n.d.-b, "Theory", para. 2 rotation-invariant 旋转不变 "They are rotation-invariant, which means, even if the image is rotated, we can find the same corners." 它们是旋转不变的，意思是即使图像旋转了，也能找到相同的角点。 OpenCV team, n.d.-b, "Theory", para. 1 Scale-space Extrema Detection 尺度空间极值检测 "So, we can find the local maxima across the scale and space which gives us a list of (x,y,σ) values which means there is a potential keypoint at (x,y) at σ scale." 于是可以求出跨尺度和空间的局部极大值，得到一组 (x,y,σ) 值，表示在 σ 尺度下 (x,y) 处有一个潜在关键点。 OpenCV team, n.d.-b, "1. Scale-space Extrema Detection", para. 1 Laplacian of Gaussian (LoG) 高斯拉普拉斯（LoG） (context) "LoG acts as a blob detector which detects blobs in various sizes due to change in σ." （语境）LoG 充当斑点检测器，随着 σ 的变化检测各种大小的斑点。 OpenCV team, n.d.-b, "1. Scale-space Extrema Detection", para. 1 Difference of Gaussians (DoG) 高斯差分（DoG） "Difference of Gaussian is obtained as the difference of Gaussian blurring of an image with two different σ, let it be σ and kσ." 高斯差分是用两个不同的 σ（设为 σ 和 kσ）对图像做高斯模糊所得结果之差。 OpenCV team, n.d.-b, "1. Scale-space Extrema Detection", para. 2 Keypoint Localization 关键点定位 "Once potential keypoints locations are found, they have to be refined to get more accurate results." 找到潜在关键点的位置后，还要对它们加以细化以得到更准确的结果。 OpenCV team, n.d.-b, "2. Keypoint Localization", para. 1 Orientation Assignment 方向分配 "Now an orientation is assigned to each keypoint to achieve invariance to image rotation." 现在给每个关键点分配一个方向，以实现对图像旋转的不变性。 OpenCV team, n.d.-b, "3. Orientation Assignment", para. 1 Keypoint Descriptor 关键点描述子 "So a total of 128 bin values are available. It is represented as a vector to form keypoint descriptor." 于是共有 128 个直方柱值。把它表示为一个向量，就构成关键点描述子。 OpenCV team, n.d.-b, "4. Keypoint Descriptor", para. 1 Keypoint Matching 关键点匹配 "Keypoints between two images are matched by identifying their nearest neighbours." 两幅图像之间的关键点通过找出它们的最近邻来匹配。 OpenCV team, n.d.-b, "5. Keypoint Matching", para. 1 SIFT in OpenCV OpenCV 中的 SIFT (No definition) （无定义） OpenCV team, n.d.-b, "SIFT in OpenCV" sift.detect() detect 方法 "sift.detect() function finds the keypoint in the images." sift.detect() 函数在图像中寻找关键点。 OpenCV team, n.d.-b, "SIFT in OpenCV", para. 2 keypoint 关键点 "Each keypoint is a special structure which has many attributes" 每个关键点都是一种具有许多属性的特殊结构 OpenCV team, n.d.-b, "SIFT in OpenCV", para. 2 sift.compute() compute 方法 "Since you already found keypoints, you can call sift.compute() which computes the descriptors from the keypoints we have found." 既然已经找到了关键点，可以调用 sift.compute()，它根据已找到的关键点计算描述子。 OpenCV team, n.d.-b, "SIFT in OpenCV", item 1 sift.detectAndCompute() detectAndCompute 方法 "If you didn't find keypoints, directly find keypoints and descriptors in a single step with the function, sift.detectAndCompute()." 如果还没有找到关键点，可以用函数 sift.detectAndCompute() 一步直接求出关键点和描述子。 OpenCV team, n.d.-b, "SIFT in OpenCV", item 2 References OpenCV team. (n.d.-a). Feature Detection and Description. OpenCV-Python Tutorials (Version 4.13.0). Retrieved October 31, 2026, from https://docs.opencv.org/4.x/db/d27/tutorial_py_table_of_contents_feature2d.html OpenCV team. (n.d.-b). Introduction to SIFT (Scale-Invariant Feature Transform). OpenCV-Python Tutorials (Version 4.13.0). Retrieved October 31, 2026, from https://docs.opencv.org/4.x/da/df5/tutorial_py_sift_intro.html

ai/opencv/feature-detection-and-descript.title: 3.5 Introduction to SURF (Speeded-Up Robust Features) | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
ai/opencv/feature-detection-and-descript.summary: 3.5 Introduction to SURF (Speeded-Up Robust Features) Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 3.5 Introduction to SURF (Speeded-Up Robust Features) SURF（加速稳健特征）简介 (context) "SIFT is really good, but not fast enough, so people came up with a speeded-up version called SURF." （语境）SIFT 确实很好，但不够快，所以人们提出了一个加速版本，叫 SURF。 OpenCV team, n.d.-a, "Feature Detection and Description", item 5 Theory 理论 "As name suggests, it is a speeded-up version of SIFT." 顾名思义，它是 SIFT 的加速版本。 OpenCV team, n.d.-b, "Theory", para. 1 Upright-SURF (U-SURF) 竖直 SURF（U-SURF） "For many applications, rotation invariance is not required, so no need of finding this orientation, which speeds up the process. SURF provides such a functionality called Upright-SURF or U-SURF." 对许多应用来说并不需要旋转不变性，因此无需求这个方向，从而加快了处理速度。SURF 提供了这样一种功能，称为 Upright-SURF 或 U-SURF。 OpenCV team, n.d.-b, "Theory", para. 3 SURF feature descriptor SURF 特征描述子 (context) "This when represented as a vector gives SURF feature descriptor with total 64 dimensions." （语境）把它表示为向量，就得到共 64 维的 SURF 特征描述子。 OpenCV team, n.d.-b, "Theory", para. 4 sign of Laplacian 拉普拉斯符号 "The sign of the Laplacian distinguishes bright blobs on dark backgrounds from the reverse situation." 拉普拉斯符号区分暗背景上的亮斑点与相反的情形。 OpenCV team, n.d.-b, "Theory", para. 6 SURF in OpenCV OpenCV 中的 SURF (No definition) （无定义） OpenCV team, n.d.-b, "SURF in OpenCV" SURF.detect() detect 方法 (context) "Then as we did in SIFT, we can use SURF.detect(), SURF.compute() etc for finding keypoints and descriptors." （语境）然后像 SIFT 中那样，可以用 SURF.detect()、SURF.compute() 等来求关键点和描述子。 OpenCV team, n.d.-b, "SURF in OpenCV", para. 1 SURF.compute() compute 方法 (context) "Then as we did in SIFT, we can use SURF.detect(), SURF.compute() etc for finding keypoints and descriptors." （语境）然后像 SIFT 中那样，可以用 SURF.detect()、SURF.compute() 等来求关键点和描述子。 OpenCV team, n.d.-b, "SURF in OpenCV", para. 1 References OpenCV team. ai/opencv/feature-detection-and-descript.summary: 3.8 ORB (Oriented FAST and Rotated BRIEF) Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 3.8 ORB (Oriented FAST and Rotated BRIEF) ORB（定向 FAST 与旋转 BRIEF） (context) "SIFT and SURF are good in what they do, but what if you have to pay a few dollars every year to use them in your applications? Yeah, they are patented!!!" （语境）SIFT 和 SURF 本身很好，但如果每年要付钱才能在应用中使用它们呢？没错，它们有专利！！！ OpenCV team, n.d.-a, "Feature Detection and Description", item 8 Theory 理论 "ORB is basically a fusion of FAST keypoint detector and BRIEF descriptor with many modifications to enhance the performance." ORB 基本上是FAST 关键点检测器与 BRIEF 描述子的融合，并做了许多改进以提升性能。 OpenCV team, n.d.-b, "Theory", para. 2 rBRIEF rBRIEF "To resolve all these, ORB runs a greedy search among all possible binary tests to find the ones that have both high variance and means close to 0.5, as well as being uncorrelated. The result is called rBRIEF." 为解决这些问题，ORB 在所有可能的二进制测试中进行贪心搜索，找出方差高、均值接近 0.5 且互不相关的测试。其结果称为 rBRIEF。 OpenCV team, n.d.-b, "Theory", para. 6 References OpenCV team. (n.d.-a). How can finding those features be useful to us?" （语境）图像中的主要特征是什么？找到这些特征对我们有什么用？ OpenCV team, n.d.-a, "Feature Detection and Description", item 1 Explanation 解释 "The answer is, we are looking for specific patterns or specific features which are unique, can be easily tracked and can be easily compared." 答案是，我们在寻找独特的、容易跟踪且容易比较的特定模式或特定特征。 OpenCV team, n.d.-b, "Explanation", para. 3 Feature Detection 特征检测 "So finding these image features is called Feature Detection." 因此，寻找这些图像特征称为特征检测。 OpenCV team, n.d.-b, "Explanation", para. 11 Feature Description 特征描述 "Similarly, a computer also should describe the region around the feature so that it can find it in other images. So called description is called Feature Description." 同样，计算机也应当描述特征周围的区域，以便在其他图像中找到它。这种描述称为特征描述。 OpenCV team, n.d.-b, "Explanation", para. 12 References OpenCV team. (n.d.-a).
