ai/opencv/image-processing-in-opencv/can.title: 2.7 Canny Edge Detection | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
ai/opencv/image-processing-in-opencv/can.summary: 2.7 Canny Edge Detection Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 2.7 Canny Edge Detection Canny 边缘检测 (context) "Learn to find edges with Canny Edge Detection" （语境）学习用 Canny 边缘检测寻找边缘 OpenCV team, n.d.-b, "Image Processing in OpenCV", item 7 Theory 理论 "Canny Edge Detection is a popular edge detection algorithm." Canny 边缘检测是一种常用的边缘检测算法。 OpenCV team, n.d.-a, "Theory", para. 1 Noise Reduction 降噪 "Noise Reduction Since edge detection is susceptible to noise in the image, first step is to remove the noise in the image with a 5x5 Gaussian filter." Noise Reduction 由于边缘检测容易受图像噪声影响，第一步是用 5×5 高斯滤波器去除图像中的噪声。 OpenCV team, n.d.-a, "Theory", item 1 Finding Intensity Gradient of the Image 计算图像的强度梯度 "Finding Intensity Gradient of the Image Smoothened image is then filtered with a Sobel kernel in both horizontal and vertical direction to get first derivative in horizontal direction ( Gx) and vertical direction ( Gy)." Finding Intensity Gradient of the Image 然后用 Sobel 卷积核在水平和垂直两个方向上对平滑后的图像滤波，得到水平方向（Gx）和垂直方向（Gy）的一阶导数。 OpenCV team, n.d.-a, "Theory", item 2 Non-maximum Suppression 非极大值抑制 "Non-maximum Suppression After getting gradient magnitude and direction, a full scan of image is done to remove any unwanted pixels which may not constitute the edge." Non-maximum Suppression 得到梯度幅值和方向之后，对图像做一次完整扫描，去除所有可能不构成边缘的多余像素。 OpenCV team, n.d.-a, "Theory", item 3 Hysteresis Thresholding 滞后阈值化 "Hysteresis Thresholding This stage decides which are all edges are really edges and which are not." Hysteresis Thresholding 这一阶段判定哪些边缘是真正的边缘，哪些不是。 OpenCV team, n.d.-a, "Theory", item 4 References OpenCV team. (n.d.-a). Canny Edge Detection. OpenCV-Python Tutorials (Version 4.13.0). Retrieved October 31, 2026, from https://docs.opencv.org/4.x/da/d22/tutorial_py_canny.html OpenCV team. (n.d.-b). Image Processing in OpenCV. OpenCV-Python Tutorials (Version 4.13.0). Retrieved October 31, 2026, from https://docs.opencv.org/4.x/d2/d96/tutorial_py_table_of_contents_imgproc.html

ai/opencv/image-processing-in-opencv/con.summary: 2.9 Contours in OpenCV Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 2.9 Contours in OpenCV OpenCV 中的轮廓 (context) "All about Contours in OpenCV" （语境）关于 OpenCV 中轮廓的一切 OpenCV team, n.d.-g, "Image Processing in OpenCV", item 9 Contours : Getting Started 轮廓入门 (context) "Learn to find and draw Contours" （语境）学习寻找和绘制轮廓 OpenCV team, n.d.-f, "Contours in OpenCV", item 1 Contours 轮廓 "Contours can be explained simply as a curve joining all the continuous points (along the boundary), having same color or intensity." 轮廓可以简单地解释为连接所有连续点（沿边界）、具有相同颜色或强度的曲线。 OpenCV team, n.d.-c, "What are contours?", para. 1 Contour Approximation Method 轮廓近似方法 (context) "But does it store all the coordinates ? That is specified by this contour approximation method." （语境）但它会存储所有坐标吗？这由轮廓近似方法来指定。 OpenCV team, n.d.-c, "Contour Approximation Method", para. 2 Contour Features 轮廓特征 (context) "Learn to find different features of contours like area, perimeter, bounding rectangle etc." （语境）学习求轮廓的各种特征，如面积、周长、外接矩形等。 OpenCV team, n.d.-f, "Contours in OpenCV", item 2 Moments 矩 "Image moments help you to calculate some features like center of mass of the object, area of the object etc." 图像矩帮助你计算一些特征，如物体的质心、物体的面积等。 OpenCV team, n.d.-a, "1. Moments", para. 1 Contour Area 轮廓面积 (context) "Contour area is given by the function cv.contourArea() or from moments, M['m00']." （语境）轮廓面积由函数 cv.contourArea() 给出，或者由矩 M['m00'] 得到。 OpenCV team, n.d.-a, "2. Contour Area", para. 1 Contour Perimeter 轮廓周长 "It is also called arc length." 它也称为弧长。 OpenCV team, n.d.-a, "3. Contour Perimeter", para. 1 Contour Approximation 轮廓近似 "It approximates a contour shape to another shape with less number of vertices depending upon the precision we specify." 它按照我们指定的精度，把一个轮廓形状近似为另一个顶点更少的形状。 OpenCV team, n.d.-a, "4. Contour Approximation", para. 1 Douglas-Peucker algorithm 道格拉斯-普克算法 (context) "It is an implementation of Douglas-Peucker algorithm." （语境）它是道格拉斯-普克算法的一种实现。 OpenCV team, n.d.-a, "4. Contour Approximation", para. 1 Convex Hull 凸包 "Here, cv.convexHull() function checks a curve for convexity defects and corrects it." 这里，cv.convexHull() 函数检查曲线的凸缺陷并加以修正。 OpenCV team, n.d.-a, "5. Convex Hull", para. 1 convex curves 凸曲线 "Generally speaking, convex curves are the curves which are always bulged out, or at-least flat." 一般来说，凸曲线是始终向外凸出、或至少是平的曲线。 OpenCV team, n.d.-a, "5. Convex Hull", para. 1 convexity defects 凸缺陷 "And if it is bulged inside, it is called convexity defects." 而如果它向内凹进，就称为凸缺陷。 OpenCV team, n.d.-a, "5. Convex Hull", para. 1 Checking Convexity 检查凸性 "There is a function to check if a curve is convex or not, cv.isContourConvex()." 有一个函数可以检查曲线是否为凸：cv.isContourConvex()。 OpenCV team, n.d.-a, "6. Checking Convexity", para. 1 Bounding Rectangle 外接矩形 (context) "There are two types of bounding rectangles." （语境）外接矩形有两种类型。 OpenCV team, n.d.-a, "7. Bounding Rectangle", para. 1 Straight Bounding Rectangle 直立外接矩形 "It is a straight rectangle, it doesn't consider the rotation of the object." 它是一个直立的矩形，不考虑物体的旋转。 OpenCV team, n.d.-a, "7.a. Straight Bounding Rectangle", para. 1 Rotated Rectangle 旋转矩形 "Here, bounding rectangle is drawn with minimum area, so it considers the rotation also." 这里，外接矩形按最小面积绘制，因此也考虑了旋转。 OpenCV team, n.d.-a, "7.b. Rotated Rectangle", para. 1 Minimum Enclosing Circle 最小外接圆 "It is a circle which completely covers the object with minimum area." 它是以最小面积完全覆盖物体的圆。 OpenCV team, n.d.-a, "8. Minimum Enclosing Circle", para. 1 Fitting an Ellipse 拟合椭圆 (context) "Next one is to fit an ellipse to an object." （语境）下一个是为物体拟合一个椭圆。 OpenCV team, n.d.-a, "9. Fitting an Ellipse", para. 1 Fitting a Line 拟合直线 (context) "Similarly we can fit a line to a set of points." （语境）类似地，我们可以为一组点拟合一条直线。 OpenCV team, n.d.-a, "10. Fitting a Line", para. 1 Contour Properties 轮廓属性 (context) "Learn to find different properties of contours like Solidity, Mean Intensity etc." （语境）学习求轮廓的各种属性，如实心度、平均强度等。 OpenCV team, n.d.-f, "Contours in OpenCV", item 3 Aspect Ratio 宽高比 "It is the ratio of width to height of bounding rect of the object." 它是物体外接矩形的宽与高之比。 OpenCV team, n.d.-b, "1. Aspect Ratio", para. 1 Extent 范围比（Extent） "Extent is the ratio of contour area to bounding rectangle area." Extent 是轮廓面积与外接矩形面积之比。 OpenCV team, n.d.-b, "2. Extent", para. 1 Solidity 实心度 "Solidity is the ratio of contour area to its convex hull area." 实心度是轮廓面积与其凸包面积之比。 OpenCV team, n.d.-b, "3. Solidity", para. 1 Equivalent Diameter 等效直径 "Equivalent Diameter is the diameter of the circle whose area is same as the contour area." 等效直径是面积与轮廓面积相同的圆的直径。 OpenCV team, n.d.-b, "4. Equivalent Diameter", para. 1 Orientation 方向 "Orientation is the angle at which object is directed." 方向是物体所指向的角度。 OpenCV team, n.d.-b, "5. Orientation", para. 1 Mask and Pixel Points 掩模与像素点 (context) "In some cases, we may need all the points which comprises that object." （语境）有些情况下，我们可能需要构成该物体的所有点。 OpenCV team, n.d.-b, "6. Mask and Pixel Points", para. 1 Maximum Value, Minimum Value and their locations 最大值、最小值及其位置 (context) "We can find these parameters using a mask image." （语境）我们可以用掩模图像求出这些参数。 OpenCV team, n.d.-b, "7. Maximum Value, Minimum Value and their locations", para. 1 Mean Color or Mean Intensity 平均颜色或平均强度 "Here, we can find the average color of an object. Or it can be average intensity of the object in grayscale mode." 这里可以求出物体的平均颜色。也可以是灰度模式下物体的平均强度。 OpenCV team, n.d.-b, "8. Mean Color or Mean Intensity", para. 1 Extreme Points 极点 "Extreme Points means topmost, bottommost, rightmost and leftmost points of the object." 极点指物体最上、最下、最右和最左的点。 OpenCV team, n.d.-b, "9. Extreme Points", para. 1 Contours : More Functions 轮廓：更多函数 (context) "Learn to find convexity defects, pointPolygonTest, match different shapes etc." （语境）学习求凸缺陷、使用 pointPolygonTest、匹配不同形状等。 OpenCV team, n.d.-f, "Contours in OpenCV", item 4 Convexity Defects 凸缺陷 "Any deviation of the object from this hull can be considered as convexity defect." 物体对凸包的任何偏离都可以看作凸缺陷。 OpenCV team, n.d.-d, "1. Convexity Defects", para. 1 Point Polygon Test 点与多边形测试 "This function finds the shortest distance between a point in the image and a contour." 这个函数求图像中一个点到轮廓的最短距离。 OpenCV team, n.d.-d, "2. Point Polygon Test", para. 1 Match Shapes 形状匹配 "OpenCV comes with a function cv.matchShapes() which enables us to compare two shapes, or two contours and returns a metric showing the similarity." OpenCV 提供函数 cv.matchShapes()，它让我们比较两个形状或两个轮廓，并返回一个表示相似度的度量。 OpenCV team, n.d.-d, "3. Match Shapes", para. 1 Hu-Moments Hu 矩 "Hu-Moments are seven moments invariant to translation, rotation and scale." Hu 矩是对平移、旋转和缩放保持不变的七个矩。 OpenCV team, n.d.-d, "3. Match Shapes", Note Contours Hierarchy 轮廓层级 (context) "Learn about Contour Hierarchy" （语境）学习轮廓层级 OpenCV team, n.d.-f, "Contours in OpenCV", item 5 Hierarchy 层级 "Representation of this relationship is called the Hierarchy." 这种关系的表示称为层级。 OpenCV team, n.d.-e, "What is Hierarchy?", para. 1 parent 父轮廓 "In this case, we call outer one as parent and inner one as child." 这种情况下，我们把外面的称为父轮廓，里面的称为子轮廓。 OpenCV team, n.d.-e, "What is Hierarchy?", para. 1 child 子轮廓 "In this case, we call outer one as parent and inner one as child." 这种情况下，我们把外面的称为父轮廓，里面的称为子轮廓。 OpenCV team, n.d.-e, "What is Hierarchy?", para. 1 external or outermost 外部轮廓（最外层） (context) "Here, contours 0,1,2 are external or outermost." （语境）这里，轮廓 0、1、2 是外部的或最外层的。 OpenCV team, n.d.-e, "What is Hierarchy?", para. 4 same hierarchy level 同一层级 (context) "We can say, they are in hierarchy-0 or simply they are in same hierarchy level." （语境）可以说它们处于 hierarchy-0，或者简单地说处于同一层级。 OpenCV team, n.d.-e, "What is Hierarchy?", para. 4 first child 第一个子轮廓 (context) "From the way I numbered the boxes, I would say contour-4 is the first child of contour-3a (It can be contour-5 also)." （语境）按照我给方框编号的方式，我会说轮廓 4 是轮廓 3a 的第一个子轮廓（也可以是轮廓 5）。 OpenCV team, n.d.-e, "What is Hierarchy?", para. 5 Hierarchy Representation in OpenCV OpenCV 中的层级表示 "OpenCV represents it as an array of four values : [Next, Previous, First_Child, Parent]" OpenCV 把它表示为由四个值组成的数组：[Next, Previous, First_Child, Parent] OpenCV team, n.d.-e, "Hierarchy Representation in OpenCV", para. 1 Next 下一个（Next） "Next denotes next contour at the same hierarchical level." Next 表示同一层级上的下一个轮廓。 OpenCV team, n.d.-e, "Hierarchy Representation in OpenCV", para. 2 Previous 上一个（Previous） "Previous denotes previous contour at the same hierarchical level." Previous 表示同一层级上的上一个轮廓。 OpenCV team, n.d.-e, "Hierarchy Representation in OpenCV", para. 5 First_Child 第一个子轮廓（First_Child） "First_Child denotes its first child contour." First_Child 表示它的第一个子轮廓。 OpenCV team, n.d.-e, "Hierarchy Representation in OpenCV", para. 7 Parent 父轮廓（Parent） "Parent denotes index of its parent contour." Parent 表示其父轮廓的索引。 OpenCV team, n.d.-e, "Hierarchy Representation in OpenCV", para. 9 Contour Retrieval Mode 轮廓检索模式 (context) "But when we found the contours in image using cv.findContours() function, we have passed an argument, Contour Retrieval Mode." （语境）但用 cv.findContours() 函数在图像中寻找轮廓时，我们传入了一个参数：轮廓检索模式。 OpenCV team, n.d.-e, "Theory", para. 1 References OpenCV team. ai/opencv/image-processing-in-opencv/his.summary: 2.10 Histograms in OpenCV Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 2.10 Histograms in OpenCV OpenCV 中的直方图 (context) "All about histograms in OpenCV" （语境）关于 OpenCV 中直方图的一切 OpenCV team, n.d.-f, "Image Processing in OpenCV", item 10 Histograms - 1 : Find, Plot, Analyze !!! 直方图 1：计算、绘制、分析 (context) "Learn the basics of histograms" （语境）学习直方图的基础 OpenCV team, n.d.-e, "Histograms in OpenCV", item 1 Histogram 直方图 "You can consider histogram as a graph or plot, which gives you an overall idea about the intensity distribution of an image." 可以把直方图看作一张图或曲线，它让你对图像的强度分布有一个整体的了解。 OpenCV team, n.d.-b, "Theory", para. 1 BINS 直方柱（BINS） "So what you do is simply split the whole histogram to 16 sub-parts and value of each sub-part is the sum of all pixel count in it. This each sub-part is called "BIN"." 所以你要做的只是把整个直方图分成 16 个子部分，每个子部分的值是其中所有像素数之和。每个子部分称为“BIN”。 OpenCV team, n.d.-b, "Find Histogram", para. 3 DIMS 维数（DIMS） "DIMS : It is the number of parameters for which we collect the data." DIMS：它是我们为之收集数据的参数个数。 OpenCV team, n.d.-b, "Find Histogram", para. 4 RANGE 范围（RANGE） "RANGE : It is the range of intensity values you want to measure." RANGE：它是你想测量的强度值的范围。 OpenCV team, n.d.-b, "Find Histogram", para. 5 Application of Mask 掩模的应用 "Just create a mask image with white color on the region you want to find histogram and black otherwise." 只需创建一幅掩模图像，在想求直方图的区域为白色，其余为黑色。 OpenCV team, n.d.-b, "Application of Mask", para. 1 Histograms - 2: Histogram Equalization 直方图 2：直方图均衡化 (context) "Learn to Equalize Histograms to get better contrast for images" （语境）学习均衡化直方图，让图像获得更好的对比度 OpenCV team, n.d.-e, "Histograms in OpenCV", item 2 Histogram Equalization 直方图均衡化 "So you need to stretch this histogram to either ends (as given in below image, from wikipedia) and that is what Histogram Equalization does (in simple words)." 所以需要把这个直方图向两端拉伸（如下图所示，图来自维基百科），简单地说，这就是直方图均衡化所做的事。 OpenCV team, n.d.-c, "Theory", para. 1 CLAHE (Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization) CLAHE（限制对比度自适应直方图均衡化） (No definition) （无定义） OpenCV team, n.d.-c, "CLAHE (Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization)" adaptive histogram equalization 自适应直方图均衡化 "So to solve this problem, adaptive histogram equalization is used. In this, image is divided into small blocks called "tiles" (tileSize is 8x8 by default in OpenCV). Then each of these blocks are histogram equalized as usual." 为了解决这个问题，使用自适应直方图均衡化。在这种方法中，图像被分成称为“tiles”的小块（OpenCV 中 tileSize 默认为 8×8）。然后对每一块照常做直方图均衡化。 OpenCV team, n.d.-c, "CLAHE (Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization)", para. 3 contrast limiting 对比度限制 "If any histogram bin is above the specified contrast limit (by default 40 in OpenCV), those pixels are clipped and distributed uniformly to other bins before applying histogram equalization." 如果某个直方柱超过指定的对比度上限（OpenCV 中默认为 40），这些像素会在做直方图均衡化之前被裁剪并均匀分配到其他直方柱。 OpenCV team, n.d.-c, "CLAHE (Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization)", para. 3 Histograms - 3 : 2D Histograms 直方图 3：二维直方图 (context) "Learn to find and plot 2D Histograms" （语境）学习计算和绘制二维直方图 OpenCV team, n.d.-e, "Histograms in OpenCV", item 3 one-dimensional histogram 一维直方图 "It is called one-dimensional because we are taking only one feature into our consideration, ie grayscale intensity value of the pixel." 它之所以称为一维，是因为我们只考虑一个特征，即像素的灰度强度值。 OpenCV team, n.d.-d, "Introduction", para. 1 two-dimensional histograms 二维直方图 "But in two-dimensional histograms, you consider two features." 而在二维直方图中，要考虑两个特征。 OpenCV team, n.d.-d, "Introduction", para. 1 color histograms 颜色直方图 "Normally it is used for finding color histograms where two features are Hue & Saturation values of every pixel." 通常它用于求颜色直方图，其中两个特征是每个像素的色调和饱和度值。 OpenCV team, n.d.-d, "Introduction", para. 1 Histogram - 4 : Histogram Backprojection 直方图 4：直方图反向投影 (context) "Learn histogram backprojection to segment colored objects" （语境）学习用直方图反向投影分割彩色物体 OpenCV team, n.d.-e, "Histograms in OpenCV", item 4 Histogram Backprojection 直方图反向投影 "It is used for image segmentation or finding objects of interest in an image." 它用于图像分割或寻找图像中感兴趣的物体。 OpenCV team, n.d.-a, "Theory", para. 2 References OpenCV team. ai/opencv/image-processing-in-opencv/ima.summary: 2.6 Image Gradients Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 2.6 Image Gradients 图像梯度 (context) "Learn to find image gradients, edges etc." （语境）学习求图像梯度、边缘等。 OpenCV team, n.d.-b, "Image Processing in OpenCV", item 6 Theory 理论 "OpenCV provides three types of gradient filters or High-pass filters, Sobel, Scharr and Laplacian." OpenCV（开源计算机视觉库）是一个开源的计算机视觉和机器学习软件库。 OpenCV team, n.d.-a, "About", para. 2 1 Core Operations 核心操作 "In this section you will learn basic operations on image like pixel editing, geometric transformations, code optimization, some mathematical tools etc." 在本节中，你将学习图像的基本操作，如像素编辑、几何变换、代码优化、一些数学工具等。 OpenCV team, n.d.-b, "OpenCV-Python Tutorials", item 3 2 Image Processing in OpenCV OpenCV 中的图像处理 "In this section you will learn different image processing functions inside OpenCV." 在本节中，你将学习 OpenCV 中各种图像处理函数。 OpenCV team, n.d.-b, "OpenCV-Python Tutorials", item 4 3 Feature Detection and Description 特征检测与描述 "In this section you will learn about feature detectors and descriptors" 在本节中，你将学习特征检测器和描述子 OpenCV team, n.d.-b, "OpenCV-Python Tutorials", item 5 4 Camera Calibration and 3D Reconstruction 相机标定与三维重建 "In this section we will learn about camera calibration, stereo imaging etc." 在本节中，我们将学习相机标定、立体成像等。 OpenCV team, n.d.-b, "OpenCV-Python Tutorials", item 7 5 Machine Learning 机器学习 (context) "In this section you will learn different image processing functions inside OpenCV." （语境）在本节中，你将学习 OpenCV 中各种图像处理函数。（原文如此，与第 4 组的句子相同） OpenCV team, n.d.-b, "OpenCV-Python Tutorials", item 8 6 Computational Photography 计算摄影 "In this section you will learn different computational photography techniques like image denoising etc." 在本节中，你将学习各种计算摄影技术，如图像去噪等。 OpenCV team, n.d.-b, "OpenCV-Python Tutorials", item 9 7 Object Detection (objdetect module) 目标检测（objdetect 模块） "In this section you will learn object detection techniques like face detection etc." 在本节中，你将学习目标检测技术，如人脸检测等。 OpenCV team, n.d.-b, "OpenCV-Python Tutorials", item 10 References OpenCV team. ai/opencv/machine-learning/k-means-clust.summary: 5.3 K-Means Clustering Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 5.3 K-Means Clustering K 均值聚类 (context) "Learn to use K-Means Clustering to group data to a number of clusters." （语境）学习用 K 均值聚类把数据分成若干簇。 OpenCV team, n.d.-b, "Machine Learning", item 3 Understanding K-Means Clustering 理解 K 均值聚类 (context) "Read to get an intuitive understanding of K-Means Clustering" （语境）阅读以获得对 K 均值聚类的直观理解 OpenCV team, n.d.-a, "K-Means Clustering", item 1 How does it work ? 工作原理 "This algorithm is an iterative process." 这个算法是一个迭代过程。 OpenCV team, n.d.-c, "How does it work ?", para. 1 Step : 1 第 1 步 "Step : 1 - Algorithm randomly chooses two centroids, C1 and C2 (sometimes, any two data are taken as the centroids)." 第 1 步：算法随机选择两个质心 C1 和 C2（有时任取两个数据作为质心）。 OpenCV team, n.d.-c, "How does it work ?", para. 3 Step : 2 第 2 步 "Step : 2 - It calculates the distance from each point to both centroids." 第 2 步：计算每个点到两个质心的距离。 OpenCV team, n.d.-c, "How does it work ?", para. 4 Step : 3 第 3 步 "Step : 3 - Next we calculate the average of all blue points and red points separately and that will be our new centroids." 第 3 步：接着分别计算所有蓝点和红点的平均值，作为新的质心。 OpenCV team, n.d.-c, "How does it work ?", para. 6 References OpenCV team. ai/opencv/machine-learning/k-nearest-nei.title: 5.1 K-Nearest Neighbour | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
ai/opencv/machine-learning/k-nearest-nei.summary: 5.1 K-Nearest Neighbour Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 5.1 K-Nearest Neighbour K 近邻 (context) "Learn to use kNN for classification Plus learn about handwritten digit recognition using kNN" （语境）学习用 kNN 做分类，另外学习用 kNN 识别手写数字 OpenCV team, n.d.-b, "Machine Learning", item 1 Understanding k-Nearest Neighbour 理解 K 近邻 (context) "Get a basic understanding of what kNN is" （语境）基本了解 kNN 是什么 OpenCV team, n.d.-a, "K-Nearest Neighbour", item 1 kNN K 近邻（kNN） "kNN is one of the simplest classification algorithms available for supervised learning." kNN 是监督学习中最简单的分类算法之一。 OpenCV team, n.d.-c, "Theory", para. 1 Class 类别 "We refer to each family as a Class." 我们把每个家族称为一个类别。 OpenCV team, n.d.-c, "Theory", para. 2 Feature Space 特征空间 "You can consider a feature space as a space where all data are projected." 可以把特征空间看作所有数据投影到其中的空间。 OpenCV team, n.d.-c, "Theory", para. 2 Classification 分类 "He should be added to one of these Blue or Red families (or classes). We call that process, Classification." 他应当被加入蓝色或红色家族（即类别）中的一个。我们把这个过程称为分类。 OpenCV team, n.d.-c, "Theory", para. 3 Nearest Neighbour 最近邻 "This method is called simply Nearest Neighbour classification, because classification depends only on the nearest neighbour." 这种方法简称为最近邻分类，因为分类只取决于最近的那个邻居。 OpenCV team, n.d.-c, "Theory", para. 4 modified kNN (weighted kNN) 改进 kNN（加权 kNN） "Then we add the total weights of each family separately and classify the new-comer as part of whichever family received higher total weights. This is called modified kNN or weighted kNN." 然后分别累加每个家族的总权重，把新来者归入总权重较高的那个家族。这称为改进 kNN 或加权 kNN。 OpenCV team, n.d.-c, "Theory", para. 6 References OpenCV team. (n.d.-a). K-Nearest Neighbour. OpenCV-Python Tutorials (Version 4.13.0). Retrieved October 31, 2026, from https://docs.opencv.org/4.x/d0/d72/tutorial_py_knn_index.html OpenCV team. (n.d.-b). Machine Learning. OpenCV-Python Tutorials (Version 4.13.0). Retrieved October 31, 2026, from https://docs.opencv.org/4.x/d6/de2/tutorial_py_table_of_contents_ml.html OpenCV team. (n.d.-c). Understanding k-Nearest Neighbour. OpenCV-Python Tutorials (Version 4.13.0). Retrieved October 31, 2026, from https://docs.opencv.org/4.x/d5/d26/tutorial_py_knn_understanding.html

ai/opencv/machine-learning/support-vecto.summary: 5.2 Support Vector Machines (SVM) Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 5.2 Support Vector Machines (SVM) 支持向量机（SVM） (context) "Understand concepts of SVM" （语境）理解 SVM 的概念 OpenCV team, n.d.-a, "Machine Learning", item 2 Understanding SVM 理解 SVM (context) "Get a basic understanding of what SVM is" （语境）基本了解 SVM 是什么 OpenCV team, n.d.-b, "Support Vector Machines (SVM)", item 1 Linearly Separable Data 线性可分数据 "Such data which can be divided into two with a straight line (or hyperplanes in higher dimensions) is called Linear Separable." 能用一条直线（高维时为超平面）分成两部分的数据称为线性可分。 OpenCV team, n.d.-c, "Linearly Separable Data", para. 2 Decision Boundary 决策边界 "We find a line, f(x)=ax1+bx2+c which divides both the data to two regions." 我们找到一条直线 f(x)=ax1+bx2+c，它把两类数据分成两个区域。 OpenCV team, n.d.-c, "Linearly Separable Data", para. 2 Support Vectors 支持向量 "Just the ones which are close to the opposite group are sufficient." 只需靠近对方组的那些数据就足够了。 OpenCV team, n.d.-c, "Linearly Separable Data", para. 4 Support Planes 支持平面 "We can call them Support Vectors and the lines passing through them are called Support Planes." 可以称它们为支持向量，穿过它们的直线称为支持平面。 OpenCV team, n.d.-c, "Linearly Separable Data", para. 4 weight vector 权重向量 "Weight vector decides the orientation of decision boundary while bias point decides its location." 权重向量决定决策边界的方向，而偏置决定其位置。 OpenCV team, n.d.-c, "Linearly Separable Data", para. 5 bias 偏置 "Weight vector decides the orientation of decision boundary while bias point decides its location." 权重向量决定决策边界的方向，而偏置决定其位置。 OpenCV team, n.d.-c, "Linearly Separable Data", para. 5 Margin 间隔 "Margin is twice this distance, and we need to maximize this margin." 间隔是这个距离的两倍，我们需要最大化这个间隔。 OpenCV team, n.d.-c, "Linearly Separable Data", para. 5 Non-Linearly Separable Data 非线性可分数据 "Consider some data which can't be divided into two with a straight line." 考虑一些不能用一条直线分成两部分的数据。 OpenCV team, n.d.-c, "Non-Linearly Separable Data", para. 1 kernel function 核函数 "Let us define a kernel function K(p,q) which does a dot product between two points, shown below:" 定义一个核函数 K(p,q)，它对两个点做点积，如下所示： OpenCV team, n.d.-c, "Non-Linearly Separable Data", para. 5 References OpenCV team. ai/opencv/object-detection-objdetect-mod.title: 7.2 Detection of ArUco boards | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
ai/opencv/object-detection-objdetect-mod.summary: 7.2 Detection of ArUco boards Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 7.2 Detection of ArUco boards ArUco 标定板检测 "An ArUco board is a set of markers that acts like a single marker in the sense that it provides a single pose for the camera." ArUco 标定板是一组标记，它像单个标记一样，为相机提供单一的位姿。 OpenCV team, n.d., "Detection of ArUco boards", para. 1 Board Detection 标定板检测 "A board detection is similar to the standard marker detection. The only difference is in the pose estimation step." 标定板检测与标准的标记检测类似。唯一的区别在于位姿估计这一步。 OpenCV team, n.d., "Board Detection", para. 1 Board Board 类 "board the cv::aruco::Board object that defines the board layout and its ids" board：cv::aruco::Board 对象，它定义标定板的布局及其 id OpenCV team, n.d., "Board Detection", item 2 GridBoard::matchImagePoints() matchImagePoints 方法 (context) "objPoints, imgPoints object and image points, matched with cv::aruco::GridBoard::matchImagePoints()" （语境）objPoints、imgPoints：物点和像点，由 cv::aruco::GridBoard::matchImagePoints() 匹配得到 OpenCV team, n.d., "Board Detection", item 1 Grid Board 网格标定板 (No definition) （无定义） OpenCV team, n.d., "Grid Board" GridBoard GridBoard 类 "The cv::aruco::GridBoard class is a specialized class that inherits from the cv::aruco::Board class and which represents a Board with all the markers in the same plane and in a grid layout" cv::aruco::GridBoard 类是一个继承自 cv::aruco::Board 类的专用类，表示所有标记位于同一平面并呈网格布局的标定板 OpenCV team, n.d., "Grid Board", para. 3 GridBoard::generateImage() generateImage 方法 (context) "The function cv::aruco::GridBoard::generateImage() is provided in cv::aruco::GridBoard class" （语境）函数 cv::aruco::GridBoard::generateImage() 由 cv::aruco::GridBoard 类提供 OpenCV team, n.d., "Grid Board", para. 1 Refine marker detection 细化标记检测 "ArUco boards can also be used to improve the detection of markers." ArUco 标定板还可以用来改进标记的检测。 OpenCV team, n.d., "Refine marker detection", para. 1 marker candidates 候选标记 "This candidates are square shapes that have been found in the original image but have failed to pass the identification step" 这些候选是在原图像中找到、但没有通过识别步骤的方形 OpenCV team, n.d., "Refine marker detection", para. 4 ArucoDetector::refineDetectedMarkers() refineDetectedMarkers 方法 "The cv::aruco::ArucoDetector::refineDetectedMarkers() function finds correspondences between these candidates and the missing markers of the board." cv::aruco::ArucoDetector::refineDetectedMarkers() 函数在这些候选与标定板上缺失的标记之间寻找对应关系。 OpenCV team, n.d., "Refine marker detection", para. 5 References OpenCV team. (n.d.). Detection of ArUco boards. OpenCV-Python Tutorials (Version 4.13.0). Retrieved October 31, 2026, from https://docs.opencv.org/4.x/db/da9/tutorial_aruco_board_detection.html

ai/opencv/object-detection-objdetect-mod.title: 7.1 Detection of ArUco Markers | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
ai/opencv/object-detection-objdetect-mod.summary: 7.1 Detection of ArUco Markers Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 7.1 Detection of ArUco Markers ArUco 标记检测 (context) "One of the most popular approaches is the use of binary square fiducial markers." （语境）最常用的方法之一是使用二进制方形基准标记。 OpenCV team, n.d., "Detection of ArUco Markers", para. 2 Markers and Dictionaries 标记与字典 (No definition) （无定义） OpenCV team, n.d., "Markers and Dictionaries" ArUco marker ArUco 标记 "An ArUco marker is a synthetic square marker composed by a wide black border and an inner binary matrix which determines its identifier (id)." ArUco 标记是一种人工合成的方形标记，由宽的黑色边框和决定其标识符（id）的内部二进制矩阵组成。 OpenCV team, n.d., "Markers and Dictionaries", para. 1 dictionary of markers 标记字典 "A dictionary of markers is the set of markers that are considered in a specific application." 标记字典是某个具体应用中所考虑的标记集合。 OpenCV team, n.d., "Markers and Dictionaries", para. 3 dictionary size 字典大小 "The dictionary size is the number of markers that compose the dictionary." 字典大小是组成字典的标记数量。 OpenCV team, n.d., "Markers and Dictionaries", item 1 marker size 标记尺寸 "The marker size is the size of those markers (the number of bits/modules)." 标记尺寸是这些标记的大小（位数/模块数）。 OpenCV team, n.d., "Markers and Dictionaries", item 2 marker id 标记 id "Instead, a marker id is simply the marker index within the dictionary it belongs to." 实际上，标记 id 只是该标记在其所属字典中的索引。 OpenCV team, n.d., "Markers and Dictionaries", para. 6 Marker Creation 标记生成 (context) "Before their detection, markers need to be printed in order to be placed in the environment." （语境）在检测之前，标记需要打印出来以便放置在环境中。 OpenCV team, n.d., "Marker Creation", para. 1 Marker Detection 标记检测 "Given an image containing ArUco markers, the detection process has to return a list of detected markers." 给定一幅包含 ArUco 标记的图像，检测过程要返回检测到的标记列表。 OpenCV team, n.d., "Marker Detection", para. 1 Detection of marker candidates 候选标记检测 "Detection of marker candidates. In this step the image is analyzed in order to find square shapes that are candidates to be markers." 候选标记检测。在这一步中，分析图像，寻找可能是标记的方形。 OpenCV team, n.d., "Marker Detection", item 1 ArucoDetector ArucoDetector 类 (context) "When you create an cv::aruco::ArucoDetector object, you need to pass the following parameters to the constructor:" （语境）创建 cv::aruco::ArucoDetector 对象时，需要向构造函数传入以下参数： OpenCV team, n.d., "Marker Detection", para. 1 ArucoDetector::detectMarkers() detectMarkers 方法 (context) "In the aruco module, the detection is performed in the cv::aruco::ArucoDetector::detectMarkers() function. This function is the most important in the module, since all the rest of the functionality is based on the detected markers returned by cv::aruco::ArucoDetector::detectMarkers()." （语境）在 aruco 模块中，检测由 cv::aruco::ArucoDetector::detectMarkers() 函数完成。这个函数是该模块中最重要的，因为其余所有功能都基于它返回的检测结果。 OpenCV team, n.d., "Marker Detection", para. 1 Pose Estimation 位姿估计 "The camera pose relative to the marker is a 3d transformation from the marker coordinate system to the camera coordinate system." 相机相对于标记的位姿是从标记坐标系到相机坐标系的三维变换。 OpenCV team, n.d., "Pose Estimation", para. 5 Selecting a dictionary 选择字典 (No definition) （无定义） OpenCV team, n.d., "Selecting a dictionary" Dictionary Dictionary 类 "The aruco module provides the Dictionary class to represent a dictionary of markers." aruco 模块提供 Dictionary 类来表示一个标记字典。 OpenCV team, n.d., "Selecting a dictionary", para. 1 Dictionary::getByteListFromBits() getByteListFromBits 静态方法 "Fortunately, a marker can be easily transformed to this form using the static method Dictionary::getByteListFromBits()." 幸好，用静态方法 Dictionary::getByteListFromBits() 可以很容易地把标记转换成这种形式。 OpenCV team, n.d., "Manual dictionary definition", para. 4 inter-marker distance 标记间距离 "The inter-marker distance is the minimum Hamming distance between dictionary markers that determines the dictionary's ability to detect and correct errors." 标记间距离是字典中各标记之间的最小汉明距离，它决定字典检测和纠正错误的能力。 OpenCV team, n.d., "Selecting a dictionary", para. 2 Predefined dictionaries 预定义字典 "The aruco module includes a set of predefined dictionaries in a variety of marker sizes and number of markers." aruco 模块包含一组标记尺寸和标记数量各不相同的预定义字典。 OpenCV team, n.d., "Predefined dictionaries", para. 1 DICT_6X6_250 DICT_6X6_250 字典 "cv::aruco::DICT_6X6_250 is an example of predefined dictionary of markers with 6x6 bits and a total of 250 markers." cv::aruco::DICT_6X6_250 是一个预定义字典的例子，标记为 6×6 位，共 250 个标记。 OpenCV team, n.d., "Predefined dictionaries", para. 2 Automatic dictionary generation 自动生成字典 "A dictionary can be generated automatically to adjust the desired number of markers and bits to optimize the inter-marker distance:" 字典可以自动生成，按所需的标记数量和位数进行调整，以优化标记间距离： OpenCV team, n.d., "Automatic dictionary generation", para. 1 Manual dictionary definition 手动定义字典 "Finally, the dictionary can be configured manually, so that any encoding can be used." 最后，字典可以手动配置，从而可以使用任意编码。 OpenCV team, n.d., "Manual dictionary definition", para. 1 Detector Parameters 检测器参数 "One of the parameters of cv::aruco::ArucoDetector is a cv::aruco::DetectorParameters object. This object includes all the options that can be customized during the marker detection process." cv::aruco::ArucoDetector 的参数之一是一个 cv::aruco::DetectorParameters 对象。这个对象包含标记检测过程中所有可以自定义的选项。 OpenCV team, n.d., "Detector Parameters", para. 1 Thresholding 阈值化 "One of the first steps in the marker detection process is adaptive thresholding of the input image." 标记检测过程的最初步骤之一是对输入图像做自适应阈值化。 OpenCV team, n.d., "Thresholding", para. 1 Contour filtering 轮廓过滤 "They are filtered out in different steps so that contours that are very unlikely to be markers are discarded." 它们分几步被过滤，从而丢弃那些不太可能是标记的轮廓。 OpenCV team, n.d., "Contour filtering", para. 1 Bits Extraction 位提取 "After candidate detection, the bits of each candidate are analyzed in order to determine if they are markers or not." 候选检测之后，分析每个候选的位，以确定它们是否是标记。 OpenCV team, n.d., "Bits Extraction", para. 1 Marker identification 标记识别 "After the bits have been extracted, the next step is checking whether the extracted code belongs to the marker dictionary and, if necessary, error correction can be performed." 位提取之后，下一步是检查提取的编码是否属于标记字典，必要时还可以进行纠错。 OpenCV team, n.d., "Marker identification", para. 1 Corner Refinement 角点细化 "After markers have been detected and identified, the last step is performing subpixel refinement of the corner positions" 标记被检测和识别之后，最后一步是对角点位置做亚像素细化 OpenCV team, n.d., "Corner Refinement", para. 1 References OpenCV team. "Focused on enhancing model performance, this section includes tutorials on profiling, hyperparameter tuning, quantization, and other techniques to optimize PyTorch models for better efficiency and speed." 本节着重于提升模型性能，包括关于性能分析、超参数调优、量化以及其他优化 PyTorch 模型的技术的教程，以获得更高的效率和速度。 PyTorch Foundation, n.d.-b, "Deep Dive", para. 1 6 Extension 扩展 "This section provides insights into extending PyTorch’s tutorials." 实用示例是小而可直接上手的例子，演示如何使用 PyTorch 的特定功能，不同于完整的教程。 PyTorch Foundation, n.d.-b, "Recipes", para. 1 9 Unstable 不稳定 "API unstable features are not available as part of binary distributions like ai/ros-2/framework/client-libraries.html.summary: 2.5 Client libraries Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 2.5 Client libraries 客户端库 "Client libraries are the APIs that allow you to implement your ROS code." 客户端库是让你实现 ROS 代码的 API。 Open Robotics, n.d.-a, "Client libraries in ROS", para. 1 Client libraries in ROS ROS 中的客户端库 "Client libraries expose the core functionality of ROS." 客户端库提供 ROS 的核心功能。 Open Robotics, n.d.-a, "Client libraries in ROS", para. 2 ROS Client Library (rcl) ROS 客户端库（rcl） "Client libraries in ROS use a common core ROS Client Library (rcl) interface that implements logic and behaviour of ROS concepts." ROS 中的客户端库使用一个共同的核心 ROS 客户端库（rcl）接口，它实现 ROS 各概念的逻辑和行为。 Open Robotics, n.d.-a, "ROS Client Library ( rcl )", para. 1 The rclcpp package rclcpp 软件包 "The ROS Client Library for C++ (rclcpp) is the user-facing, idiomatic C++ interface that provides all of the ROS client functionality, such as creating nodes, publishers, and subscriptions." C++ 版 ROS 客户端库（rclcpp）是面向用户、符合 C++ 习惯的接口，提供 ROS 客户端的全部功能，如创建节点、发布者和订阅。 Open Robotics, n.d.-a, "The rclcpp package", para. 1 The rclpy package rclpy 软件包 "The ROS Client Library for Python (rclpy) provides an idiomatic Python experience that uses native Python types and patterns, such as lists and context objects." Python 版 ROS 客户端库（rclpy）提供符合 Python 习惯的体验，使用原生 Python 类型和模式，如列表和上下文对象。 Open Robotics, n.d.-a, "The rclpy package", para. 1 Different ROS 2 middleware vendors 不同的 ROS 2 中间件供应商 (context) "ROS 2 supports multiple middleware implementations which provide discovery, serialisation, and transportation communications." （语境）ROS 2 支持多种中间件实现，它们提供发现、序列化和传输通信。 Open Robotics, n.d.-b, "Different ROS 2 middleware vendors", para. 2 Executors 执行器 "An Executor uses one or more threads of the underlying operating system to invoke the callbacks of subscriptions, timers, service servers, action servers, etc. on incoming messages and events." 执行器使用底层操作系统的一个或多个线程，在收到消息和事件时调用订阅、定时器、服务服务器、动作服务器等的回调。 Open Robotics, n.d.-c, "Overview", para. 1 Internal ROS 2 interfaces ROS 2 内部接口 "The internal ROS interfaces are public C APIs that are intended for use by developers who are creating client libraries or adding a new underlying middleware, but are not intended for use by typical ROS users." ROS 内部接口是公开的 C API，供创建客户端库或添加新的底层中间件的开发者使用，普通 ROS 用户不需要使用。 Open Robotics, n.d.-d, "Internal ROS 2 interfaces", para. 2 ROS 2 middleware implementations ROS 2 中间件实现 "ROS middleware implementations are sets of packages that provide the underlying communication framework for ROS 2." ROS 中间件实现是为 ROS 2 提供底层通信框架的软件包集合。 Open Robotics, n.d.-e, "ROS 2 middleware implementations", para. 2 References Open Robotics. (n.d.-a). Client libraries. ROS 2 Documentation: Lyrical. ai/ros-2/framework/nodes.html.summary: 2.2 Nodes Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 2.2 Nodes 节点 "A node is a participant in the ROS 2 graph, which uses a client library to communicate with other nodes." 节点是 ROS 2 图中的一个参与者，它使用客户端库与其他节点通信。 Open Robotics, n.d.-d, "Overview of nodes", para. 1 Discovery 发现 "Discovery lets ROS nodes find each other so they can communicate without manual connection setup." 发现让 ROS 节点互相找到对方，从而无需手动建立连接就能通信。 Open Robotics, n.d.-b, "Discovery", para. 1 The ROS_DOMAIN_ID ROS 域 ID "In DDS, the primary mechanism for having different logical networks share a physical network is known as the Domain ID." 在 DDS 中，让不同逻辑网络共享同一物理网络的主要机制称为域 ID（Domain ID）。 Open Robotics, n.d.-e, "Overview", para. 1 Logging 日志 "ROS logging helps you monitor node behavior and diagnose problems by sending logs to console output, log files, and the /rosout topic." ROS 日志通过把日志发送到控制台输出、日志文件和 /rosout 话题，帮助你监控节点行为、诊断问题。 Open Robotics, n.d.-c, "Logging", para. 1 Composition 组合 "Composition lets you decide how ROS nodes are arranged into processes when an application is deployed." 组合让你在部署应用时决定 ROS 节点如何分配到各个进程中。 Open Robotics, n.d.-a, "Composition", para. 1 References Open Robotics. ai/ros-2/framework/parameters.html.title: 2.4 Parameters | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
ai/ros-2/framework/parameters.html.summary: 2.4 Parameters Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 2.4 Parameters 参数 "Parameters in ROS configure node behavior without requiring changes to the node’s source code." ROS 中的参数在不修改节点源代码的情况下配置节点的行为。 Open Robotics, n.d., "Parameters", para. 1 Parameters background 参数背景 (No definition) （无定义） Open Robotics, n.d., "Parameters background" Declaring parameters 声明参数 (context) "By default, a node needs to declare all of the parameters that it will accept during its lifetime." （语境）默认情况下，节点需要声明它在生命周期内会接受的所有参数。 Open Robotics, n.d., "Declaring parameters", para. 1 Parameter types 参数类型 (context) "Each parameter on a ROS 2 node has one of the pre-defined parameter types as mentioned in the Overview." （语境）ROS 2 节点上的每个参数都具有预定义参数类型中的一种，如概述中所述。 Open Robotics, n.d., "Parameter types", para. 1 Parameter callbacks 参数回调 "A ROS 2 node can register three different types of callbacks to be informed when changes are happening to parameters." ROS 2 节点可以注册三种不同类型的回调，以便在参数发生变化时得到通知。 Open Robotics, n.d., "Parameter callbacks", para. 1 Interacting with parameters 与参数交互 (context) "External processes can perform parameter operations via parameter services that are created by default when a node is instantiated." （语境）外部进程可以通过节点实例化时默认创建的参数服务来执行参数操作。 Open Robotics, n.d., "Interacting with parameters", para. 1 References Open Robotics. (n.d.). Parameters. ROS 2 Documentation: Lyrical. Retrieved October 31, 2026, from https://docs.ros.org/en/lyrical/ROS-Framework/About-Parameters.html

ai/ros-2/get-started/glossary.html.title: 1.1 Glossary | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
ai/ros-2/get-started/glossary.html.summary: 1.1 Glossary Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 1.1 Glossary 术语表 "This article provides a glossary of commonly used ROS terms, helping you understand key definitions and follow related documentation more easily." 本文提供一份 ROS 常用术语的词汇表，帮助你理解关键定义，更容易读懂相关文档。 Open Robotics, n.d., "Glossary", para. 1 API API "An API, or Application Programming Interface, is an interface that is provided by an “application”, which in this case is usually a shared library or other language appropriate shared resource." API（应用程序编程接口）是由一个“应用”提供的接口，这里的“应用”通常是一个共享库或其他适合该语言的共享资源。 Open Robotics, n.d., "API" client_library 客户端库 "A client library is an API that provides access to the ROS graph using primitive middleware concepts like Topics, Services, and Actions." 客户端库是一种 API，它用话题、服务和动作等基本中间件概念来访问 ROS 图。 Open Robotics, n.d., "client_library" package 软件包 "A single unit of software, including source code, build system files, documentation, tests, and other associated resources." 一个单独的软件单元，包括源代码、构建系统文件、文档、测试和其他相关资源。 Open Robotics, n.d., "package" REP REP（机器人增强提案） "Robotics Enhancement Proposal. A document that describes an enhancement, standardization, or convention for the ROS community." 机器人增强提案。一份描述 ROS 社区的增强、标准化或约定的文档。 Open Robotics, n.d., "REP" VCS 版本控制系统 "Version Control System, such as CVS, SVN, git, mercurial, etc…" 版本控制系统，如 CVS、SVN、git、mercurial 等。 Open Robotics, n.d., "VCS" rclcpp rclcpp "The C++ specific Client Library for ROS." ROS 的 C++ 专用客户端库。 Open Robotics, n.d., "rclcpp" repository 仓库 "A collection of packages usually managed using a VCS like git or mercurial and usually hosted on a site like GitHub or BitBucket." 软件包的集合，通常用 git 或 mercurial 等 VCS 管理，通常托管在 GitHub 或 BitBucket 等网站上。 Open Robotics, n.d., "repository" Buffer 缓冲区 "rosidl::Buffer , the in-memory container used by generated C++ messages for variable-length primitive array fields (uint8[], float32[], …)." rosidl::Buffer ，生成的 C++ 消息用来存放变长基本类型数组字段的内存容器（uint8[]、float32[] 等）。 Open Robotics, n.d., "Buffer" Buffer backend 缓冲区后端 "A pluginlib plugin, implementing the rosidl::BufferBackend interface, that teaches the RMW how to transport a rosidl::Buffer whose storage lives in a vendor-specific memory domain (for example, GPU memory)." 一个 pluginlib 插件，实现 rosidl::BufferBackend 接口，告诉 RMW 如何传输存储在厂商专用内存域中的 rosidl::Buffer（例如 GPU 内存）。 Open Robotics, n.d., "Buffer backend" Tensor message 张量消息 "A normal ROS 2 message, such as tensor_msgs/msg/ExperimentalTensor, that carries tensor metadata and stores the raw tensor bytes in a uint8[] field backed by rosidl::Buffer." 一种普通的 ROS 2 消息，如 tensor_msgs/msg/ExperimentalTensor，它携带张量元数据，并把原始张量字节存放在由 rosidl::Buffer 支撑的 uint8[] 字段中。 Open Robotics, n.d., "Tensor message" Buffer descriptor 缓冲区描述符 "A normal ROS 2 .msg produced by a BufferBackend that travels on the wire in place of the raw uint8[] contents of a buffer-backed field." 由 BufferBackend 生成的一种普通 ROS 2 .msg，在传输线路上代替缓冲区支撑字段的原始 uint8[] 内容。 Open Robotics, n.d., "Buffer descriptor" Acceptable backend list 可接受后端列表 "A comma-separated list of backend names the subscription is willing to receive; "cpu" (or empty) means CPU-only, "any" means any installed backend, and CPU is always implicitly acceptable." 一个用逗号分隔的后端名称列表，列出订阅愿意接收的后端；"cpu"（或空）表示只用 CPU，"any" 表示任何已安装的后端，CPU 总是隐含可接受。 Open Robotics, n.d., "Acceptable backend list" References Open Robotics. (n.d.). Glossary. ROS 2 Documentation: Lyrical. Retrieved October 31, 2026, from https://docs.ros.org/en/lyrical/Get-Started/Glossary.html

ai/ros-2/index.html.summary: ROS 2 Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source ROS 2 ROS 2 "ROS (Robot Operating System) is an open-source ecosystem that provides the framework, tools, and libraries for building, deploying, running, and maintaining robotic applications." ROS（Robot Operating System，机器人操作系统）是一个开源生态系统，提供用于构建、部署、运行和维护机器人应用的框架、工具和库。 Open Robotics, n.d.-a, "About ROS", para. 1 1 Get started 入门 (No definition) （无定义） Open Robotics, n.d.-b, "Get started", documentation menu 2 Framework 框架 "The ROS framework is the “plumbing” which allows for communication between parts of a robot, and within parts of a robot." ROS 框架是让机器人各部分之间以及各部分内部能够通信的“管道”。 Open Robotics, n.d.-a, "Framework", para. 1 3 Tools 工具 "Tools in ROS help developers build, test, and monitor robotic systems." ROS 中的工具帮助开发者构建、测试和监控机器人系统。 Open Robotics, n.d.-a, "Tools", para. 1 4 Capabilities 能力 "Capabilities in ROS are ready-to-use packages that offer common functions for robots, such as manipulation, motion planning, and perception." ROS 中的能力是现成可用的软件包，为机器人提供常用功能，如操作、运动规划和感知。 Open Robotics, n.d.-a, "Capabilities", para. 1 The ecosystem 生态系统 "Despite its name, ROS is actually not an operating system in the traditional sense, but a set of tools and libraries that help developers create robots using various platforms and programming languages." 尽管名字如此，ROS 实际上并不是传统意义上的操作系统，而是一套帮助开发者用各种平台和编程语言创建机器人的工具和库。 Open Robotics, n.d.-a, "The ecosystem", para. 1 ROS distributions ROS 发行版 "A ROS distribution is a packaged set of ROS software released on a regular schedule." ROS 发行版是按固定周期发布的一套打包好的 ROS 软件。 Open Robotics, n.d.-a, "ROS distributions", para. 1 References Open Robotics. (n.d.-a). About ROS. ROS 2 Documentation: Lyrical. ai/scikit-learn/index.html.title: scikit-learn | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
ai/scikit-learn/index.html.summary: scikit-learn Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source scikit-learn scikit-learn "Scikit-learn is an open source machine learning library that supports supervised and unsupervised learning." Scikit-learn 是一个支持监督学习和无监督学习的开源机器学习库。 scikit-learn developers, n.d.-b, "Getting Started", para. 1 1 Supervised Learning 监督学习 "Learning where the expected prediction (label or ground truth) is available for each sample when fitting the model, provided as y." 在拟合模型时，每个样本的预期预测（标签或真实值）都可得到的学习，以 y 的形式提供。 scikit-learn developers, n.d.-a, "supervised learning" 2 Unsupervised Learning 无监督学习 "Learning where the expected prediction (label or ground truth) is not available for each sample when fitting the model, as in clusterers and outlier detectors." 在拟合模型时，每个样本的预期预测（标签或真实值）都不可得到的学习，如聚类器和离群点检测器。 scikit-learn developers, n.d.-a, "unsupervised learning" 3 Model Selection and Evaluation 模型选择与评估 (context) "Fitting a model to some data does not entail that it will predict well on unseen data. This needs to be directly evaluated." （语境）用一些数据拟合了模型，并不意味着它在未见过的数据上也能预测得好。这需要直接加以评估。 scikit-learn developers, n.d.-b, "Model evaluation", para. 1 4 Metadata Routing 元数据路由 "This guide demonstrates how metadata can be routed and passed between objects in scikit-learn." 本指南演示在 scikit-learn 中元数据如何在对象之间路由和传递。 scikit-learn developers, n.d.-c, "4. Metadata Routing", para. 1 after the Note 5 Inspection 检查 "The sklearn.inspection module provides tools to help understand the predictions from a model and what affects them." sklearn.inspection 模块提供工具，帮助理解模型的预测以及影响预测的因素。 scikit-learn developers, n.d.-c, "5. Inspection", para. 1 6 Visualizations 可视化 "Scikit-learn defines a simple API for creating visualizations for machine learning." Scikit-learn 定义了一个用于创建机器学习可视化的简单 API。 scikit-learn developers, n.d.-c, "6. Visualizations", para. 1 7 Callbacks 回调 "An object which can be registered on a compatible estimator to have its hooks called during the fitting of that estimator." 一个可以注册到兼容估计器上的对象，在该估计器拟合期间调用它的钩子。 scikit-learn developers, n.d.-a, "callbacks" 8 Dataset Transformations 数据集变换 "scikit-learn provides a library of transformers, which may clean (see Preprocessing data), reduce (see Unsupervised dimensionality reduction), expand (see Kernel Approximation) or generate (see Feature extraction) feature representations." scikit-learn 提供一个变换器库，可以清洗（见 Preprocessing data）、约简（见 Unsupervised dimensionality reduction）、扩展（见 Kernel Approximation）或生成（见 Feature extraction）特征表示。 scikit-learn developers, n.d.-c, "8. Dataset transformations", para. 1 9 Dataset Loading Utilities 数据集加载工具 "The sklearn.datasets package embeds some small toy datasets and provides helpers to fetch larger datasets commonly used by the machine learning community to benchmark algorithms on data that comes from the ‘real world’." sklearn.datasets 包内置了一些小型玩具数据集，并提供辅助工具来获取更大的数据集，这些数据集常被机器学习社区用来在来自“真实世界”的数据上对算法做基准测试。 scikit-learn developers, n.d.-c, "9. Dataset loading utilities", para. 1 10 Computing with scikit-learn 用 scikit-learn 计算 (context) "For some applications the amount of examples, features (or both) and/or the speed at which they need to be processed are challenging for traditional approaches. In these cases scikit-learn has a number of options you can consider to make your system scale." （语境）对某些应用来说，样本、特征（或两者）的数量，以及/或者处理它们所需的速度，对传统方法是一种挑战。这时 scikit-learn 有一些选项可供考虑，让你的系统扩展。 scikit-learn developers, n.d.-c, "10.1. Strategies to scale computationally: bigger data", para. 1 11 Model Persistence 模型持久化 "After training a scikit-learn model, it is desirable to have a way to persist the model for future use without having to retrain." 训练好一个 scikit-learn 模型后，最好有一种方法把模型持久保存下来，供以后使用而无需重新训练。 scikit-learn developers, n.d.-c, "11. Model persistence", para. 1 12 Common Pitfalls and Recommended Practices 常见陷阱与推荐做法 "The purpose of this chapter is to illustrate some common pitfalls and anti-patterns that occur when using scikit-learn." 本章的目的是说明使用 scikit-learn 时出现的一些常见陷阱和反模式。 scikit-learn developers, n.d.-c, "12. Common pitfalls and recommended practices", para. 1 13 Data Interoperability 数据互操作性 "Scikit-learn handles four kinds of data for X as used in fit(X, y), fit(X), fit_transform(X) and transform(X) as well as Xt as returned by transform(X) and fit_transform(X):" Scikit-learn 为 X 处理四种数据，X 即 fit(X, y)、fit(X)、fit_transform(X) 和 transform(X) 中所用的 X，以及 transform(X) 和 fit_transform(X) 返回的 Xt： scikit-learn developers, n.d.-c, "13. Data Interoperability", para. 1 14 Choosing the Right Estimator 选择合适的估计器 "Often the hardest part of solving a machine learning problem can be finding the right estimator for the job." 解决机器学习问题时，最难的部分往往是为任务找到合适的估计器。 scikit-learn developers, n.d.-c, "14. Choosing the right estimator", para. 1 15 External Resources, Videos and Talks 外部资源、视频与讲座 (context) "If you are new to scikit-learn, or looking to strengthen your understanding, we highly recommend the scikit-learn MOOC (Massive Open Online Course)." （语境）如果你刚接触 scikit-learn，或想加深理解，我们强烈推荐 scikit-learn MOOC（大型开放在线课程）。 scikit-learn developers, n.d.-c, "15.1. The scikit-learn MOOC", para. 1 References scikit-learn developers. (n.d.-a). Glossary of common terms and API elements (Version 1.9.1). the VecEnv, normalize the observation, …), you can use VecEnvWrapper for that." （语境）如果你想在不完全重新定义的情况下修改或增强一个 VecEnv（例如堆叠多帧、监控 VecEnv、归一化观测……），可以使用 VecEnvWrapper。 Raffin et al., n.d., "Vectorized Environments Wrappers", para. 1 VecEnvWrapper VecEnvWrapper 向量化环境包装器 "They are the vectorized equivalents (i.e., they act on multiple environments at the same time) of gym.Wrapper." 它们是 gym.Wrapper 的向量化对应物（即同时作用于多个环境）。 Raffin et al., n.d., "Vectorized Environments Wrappers", para. 1 VecEnv VecEnv 向量化环境 "An abstract asynchronous, vectorized environment." 一个抽象的异步向量化环境。 Raffin et al., n.d., "VecEnv", para. 1 VecEnv.close close 方法 "Clean up the environment’s resources." 清理环境的资源。 Raffin et al., n.d., "VecEnv", para. 1 VecEnv.env_is_wrapped env_is_wrapped 方法 "Check if environments are wrapped with a given wrapper." 检查各环境是否被给定的包装器包装。 Raffin et al., n.d., "VecEnv", para. 1 VecEnv.env_method env_method 方法 "Call instance methods of vectorized environments." 调用向量化环境的实例方法。 Raffin et al., n.d., "VecEnv", para. 1 VecEnv.get_attr get_attr 方法 "Return attribute from vectorized environment." 从向量化环境返回属性。 Raffin et al., n.d., "VecEnv", para. 1 VecEnv.get_images get_images 方法 "Return RGB images from each environment when available" 在可用时从每个环境返回 RGB 图像 Raffin et al., n.d., "VecEnv", para. 1 VecEnv.getattr_depth_check getattr_depth_check 方法 "Check if an attribute reference is being hidden in a recursive call to getattr" 检查某个属性引用是否在对 getattr 的递归调用中被隐藏 Raffin et al., n.d., "VecEnv", para. 1 VecEnv.has_attr has_attr 方法 "Check if an attribute exists for a vectorized environment." 检查向量化环境是否存在某个属性。 Raffin et al., n.d., "VecEnv", para. 1 VecEnv.render render 方法 "Gym environment rendering" Gym 环境渲染 Raffin et al., n.d., "VecEnv", para. 1 VecEnv.reset reset 方法 "Reset all the environments and return an array of observations, or a tuple of observation arrays." 重置所有环境并返回一个观测数组，或一个由观测数组组成的元组。 Raffin et al., n.d., "VecEnv", para. 1 VecEnv.seed seed 方法 "Sets the random seeds for all environments, based on a given seed." 基于给定的种子为所有环境设置随机种子。 Raffin et al., n.d., "VecEnv", para. 1 VecEnv.set_attr set_attr 方法 "Set attribute inside vectorized environments." 在向量化环境内部设置属性。 Raffin et al., n.d., "VecEnv", para. 1 VecEnv.set_options set_options 方法 "Set environment options for all environments." 为所有环境设置环境选项。 Raffin et al., n.d., "VecEnv", para. 1 VecEnv.step step 方法 "Step the environments with the given action" 用给定的动作让各环境前进一步 Raffin et al., n.d., "VecEnv", para. 1 VecEnv.step_async step_async 方法 "Tell all the environments to start taking a step with the given actions." 通知所有环境开始用给定的动作执行一步。 Raffin et al., n.d., "VecEnv", para. 1 VecEnv.step_wait step_wait 方法 "Wait for the step taken with step_async()." 等待用 step_async() 执行的那一步完成。 Raffin et al., n.d., "VecEnv", para. 1 DummyVecEnv DummyVecEnv 顺序向量化环境 "Creates a simple vectorized wrapper for multiple environments, calling each environment in sequence on the current Python process." 创建一个用于多个环境的简单向量化包装器，在当前 Python 进程中依次调用每个环境。 Raffin et al., n.d., "DummyVecEnv", para. 1 DummyVecEnv.env_is_wrapped env_is_wrapped 方法 "Check if worker environments are wrapped with a given wrapper" 检查各工作环境是否被给定的包装器包装 Raffin et al., n.d., "DummyVecEnv", para. 1 DummyVecEnv.render render 方法 "Gym environment rendering. If there are multiple environments then they are tiled together in one image via BaseVecEnv.render()." Gym 环境渲染。如果有多个环境，它们会通过 BaseVecEnv.render() 拼接成一张图像。 Raffin et al., n.d., "DummyVecEnv", para. 1 SubprocVecEnv SubprocVecEnv 多进程向量化环境 "Creates a multiprocess vectorized wrapper for multiple environments, distributing each environment to its own process, allowing significant speed up when the environment is computationally complex." 创建一个用于多个环境的多进程向量化包装器，把每个环境分配到各自的进程中，在环境计算复杂时可以显著提速。 Raffin et al., n.d., "SubprocVecEnv", para. 1 Wrappers 包装器 (No definition) （无定义） Raffin et al., n.d., "Wrappers" VecFrameStack VecFrameStack 帧堆叠包装器 "Frame stacking wrapper for vectorized environment." 用于向量化环境的帧堆叠包装器。 Raffin et al., n.d., "VecFrameStack", para. 1 VecFrameStack.reset reset 方法 "Reset all environments" 重置所有环境 Raffin et al., n.d., "VecFrameStack", para. 1 StackedObservations StackedObservations 堆叠观测 "Frame stacking wrapper for data." 用于数据的帧堆叠包装器。 Raffin et al., n.d., "StackedObservations", para. 1 StackedObservations.compute_stacking compute_stacking 方法 "Calculates the parameters in order to stack observations" 计算堆叠观测所需的参数 Raffin et al., n.d., "StackedObservations", para. 1 StackedObservations.reset reset 方法 "Reset the stacked_obs, add the reset observation to the stack, and return the stack." 重置 stacked_obs，把重置后的观测加入堆栈，并返回该堆栈。 Raffin et al., n.d., "StackedObservations", para. 1 StackedObservations.update update 方法 "Add the observations to the stack and use the dones to update the infos." 把观测加入堆栈，并用 dones 更新 infos。 Raffin et al., n.d., "StackedObservations", para. 1 VecNormalize VecNormalize 归一化包装器 "A moving average, normalizing wrapper for vectorized environment." 用于向量化环境的滑动平均归一化包装器。 Raffin et al., n.d., "VecNormalize", para. 1 VecNormalize.get_original_obs get_original_obs 方法 "Returns an unnormalized version of the observations from the most recent step or reset." 返回最近一次 step 或 reset 得到的观测的未归一化版本。 Raffin et al., n.d., "VecNormalize", para. 1 VecNormalize.get_original_reward get_original_reward 方法 "Returns an unnormalized version of the rewards from the most recent step." 返回最近一次 step 得到的奖励的未归一化版本。 Raffin et al., n.d., "VecNormalize", para. 1 VecNormalize.load load 方法 "Loads a saved VecNormalize object." 加载一个已保存的 VecNormalize 对象。 Raffin et al., n.d., "VecNormalize", para. 1 VecNormalize.normalize_obs normalize_obs 方法 "Normalize observations using this VecNormalize’s observations statistics." 用这个 VecNormalize 的观测统计量归一化观测。 Raffin et al., n.d., "VecNormalize", para. 1 VecNormalize.normalize_reward normalize_reward 方法 "Normalize rewards using this VecNormalize’s rewards statistics." 用这个 VecNormalize 的奖励统计量归一化奖励。 Raffin et al., n.d., "VecNormalize", para. 1 VecNormalize.reset reset 方法 "Reset all environments :return: first observation of the episode" 重置所有环境 :return: 回合的第一个观测 Raffin et al., n.d., "VecNormalize", para. 1 VecNormalize.save save 方法 "Save current VecNormalize object with all running statistics and settings (e.g. clip_obs)" 保存当前的 VecNormalize 对象及其全部运行统计量和设置（例如 clip_obs） Raffin et al., n.d., "VecNormalize", para. 1 VecNormalize.set_venv set_venv 方法 "Sets the vector environment to wrap to venv." 把要包装的向量环境设为 venv。 Raffin et al., n.d., "VecNormalize", para. 1 VecNormalize.step_wait step_wait 方法 "Apply sequence of actions to sequence of environments actions -> (observations, rewards, dones)" 把一组动作施加到一组环境上 actions -> (observations, rewards, dones) Raffin et al., n.d., "VecNormalize", para. 1 VecVideoRecorder VecVideoRecorder 视频录制包装器 "Wraps a VecEnv or VecEnvWrapper object to record rendered image as mp4 video." 包装一个 VecEnv 或 VecEnvWrapper 对象，把渲染的图像录制为 mp4 视频。 Raffin et al., n.d., "VecVideoRecorder", para. 1 VecVideoRecorder.close close 方法 "Closes the wrapper then the video recorder." 先关闭包装器，再关闭视频录制器。 Raffin et al., n.d., "VecVideoRecorder", para. 1 VecCheckNan VecCheckNan NaN 检查包装器 "NaN and inf checking wrapper for vectorized environment, will raise a warning by default, allowing you to know from what the NaN of inf originated from." 用于向量化环境的 NaN 与 inf 检查包装器，默认会发出警告，让你知道 NaN 或 inf 源自何处。 Raffin et al., n.d., "VecCheckNan", para. 1 VecCheckNan.check_array_value check_array_value 方法 "Check for inf and NaN for a single numpy array." 检查单个 numpy 数组中的 inf 和 NaN。 Raffin et al., n.d., "VecCheckNan", para. 1 VecTransposeImage VecTransposeImage 图像转置包装器 "Re-order channels, from HxWxC to CxHxW." 重新排列通道，从 HxWxC 变为 CxHxW。 Raffin et al., n.d., "VecTransposeImage", para. 1 VecTransposeImage.transpose_image transpose_image 方法 "Transpose an image or batch of images (re-order channels)." 转置一张图像或一批图像（重新排列通道）。 Raffin et al., n.d., "VecTransposeImage", para. 1 VecTransposeImage.transpose_observations transpose_observations 方法 "Transpose (if needed) and return new observations." （在需要时）转置并返回新的观测。 Raffin et al., n.d., "VecTransposeImage", para. 1 VecTransposeImage.transpose_space transpose_space 方法 "Transpose an observation space (re-order channels)." 转置一个观测空间（重新排列通道）。 Raffin et al., n.d., "VecTransposeImage", para. 1 VecMonitor VecMonitor 向量化监控包装器 "A vectorized monitor wrapper for vectorized Gym environments, it is used to record the episode reward, length, time and other data." 用于向量化 Gym 环境的向量化监控包装器，用来记录回合奖励、长度、时间和其他数据。 Raffin et al., n.d., "VecMonitor", para. 1 VecExtractDictObs VecExtractDictObs 字典观测提取包装器 "A vectorized wrapper for extracting dictionary observations." 用于提取字典观测的向量化包装器。 Raffin et al., n.d., "VecExtractDictObs", para. 1 References Raffin, A., Hill, A., Gleave, A., Kanervisto, A., Ernestus, M., & Dormann, N.. (n.d.). Vectorized Environments. Stable-Baselines3 docs (Version 2.9.2a0). Retrieved October 31, 2026, from https://stable-baselines3.readthedocs.io/en/master/guide/vec_envs.html

ai/ultralytics-yolo/datasets/classificat.summary: 4.6 Classification Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 4.6 Classification 分类数据集 (No definition) （无定义） Ultralytics, n.d.-f, "Image Classification Datasets Overview" Dataset Structure for YOLO Classification Tasks YOLO 分类任务的数据集结构 "For Ultralytics YOLO classification tasks, the dataset must be organized in a specific split-directory structure under the root directory." 对于 Ultralytics YOLO 分类任务，数据集必须在 root 目录下按特定的划分目录结构组织。 Ultralytics, n.d.-f, "Dataset Structure for YOLO Classification Tasks", para. 1 Caltech 101 Caltech-101 "The Caltech-101 dataset is a classic image classification benchmark of 9,144 images spanning 101 object categories plus one background class." Caltech-101 数据集是一个经典的图像分类基准，含 9,144 张图像，涵盖 101 个物体类别和一个背景类别。 Ultralytics, n.d.-a, "Caltech-101 Dataset", para. 1 Caltech 256 Caltech-256 "The Caltech-256 dataset is a classic image classification benchmark of 30,607 images spanning 256 object categories plus one background class." Caltech-256 数据集是一个经典的图像分类基准，含 30,607 张图像，涵盖 256 个物体类别和一个背景类别。 Ultralytics, n.d.-b, "Caltech-256 Dataset", para. 1 CIFAR-10 CIFAR-10 "The CIFAR-10 (Canadian Institute For Advanced Research) dataset is a classic image classification benchmark of 60,000 32x32 color images evenly split across 10 classes — airplane, automobile, bird, cat, deer, dog, frog, horse, ship, and truck." CIFAR-10（加拿大高等研究院）数据集是一个经典的图像分类基准，含 60,000 张 32×32 的彩色图像，平均分为 10 个类别：飞机、汽车、鸟、猫、鹿、狗、青蛙、马、船和卡车。 Ultralytics, n.d.-c, "CIFAR-10 Dataset", para. 1 CIFAR-100 CIFAR-100 "The CIFAR-100 (Canadian Institute For Advanced Research) dataset is an image classification benchmark of 60,000 32x32 color images spread evenly across 100 fine-grained classes (600 images each), which are in turn grouped into 20 coarse superclasses." CIFAR-100（加拿大高等研究院）数据集是一个图像分类基准，含 60,000 张 32×32 的彩色图像，平均分布在 100 个细粒度类别中（每类 600 张），这些类别又归为 20 个粗粒度超类。 Ultralytics, n.d.-d, "CIFAR-100 Dataset", para. 1 Fashion-MNIST Fashion-MNIST "The Fashion-MNIST dataset is an image classification benchmark of 70,000 28x28 grayscale images of Zalando's clothing articles, evenly split across 10 classes — T-shirt/top, trouser, pullover, dress, coat, sandal, shirt, sneaker, bag, and ankle boot." Fashion-MNIST 数据集是一个图像分类基准，含 70,000 张 28×28 的 Zalando 服装商品灰度图像，平均分为 10 个类别：T 恤/上衣、裤子、套头衫、连衣裙、外套、凉鞋、衬衫、运动鞋、包和短靴。 Ultralytics, n.d.-e, "Fashion-MNIST Dataset", para. 1 ImageNet ImageNet "The Ultralytics ImageNet dataset (data="imagenet") is the ImageNet-1k / ILSVRC-2012 subset used to train and benchmark image classification models." Ultralytics ImageNet 数据集（data="imagenet"）是用于训练和评测图像分类模型的 ImageNet-1k / ILSVRC-2012 子集。 Ultralytics, n.d.-g, "ImageNet Dataset", para. 1 ImageNet-10 ImageNet-10 "The Ultralytics ImageNet10 dataset (data="imagenet10") is a tiny 24-image subset of ImageNet spanning its first 10 classes, built for continuous-integration tests, sanity checks, and fast validation of training pipelines." Ultralytics ImageNet10 数据集（data="imagenet10"）是一个只有 24 张图像的 ImageNet 子集，涵盖其前 10 个类别，用于持续集成测试、健全性检查和快速验证训练流程。 Ultralytics, n.d.-h, "ImageNet10 Dataset", para. 1 Imagenette Imagenette "The ImageNette dataset is a subset of ImageNet with 10 easily distinguishable classes, created by fast.ai to provide a quicker, easier-to-use version of ImageNet for software development and education." ImageNette 数据集是 ImageNet 的一个子集，含 10 个容易区分的类别，由 fast.ai 创建，为软件开发和教学提供一个更快、更易用的 ImageNet 版本。 Ultralytics, n.d.-i, "ImageNette Dataset", para. 1 Imagewoof Imagewoof "The ImageWoof dataset is a subset of ImageNet consisting of 10 dog-breed classes that are deliberately hard to tell apart, created by fast.ai as a tougher challenge for image classification algorithms." ImageWoof 数据集是 ImageNet 的一个子集，由 10 个故意选得难以区分的狗品种类别组成，由 fast.ai 创建，作为图像分类算法更难的挑战。 Ultralytics, n.d.-j, "ImageWoof Dataset", para. 1 MNIST MNIST "The MNIST (Modified National Institute of Standards and Technology) dataset is an image classification benchmark of 70,000 28x28 grayscale images of handwritten digits spanning 10 classes — the digits 0 through 9." MNIST（改进的美国国家标准与技术研究院）数据集是一个图像分类基准，含 70,000 张 28×28 的手写数字灰度图像，共 10 个类别，即数字 0 到 9。 Ultralytics, n.d.-k, "MNIST Dataset", para. 1 References Ultralytics. (n.d.-a). Caltech-101 Dataset. ai/ultralytics-yolo/datasets/depth-estim.title: 4.4 Depth Estimation | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
ai/ultralytics-yolo/datasets/depth-estim.summary: 4.4 Depth Estimation Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 4.4 Depth Estimation 深度估计数据集 (context) "Monocular depth estimation assigns a depth value in meters to every pixel in an image." （语境）单目深度估计给图像中的每个像素分配一个以米为单位的深度值。 Ultralytics, n.d.-b, "Depth Estimation Datasets Overview", para. 1 ARKitScenes ARKitScenes "ARKitScenes is a large-scale real-world indoor RGB-D dataset captured with Apple's ARKit on iPad Pro devices equipped with a LiDAR scanner." ARKitScenes 是一个大规模真实室内 RGB-D 数据集，用苹果 ARKit 在配备激光雷达扫描仪的 iPad Pro 上采集。 Ultralytics, n.d.-a, "ARKitScenes Depth Dataset", para. 1 Depth8 Depth8 "The Ultralytics Depth8 dataset is a compact monocular depth estimation dataset with 8 images sampled from the SUN RGB-D dataset: 4 for training and 4 for validation, drawn from its Kinect v1 and Kinect v2 captures (two per sensor in each split) for dense, artifact-free ground-truth depth maps." Ultralytics Depth8 数据集是一个紧凑的单目深度估计数据集，含从 SUN RGB-D 数据集中抽取的 8 张图像：4 张训练，4 张验证，取自 Kinect v1 和 Kinect v2 的采集（每个划分中每种传感器各两张），以获得稠密、无伪影的真值深度图。 Ultralytics, n.d.-c, "Depth8 Dataset", para. 1 DIODE DIODE "DIODE (Dense Indoor/Outdoor DEpth) is a real-world dataset with very high-quality dense depth ground truth captured by a FARO Focus survey-grade laser scanner." DIODE（稠密室内/室外深度）是一个真实世界数据集，带有用 FARO Focus 测绘级激光扫描仪采集的高质量稠密深度真值。 Ultralytics, n.d.-d, "DIODE Depth Dataset", para. 1 ETH3D ETH3D "ETH3D is a high-resolution multi-view-stereo benchmark used for monocular depth estimation." ETH3D 是一个用于单目深度估计的高分辨率多视图立体基准。 Ultralytics, n.d.-e, "ETH3D Depth Dataset", para. 1 Hypersim Hypersim "Hypersim is a photorealistic synthetic dataset of indoor scenes designed for holistic indoor scene understanding." Hypersim 是一个逼真的室内场景合成数据集，用于整体的室内场景理解。 Ultralytics, n.d.-f, "Hypersim Depth Dataset", para. 1 iBims-1 iBims-1 (context) "iBims-1 is a zero-shot evaluation benchmark for the YOLO26-Depth family; the published models are not trained on it." （语境）iBims-1 是 YOLO26-Depth 系列的零样本评估基准；已发布的模型没有在它上面训练。 Ultralytics, n.d.-g, "iBims-1 Depth Dataset", para. 1 ImageNet (pseudo) ImageNet（伪标签） "The ImageNet (pseudo-labeled depth) dataset reuses the 1,281,167 ImageNet-1K training images, which have no ground-truth depth, and pairs each image with a pseudo depth map produced by a Depth Anything 3 teacher, combining its monocular and metric checkpoints." ImageNet（伪标签深度）数据集沿用 1,281,167 张没有深度真值的 ImageNet-1K 训练图像，并为每张图像配上由 Depth Anything 3 教师模型生成的伪深度图，结合了它的单目和度量检查点。 Ultralytics, n.d.-h, "ImageNet (Pseudo-Labeled) Depth Dataset", para. 1 KITTI KITTI 深度版 "The KITTI dataset is a real-world outdoor autonomous-driving benchmark captured from a moving vehicle in and around the city of Karlsruhe." KITTI 数据集是一个真实室外自动驾驶基准，从在卡尔斯鲁厄市内及周边行驶的车辆上采集。 Ultralytics, n.d.-i, "KITTI Depth Dataset", para. 1 Make3D Make3D "Make3D is a classic outdoor benchmark for monocular depth estimation." Make3D 是一个经典的室外单目深度估计基准。 Ultralytics, n.d.-j, "Make3D Depth Dataset", para. 1 NYU Depth V2 NYU Depth V2 "NYU Depth V2 is the standard indoor benchmark for monocular depth estimation." NYU Depth V2 是单目深度估计的标准室内基准。 Ultralytics, n.d.-k, "NYU Depth V2 Depth Dataset", para. 1 SUN RGB-D SUN RGB-D "SUN RGB-D is a real-world indoor scene-understanding benchmark captured with four different RGB-D sensors: Intel RealSense, Asus Xtion, and Microsoft Kinect v1 and v2." SUN RGB-D 是一个真实室内场景理解基准，用四种不同的 RGB-D 传感器采集：Intel RealSense、Asus Xtion，以及 Microsoft Kinect v1 和 v2。 Ultralytics, n.d.-l, "SUN RGB-D Depth Dataset", para. 1 TartanAir TartanAir "TartanAir is a large-scale synthetic dataset generated in the AirSim simulator." TartanAir 是一个在 AirSim 仿真器中生成的大规模合成数据集。 Ultralytics, n.d.-m, "TartanAir Depth Dataset", para. 1 Virtual KITTI 2 Virtual KITTI 2 "Virtual KITTI 2 (vKITTI2) is a photorealistic synthetic recreation of the KITTI driving scenes." Virtual KITTI 2（vKITTI2）是对 KITTI 驾驶场景的逼真合成重建。 Ultralytics, n.d.-n, "Virtual KITTI 2 Depth Dataset", para. 1 References Ultralytics. (n.d.-a). ARKitScenes Depth Dataset. ai/ultralytics-yolo/datasets/detection.h.summary: 4.1 Detection Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 4.1 Detection 检测数据集 (context) "This guide introduces various formats of datasets that are compatible with the Ultralytics YOLO model and provides insights into their structure, usage, and how to convert between different formats." （语境）本指南介绍与 Ultralytics YOLO 模型兼容的各种数据集格式，并说明它们的结构、用法以及如何在不同格式之间转换。 Ultralytics, n.d.-p, "Object Detection Datasets Overview", para. 1 Ultralytics Benchmark Ultralytics 基准 "Ultralytics Benchmark is a benchmark dataset for measuring model generalizability) across 37 curated object detection datasets with high-quality bounding box labels." Ultralytics Benchmark 是一个衡量模型泛化能力的基准数据集，涵盖 37 个精选的、带高质量边界框标注的目标检测数据集。 Ultralytics, n.d.-x, "Ultralytics Benchmark", para. 1 African-wildlife 非洲野生动物 "The Ultralytics African Wildlife Dataset is an object detection dataset of 1,504 images across 4 animal classes — buffalo, elephant, rhino, and zebra — commonly found in South African nature reserves." Ultralytics 非洲野生动物数据集是一个目标检测数据集，含 1,504 张图像、4 个动物类别：水牛、大象、犀牛和斑马，都是南非自然保护区常见的动物。 Ultralytics, n.d.-a, "African Wildlife Dataset", para. 1 Argoverse Argoverse "The Ultralytics Argoverse dataset (Argoverse-HD) is a 2D object detection dataset of 54,446 labeled autonomous-driving images — 39,384 for training and 15,062 for validation — across 8 classes: person, bicycle, car, motorcycle, bus, truck, traffic light, and stop sign." Ultralytics Argoverse 数据集（Argoverse-HD）是一个二维目标检测数据集，含 54,446 张带标注的自动驾驶图像（训练 39,384 张，验证 15,062 张），共 8 个类别：行人、自行车、汽车、摩托车、公交车、卡车、交通灯和停车标志。 Ultralytics, n.d.-b, "Argoverse Dataset", para. 1 Brain-tumor 脑肿瘤 "The Ultralytics Brain Tumor dataset is an object detection dataset of 1,116 medical images (893 for training and 223 for validation) from MRI and CT scans, labeled across 2 classes: negative (no tumor) and positive (tumor present)." Ultralytics 脑肿瘤数据集是一个目标检测数据集，含 1,116 张医学图像（训练 893 张，验证 223 张），来自 MRI 和 CT 扫描，标注为两个类别：negative（无肿瘤）和 positive（有肿瘤）。 Ultralytics, n.d.-c, "Brain Tumor Dataset", para. 1 COCO COCO "The COCO (Common Objects in Context) dataset is a large-scale object detection, segmentation, and captioning dataset." COCO（Common Objects in Context）数据集是一个大规模的目标检测、分割和图像描述数据集。 Ultralytics, n.d.-d, "COCO Dataset", para. 1 COCO8 COCO8 "The Ultralytics COCO8 dataset is a compact yet powerful object detection dataset, consisting of the first 8 images from the COCO train 2017 set—4 for training and 4 for validation." Ultralytics COCO8 数据集是一个小巧而强大的目标检测数据集，由 COCO train 2017 集的前 8 张图像组成：4 张训练，4 张验证。 Ultralytics, n.d.-g, "COCO8 Dataset", para. 1 COCO8-Grayscale COCO8 灰度版 "The Ultralytics COCO8-Grayscale dataset is a compact yet powerful object detection dataset, consisting of the first 8 images from the COCO train 2017 set and converted to grayscale format—4 for training and 4 for validation." Ultralytics COCO8 灰度数据集是一个小巧而强大的目标检测数据集，由 COCO train 2017 集的前 8 张图像转换为灰度格式而成：4 张训练，4 张验证。 Ultralytics, n.d.-h, "COCO8-Grayscale Dataset", para. 1 COCO8-Multispectral COCO8 多光谱版 "The Ultralytics COCO8-Multispectral dataset is an advanced variant of the original COCO8 dataset, designed to facilitate experimentation with multispectral object detection models." Ultralytics COCO8 多光谱数据集是原始 COCO8 数据集的进阶变体，用于方便地试验多光谱目标检测模型。 Ultralytics, n.d.-i, "COCO8-Multispectral Dataset", para. 1 COCO12-Formats COCO12 多格式版 "The Ultralytics COCO12-Formats dataset is a specialized test dataset designed to validate image loading across 12 supported image format extensions." Ultralytics COCO12 多格式数据集是一个专用测试数据集，用于验证对 12 种受支持图像格式扩展名的加载。 Ultralytics, n.d.-e, "COCO12-Formats Dataset", para. 1 COCO128 COCO128 "Ultralytics COCO128 is a small, but versatile object detection dataset composed of the first 128 images of the COCO train 2017 set." Ultralytics COCO128 是一个小而多用途的目标检测数据集，由 COCO train 2017 集的前 128 张图像组成。 Ultralytics, n.d.-f, "COCO128 Dataset", para. 1 Construction-PPE 施工个人防护装备 "The Ultralytics Construction-PPE dataset is an object detection dataset of 1,416 images (1,132 for training, 143 for validation, and 141 for testing) labeled across 11 classes for detecting personal protective equipment — helmets, gloves, vests, boots, and goggles — and flagging missing gear on construction sites." Ultralytics 施工个人防护装备数据集是一个目标检测数据集，含 1,416 张图像（训练 1,132 张、验证 143 张、测试 141 张），标注了 11 个类别，用于检测安全帽、手套、背心、靴子和护目镜等个人防护装备，并标出施工现场缺少的装备。 Ultralytics, n.d.-j, "Construction-PPE Dataset", para. 1 GlobalWheat2020 全球麦穗 2020 "The Global Wheat Head Dataset (GWHD) is a single-class object detection dataset for detecting wheat heads — the grain-bearing spikes of the wheat plant — in outdoor field images." 全球麦穗数据集（GWHD）是一个单类别目标检测数据集，用于在室外田间图像中检测麦穗，即小麦植株上结籽的穗。 Ultralytics, n.d.-k, "Global Wheat Head Dataset", para. 1 HomeObjects-3K 家居物品 3K "The Ultralytics HomeObjects-3K dataset is an indoor object detection dataset of 2,689 images (2,285 training and 404 validation) labeled across 12 everyday household classes — bed, sofa, chair, table, lamp, tv, laptop, wardrobe, window, door, potted plant, and photo frame." Ultralytics 家居物品 3K 数据集是一个室内目标检测数据集，含 2,689 张图像（训练 2,285 张，验证 404 张），标注了 12 个日常家居类别：床、沙发、椅子、桌子、灯、电视、笔记本电脑、衣柜、窗户、门、盆栽和相框。 Ultralytics, n.d.-l, "HomeObjects-3K Dataset", para. 1 KITTI KITTI "The Ultralytics KITTI dataset is a 2D object detection dataset for autonomous driving, containing 7,481 annotated images (5,985 for training and 1,496 for validation) across 8 classes — car, van, truck, pedestrian, person_sitting, cyclist, tram, and misc." Ultralytics KITTI 数据集是一个用于自动驾驶的二维目标检测数据集，含 7,481 张标注图像（训练 5,985 张，验证 1,496 张），共 8 个类别：汽车、厢式车、卡车、行人、坐着的人、骑车人、电车和其他。 Ultralytics, n.d.-m, "KITTI Dataset", para. 1 LVIS LVIS "The LVIS dataset is a large-scale object detection and instance segmentation benchmark with 1,203 object categories across roughly 160,000 images." LVIS 数据集是一个大规模的目标检测和实例分割基准，约 16 万张图像，涵盖 1,203 个物体类别。 Ultralytics, n.d.-n, "LVIS Dataset", para. 1 Medical-pills 药片 "The Ultralytics Medical Pills dataset is a proof-of-concept (POC) object detection dataset of 115 labeled images across a single class, pill — 92 for training and 23 for validation." Ultralytics 药片数据集是一个概念验证（POC）目标检测数据集，含 115 张带标注的图像，只有一个类别：pill（药片），训练 92 张，验证 23 张。 Ultralytics, n.d.-o, "Medical Pills Dataset", para. 1 Objects365 Objects365 "The Objects365 dataset is a large-scale object detection benchmark with 1,742,289 training images and 80,000 validation images spanning 365 object classes — from people, cars, and chairs to bottles, dogs, and street lights." Objects365 数据集是一个大规模目标检测基准，含 1,742,289 张训练图像和 80,000 张验证图像，涵盖 365 个物体类别：从人、汽车、椅子到瓶子、狗和路灯。 Ultralytics, n.d.-q, "Objects365 Dataset", para. 1 OpenImagesV7 Open Images V7 "Open Images V7 is a large-scale object detection dataset created by Google, with 1,743,042 training images and 41,620 validation images across 601 object classes in the Ultralytics configuration." Open Images V7 是谷歌创建的大规模目标检测数据集，在 Ultralytics 配置中含 1,743,042 张训练图像和 41,620 张验证图像，涵盖 601 个物体类别。 Ultralytics, n.d.-r, "Open Images V7 Dataset", para. 1 RF100 Roboflow 100 "Roboflow 100, sponsored by Intel, is a groundbreaking object detection benchmark dataset." Roboflow 100 由英特尔赞助，是一个开创性的目标检测基准数据集。 Ultralytics, n.d.-t, "Roboflow 100 Dataset", para. 1 Signature 签名 "The Ultralytics Signature Detection Dataset is an object detection dataset of 178 document images annotated with a single signature class, pre-split into 143 training and 35 validation images." Ultralytics 签名检测数据集是一个目标检测数据集，含 178 张文档图像，只标注了 signature（签名）一个类别，已预先划分为 143 张训练图像和 35 张验证图像。 Ultralytics, n.d.-u, "Signature Detection Dataset", para. 1 SKU-110K SKU-110K "The SKU-110K dataset is a single-class object detection dataset of 11,743 densely packed retail-shelf images, split into 8,219 training, 588 validation, and 2,936 test images." SKU-110K 数据集是一个单类别目标检测数据集，含 11,743 张商品密集的零售货架图像，划分为训练 8,219 张、验证 588 张、测试 2,936 张。 Ultralytics, n.d.-v, "SKU-110K Dataset", para. 1 TT100K TT100K "The Tsinghua-Tencent 100K (TT100K) dataset is a traffic-sign benchmark for object detection, created by Zhu et al. for the CVPR 2016 paper Traffic-Sign Detection and Classification in the Wild." 清华-腾讯 100K（TT100K）数据集是一个用于目标检测的交通标志基准，由 Zhu 等人为 CVPR 2016 论文 Traffic-Sign Detection and Classification in the Wild 创建。 Ultralytics, n.d.-w, "TT100K Dataset", para. 1 VisDrone VisDrone "The VisDrone Dataset is a large-scale drone-imagery benchmark whose detection subset (VisDrone2019-DET) provides 8,629 aerial images — 6,471 train, 548 validation, and 1,610 test-dev — annotated with 10 object classes for object detection." VisDrone 数据集是一个大规模的无人机影像基准，其检测子集（VisDrone2019-DET）提供 8,629 张航拍图像（训练 6,471 张、验证 548 张、test-dev 1,610 张），标注了 10 个物体类别，用于目标检测。 Ultralytics, n.d.-y, "VisDrone Dataset", para. 1 VOC VOC "The PASCAL VOC (Visual Object Classes) dataset is a classic object detection benchmark with 20 everyday object classes." PASCAL VOC（视觉物体类别）数据集是一个经典的目标检测基准，含 20 个日常物体类别。 Ultralytics, n.d.-s, "PASCAL VOC Dataset", para. 1 xView xView "The xView dataset is one of the largest publicly available satellite-imagery benchmarks for object detection, providing over 1 million object instances across 60 classes annotated with bounding boxes in more than 1,400 km² of 0.3 m WorldView-3 imagery." xView 数据集是最大的公开卫星影像目标检测基准之一，在超过 1,400 平方公里、分辨率 0.3 米的 WorldView-3 影像中，用边界框标注了 60 个类别、超过 100 万个物体实例。 Ultralytics, n.d.-z, "xView Dataset", para. 1 References Ultralytics. ai/ultralytics-yolo/datasets/index.html.summary: 4. Datasets Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 4 Datasets 数据集 (context) "Ultralytics provides support for various datasets to facilitate computer vision tasks such as detection, instance segmentation, semantic segmentation, depth estimation, classification, pose estimation, and oriented bounding boxes (OBB)." （语境）Ultralytics 支持多种数据集，以便开展计算机视觉任务，如检测、实例分割、语义分割、深度估计、分类、姿态估计和旋转边界框（OBB）。 Ultralytics, n.d.-a, "Datasets Overview", para. 1 4.1 Detection 检测数据集 (context) "This guide introduces various formats of datasets that are compatible with the Ultralytics YOLO model and provides insights into their structure, usage, and how to convert between different formats." （语境）本指南介绍与 Ultralytics YOLO 模型兼容的各种数据集格式，并说明它们的结构、用法以及如何在不同格式之间转换。 Ultralytics, n.d.-f, "Object Detection Datasets Overview", para. 1 4.2 Segmentation 实例分割数据集 (context) "Instance segmentation is a computer vision task that involves identifying and delineating individual objects within an image." （语境）实例分割是一项识别并勾勒图像中各个物体的计算机视觉任务。 Ultralytics, n.d.-d, "Instance Segmentation Datasets Overview", para. 1 4.3 Semantic Segmentation 语义分割数据集 (context) "Semantic segmentation assigns one class label to every pixel in an image." （语境）语义分割给图像中的每个像素分配一个类别标签。 Ultralytics, n.d.-i, "Semantic Segmentation Datasets Overview", para. 1 4.4 Depth Estimation 深度估计数据集 (context) "Monocular depth estimation assigns COCO-Seg 数据集以 Ultralytics YOLO 标注格式提供 COCO 的实例分割掩码：118,287 张训练图像和 5,000 张验证图像，带多边形掩码，涵盖 80 个物体类别。 Ultralytics, n.d.-b, "COCO-Seg Dataset", para. 1 COCO8-seg COCO8 分割版 "Ultralytics COCO8-Seg is a small but versatile instance segmentation dataset composed of the first 8 images of the COCO train 2017 set, 4 for training and 4 for validation."
