ai/ultralytics-yolo/index.html.title: Ultralytics YOLO | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
ai/ultralytics-yolo/index.html.summary: Ultralytics YOLO Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source Ultralytics YOLO Ultralytics YOLO "Ultralytics YOLO is a family of real-time computer vision models for object detection, instance segmentation, semantic segmentation, depth estimation, classification, pose estimation, oriented bounding boxes, and tracking, available through one Python package and CLI." Ultralytics YOLO 是一系列实时计算机视觉模型，用于目标检测、实例分割、语义分割、深度估计、分类、姿态估计、旋转边界框和跟踪，通过一个 Python 包和命令行工具提供。 Ultralytics, n.d.-h, "Ultralytics YOLO Docs", para. 1 1 Modes 模式 (context) "Ultralytics YOLO26 is not just another object detection model; it's a versatile framework designed to cover the entire lifecycle of machine learning models—from data ingestion and model training to validation, deployment, and real-world tracking." （语境）Ultralytics YOLO26 不只是又一个目标检测模型；它是一个多用途框架，旨在覆盖机器学习模型的整个生命周期：从数据摄取、模型训练，到验证、部署和真实场景中的跟踪。 Ultralytics, n.d.-c, "Introduction", para. 1 2 Tasks 任务 (context) "Ultralytics YOLO26 is a versatile AI framework that supports multiple computer vision tasks. The framework can be used to perform detection, segmentation, semantic segmentation, depth estimation, classification, pose estimation, and OBB." （语境）Ultralytics YOLO26 是一个支持多种计算机视觉任务的多用途 AI 框架。该框架可以用来做检测、分割、语义分割、深度估计、分类、姿态估计和旋转边界框（OBB）。 Ultralytics, n.d.-a, "Computer Vision Tasks Supported by Ultralytics YOLO26", para. 1 3 Models 模型 (context) "We offer support for a wide range of models, each tailored to specific tasks like object detection, instance segmentation, semantic segmentation, depth estimation, image classification, pose estimation, and oriented bounding boxes." （语境）我们支持多种模型，每种都针对特定任务而设计，如目标检测、实例分割、语义分割、深度估计、图像分类、姿态估计和旋转边界框。 Ultralytics, n.d.-d, "Models Supported by Ultralytics", para. 1 4 Datasets 数据集 (context) "Ultralytics provides support for various datasets to facilitate computer vision tasks such as detection, instance segmentation, semantic segmentation, depth estimation, classification, pose estimation, and oriented bounding boxes (OBB)." （语境）Ultralytics 支持多种数据集，以便开展计算机视觉任务，如检测、实例分割、语义分割、深度估计、分类、姿态估计和旋转边界框（OBB）。 Ultralytics, n.d.-b, "Datasets Overview", para. 1 5 Solutions 解决方案 "Ultralytics Solutions provide cutting-edge applications of YOLO models, offering real-world solutions like object counting, blurring, and security systems, enhancing efficiency and accuracy in diverse industries." Ultralytics Solutions 提供 YOLO 模型的前沿应用，给出目标计数、模糊处理、安防系统等真实场景的解决方案，在各行各业提升效率和准确率。 Ultralytics, n.d.-g, "Ultralytics Solutions: Harness YOLO26 to Solve Real-World Problems", para. 1 6 Platform 平台 "Ultralytics Platform is a comprehensive end-to-end computer vision platform that streamlines the entire ML workflow from data preparation to model deployment." Ultralytics Platform 是一个全面的端到端计算机视觉平台，简化从数据准备到模型部署的整个机器学习工作流。 Ultralytics, n.d.-f, "Ultralytics Platform", para. 1 7 Rust Inference Rust 推理 "Ultralytics Inference is a high-performance YOLO inference library and command-line tool written in Rust." ai/ultralytics-yolo/models/fastsam-fast-.summary: 3.16 FastSAM (Fast Segment Anything Model) Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 3.16 FastSAM (Fast Segment Anything Model) FastSAM（快速分割一切模型） "The Fast Segment Anything Model (FastSAM) is a novel, real-time CNN-based solution for the Segment Anything task." 快速分割一切模型（FastSAM）是一种新颖的、基于 CNN 的实时方案，用于“分割一切”任务。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Fast Segment Anything Model (FastSAM)", para. 1 Model Architecture 模型架构 (No definition) （无定义） Ultralytics, n.d., "Model Architecture" Key Features 主要特性 (No definition) （无定义） Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features" Real-time Solution 实时解决方案 "Real-time Solution: By leveraging the computational efficiency of CNNs, FastSAM provides a real-time solution for the segment anything task" 实时解决方案：借助 CNN 的计算效率，FastSAM 为“分割一切”任务提供了实时解决方案 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features", item 1 Efficiency and Performance 效率与性能 "Efficiency and Performance: FastSAM offers a significant reduction in computational and resource demands without compromising on performance quality." 效率与性能：FastSAM 在不牺牲性能质量的前提下大幅降低了计算和资源需求。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features", item 2 Prompt-guided Segmentation 提示引导分割 "Prompt-guided Segmentation: FastSAM can segment any object within an image guided by various possible user interaction prompts" 提示引导分割：FastSAM 能在各种可能的用户交互提示引导下分割图像中的任何物体 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features", item 3 Based on YOLOv8-seg 基于 YOLOv8-seg "Based on YOLOv8-seg: FastSAM is based on YOLOv8-seg, an object detector equipped with an instance segmentation branch." 基于 YOLOv8-seg：FastSAM 基于 YOLOv8-seg，它是一种配有实例分割分支的目标检测器。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features", item 4 Model Compression Feasibility 模型压缩可行性 "Model Compression Feasibility: FastSAM demonstrates the feasibility of a path that can significantly reduce the computational effort by introducing an artificial prior to the structure" 模型压缩可行性：FastSAM 证明了通过给结构引入人工先验来大幅减少计算量这条路径的可行性 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features", item 7 References Ultralytics. (n.d.). Fast Segment Anything Model (FastSAM). Ultralytics YOLO Docs (ultralytics 8.4.194). Retrieved October 31, 2026, from https://docs.ultralytics.com/models/fast-sam/

ai/ultralytics-yolo/models/index.html.summary: 3. Models Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 3 Models 模型 (context) "We offer support for a wide range of models, each tailored to specific tasks like object detection, instance segmentation, semantic segmentation, depth estimation, image classification, pose estimation, and oriented bounding boxes." （语境）我们支持多种模型，每种都针对特定任务而设计，如目标检测、实例分割、语义分割、深度估计、图像分类、姿态估计和旋转边界框。 Ultralytics, n.d.-f, "Models Supported by Ultralytics", para. 1 3.1 YOLO26 YOLO26 "YOLO26 is a unified family of real-time vision models described in the Ultralytics YOLO26 paper." YOLO26 是 Ultralytics YOLO26 论文中描述的一个统一的实时视觉模型家族。 Ultralytics, n.d.-l, "Ultralytics YOLO26", para. 1 3.2 YOLO12 YOLO12 "YOLO12, released in early 2025, introduces an attention-centric architecture that departs from the traditional CNN-based approaches used in previous YOLO models, yet retains the real-time inference speed essential for many applications." YOLO12 于 2025 年初发布，引入了以注意力为中心的架构，不同于以往 YOLO 模型使用的传统 CNN 方法，同时保留了许多应用所需的实时推理速度。 Ultralytics, n.d.-p, "YOLO12: Attention-Centric Object Detection", para. 1 3.3 YOLO11 YOLO11 (context) "Released September 2024. Current stable release and the recommended choice for all use cases." （语境）2024 年 9 月发布。当前的稳定版本，所有用例的推荐选择。 Ultralytics, n.d.-k, "Ultralytics YOLO11", para. 1 3.4 YOLOv10 YOLOv10 "YOLOv10, released in May 2024 and built on the Ultralytics Python package by researchers at Tsinghua University, introduces a new approach to real-time object detection, addressing both the post-processing and model architecture deficiencies found in previous YOLO versions." YOLOv10 于 2024 年 5 月发布，由清华大学的研究人员基于 Ultralytics Python 包构建，提出了一种新的实时目标检测方法，同时解决了以往 YOLO 版本在后处理和模型架构上的不足。 Ultralytics, n.d.-r, "YOLOv10: Real-Time End-to-End Object Detection", para. 1 3.5 YOLOv9 YOLOv9 "YOLOv9 marks a significant advancement in real-time object detection, introducing groundbreaking techniques such as Programmable Gradient Information (PGI) and the Generalized Efficient Layer Aggregation Network (GELAN)." YOLOv9 标志着实时目标检测的重大进步，引入了可编程梯度信息（PGI）和广义高效层聚合网络（GELAN）等开创性技术。 Ultralytics, n.d.-v, "YOLOv9: A Leap Forward in Object Detection Technology", para. 1 3.6 YOLOv8 YOLOv8 (context) "Released January 2023. Proven and widely adopted with extensive community support." （语境）2023 年 1 月发布。久经验证、广泛采用，社区支持丰富。 Ultralytics, n.d.-b, "Explore Ultralytics YOLOv8", para. 1 3.7 YOLOv7 YOLOv7 "YOLOv7, released in July 2022, was a significant advancement in real-time object detection at its time of release." YOLOv7 于 2022 年 7 月发布，在发布时是实时目标检测的一项重大进步。 Ultralytics, n.d.-u, "YOLOv7: Trainable Bag-of-Freebies", para. 1 3.8 YOLOv6 YOLOv6 "Meituan YOLOv6, released in 2022, offers a strong balance between speed and accuracy, making it a popular choice for real-time applications." 美团 YOLOv6 于 2022 年发布，在速度和精度之间取得了很好的平衡，因此常用于实时应用。 Ultralytics, n.d.-d, "Meituan YOLOv6", para. 1 3.9 YOLOv5 YOLOv5 (context) "Released June 2020. The foundational PyTorch implementation, battle-tested across millions of deployments." （语境）2020 年 6 月发布。奠基性的 PyTorch 实现，经过数百万次部署的实战检验。 Ultralytics, n.d.-m, "Ultralytics YOLOv5", para. 1 3.10 YOLOv4 YOLOv4 "YOLOv4 is designed to provide the optimal balance between speed and accuracy, making it an excellent choice for many applications." YOLOv4 旨在提供速度与精度之间的最佳平衡，因此是许多应用的绝佳选择。 Ultralytics, n.d.-t, "YOLOv4: High-Speed and Precise Object Detection", para. 1 3.11 YOLOv3 YOLOv3 (context) "This document presents an overview of three closely related object detection models, namely YOLOv3, YOLOv3-Ultralytics, and YOLOv3u." （语境）本文档概述三个密切相关的目标检测模型，即 YOLOv3、YOLOv3-Ultralytics 和 YOLOv3u。 Ultralytics, n.d.-s, "YOLOv3 and YOLOv3u", para. 1 3.12 SAM 3 (Segment Anything Model 3) SAM 3（分割一切模型 3） "SAM 3 (Segment Anything Model 3) is Meta's released foundation model for Promptable Concept Segmentation (PCS)." SAM 3（分割一切模型 3）是 Meta 发布的、用于可提示概念分割（PCS）的基础模型。 Ultralytics, n.d.-h, "SAM 3: Segment Anything with Concepts", para. 1 3.13 SAM 2 (Segment Anything Model 2) SAM 2（分割一切模型 2） "SAM 2 builds upon the original SAM with video segmentation capabilities." SAM 2 在原始 SAM 的基础上增加了视频分割能力。 Ultralytics, n.d.-g, "SAM 2: Segment Anything Model 2", para. 1 3.14 SAM (Segment Anything Model) SAM（分割一切模型） "This is the original SAM model from Meta." 这是 Meta 推出的原始 SAM 模型。 Ultralytics, n.d.-i, "Segment Anything Model (SAM)", para. 1 3.15 MobileSAM (Mobile Segment Anything Model) MobileSAM（移动端分割一切模型） "MobileSAM is a compact, efficient image segmentation model purpose-built for mobile and edge devices." MobileSAM 是一个专为移动和边缘设备打造的紧凑、高效的图像分割模型。 Ultralytics, n.d.-e, "Mobile Segment Anything (MobileSAM)", para. 1 3.16 FastSAM (Fast Segment Anything Model) FastSAM（快速分割一切模型） "The Fast Segment Anything Model (FastSAM) is a novel, real-time CNN-based solution for the Segment Anything task." 快速分割一切模型（FastSAM）是一种新颖的、基于 CNN 的实时方案，用于“分割一切”任务。 Ultralytics, n.d.-c, "Fast Segment Anything Model (FastSAM)", para. 1 3.17 YOLO-NAS (Neural Architecture Search) YOLO-NAS（神经架构搜索） "Developed by Deci AI, YOLO-NAS is a groundbreaking object detection foundational model." YOLO-NAS 由 Deci AI 开发，是一个开创性的目标检测基础模型。 Ultralytics, n.d.-n, "YOLO-NAS", para. 2 3.18 RT-DETR (Realtime Detection Transformer) RT-DETR（实时检测 Transformer） "Real-Time Detection Transformer (RT-DETR), developed by Baidu, is a cutting-edge end-to-end object detector that provides real-time performance while maintaining high accuracy." 实时检测 Transformer（RT-DETR）由百度开发，是一种前沿的端到端目标检测器，在保持高精度的同时提供实时性能。 Ultralytics, n.d.-a, "Baidu's RT-DETR: A Vision Transformer -Based Real-Time Object Detector", para. 1 3.19 YOLO-World YOLO-World "The YOLO-World Model introduces an advanced, real-time Ultralytics YOLOv8-based approach for Open-Vocabulary Detection tasks." YOLO-World 模型提出了一种先进的、基于 Ultralytics YOLOv8 的实时方法，用于开放词汇检测任务。 Ultralytics, n.d.-o, "YOLO-World Model", para. 1 3.20 YOLOE (Real-Time Seeing Anything) YOLOE（实时看见一切） "Ultralytics YOLOE (Real-Time Seeing Anything) is an open-vocabulary detection and instance segmentation model: instead of a class list fixed at training time, it takes the categories you want at inference time, as a text prompt, a visual example, or a built-in 4,585-name vocabulary." Ultralytics YOLOE（实时看见一切）是一个开放词汇的检测和实例分割模型：它不用训练时固定的类别表，而是在推理时接收你想要的类别，形式可以是文本提示、视觉示例或内置的 4,585 个名称的词表。 Ultralytics, n.d.-q, "YOLOE: Real-Time Open-Vocabulary Detection and Segmentation", para. 1 3.21 Ultralytics LLM Interface Ultralytics LLM 接口 "LLM is a small interface for calling language and vision models through an OpenAI-compatible API." LLM 是一个小型接口，通过兼容 OpenAI 的 API 调用语言模型和视觉模型。 Ultralytics, n.d.-j, "Ultralytics LLM Interface", para. 1 References Ultralytics. (n.d.-a). ai/ultralytics-yolo/models/rt-detr-realt.title: 3.18 RT-DETR (Realtime Detection Transformer) | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
ai/ultralytics-yolo/models/rt-detr-realt.summary: 3.18 RT-DETR (Realtime Detection Transformer) Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 3.18 RT-DETR (Realtime Detection Transformer) RT-DETR（实时检测 Transformer） "Real-Time Detection Transformer (RT-DETR), developed by Baidu, is a cutting-edge end-to-end object detector that provides real-time performance while maintaining high accuracy." 实时检测 Transformer（RT-DETR）由百度开发，是一种前沿的端到端目标检测器，在保持高精度的同时提供实时性能。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Baidu's RT-DETR: A Vision Transformer -Based Real-Time Object Detector", para. 1 Key Features 主要特性 (No definition) （无定义） Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features" Efficient Hybrid Encoder 高效混合编码器 "Efficient Hybrid Encoder: Baidu's RT-DETR uses an efficient hybrid encoder that processes multiscale features by decoupling intra-scale interaction and cross-scale fusion." 高效混合编码器：百度的 RT-DETR 使用一种高效混合编码器，它通过解耦尺度内交互和跨尺度融合来处理多尺度特征。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features", item 1 IoU-aware Query Selection IoU 感知的查询选择 "IoU-aware Query Selection: Baidu's RT-DETR improves object query initialization by utilizing IoU-aware query selection." IoU 感知的查询选择：百度的 RT-DETR 利用 IoU 感知的查询选择来改进目标查询的初始化。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features", item 2 Adaptable Inference Speed 可调的推理速度 "Adaptable Inference Speed: Baidu's RT-DETR supports flexible adjustments of inference speed by using different decoder layers without the need for retraining." 可调的推理速度：百度的 RT-DETR 支持通过使用不同的解码器层来灵活调整推理速度，而无需重新训练。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features", item 3 NMS-Free Framework 免 NMS 框架 "NMS-Free Framework: Based on DETR, RT-DETR eliminates the need for non-maximum suppression post-processing" 免 NMS 框架：基于 DETR，RT-DETR 消除了对非极大值抑制后处理的需要 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features", item 4 Anchor-Free Detection 无锚框检测 "Anchor-Free Detection: As an anchor-free detector, RT-DETR simplifies the detection process and may improve generalization across different datasets." 无锚框检测：作为无锚框检测器，RT-DETR 简化了检测过程，并可能改善在不同数据集上的泛化能力。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features", item 5 Pretrained Models 预训练模型 (context) "The Ultralytics Python API provides pretrained PaddlePaddle RT-DETR models with different scales:" （语境）Ultralytics Python API 提供了不同规模的 PaddlePaddle 预训练 RT-DETR 模型： Ultralytics, n.d., "Pretrained Models", para. 1 RT-DETR-L RT-DETR-L (context) "RT-DETR-L: 53.0% AP on COCO val2017, 114 FPS on T4 GPU" （语境）RT-DETR-L 的成绩是在 COCO val2017 上 AP 为 53.0%，在 T4 GPU 上 114 FPS Ultralytics, n.d., "Pretrained Models", item 1 RT-DETR-X RT-DETR-X (context) "RT-DETR-X: 54.8% AP on COCO val2017, 74 FPS on T4 GPU" （语境）RT-DETR-X 的成绩是在 COCO val2017 上 AP 为 54.8%，在 T4 GPU 上 74 FPS Ultralytics, n.d., "Pretrained Models", item 2 RTDETRv2 RTDETRv2 "Additionally, Baidu has released RTDETRv2 in July 2024, which further improves upon the original architecture with enhanced performance metrics." 此外，百度于 2024 年 7 月发布了 RTDETRv2，它在原有架构的基础上进一步改进，性能指标更高。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Pretrained Models", para. 2 References Ultralytics. (n.d.). Baidu's RT-DETR: A Vision Transformer -Based Real-Time Object Detector. Ultralytics YOLO Docs (ultralytics 8.4.194). Retrieved October 31, 2026, from https://docs.ultralytics.com/models/rtdetr/

ai/ultralytics-yolo/models/sam-2-segment.title: 3.13 SAM 2 (Segment Anything Model 2) | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
ai/ultralytics-yolo/models/sam-2-segment.summary: 3.13 SAM 2 (Segment Anything Model 2) Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 3.13 SAM 2 (Segment Anything Model 2) SAM 2（分割一切模型 2） "SAM 2 builds upon the original SAM with video segmentation capabilities." SAM 2 在原始 SAM 的基础上增加了视频分割能力。 Ultralytics, n.d., "SAM 2: Segment Anything Model 2", para. 1 Key Features 主要特性 (No definition) （无定义） Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features" Unified Model Architecture 统一的模型架构 "SAM 2 combines the capabilities of image and video segmentation in a single model." SAM 2 在单个模型中结合了图像分割和视频分割的能力。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Unified Model Architecture", para. 1 Real-Time Performance 实时性能 "The model achieves real-time inference speeds, processing approximately 44 frames per second." 该模型达到实时推理速度，每秒约处理 44 帧。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Real-Time Performance", para. 1 Zero-Shot Generalization 零样本泛化 "SAM 2 can segment objects it has never encountered before, demonstrating strong zero-shot generalization." SAM 2 能够分割从未见过的物体，体现出很强的零样本泛化能力。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Zero-Shot Generalization", para. 1 Interactive Refinement 交互式细化 "Users can iteratively refine the segmentation results by providing additional prompts, allowing for precise control over the output." 用户可以通过提供额外的提示来迭代地细化分割结果，从而精确控制输出。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Interactive Refinement", para. 1 Advanced Handling of Visual Challenges 视觉难题的高级处理 "SAM 2 includes mechanisms to manage common video segmentation challenges, such as object occlusion and reappearance." SAM 2 包含应对常见视频分割难题（如物体遮挡和重新出现）的机制。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Advanced Handling of Visual Challenges", para. 1 Model Architecture 模型架构 (No definition) （无定义） Ultralytics, n.d., "Model Architecture" Core Components 核心组件 (No definition) （无定义） Ultralytics, n.d., "Core Components" Image and Video Encoder 图像与视频编码器 "Image and Video Encoder: Utilizes a transformer-based architecture to extract high-level features from both images and video frames." 图像与视频编码器使用基于 Transformer 的架构，从图像和视频帧中提取高层特征。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Core Components", item 1 Prompt Encoder 提示编码器 "Prompt Encoder: Processes user-provided prompts (points, boxes, masks) to guide the segmentation task." 提示编码器处理用户提供的提示（点、框、掩码），以引导分割任务。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Core Components", item 2 Memory Mechanism 记忆机制 "Memory Mechanism: Includes a memory encoder, memory bank, and memory attention module." 记忆机制包括记忆编码器、记忆库和记忆注意力模块。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Core Components", item 3 Mask Decoder 掩码解码器 "Mask Decoder: Generates the final segmentation masks based on the encoded image features and prompts." 掩码解码器根据编码后的图像特征和提示生成最终的分割掩码。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Core Components", item 4 Memory Mechanism and Occlusion Handling 记忆机制与遮挡处理 "The memory mechanism allows SAM 2 to handle temporal dependencies and occlusions in video data." 记忆机制使 SAM 2 能够处理视频数据中的时间依赖和遮挡。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Memory Mechanism and Occlusion Handling", para. 1 Multi-Mask Ambiguity Resolution 多掩码歧义消解 "In situations with ambiguity (e.g., overlapping objects), SAM 2 can generate multiple mask predictions." 在存在歧义的情况下（例如物体重叠），SAM 2 可以生成多个掩码预测。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Multi-Mask Ambiguity Resolution", para. 1 SA-V Dataset SA-V 数据集 "The SA-V dataset, developed for SAM 2's training, is one of the largest and most diverse video segmentation datasets available." SA-V 数据集为训练 SAM 2 而开发，是现有规模最大、最多样的视频分割数据集之一。 Ultralytics, n.d., "SA-V Dataset", para. 1 Dynamic Interactive Segment and Track 动态交互式分割与跟踪 "SAM2DynamicInteractivePredictor is an advanced training-free extension of SAM 2 that enables dynamic interaction with multiple frames and continual learning capabilities." SAM2DynamicInteractivePredictor 是 SAM 2 的一个无需训练的高级扩展，支持与多帧进行动态交互，并具备持续学习能力。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Dynamic Interactive Segment and Track", para. 1 Key Features 主要特性 (context) "It offers three significant enhancements:" （语境）它提供了三项重要增强： Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features", para. 1 Dynamic Interactive 动态交互 "Dynamic Interactive: Add new prompts for merging/untracked new instances in following frames anytime during video processing" 动态交互指在视频处理期间随时为后续帧中要合并的或未跟踪的新实例添加新提示 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features", item 1 Continual Learning 持续学习 "Continual Learning: Add new prompts for existing instances to improve the model performance over time" 持续学习指为已有实例添加新提示，随时间推移提升模型性能 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features", item 2 Independent Multi-Image Support 独立多图像支持 "Independent Multi-Image Support: Process multiple independent images (not necessarily from a video sequence) with memory sharing and cross-image object tracking" 独立多图像支持指借助记忆共享和跨图像目标跟踪，处理多张相互独立的图像（不一定来自视频序列） Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features", item 3 Core Capabilities 核心能力 (No definition) （无定义） Ultralytics, n.d., "Core Capabilities" Prompt Flexibility 提示灵活性 "Prompt Flexibility: Accepts bounding boxes, points, and masks as prompts" 提示灵活性指接受边界框、点和掩码作为提示 Ultralytics, n.d., "Core Capabilities", item 1 Memory Bank Management 记忆库管理 "Memory Bank Management: Maintains a dynamic memory bank to store object states across frames" 记忆库管理指维护一个动态记忆库，跨帧存储物体状态 Ultralytics, n.d., "Core Capabilities", item 2 Multi-Object Tracking 多目标跟踪 "Multi-Object Tracking: Supports tracking multiple objects simultaneously with individual object IDs" 多目标跟踪指支持用各自的物体 ID 同时跟踪多个物体 Ultralytics, n.d., "Core Capabilities", item 3 Real-Time Updates 实时更新 "Real-Time Updates: Allows adding new prompts during inference without reprocessing previous frames" 实时更新指允许在推理过程中添加新提示，而无需重新处理之前的帧 Ultralytics, n.d., "Core Capabilities", item 4 Independent Image Processing 独立图像处理 "Independent Image Processing: Process standalone images with shared memory context for cross-image object consistency" 独立图像处理指借助共享的记忆上下文处理独立图像，保持跨图像的物体一致性 Ultralytics, n.d., "Core Capabilities", item 5 Auto-Annotation: Efficient Dataset Creation 自动标注：高效创建数据集 "Auto-annotation is a powerful feature of SAM 2, enabling users to generate segmentation datasets quickly and accurately by leveraging pretrained models." 自动标注是 SAM 2 的一项强大功能，让用户能借助预训练模型快速而准确地生成分割数据集。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Auto-Annotation: Efficient Dataset Creation", para. 1 References Ultralytics. (n.d.). SAM 2: Segment Anything Model 2. Ultralytics YOLO Docs (ultralytics 8.4.194). Retrieved October 31, 2026, from https://docs.ultralytics.com/models/sam-2/

ai/ultralytics-yolo/models/sam-3-segment.title: 3.12 SAM 3 (Segment Anything Model 3) | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
ai/ultralytics-yolo/models/sam-3-segment.summary: 3.12 SAM 3 (Segment Anything Model 3) Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 3.12 SAM 3 (Segment Anything Model 3) SAM 3（分割一切模型 3） "SAM 3 (Segment Anything Model 3) is Meta's released foundation model for Promptable Concept Segmentation (PCS)." SAM 3（分割一切模型 3）是 Meta 发布的、用于可提示概念分割（PCS）的基础模型。 Ultralytics, n.d., "SAM 3: Segment Anything with Concepts", para. 1 Promptable Concept Segmentation (PCS) 可提示概念分割（PCS） "The PCS task takes a concept prompt as input and returns segmentation masks with unique identities for all matching object instances." PCS 任务以概念提示为输入，为所有匹配的物体实例返回带有唯一身份的分割掩码。 Ultralytics, n.d., "What is Promptable Concept Segmentation (PCS)?", para. 1 Text 文本 "Text: Simple noun phrases like "red apple" or "person wearing a hat", similar to zero-shot learning" 文本指简单的名词短语，例如“red apple”或“person wearing a hat”，类似于零样本学习 Ultralytics, n.d., "What is Promptable Concept Segmentation (PCS)?", item 1 Image exemplars 图像示例 "Image exemplars: Bounding boxes around example objects (positive or negative) for fast generalization" 图像示例指围住示例物体（正例或负例）的边界框，用于快速泛化 Ultralytics, n.d., "What is Promptable Concept Segmentation (PCS)?", item 2 Combined 组合 "Combined: Both text and image exemplars together for precise control" 组合指文本和图像示例一起使用，以实现精确控制 Ultralytics, n.d., "What is Promptable Concept Segmentation (PCS)?", item 3 SAM 3.1 SAM 3.1 "SAM 3.1, released by Meta on March 27, 2026, is a new SAM 3 checkpoint that adds Object Multiplex, a shared-memory approach to multi-object video tracking." SAM 3.1 由 Meta 于 2026 年 3 月 27 日发布，是一个新的 SAM 3 检查点，它加入了 Object Multiplex，一种用于多目标视频跟踪的共享内存方法。 Ultralytics, n.d., "SAM 3.1", para. 1 Object Multiplex Object Multiplex（对象多路复用） "Instead of processing every tracked object independently, SAM 3.1 groups objects into fixed-capacity buckets and processes them jointly" SAM 3.1 不再独立处理每个被跟踪的物体，而是把物体分组放入固定容量的桶中并联合处理 Ultralytics, n.d., "SAM 3.1", para. 1 Architecture 架构 "SAM 3 consists of a detector and tracker that share a Perception Encoder (PE) vision backbone." SAM 3 由共用一个感知编码器（PE）视觉骨干网络的检测器和跟踪器组成。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Architecture", para. 1 Core Components 核心组件 (No definition) （无定义） Ultralytics, n.d., "Core Components" Detector 检测器 "Detector: DETR-based architecture for image-level concept detection" 检测器是用于图像级概念检测的基于 DETR 的架构 Ultralytics, n.d., "Core Components", item 1 Tracker 跟踪器 "Tracker: Memory-based video segmentation inherited from SAM 2" 跟踪器是继承自 SAM 2 的基于记忆的视频分割 Ultralytics, n.d., "Core Components", item 2 Presence Token 存在标记 "Presence Token: A learned global token that predicts whether the target concept is present in the image/frame, improving detection by separating recognition from localization." 存在标记是一个学习得到的全局标记，用来预测目标概念是否出现在图像或帧中，通过把识别与定位分开来改进检测。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Core Components", item 3 Key Innovations 关键创新 (No definition) （无定义） Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Innovations" Decoupled Recognition and Localization 识别与定位解耦 "Decoupled Recognition and Localization: The presence head predicts concept presence globally, while proposal queries focus only on localization, avoiding conflicting objectives." 识别与定位解耦指存在头在全局预测概念是否存在，而提议查询只专注于定位，避免目标相互冲突。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Innovations", item 1 Unified Concept and Visual Prompts 统一的概念提示与视觉提示 "Unified Concept and Visual Prompts: Supports both PCS (concept prompts) and PVS (visual prompts like SAM 2's clicks/boxes) in a single model." 统一的概念提示与视觉提示指在单个模型中同时支持 PCS（概念提示）和 PVS（像 SAM 2 的点击或框那样的视觉提示）。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Innovations", item 2 Interactive Exemplar Refinement 交互式示例细化 "Interactive Exemplar Refinement: Users can add positive or negative image exemplars to iteratively refine results" 交互式示例细化指用户可以添加正例或负例图像示例来迭代地细化结果 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Innovations", item 3 Temporal Disambiguation 时间消歧 "Temporal Disambiguation: Uses masklet detection scores and periodic re-prompting to handle occlusions, crowded scenes, and tracking failures in video" 时间消歧指使用掩码片段检测分数和周期性重新提示来处理视频中的遮挡、拥挤场景和跟踪失败 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Innovations", item 4 SA-Co Dataset SA-Co 数据集 "SAM 3 is trained on Segment Anything with Concepts (SA-Co), Meta's largest and most diverse segmentation dataset to date" SAM 3 在 Segment Anything with Concepts（SA-Co）上训练，它是 Meta 迄今规模最大、最多样的分割数据集 Ultralytics, n.d., "SA-Co Dataset", para. 1 Training Data 训练数据 (No definition) （无定义） Ultralytics, n.d., "Training Data" SA-Co/HQ SA-Co/HQ "High-quality human-annotated image data from 4-phase data engine" 来自四阶段数据引擎的高质量人工标注图像数据 Ultralytics, n.d., "Training Data", table, row 1 SA-Co/SYN SA-Co/SYN "Synthetic dataset labeled by AI without human involvement" 由 AI 在无人参与的情况下标注的合成数据集 Ultralytics, n.d., "Training Data", table, row 2 SA-Co/EXT SA-Co/EXT "15 external datasets enriched with hard negatives" 15 个用困难负例充实过的外部数据集 Ultralytics, n.d., "Training Data", table, row 3 SA-Co/VIDEO SA-Co/VIDEO "Video annotations with temporal tracking" 带有时间跟踪的视频标注 Ultralytics, n.d., "Training Data", table, row 4 Benchmark Data 基准数据 (context) "The SA-Co evaluation benchmark contains 214K unique phrases across 126K images and videos" （语境）SA-Co 评估基准包含分布在 12.6 万张图像和视频中的 21.4 万个不同短语 Ultralytics, n.d., "Benchmark Data", para. 1 SA-Co/Gold SA-Co/Gold "SA-Co/Gold: 7 domains, triple-annotated for measuring human performance bounds" SA-Co/Gold：7 个领域，三重标注，用于衡量人类表现的界限 Ultralytics, n.d., "Benchmark Data", item 1 SA-Co/Silver SA-Co/Silver "SA-Co/Silver: 10 domains, single human annotation" SA-Co/Silver：10 个领域，单次人工标注 Ultralytics, n.d., "Benchmark Data", item 2 SA-Co/Bronze and SA-Co/Bio SA-Co/Bronze 与 SA-Co/Bio "SA-Co/Bronze and SA-Co/Bio: 9 existing datasets adapted for concept segmentation" SA-Co/Bronze 与 SA-Co/Bio：9 个为概念分割改编的现有数据集 Ultralytics, n.d., "Benchmark Data", item 3 SA-Co/VEval SA-Co/VEval "SA-Co/VEval: Video benchmark with 3 domains (SA-V, YT-Temporal-1B, SmartGlasses)" SA-Co/VEval 是包含 3 个领域（SA-V、YT-Temporal-1B、SmartGlasses）的视频基准 Ultralytics, n.d., "Benchmark Data", item 4 Data Engine Innovations 数据引擎创新 (context) "SAM 3's scalable human- and model-in-the-loop data engine achieves 2× annotation throughput through:" （语境）SAM 3 的可扩展、人与模型共同参与的数据引擎通过以下方式实现了 2 倍的标注吞吐量： Ultralytics, n.d., "Data Engine Innovations", para. 1 AI Annotators AI 标注器 "AI Annotators: Llama based models propose diverse noun phrases including hard negatives" AI 标注器指基于 Llama 的模型提出多样的名词短语，包括困难负例 Ultralytics, n.d., "Data Engine Innovations", item 1 AI Verifiers AI 校验器 "AI Verifiers: Fine-tuned multimodal LLMs verify mask quality and exhaustivity at near-human performance" AI 校验器指微调过的多模态大语言模型以接近人类的水平校验掩码质量和完备性 Ultralytics, n.d., "Data Engine Innovations", item 2 Active Mining 主动挖掘 "Active Mining: Focuses human effort on challenging failure cases where AI struggles" 主动挖掘指把人工精力集中在 AI 难以处理的困难失败案例上 Ultralytics, n.d., "Data Engine Innovations", item 3 Ontology-Driven 本体驱动 "Ontology-Driven: Leverages a large ontology grounded in Wikidata for concept coverage" 本体驱动指利用一个以 Wikidata 为基础的大型本体来覆盖概念 Ultralytics, n.d., "Data Engine Innovations", item 4 Evaluation Metrics 评估指标 (context) "SAM 3 introduces new metrics designed for the PCS task, complementing familiar measures like F1 score, precision, and recall." （语境）SAM 3 引入了为 PCS 任务设计的新指标，作为 F1 分数、精确率和召回率等常见度量的补充。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Evaluation Metrics", para. 1 Classification-Gated F1 (CGF1) 分类门控 F1（CGF1） "The primary metric combining localization and classification:" 结合定位与分类的主要指标： Ultralytics, n.d., "Classification-Gated F1 (CGF1)", para. 1 pmF1 pmF1（正样本宏平均 F1） "pmF1 (Positive Macro F1): Measures localization quality on positive examples" pmF1（正样本宏平均 F1）用于衡量正样本上的定位质量 Ultralytics, n.d., "Classification-Gated F1 (CGF1)", item 1 IL_MCC IL_MCC（图像级马修斯相关系数） "IL_MCC (Image-Level Matthews Correlation Coefficient): Measures binary classification accuracy" IL_MCC（图像级马修斯相关系数）用于衡量二分类准确率 Ultralytics, n.d., "Classification-Gated F1 (CGF1)", item 2 SAM 3 Agent: Extended Language Reasoning SAM 3 Agent：扩展的语言推理 "SAM 3 can be combined with Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to handle complex queries requiring reasoning" SAM 3 可以与多模态大语言模型（MLLM）结合，用来处理需要推理的复杂查询 Ultralytics, n.d., "SAM 3 Agent: Extended Language Reasoning", para. 1 References Ultralytics. (n.d.). SAM 3: Segment Anything with Concepts. Ultralytics YOLO Docs (ultralytics 8.4.194). Retrieved October 31, 2026, from https://docs.ultralytics.com/models/sam-3/

ai/ultralytics-yolo/models/sam-segment-a.title: 3.14 SAM (Segment Anything Model) | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
ai/ultralytics-yolo/models/sam-segment-a.summary: 3.14 SAM (Segment Anything Model) Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 3.14 SAM (Segment Anything Model) SAM（分割一切模型） "This is the original SAM model from Meta." 这是 Meta 推出的原始 SAM 模型。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Segment Anything Model (SAM)", para. 1 Key Features of the Segment Anything Model (SAM) Segment Anything Model（SAM）的主要特性 (No definition) （无定义） Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features of the Segment Anything Model (SAM)" Promptable Segmentation Task 可提示分割任务 "Promptable Segmentation Task: SAM was designed with a promptable segmentation task in mind, allowing it to generate valid segmentation masks from any given prompt, such as spatial or text clues identifying an object." 可提示分割任务：SAM 在设计时就以可提示分割任务为目标，这使它能根据任何给定的提示生成有效的分割掩码，例如标识物体的空间线索或文本线索。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features of the Segment Anything Model (SAM)", item 1 Advanced Architecture 先进的架构 "Advanced Architecture: The Segment Anything Model employs a powerful image encoder, a prompt encoder, and a lightweight mask decoder." 先进的架构：Segment Anything Model 采用强大的图像编码器、提示编码器和轻量级掩码解码器。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features of the Segment Anything Model (SAM)", item 2 The SA-1B Dataset SA-1B 数据集 "The SA-1B Dataset: Introduced by the Segment Anything project, the SA-1B dataset features over 1 billion masks on 11 million images." SA-1B 数据集：SA-1B 数据集由 Segment Anything 项目推出，它在 1100 万张图像上包含超过 10 亿个掩码。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features of the Segment Anything Model (SAM)", item 3 Zero-Shot Performance 零样本性能 "Zero-Shot Performance: SAM displays outstanding zero-shot performance across various segmentation tasks" 零样本性能：SAM 在各种分割任务上表现出出色的零样本性能 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features of the Segment Anything Model (SAM)", item 4 Auto-Annotation: A Quick Path to Segmentation Datasets 自动标注：快速获得分割数据集 "Auto-annotation is a key feature of SAM, allowing users to generate a segmentation dataset using a pretrained detection model." 自动标注是 SAM 的一项关键功能，让用户能用预训练的检测模型生成分割数据集。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Auto-Annotation: A Quick Path to Segmentation Datasets", para. 1 References Ultralytics. (n.d.). Segment Anything Model (SAM). Ultralytics YOLO Docs (ultralytics 8.4.194). Retrieved October 31, 2026, from https://docs.ultralytics.com/models/sam/

ai/ultralytics-yolo/models/ultralytics-l.summary: 3.21 Ultralytics LLM Interface Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 3.21 Ultralytics LLM Interface Ultralytics LLM 接口 "LLM is a small interface for calling language and vision models through an OpenAI-compatible API." LLM 是一个小型接口，通过兼容 OpenAI 的 API 调用语言模型和视觉模型。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Ultralytics LLM Interface", para. 1 Responses API Responses API (context) "The Responses API is the default." （语境）Responses API 是默认选项。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Responses API", para. 1 Multimodal Input 多模态输入 (context) "Pass a path, HTTP URL, data URI, NumPy array, or PIL image through image:" （语境）可以通过 image 传入路径、HTTP URL、data URI、NumPy 数组或 PIL 图像： Ultralytics, n.d., "Multimodal Input", para. 1 Chat Completions Chat Completions (context) "Select Chat Completions when required by the endpoint, and read its native response shape:" （语境）在端点要求时选择 Chat Completions，并读取其原生的响应结构： Ultralytics, n.d., "Chat Completions", para. 1 Streaming and Async Calls 流式与异步调用 (context) "SDK request arguments pass through unchanged, including stream=True:" （语境）所有 SDK 请求参数原样传递，包括 stream=True： Ultralytics, n.d., "Streaming and Async Calls", para. 1 OpenAI-Compatible Providers 兼容 OpenAI 的提供方 "LLM works with providers that expose an OpenAI-compatible Responses or Chat Completions API, including DeepSeek, Kimi, Z.AI GLM, and OpenRouter." LLM 可与提供 OpenAI 兼容的 Responses 或 Chat Completions API 的服务商配合使用，包括 DeepSeek、Kimi、Z.AI GLM 和 OpenRouter。 Ultralytics, n.d., "OpenAI-Compatible Providers", para. 1 References Ultralytics. (n.d.). Ultralytics LLM Interface. Ultralytics YOLO Docs (ultralytics 8.4.194). Retrieved October 31, 2026, from https://docs.ultralytics.com/models/llm/

ai/ultralytics-yolo/models/yolo-nas-neur.summary: 3.17 YOLO-NAS (Neural Architecture Search) Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 3.17 YOLO-NAS (Neural Architecture Search) YOLO-NAS（神经架构搜索） "Developed by Deci AI, YOLO-NAS is a groundbreaking object detection foundational model." YOLO-NAS 由 Deci AI 开发，是一个开创性的目标检测基础模型。 Ultralytics, n.d., "YOLO-NAS", para. 2 Key Features 主要特性 (No definition) （无定义） Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features" Quantization-Friendly Basic Block 量化友好的基本模块 "Quantization-Friendly Basic Block: YOLO-NAS introduces a new basic block that is friendly to quantization" 量化友好的基本模块：YOLO-NAS 引入了一种对量化友好的新基本模块 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features", item 1 Sophisticated Training and Quantization 精细的训练与量化 "Sophisticated Training and Quantization: YOLO-NAS leverages advanced training schemes and post-training quantization to enhance performance." 精细的训练与量化：YOLO-NAS 利用先进的训练方案和训练后量化来提升性能。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features", item 2 AutoNAC Optimization and Pre-training AutoNAC 优化与预训练 "AutoNAC Optimization and Pre-training: YOLO-NAS utilizes AutoNAC optimization and is pretrained on prominent datasets such as COCO, Objects365, and Roboflow 100." AutoNAC 优化与预训练：YOLO-NAS 使用 AutoNAC 优化，并在 COCO、Objects365 和 Roboflow 100 等知名数据集上预训练。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features", item 3 Supported Tasks and Modes 支持的任务与模式 (context) "We offer three variants of the YOLO-NAS models: Small (s), Medium (m), and Large (l)." （语境）我们提供 YOLO-NAS 模型的三个变体：Small（s）、Medium（m）和 Large（l）。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Supported Tasks and Modes", para. 1 YOLO-NAS-s YOLO-NAS-s "YOLO-NAS-s: Optimized for environments where computational resources are limited but efficiency is key." YOLO-NAS-s 为计算资源有限但效率关键的环境优化。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Supported Tasks and Modes", item 1 YOLO-NAS-m YOLO-NAS-m "YOLO-NAS-m: Offers a balanced approach, suitable for general-purpose object detection with higher accuracy." YOLO-NAS-m 提供一种平衡的方案，适用于精度更高的通用目标检测。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Supported Tasks and Modes", item 2 YOLO-NAS-l YOLO-NAS-l "YOLO-NAS-l: Tailored for scenarios requiring the highest accuracy, where computational resources are less of a constraint." YOLO-NAS-l 为需要最高精度、计算资源约束较小的场景定制。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Supported Tasks and Modes", item 3 References Ultralytics. (n.d.). YOLO-NAS. Ultralytics YOLO Docs (ultralytics 8.4.194). Retrieved October 31, 2026, from https://docs.ultralytics.com/models/yolo-nas/

ai/ultralytics-yolo/models/yolo-world.ht.title: 3.19 YOLO-World | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
ai/ultralytics-yolo/models/yolo-world.ht.summary: 3.19 YOLO-World Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 3.19 YOLO-World YOLO-World "The YOLO-World Model introduces an advanced, real-time Ultralytics YOLOv8-based approach for Open-Vocabulary Detection tasks." YOLO-World 模型提出了一种先进的、基于 Ultralytics YOLOv8 的实时方法，用于开放词汇检测任务。 Ultralytics, n.d., "YOLO-World Model", para. 1 Key Features 主要特性 (No definition) （无定义） Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features" Real-time Solution 实时解决方案 "Real-time Solution: Harnessing the computational speed of CNNs, YOLO-World delivers a swift open-vocabulary detection solution" 实时解决方案：借助 CNN 的计算速度，YOLO-World 提供了一种快速的开放词汇检测方案 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features", item 1 Efficiency and Performance 效率与性能 "Efficiency and Performance: YOLO-World slashes computational and resource requirements without sacrificing performance" 效率与性能：YOLO-World 在不牺牲性能的前提下大幅削减计算和资源需求 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features", item 2 Inference with Offline Vocabulary 使用离线词表推理 "Inference with Offline Vocabulary: YOLO-World introduces a "prompt-then-detect" strategy, employing an offline vocabulary to enhance efficiency further." 使用离线词表推理：YOLO-World 引入“先提示后检测”策略，它使用离线词表进一步提高效率。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features", item 3 Powered by YOLOv8 基于 YOLOv8 "Powered by YOLOv8: Built upon Ultralytics YOLOv8, YOLO-World leverages the latest advancements in real-time object detection to facilitate open-vocabulary detection with unparalleled accuracy and speed." 基于 YOLOv8：YOLO-World 构建在 Ultralytics YOLOv8 之上，利用实时目标检测的最新进展，以无与伦比的精度和速度实现开放词汇检测。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features", item 4 Set prompts 设置提示 "The YOLO-World framework allows for the dynamic specification of classes through custom prompts, empowering users to tailor the model to their specific needs without retraining." YOLO-World 框架允许通过自定义提示动态指定类别，让用户无需重新训练就能按自身需求定制模型。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Set prompts", para. 1 References Ultralytics. (n.d.). YOLO-World Model. Ultralytics YOLO Docs (ultralytics 8.4.194). Retrieved October 31, 2026, from https://docs.ultralytics.com/models/yolo-world/

ai/ultralytics-yolo/models/yolo11.html.summary: 3.3 YOLO11 Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 3.3 YOLO11 YOLO11 (context) "Released September 2024. Current stable release and the recommended choice for all use cases." （语境）2024 年 9 月发布。当前的稳定版本，所有用例的推荐选择。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Ultralytics YOLO11", para. 1 Key Features 主要特性 (No definition) （无定义） Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features" Enhanced Feature Extraction 增强的特征提取 "Enhanced Feature Extraction: YOLO11 employs an improved backbone and neck architecture, which enhances feature extraction capabilities for more precise object detection and complex task performance." 增强的特征提取：YOLO11 采用改进的骨干网络和颈部架构，增强了特征提取能力，使目标检测更精确、复杂任务表现更好。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features", item 1 Optimized for Efficiency and Speed 针对效率与速度优化 "Optimized for Efficiency and Speed: YOLO11 introduces refined architectural designs and optimized training pipelines, delivering faster processing speeds and maintaining an optimal balance between accuracy and performance." 针对效率与速度优化：YOLO11 引入了改进的架构设计和优化的训练流水线，带来更快的处理速度，并在精度与性能之间保持最佳平衡。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features", item 2 Greater Accuracy with Fewer Parameters 更少参数、更高精度 "Greater Accuracy with Fewer Parameters: With advancements in model design, YOLO11m achieves a higher mean Average Precision (mAP) on the COCO dataset while using 22% fewer parameters than YOLOv8m, making it computationally efficient without compromising accuracy." 更少参数、更高精度：凭借模型设计上的进步，YOLO11m 在 COCO 数据集上取得更高的平均精度均值（mAP），而参数比 YOLOv8m 少 22%，在不牺牲精度的情况下实现计算高效。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features", item 3 Adaptability Across Environments 跨环境适应性 "Adaptability Across Environments: YOLO11 can be seamlessly deployed across various environments, including edge devices, cloud platforms, and systems supporting NVIDIA GPUs, ensuring maximum flexibility." 跨环境适应性：YOLO11 可以无缝部署到各种环境中，包括边缘设备、云平台和支持 NVIDIA GPU 的系统，确保最大的灵活性。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features", item 4 Broad Range of Supported Tasks 广泛的任务支持 "Broad Range of Supported Tasks: Whether it's object detection, instance segmentation, image classification, pose estimation, or oriented object detection (OBB), YOLO11 is designed to cater to a diverse set of computer vision challenges." 广泛的任务支持：无论是目标检测、实例分割、图像分类、姿态估计还是旋转目标检测（OBB），YOLO11 都旨在应对各种计算机视觉挑战。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features", item 5 References Ultralytics. (n.d.). Ultralytics YOLO11. Ultralytics YOLO Docs (ultralytics 8.4.194). Retrieved October 31, 2026, from https://docs.ultralytics.com/models/yolo11/

ai/ultralytics-yolo/models/yolo12.html.title: 3.2 YOLO12 | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
ai/ultralytics-yolo/models/yolo12.html.summary: 3.2 YOLO12 Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 3.2 YOLO12 YOLO12 "YOLO12, released in early 2025, introduces an attention-centric architecture that departs from the traditional CNN-based approaches used in previous YOLO models, yet retains the real-time inference speed essential for many applications." YOLO12 于 2025 年初发布，引入了以注意力为中心的架构，不同于以往 YOLO 模型使用的传统 CNN 方法，同时保留了许多应用所需的实时推理速度。 Ultralytics, n.d., "YOLO12: Attention-Centric Object Detection", para. 1 Key Features 主要特性 (No definition) （无定义） Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features" Area Attention Mechanism 区域注意力机制 "Area Attention Mechanism: A new self-attention approach that processes large receptive fields efficiently." 区域注意力机制是一种高效处理大感受野的新型自注意力方法。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features", item 1 Residual Efficient Layer Aggregation Networks (R-ELAN) 残差高效层聚合网络（R-ELAN） "Residual Efficient Layer Aggregation Networks (R-ELAN): An improved feature aggregation module based on ELAN, designed to address optimization challenges, especially in larger-scale attention-centric models." 残差高效层聚合网络（R-ELAN）是一种基于 ELAN 的改进特征聚合模块，用于解决优化难题，尤其是在更大规模、以注意力为中心的模型中。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features", item 2 Optimized Attention Architecture 优化的注意力架构 "Optimized Attention Architecture: YOLO12 streamlines the standard attention mechanism for greater efficiency and compatibility with the YOLO framework." 优化的注意力架构：YOLO12 精简了标准注意力机制，使其更高效，并与 YOLO 框架更兼容。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features", item 3 Comprehensive Task Support 全面的任务支持 "Comprehensive Task Support: YOLO12 supports a range of core computer vision tasks: object detection, instance segmentation, image classification, pose estimation, and oriented object detection (OBB)." 全面的任务支持：YOLO12 支持一系列核心计算机视觉任务：目标检测、实例分割、图像分类、姿态估计和旋转目标检测（OBB）。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features", item 4 Enhanced Efficiency 效率提升 "Enhanced Efficiency: Achieves higher accuracy with fewer parameters compared to many prior models, demonstrating an improved balance between speed and accuracy." 效率提升体现在与许多先前的模型相比，用更少的参数达到更高的精度，体现出速度与精度之间更好的平衡。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features", item 5 Flexible Deployment 灵活部署 "Flexible Deployment: Designed for deployment across diverse platforms, from edge devices to cloud infrastructure." 灵活部署指为在从边缘设备到云基础设施的各种平台上部署而设计。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features", item 6 Key Improvements 主要改进 (No definition) （无定义） Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Improvements" Enhanced Feature Extraction 增强的特征提取 (No definition) （无定义） Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Improvements" Area Attention 区域注意力 "Area Attention: Efficiently handles large receptive fields, reducing computational cost." 区域注意力高效处理大感受野，降低计算成本。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Improvements", Enhanced Feature Extraction, item 1 Optimized Balance 优化的平衡 "Optimized Balance: Improved balance between attention and feed-forward network computations." 优化的平衡指改进了注意力计算与前馈网络计算之间的平衡。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Improvements", Enhanced Feature Extraction, item 2 R-ELAN R-ELAN "R-ELAN: Enhances feature aggregation using the R-ELAN architecture." R-ELAN 使用 R-ELAN 架构增强特征聚合。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Improvements", Enhanced Feature Extraction, item 3 Optimization Innovations 优化创新 (No definition) （无定义） Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Improvements" Residual Connections 残差连接 "Residual Connections: Introduces residual connections with scaling to stabilize training, especially in larger models." 残差连接指引入带缩放的残差连接来稳定训练，在较大的模型中尤其如此。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Improvements", Optimization Innovations, item 1 Refined Feature Integration 改进的特征整合 "Refined Feature Integration: Implements an improved method for feature integration within R-ELAN." 改进的特征整合指在 R-ELAN 中实现一种改进的特征整合方法。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Improvements", Optimization Innovations, item 2 FlashAttention FlashAttention "FlashAttention: Incorporates FlashAttention to reduce memory access overhead." FlashAttention 引入 FlashAttention 以减少内存访问开销。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Improvements", Optimization Innovations, item 3 Architectural Efficiency 架构效率 (No definition) （无定义） Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Improvements" Reduced Parameters 更少的参数 "Reduced Parameters: Achieves a lower parameter count while maintaining or improving accuracy compared to many previous models." 更少的参数：与许多先前的模型相比，它在保持或提高精度的同时参数量更少。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Improvements", Architectural Efficiency, item 1 Streamlined Attention 精简的注意力 "Streamlined Attention: Uses a simplified attention implementation, avoiding positional encoding." 精简的注意力指使用简化的注意力实现，不用位置编码。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Improvements", Architectural Efficiency, item 2 Optimized MLP Ratios 优化的 MLP 比率 "Optimized MLP Ratios: Adjusts MLP ratios to more effectively allocate computational resources." 优化的 MLP 比率指调整 MLP 比率，以更有效地分配计算资源。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Improvements", Architectural Efficiency, item 3 References Ultralytics. (n.d.). YOLO12: Attention-Centric Object Detection. Ultralytics YOLO Docs (ultralytics 8.4.194). Retrieved October 31, 2026, from https://docs.ultralytics.com/models/yolo12/

ai/ultralytics-yolo/models/yolo26.html.title: 3.1 YOLO26 | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
ai/ultralytics-yolo/models/yolo26.html.summary: 3.1 YOLO26 Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 3.1 YOLO26 YOLO26 "YOLO26 is a unified family of real-time vision models described in the Ultralytics YOLO26 paper." YOLO26 是 Ultralytics YOLO26 论文中描述的一个统一的实时视觉模型家族。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Ultralytics YOLO26", para. 1 Key Features 主要特性 (No definition) （无定义） Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features" DFL-Free Regression 无 DFL 回归 "DFL-Free Regression YOLO26 removes Distribution Focal Loss (DFL), reducing detection-head complexity and simplifying export." 无 DFL 回归：YOLO26 移除了分布焦点损失（DFL），降低了检测头的复杂度并简化了导出。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features", item 1 End-to-End NMS-Free Inference 端到端免 NMS 推理 "End-to-End NMS-Free Inference YOLO26 supports native end-to-end inference with nms=False, producing predictions without a separate NMS pass." 端到端免 NMS 推理：YOLO26 支持用 nms=False 做原生端到端推理，无需单独的 NMS 步骤即可产生预测。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features", item 2 Progressive Loss + STAL 渐进式损失 + STAL "Progressive Loss + STAL Progressive Loss shifts training emphasis toward the inference-time head, while STAL improves positive label coverage for small objects." 渐进式损失 + STAL：渐进式损失把训练重心移向推理时使用的检测头，而 STAL 提高小目标的正样本标签覆盖率。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features", item 3 MuSGD Optimizer MuSGD 优化器 "MuSGD Optimizer A hybrid optimizer that combines SGD with Muon, adapting optimization ideas from large language model training to computer vision." MuSGD 优化器是一种把 SGD 与 Muon 结合起来的混合优化器，把大语言模型训练中的优化思想移用到计算机视觉。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features", item 4 Efficient Deployment 高效部署 "Efficient Deployment The simplified head and optional NMS-free path reduce inference overhead across export targets and hardware profiles" 高效部署：简化的检测头和可选的免 NMS 路径降低了各种导出目标和硬件配置上的推理开销 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features", item 5 Instance Segmentation Enhancements 实例分割增强 "Instance Segmentation Enhancements Introduces semantic segmentation loss to improve model convergence and an upgraded proto module that leverages multi-scale information for superior mask quality." 实例分割增强：引入语义分割损失以改善模型收敛，以及一个利用多尺度信息、提升掩码质量的升级版 proto 模块。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features", item 6 Precision Pose Estimation 精确姿态估计 "Precision Pose Estimation Integrates Residual Log-Likelihood Estimation (RLE) for more accurate keypoint localization and optimizes the decoding process for increased inference speed." 精确姿态估计：集成残差对数似然估计（RLE），使关键点定位更准确，并优化解码过程以提高推理速度。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features", item 7 Refined OBB Decoding 改进的 OBB 解码 "Refined OBB Decoding Introduces a specialized angle loss to improve detection accuracy for square-shaped objects and optimizes OBB decoding to resolve boundary discontinuity issues." 改进的 OBB 解码：引入专门的角度损失，提高方形物体的检测精度，并优化 OBB 解码以解决边界不连续问题。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features", item 8 Dual-Head Architecture 双头架构 "YOLO26 detection models use a dual-head architecture that provides flexibility for different deployment scenarios:" YOLO26 检测模型采用双头架构，它为不同的部署场景提供灵活性： Ultralytics, n.d., "Usage Examples", Dual-Head Architecture, para. 1 One-to-Many Head (Default) 一对多检测头（默认） "One-to-Many Head (Default): Generates traditional YOLO outputs requiring NMS post-processing, outputting (N, nc + 4, 8400) where nc is the number of classes." 一对多检测头（默认）会生成需要 NMS 后处理的传统 YOLO 输出，输出形状为 (N, nc + 4, 8400)，其中 nc 是类别数。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Usage Examples", Dual-Head Architecture, item 1 One-to-One Head (nms=False) 一对一检测头（nms=False） "One-to-One Head (nms=False): Produces end-to-end predictions without NMS, outputting (N, 300, 6) with a maximum of 300 detections per image." 一对一检测头（nms=False）会不经 NMS 直接产生端到端预测，输出形状为 (N, 300, 6)，每张图像最多 300 个检测结果。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Usage Examples", Dual-Head Architecture, item 2 YOLOE-26: Open-Vocabulary Detection and Segmentation YOLOE-26：开放词汇检测与分割 "YOLO26 also powers YOLOE-26, an open-vocabulary variant that detects and segments object categories from text prompts, visual prompts, or a prompt-free mode instead of a fixed class list learned at training time." YOLO26 还支撑着 YOLOE-26，它是一个开放词汇变体，它根据文本提示、视觉提示或无提示模式来检测和分割物体类别，而不是使用训练时学到的固定类别列表。 Ultralytics, n.d., "YOLOE-26: Open-Vocabulary Detection and Segmentation", para. 1 References Ultralytics. (n.d.). Ultralytics YOLO26. Ultralytics YOLO Docs (ultralytics 8.4.194). Retrieved October 31, 2026, from https://docs.ultralytics.com/models/yolo26/

ai/ultralytics-yolo/models/yoloe-real-ti.title: 3.20 YOLOE (Real-Time Seeing Anything) | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
ai/ultralytics-yolo/models/yoloe-real-ti.summary: 3.20 YOLOE (Real-Time Seeing Anything) Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 3.20 YOLOE (Real-Time Seeing Anything) YOLOE（实时看见一切） "Ultralytics YOLOE (Real-Time Seeing Anything) is an open-vocabulary detection and instance segmentation model: instead of a class list fixed at training time, it takes the categories you want at inference time, as a text prompt, a visual example, or a built-in 4,585-name vocabulary." Ultralytics YOLOE（实时看见一切）是一个开放词汇的检测和实例分割模型：它不用训练时固定的类别表，而是在推理时接收你想要的类别，形式可以是文本提示、视觉示例或内置的 4,585 个名称的词表。 Ultralytics, n.d., "YOLOE: Real-Time Open-Vocabulary Detection and Segmentation", para. 1 Choosing a Prompting Mode 选择提示模式 (context) "YOLOE supports three prompting modes, and the choice decides which checkpoint you load and what your class labels look like." （语境）YOLOE 支持三种提示模式，所选模式决定你加载哪个检查点以及类别标签是什么样子。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Choosing a Prompting Mode", para. 1 Text prompt 文本提示 (context) "You can describe the target in words — the usual choice" （语境）当你能用文字描述目标时使用，这是通常的选择 Ultralytics, n.d., "Choosing a Prompting Mode", table, row 1 Visual prompt 视觉提示 (context) "You cannot put the target into words: a specific part, logo, or defect" （语境）当你无法用文字表述目标时使用：某个特定部件、标志或缺陷 Ultralytics, n.d., "Choosing a Prompting Mode", table, row 2 Prompt-free 无提示 (context) "You are cataloging or exploring and do not know what to look for in advance" （语境）当你在编目或探索，事先不知道要找什么时使用 Ultralytics, n.d., "Choosing a Prompting Mode", table, row 3 Architecture Overview 架构概览 "YOLOE keeps the standard YOLO structure — a convolutional backbone for feature extraction, a neck for multi-scale fusion, and an anchor-free, decoupled head predicting classes and boxes — and adds three modules, one per prompting mode:" YOLOE 保留了标准的 YOLO 结构（用于特征提取的卷积骨干网络、用于多尺度融合的颈部，以及预测类别和框的无锚框解耦检测头），并增加了三个模块，每种提示模式一个： Ultralytics, n.d., "Architecture Overview", para. 1 Re-parameterizable Region-Text Alignment (RepRTA) 可重参数化区域-文本对齐（RepRTA） "Re-parameterizable Region-Text Alignment (RepRTA) refines text embeddings from CLIP through a small auxiliary network." 可重参数化区域-文本对齐（RepRTA）负责通过一个小型辅助网络细化来自 CLIP 的文本嵌入。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Architecture Overview", item 1 Semantic-Activated Visual Prompt Encoder (SAVPE) 语义激活视觉提示编码器（SAVPE） "Semantic-Activated Visual Prompt Encoder (SAVPE) encodes semantic and activation features from an example box, conditioning the model on objects that look like it." 语义激活视觉提示编码器（SAVPE）负责对示例框中的语义特征和激活特征进行编码，使模型以与之外观相似的物体为条件。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Architecture Overview", item 2 Lazy Region-Prompt Contrast (LRPC) 惰性区域-提示对比（LRPC） "Lazy Region-Prompt Contrast (LRPC) matches region embeddings against a built-in 4,585-name vocabulary, so prompt-free checkpoints recognize objects with no external prompt and no text encoder." 惰性区域-提示对比（LRPC）负责把区域嵌入与内置的 4,585 个名称的词表进行匹配，使无提示检查点无需外部提示、也无需文本编码器就能识别物体。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Architecture Overview", item 3 References Ultralytics. (n.d.). YOLOE: Real-Time Open-Vocabulary Detection and Segmentation. Ultralytics YOLO Docs (ultralytics 8.4.194). Retrieved October 31, 2026, from https://docs.ultralytics.com/models/yoloe/

ai/ultralytics-yolo/models/yolov10.html.title: 3.4 YOLOv10 | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
ai/ultralytics-yolo/models/yolov10.html.summary: 3.4 YOLOv10 Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 3.4 YOLOv10 YOLOv10 "YOLOv10, released in May 2024 and built on the Ultralytics Python package by researchers at Tsinghua University, introduces a new approach to real-time object detection, addressing both the post-processing and model architecture deficiencies found in previous YOLO versions." YOLOv10 于 2024 年 5 月发布，由清华大学的研究人员基于 Ultralytics Python 包构建，提出了一种新的实时目标检测方法，同时解决了以往 YOLO 版本在后处理和模型架构上的不足。 Ultralytics, n.d., "YOLOv10: Real-Time End-to-End Object Detection", para. 1 Architecture 架构 (context) "The architecture of YOLOv10 builds upon the strengths of previous YOLO models while introducing several key innovations." （语境）YOLOv10 的架构在以往 YOLO 模型优势的基础上，引入了若干关键创新。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Architecture", para. 1 Backbone 骨干网络 "Backbone: Responsible for feature extraction, the backbone in YOLOv10 uses an enhanced version of CSPNet (Cross Stage Partial Network) to improve gradient flow and reduce computational redundancy." 骨干网络负责特征提取，YOLOv10 的骨干网络使用增强版的 CSPNet（跨阶段局部网络），以改善梯度流并减少计算冗余。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Architecture", item 1 Neck 颈部 "Neck: The neck is designed to aggregate features from different scales and passes them to the head." 颈部：颈部用于聚合来自不同尺度的特征，并把它们传给检测头。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Architecture", item 2 One-to-Many Head 一对多检测头 "One-to-Many Head: Generates multiple predictions per object during training to provide rich supervisory signals and improve learning accuracy." 一对多检测头训练时为每个物体生成多个预测，以提供丰富的监督信号并提高学习精度。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Architecture", item 3 One-to-One Head 一对一检测头 "One-to-One Head: Generates a single best prediction per object during inference to eliminate the need for NMS, thereby reducing latency and improving efficiency." 一对一检测头推理时为每个物体只生成一个最佳预测，从而无需 NMS，降低延迟并提高效率。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Architecture", item 4 Key Features 主要特性 (No definition) （无定义） Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features" NMS-Free Training 免 NMS 训练 "NMS-Free Training: Utilizes consistent dual assignments to eliminate the need for NMS, reducing inference latency." 免 NMS 训练利用一致的双重分配来消除对 NMS 的需要，降低推理延迟。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features", item 1 Holistic Model Design 整体模型设计 "Holistic Model Design: Comprehensive optimization of various components from both efficiency and accuracy perspectives, including lightweight classification heads, spatial-channel decoupled downsampling, and rank-guided block design." 整体模型设计指从效率和精度两个角度全面优化各个组件，包括轻量级分类头、空间-通道解耦下采样和秩引导的模块设计。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features", item 2 Enhanced Model Capabilities 增强的模型能力 "Enhanced Model Capabilities: Incorporates large-kernel convolutions and partial self-attention modules to improve performance without significant computational cost." 增强的模型能力指引入大核卷积和部分自注意力模块，在不显著增加计算成本的情况下提升性能。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features", item 3 Model Variants 模型变体 (context) "YOLOv10 comes in various model scales to cater to different application needs:" （语境）YOLOv10 提供多种模型规模，以满足不同的应用需求： Ultralytics, n.d., "Model Variants", para. 1 YOLOv10n YOLOv10n "YOLOv10n: Nano version for extremely resource-constrained environments." YOLOv10n 是面向资源极其受限环境的 Nano 版本。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Model Variants", item 1 YOLOv10s YOLOv10s "YOLOv10s: Small version balancing speed and accuracy." YOLOv10s 是兼顾速度与精度的 Small 版本。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Model Variants", item 2 YOLOv10m YOLOv10m "YOLOv10m: Medium version for general-purpose use." YOLOv10m 是用于通用场景的 Medium 版本。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Model Variants", item 3 YOLOv10b YOLOv10b "YOLOv10b: Balanced version with increased width for higher accuracy." YOLOv10b 是加大宽度以提高精度的 Balanced 版本。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Model Variants", item 4 YOLOv10l YOLOv10l "YOLOv10l: Large version for higher accuracy at the cost of increased computational resources." YOLOv10l 是以更多计算资源换取更高精度的 Large 版本。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Model Variants", item 5 YOLOv10x YOLOv10x "YOLOv10x: Extra-large version for maximum accuracy and performance." YOLOv10x 是追求最高精度和性能的 Extra-large 版本。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Model Variants", item 6 Methodology 方法 (No definition) （无定义） Ultralytics, n.d., "Methodology" Consistent Dual Assignments for NMS-Free Training 面向免 NMS 训练的一致双重分配 "YOLOv10 employs dual label assignments, combining one-to-many and one-to-one strategies during training to ensure rich supervision and efficient end-to-end deployment." YOLOv10 采用双重标签分配，即在训练中结合一对多和一对一两种策略，以确保丰富的监督和高效的端到端部署。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Consistent Dual Assignments for NMS-Free Training", para. 1 Holistic Efficiency-Accuracy Driven Model Design 效率与精度驱动的整体模型设计 (No definition) （无定义） Ultralytics, n.d., "Holistic Efficiency- Accuracy Driven Model Design" Lightweight Classification Head 轻量级分类头 "Lightweight Classification Head: Reduces the computational overhead of the classification head by using depth-wise separable convolutions." 轻量级分类头使用深度可分离卷积来减少分类头的计算开销。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Efficiency Enhancements", Efficiency Enhancements, item 1 Spatial-Channel Decoupled Downsampling 空间-通道解耦下采样 "Spatial-Channel Decoupled Downsampling: Decouples spatial reduction and channel modulation to minimize information loss and computational cost." 空间-通道解耦下采样把空间缩减与通道调制解耦，以尽量减少信息损失和计算成本。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Efficiency Enhancements", Efficiency Enhancements, item 2 Rank-Guided Block Design 秩引导的模块设计 "Rank-Guided Block Design: Adapts block design based on intrinsic stage redundancy, ensuring optimal parameter utilization." 秩引导的模块设计根据各阶段的内在冗余调整模块设计，确保参数得到最佳利用。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Efficiency Enhancements", Efficiency Enhancements, item 3 Large-Kernel Convolution 大核卷积 "Large-Kernel Convolution: Enlarges the receptive field to enhance feature extraction capability." 大核卷积扩大感受野以增强特征提取能力。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Accuracy Enhancements", Accuracy Enhancements, item 1 Partial Self-Attention (PSA) 部分自注意力（PSA） "Partial Self-Attention (PSA): Incorporates self-attention modules to improve global representation learning with minimal overhead." 部分自注意力（PSA）的做法是引入自注意力模块，以极小的开销改进全局表征学习。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Accuracy Enhancements", Accuracy Enhancements, item 2 References Ultralytics. (n.d.). YOLOv10: Real-Time End-to-End Object Detection. Ultralytics YOLO Docs (ultralytics 8.4.194). Retrieved October 31, 2026, from https://docs.ultralytics.com/models/yolov10/

YOLOv3 引入三种不同尺度来做检测，利用三种不同大小的检测核：13x13、26x26 和 52x52。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features", item 1 YOLOv3u YOLOv3u "YOLOv3u: This updated model incorporates the anchor-free, objectness-free split head from YOLOv8." YOLOv3u：这个更新的模型采用了来自 YOLOv8 的无锚框、无目标性分数的分离式检测头。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features", item 2 References Ultralytics. (n.d.). YOLOv3 and YOLOv3u. Ultralytics YOLO Docs (ultralytics 8.4.194). YOLOv4 还使用了被称为“免费技巧包”的方法，它们是在训练中提高模型精度而不增加推理成本的技术。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Bag of Freebies", para. 1 References Ultralytics. (n.d.). YOLOv4: High-Speed and Precise Object Detection. ai/ultralytics-yolo/models/yolov5.html.summary: 3.9 YOLOv5 Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 3.9 YOLOv5 YOLOv5 (context) "Released June 2020. The foundational PyTorch implementation, battle-tested across millions of deployments." （语境）2020 年 6 月发布。奠基性的 PyTorch 实现，经过数百万次部署的实战检验。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Ultralytics YOLOv5", para. 1 Key Features 主要特性 (No definition) （无定义） Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features" Anchor-free Split Ultralytics Head 无锚框分离式 Ultralytics 检测头 "By adopting an anchor-free split Ultralytics head, it ensures a more flexible and adaptive detection mechanism, consequently enhancing the performance in diverse scenarios." 通过采用无锚框的分离式 Ultralytics 检测头，它确保了更灵活、更具适应性的检测机制，从而提升了在各种场景中的性能。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features", item 1 Optimized Accuracy-Speed Tradeoff 优化的精度与速度权衡 "It offers a calibrated balance, ensuring real-time detections without compromising on accuracy." 它提供了一种经过校准的平衡，确保在不牺牲精度的情况下实时检测。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features", item 2 Variety of Pretrained Models 多样的预训练模型 "Understanding that different tasks require different toolsets, YOLOv5u provides a plethora of pretrained models." 考虑到不同任务需要不同的工具集，YOLOv5u 提供了大量预训练模型。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features", item 3 References Ultralytics. ai/ultralytics-yolo/models/yolov6.html.summary: 3.8 YOLOv6 Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 3.8 YOLOv6 YOLOv6 "Meituan YOLOv6, released in 2022, offers a strong balance between speed and accuracy, making it a popular choice for real-time applications." 美团 YOLOv6 于 2022 年发布，在速度和精度之间取得了很好的平衡，因此常用于实时应用。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Meituan YOLOv6", para. 1 Key Features 主要特性 (No definition) （无定义） Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features" Bidirectional Concatenation (BiC) Module 双向拼接（BiC）模块 "Bidirectional Concatenation (BiC) Module: YOLOv6 introduces a BiC module in the neck of the detector, enhancing localization signals and delivering performance gains with negligible speed degradation." 双向拼接（BiC）模块：YOLOv6 在检测器的颈部引入 BiC 模块，以此增强定位信号，并以几乎可以忽略的速度损失带来性能提升。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features", item 1 Anchor-Aided Training (AAT) Strategy 锚框辅助训练（AAT）策略 "Anchor-Aided Training (AAT) Strategy: This model proposes AAT to enjoy the benefits of both anchor-based and anchor-free paradigms without compromising inference efficiency." 锚框辅助训练（AAT）策略：该模型提出 AAT，以便在不影响推理效率的前提下兼得基于锚框和无锚框两种范式的好处。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features", item 2 Enhanced Backbone and Neck Design 增强的骨干与颈部设计 "Enhanced Backbone and Neck Design: By deepening YOLOv6 to include another stage in the backbone and neck, this model achieved strong performance on the COCO dataset at high-resolution input when released." 增强的骨干与颈部设计：通过加深 YOLOv6，在骨干网络和颈部各增加一个阶段，该模型发布时在高分辨率输入下于 COCO 数据集上取得了强劲的性能。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features", item 3 Self-Distillation Strategy 自蒸馏策略 "Self-Distillation Strategy: A new self-distillation strategy is implemented to boost the performance of smaller models of YOLOv6, enhancing the auxiliary regression branch during training and removing it at inference to avoid a marked speed decline." 自蒸馏策略：实现了一种新的自蒸馏策略，它用来提升 YOLOv6 较小模型的性能，训练时增强辅助回归分支，推理时去掉它以避免明显的速度下降。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features", item 4 References Ultralytics. ai/ultralytics-yolo/models/yolov7.html.summary: 3.7 YOLOv7 Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 3.7 YOLOv7 YOLOv7 "YOLOv7, released in July 2022, was a significant advancement in real-time object detection at its time of release." YOLOv7 于 2022 年 7 月发布，在发布时是实时目标检测的一项重大进步。 Ultralytics, n.d., "YOLOv7: Trainable Bag-of-Freebies", para. 1 Key Features 主要特性 (context) "YOLOv7 introduces several key features:" （语境）YOLOv7 引入了几项主要特性： Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features", para. 1 Model Re-parameterization 模型重参数化 "Model Re-parameterization: YOLOv7 proposes a planned re-parameterized model, which is a strategy applicable to layers in different networks with the concept of gradient propagation path." 模型重参数化：YOLOv7 提出一种有规划的重参数化模型，它是一种借助梯度传播路径的概念、适用于不同网络中各层的策略。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features", item 1 Dynamic Label Assignment 动态标签分配 "To solve this problem, YOLOv7 introduces a new label assignment method called coarse-to-fine lead guided label assignment." 为解决这个问题，YOLOv7 引入了一种新的标签分配方法，称为由粗到细的引导头标签分配。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features", item 2 Extended and Compound Scaling 扩展与复合缩放 "Extended and Compound Scaling: YOLOv7 proposes "extend" and "compound scaling" methods for the real-time object detector that can effectively utilize parameters and computation." 扩展与复合缩放：YOLOv7 为实时目标检测器提出了“扩展”和“复合缩放”方法，它们能够有效利用参数和计算量。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features", item 3 Efficiency 效率 "Efficiency: The method proposed by YOLOv7 can effectively reduce about 40% parameters and 50% computation of state-of-the-art real-time object detector, and has faster inference speed and higher detection accuracy." 效率：YOLOv7 提出的方法能把最先进实时目标检测器的参数减少约 40%、计算量减少约 50%，并且推理更快、检测精度更高。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features", item 4 References Ultralytics. only identifies the location and class of objects within the frame but also maintains a unique ID for each detected object as the video progresses." 视频分析中的目标跟踪是一项关键任务，它不仅识别画面中物体的位置和类别，还随着视频推进为每个检测到的物体保持唯一的 ID。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Multi-Object Tracking with Ultralytics YOLO", para. 1 Supported Trackers 支持的跟踪器 (context) "Ultralytics YOLO ships with six built-in trackers." （语境）Ultralytics YOLO 内置六个跟踪器。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Supported Trackers", para. 1 Configuration 配置 (No definition) （无定义） Ultralytics, n.d., "Configuration" Tracking Arguments 跟踪参数 (context) "Tracking configuration shares properties with Predict mode, such as conf, iou, and show." （语境）跟踪配置与预测模式共用一些属性，例如 conf、iou 和 show。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Tracking Arguments", para. 1 Custom Tracker Configuration 自定义跟踪器配置 (context) "Ultralytics also allows you to use a modified tracker configuration file." （语境）Ultralytics 还允许你使用修改过的跟踪器配置文件。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Custom Tracker Configuration", para. 1 Shared Tracker Arguments 共享跟踪器参数 (context) "The following parameters are common to most tracker YAML files" （语境）以下参数为大多数跟踪器 YAML 文件所共有 Ultralytics, n.d., "Shared Tracker Arguments", para. 1 Tracker-specific Arguments 跟踪器专属参数 (context) "Each algorithm exposes additional knobs on top of the shared parameters." （语境）每个算法都在共享参数之外提供额外的调节项。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Tracker-specific Arguments", para. 1 Enabling Re-Identification (ReID) 启用重识别（ReID） (context) "ReID is disabled by default to minimize overhead." （语境）ReID 默认关闭，以尽量减少开销。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Enabling Re-Identification (ReID)", para. 1 model: auto model: auto "model: auto — Uses native YOLO detector features, adding minimal overhead." model: auto：使用 YOLO 检测器自身的特征，开销极小。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Enabling Re-Identification (ReID)", item 1 Custom ReID model 自定义 ReID 模型 "Custom ReID model — Point model: at a .pt checkpoint or a compatible exported embedding model" 自定义 ReID 模型：把 model: 指向一个 .pt 检查点或兼容的已导出嵌入模型 Ultralytics, n.d., "Enabling Re-Identification (ReID)", item 2 Tracker Details 跟踪器详解 (context) "The sections below describe each tracker's design, specific parameters, and tuning tips." （语境）下面各节介绍每个跟踪器的设计、专属参数和调参建议。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Tracker Details", para. 1 BoT-SORT BoT-SORT "BoT-SORT (Aharon et al., 2022) extends ByteTrack with camera-motion compensation and optional ReID:" BoT-SORT（Aharon 等，2022）在 ByteTrack 的基础上加入相机运动补偿和可选的 ReID： Ultralytics, n.d., "BoT-SORT", para. 1 Camera Motion Compensation (CMC) 相机运动补偿（CMC） "Camera Motion Compensation (CMC): an affine warp estimated each frame (sparse optical flow by default; ORB / ECC also available) is applied to Kalman states before IoU matching." 相机运动补偿（CMC）：每帧估计一个仿射变换（默认用稀疏光流；也可用 ORB / ECC），在 IoU 匹配前作用到卡尔曼状态上。 Ultralytics, n.d., "BoT-SORT", item 1 Optional ReID 可选 ReID "Optional ReID: appearance embeddings can be fused into the cost matrix." 可选 ReID：外观嵌入可以融合进代价矩阵。 Ultralytics, n.d., "BoT-SORT", item 2 ByteTrack ByteTrack "ByteTrack (Zhang et al., ECCV 2022) is the lightweight baseline." ByteTrack（Zhang 等，ECCV 2022）是轻量级基线。 Ultralytics, n.d., "ByteTrack", para. 1 Stage 1 第一阶段 "Stage 1: match high-score detections against active tracks." 第一阶段：把高分检测结果与活动轨迹匹配。 Ultralytics, n.d., "ByteTrack", item 1 Stage 2 第二阶段 "Stage 2: retry unmatched tracks against low-score detections to recover through brief partial occlusion." 第二阶段：把未匹配的轨迹再与低分检测结果匹配，以便在短暂的部分遮挡后恢复。 Ultralytics, n.d., "ByteTrack", item 2 OC-SORT OC-SORT "OC-SORT (Cao et al., CVPR 2023) is an observation-centric extension of SORT." OC-SORT（Cao 等，CVPR 2023）是以观测为中心的 SORT 扩展。 Ultralytics, n.d., "OC-SORT", para. 1 Observation-Centric Re-update (ORU) 以观测为中心的重新更新（ORU） "Observation-Centric Re-update (ORU): replays a virtual trajectory between the last observation and the current detection, re-running the Kalman update to repair drifted velocity." 以观测为中心的重新更新（ORU）：在上一次观测和当前检测之间回放一条虚拟轨迹，重新执行卡尔曼更新以修正漂移的速度。 Ultralytics, n.d., "OC-SORT", item 1 Observation-Centric Momentum (OCM) 以观测为中心的动量（OCM） "Observation-Centric Momentum (OCM): penalizes detections moving in the wrong direction via a velocity-consistency term." 以观测为中心的动量（OCM）：通过速度一致性项惩罚朝错误方向移动的检测结果。 Ultralytics, n.d., "OC-SORT", item 2 Observation-Centric Recovery (OCR) 以观测为中心的恢复（OCR） "Observation-Centric Recovery (OCR): re-checks unmatched detections against recently lost tracks using their last observation rather than the predicted state." 以观测为中心的恢复（OCR）：用最近丢失轨迹的最后一次观测（而非预测状态）重新核对未匹配的检测结果。 Ultralytics, n.d., "OC-SORT", item 3 Deep OC-SORT Deep OC-SORT "Deep OC-SORT augments OC-SORT with appearance information and camera-motion compensation:" Deep OC-SORT 在 OC-SORT 的基础上加入外观信息和相机运动补偿： Ultralytics, n.d., "Deep OC-SORT", para. 1 Appearance matching 外观匹配 "Appearance matching: cosine embedding distance is gated by overlap and fused with motion cost." 外观匹配：余弦嵌入距离先经重叠度门控，再与运动代价融合。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Deep OC-SORT", item 1 Dynamic appearance EMA 动态外观 EMA "Dynamic appearance EMA: track embeddings update with an EMA whose smoothing factor adapts to detection confidence." 动态外观 EMA：轨迹嵌入用 EMA 更新，其平滑系数随检测置信度自适应。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Deep OC-SORT", item 2 Camera Motion Compensation 相机运动补偿 "Camera Motion Compensation: Kalman states are warped frame-to-frame via sparse optical flow, ORB, or ECC." 相机运动补偿：卡尔曼状态通过稀疏光流、ORB 或 ECC 逐帧变换。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Deep OC-SORT", item 3 FastTracker FastTracker "FastTracker is an occlusion-aware ByteTrack variant with no appearance model:" FastTracker 是一种能感知遮挡、不带外观模型的 ByteTrack 变体： Ultralytics, n.d., "FastTracker", para. 1 Occlusion detection 遮挡检测 "Occlusion detection: flags tracks occluded when coverage by other active tracks exceeds occ_cover_thresh." 遮挡检测：当轨迹被其他活动轨迹覆盖的比例超过 occ_cover_thresh 时，把它标记为被遮挡。 Ultralytics, n.d., "FastTracker", item 1 Kalman rollback on occlusion 遮挡时卡尔曼回滚 "Kalman rollback on occlusion: rolls the Kalman state back to a pre-occlusion frame using ring-buffered history." 遮挡时卡尔曼回滚：利用环形缓冲的历史，把卡尔曼状态回滚到遮挡前的一帧。 Ultralytics, n.d., "FastTracker", item 2 Motion dampening and search expansion 运动阻尼与搜索扩展 "Motion dampening and search expansion: velocity is dampened and the predicted bbox is enlarged while occluded." 运动阻尼与搜索扩展：遮挡期间速度被阻尼，预测框被放大。 Ultralytics, n.d., "FastTracker", item 3 Init-IoU suppression 初始化 IoU 抑制 "Init-IoU suppression: prevents new tracks from spawning on top of active tracks." 初始化 IoU 抑制：防止新轨迹在活动轨迹之上生成。 Ultralytics, n.d., "FastTracker", item 4 TrackTrack TrackTrack "TrackTrack (Shim et al., CVPR 2025) is the default tracker. It reasons from each track's perspective with multi-cue iterative association:" TrackTrack（Shim 等，CVPR 2025）是默认跟踪器。它从每条轨迹的视角出发，用多线索迭代关联进行推理： Ultralytics, n.d., "TrackTrack", para. 1 Track-Perspective-Based Association (TPA) 基于轨迹视角的关联（TPA） "Track-Perspective-Based Association (TPA): combines HMIoU, optional cosine ReID distance, confidence-projection distance, and corner-angle distance." 基于轨迹视角的关联（TPA）：结合 HMIoU、可选的余弦 ReID 距离、置信度投影距离和角点角度距离。 Ultralytics, n.d., "TrackTrack", item 1 Track-Aware Initialization (TAI) 感知轨迹的初始化（TAI） "Track-Aware Initialization (TAI): suppresses duplicate spawns before a new ID is created." 感知轨迹的初始化（TAI）：在创建新 ID 之前抑制重复生成。 Ultralytics, n.d., "TrackTrack", item 2 References Ultralytics. (n.d.). Multi-Object Tracking with Ultralytics YOLO. Ultralytics YOLO Docs (ultralytics 8.4.194). Retrieved October 31, 2026, from https://docs.ultralytics.com/modes/track/

ai/ultralytics-yolo/modes/train.html.summary: 1.1 Train Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 1.1 Train 训练 "Training a deep learning model involves feeding it data and adjusting its parameters so that it can make accurate predictions." 训练深度学习模型就是给它输入数据并调整其参数，使它能做出准确的预测。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Model Training with Ultralytics YOLO", para. 1 Key Features of Train Mode 训练模式的主要功能 (context) "The following are some notable features of YOLO26's Train mode:" （语境）以下是 YOLO26 训练模式的一些主要功能： Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features of Train Mode", para. 1 Automatic Dataset Download 自动下载数据集 "Automatic Dataset Download: Dataset configurations with a download source are downloaded automatically on first use" 自动下载数据集：带有下载来源的数据集配置会在首次使用时自动下载 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features of Train Mode", item 1 Multi-GPU Support 多 GPU 支持 "Multi-GPU Support: Scale your training efforts seamlessly across multiple GPUs to expedite the process." 多 GPU 支持：把训练无缝扩展到多块 GPU 上，以加快过程。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features of Train Mode", item 2 Hyperparameter Configuration 超参数配置 "Hyperparameter Configuration: The option to modify hyperparameters through YAML configuration files or CLI arguments." 超参数配置：可以通过 YAML 配置文件或命令行参数修改超参数。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features of Train Mode", item 3 Visualization and Monitoring 可视化与监控 "Visualization and Monitoring: Real-time tracking of training metrics and visualization of the learning process for better insights." 可视化与监控：实时跟踪训练指标并可视化学习过程，以便更好地洞察。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features of Train Mode", item 4 Usage Examples 使用示例 (No definition) （无定义） Ultralytics, n.d., "Usage Examples" Multi-GPU Training 多 GPU 训练 "Multi-GPU training allows for more efficient utilization of available hardware resources by distributing the training load across multiple GPUs." 多 GPU 训练把训练负载分布到多块 GPU 上，从而更高效地利用可用的硬件资源。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Multi-GPU Training", para. 1 Huawei Ascend NPU Training 华为昇腾 NPU 训练 (context) "Ultralytics supports training and validation on Huawei Ascend NPUs through torch_npu." （语境）Ultralytics 支持通过 torch_npu 在华为昇腾 NPU 上训练和验证。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Huawei Ascend NPU Training", para. 1 Idle GPU Training 空闲 GPU 训练 "Idle GPU Training enables automatic selection of the least utilized GPUs in multi-GPU systems, optimizing resource usage without manual GPU selection." 空闲 GPU 训练能在多 GPU 系统中自动选择利用率最低的 GPU，无需手动选择 GPU 即可优化资源使用。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Idle GPU Training", para. 1 Apple Silicon MPS Training Apple 芯片 MPS 训练 (context) "The MPS offers a high-performance way of executing computation and image processing tasks on Apple's custom silicon." （语境）MPS 提供了在 Apple 自研芯片上执行计算和图像处理任务的高性能方式。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Apple Silicon MPS Training", para. 1 Resuming Interrupted Trainings 恢复中断的训练 "Resuming training from a previously saved state is a crucial feature when working with deep learning models." 从先前保存的状态恢复训练是使用深度学习模型时的一项关键功能。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Resuming Interrupted Trainings", para. 1 Train Settings 训练设置 "The training settings for YOLO models encompass various hyperparameters and configurations used during the training process." YOLO 模型的训练设置包括训练过程中使用的各种超参数和配置。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Train Settings", para. 1 MuSGD Optimizer MuSGD 优化器 "In YOLO26, MuSGD is a hybrid optimizer that combines standard SGD updates with Muon-style orthogonalized updates." 在 YOLO26 中，MuSGD 是一种混合优化器，把标准 SGD 更新与 Muon 风格的正交化更新结合起来。 Ultralytics, n.d., "MuSGD Optimizer", para. 1 Fixed Batch Size 固定批大小 "Fixed Batch Size: Set an integer value (e.g., batch=16), specifying the number of images per batch directly." 固定批大小：设置一个整数值（例如 batch=16），直接指定每批的图像数量。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Train Settings", Note on Batch-size Settings, item 1 Auto Mode (60% GPU Memory) 自动模式（60% GPU 显存） "Auto Mode (60% GPU Memory): Use batch=-1 to automatically adjust batch size for approximately 60% of the CUDA memory available to training." 自动模式（60% GPU 显存）：使用 batch=-1，自动调整批大小，使其占用训练可用 CUDA 显存的约 60%。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Train Settings", Note on Batch-size Settings, item 2 Auto Mode with Utilization Fraction 按利用率比例的自动模式 "Auto Mode with Utilization Fraction: Set a fraction value (e.g., batch=0.70) to adjust batch size based on the specified fraction of available GPU memory." 按利用率比例的自动模式：设置一个比例值（例如 batch=0.70），按可用 GPU 显存的指定比例调整批大小。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Train Settings", Note on Batch-size Settings, item 3 OOM Auto-Retry 显存溢出自动重试 "OOM Auto-Retry: If a CUDA out-of-memory error occurs during the first epoch, the trainer automatically halves the batch size and retries (up to 3 times)." 显存溢出自动重试：如果第一个轮次中发生 CUDA 显存溢出错误，训练器会自动把批大小减半并重试（最多 3 次）。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Train Settings", Note on Batch-size Settings, item 4 No Fit Found 找不到合适值 "No Fit Found: If no candidate batch size produces a usable profile, AutoBatch raises a clear RuntimeError instead of silently falling back to an unrelated default." 找不到合适值：如果没有任何候选批大小能得到可用的分析结果，AutoBatch 会抛出明确的 RuntimeError，而不是悄悄退回到一个无关的默认值。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Train Settings", Note on Batch-size Settings, item 5 Augmentation Settings and Hyperparameters 增强设置与超参数 "Augmentation techniques are essential for improving the robustness and performance of YOLO models by introducing variability into the training data, helping the model generalize better to unseen data." 增强技术对于通过给训练数据引入变化来提升 YOLO 模型的鲁棒性和性能至关重要，能帮助模型更好地泛化到未见过的数据。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Augmentation Settings and Hyperparameters", para. 1 Logging 日志记录 (context) "Training metrics, plots, and checkpoints are always written to the run directory, and Ultralytics also streams them to any experiment tracker you have installed and enabled" （语境）训练指标、图表和检查点总会写入运行目录，Ultralytics 还会把它们推送到你已安装并启用的任何实验跟踪工具 Ultralytics, n.d., "Logging", para. 1 References Ultralytics. (n.d.). Model Training with Ultralytics YOLO. Ultralytics YOLO Docs (ultralytics 8.4.194). Retrieved October 31, 2026, from https://docs.ultralytics.com/modes/train/
