ai/ultralytics-yolo/modes/val.html.summary: 1.2 Val Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 1.2 Val 验证 "Validation is a critical step in the machine learning pipeline, allowing you to assess the quality of your trained models." 验证是机器学习流水线中的关键一步，让你评估训练好的模型的质量。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Model Validation with Ultralytics YOLO", para. 1 Key Features of Val Mode 验证模式的主要功能 (context) "These are the notable functionalities offered by YOLO26's Val mode:" （语境）以下是 YOLO26 验证模式提供的主要功能： Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features of Val Mode", para. 1 Automated Settings 自动设置 "Automated Settings: Models remember their training configurations for straightforward validation." 自动设置：模型会记住自己的训练配置，使验证简单直接。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features of Val Mode", item 1 Multi-Metric Support 多指标支持 "Multi-Metric Support: Evaluate your model based on a range of accuracy metrics." 多指标支持：基于一系列精度指标评估你的模型。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features of Val Mode", item 2 CLI and Python API 命令行与 Python API "CLI and Python API: Choose from command-line interface or Python API based on your preference for validation." 命令行与 Python API：根据你的偏好，在命令行界面和 Python API 之间选择来做验证。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features of Val Mode", item 3 Data Compatibility 数据兼容性 "Data Compatibility: Works seamlessly with datasets used during the training phase as well as custom datasets." 数据兼容性：可无缝使用训练阶段用过的数据集以及自定义数据集。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Key Features of Val Mode", item 4 Arguments for YOLO Model Validation YOLO 模型验证的参数 "These arguments control aspects such as input image size, batch processing, and performance thresholds." 这些参数控制输入图像尺寸、批处理和性能阈值等方面。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Arguments for YOLO Model Validation", para. 1 Rectangular validation geometry (rect) 矩形验证几何（rect） (context) "Static exports use their recorded (height, width) input shape, including non-square exports, for validation." （语境）静态导出的模型在验证时使用其记录的 (height, width) 输入形状，包括非正方形的导出。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Rectangular validation geometry ( rect )", para. 1 References Ultralytics. (n.d.). Model Validation with Ultralytics YOLO. Ultralytics YOLO Docs (ultralytics 8.4.194). Retrieved October 31, 2026, from https://docs.ultralytics.com/modes/val/

ai/ultralytics-yolo/platform/agents.html.summary: 6.1 Agents Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 6.1 Agents 智能体 "Agents connects images, models, conditions, and actions in a visual workflow." Agents 在一个可视化工作流中把图像、模型、条件和动作连接起来。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Agents", para. 1 Configure Blocks 配置模块 (context) "Select a block to edit its settings. Connect an output to another block to pass its result downstream." （语境）选中一个模块即可编辑其设置。把一个输出连接到另一个模块，就能把它的结果传给下游。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Configure Blocks", para. 1 Image 图像模块 "Upload an image or a video 把图像和上游上下文发送给选定的语言模型或视觉语言模型 Ultralytics, n.d., "Configure Blocks", table, row 5 Gate 门控模块 "Control downstream execution with a condition or cadence" 用条件或节奏控制下游的执行 Ultralytics, n.d., "Configure Blocks", (n.d.). Agents. Ultralytics YOLO Docs (ultralytics 8.4.194). Retrieved October 31, 2026, from https://docs.ultralytics.com/platform/agents/

ai/ultralytics-yolo/platform/data.html.summary: 6.2 Data Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 6.2 Data 数据 (context) "Data preparation is the foundation of successful computer vision models." （语境）数据准备是成功的计算机视觉模型的基础。 Ultralytics, n.d.-b, "Data Preparation", para. 1 Supported Tasks 支持的任务 (context) "Ultralytics Platform datasets support all 7 YOLO task types:" （语境）Ultralytics 平台的数据集支持全部 7 种 YOLO 任务类型： Ultralytics, n.d.-b, "Supported Tasks", para. 1 Task Type Selection 任务类型选择 "The task type is set when creating a dataset and determines which annotation tools are available." ai/ultralytics-yolo/solutions/index.html.summary: 5. Solutions Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 5 Solutions 解决方案 "Ultralytics Solutions provide cutting-edge applications of YOLO models, offering real-world solutions like object counting, blurring, and security systems, enhancing efficiency and accuracy in diverse industries." Ultralytics Solutions 提供 YOLO 模型的前沿应用，给出目标计数、模糊处理、安防系统等真实场景的解决方案，在各行各业提升效率和准确率。 Ultralytics, n.d.-p, "Ultralytics Solutions: Harness YOLO26 to Solve Real-World Problems", para. 1 5.1 Analytics 分析 "Analytics with Ultralytics YOLO26 turns object detection and tracking results into real-time charts, so you can watch how object counts change across a video frame by frame." Ultralytics YOLO26 的分析功能把目标检测和跟踪结果转换成实时图表，让你逐帧观察视频中物体数量的变化。 Ultralytics, n.d.-a, "Analytics using Ultralytics YOLO26", para. 1 5.2 Distance Calculation 距离计算 "Distance calculation is the process of measuring the space between two detected objects within an image or video frame." 距离计算是测量图像或视频帧中两个被检测物体之间距离的过程。 Ultralytics, n.d.-c, "Distance Calculation using Ultralytics YOLO26", para. 1 5.3 Heatmaps 热力图 "The Heatmap solution in Ultralytics YOLO26 tracks objects across video frames and overlays their accumulated movement intensity onto each frame, so busy areas glow in warm colors while quiet areas stay cool." Ultralytics YOLO26 的热力图方案在各视频帧中跟踪物体，并把它们累积的运动强度叠加到每一帧上，繁忙区域显示暖色，安静区域保持冷色。 Ultralytics, n.d.-k, "Object Tracking Heatmaps with Ultralytics YOLO26", para. 1 5.4 Instance Segmentation Tracking 实例分割跟踪 (context) "Instance segmentation is a computer vision task that involves identifying and outlining individual objects in an image at the pixel level." （语境）实例分割是一项在像素级别识别并勾勒图像中各个物体的计算机视觉任务。 Ultralytics, n.d.-e, "Instance Segmentation and Tracking using Ultralytics YOLO26", para. 1 5.5 Live Inference 实时推理 (context) "Combining this with Ultralytics YOLO26 allows for real-time object detection and analysis directly in your browser." （语境）把它与 Ultralytics YOLO26 结合，就能直接在浏览器中进行实时目标检测和分析。 Ultralytics, n.d.-f, "Live Inference with Streamlit Application using Ultralytics YOLO26", para. 1 5.6 Object Blurring 物体模糊 "Object blurring with Ultralytics YOLO26 involves applying a blurring effect to specific detected objects in an image or video." Ultralytics YOLO26 的物体模糊是对图像或视频中特定的被检测物体施加模糊效果。 Ultralytics, n.d.-g, "Object Blurring using Ultralytics YOLO26", para. 1 5.7 Object Counting 物体计数 "Object counting with Ultralytics YOLO26 involves accurate identification and counting of specific objects in videos and camera streams." Ultralytics YOLO26 的物体计数是在视频和摄像头流中准确识别并计数特定物体。 Ultralytics, n.d.-i, "Object Counting using Ultralytics YOLO26", para. 1 5.8 Object Counting in Regions 区域内物体计数 "The RegionCounter solution in Ultralytics YOLO26 tracks objects across video frames and, on every frame, counts the objects whose bounding-box center falls inside each region you define." Ultralytics YOLO26 的 RegionCounter 方案在各视频帧中跟踪物体，并在每一帧统计边界框中心落在你定义的各个区域内的物体数量。 Ultralytics, n.d.-h, "Object Counting in Regions with Ultralytics YOLO26", para. 1 5.9 Object Cropping 物体裁剪 "Object cropping with Ultralytics YOLO26 involves isolating and extracting specific detected objects from an image or video." Ultralytics YOLO26 的物体裁剪是从图像或视频中分离并提取特定的被检测物体。 Ultralytics, n.d.-j, "Object Cropping using Ultralytics YOLO26", para. 1 5.10 Parking Management 停车管理 "A parking management system built with Ultralytics YOLO26 detects vehicles in real time to track which parking spaces are occupied or available, then reports live lot occupancy." 用 Ultralytics YOLO26 构建的停车管理系统实时检测车辆，跟踪哪些车位被占用、哪些空闲，并报告停车场的实时占用情况。 Ultralytics, n.d.-b, "Build a Parking Management System with Ultralytics YOLO26", para. 1 5.11 Queue Management 排队管理 "Queue management using Ultralytics YOLO26 involves organizing and controlling lines of people or vehicles to reduce wait times and enhance efficiency." 用 Ultralytics YOLO26 进行排队管理，是组织和控制人或车辆的队列，以减少等待时间、提高效率。 Ultralytics, n.d.-l, "Queue Management using Ultralytics YOLO26", para. 1 5.12 Security Alarm System 安防报警系统 "The Security Alarm System Project utilizing Ultralytics YOLO26 integrates advanced computer vision capabilities to enhance security measures." 基于 Ultralytics YOLO26 的安防报警系统项目集成了先进的计算机视觉能力，以加强安防措施。 Ultralytics, n.d.-m, "Security Alarm System Project Using Ultralytics YOLO26", para. 1 5.13 Similarity Search 相似度搜索 (context) "This guide walks you through building a semantic image search engine using OpenAI CLIP and Flask." （语境）本指南带你用 OpenAI CLIP 和 Flask 构建一个语义图像搜索引擎。 Ultralytics, n.d.-d, "How to Build Semantic Image Search with OpenAI CLIP", para. 1 5.14 Speed Estimation 速度估计 "Speed estimation is the process of calculating the rate of movement of an object within a given context, often employed in computer vision applications." 速度估计是计算物体在给定情境中运动速率的过程，常用于计算机视觉应用。 Ultralytics, n.d.-n, "Speed Estimation using Ultralytics YOLO26", para. 1 5.15 Track Objects in Zone 区域内物体跟踪 "TrackZone specializes in monitoring objects within designated areas of a frame instead of the whole frame." TrackZone 专门监控画面中指定区域内的物体，而不是整个画面。 Ultralytics, n.d.-o, "TrackZone using Ultralytics YOLO26", para. 1 5.16 VisionEye View Objects Mapping VisionEye 视角物体映射 "Ultralytics YOLO26 VisionEye offers the capability for computers to identify and pinpoint objects, simulating the observational precision of the human eye." Ultralytics YOLO26 VisionEye 让计算机能够识别并精确定位物体，模拟人眼观察的精确度。 Ultralytics, n.d.-q, "VisionEye View Object Mapping using Ultralytics YOLO26", para. 1 5.17 Workouts Monitoring 健身监测 "Monitoring workouts through pose estimation with Ultralytics YOLO26 enhances exercise assessment by accurately tracking key body landmarks and joints in real-time." 用 Ultralytics YOLO26 的姿态估计监测健身，通过实时准确跟踪身体关键部位和关节来改进运动评估。 Ultralytics, n.d.-r, "Workouts Monitoring using Ultralytics YOLO26", para. 1 Solutions Arguments 解决方案参数 (No definition) （无定义） Ultralytics, n.d.-p, "Solutions Arguments" SolutionAnnotator SolutionAnnotator（解决方案标注器） "All Ultralytics Solutions use the separate class SolutionAnnotator, that extends the main Annotator class" 所有 Ultralytics 解决方案都使用单独的 SolutionAnnotator 类，它扩展了主 Annotator 类 Ultralytics, n.d.-p, "Usage of SolutionAnnotator", para. 1 SolutionResults SolutionResults（解决方案结果） (context) "Except Similarity Search, each Solution call returns a SolutionResults object." （语境）除相似性搜索外，每次调用解决方案都会返回一个 SolutionResults 对象。 Ultralytics, n.d.-p, "Working with SolutionResults", para. 1 References Ultralytics. Ultralytics, n.d., "Depth range and the log-depth head", para. 1 Dataset format 数据集格式 "Depth estimation datasets pair each RGB image with a scaled uint16 depth PNG or floating-point NPY depth map in meters." 深度估计数据集把每张 RGB 图像与一张以米为单位的深度图配对，深度图为缩放过的 uint16 PNG 或浮点 NPY。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Dataset format", para. 1 Calibrating the depth scale 校准深度尺度 "If a model already produces good relative depth Ultralytics, n.d., "Calibrating the depth scale", para. 1 identity 恒等（identity） "identity: the raw head output, with no calibration." 恒等（identity）：即原始的头部输出，不做校准。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Calibrating the depth scale", item 1 current 当前（current） "current: the calibration the model already carries, such as the one baked into the released checkpoints." 当前（current）：即模型已带有的校准，例如已固化在发布检查点中的校准。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Calibrating the depth scale", item 2 scale-only 仅尺度（scale-only） "scale-only: a new global scale, refit on all of those images when selected." 仅尺度（scale-only）：即一个新的全局尺度，被选中时在所有这些图像上重新拟合。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Calibrating the depth scale", item 3 Results Output 结果输出 "Each result stores one dense float depth map for the full image." 每个结果为整张图像存储一张稠密的浮点深度图。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Results Output", para. 1 Per-object depth with instance segmentation 结合实例分割的逐物体深度 "Combine instance segmentation with depth to estimate how far away each detected object is." 把实例分割与深度结合起来，以估计每个检测到的物体有多远。 ai/ultralytics-yolo/tasks/segment.html.summary: 2.2 Segment Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 2.2 Segment 实例分割 "Instance segmentation goes a step further than object detection and involves identifying individual objects in an image and segmenting them from the rest of the image." 实例分割比目标检测更进一步，要识别图像中的各个物体，并把它们从图像的其余部分中分割出来。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Instance Segmentation with Ultralytics YOLO", para. 1 Dataset format 数据集格式 (context) "YOLO segmentation dataset format can be found in detail in the Dataset Guide." （语境）YOLO 分割数据集格式可在数据集指南中找到详细说明。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Dataset format", para. 1 Results Output 结果输出 "Each result stores object-level predictions, where each detected instance has its own binary mask, class, confidence, and box." 每个结果存储物体级的预测，其中每个检测到的实例都有自己的二值掩码、类别、置信度和框。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Results Output", para. 1 Instance vs Semantic Segmentation 实例分割与语义分割 "Instance segmentation is object-level segmentation: two cars produce two masks, two boxes, and two confidence scores. Semantic segmentation is pixel-level classification: those same cars become pixels with the same class ID in one image-sized class map, with no per-object boxes, confidences, or default polygon list." 实例分割是物体级的分割：两辆车产生两个掩码、两个框和两个置信度分数。语义分割是像素级的分类：同样这两辆车会变成一张与图像同尺寸的类别图中具有相同类别 ID 的像素，没有逐物体的框、置信度，也没有默认的多边形列表。 Ultralytics, n.d., "Instance vs Semantic Segmentation", para. 1 References Ultralytics. (n.d.). Instance Segmentation with Ultralytics YOLO. Ultralytics YOLO Docs (ultralytics 8.4.194). Retrieved October 31, 2026, from https://docs.ultralytics.com/tasks/segment/

blog/interview/2025/ai-course-exam-crisi.title: Interview: The AI Course Exam Crisis | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
blog/interview/2025/ai-course-exam-crisi.summary: Interview: The AI Course Exam Crisis The full story is in The AI Course Exam Crisis. Interview Version Step Description 中文翻译 Problem In my AI program, the machine learning course was very hard. The exams were on paper, with math and handwritten definitions, and the material was huge: slides, labs and many long readings. After the midterm, the class average was only about 50 to 60 percent. This course is a prerequisite and only runs once a year, so failing it would cost a full year. 在我的 AI 专业里，机器学习这门课非常难。考试是纸笔考试，有数学计算和手写定义，资料又非常多：课件、实验，还有大量很长的阅读材料。期中考试后，全班平均分只有 50 到 60 分左右。这门课是下学期的前置课，一年只开一次，挂科就要损失整整一年。 What I did The professor agreed to change the final to multiple choice, but the scope was still very large. So I built a quiz system by myself, using AI coding tools. It covered all the course materials, the key concepts and the formulas. I practised with it again and again, some topics more than five times. 老师同意把期末改成选择题，但考试范围仍然很大。所以我自己做了一个答题系统，用的是 AI 编程工具。它覆盖了全部课程资料、重点概念和公式。我用它一遍又一遍地练，有些内容练了五遍以上。 Result In the end, almost everyone in the class passed. I learned that under pressure, building the right tool is better than just working harder. 最后，全班几乎所有人都通过了。我学到的是：压力大的时候，做出合适的工具比单纯更努力更有效。 Answers Questions about pressure, a difficult challenge, problem solving and using technology to solve a problem. 用来回答关于压力、困难挑战、解决问题，以及用技术解决问题的提问。

blog/interview/2025/city-of-ottawa-ai-ch.title: Interview: The City of Ottawa AI Chatbot | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
blog/interview/2025/city-of-ottawa-ai-ch.summary: Interview: The City of Ottawa AI Chatbot The full story is in The City of Ottawa AI Chatbot. Interview Version Step Description 中文翻译 Problem In another course, my team built a proof-of-concept AI chatbot for the City of Ottawa. We started with four people, and one left. A classmate with strong English handled the emails and the client, so in practice I was the only one developing. 在另一门课上，我们团队给 City of Ottawa 做了一个 AI 聊天机器人概念验证。团队一开始四个人，后来走了一个。一位英语好的同学负责邮件和对接客户，所以实际上只有我一个人在开发。 What I did I owned the architecture, the front end and back end, and the technology choices. I used React and Python FastAPI. For the RAG part, I compared LangChain and LlamaIndex. I read their source code and chose LlamaIndex because it was much cleaner. I used MinerU to parse PDFs into titles, text and images, stored them in a vector database, and used hybrid search, vector plus BM25. 我负责整体架构、前端和后端，以及技术选型。我用了 React 和 Python FastAPI。RAG 部分我比较了 LangChain 和 LlamaIndex，读了它们的源代码，选了写得清楚得多的 LlamaIndex。我用 MinerU 把 PDF 解析成标题、正文和图片，存进向量数据库，并用了向量检索加 BM25 的混合检索。 Result Later the city asked for Azure services. I shared my code with the city's developer team, and they added features and adapted it to Azure. My code became the base for their version. 后来市政府要求改用 Azure 服务。我把代码交给了市政府的开发团队，他们加了一些功能并适配到 Azure 上。我的代码成了他们版本的基础。 Answers Questions about teamwork, leadership, technical decisions and changing requirements. 用来回答关于团队合作、领导力、技术决策和需求变化的提问。

blog/learning/2025/ai-course-exam-crisis.title: The AI Course Exam Crisis | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
blog/learning/2025/ai-course-exam-crisis.summary: The AI Course Exam Crisis Time: Fall 2025 term Topic: Learning My role: built the quiz system on my own After a failed machine learning midterm, I built a quiz system on my own that covered all of the course materials, and in the end almost everyone in the class passed. 机器学习课期中考砸之后，我自己做了一个覆盖全部课程资料的答题系统，最后基本上全班都通过了。 What Happened The Course Some AI courses taught knowledge that was 10 to 20 years old. The teacher skipped around the textbook, cutting a part here and a part there, so the content was pieced together. I had to look things up and fill the gaps systematically on my own. The machine learning course also used software that companies no longer use; in industry, machine learning is basically all done in Python. We still had to learn it, and that toughened my will. 有些 AI 课程讲的是十年甚至二十年前的知识。老师按教科书跳着讲，这里删一块、那里删一块，内容是拼凑起来的。我只能自己查资料，系统地把缺的部分补上。机器学习课用的软件，现在的公司和市场也已经不用了；行业里机器学习基本都用 Python 做。但我们还得硬着头皮学，这磨砺了我的意志。 Following the Lectures My English is not very good, and with some teachers' accents the words sounded completely different, so I could not connect them. I recorded every lecture with translation software, which sometimes could not understand either, so that I would not miss anything. Afterwards I used AI to sort out the key points. 我的英语不是太好，有些老师有口音，单词发音完全不一样，我没法把它们连起来。为了不漏掉信息，我用翻译软件从头到尾录下每节课，有时翻译软件也听不懂。课后我再用 AI 整理出需要关注的重点。 The Exams The exams were on paper, with math calculations. The teacher did not point out what was important, so I had to organize everything myself. The materials were very broad: slides, lab content, and many links to very long outside articles. Some content was never taught in class but was still tested, including handwritten calculations and handwritten definitions. The pressure was very high. 考试是纸笔考试，有数学计算。老师不划重点，我只能自己整理。资料特别多：PPT、Lab 的内容，还有大量课外链接，都是很长的文章。有些内容课上不讲，但照样会考，包括手写计算题和手写单词定义。压力非常大。 The Midterm At first we reviewed only the slides and the labs, because there were no key points. After the midterm the results were very poor: the class average was about 50 to 60 percent, and many students scored under half. 一开始因为没有重点，我们只复习了 PPT 和 Lab。期中考试成绩非常差：全班平均分大约 50 到 60 分，很多人没有超过一半。 The stakes were high. If the midterm and final together are under half, the course must be retaken. It is a prerequisite for the next semester, so failing it blocks the next semester too. Few students take the AI program, so the course runs only once a year, in September. Failing it wastes a full year of time and tuition and forces a plan B, which is especially serious for international students. 后果很严重。期中加期末如果不过一半，这门课就要重修。它是下学期课程的前置课，挂了下学期也没法上。AI 专业学的人少，这门课每年只在九月开一次，不会在一月或五月开。挂一次就白白浪费一年的时间和学费，还得考虑方案 B，对国际生来说后果尤其严重。 What I Did After the midterm everyone was under great pressure. After talking with the teacher, the final was changed to multiple choice, but the scope was still large. To handle it, I used AI to build a quiz system covering all of the teacher's materials, and we drilled the concepts and math formulas again and again; for the machine learning course, more than five times. 期中之后所有人压力都非常大。跟老师商量后，期末题改成了选择题，但范围还是比较大。为了解决这个问题，我用 AI 做了一个覆盖老师所有资料的答题系统，把概念和数学公式一遍一遍地练，机器学习这门课练了五遍以上。 I built the quiz system by myself. Since September to October 2025 I have been programming with AI (then called vibe coding), mainly with Claude 4; I also used Claude 3.5, which was cheaper but performed worse. The agents were not as smart as now and had many problems, so I tested everything from start to finish. I started with the simplest HTML, CSS and JavaScript, and later moved to frameworks. My product research showed that the courses may not match what future jobs need, so while studying I also taught myself practical skills such as full-stack frameworks and AI. 答题系统是我自己做的。我从 2025 年 9 到 10 月开始用 AI 编程，当时叫 vibe coding，主要用 Claude 4；Claude 3.5 也在用，它便宜，但性能不好。那时的 AI agent 不像现在这么聪明，会有很多问题，所以我从前到后自己测试。一开始用最简单的 HTML、CSS 和 JS，后来换成框架。通过产品研究我发现，老师讲的内容不太符合以后工作的需要，所以我一边上课，一边自己补实际工作会用到的知识，比如全栈开发框架和 AI 相关的知识。 The Result In the end almost everyone passed; only a few did not. 最后基本上大家都过了，只有少部分人没过。 Reflections Learning software the industry no longer uses still toughened my will. 学业界已经不用的软件，也磨砺了我的意志。

blog/projects/2025/city-of-ottawa-ai-cha.title: The City of Ottawa AI Chatbot | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
blog/projects/2025/city-of-ottawa-ai-cha.summary: The City of Ottawa AI Chatbot Time: September 2025 to April 2026 Topic: Projects My role: architecture, front end and back end, technology selection In a course project for the City of Ottawa, I built most of a proof-of-concept AI chatbot on my own, chose its RAG components after reading their source code, and later handed the code to the City's development team, who adapted it to Azure. 在给 City of Ottawa 做的课程项目里，AI chatbot 概念验证的大部分是我一个人做的。RAG 组件是我读过源代码后选定的；后来我把代码交给市政府的开发团队，由他们适配到 Azure。 What Happened The Project Another course had us build a proof of concept for the City of Ottawa: an AI chatbot. At first the city gave us no clear technology stack, so we wrote it entirely with open-source components. The front end was React and the back end was Python FastAPI. 另一门课要给 City of Ottawa 做一个概念验证 POC：一个 AI chatbot。前期他们没有给我们明确的技术栈，所以一开始我们完全用开源方案来写。前端用的是 React，后端用的是 Python FastAPI。 The Team The team had four people; one dropped out last semester, leaving three. A classmate with good English but no software development background replied to emails and worked with the client. The other classmate felt the course load was too heavy and had no time to develop. We had no time to discuss splitting the work, so I did basically all of the early work: the overall architecture, front end and back end, technology selection and functional analysis. 团队一开始有四个人，上学期一个人退了，剩下三个人。一位英语好的同学没有软件开发基础，负责回复邮件和对接客户。另一位同学觉得课程压力比较大，没有时间开发。我们也没有时间讨论分工，所以前期基本上都是我一个人在做：整体架构、前后端开发、技术选型和功能分析。 Choosing the Components We chose LlamaIndex, not LangChain. I read LangChain's source code and found it very messy; LlamaIndex was written much more clearly. 我们没有选 LangChain，选的是 LlamaIndex。因为我看了 LangChain 的源代码，写得非常乱，不如 LlamaIndex 清晰。 RAG projects were very popular last year. We used MinerU to scan the PDFs: it identified which parts were titles, body text and images, tagged them and built an index, turning them into text that could be stored in our vector database. That made RAG retrieval and BM25 retrieval straightforward afterwards. 去年 RAG 相关的项目非常火。我们用 MinerU 扫描 PDF，识别出哪些是标题、哪些是正文、哪些是图片，打上标记并建立索引，把它们转成文本，这样就能存进我们的向量数据库。之后再做 RAG 检索和 BM25 检索就比较方便。 I did all of this research by myself. The Chinese-language internet has a very active AI community, so in my free time I kept reading AI news and posts there, learning and researching on my own, and worked these choices out step by step. 这些调研都是我一个人做的。中文互联网的 AI 社区非常活跃，我休息的时候没事就刷相关的 AI 信息，自己学习、自己研究，一点点摸索出了这些方案。 Moving to Azure Later, in the next semester, the city required Azure services. The City of Ottawa has a small development team of its own; we shared our code with them, and they added features and fine-tuned it for Azure. The open-source components that had Azure equivalents were replaced with Azure services. 后来到了下学期，他们强制要求用 Azure 相关的服务。City of Ottawa 那边也有一个小的开发团队，我们把之前写的代码分享给他们，他们在我们的基础上加了一些功能，做了微调，用于适配 Azure。可以用 Azure 服务替代的开源组件都被换掉了。 Reflections Not written yet.

事件溯源 "Use an append-only store to record a full series of events that describe actions taken on data in a domain." 使用仅追加存储来记录一系列完整的事件，这些事件描述对某个域中数据执行的操作。 Microsoft, 2026, "Catalog of patterns" table, "Event Sourcing" row Gateway Aggregation 网关聚合 "Use a gateway to aggregate multiple individual requests into a single request." 使用网关，把多个单独的请求聚合为一个请求。 Microsoft, 2026, "Catalog of patterns" table, "Gateway Aggregation" row Gateway Offloading 网关卸载 "Offload shared or specialized service functionality to a gateway proxy." 把共享或专用的服务功能卸载到网关代理。 Microsoft, 2026, "Catalog of patterns" table, "Gateway Publisher-Subscriber 发布服务器-订阅服务器 "Enable an application to announce events to multiple consumers asynchronously, without coupling senders to receivers." 让应用程序能够异步地向多个使用者发布事件，而不把发送方和接收方耦合在一起。 Cloud readiness reduces cutover risk and ensures compatibility with Azure services." （语境）迁移到 Azure 之前，工作负载必须做好上云准备。上云准备降低切换风险，并确保与 Azure 服务兼容。 Microsoft, 2025h, para. 1 Execute (Migration) 执行（迁移） (context) "This article provides structured guidance for executing a successful migration to Azure. cloud/azure/cloud-computing/actors.html.title: 1.3 Actors | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
cloud/azure/cloud-computing/actors.html.summary: 1.3 Actors Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文解释 Source Actors 参与者 "... the NIST cloud computing reference architecture defines five major actors: cloud consumer, cloud provider, cloud carrier, cloud auditor and cloud broker. Each actor is an entity (a person or an organization) that participates in a transaction or process and/or performs tasks in cloud computing." ……NIST 云计算参考架构定义了五个主要参与者：云使用者、云提供者、云运营商、云审计者和云代理。每个参与者都是一个实体（个人或组织），它参与事务或流程，和/或在云计算中执行任务。 Liu et al., 2011, Section 2.1, para. 2 Cloud consumer 云使用者 "A cloud consumer represents a person or organization that maintains a business relationship with, and uses the service from a cloud provider." 云使用者是一个个人或组织，它与云提供者保持业务关系，并使用其服务。 Liu et al., 2011, Section 2.2, para. 1 SaaS consumers SaaS 使用者 "The consumers of SaaS can be organizations that provide their members with access to software applications, end users who directly use software applications, or software application administrators who configure applications for end users." SaaS 的使用者可以是为成员提供软件应用程序访问权限的组织、直接使用软件应用程序的最终用户，或为最终用户配置应用程序的软件应用程序管理员。 Liu et al., 2011, Section 2.2, para. 4 PaaS consumers PaaS 使用者 "Cloud consumers of PaaS can employ the tools and execution resources provided by cloud providers to develop, test, deploy and manage the applications hosted in a cloud environment." PaaS 的云使用者可以利用云提供者提供的工具和执行资源，来开发、测试、部署和管理应用程序（这些应用程序托管在云环境中）。 Liu et al., 2011, Section 2.2, para. 5 IaaS consumers IaaS 使用者 "Consumers of IaaS have access to virtual computers, network-accessible storage, network infrastructure components, and other fundamental computing resources on which they can deploy and run arbitrary software." IaaS 的使用者可以访问虚拟计算机、可通过网络访问的存储、网络基础结构组件以及其他基本计算资源，并在其上部署和运行任意软件。 Liu et al., 2011, Section 2.2, para. 6 Cloud provider 云提供者 "A cloud provider is a person, an organization; it is the entity responsible for making a service available to interested parties." 云提供者是一个人或一个组织；它是负责提供服务的实体，服务对象是相关方。 Liu et al., 2011, Section 2.3, para. 1 Service deployment 服务部署 (context) "As identified in the NIST cloud computing definition [1], a cloud infrastructure may be operated in one of the following deployment models: public cloud, private cloud, community cloud, or hybrid cloud." （语境）正如 NIST 云计算定义 [1] 所指出的，云基础结构可以按以下部署模型之一运营：公有云、私有云、社区云或混合云。 Liu et al., 2011, Section 3.1, para. 1 Service orchestration 服务编排 "Service Orchestration refers to the composition of system components to support the Cloud Providers activities in arrangement, coordination and management of computing resources in order to provide cloud services to Cloud Consumers." 服务编排是指系统组件的组合，用来支持云提供者在计算资源的安排、协调和管理方面的活动，以便向云使用者提供云服务。 Liu et al., 2011, Section 3.2, para. 1 Cloud service management 云服务管理 "Cloud Service Management includes all of the service-related functions that are necessary for the management and operation of those services required by or proposed to cloud consumers." 云服务管理包括所有与服务相关的功能，这些功能是云使用者所需或向其提议的服务的管理和运营所必需的。 Liu et al., 2011, Section 3.3, para. 1 Security 安全 "It is critical to recognize that security is a cross-cutting aspect of the architecture that spans across all layers of the reference model, ranging from physical security to application security." 必须认识到，安全是架构的一个横切方面，它贯穿参考模型的所有层，从物理安全到应用程序安全。 Liu et al., 2011, Section 3.4, para. 1 Privacy 隐私 (context) "Cloud providers should protect the assured, proper, and consistent collection, processing, communication, use and disposition of personal information (PI) and personally identifiable information (PII) in the cloud [14]." （语境）云提供者应当保护云中个人信息 (PI) 和个人身份信息 (PII) 的收集、处理、通信、使用和处置，使其有保障、恰当且一致。 Liu et al., 2011, Section 3.5, para. 1 Cloud auditor 云审计者 "A cloud auditor is a party that can perform an independent examination of cloud service controls with the intent to express an opinion thereon." 云审计者是一方，它能够对云服务控制措施进行独立检查，目的是对其发表意见。 Liu et al., 2011, Section 2.4, para. 1 Security controls 安全控制措施 "Security controls [3] are the management, operational, and technical safeguards or countermeasures employed within an organizational information system to protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the system and its information." 安全控制措施 [3] 是组织的信息系统中采用的管理、运营和技术保护措施或对策，用于保护机密性、完整性和可用性，对象是系统及其信息。 Liu et al., 2011, Section 2.4, para. 2 Privacy impact 隐私影响 "A privacy impact audit can help Federal agencies comply with applicable privacy laws and regulations governing an individuals privacy, and to ensure confidentiality, integrity, and availability of an individuals personal information at every stage of development and operation." 隐私影响审计可以帮助联邦机构遵守适用的隐私法律法规（这些法律法规管理个人隐私），并在开发和运营的每个阶段确保机密性、完整性和可用性，对象是个人的个人信息。 Liu et al., 2011, Section 2.4, para. 3 Performance 性能 (context) "A cloud auditor can evaluate the services provided by a cloud provider in terms of security controls, privacy impact, performance, etc." （语境）云审计者可以评估云提供者所提供的服务，评估方面包括安全控制措施、隐私影响、性能等。 Liu et al., 2011, Section 2.4, para. 1 Cloud broker 云代理 "A cloud broker is an entity that manages the use, performance and delivery of cloud services and negotiates relationships between cloud providers and cloud consumers." 云代理是一个实体，它管理云服务的使用、性能和交付，并在云提供者和云使用者之间协商关系。 Liu et al., 2011, Section 2.5, para. 1 Service intermediation 服务中介 "Service Intermediation: A cloud broker enhances a given service by improving some specific capability and providing value-added services to cloud consumers." 服务中介：云代理增强某项服务，方法是改进某些特定能力并向云使用者提供增值服务。 Liu et al., 2011, Section 2.5, list item 1 Service aggregation 服务聚合 "Service Aggregation: A cloud broker combines and integrates multiple Azure 的核心体系结构组件可以分为两个主要分组：物理基础结构和管理基础结构。 Microsoft, n.d., "Describe Azure physical infrastructure" unit, para. 1 Physical infrastructure 物理基础结构 "The physical infrastructure for Azure starts with datacenters. These datacenters are facilities with servers arranged in racks, with dedicated power, cooling, and networking infrastructure ..." Azure 的物理基础结构从数据中心开始。这些数据中心是一些设施，其中的服务器排列在机架中，并配有专用的电源、冷却和网络基础结构…… Microsoft, n.d., "Describe Azure physical infrastructure" unit, "Physical infrastructure" section, para. 1 Management infrastructure 管理基础结构 "The management infrastructure includes Azure resources and resource groups, subscriptions, and accounts." 管理基础结构包括 Azure 资源和资源组、订阅以及帐户。 Microsoft, n.d., "Describe Azure management infrastructure" unit, para. 1 Coverage Certification Skill area AZ-900 Microsoft Azure Fundamentals Describe Azure architecture and services (35–40%) References Microsoft. cloud/azure/core-architectural-component.title: 2.2 Management Infrastructure | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
cloud/azure/core-architectural-component.summary: 2.2 Management Infrastructure Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文解释 Source Management infrastructure 管理基础结构 "The management infrastructure includes Azure resources and resource groups, subscriptions, and accounts." 管理基础结构包括 Azure 资源和资源组、订阅以及帐户。 Microsoft, n.d.-b, unit introduction, para. 1 Resources 资源 "A resource is the basic building block of Azure. Anything you create, provision, or deploy is a resource." 资源是 Azure 的基本构建基块。你创建、预配或部署的任何内容都是资源。 Microsoft, n.d.-b, "Azure resources and resource groups" section, para. 1 Resource groups 资源组 "Resource groups are groupings of resources. Every resource must belong to exactly one resource group." 资源组是资源的分组。每个资源都必须属于恰好一个资源组。 Microsoft, n.d.-b, "Azure resources and resource groups" section, para. 2 Subscriptions 订阅 "In Azure, subscriptions are a unit of management, billing, and scale." 在 Azure 中，订阅是管理、计费和缩放的单位。 Microsoft, n.d.-b, "Azure subscriptions" section, para. 1 Billing boundary 计费边界 "Billing boundary: Determines how an Azure account is billed." 计费边界：决定 Azure 帐户如何计费。 Microsoft, n.d.-b, "Azure subscriptions" section, list item 1 Access control boundary 访问控制边界 "Access control boundary: Azure applies access-management policies at the subscription level." 访问控制边界：Azure 在订阅级别应用访问管理策略。 Microsoft, n.d.-b, "Azure subscriptions" section, list item 2 Management groups 管理组 "Azure management groups sit above subscriptions. You organize subscriptions into management groups and apply governance conditions — like access policies or compliance rules — to the group." Azure 管理组位于订阅之上。你把订阅组织到管理组中，并对该组应用治理条件（如访问策略或合规性规则）。 Microsoft, n.d.-b, "Azure management groups" section, para. 2 Tenant Root Group 租户根组 "Every Microsoft Entra tenant has a single top-level Tenant Root Group. All other management groups and subscriptions fold up to this root group, which lets you apply governance policies globally." 每个 Microsoft Entra 租户都有一个顶级租户根组。所有其他管理组和订阅都向上归入这个根组，这样你就可以在全局应用治理策略。 Microsoft, n.d.-b, "Azure management groups" section, para. 3 Azure account Azure 帐户 "An Azure subscription links to an Azure account, which is an identity in Microsoft Entra ID or in a directory that Microsoft Entra ID trusts." Azure 订阅链接到一个 Azure 帐户，该帐户是 Microsoft Entra ID 中的标识，或 Microsoft Entra ID 信任的目录中的标识。 Microsoft, n.d.-b, "Azure subscriptions" section, para. 2 Azure free account Azure 免费帐户 "The Azure free account is an excellent way for new users to get started and explore." Azure 免费帐户是新用户的绝佳方式，可用来入门和探索。 Microsoft, n.d.-a, "What is the Azure free account?" section, para. 2 Azure free student account Azure 免费学生帐户 "The Azure free student account is an offer for students that gives $100 credit and free developer tools." Azure 免费学生帐户是面向学生的优惠，提供 100 美元额度和免费开发人员工具。 Microsoft, n.d.-a, "What is the Azure free student account?" section, para. 2 References Microsoft. (n.d.-a). Get started with Azure accounts [Training unit]. Microsoft Learn. Retrieved October 26, 2026, from https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/training/modules/describe-core-architectural-components-of-azure/3-get-started-azure-accounts Microsoft. (n.d.-b). Describe Azure management infrastructure [Training unit]. Microsoft Learn. Retrieved October 18, 2026, from https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/training/modules/describe-core-architectural-components-of-azure/6-describe-azure-management-infrastructure

cloud/azure/core-architectural-component.summary: 2.1 Physical Infrastructure Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文解释 Source Physical infrastructure 物理基础结构 "This unit covers the physical side — how Azure organizes its datacenters, regions, and availability zones to deliver reliable services worldwide." 本单元介绍物理层面：Azure 如何组织其数据中心、区域和可用区，以在全球提供可靠的服务。 Microsoft, n.d.-b, unit introduction, para. 1 Datacenters 数据中心 "These datacenters are facilities with servers arranged in racks, with dedicated power, cooling, and networking infrastructure — similar to an on-premises datacenter, but at a much larger scale." 这些数据中心是放置成排机架服务器的设施，配有专用的供电、冷却和网络基础结构，类似于本地数据中心，但规模大得多。 Microsoft, n.d.-b, "Physical infrastructure" section, para. 1 Servers arranged in racks 成排机架服务器 (context) "These datacenters are facilities with servers arranged in racks, with dedicated power, cooling, and networking infrastructure — similar to an on-premises datacenter, but at a much larger scale." （语境）这些数据中心是放置成排机架服务器的设施，配有专用的供电、冷却和网络基础结构，类似于本地数据中心，但规模大得多。 Microsoft, n.d.-b, "Physical infrastructure" section, para. 1 Power 供电 (context) "These datacenters are facilities with servers arranged in racks, with dedicated power, cooling, and networking infrastructure — similar to an on-premises datacenter, but at a much larger scale." （语境）这些数据中心是放置成排机架服务器的设施，配有专用的供电、冷却和网络基础结构，类似于本地数据中心，但规模大得多。 Microsoft, n.d.-b, "Physical infrastructure" section, para. 1 Cooling 冷却 (context) "These datacenters are facilities with servers arranged in racks, with dedicated power, cooling, and networking infrastructure — similar to an on-premises datacenter, but at a much larger scale." （语境）这些数据中心是放置成排机架服务器的设施，配有专用的供电、冷却和网络基础结构，类似于本地数据中心，但规模大得多。 Microsoft, n.d.-b, "Physical infrastructure" section, para. 1 Networking infrastructure 网络基础结构 (context) "These datacenters are facilities with servers arranged in racks, with dedicated power, cooling, and networking infrastructure — similar to an on-premises datacenter, but at a much larger scale." （语境）这些数据中心是放置成排机架服务器的设施，配有专用的供电、冷却和网络基础结构，类似于本地数据中心，但规模大得多。 Microsoft, n.d.-b, "Physical infrastructure" section, para. 1 Availability zones 可用区 "Availability zones are physically separate datacenters within an Azure region." 可用区是物理上分离的数据中心，位于 Azure 区域内。 Microsoft, n.d.-b, "Availability Zones" section, para. 1 Zonal services 可用区服务 "Zonal services: You pin the resource to a specific zone (for example, VMs, managed disks, IP addresses)." 可用区服务：你把资源固定到特定的可用区（例如虚拟机、托管磁盘、IP 地址）。 Microsoft, n.d.-b, "Use availability zones for your workloads" section, list item 1 Zone-redundant services 区域冗余服务 "Zone-redundant services: The platform replicates automatically across zones (for example, zone-redundant storage, SQL Database)." 区域冗余服务：平台自动跨可用区复制（例如区域冗余存储、SQL 数据库）。 Microsoft, n.d.-b, "Use availability zones for your workloads" section, list item 2 Non-regional services 非区域服务 "Non-regional services: Services are always available from Azure geographies and are resilient to zone-wide outages as well as region-wide outages." 非区域服务：服务始终可从 Azure 地理位置获得，并且能承受整个可用区乃至整个区域的中断。 Microsoft, n.d.-b, "Use availability zones for your workloads" section, list item 3 Regions 区域 "An Azure region consists of one or more datacenters, connected by a high-capacity, fault-tolerant, low-latency network connection." Azure 区域由一个或多个数据中心组成，这些数据中心通过高容量、容错、低延迟的网络连接互联。 Microsoft, 2026b, "Understand Azure regions and geographies" section, para. 1 Low-latency network 低延迟网络 (context) "A region is a geographical area on the planet that contains at least one, but potentially multiple datacenters that are nearby and networked together with a low-latency network." （语境）区域是地球上的一个地理区域，包含至少一个、也可能多个数据中心，它们彼此相邻，并通过低延迟网络互联。 Microsoft, n.d.-b, "Regions" section, para. 1 Region pairs 区域对 "Most Azure regions are paired with another region within the same geography (such as US, Europe, or Asia) at least 300 miles away." 大多数 Azure 区域都与另一个区域配对，后者位于同一地理位置（如美国、欧洲或亚洲），且相距至少 300 英里。 Microsoft, n.d.-b, "Region pairs" section, para. 1 Paired in two directions 双向配对 "Most regions are paired in two directions, meaning they are the backup for the region that provides a backup for them (West US and East US back each other up)." 大多数区域是双向配对的，也就是说，它们为给自己提供备份的那个区域提供备份（美国西部和美国东部互为备份）。 Microsoft, n.d.-b, "Additional advantages of region pairs" section, "Important" note Paired in only one direction 单向配对 "However, some regions, such as Brazil South, are paired in only one direction. In a one-direction pairing, the Primary region does not provide backup for its secondary region." 不过，有些区域（如巴西南部）只单向配对。在单向配对中，主区域不为其次要区域提供备份。 Microsoft, n.d.-b, "Additional advantages of region pairs" section, "Important" note Data-residency 数据驻留 "Every region is contained within a single geography that serves as a fixed data residency boundary." 每个区域都位于单一的地理区域内，该地理区域是一个固定的数据驻留边界。 Microsoft, 2026b, "Understand Azure regions and geographies" section, para. 3; term from Microsoft, n.d.-b, "Additional advantages of region pairs" section, list item 3 Sovereign regions 主权区域 "In addition to regular regions, Azure also has sovereign regions. Sovereign regions are instances of Azure that are isolated from the main instance of Azure. You may need to use a sovereign region for compliance or legal purposes." 除了普通区域，Azure 还有主权区域。主权区域是 Azure 的实例，它们与 Azure 的主实例隔离。出于合规或法律原因，你可能需要使用主权区域。 Microsoft, n.d.-b, "Sovereign Regions" section, para. 1 Sovereignty 主权 "Sovereignty means you retain control over your data and ensure that data remains subject to your jurisdiction's laws." 主权意味着你保留对数据的控制，并确保数据始终受你所在司法管辖区的法律约束。 Microsoft, 2026a, "What sovereignty means for a reliable workload" section, para. 1 Azure Government Azure 政府 "A dedicated cloud for U.S. government agencies and their partners." 一个专供美国政府机构及其合作伙伴使用的专用云。 Microsoft, n.d.-a, "Azure clouds" section, item 1 Microsoft Azure operated by 21Vianet 由世纪互联运营的 Microsoft Azure "A dedicated cloud located in China and operated by 21Vianet." 一个位于中国、由世纪互联运营的专用云。 Microsoft, n.d.-a, "Azure clouds" section, item 2 Microsoft Sovereign Cloud Microsoft 主权云 (context) "Microsoft Sovereign Cloud supports logical isolation patterns within Azure public cloud." （语境）Microsoft Sovereign Cloud 支持在 Azure 公有云内采用逻辑隔离模式。 Microsoft, 2026a, "Azure capabilities that support sovereignty" section, list item 3 References Microsoft. Microsoft Learn. Databases Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source Databases 数据库 "A database is a structured system for storing, managing, and retrieving data, enabling everything from simple recordkeeping to powering complex applications and services." 数据库是一种结构化系统，用于存储、管理和检索数据，用途从简单的记录保存到驱动复杂的应用程序和服务。 Microsoft, n.d., para. 1 Relational data stores 关系数据存储 "Relational database management systems organize data into normalized tables by using schema-on-write." 关系数据库管理系统使用写入时架构，把数据组织成规范化的表。 Microsoft, 2025, "Relational data stores" section, para. 1 Document data stores 文档数据存储 "Use document data stores to store semi-structured documents, often in JSON format, where each document includes named fields and data." 使用文档数据存储来存放半结构化文档，通常是 JSON 格式，每个文档都包含命名字段和数据。 Microsoft, 2025, "Document data stores" section, para. 1 Column-family data stores 列族数据存储 "A column-family database, also known as a wide-column database, stores sparse data into rows and organizes dynamic columns into column families to support co-access." 列族数据库也叫宽列数据库，它把稀疏数据存成行，并把动态列组织成列族，以便一起访问。 Microsoft, 2025, "Column-family data stores" section, para. 1 Key-value data stores 键值数据存储 "A key-value data store associates each data value with a unique key." 键值数据存储把每个数据值和一个唯一的键关联起来。 Microsoft, 2025, "Key-value data stores" section, para. 1 Graph data stores 图数据存储 "A graph database stores information as nodes and edges." 图数据库把信息存成节点和边。 Microsoft, 2025, "Graph data stores" section, para. 1 Time-series data stores 时间序列数据存储 "Time-series data stores manage a set of values organized by time." 时间序列数据存储管理一组按时间组织的值。 Microsoft, 2025, "Time-series data stores" section, para. 1 Coverage Certification Skill area DP-900 Microsoft Azure Data Fundamentals Identify considerations for relational data on Azure (20–25%) Describe considerations for working with non-relational data on Azure (15–20%) References Microsoft. cloud/azure/databases/relational-data-st.title: 9.1 Relational Data Stores | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
cloud/azure/databases/relational-data-st.summary: 9.1 Relational Data Stores Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source SQL Database SQL 数据库 "SQL Database is a managed relational database for modern cloud applications that use the SQL Server engine." SQL 数据库是一种托管关系数据库，面向现代云应用程序，使用的是 SQL Server 引擎。 Microsoft, 2025, "Select an Azure service for relational data stores" section, list item 1 Dynamic data masking 动态数据掩码 "Azure SQL Database, SQL database in Microsoft Fabric, and Azure SQL Managed Instance support dynamic data masking (DDM). Dynamic data masking limits sensitive data exposure by masking it to nonprivileged users." Azure SQL 数据库、Microsoft Fabric 中的 SQL 数据库和 Azure SQL 托管实例都支持动态数据掩码（DDM）。动态数据掩码通过对非特权用户掩盖敏感数据来减少敏感数据的暴露。 Microsoft, 2026, para. 1 Default 默认 "Default Full masking according to the data types of the designated fields" 默认：按指定字段的数据类型进行完全掩码。 Microsoft, 2026, "Dynamic data masking policy" section, "Masking functions" table, row 1 Credit card 信用卡 "Credit card Masking method, which exposes the last four digits of the designated fields and adds a constant string as a prefix in the form of a credit card." 信用卡：只露出指定字段的最后四位，并在前面加一个信用卡格式的固定字符串。 Microsoft, 2026, "Dynamic data masking policy" section, "Masking functions" table, row 2 Email 电子邮件 "Email Masking method, which exposes the first letter and replaces the domain with XXXX.com using a constant string prefix in the form of an email address." 电子邮件：只露出第一个字母，并把域名替换成 XXXX.com，前缀是电子邮件格式的固定字符串。 Microsoft, 2026, "Dynamic data masking policy" section, "Masking functions" table, row 3 Random number 随机数 "Random number Masking method, which generates a random number according to the selected boundaries and actual data types." 随机数：生成一个随机数，范围按所选的边界和实际数据类型决定。 Microsoft, 2026, "Dynamic data masking policy" section, "Masking functions" table, row 4 Custom text 自定义文本 "Custom text Masking method, which exposes the first and last characters and adds a custom padding string in the middle." 自定义文本：只露出首尾字符，中间加一段自定义的填充字符串。 Microsoft, 2026, "Dynamic data masking policy" section, "Masking functions" table, row 5 Datetime 日期时间 "Datetime Enables granular masking for date/time columns, namely datetime, datetime2, date, time, datetimeoffset, and smalldatetime." 日期时间：对日期/时间列做细粒度掩码，即 datetime、datetime2、date、time、datetimeoffset 和 smalldatetime。 Microsoft, 2026, "Dynamic data masking policy" section, "Masking functions" table, row 6 Azure SQL Managed Instance Azure SQL 托管实例 "Azure SQL Managed Instance is a near-complete SQL Server environment in the cloud that's ideal for lift-and-shift migrations." This process of identification is called discovery." 迁移之旅的第一步是识别你的工作负载。这个识别过程称为发现。 Microsoft, n.d., "Decide" section, para. 1 Azure Migrate project Azure Migrate 项目 "A project is used to store discovery, assessment, and migration metadata collected from the environment you're assessing or migrating. Migration Classification Process Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source Migration 迁移 "Cloud migration is the process of moving applications and data from one location, often a company's private, on-premises servers, to a public cloud provider's servers, but it can also entail moving resources between different clouds." 云迁移是把应用程序和数据从一个位置（通常是公司自己的本地服务器）迁到公有云提供商的服务器上的过程，也可以是在不同的云之间迁移资源。 Microsoft, n.d., "Cloud migration definition" section, para. 1 Migration strategies 迁移策略 "There are multiple migration strategies, sometimes known as the "Rs" of cloud migration." 迁移有多种策略，有时被称为云迁移的"R"。 Microsoft, 2025, para. 1 Migration phases 迁移阶段 "A general migration journey includes the following phases. Azure Migrate provides support at each phase." 一般的迁移之旅包括以下几个阶段。Azure Migrate 在每个阶段都提供支持。 Microsoft, 2026b, "Migration phases" section, para. 2 Decide 决策 "The first step in a migration journey is to identify your workloads." 迁移之旅的第一步是识别你的工作负载。 Microsoft, 2026b, "Decide" section, para. 1 Plan 规划 "After you make the decision to migrate to Azure, the next important phase of migration is planning." 在你决定迁移到 Azure 之后，迁移的下一个重要阶段是规划。 Microsoft, 2026b, "Plan" section, para. 1 Execute 执行 "In the execution phase, you perform the migration or modernization of your workloads to move to Azure." 在执行阶段，你对工作负载进行迁移或现代化，把它们迁到 Azure。 Microsoft, 2026b, "Execute" section, para. 1 Replication 复制 "After setting up the appliance and completing discovery, you can begin replication of VMware VMs to Azure." 设置好设备并完成发现后，就可以开始把 VMware 虚拟机复制到 Azure。 Microsoft, 2026c, "Execute migrations" section, para. 1 Test migration 测试迁移 "Test migration simulates the migration by creating an Azure VM using replicated data (usually migrating to a non-production VNet in your Azure subscription)." 测试迁移用复制过来的数据创建一台 Azure 虚拟机，模拟迁移（通常迁到 Azure 订阅里一个非生产的虚拟网络）。 Microsoft, 2026c, "Run a test migration" section, bullet 2 Migrate VMs 迁移虚拟机 "After you've verified that the test migration works as expected, you can migrate the source (on-premises or AVS) machines." 确认测试迁移符合预期后，就可以迁移源（本地或 AVS）计算机。 Microsoft, 2026c, "Migrate VMs" section, para. 1 Complete migration 完成迁移 "This stops replication for the source (on-premises or AVS) machine, and cleans up replication state information for the VM." 这一步停止源（本地或 AVS）计算机的复制，并清理该虚拟机的复制状态信息。 Microsoft, 2026c, "Complete the migration" section, step 1 Coverage Certification Skill area AZ-900 Microsoft Azure Fundamentals Describe Azure architecture and services (35–40%) AZ-305 Designing Microsoft Azure Infrastructure Solutions Design infrastructure solutions (30–35%) References Microsoft. cloud/azure/migration/migration-strategi.summary: 24.1 Migration Strategies Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文解释 Source Migration strategies 迁移策略 "There are multiple migration strategies, sometimes known as the 'Rs' of cloud migration. Each workload can be Retired, Retained, Rehosted, Replatformed, Refactored, Rearchitected, Rebuilt, or Replaced." 有多种迁移策略，有时称为云迁移的 R 策略。每个工作负载都可以被停用、保留、重新托管、更换平台、重构、重新架构、重建或替换。 Microsoft, n.d., "Select your cloud migration strategies" introduction, para. 1 Retire 停用 "Retire decommissions workloads that no longer provide business value." Retire 会停用工作负载，这些工作负载不再提供业务价值。 Microsoft, n.d., "1. Retire (decommission)" section, para. 1 Rehost 重新托管 (also known as lift-and-shift) "A rehost strategy enables fast and low-risk migration by moving workloads to Azure with minimal changes." Also known as lift-and-shift: "Azure Migrate supports rehosting (also known as lift-and-shift)." 重新托管策略实现快速、低风险的迁移，方法是以最少的更改把工作负载移到 Azure。 也称为 lift-and-shift（直接迁移）："Azure Migrate 支持重新托管（也称为 lift-and-shift）。" Microsoft, n.d., "2. Rehost (like-for-like migration)" section, para. 1 Microsoft, 2024, "What migration approaches do I have with Azure Migrate…?" section, para. 2 Replatform 更换平台 "Replatforming moves workloads to a modern hosting environment with minimal code changes." 更换平台把工作负载移到现代托管环境，只需极少的代码更改。 Microsoft, n.d., "3. Replatform (modernize hosting environment)" section, para. 1 Refactor 重构 "Refactoring improves the internal structure of code without adding new features." 重构改进代码的内部结构，但不添加新功能。 Microsoft, n.d., "4. Refactor (modernize code)" section, para. 1 Rearchitect 重新架构 "A rearchitect strategy redesigns the workload's architecture to improve scalability, agility, and service orientation." 重新架构策略重新设计工作负载的架构，以提升可伸缩性、敏捷性和面向服务的程度。 Microsoft, n.d., "5. Rearchitect (modernize architecture and code)" section, para. 1 Replace 替换 "A replace strategy uses commercial SaaS solutions to eliminate the need for custom development and ongoing maintenance." 替换策略使用商业 SaaS 解决方案，从而无需自定义开发和持续维护。 Microsoft, n.d., "6. Replace (use SaaS alternative)" section, para. 1 Rebuild 重建 "A rebuild strategy is a full redevelopment of a workload using cloud-native solutions." 重建策略是对工作负载的完全重新开发，使用云原生解决方案。 Microsoft, n.d., "7. Rebuild (build cloud-native)" section, para. 1 Retain 保留 "A retain strategy keeps workloads in their current environment when they're stable, compliant, and meet all current and future business needs with no near-term driver to move." 保留策略让工作负载留在当前环境中，前提是它们稳定、合规，并满足当前和未来的所有业务需求，且近期没有迁移的驱动因素。 Microsoft, n.d., "8. Retain (keep as is)" section, para. 1 References Microsoft. (n.d.). Select your cloud migration strategies. Cloud Adoption Framework. Microsoft Learn. cloud/azure/migration/plan.html.summary: 24.3 Plan Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文解释 Source Plan 计划 "After you make the decision to migrate to Azure, the next important phase of migration is planning. To plan migration in detail, use Azure Migrate assessments to find:" 决定迁移到 Azure 之后，迁移的下一个重要阶段是规划。要详细规划迁移，请使用 Azure Migrate 评估来确定： Microsoft, n.d., "Plan" section, para. 1 Discovery and Assessment 发现和评估 "Discover and assess on-premises servers running on VMware, Hyper-V, and physical servers in preparation for migration to Azure." 发现并评估本地服务器，这些服务器运行在 VMware、Hyper-V 和物理服务器上，为迁移到 Azure 做准备。 Microsoft, n.d., "Integrated tools and features" section, "Discovery and Assessment" row, Details Movere Movere "Discover and assess on-premises workloads. This tool is retired. Use Azure Migrate for your migration journey." 发现并评估本地工作负载。 此工具已停用。请使用 Azure Migrate 完成迁移之旅。 Microsoft, n.d., "Integrated tools and features" section, "Movere" row, Function and Details Assessment 评估 "An assessment with the Discovery and assessment tool measures the readiness and estimates the effect of migrating on-premises servers to Azure." 使用发现和评估工具进行的评估会衡量就绪性，并估算把本地服务器迁移到 Azure 的影响。 Microsoft, 2026, "What's an assessment?" section, para. 1 Azure readiness Azure 就绪性 "Azure readiness: Assess whether on-premises servers, SQL servers, and web apps are ready for migration to Azure." Azure 就绪性：评估本地服务器、SQL 服务器和 Web 应用是否已准备好迁移到 Azure。 Microsoft, n.d., "Plan" section, list item 1 Ready for Azure Azure 就绪 "Ready for Azure: The server can be migrated as-is to Azure without any changes. It will start in Azure with full Azure support." Azure 就绪：服务器可以不做任何更改、按原样迁移到 Azure。它会在 Azure 中启动，并获得完整的 Azure 支持。 Microsoft, 2026, "Calculate readiness" section, list item 1 Conditionally ready for Azure 有条件就绪 "Conditionally ready for Azure: The server might start in Azure but might not have full Azure support. For example, Azure doesn't support a server that's running an old version of Windows Server." 有条件就绪：服务器可能可以在 Azure 中启动，但可能没有完整的 Azure 支持。例如，Azure 不支持运行旧版 Windows Server 的服务器。 Microsoft, 2026, "Calculate readiness" section, list item 2 Not ready for Azure 未就绪 "Not ready for Azure: The server won't start in Azure. Azure 平台通过底层基础结构、服务和流程，提供基本的可靠性，面向所有客户和所有服务。 Microsoft, 2026b, "Shared responsibility model for reliability" section, list item 1 Reliability-enhancing capabilities 可靠性增强功能 "Azure offers a suite of built-in features and services that enhance reliability, such as using availability zones, deploying across multiple regions, and implementing backup strategies. While Azure provides these capabilities, it's your responsibility to evaluate and configure them to align with your specific requirements." Azure 提供一套增强可靠性的内置功能和服务，例如使用可用区、跨多个区域部署以及实施备份策略。虽然 Azure 提供这些功能，但评估和配置它们是你的责任，以符合你的具体要求。 Microsoft, 2026b, "Shared responsibility model for reliability" section, list item 2 Applications 应用程序 "To make effective use of the other levels, you must design your application and workload for reliability." 要有效利用其他层级，你必须为可靠性设计你的应用程序和工作负载。 Microsoft, 2026b, "Shared responsibility model for reliability" section, list item 3 High availability 高可用性 "High availability is the state in which a specific workload can maintain its necessary level of uptime on a day-to-day basis, even during transient faults and intermittent failures." 高可用性是指特定工作负载能够日常保持所需正常运行时间水平的状态，即使在发生暂时性故障和间歇性失败时也是如此。 Microsoft, 2025a, "High availability" section, para. 1 Fault tolerance 容错 "Fault tolerance is the ability of a system to continue operating, in some defined capacity, in the event of a failure." 容错是系统在发生故障时仍能以某种既定能力继续运行的能力。 Microsoft, 2025a, "Fault tolerance" section, para. 1 Scalability and elasticity 可伸缩性和弹性 "Scalability and elasticity are the abilities of a system to handle increased load by adding and removing resources (scalability), and to do so quickly as your requirements change (elasticity)." 可伸缩性和弹性是系统的能力：通过添加和移除资源来处理增加的负载（可伸缩性），以及在需求变化时快速做到这一点（弹性）。 Microsoft, 2025a, "Scalability and elasticity" section, para. 1 Chaos engineering 混沌工程 "Testing your solution's ability to automatically tolerate or recover from a variety of fault types is called chaos engineering." 测试解决方案自动承受各种故障类型或从中恢复的能力，称为混沌工程。 Microsoft, 2025a, "Automated testing" section, para. 1 Azure Chaos Studio Azure 混沌工作室 "Azure Chaos Studio is a chaos engineering tool that can simulate some common fault types." Azure 混沌工作室是一种混沌工程工具，可以模拟一些常见的故障类型。 Microsoft, 2025a, "Automated testing" section, para. 1 Recovery Point Objective (RPO) 恢复点目标 "Recovery Point Objective (RPO) is the maximum duration of acceptable data loss in the event of a disaster." 恢复点目标（RPO）是可接受的最长数据丢失时长，针对的是发生灾难的情况。 Microsoft, 2025a, "Disaster recovery requirements" section, list item 1 Recovery Time Objective (RTO) 恢复时间目标 "Recovery Time Objective (RTO) is the maximum duration of acceptable downtime in the event of a disaster, where 'downtime' is defined by your specification." 恢复时间目标（RTO）是可接受的最长停机时长，针对的是发生灾难的情况，其中“停机”由你的规范定义。 Microsoft, 2025a, "Disaster recovery requirements" section, list item 2 Redundancy 冗余 "Redundancy is the ability to maintain multiple identical copies of a service component, and to use those copies in a way that prevents any one component from becoming a single point of failure." 冗余是维护服务组件的多个相同副本的能力，并以某种方式使用这些副本，防止任何一个组件成为单点故障。 Microsoft, 2025b, para. 3 Replication 复制 "Replication or data redundancy is the ability to maintain multiple copies of data, called replicas." 复制（或数据冗余）是维护数据的多个副本的能力，这些副本称为副本（replica）。 Microsoft, 2025b, para. 4 Backup 备份 "Backup is the ability to maintain a timestamped copy of data that can be used to restore data that has been lost." 备份是维护带时间戳的数据副本的能力，可用来恢复已丢失的数据。 Microsoft, 2025b, para. 5 Failover 故障转移 "With failover, you can redirect traffic and requests from unhealthy instances to healthy ones." 通过故障转移，你可以重定向流量和请求，从运行不正常的实例转到正常的实例。 Microsoft, 2026c, para. 2 Active-active 主动-主动 "Some solutions are built to use an active-active approach, which means multiple instances all serve requests." 有些解决方案采用主动-主动方式，即多个实例都处理请求。 Microsoft, 2026c, "Active and passive instance roles" section, para. 1 Planned failover 计划内故障转移 "In contrast, planned failovers are those that you proactively trigger." 相比之下，计划内故障转移是你主动触发的故障转移。 Microsoft, 2026c, "Planned and unplanned failovers" section Unplanned failover 计划外故障转移 "Unplanned failovers are those that are performed during an outage of a component, so that you can restore service by using another instance." 计划外故障转移是在某个组件中断期间执行的故障转移，以便使用另一个实例恢复服务。 Microsoft, 2026c, "Planned and unplanned failovers" section Failback 故障回复 "Failback is the process of reinstating and redirecting traffic back to the original primary instance." 故障回复是恢复原始主实例并把流量重新导回它的过程。 Microsoft, 2026c, "Failback" section, para. 1 Service-level agreement (SLA) 服务级别协议 (SLA) "An SLA is a set of conditional commitments. It states that if a customer meets certain requirements, then the service provider commits to a defined level of service." SLA 是一组有条件的承诺。它规定：如果客户满足某些要求，那么服务提供商承诺提供规定的服务水平。 Microsoft, 2026a, "What an SLA is and isn't" section, para. 1 Service-level objective (SLO) 服务级别目标 (SLO) "A service-level objective (SLO) is an internal reliability target that you set for your own workload." 服务级别目标 (SLO) 是一个内部可靠性目标，由你为自己的工作负载设定。 Microsoft, 2026a, "How SLAs relate to SLOs and reliability targets" section, list item 1 Service credits 服务抵扣额 "Service credits are typically a percentage of the monthly service fee for the affected service." 服务抵扣额通常是月度服务费的一个百分比，按受影响的服务计算。 Microsoft, 2026a, "Step 4: File the claim within the required timeframe" section, para. 1 References Microsoft. Microsoft Learn. https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/reliability/concept-business-continuity-high-availability-disaster-recovery Microsoft. (2025b, February 26). What are failover and failback? Microsoft Learn. https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/reliability/concept-failover-failback

cloud/azure/security/defense-in-depth.ht.summary: 18.2 Defense-in-Depth Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source Physical security 物理安全 "The physical security layer is the first line of defense to protect computing hardware in the datacenter." 物理安全层是第一道防线，用于保护数据中心中的计算硬件。 Microsoft, n.d., "Layers of defense-in-depth" section, list item 1 Identity and access 身份和访问 "The identity and access layer controls access to infrastructure and change control." 身份和访问层控制对基础结构的访问以及变更控制。 Microsoft, n.d., "Layers of defense-in-depth" section, list item 2 Perimeter 外围 "The perimeter layer uses distributed denial of service (DDoS) protection to filter large-scale attacks before they can cause a denial of service for users." 外围层使用分布式拒绝服务 (DDoS) 防护，过滤大规模攻击，赶在它们对用户造成拒绝服务之前。 Microsoft, n.d., "Layers of defense-in-depth" section, list item 3 Network 网络 "The network layer limits communication between resources through segmentation and access controls." 网络层限制资源之间的通信，手段是分段和访问控制。 Microsoft, n.d., "Layers of defense-in-depth" section, list item 4 Compute 计算 "The compute layer secures access to virtual machines." 计算层保护对虚拟机的访问。 Microsoft, n.d., "Layers of defense-in-depth" section, list item 5 Application 应用程序 "The application layer helps ensure that applications are secure and free of security vulnerabilities." 应用程序层帮助确保应用程序安全且没有安全漏洞。 Microsoft, n.d., "Layers of defense-in-depth" section, list item 6 Data 数据 "The data layer controls access to operational and customer data that you need to protect." 数据层控制对需要保护的运营数据和客户数据的访问。 Microsoft, n.d., "Layers of defense-in-depth" section, list item 7 References Microsoft. (n.d.). Describe defense-in-depth [Training module unit]. Microsoft Learn. Retrieved October 27, 2026, from https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/training/modules/describe-azure-identity-access-security/8-describe-defense-depth

cloud/azure/security/encryption-and-key-.summary: 18.3 Encryption and Key Management Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source Encryption at rest 静态加密 (context) "Encryption at rest is a common security requirement. Azure encrypts data at rest by default by using platform-managed keys." （语境）静态加密是一项常见的安全要求。Azure 默认对静态数据进行加密，使用的是平台管理的密钥。 Microsoft, 2026b, para. 2 Platform-managed keys 平台管理的密钥 "Platform-managed keys (default) (also sometimes called service-managed keys): Azure automatically handles all aspects of encryption key management, including key generation, storage, rotation, and backup." 平台管理的密钥（默认）（有时也叫服务管理的密钥）：Azure 自动处理加密密钥管理的所有方面，包括密钥的生成、存储、轮换和备份。 Microsoft, 2026b, "Key management options" section, para. 2 Customer-managed keys 客户管理的密钥 "Customer-managed keys (optional): Organizations that require greater control over their encryption keys can choose to manage their own keys by using Azure Key Vault or Azure Key Vault Managed HSM." 客户管理的密钥（可选）：需要更严格地控制自己的加密密钥的组织，可以选择用 Azure Key Vault 或 Azure Key Vault 托管 HSM 来管理自己的密钥。 Microsoft, 2026b, "Key management options" section, para. 3 Data encryption key (DEK) 数据加密密钥 "Data encryption key (DEK) - A symmetric AES-256 key that encrypts a partition or block of data, sometimes also referred to as a data key." 数据加密密钥（DEK）：一个对称的 AES-256 密钥，用来加密一个分区或一块数据，有时也叫数据密钥。 Microsoft, 2026b, "Envelope encryption with a key hierarchy" section, list item 1 Key encryption key (KEK) 密钥加密密钥 "Key encryption key (KEK) - An encryption key that encrypts the DEKs by using envelope encryption, also referred to as wrapping." 密钥加密密钥（KEK）：一个用信封加密（也叫包装）来加密各个 DEK 的加密密钥。 Microsoft, 2026b, "Envelope encryption with a key hierarchy" section, list item 2 Encryption in transit 传输中加密 (context) "Azure provides many mechanisms to help keep data private as it moves from one location to another." （语境）Azure 提供许多机制，帮助保持数据私密，在数据从一个位置移动到另一个位置时。 Microsoft, 2026c, "Encryption in transit" section, para. 1 Azure Key Vault Azure 密钥保管库 (context) "Azure Key Vault is one of several key management solutions in Azure, and helps solve the following problems:" （语境）Azure 密钥保管库是 Azure 中的几种密钥管理解决方案之一，用来解决下面这些问题： Microsoft, 2026a, para. 1 Secrets Management 机密管理 "Secrets Management - Azure Key Vault can be used to Securely store and tightly control access to tokens, passwords, certificates, API keys, and other secrets" 机密管理：Azure 密钥保管库可用于安全地存储和严格控制访问，对象是令牌、密码、证书、API 密钥和其他机密。 Microsoft, 2026a, para. 1, list item 1 Key Management 密钥管理 "Key Management - Azure Key Vault can be used as a Key Management solution. Azure Key Vault makes it easy to create and control the encryption keys used to encrypt your data." 密钥管理：Azure 密钥保管库可用作密钥管理解决方案，让你能轻松创建和控制用来加密数据的加密密钥。 Microsoft, 2026a, para. 1, list item 2 Certificate Management 证书管理 "Certificate Management - Azure Key Vault lets you easily provision, manage, and deploy public and private Transport Layer Security/Secure Sockets Layer (TLS/SSL) certificates for use with Azure and your internal connected resources." 证书管理：Azure 密钥保管库让你能轻松预配、管理和部署公共与私有的传输层安全性/安全套接字层（TLS/SSL）证书，供 Azure 和内部联网资源使用。 Microsoft, 2026a, para. 1, list item 3 Standard tier 标准层 "Standard tier - Encrypts data using software libraries validated to FIPS 140 Level 1" 标准层：用通过 FIPS 140 Level 1 验证的软件库加密数据。 Microsoft, 2026a, para. 2, list item 1 Premium tier 高级层 "Premium tier - Offers HSM-protected keys, generated and protected by FIPS 140-3 Level 3 validated Marvell LiquidSecurity HSMs, for the highest level of cryptographic protection" 高级层：提供 HSM 保护的密钥，由通过 FIPS 140-3 Level 3 验证的 Marvell LiquidSecurity HSM 生成和保护，达到最高级别的加密保护。 Microsoft, 2026a, para. 2, list item 2 References Microsoft. (2026b, July 21). Azure data encryption at rest. Microsoft Learn. https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/security/fundamentals/encryption-atrest Microsoft. (2026c, September 18). Azure encryption overview. Microsoft Learn. https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/security/fundamentals/encryption-overview Microsoft. (2026a, September 22). About Azure Key Vault. Microsoft Learn. https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/key-vault/general/overview

Security Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source Security 安全 "Cybersecurity is the practice of protecting your critical systems, data, and networks from digital attacks." 网络安全是保护你的关键系统、数据和网络、使其免受数字攻击的做法。 Microsoft, n.d., "Key takeaways" section, list item 1 Zero Trust model 零信任模型 "Zero Trust is a security model that assumes the worst case scenario and protects resources with that expectation." 零信任是一种安全模型，它假设最坏的情况，并按照这种预期来保护资源。 Microsoft, 2026a, "Describe Zero Trust model" unit, para. 1 Defense-in-depth 纵深防御 "The objective of defense-in-depth is to protect information and prevent it from being stolen by those who aren't authorized to access it." 纵深防御的目标是保护信息，防止它被无权访问的人窃取。 Microsoft, 2026a, "Describe defense-in-depth" unit, para. 1 Encryption and key management 加密和密钥管理 "Encryption helps protect data confidentiality by making data unreadable to unauthorized users." 加密通过让数据对未授权用户不可读来帮助保护数据机密性。 Microsoft, 2026a, "Describe encryption and key management in Azure" unit, para. 1 Microsoft Defender for Cloud Microsoft Defender for Cloud "Defender for Cloud is a security posture management and threat protection service." Microsoft Defender Experts for Servers 是一种托管检测和响应服务，它为你的 Defender for Servers 部署增加 Microsoft 分析师的专业知识。 Microsoft, 2026, "Managed detection and response for servers" section, para. 1 References Microsoft. data and recovery points, and acts as a security boundary." 恢复服务保管库或备份保管库：存放备份数据和恢复点，并充当安全边界。 Microsoft, 2026b, "Key components in Azure Backup" section, list item 1 Backup policies 备份策略 "Backup policies: Define when backups run and how long data is retained." 备份策略：规定备份何时运行、数据保留多久。 Microsoft, 2026b, "Key components in Azure Backup" section, list item 2 Backup extension or agent 备份扩展或代理 基于快照的备份 "Snapshot-based backup – Fast backups and restores for supported workloads." 基于快照的备份：为受支持的工作负载提供快速的备份和还原。 Microsoft, 2026b, "Backup types and tiers" section, list item 1 Vaulted backup 保管库备份 cloud/azure/well-architected-framework/o.summary: 25.4 Operational Excellence Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文解释 Source Operational Excellence 卓越运营 "At the core of the Operational Excellence pillar are DevOps practices that ensure workload quality through standardized workflows and team cohesion." 卓越运营支柱的核心是 DevOps 做法，它们通过标准化工作流和团队凝聚力确保工作负载质量。 Microsoft, 2025, para. 1 Embrace DevOps culture 拥抱 DevOps 文化 "Empower development and operations teams to continuously improve their system design and processes by working together with a mindset of collaboration, shared responsibility, and ownership." 让开发和运营团队持续改进其系统设计和流程，方法是带着协作、共担责任和主人翁的思维方式一起工作。 Microsoft, 2025, "Embrace DevOps culture" section, para. 1 Establish development standards 建立开发标准 "Optimize productivity by standardizing development practices, enforcing quality gates, and tracking progress and success through systematic change management." 优化生产力，方法是标准化开发做法、强制执行质量门禁，并通过系统化的变更管理跟踪进度和成效。 Microsoft, 2025, "Establish development standards" section, para. 1 Evolve operations with observability 通过可观测性改进操作 "Gain visibility into the system, derive insight, and make data-driven decisions." 获得对系统的可见性、得出见解，并做出数据驱动的决策。 Microsoft, 2025, "Evolve operations with observability" section, para. 1 Automate for efficiency 自动执行以提高效率 "Replace repetitive manual tasks with software automation that completes them quicker, with greater consistency and accuracy, and reduces risks." 用软件自动化取代重复的手动任务，让任务完成得更快、更一致、更准确，并降低风险。 Microsoft, 2025, "Automate for efficiency" section, para. 1 Adopt safe deployment practices 采用安全部署做法 "Achieve consistency in deployments by using guardrails that reduce the effect of errors and unexpected conditions." 实现部署的一致性，方法是使用防护措施来减少错误和意外情况的影响。 Microsoft, 2025, "Adopt safe deployment practices" section, para. 1 References Microsoft. cloud/azure/well-architected-framework/p.summary: 25.5 Performance Efficiency Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文解释 Source Performance Efficiency 性能效率 "Performance efficiency is the ability of a workload to adapt to changing demands by scaling up to meet increased load without impacting user experience, and scaling down to conserve resources during low demand." 性能效率是工作负载适应不断变化的需求的能力：向上扩展以满足增加的负载而不影响用户体验，在需求低时向下缩减以节省资源。 Microsoft, 2025, para. 2 Negotiate realistic performance targets 协商现实性能目标 "The intended user experience is defined, and there's a strategy to develop a benchmark and measure targets against the pre-established business requirements." 预期的用户体验已经定义，并且有策略来制定基准，并对照预先确定的业务要求衡量目标。 Microsoft, 2025, "Negotiate realistic performance targets" section, para. 1 Design to meet capacity requirements 设计以满足产能要求 "Provide enough supply to address anticipated demand." 提供足够的供给来应对预期的需求。 Microsoft, 2025, "Design to meet capacity requirements" section, para. 1 Achieve and sustain performance 实现和保持性能 "Protect against performance degradation while the system is in use and as it evolves." 在系统使用和演进的过程中防止性能下降。 Microsoft, 2025, "Achieve and sustain performance" section, para. 1 Optimize for long-term improvement 针对长期改进进行优化 "Improve system efficiency within the defined performance targets to increase workload value." 提高系统效率，并保持在既定的性能目标之内，以增加工作负载的价值。 Microsoft, 2025, "Optimize for long-term improvement" section, para. 1 References Microsoft. (2025, August 1). Performance Efficiency design principles. Microsoft Azure Well-Architected Framework. Microsoft Learn. https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/well-architected/performance-efficiency/principles

cloud/azure/well-architected-framework/r.summary: 25.1 Reliability Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文解释 Source Reliability 可靠性 "A reliable workload must survive those events and continue to consistently provide its intended functionality." 可靠的工作负载必须挺过这些事件，并持续稳定地提供其预期功能。 Microsoft, 2025, para. 1 Design for business requirements 为满足业务要求进行设计 "Get clarity on the workload's scope, user growth, and most importantly promises the team has made to external customers and internal stakeholders." 明确工作负载的范围、用户增长，以及最重要的团队已作出的承诺，即对外部客户和内部利益干系人的承诺。 Microsoft, 2025, "Design for business requirements" section, para. 1 Design for resilience 为复原力而设计 "The workload must continue to operate with full or reduced functionality." 工作负载必须继续运行，功能可以是完整的或降低的。 Microsoft, 2025, "Design for resilience" section, para. 1 Design for recovery 为恢复进行设计 "The workload must be able to anticipate and recover from most failures, of all magnitudes, with minimal disruption to the user experience and business objectives." 工作负载必须能够预测大多数故障并从中恢复，无论故障规模大小，并且对用户体验和业务目标造成的干扰最小。 Microsoft, 2025, "Design for recovery" section, para. 1 Design for operations 运营设计 "Shift left in operations to anticipate failure conditions." 在运营中左移，以预测故障情况。 Microsoft, 2025, "Design for operations" section, para. 1 Keep it simple 保持简单 "Avoid overengineering the architecture design, application code, and operations." 避免过度设计架构、应用程序代码和运营。 Microsoft, 2025, "Keep it simple" section, para. 1 References Microsoft. (2025, September 30). Reliability design principles. Microsoft Azure Well-Architected Framework. Microsoft Learn. https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/well-architected/reliability/principles

cloud/azure/well-architected-framework/s.summary: 25.2 Security Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文解释 Source Security 安全性 "A secure workload is resilient to attacks and incorporates the interrelated security principles of confidentiality, integrity, and availability (also known as the CIA triad) in addition to meeting business goals." 安全的工作负载除了满足业务目标，还能抵御攻击，并纳入相互关联的机密性、完整性和可用性安全原则（也称为 CIA 三元组）。 Microsoft, 2023, para. 1 Plan your security readiness 规划安全就绪情况 "Strive to adopt and implement security practices in architectural design decisions and operations with minimal friction." 力求在架构设计决策和运营中采用并实施安全做法，同时把摩擦降到最低。 Microsoft, 2023, "Plan your security readiness" section, para. 1 Design to protect confidentiality 保护机密性的设计 "Prevent exposure to privacy, regulatory, application, and proprietary information through access restrictions and obfuscation techniques." 防止暴露隐私、法规、应用程序和专有信息，手段是访问限制和混淆技术。 Microsoft, 2023, "Design to protect confidentiality" section, para. 1 Design to protect integrity 保护完整性的设计 "Prevent corruption of design, implementation, operations, and data to avoid disruptions that can stop the system from delivering its intended utility or cause it to operate outside the prescribed limits. The system should provide information assurance throughout the workload lifecycle." 防止破坏设计、实现、运营和数据，以免中断让系统无法提供预期效用，或让它在规定的限制之外运行。系统应在整个工作负载生命周期中提供信息保障。 Microsoft, 2023, "Design to protect integrity" section, para. 1 Design to protect availability 保护可用性的设计 "Prevent or minimize system and workload downtime and degradation in the event of a security incident by using strong security controls. You must maintain data integrity during the incident and after the system recovers." 防止或尽量减少系统和工作负载的停机与降级，在发生安全事件时依靠强有力的安全控制做到这一点。在事件期间和系统恢复之后，都必须保持数据完整性。 Microsoft, 2023, "Design to protect availability" section, para. 1 Sustain and evolve your security posture 维持和改善安全状况 "Incorporate continuous improvement and apply vigilance to stay ahead of attackers who are continuously evolving their attack strategies." 引入持续改进并保持警惕，以领先于攻击者，他们的攻击策略在不断演变。 Microsoft, 2023, "Sustain and evolve your security posture" section, para. 1 References Microsoft. (2023, November 15). Security design principles. Microsoft Azure Well-Architected Framework. Microsoft Learn. https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/well-architected/security/principles

cloud/docker/reference/dockerfile.html.title: 4.5 Dockerfile reference | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
cloud/docker/reference/dockerfile.html.summary: 4.5 Dockerfile reference Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 4.5 Dockerfile reference Dockerfile (No definition) （无定义） Docker Inc., n.d., "Dockerfile reference", documentation menu 4.5.1 .dockerignore file .dockerignore 文件 "You can use .dockerignore file to exclude files and directories from the build context." 你可以用 .dockerignore 文件来排除文件和目录，使其不进入构建上下文。 Docker Inc., n.d., ".dockerignore file", para. 1 4.5.2 FROM FROM 指令 "The FROM instruction initializes a new build stage and sets the base image for subsequent instructions." FROM 指令初始化一个新的构建阶段，并设置基础镜像，供后续指令使用。 Docker Inc., n.d., "FROM", para. 3 AS name 命名构建阶段 "Optionally a name can be given to a new build stage by adding AS name to the FROM instruction." 可以选择为新的构建阶段命名，方法是在 FROM 指令后加上 AS name。 Docker Inc., n.d., "FROM", para. 6 4.5.3 COPY --from 从其他来源复制 "The COPY --from flag lets you copy files from an image, a build stage, or a named context instead." COPY --from 标志让你改为复制文件，来源是镜像、构建阶段或命名上下文。 Docker Inc., n.d., "COPY --from", para. 1 4.5.4 ENTRYPOINT ENTRYPOINT 指令 "An ENTRYPOINT allows you to configure a container that will run as an executable." ENTRYPOINT 让你配置一个容器，使其像可执行程序一样运行。 Docker Inc., n.d., "ENTRYPOINT", para. 1 4.5.5 ARG ARG 指令 "The ARG instruction defines a variable that users can pass at build time to the builder with the docker build command using the --build-arg <varname>=<value> flag." ARG 指令定义一个变量，用户可以在构建时把它传给构建器，方法是在 docker build 命令中使用 --build-arg <varname>=<value> 标志。 Docker Inc., n.d., "ARG", para. 1 4.5.6 HEALTHCHECK HEALTHCHECK 指令 "HEALTHCHECK [OPTIONS] CMD command (check container health by running a command inside the container)" HEALTHCHECK [OPTIONS] CMD command（检查容器健康状况，方法是在容器内运行命令） Docker Inc., n.d., "HEALTHCHECK", para. 2 interval 检查间隔 "The health check will first run interval seconds after the container is started, and then again interval seconds after each previous check completes." 健康检查在容器启动 interval 秒后首次运行，之后在每次检查完成 interval 秒后再次运行。 Docker Inc., n.d., "HEALTHCHECK", para. 12 timeout 单次超时 "If a single run of the check takes longer than timeout seconds then the check is considered to have failed." 如果单次检查耗时超过 timeout 秒，这次检查就算失败。 Docker Inc., n.d., "HEALTHCHECK", para. 13 retries 重试次数 "It takes retries consecutive failures of the health check for the container to be considered unhealthy." 健康检查连续失败 retries 次后，容器才被视为 unhealthy。 Docker Inc., n.d., "HEALTHCHECK", para. 14 start period 启动宽限期 "start period provides initialization time for containers that need time to bootstrap." start period 提供初始化时间，给需要时间启动的容器。 Docker Inc., n.d., "HEALTHCHECK", para. 15 References Docker Inc. (n.d.). Dockerfile reference. Docker Docs. Retrieved November 2, 2026, from https://docs.docker.com/reference/dockerfile/

cloud/kubernetes/architecture/cloud-cont.summary: 2.5 Cloud Controller Manager Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 2.5 Cloud Controller Manager 云控制器管理器 "The cloud-controller-manager is a Kubernetes control plane component that embeds cloud-specific control logic." 云控制器管理器是一个 Kubernetes 控制平面组件，嵌入了云平台特定的控制逻辑。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Cloud Controller Manager", para. 2 2.5.1 Cloud controller manager functions 云控制器管理器的功能 (context) "The controllers inside the cloud controller manager include:" （语境）云控制器管理器中的控制器包括： The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Cloud controller manager functions", para. 1 Node controller 节点控制器 "The node controller is responsible for updating Node objects when new servers are created in your cloud infrastructure." 节点控制器负责更新 Node 对象，当云基础设施中创建了新服务器时。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Node controller", para. 1 Route controller 路由控制器 "The route controller is responsible for configuring routes in the cloud appropriately so that containers on different nodes in your Kubernetes cluster can communicate with each other." 路由控制器负责在云中正确配置路由，使 Kubernetes 集群中不同节点上的容器能够相互通信。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Route controller", para. 1 Service controller 服务控制器 "The service controller interacts with your cloud provider's APIs to set up load balancers and other infrastructure components" 服务控制器会与云服务商的 API 交互，以设置负载均衡器和其他基础设施组件 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Service controller", para. 1 References The Kubernetes Authors. (n.d.). Cloud Controller Manager. Kubernetes Documentation. Retrieved October 31, 2026, from https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/architecture/cloud-controller/

cloud/kubernetes/architecture/cluster-ar.title: 2.0 Cluster Architecture | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
cloud/kubernetes/architecture/cluster-ar.summary: 2.0 Cluster Architecture Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 2.0 Cluster Architecture 集群架构 "A Kubernetes cluster consists of a control plane plus a set of worker machines, called nodes, that run containerized applications." Kubernetes 集群由一个控制平面加上一组称为节点的工作机器组成，它们运行容器化应用。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Cluster Architecture", para. 2 2.0.1 Control plane components 控制平面组件 "The control plane's components make global decisions about the cluster (for example, scheduling)" 控制平面组件对集群做出全局决策（例如调度） The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Control plane components", para. 1 kube-apiserver kube-apiserver "The API server is a component of the Kubernetes control plane that exposes the Kubernetes API."
