Kubernetes 指标 API 提供 CPU 与内存资源用量，针对节点和 Pod。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Metrics API", para. 1 12.5.2 Logs 日志 "Logs provide a chronological record of events inside applications, Kubernetes system components, and security-related activities such as audit logging." 日志提供事件的时间顺序记录，涵盖应用、Kubernetes 系统组件以及审计日志等安全相关活动。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Logs", para. 1 CRI logging format CRI 日志格式 (context) "While runtimes implement this differently, the integration with the kubelet is standardized through the CRI logging format" （语境）虽然各运行时实现方式不同，与 kubelet 的集成都通过 CRI 日志格式实现标准化 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Logs", para. 2 12.5.3 Traces 追踪 "Traces capture how requests moves across Kubernetes components and applications, linking latency, timing and relationships between operations." 追踪捕获请求如何流转于 Kubernetes 组件和应用之间，并联系起各操作的延迟、时序和相互关系。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Traces", para. 1 References The Kubernetes Authors. (n.d.). Observability. Kubernetes Documentation. Retrieved October 31, 2026, from https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/cluster-administration/observability/

cloud/kubernetes/containers/container-li.summary: 3.4 Container Lifecycle Hooks Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 3.4 Container Lifecycle Hooks 容器生命周期钩子 "Analogous to many programming language frameworks that have component lifecycle hooks, such as Angular, Kubernetes provides Containers with lifecycle hooks." 类似于许多带有组件生命周期钩子的编程语言框架（例如 Angular），Kubernetes 为容器提供生命周期钩子。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Overview", para. 1 3.4.1 Container hooks 容器钩子 "There are two hooks that are exposed to Containers:" 有两个钩子会暴露给容器： The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Container hooks", para. 1 PostStart PostStart "This hook is executed immediately after a container is created." 这个钩子会在容器创建后立即执行。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Container hooks", para. 3 PreStop PreStop "This hook is called immediately before a container is terminated due to an API request or management event such as a liveness/startup probe failure, preemption, resource contention and others." 这个钩子会在容器被终止之前立即调用，起因是 API 请求或管理事件，例如存活/启动探针失败、抢占、资源争用等。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Note:", para. 3 StopSignal StopSignal "The StopSignal lifecycle can be used to define a stop signal which would be sent to the container when it is stopped." StopSignal 生命周期可用来定义一个停止信号，它会在容器停止时发送给容器。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Note:", para. 6 3.4.2 Hook handler implementations 钩子处理程序的实现 "Containers can access a hook by implementing and registering a handler for that hook." 容器可以使用某个钩子，方式是为该钩子实现并注册一个处理程序。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Hook handler implementations", para. 1 Exec Exec "Exec - Executes a specific command, such as pre-stop.sh, inside the cgroups and namespaces of the Container." Exec：执行特定命令，例如 pre-stop.sh，在容器的 cgroup 和命名空间内运行。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Hook handler implementations", para. 2 HTTP HTTP "HTTP - Executes an HTTP request against a specific endpoint on the Container." HTTP：执行一次 HTTP 请求，目标是容器上的特定端点。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Hook handler implementations", para. 3 Sleep Sleep "Sleep - Pauses the container for a specified duration." Sleep：让容器暂停，持续指定的时长。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Hook handler implementations", para. 4 3.4.3 Hook delivery guarantees 钩子交付保证 "Hook delivery is intended to be at least once, which means that a hook may be called multiple times for any given event, such as for PostStart or PreStop." 钩子交付的设计目标是 至少一次，即钩子对任一事件都可能被调用多次（例如 PostStart 或 PreStop）。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Hook delivery guarantees", para. 1 References The Kubernetes Authors. SRV 记录为命名端口创建，这些端口属于普通或无头 Service。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "SRV records", para. 1 5.7.2 Pods Pod (No definition) （无定义） The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Pods" Pod's DNS Policy Pod 的 DNS 策略 "DNS policies can be set on a per-Pod basis." DNS 策略可以按 Pod 逐个设置。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Pod's DNS Policy", para. 1 Default Default ""Default": The Pod inherits the name resolution configuration from the node that the Pods run on." “Default”：Pod 继承名称解析配置，来自其所在的节点。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Pod's DNS Policy", para. 2 ClusterFirst ClusterFirst ""ClusterFirst": Any DNS query that does not match the configured cluster domain suffix, such as "www.kubernetes.io", is forwarded to an upstream nameserver by the DNS server." “ClusterFirst”：任何与所配置的集群域后缀不匹配的 DNS 查询（例如“www.kubernetes.io”）都由 DNS 服务器转发给上游域名服务器。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Pod's DNS Policy", para. 3 ClusterFirstWithHostNet ClusterFirstWithHostNet ""ClusterFirstWithHostNet": For Pods running with hostNetwork, you should explicitly set its DNS policy to "ClusterFirstWithHostNet"." “ClusterFirstWithHostNet”：对以 hostNetwork 运行的 Pod，应显式设置其 DNS 策略为“ClusterFirstWithHostNet”。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Pod's DNS Policy", para. 4 None None ""None": It allows a Pod to ignore DNS settings from the Kubernetes environment." “None”：它允许 Pod 忽略来自 Kubernetes 环境的 DNS 设置。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Pod's DNS Policy", para. 5 Pod's DNS Config Pod 的 DNS 配置 "Pod's DNS Config allows users more control on the DNS settings for a Pod." Pod 的 DNS 配置让用户对 Pod 的 DNS 设置有更多控制。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Pod's DNS Config", para. 1 References The Kubernetes Authors. (n.d.). DNS for Services and Pods. Kubernetes Documentation. Retrieved October 31, 2026, from https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/dns-pod-service/

cloud/kubernetes/services-networking/end.summary: 5.5 EndpointSlices Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 5.5 EndpointSlices EndpointSlice "In Kubernetes, an EndpointSlice contains references to a set of network endpoints." 在 Kubernetes 中，EndpointSlice 包含对一组网络端点的引用。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "EndpointSlice API", para. 1 5.5.1 EndpointSlice API EndpointSlice API (No definition) （无定义） The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "EndpointSlice API" Address types 地址类型 "EndpointSlices support two address types:" EndpointSlice 支持两种地址类型： The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Address types", para. 1 Serving Serving "The serving condition indicates that the endpoint is currently serving responses, and so it should be used as a target for Service traffic." serving 状况表示端点当前正在提供响应，因此应把它用作 Service 流量的目标。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Serving", para. 1 Terminating Terminating "The terminating condition indicates that the endpoint is terminating." terminating 状况表示端点正在终止。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Terminating", para. 1 Ready Ready "The ready condition is essentially a shortcut for checking "serving and not terminating"" ready 状况本质上是一种简写，用于检查“serving 且非 terminating” The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Ready", para. 1 EndpointSlice mirroring EndpointSlice 镜像 (context) "The EndpointSlice API is a replacement for the older Endpoints API." （语境）EndpointSlice API 是旧版 Endpoints API 的替代品。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "EndpointSlice mirroring", para. 1 References The Kubernetes Authors. (n.d.). EndpointSlices. Kubernetes Documentation. Retrieved October 31, 2026, from https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/endpoint-slices/

GRPCRoute 类型指定 gRPC 请求的路由行为，从 Gateway 监听器到后端网络端点。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "GRPCRoute", para. 1 References The Kubernetes Authors. (n.d.). Gateway API. Kubernetes Documentation. cloud/kubernetes/services-networking/ind.summary: 5 Services, Load Balancing, and Networking Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 5 Services, Load Balancing, and Networking 服务、负载均衡与网络 (context) "Concepts and resources behind networking in Kubernetes." （语境）概念和资源，关于 Kubernetes 中的网络。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d.-l, "Services, Load Balancing, and Networking", para. 1 5.0 Services, Load Balancing, and Networking 服务、负载均衡与网络 (context) "Concepts and resources behind networking in Kubernetes." （语境）概念和资源，关于 Kubernetes 中的网络。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d.-l, "Services, Load Balancing, and Networking", para. 1 5.1 Service Service "In Kubernetes, a Service is a method for exposing a network application that is running as one or more Pods in your cluster." 在 Kubernetes 中，Service 是一种暴露网络应用的方法，该应用运行为集群中的一个或多个 Pod。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d.-i, "Service", para. 2 5.2 Ingress Ingress "An API object that manages external access to the services in a cluster, typically HTTP." 一个 API 对象，管理从外部访问集群中服务的行为，通常是 HTTP。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d.-d, "Ingress", para. 2 5.3 Ingress Controllers Ingress 控制器 (context) "In order for an Ingress to work in your cluster, there must be an ingress controller running." （语境）要让 Ingress 在集群中工作，必须有一个 Ingress 控制器在运行。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d.-e, "Ingress Controllers", para. 1 5.4 Gateway API Gateway API "Gateway API is a family of API kinds that provide dynamic infrastructure provisioning and advanced traffic routing." Gateway API 是一组 API 类型，提供动态基础设施供应和高级流量路由。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d.-c, "Gateway API", para. 1 5.5 EndpointSlices EndpointSlice "In Kubernetes, an EndpointSlice contains references to a set of network endpoints." 在 Kubernetes 中，EndpointSlice 包含对一组网络端点的引用。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d.-b, "EndpointSlice API", para. 1 5.6 Network Policies 网络策略 "If you want to control traffic flow at the IP address or port level (OSI layer 3 or 4), NetworkPolicies allow you to specify rules for traffic flow within your cluster, and also between Pods and the outside world." 如果你想在 IP 地址或端口层面控制流量（OSI 第 3 或第 4 层），NetworkPolicy 让你指定集群内部流量的规则，以及 Pod 与外部世界之间的规则。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d.-g, "Network Policies", para. 1 5.7 DNS for Services and Pods Service 与 Pod 的 DNS (context) "Kubernetes creates DNS records for Services and Pods." （语境）Kubernetes 会创建 DNS 记录，对象是 Service 和 Pod。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d.-a, "DNS for Services and Pods", para. 2 5.8 IPv4/IPv6 dual-stack IPv4/IPv6 双栈 "IPv4/IPv6 dual-stack networking enables the allocation of both IPv4 and IPv6 addresses to Pods and Services." IPv4/IPv6 双栈网络能够把 IPv4 和 IPv6 两种地址同时分配给 Pod 和 Service。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d.-f, "IPv4/IPv6 dual-stack", para. 2 5.9 Topology Aware Routing 拓扑感知路由 "Topology Aware Routing provides a mechanism to help keep network traffic within the zone where it originated." 拓扑感知路由 提供一种机制，帮助把网络流量保持在其发出的可用区内。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d.-m, "Topology Aware Routing", para. 1 5.10 Networking on Windows Windows 上的网络 (context) "Networking for Windows containers is exposed through CNI plugins." （语境）Windows 容器的网络是通过 CNI 插件提供的。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d.-h, "Container networking on Windows", para. 1 5.11 Service ClusterIP allocation Service ClusterIP 分配 (context) "In Kubernetes, Services are an abstract way to expose an application running on a set of Pods." （语境）在 Kubernetes 中，Service 是一种抽象方式，用来暴露运行在一组 Pod 上的应用。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d.-j, "Service ClusterIP allocation", para. 1 5.12 Service Internal Traffic Policy Service 内部流量策略 "Service Internal Traffic Policy enables internal traffic restrictions to only route internal traffic to endpoints within the node the traffic originated from." Service 内部流量策略 启用内部流量限制，只把内部流量路由到流量发出节点内的端点。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d.-k, "Service Internal Traffic Policy", para. 2 References The Kubernetes Authors. (n.d.-a). DNS for Services and Pods. cloud/kubernetes/services-networking/ing.title: 5.2 Ingress | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
cloud/kubernetes/services-networking/ing.summary: 5.2 Ingress Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 5.2 Ingress Ingress "An API object that manages external access to the services in a cluster, typically HTTP." 一个 API 对象，管理从外部访问集群中的服务，通常是 HTTP。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Ingress", para. 2 5.2.1 Terminology 术语 "For clarity, this guide defines the following terms:" 为清楚起见，本指南定义以下术语： The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Terminology", para. 1 Node 节点 "Node: A worker machine in Kubernetes, part of a cluster." 节点：Kubernetes 中的工作机器，是集群的一部分。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Terminology", para. 2 Cluster 集群 "Cluster: A set of Nodes that run containerized applications managed by Kubernetes." 集群：一组节点，运行由 Kubernetes 管理的容器化应用。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Terminology", para. 3 Edge router 边缘路由器 "Edge router: A router that enforces the firewall policy for your cluster." 边缘路由器：一个路由器，为集群执行防火墙策略。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Terminology", para. 4 Cluster network 集群网络 "Cluster network: A set of links, logical or physical, that facilitate communication within a cluster according to the Kubernetes networking model." 集群网络：一组逻辑或物理的链路，按照 Kubernetes 网络模型促进集群内的通信。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Terminology", para. 5 5.2.2 The Ingress resource Ingress 资源 (No definition) （无定义） The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "The Ingress resource" DefaultBackend 默认后端 "An Ingress with no rules sends all traffic to a single default backend" 没有规则的 Ingress 会把所有流量发送到单个默认后端 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "DefaultBackend", para. 1 Resource backends 资源后端 "A Resource backend is an ObjectRef to another Kubernetes resource within the same namespace as the Ingress object." Resource 后端是一个指向另一个 Kubernetes 资源的 ObjectRef，该资源位于与 Ingress 对象相同的命名空间。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Resource backends", para. 1 ImplementationSpecific ImplementationSpecific "ImplementationSpecific: With this path type, matching is up to the IngressClass." ImplementationSpecific：使用这种路径类型时，如何匹配由 IngressClass 决定。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Path types", para. 2 Exact Exact "Exact: Matches the URL path exactly and with case sensitivity." Exact：精确匹配 URL 路径，区分大小写。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Path types", para. 3 Prefix Prefix "Prefix: Matches based on a URL path prefix split by /." Prefix：匹配依据是以 / 分隔的 URL 路径前缀。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Path types", para. 4 5.2.3 Ingress class Ingress 类 "Ingresses can be implemented by different controllers, often with different configuration." Ingress 可以由不同的控制器实现，配置也往往不同。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Ingress class", para. 1 5.2.4 Types of Ingress Ingress 的类型 (No definition) （无定义） The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Types of Ingress" Simple fanout 简单扇出 "A fanout configuration routes traffic from a single IP address to more than one Service, based on the HTTP URI being requested." 扇出配置把来自单个 IP 地址的流量路由到多个 Service，依据是所请求的 HTTP URI。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Simple fanout", para. 1 Name based virtual hosting 基于名称的虚拟主机 "Name-based virtual hosts support routing HTTP traffic to multiple host names at the same IP address." 基于名称的虚拟主机支持把 HTTP 流量路由到多个主机名，这些主机名位于同一 IP 地址。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Name based virtual hosting", para. 1 References The Kubernetes Authors. (n.d.). Ingress. Kubernetes Documentation. Retrieved October 31, 2026, from https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/ingress/

Pod 有两种隔离：出站隔离和入站隔离。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "The two sorts of pod isolation", para. 1 5.6.2 Default policies 默认策略 "By default, if no policies exist in a namespace, then all ingress and egress traffic is allowed to and from pods in that namespace." 默认情况下，如果命名空间中不存在任何策略，则所有入站和出站流量都被允许，对象是该命名空间中的 Pod。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Default policies", para. 1 References The Kubernetes Authors. (n.d.). Network Policies. Kubernetes Documentation. Retrieved October 31, 2026, from https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/network-policies/

cloud/kubernetes/services-networking/ser.title: 5.1 Service | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
cloud/kubernetes/services-networking/ser.summary: 5.1 Service Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 5.1 Service Service "In Kubernetes, a Service is a method for exposing a network application that is running as one or more Pods in your cluster." 在 Kubernetes 中，Service 是一种暴露网络应用的方法，该应用在集群中以一个或多个 Pod 运行。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Service", para. 2 5.1.1 Services in Kubernetes Kubernetes 中的 Service "The Service API, part of Kubernetes, is an abstraction to help you expose groups of Pods over a network." Service API 是 Kubernetes 的一部分，是一种抽象，帮助你通过网络暴露一组 Pod。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Services in Kubernetes", para. 1 5.1.2 Defining a Service 定义 Service "A Service is an object (the same way that a Pod or a ConfigMap is an object)." Service 是一个对象（就像 Pod 或 ConfigMap 是对象一样）。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Defining a Service", para. 1 cluster IP 集群 IP "Kubernetes assigns this Service an IP address (the cluster IP), that is used by the virtual IP address mechanism." Kubernetes 为这个 Service 分配一个 IP 地址（即集群 IP），供虚拟 IP 地址机制使用。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Defining a Service", para. 5 EndpointSlices EndpointSlice "EndpointSlices are objects that represent a subset (a slice) of the backing network endpoints for a Service." EndpointSlice 是对象，代表 Service 后端网络端点的一个子集（一个切片）。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "EndpointSlices", para. 1 Application protocol 应用协议 "The appProtocol field provides a way to specify an application protocol for each Service port." appProtocol 字段提供一种方式来指定应用协议，针对每个 Service 端口。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Application protocol", para. 1 5.1.3 Service type Service 类型 (No definition) （无定义） The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Service type" ClusterIP ClusterIP "This default Service type assigns an IP address from a pool of IP addresses that your cluster has reserved for that purpose." 这种默认的 Service 类型分配一个 IP 地址，来自集群为此预留的 IP 地址池。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "type: ClusterIP", para. 1 NodePort NodePort "If you set the type field to NodePort, the Kubernetes control plane allocates a port from a range specified by --service-node-port-range flag (default: 30000-32767)." 如果把 type 字段设为 NodePort，Kubernetes 控制平面会分配一个端口，来自 --service-node-port-range 标志指定的范围（默认：30000-32767）。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "type: NodePort", para. 1 LoadBalancer LoadBalancer "On cloud providers which support external load balancers, setting the type field to LoadBalancer provisions a load balancer for your Service." 在支持外部负载均衡器的云服务商上，把 type 字段设为 LoadBalancer 会为 Service 供应一个负载均衡器。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "type: LoadBalancer", para. 1 ExternalName ExternalName "Services of type ExternalName map a Service to a DNS name, not to a typical selector such as my-service or cassandra." ExternalName 类型的 Service 把 Service 映射到一个 DNS 名称，而不是映射到 my-service 或 cassandra 这类常见的选择算符。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "type: ExternalName", para. 1 5.1.4 Headless Services 无头 Service "In this case, you can create what are termed headless Services, by explicitly specifying "None" for the cluster IP address (.spec.clusterIP)." 这种情况下，你可以创建所谓的无头 Service，方法是为集群 IP 地址（.spec.clusterIP）显式指定 "None"。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Headless Services", para. 1 5.1.5 Discovering services 发现服务 "For clients running inside your cluster, Kubernetes supports two primary modes of finding a Service: environment variables and DNS." 对于集群内运行的客户端，Kubernetes 支持两种主要的服务发现方式：环境变量和 DNS。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Discovering services", para. 1 5.1.6 Virtual IP addressing mechanism 虚拟 IP 寻址机制 (No definition) （无定义） The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Virtual IP addressing mechanism" Traffic policies 流量策略 "You can set the .spec.internalTrafficPolicy and .spec.externalTrafficPolicy fields to control how Kubernetes routes traffic to healthy (“ready”) backends." 你可以设置 .spec.internalTrafficPolicy 和 .spec.externalTrafficPolicy 字段，控制 Kubernetes 如何把流量路由到健康（“就绪”）的后端。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Traffic policies", para. 1 Traffic distribution control 流量分布控制 "The .spec.trafficDistribution field provides another way to influence traffic routing within a Kubernetes Service." .spec.trafficDistribution 字段提供了另一种方式，用来影响 Kubernetes Service 内的流量路由。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Traffic distribution control", para. 1 Session stickiness 会话粘性 "If you want to make sure that connections from a particular client are passed to the same Pod each time, you can configure session affinity based on the client's IP address." 如果你想确保某个客户端的连接每次都被转发到同一个 Pod，可以基于客户端 IP 地址配置会话亲和性。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Session stickiness", para. 1 References The Kubernetes Authors. cloud/kubernetes/workloads/controllers/j.summary: 4.2.5 Jobs Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 4.2.5 Jobs Job "Jobs represent one-off tasks that run to completion and then stop." Job 代表一次性任务，它们运行至完成后即停止。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Jobs", para. 1 4.2.5.1 Writing a Job spec 编写 Job 规约 "There are three main types of task suitable to run as a Job:" 有三种主要类型的任务适合以 Job 运行： The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Parallel execution for Jobs", para. 1 Non-parallel Jobs 非并行 Job "Non-parallel Jobsnormally, only one Pod is started, unless the Pod fails." 非并行 Job：通常只启动一个 Pod，除非该 Pod 失败。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Parallel execution for Jobs", para. 2 fixed completion count 固定完成计数 "Parallel Jobs with a fixed completion count:specify a non-zero positive value for .spec.completions." 具有固定完成计数的并行 Job：指定 .spec.completions 的一个非零正值。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Parallel execution for Jobs", para. 3 work queue 工作队列 "Parallel Jobs with a work queue:do not specify .spec.completions, default to .spec.parallelism." 使用工作队列的并行 Job：此时不指定 .spec.completions，默认取 .spec.parallelism。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Parallel execution for Jobs", para. 4 NonIndexed NonIndexed "NonIndexed (default): the Job is considered complete when there have been .spec.completions successfully completed Pods." NonIndexed（默认）：Job 被视为完成，当成功完成的 Pod 数达到 .spec.completions 时。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Completion mode", para. 2 Indexed Indexed "Indexed: the Pods of a Job get an associated completion index from 0 to .spec.completions-1." Indexed：Job 的各个 Pod 获得一个关联的完成索引，范围是 0 到 .spec.completions-1。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Completion mode", para. 3 4.2.5.2 Handling Pod and container failures 处理 Pod 和容器失败 (No definition) （无定义） The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Handling Pod and container failures" Pod backoff failure policy Pod 回退失败策略 (context) "There are situations where you want to fail a Job after some amount of retries due to a logical error in configuration etc." （语境）有些情况下，你希望让 Job 失败，在若干次重试之后，原因是配置中的逻辑错误等。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Pod backoff failure policy", para. 1 4.2.5.3 Success policy 成功策略 "When creating an Indexed Job, you can define when a Job can be declared as succeeded using a .spec.successPolicy, based on the pods that succeeded." 创建 Indexed Job 时，你可以定义何时可以宣告 Job 成功，方法是用一个 .spec.successPolicy，依据是成功的 Pod。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Success policy", para. 1 4.2.5.4 Job termination and cleanup Job 的终止与清理 (No definition) （无定义） The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Job termination and cleanup" Terminal Job conditions Job 终止状况 "A Job has two possible terminal states, each of which has a corresponding Job condition:" Job 有两种可能的终止状态，每种都有对应的 Job 状况： The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Terminal Job conditions", para. 1 4.2.5.5 Job patterns Job 模式 (No definition) （无定义） The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Job patterns" work items 工作项 "The Job object can be used to process a set of independent but related work items." Job 对象可用来处理一组相互独立但又相关的工作项。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Job patterns", para. 1 batch job 批处理作业 (context) "Here we are just considering one set of work items that the user wants to manage together — a batch job." （语境）这里我们只考虑一组工作项，用户想把它们一起管理，即批处理作业。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Job patterns", para. 2 References The Kubernetes Authors. ReplicaSet 的目的是维持一组稳定的副本 Pod，在任何时刻都保持运行。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "ReplicaSet", para. 1 4.2.2.1 How a ReplicaSet works ReplicaSet 的工作方式 "A ReplicaSet is defined with fields, including a selector that specifies how to identify Pods it can acquire, a number of replicas indicating how many Pods it should be maintaining, and a pod template specifying the data of new Pods it should create to meet the number of replicas criteria." ReplicaSet 由若干字段定义，包括一个说明如何识别可获取 Pod 的选择算符、一个表示应维持多少 Pod 的副本数，以及一个指定新建 Pod 数据的 Pod 模板，以满足副本数要求。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "How a ReplicaSet works", para. 1 4.2.2.2 Working with ReplicaSets 使用 ReplicaSet (No definition) （无定义） The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Working with ReplicaSets" Pod deletion cost Pod 删除开销 "Using the controller.kubernetes.io/pod-deletion-cost annotation, users can set a preference regarding which pods to remove first when downscaling a ReplicaSet." 使用 controller.kubernetes.io/pod-deletion-cost 注解，用户可以设定偏好，决定在缩容 ReplicaSet 时优先删除哪些 Pod。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Pod deletion cost", para. 1 References The Kubernetes Authors. cloud/kubernetes/workloads/controllers/s.summary: 4.2.3 StatefulSets Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 4.2.3 StatefulSets StatefulSet "A StatefulSet runs a group of Pods, and maintains a sticky identity for each of those Pods." StatefulSet 运行一组 Pod，并为每个 Pod 维持一个粘性身份。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "StatefulSets", para. 1 4.2.3.1 Pod Identity Pod 身份 "StatefulSet Pods have a unique identity that consists of an ordinal, a stable network identity, and stable storage." StatefulSet 的 Pod 拥有唯一身份，由序号、稳定的网络标识和稳定的存储组成。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Pod Identity", para. 1 Ordinal Index 序号索引 "For a StatefulSet with N replicas, each Pod in the StatefulSet will be assigned an integer ordinal, that is unique over the Set." 对于有 N 个副本的 StatefulSet，其中每个 Pod 都会被分配一个整数序号，该序号在该集合内唯一。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Ordinal Index", para. 1 Stable Network ID 稳定的网络标识 "Each Pod in a StatefulSet derives its hostname from the name of the StatefulSet and the ordinal of the Pod." StatefulSet 中的每个 Pod 得出自己的主机名，依据是 StatefulSet 的名称和该 Pod 的序号。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Stable Network ID", para. 1 Stable Storage 稳定的存储 "For each VolumeClaimTemplate entry defined in a StatefulSet, each Pod receives one PersistentVolumeClaim." 对于 StatefulSet 中定义的每个 VolumeClaimTemplate 条目，每个 Pod 都会获得一个 PersistentVolumeClaim。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Stable Storage", para. 1 4.2.3.2 Deployment and Scaling Guarantees 部署和扩缩保证 (No definition) （无定义） The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Deployment and Scaling Guarantees" OrderedReady Pod Management OrderedReady Pod 管理 "OrderedReady pod management is the default for StatefulSets." OrderedReady Pod 管理是 StatefulSet 的默认方式。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "OrderedReady Pod Management", para. 1 Parallel Pod Management Parallel Pod 管理 "Parallel pod management tells the StatefulSet controller to launch or terminate all Pods in parallel" Parallel Pod 管理让 StatefulSet 控制器去并行启动或终止所有 Pod The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Parallel Pod Management", para. 1 4.2.3.3 Rolling Updates 滚动更新 "When a StatefulSet's .spec.updateStrategy.type is set to RollingUpdate, the StatefulSet controller will delete and recreate each Pod in the StatefulSet." 当 StatefulSet 的 .spec.updateStrategy.type 设为 RollingUpdate 时，StatefulSet 控制器会删除并重建 StatefulSet 中的每个 Pod。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Rolling Updates", para. 1 Partitioned rolling updates 分区滚动更新 "The RollingUpdate update strategy can be partitioned, by specifying a .spec.updateStrategy.rollingUpdate.partition." RollingUpdate 更新策略可以分区，方法是指定 .spec.updateStrategy.rollingUpdate.partition。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Partitioned rolling updates", para. 1 4.2.3.4 Revision history 修订历史 (No definition) （无定义） The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Revision history" ControllerRevision ControllerRevision "ControllerRevision is a Kubernetes API resource used by controllers, such as the StatefulSet controller, to track historical configuration changes." ControllerRevision 是一种 Kubernetes API 资源，供 StatefulSet 控制器等控制器跟踪历史配置变更。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., "Revision history", para. 1 References The Kubernetes Authors. (n.d.). StatefulSets. courses/index.html.summary: Courses CST8913 Cloud Migration Course map Keyword Description 中文翻译 1 Strategy Why an organization adopts Azure. 组织为什么采用 Azure。 1.1 Motivations, mission and objectives (W2, W3) W2 introduces the cloud migration motivators (Lab 2); W3 covers the cloud adoption strategy: motivations, business outcomes, financial and technical considerations, and the adoption horizons. W2 讲云迁移动机（Lab 2）；W3 讲云采用战略：动机、业务成果、财务和技术考量，以及采用阶段（horizons）。 2 Plan Turns the strategy into an actionable plan. 把战略变成可执行的计划。 2.1 Plan migration (W4) W4 covers discovery and assessment and the migration plan. W4 讲发现与评估，以及迁移计划。 3 Ready Builds the Azure landing zone; not taught in W1 to W6. 搭建 Azure 着陆区；W1 到 W6 没讲。 4 Adopt Migrates, modernizes and builds workloads. 迁移、现代化和新建工作负载。 4.1 Migration (W5) W5 moves workloads by rehosting. W5 用重新托管迁移工作负载。 4.2 Modernization (W6) W6 improves workloads by replatforming them onto PaaS; the W6 slides say refactoring. W6 通过换平台把工作负载改到 PaaS 上；W6 课件叫重构（refactoring）。 5 Govern Sets guardrails; not taught in W1 to W6. 设置护栏；W1 到 W6 没讲。 6 Secure Protects the Azure cloud estate; not taught in W1 to W6. 保护 Azure 云资产；W1 到 W6 没讲。 7 Manage Operates Azure with RAMP; not taught in W1 to W6. 用 RAMP 运营 Azure；W1 到 W6 没讲。 Lab 1: Git, GitHub and Markdown (W1) Scenario: Set up a private GitHub repository for the course and submit Lab 1, written in Markdown, through a branch and a pull request. Git records every change as a commit; GitHub hosts the repository for sharing and review. Keyword Description 中文翻译 1 Private repository A private repository is visible only to invited collaborators, such as the instructor. 私有仓库只有受邀的协作者（比如老师）能看到。 2 Clone Cloning copies the repository, with its full history, to a local copy on the computer. 克隆把仓库连同完整历史复制到电脑上，成为本地副本。 3 Branch A branch such as lab-01 keeps the work off main until it is reviewed. 像 lab-01 这样的分支让作业在审阅之前不进 main。 4 Commit A commit records one stage of the work; Lab 1 was built in five stages. 一次提交记录作业的一个阶段；Lab 1 分五个阶段完成。 5 Push A push sends the branch to GitHub. 推送把分支发到 GitHub。 6 Pull request A pull request asks to merge the branch, after a review of the changed files. 拉取请求在审阅改动的文件之后，请求合并这个分支。 7 Merge Merging brings the reviewed branch into main. 合并把审阅过的分支并入 main。 Keyword Description 中文翻译 1 Heading A line starting with # signs; more signs make a lower level. 以 # 开头的一行；# 越多，级别越低。 2 Text formatting Two asterisks around text make it bold; one asterisk makes it italic. 文字两边加两个星号变粗体；加一个星号变斜体。 3 List Lines starting with a dash make a bulleted list; numbers make a numbered list. 以短横线开头的行组成无序列表；以数字开头组成有序列表。 4 Link The link text in square brackets, then the URL in parentheses. 方括号里写链接文字，后面圆括号里写 URL。 5 Image Like a link with an exclamation mark in front; the brackets hold the alt text. 和链接一样，前面加一个感叹号；方括号里写替代文字。 6 Blockquote A line starting with > becomes a quote. 以 > 开头的一行变成引用。 7 Inline code Backticks around a word show it as code inside a sentence. 单词两边加反引号，在句子里显示成代码。 8 Fenced code block Three backticks above and below a block, with the language name, such as bash. 代码块上下各加三个反引号，并写上语言名，比如 bash。 9 Table Cells separated by vertical bars, with a dash row under the header. 单元格用竖线隔开，表头下面加一行短横线。 10 Task list A list item with square brackets; an x marks it done. 带方括号的列表项；x 表示已完成。 11 Horizontal rule Three dashes on a line draw a dividing line. 一行写三个短横线，画出一条分隔线。 Lab 2: Levi Strauss migration case study (W2) Scenario: Levi Strauss & Co. moves from several datacenters, about 160 applications and nine ERP systems in 110 countries to Azure, as it shifts to direct-to-consumer sales. CAF: Strategy > Motivations, mission and objectives and Plan > Plan migration. Keyword Description 中文翻译 1 Migration motivators (Motivations) The business reasons Levi Strauss moves to the cloud; the Lab 2 rubric says migration motivators. Levi Strauss 上云的业务原因；Lab 2 评分表叫 migration motivators。 1.1 Direct-to-consumer Becoming a USD 10 billion DTC brand needs speed, automation and data. 要成为 100 亿美元的直面消费者（DTC）品牌，需要速度、自动化和数据。 1.2 Technical debt About 160 applications, several datacenters, nine ERP systems and different processes in 110 countries. 大约 160 个应用、多个数据中心、九套 ERP 系统，110 个国家流程各不相同。 1.3 Datacenter cost Owning and operating datacenters became too expensive. 自建和运营数据中心变得太贵。 1.4 Standardization One global ERP means consistent processes and data. 一套全球 ERP 意味着统一的流程和数据。 1.5 AI readiness Unified data on a standard platform is the foundation for AI and agents. 标准平台上的统一数据是 AI 和智能体的基础。 2 Discovery questions (Discover your existing workload inventory) The questions that complete the picture before planning; the Lab 2 rubric says infrastructure discovery questions. 做计划之前要问清楚的问题；Lab 2 评分表叫 infrastructure discovery questions。 2.1 Applications Which applications are business-critical, and which could be retired or replaced with SaaS? 哪些应用是业务关键的？哪些可以下线或换成 SaaS？ 2.2 Servers How many servers, how heavily used, and which run an OS near end of support? 有多少台服务器、使用率多高、哪些的操作系统快到支持期结束？ 2.3 Data How much data the nine ERP systems hold, and how it merges into one data model. 九套 ERP 系统有多少数据，怎样合并成一个数据模型。 2.4 Networking How stores, distribution centers and offices in 110 countries connect, and what latency they need. 110 个国家的门店、配送中心和办公室怎样连接，需要多低的延迟。 2.5 Security How identity is managed, which data-residency laws apply, and the RPO and RTO. 身份怎样管理，适用哪些数据驻留法律，RPO 和 RTO 是多少。 2.6 Dependencies Which applications depend on each other, and so must move in the same wave. 哪些应用互相依赖，因此必须在同一批次迁移。 2.7 Business requirements The acceptable downtime, the retail peak periods to avoid, and the budget and deadline. 可接受的停机时间、要避开的零售高峰期，以及预算和截止日期。 CAF: Plan > Define operating model. Keyword Description 中文翻译 R Responsible Does the work; the migration team for most activities. 干活的人；大多数活动由迁移团队负责。 A Accountable The single owner of an activity; the infrastructure director for discovery, landing zone, migration, cutover and optimization. 一项活动的唯一负责人；发现、着陆区、迁移、切换和优化都由基础设施总监负责。 C Consulted Gives input before decisions, such as security and business leaders. 决策前提供意见，比如安全和业务负责人。 I Informed Kept up to date, such as the sponsor after approval. 随时知情，比如批准之后的发起人。 CAF: Plan > Plan migration. Keyword Description 中文翻译 1 Retire Decommissions a workload with no business value, so it does not move; used for applications no longer needed. 停用没有业务价值的工作负载，所以它不迁移；用于不再需要的应用。 2 Rehost Moves the workload like for like with minimal changes, such as a server to an Azure VM; used for most servers. 原样迁移工作负载，改动最少，比如把服务器搬到 Azure 虚拟机；大多数服务器用这种方式。 3 Replatform Changes the hosting environment to PaaS with minimal code changes, such as SQL Server on a VM to Azure SQL; fits the databases (Azure SQL Managed Instance) and third-party apps (AKS), which the W2 slides and Lab 2 call Refactor. 把托管环境换成 PaaS，代码改动很少，比如把虚拟机上的 SQL Server 换成 Azure SQL；符合数据库（Azure SQL Managed Instance）和第三方应用（AKS），W2 课件和 Lab 2 把它们叫作 Refactor。 4 Refactor Improves the internal structure of the code without adding features, to reduce technical debt. 改进代码的内部结构，不增加新功能，以减少技术债。 5 Rearchitect Redesigns the architecture and code, such as splitting a monolith into microservices; too slow for 160 applications before the datacenter exit. 重新设计架构和代码，比如把单体应用拆成微服务；在退出数据中心之前对 160 个应用这样做太慢。 6 Replace Swaps the workload for a SaaS product, so no custom code remains to maintain; the nine ERP systems become one global ERP. 把工作负载换成 SaaS 产品，不再有自定义代码要维护；九套 ERP 系统变成一套全球 ERP。 7 Rebuild Develops the workload again from the start with cloud-native solutions, when the old system is too outdated to modernize. 用云原生方案从头重新开发工作负载，适用于旧系统过于陈旧、无法现代化的情况。 8 Retain Keeps the workload where it is, when it is stable or cannot be migrated, for example because of regulations. 工作负载留在原地，适用于它运行稳定或无法迁移的情况，比如受法规限制。 CAF: Plan > Plan migration. Keyword Description 中文翻译 1 Discovery and assessment Months 1-2: inventory with Azure Migrate, map dependencies, choose a strategy per workload. 第 1 到 2 个月：用 Azure Migrate 盘点，梳理依赖关系，为每个工作负载选迁移策略。 2 Azure landing zone Months 2-3: subscriptions, networking, identity, security and backup. 第 2 到 3 个月：订阅、网络、身份、安全和备份。 3 Migration waves Month 3: a pilot wave of low-risk servers tests replication, cutover and rollback. Months 4-8: dependent applications move together, avoiding retail peak periods. 第 3 个月：试点波次迁移低风险服务器，测试复制、切换和回滚。第 4 到 8 个月：互相依赖的应用一起迁，避开零售高峰期。 4 Execute Month 8: final cutover in approved downtime windows. 第 8 个月：在批准的停机窗口内完成最终切换。 5 Decommission Month 8: the datacenters are decommissioned after the cutover. 第 8 个月：切换之后关停数据中心。 6 Optimize Month 9 onward: right-size, track cost, test disaster recovery. 第 9 个月起：调整规格、跟踪成本、测试灾难恢复。 Cloud Adoption Framework (W2, W3) CAF: All seven phases. Keyword Description 中文翻译 Azure adoption phases The Cloud Adoption Framework has seven Azure adoption phases. 云采用框架有七个 Azure 采用阶段。 1 Strategy Strategy sets why an organization adopts Azure: the cloud adoption strategy. 战略确定组织为什么采用 Azure：即云采用战略。 2 Plan Plan turns that strategy into an actionable plan: the cloud adoption plan. 计划把战略变成可执行的计划：即云采用计划。 3 Ready Ready builds the Azure landing zone. 就绪搭建 Azure 着陆区。 4 Adopt Adopt migrates, modernizes and builds workloads. 采用负责迁移、现代化和新建工作负载。 5 Govern Govern sets guardrails. 治理设置护栏。 6 Secure Secure protects the Azure cloud estate. 安全保护 Azure 云资产。 7 Manage Manage operates Azure with RAMP: Ready, Administer, Monitor, Protect. 管理用 RAMP 运营 Azure：就绪、管理、监控、保护。 Lab 3: IaaS and PaaS architecture (W3) Scenario: A web application with a React UI, a Flask web server and a PostgreSQL database is designed on Azure twice: once on IaaS, once on PaaS. Keyword Description 中文翻译 1 IaaS In IaaS, the provider supplies VMs, disks and network; the team builds and maintains everything on them. 在 IaaS 里，云服务商提供虚拟机、磁盘和网络；上面的一切由团队自己搭建和维护。 2 N-tier, subnets, NSGs In an N-tier architecture, each tier has its own subnet, and its NSG allows only traffic from the tier in front of it. 在 N 层架构里，每一层有自己的子网，它的 NSG（网络安全组）只允许前一层的流量进来。 3 Availability zones Availability zones are separate datacenters in one region, so one zone can fail. 可用区是同一区域里相互独立的数据中心，所以一个区坏了也没关系。 4 Load balancer A load balancer spreads requests across servers and removes failed ones. 负载均衡器把请求分给多台服务器，并把坏掉的服务器移出去。 5 Replication Database replication keeps a standby in sync with the primary. 数据库复制让备用库和主库保持同步。 6 Management VMs IaaS needs its own jumpbox, monitoring, NAT and backup servers. IaaS 需要自己的跳板机、监控、NAT 和备份服务器。 7 PaaS In PaaS, each tier becomes a managed service, and the provider runs the servers, patching, scaling and backups. 在 PaaS 里，每一层变成一个托管服务，服务器、打补丁、扩缩容和备份都由云服务商负责。 8 App Service App Service runs web apps on several instances behind a built-in load balancer, with autoscale. App Service 在内置负载均衡器后面用多个实例运行 Web 应用，并支持自动扩缩。 9 VNet integration VNet integration lets App Service reach resources that accept private connections only. VNet 集成让 App Service 能访问只接受私有连接的资源。 10 Key Vault, Application Insights Key Vault stores secrets; Application Insights collects telemetry. Keyword Description 中文翻译 1 New DC Every server needs sign-in and DNS. 每台服务器都需要登录和 DNS。 2 FILE-01 Few dependencies and a security deadline. 依赖少，且有安全截止日期。 3 Group 1 Last, because DB-01 is mission-critical. 最后迁，因为 DB-01 是关键任务。 4 Retire DC-01 Only after nothing uses it. 要等到没有东西再用它。 Q6.5: Validation: Describe how you would confirm that migrated services work correctly. Keyword Description 中文翻译 1 Servers Boot, join the domain and resolve DNS. 能启动、加入域并解析 DNS。 2 Application The website loads over HTTPS; APP-01 reads and writes DB-01. 网站能通过 HTTPS 打开；APP-01 能读写 DB-01。 3 Data and files DB-01 data matches the source; users open their shares. DB-01 数据与源一致；用户能打开共享。 Q6.6: Rollback: Identify a condition that would trigger rollback and describe the high-level recovery approach. Keyword Description 中文翻译 1 Trigger A failed check that cannot be fixed within the window, such as APP-01 unable to reach DB-01. 检查失败且无法在窗口内修复，比如 APP-01 连不上 DB-01。 2 Recovery Point DNS back, restart the originals, stop the Azure VMs. 把 DNS 指回，重启原服务器，停掉 Azure 虚拟机。 Q6.7: If you propose a pilot, explain how it can be tested without disrupting dependent production systems. Keyword Description 中文翻译 1 Test migration A copy in an isolated Azure network; the original keeps running. 在隔离的 Azure 网络里创建副本；原服务器继续运行。 2 Clean up The copy is removed after testing. 测试后清理副本。 Lab 5 Q1.1: Identify two reasons the organization migrated to the cloud. Keyword Description 中文翻译 1 Aging infrastructure Over 400 servers and 200 applications built over 45 years. 45 年积累的 400 多台服务器和 200 多个应用。 2 State legislation A 2021 law encouraged agencies to use the cloud. 2021 年的法律鼓励机构使用云。 Q1.2: Explain why rehosting was appropriate. Keyword Description 中文翻译 1 Speed Moves VMs without code changes, within nine months. 不改代码迁移虚拟机，在九个月内完成。 2 No disruption Azure VMware Solution runs the same VMware stack. Azure VMware Solution 运行相同的 VMware 技术栈。 3 Safe partial progress Waves mean a half-finished migration still works. 波次让迁到一半时系统仍能工作。 4 Modernize later Applications improve one at a time afterwards. 之后逐个改进应用。 Q1.3: Explain how rehosting differs from replatforming. Keyword Description 中文翻译 1 Rehosting Moves the VM as is; only where it runs changes. 把虚拟机原样迁走；只改变运行位置。 2 Replatforming Small changes to use a managed platform; less operations work, more testing. 做少量修改以使用托管平台；运维更省，测试更多。 Q2: Draw a high-level diagram showing the migration from an on-premises VMware environment to Azure VMware Solution. Keyword Description 中文翻译 1 On-premises vSphere datacenter with application, database and AD DS/DNS VMs. vSphere 数据中心，含应用、数据库和 AD DS/DNS 虚拟机。 2 ExpressRoute with Global Reach The private link between the two sides. 两边之间的私有连接。 3 Private cloud vCenter, NSX and vSAN on dedicated hosts. 专用主机上的 vCenter、NSX 和 vSAN。 4 VMware HCX Moves VMs in waves and keeps their IP addresses. 分波次迁移虚拟机并保留 IP 地址。 Q3.1: Propose a phased migration plan. Keyword Description 中文翻译 1 Prepare Private cloud, ExpressRoute, HCX, and a baseline. 私有云、ExpressRoute、HCX 和基线。 2 Discover and group Map dependencies and build waves. 梳理依赖并建立波次。 3 Pilot wave About 10 low-risk VMs. 约 10 台低风险虚拟机。 4 Main waves About 75 VMs each, most critical last. 每批约 75 台，最关键的最后迁。 5 Stabilize and decommission Retire on-premises copies, then modernize. 下线本地副本，然后现代化。 Q3.2: Explain how you would group dependent workloads. Keyword Description 中文翻译 1 Find dependencies Dependency analysis and owner interviews. 依赖分析和访谈负责人。 2 Same wave An application and everything it calls. 应用和它调用的一切。 3 Shared services AD DS and DNS stay reachable from both sides, and move last. AD DS 和 DNS 两边都能访问，最后迁。 4 Order From lowest to highest criticality. 按重要性从低到高。 Q3.3: Explain how you would test a migration wave. Keyword Description 中文翻译 1 Before cutover A test migration in an isolated network segment. 在隔离网段做测试迁移。 2 At cutover VMs keep their IPs, smoke tests pass, owners sign off. 虚拟机保留 IP，冒烟测试通过，负责人签字。 3 After cutover Compare with the baseline; confirm monitoring and backup. 与基线比较；确认监控和备份。 Q3.4: Explain how you would decide whether to proceed or roll back. Keyword Description 中文翻译 1 Proceed Tests pass, within about 10% of baseline, 48 hours with no critical incidents, backups complete. 测试通过、在基线约 10% 以内、48 小时无严重事故、备份完成。 2 Roll back A critical application cannot be fixed in the window, data is lost, or performance is far below baseline. 关键应用无法在窗口内修复、数据丢失或性能远低于基线。 3 How Keep on-premises VMs intact; move back with HCX or restart the originals, then reconcile data. 保持本地虚拟机完好；用 HCX 迁回或重启原虚拟机，然后核对数据。 Lab 6 Q1: Key similarities and differences between equivalent services from the three cloud providers. Keyword Description 中文翻译 1 Similarities Most services match one to one; all offer VMs, PaaS, serverless and Kubernetes. 多数服务一一对应；都有虚拟机、PaaS、无服务器和 Kubernetes。 2 Differences RDS and Cloud SQL cover several engines in one service; Azure has one per engine. RDS 和 Cloud SQL 一个服务支持多种引擎；Azure 每种引擎一个服务。 3 No match Google has no desktop as a service (row 25); Azure has no media transcoding (row 29). Google 没有桌面即服务（第 25 行）；Azure 没有媒体转码（第 29 行）。 Q2: Unique features or capabilities that certain services may offer compared to their counterparts. Keyword Description 中文翻译 1 Azure Event Hubs Apache Kafka compatible without code changes. 不改代码就兼容 Apache Kafka。 2 AWS Step Functions Calls over 9,000 API actions. 能调用 9000 多个 API 操作。 3 Amazon WorkSpaces Personal and Pools modes. Personal 和 Pools 两种模式。 Q3: How the naming conventions between cloud providers differ for similar services. Keyword Description 中文翻译 1 AWS Brand names and acronyms, such as EC2 and S3. 品牌名和缩写，比如 EC2 和 S3。 2 Azure "Azure" plus the function. "Azure" 加功能名。 3 Google Cloud Often "Cloud" plus the function. 常用 "Cloud" 加功能名。 4 Names change Azure Purview became Microsoft Purview. Azure Purview 变成 Microsoft Purview。 Comparison table: For each description, identify the corresponding service name in AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud. # Description AWS Azure Google Cloud 1 A compute service that provides scalable virtual machines for running applications. Amazon EC2 Azure Virtual Machines Compute Engine 2 An object storage service used to store and retrieve data, commonly used for backups and static website content. Amazon S3 Azure Blob Storage Cloud Storage 3 A managed relational database service that supports multiple database engines like MySQL, PostgreSQL, and SQL Server. Amazon RDS Azure SQL Database, Azure Database for MySQL, Azure Database for PostgreSQL Cloud SQL 4 A serverless compute service that allows you to run code in response to events without provisioning or managing servers. data/index.html.title: Data | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
data/index.html.summary: Data Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source Data 数据 "Information in a specific representation, usually as a sequence of symbols that have meaning." 信息，以特定的表示形式呈现，通常是一串有意义的符号序列。 National Institute of Standards and Technology, n.d., "data" entry, definition 1 CS2023 DM CS2023 DM "Today's graduates are expected to possess DBMS user (rather than implementor) skills. These primarily include data modeling and query construction; ability to take an unorganized collection of data, organize it using a DBMS, and access/update the collection via queries." 如今的毕业生应具备DBMS 使用者（而非实现者）的技能。这些技能主要包括数据建模和查询构建；能够把一堆无组织的数据用 DBMS 组织起来，并通过查询访问和更新这些数据。 Joint Task Force on Computing Curricula, 2024, DM "Preamble" section, para. 2 Analytics engines 分析引擎 "Apache Spark is a unified analytics engine for large-scale data processing." Apache Spark 是一个统一的分析引擎，用于大规模数据处理。 The Apache Software Foundation, n.d., "Overview" page, para. 1 Document databases 文档数据库 "MongoDB is a document database designed to help developers build modern applications faster. It stores data in flexible, JSON-like documents, making it easy to model data the same way your application code uses it." MongoDB 是一种文档数据库，旨在帮助开发者更快地构建现代应用。它把数据存储在灵活的、类似 JSON 的文档中，让你能按应用代码使用数据的方式来建模数据。 MongoDB, Inc., n.d.-b, "What is MongoDB?" page, para. 1 In-memory data stores 内存数据存储 "Redis can be used as a database, cache, streaming engine, message broker, and more." Redis 可以用作数据库、缓存、流处理引擎、消息代理等。 Redis Ltd., n.d.-b, "Quick starts" page, para. 1 Relational database systems 关系数据库系统 "PostgreSQL is an object-relational database management system (ORDBMS) based on POSTGRES, Version 4.2, developed at the University of California at Berkeley Computer Science Department." data/sql-server/business-continuity/inde.summary: 5. Business Continuity Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文解释 Source Business continuity 业务连续性 "The goal is to keep the business up and running with minimal or no interruption. This concept is also known as business continuity." 目标是让业务在尽量少或没有中断的情况下持续运转。这个概念也称为业务连续性。 Microsoft, 2025b, para. 2 Always On Always On "Always On is an umbrella term for the availability features in SQL Server and covers both AGs and FCIs. Always On isn't the name of the AG feature." Always On 是 SQL Server 可用性功能的总称，同时涵盖 AG 和 FCI。Always On 不是 AG 功能的名称。 Microsoft, 2025b, "Availability groups" subsection, Note Backup 备份 "A copy of data that you can use to restore and recover the data after a failure." 数据的副本，可用于在故障后还原并恢复数据。 Microsoft, 2026b, "Glossary of backup terms" section, row "backup (noun)" Restore 还原 "A multiphase process that copies all the data and log pages from a specified SQL Server backup to a specified database, and then rolls forward all the transactions that are logged in the backup by applying logged changes to bring the data forward in time." 一个多阶段过程，将指定 SQL Server 备份中的所有数据页和日志页复制到指定的数据库，然后通过应用已记录的更改来前滚备份中记录的所有事务，使数据向前推进到某个时间点。 Microsoft, 2026b, "Glossary of backup terms" section, row "restore" Always On availability groups Always On 可用性组 "The Always On availability groups feature is a high-availability and disaster-recovery solution that provides an enterprise-level alternative to database mirroring." Always On 可用性组功能是一种高可用性和灾难恢复解决方案，提供了企业级的数据库镜像替代方案。 Microsoft, 2026c, para. 2 Always On failover cluster instance Always On 故障转移群集实例 "SQL Server Always On failover cluster instances use Windows Server Failover Clustering (WSFC) to provide local high availability. A failover cluster instance (FCI) is redundant at the server-instance level." SQL Server Always On 故障转移群集实例使用 Windows Server 故障转移群集（WSFC）提供本地高可用性。故障转移群集实例（FCI）在服务器实例级别是冗余的。 Microsoft, 2025a, para. 1 Database mirroring 数据库镜像 "Database mirroring is a solution for increasing the availability of a SQL Server database." 数据库镜像是一种提高 SQL Server 数据库可用性的解决方案。 Microsoft, 2025c, para. 1 after the Caution and Important notes Log shipping 日志传送 "SQL Server Log shipping allows you to automatically send transaction log backups from a primary database on a primary server instance to one or more secondary databases on separate secondary server instances." SQL Server 日志传送让你能够自动将事务日志备份从主服务器实例上的主数据库发送到位于不同辅助服务器实例上的一个或多个辅助数据库。 Microsoft, 2026a, para. 1 References Microsoft. (2025a, August 25). Always On failover cluster instances (SQL Server). Database Design Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source Hierarchical data 层次结构数据 "Hierarchical data is defined as a set of data items that are related to each other by hierarchical relationships." 层次结构数据被定义为一组通过层次关系相互关联的数据项。 Microsoft, 2025c, para. 2 Collation 排序规则 "A collation specifies the bit patterns that represent each character in a dataset. Collations also determine the rules that sort and compare data." 排序规则会指定表示数据集中每个字符的位模式。排序规则还会决定对数据进行排序和比较的规则。 Microsoft, 2026a, "Collation" section, para. 1 Database 数据库 "A database in SQL Server is made up of a collection of tables that stores a specific set of structured data." SQL Server 中的数据库由一组表构成，这些表存储一组特定的结构化数据。 Microsoft, 2017b, para. 1 Event notification 事件通知 "Event notifications send information about events to a Service Broker service." 事件通知会把有关事件的信息发送到 Service Broker 服务。 Microsoft, 2025a, para. 1 FILESTREAM FILESTREAM "FILESTREAM enables SQL Server-based applications to store unstructured data, such as documents and images, on the file system." FILESTREAM 让基于 SQL Server 的应用程序能够把非结构化数据（例如文档和图像）存储在文件系统上。 Microsoft, 2017a, "FILESTREAM (SQL Server)" section, para. 1 FileTable FileTable "The FileTable feature brings support for the Windows file namespace and compatibility with Windows applications to the file data stored in SQL Server." FileTable 功能为存储在 SQL Server 中的文件数据带来对 Windows 文件命名空间的支持以及与 Windows 应用程序的兼容性。 Microsoft, 2017a, "FileTables (SQL Server)" section, para. 1 Graph database 图数据库 "A graph database is a collection of nodes (or vertices) and edges (or relationships)." 图数据库是节点（或顶点）与边（或关系）的集合。 Microsoft, 2025b, "What is a graph database?" section, para. 1 Sequence 序列 "A sequence is a user-defined schema-bound object that generates a sequence of numeric values according to the specification with which the sequence was created." 序列是用户定义的、绑定到架构的对象，它按照创建序列时所指定的规格生成一系列数值。 Microsoft, 2025d, para. 1 Service Broker Service Broker "Service Broker is a message delivery framework that enables you to create native in-database service-oriented applications." Service Broker 是一个消息传递框架，让你能够创建原生的数据库内面向服务的应用程序。 Microsoft, 2025e, "Overview" section, para. 1 Spatial data 空间数据 "Spatial data represents information about the physical location and shape of geometric objects." 空间数据表示有关几何对象的物理位置和形状的信息。 Microsoft, 2024b, para. 1 Stored procedure 存储过程 "A stored procedure in SQL Server is a group of one or more Transact-SQL statements, or a reference to a Microsoft .NET Framework common runtime language (CLR) method." SQL Server 中的存储过程是一组一条或多条 Transact-SQL 语句，或是对 Microsoft .NET Framework 公共语言运行时 (CLR) 方法的引用。 Microsoft, 2026b, para. 1 Table 表 "Tables are database objects that contain all the data in a database." 表是包含数据库中全部数据的数据库对象。 Microsoft, 2025f, para. 1 Change data capture 变更数据捕获 "Change data capture provides historical change information for a user table by capturing both the fact that DML changes were made and the actual data that was changed." 变更数据捕获通过同时捕获 DML 更改已发生这一事实和实际被更改的数据，来为用户表提供历史更改信息。 Microsoft, 2025g, "Change data capture" section, para. 1 Change tracking 更改跟踪 "Change tracking captures the fact that rows in a table were changed, but doesn't capture the data that was changed." 更改跟踪会捕获表中的行已被更改这一事实，但不会捕获被更改的数据。 Microsoft, 2025g, "Change tracking" section, para. 1 Logon trigger 登录触发器 "Logon triggers fire stored procedures in response to a LOGON event." 登录触发器会响应 LOGON 事件而触发存储过程。 Microsoft, 2024a, para. 1 User-defined function 用户定义函数 "Like functions in programming languages, SQL Server user-defined functions are routines that accept parameters, perform an action, such as a complex calculation, and return the result of that action as a value." 与编程语言中的函数类似，SQL Server 用户定义函数是接受参数、执行某个操作（例如复杂计算）并以值的形式返回该操作结果的例程。 Microsoft, 2025h, para. 1 View 视图 "A view is a virtual table whose contents are defined by a query." 视图是其内容由查询定义的虚拟表。 Microsoft, 2024c, para. 1 xml data type xml 数据类型 "The xml data type. XML values can be stored natively in an xml data type column that can be typed according to a collection of XML schemas, or left untyped." xml 数据类型。XML 值可以原生存储在 xml 数据类型的列中，该列可以按一组 XML 架构进行类型化，也可以保持非类型化。 Microsoft, 2023, intro list, item 1 References Microsoft. Microsoft SQL 数据库引擎是存储、处理和保护数据的核心服务。 Microsoft, 2026e, para. 1 SQL Server editions SQL Server 版本 (context) "The different editions of SQL Server accommodate the unique performance, runtime, and price a table or view that speeds retrieval of rows from the table or view." 索引是与表或视图关联的磁盘上或内存中的结构，可以加快从表或视图中检索行的速度。 Microsoft, 2026a, "Index basics" section, para. 3 Page 页 "A page is a fundamental unit of data storage in the Database Engine." 页是数据库引擎中数据存储的基本单位。 Microsoft, 2025e, para. 2 Extent 区 "An extent is a collection of eight physically contiguous pages, used to manage pages efficiently." 区是由八个物理上连续的页组成的集合，用于高效管理页。 Microsoft, 2025e, para. 3 Query processing 查询处理 (context) "The SQL Server Database Engine processes queries on various data storage architectures such as local tables, 数据库的主要用途是存储和检索数据，因此密集的磁盘输入/输出（I/O）是数据库引擎的核心特征。 Microsoft, 2026d, para. 1 Security cache 安全缓存 "The security cache stores permissions for a user or a login for various securable objects in a database or para. 1 Task 任务 "A task represents the unit of work that needs to be completed to fulfill the request." 任务表示为完成请求而需要完成的工作单元。 Microsoft, 2025h, "Tasks" section, para. 1 Transaction log 事务日志 "Every SQL Server database has a transaction log that records all transactions and the database modifications that are made by each transaction." 每个 SQL Server 数据库都有一个事务日志，用于记录所有事务以及每个事务所做的数据库修改。 Microsoft, 2025f, para. 1 Locking 锁定 "Locking is a mechanism used by the Database Engine to synchronize access by multiple users to the same piece of data at the same time." 锁定是数据库引擎使用的一种机制，用于同步多个用户对同一数据的同时访问。 graphics/index.html.summary: Graphics Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source Graphics 图形学 "Computer graphics is the term used to describe the computer generation and manipulation of images and can be viewed as the science of enabling visual communication through computation." 计算机图形学这个术语指用计算机生成和处理图像，也可以看作实现视觉交流的科学，通过计算来实现。 Joint Task Force on Computing Curricula, 2024, GIT "Preamble" section, para. 1 CS2023 GIT CS2023 GIT "Traditionally, graphics at the undergraduate level focused on rendering, linear algebra, physics, the graphics pipeline, interaction, and phenomenological approaches. Today’s graphics courses increasingly include data science, physical computing, animation, and haptics." 传统上，本科阶段的图形学侧重于渲染、线性代数、物理、图形管线、交互以及现象学方法。如今的图形学课程越来越多地包含数据科学、物理计算、动画和触觉。 Joint Task Force on Computing Curricula, 2024, GIT "Preamble" section, para. 1 Graphics APIs 图形 API "Vulkan is a new generation graphics and compute API that provides high-efficiency, cross-platform access to modern GPUs used in a wide variety of devices from PCs and consoles to mobile phones and embedded platforms." hardware/cs2023/index.html.summary: CS2023 AR Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source CS2023 AR CS2023 AR "The Architecture and Organization (AR) knowledge area aims to develop a deeper understanding of the hardware environments upon which almost all computing is based, and the relevant interfaces provided to higher software layers." 体系结构与组成（AR）知识领域旨在加深对几乎所有计算赖以运行的硬件环境的理解，以及对向上层软件提供的相关接口的理解。 Joint Task Force on Computing Curricula, 2024, AR "Preamble" section, para. 2 Digital Logic and Digital Systems 数字逻辑与数字系统 (context) "Discuss the progression of computer technology components from vacuum tubes to VLSI, from mainframe computer architectures to the organization of warehouse-scale computers." （语境）讨论计算机技术部件的演进：从真空管到超大规模集成电路（VLSI），从大型机体系结构到仓库级计算机的组织。 Joint Task Force on Computing Curricula, 2024, AR-Logic "Illustrative Learning Outcomes", 1 Machine-Level Data Representation 机器级数据表示 (context) "Discuss why everything in computers are data, including instructions." （语境）讨论为什么计算机里的一切都是数据，包括指令。 Joint Task Force on Computing Curricula, 2024, AR-Representation "Illustrative Learning Outcomes", 1 Assembly Level Machine Organization 汇编级机器组织 (context) "Discuss how the classical von Neumann functional units are implemented in embedded systems, particularly on-chip and off-chip memory." （语境）讨论经典冯·诺依曼功能部件在嵌入式系统中如何实现，尤其是片上和片外存储器。 Joint Task Force on Computing Curricula, 2024, AR-Assembly "Illustrative Learning Outcomes", 1 Memory Hierarchy 存储层次结构 (context) "Using a memory system diagram, identify the main types of memory technology (e.g., SRAM, DRAM) and their relative cost and performance." （语境）借助存储系统图，识别主要的存储技术类型（例如 SRAM、DRAM）及其相对成本和性能。 Joint Task Force on Computing Curricula, 2024, AR-Memory "Illustrative Learning Outcomes", 1 Interfacing and Communication 接口与通信 (context) "Analyze an interrupt control diagram to comment on how interrupts are used to implement I/O control and data transfers." （语境）分析中断控制图，说明如何用中断实现 I/O 控制和数据传输。 Joint Task Force on Computing Curricula, 2024, AR-IO "Illustrative Learning Outcomes", 1 Functional Organization 功能组织 (context) "Compare alternative implementation of datapaths in modern computer architectures." （语境）比较现代计算机体系结构中数据通路的不同实现。 Joint Task Force on Computing Curricula, 2024, AR-Organization "Illustrative Learning Outcomes", 1 Performance and Energy Efficiency 性能与能效 (context) "Discuss performance and energy efficiency evaluation metrics." （语境）讨论性能和能效的评估指标。 Joint Task Force on Computing Curricula, 2024, AR-Performance-Energy "Illustrative Learning Outcomes", 1 Heterogeneous Architectures 异构体系结构 (context) "Analyze a system diagram with alternative parallel architectures, e.g., SIMD and MIMD, and identify the key differences." （语境）分析一张含有不同并行体系结构（例如 SIMD 和 MIMD）的系统图，并找出关键区别。 Joint Task Force on Computing Curricula, 2024, AR-Heterogeneity "Illustrative Learning Outcomes", 1 Secure Processor Architectures 安全处理器体系结构 (context) "Discuss principles of secure hardware, exploring a framework for risk analysis and asset protection." （语境）讨论安全硬件的原理，探讨风险分析和资产保护的框架。 Joint Task Force on Computing Curricula, 2024, AR-Security "Illustrative Learning Outcomes", 1 Quantum Architectures 量子体系结构 (context) "Discuss how a quantum object produced as a particle propagates like a wave and is detected as a math/axioms/2-geometry/3-group-i-axioms-.title: Group I: Axioms of Connection | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
math/axioms/2-geometry/3-group-i-axioms-.summary: Group I: Axioms of Connection Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 2 Geometry 几何 (No definition) （无定义） Euclid, ca. 300 B.C.E./1996, Book I, "Postulates" Group I: Axioms of Connection 第一组：关联公理 "The axioms of this group establish a connection between the concepts indicated above; namely, points, straight lines, and planes." 这一组公理在前面所说的概念之间建立联系，即点、直线和平面。 Hilbert, 1902, § 2 Axiom I, 1 公理 I, 1 "Two distinct points A and B always completely determine a straight line a. We write AB = a or BA = a." 两个不同的点 A、B 总能完全确定一条直线 a，记作 AB = a 或 BA = a。 Hilbert, 1902, § 2 Axiom I, 2 公理 I, 2 "Any two distinct points of a straight line completely determine that line; that is, if AB = a and AC = a, where B ≠ C, then is also BC = a." 直线上任意两个不同的点完全确定这条直线：若 AB = a、AC = a 且 B ≠ C，则 BC = a。 Hilbert, 1902, § 2 Axiom I, 3 公理 I, 3 "Three points A, B, C not situated in the same straight line always completely determine a plane α. We write ABC = α." 不在同一直线上的三点 A、B、C 总能完全确定一个平面 α，记作 ABC = α。 Hilbert, 1902, § 2 Axiom I, 4 公理 I, 4 "Any three points A, B, C of a plane α, which do not lie in the same straight line, completely determine that plane." 平面 α 上不在同一直线上的任意三点 A、B、C 完全确定这个平面。 Hilbert, 1902, § 2 Axiom I, 5 公理 I, 5 "If two points A, B of a straight line a lie in a plane α, then every point of a lies in a." 若直线 a 上的两点 A、B 在平面 α 内，则 a 上的每一点都在 α 内（原文末尾的 a 应为 α）。 Hilbert, 1902, § 2 Axiom I, 6 公理 I, 6 "If two planes α, β have a point A in common, then they have at least a second point B in common." 若两个平面 α、β 有一个公共点 A，则它们至少还有第二个公共点 B。 Hilbert, 1902, § 2 Axiom I, 7 公理 I, 7 "Upon every straight line there exist at least two points, in every plane at least three points not lying in the same straight line, and in space there exist at least four points not lying in a plane." 每条直线上至少有两点；每个平面上至少有三点不在同一直线上；空间中至少有四点不在同一平面上。 Hilbert, 1902, § 2 References Euclid. math/axioms/2-geometry/4-group-ii-axioms.title: Group II: Axioms of Order | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
math/axioms/2-geometry/4-group-ii-axioms.summary: Group II: Axioms of Order Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 2 Geometry 几何 (No definition) （无定义） Euclid, ca. 300 B.C.E./1996, Book I, "Postulates" Group II: Axioms of Order 第二组：顺序公理 "The axioms of this group define the idea expressed by the word "between," and make possible, upon the basis of this idea, an order of sequence of the points upon a straight line, in a plane, and in space." 这一组公理定义“在……之间”这个词所表达的概念，并在此基础上，使直线上、平面上和空间中的点有先后顺序。 Hilbert, 1902, § 3 Axiom II, 1 公理 II, 1 "If A, B, C are points of a straight line and B lies between A and C, then B lies also between C and A." 若 A、B、C 是一条直线上的点，且 B 在 A 与 C 之间，则 B 也在 C 与 A 之间。 Hilbert, 1902, § 3 Axiom II, 2 公理 II, 2 "If A and C are two points of a straight line, then there exists at least one point B lying between A and C and at least one point D so situated that C lies between A and D." 若 A、C 是直线上的两点，则至少有一点 B 在 A 与 C 之间，并且至少有一点 D 使 C 在 A 与 D 之间。 Hilbert, 1902, § 3 Axiom II, 3 公理 II, 3 "Of any three points situated on a straight line, there is always one and only one which lies between the other two." 直线上任意三点中，有且只有一点在另两点之间。 Hilbert, 1902, § 3 Axiom II, 4 公理 II, 4 "Any four points A, B, C, D of a straight line can always be so arranged that B shall lie between A and C and also between A and D, and, furthermore, that C shall lie between A and D and also between B and D." 直线上任意四点 A、B、C、D 总能这样排列：B 在 A 与 C 之间、也在 A 与 D 之间，C 在 A 与 D 之间、也在 B 与 D 之间。 Hilbert, 1902, § 3 Axiom II, 5 公理 II, 5（帕施公理） "Let A, B, C be three points not lying in the same straight line and let a be a straight line lying in the plane ABC and not passing through any of the points A, B, C. Then, if the straight line a passes through a point of the segment AB, it will also pass through either a point of the segment BC or a point of the segment AC." 设 A、B、C 不共线，直线 a 在平面 ABC 内且不经过 A、B、C。若 a 经过线段 AB 上的一点，则它也经过线段 BC 或线段 AC 上的一点。 Hilbert, 1902, § 3 References Euclid. math/axioms/2-geometry/5-group-iii-axiom.summary: Group III: Axiom of Parallels (Euclid's Axiom) Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 2 Geometry 几何 (No definition) （无定义） Euclid, ca. 300 B.C.E./1996, Book I, "Postulates" Group III: Axiom of Parallels (Euclid's Axiom) 第三组：平行公理（欧几里得公理） "The introduction of this axiom simplifies greatly the fundamental principles of geometry and facilitates in no small degree its development." 引入这条公理大大简化了几何的基本原理，并在很大程度上便利了几何的发展。 Hilbert, 1902, § 5 Axiom III 公理 III（平行公理） "In a plane α there can be drawn through any point A, lying outside of a straight line a, one and only one straight line which does not intersect the line a. This straight line is called the parallel to a through the given point A." 在平面 α 内，过直线 a 外的任一点 A，有且只有一条直线不与 a 相交，这条直线叫作过点 A 的 a 的平行线。 Hilbert, 1902, § 5 References Euclid. (1996). math/axioms/2-geometry/6-group-iv-axioms.title: Group IV: Axioms of Congruence | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
math/axioms/2-geometry/6-group-iv-axioms.summary: Group IV: Axioms of Congruence Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 2 Geometry 几何 (No definition) （无定义） Euclid, ca. 300 B.C.E./1996, Book I, "Postulates" Group IV: Axioms of Congruence 第四组：合同公理 "The axioms of this group define the idea of congruence or displacement." 这一组公理定义合同（全等）或移动的概念。 Hilbert, 1902, § 6 Axiom IV, 1 公理 IV, 1 "If A, B are two points on a straight line a, and if A′ is a point upon the same or another straight line a′, then, upon a given side of A′ on the straight line a′, we can always find one and only one point B′ so that the segment AB (or BA) is congruent to the segment A′B′. We indicate this relation by writing AB ≡ A′B′. Every segment is congruent to itself; that is, we always have AB ≡ AB." 在直线 a′ 上点 A′ 的给定一侧，总能找到唯一的点 B′，使线段 AB 与 A′B′ 合同，记作 AB ≡ A′B′；每条线段都与自身合同。 Hilbert, 1902, § 6 Axiom IV, 2 公理 IV, 2 "If a segment AB is congruent to the segment A′B′ and also to the segment A″B″, then the segment A′B′ is congruent to the segment A″B″; that is, if AB ≡ A′B and AB ≡ A″B″, then A′B′ ≡ A″B″." 若线段 AB 与 A′B′ 合同，也与 A″B″ 合同，则 A′B′ 与 A″B″ 合同（原文 “A′B” 应为 A′B′）。 Hilbert, 1902, § 6 Axiom IV, 3 公理 IV, 3 "Let AB and BC be two segments of a straight line a which have no points in common aside from the point B, and, furthermore, let A′B′ and B′C′ be two segments of the same or of another straight line a′ having, likewise, no point other than B′ in common. Then, if AB ≡ A′B′ and BC ≡ B′C′, we have AC ≡ A′C′." 两条线段首尾相接、除公共端点外没有公共点；若对应的两段分别合同，则拼起来的整段也合同。 Hilbert, 1902, § 6 Axiom IV, 4 公理 IV, 4 "Let an angle (h,k) be given in the plane α and let a straight line a′ be given in a plane α′. Suppose also that, in the plane α′, a definite side of the straight line a′ be assigned. Denote by h′ a half-ray of the straight line a′ emanating from a point O′ of this line. Then in the plane α′ there is one and only one half-ray k′ such that the angle (h,k), or (k,h), is congruent to the angle (h′,k′) and at the same time all interior points of the angle (h′,k′) lie upon the given side of a′." 在给定半射线的给定一侧，有且只有一种方法作出与已知角合同的角；每个角都与自身合同。 Hilbert, 1902, § 6 Axiom IV, 5 公理 IV, 5 "If the angle (h,k) is congruent to the angle (h′,k′) and to the angle (h″,k″), then the angle (h′,k′) is congruent to the angle (h″,k″)." 若一个角与另外两个角都合同，则这两个角彼此合同。 Hilbert, 1902, § 6 Axiom IV, 6 公理 IV, 6 "If, in the two triangles ABC and A′B′C′ the congruences AB ≡ A′B′, AC ≡ A′C′, ∠BAC ≡ ∠B′A′C′ hold, then the congruences ∠ABC ≡ ∠A′B′C′ and ∠ACB ≡ ∠A′C′B′ also hold." 两个三角形若两边及其夹角对应合同，则其余两角也对应合同（全等判定 SAS 的核心）。 Hilbert, 1902, § 6 References Euclid. math/axioms/2-geometry/7-group-v-axiom-o.title: Group V: Axiom of Continuity (Archimedean Axiom) | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
math/axioms/2-geometry/7-group-v-axiom-o.summary: Group V: Axiom of Continuity (Archimedean Axiom) Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 2 Geometry 几何 (No definition) （无定义） Euclid, ca. 300 B.C.E./1996, Book I, "Postulates" Group V: Axiom of Continuity (Archimedean Axiom) 第五组：连续公理（阿基米德公理） "This axiom makes possible the introduction into geometry of the idea of continuity." 这条公理使连续性的概念得以引入几何。 Hilbert, 1902, § 8 Axiom V 公理 V（阿基米德公理） "Let A₁ be any point upon a straight line between the arbitrarily chosen points A and B. Take the points A₂, A₃, A₄, … so that A₁ lies between A and A₂, A₂ between A₁ and A₃, A₃ between A₂ and A₄ etc. Moreover, let the segments AA₁, A₁A₂, A₂A₃, A₃A₄, … be equal to one another. Then, among this series of points, there always exists a certain point Aₙ such that B lies between A and Aₙ." 从 A 出发，沿直线一段接一段地截取等长线段，总有一个点 Aₙ 越过 B：再短的线段，重复足够多次，也能超过任何给定长度。 Hilbert, 1902, § 8 References Euclid. math/axioms/2-geometry/8-axiom-of-comple.summary: Axiom of Completeness Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 2 Geometry 几何 (No definition) （无定义） Euclid, ca. 300 B.C.E./1996, Book I, "Postulates" Axiom of Completeness 完备公理 "To the preceeding five groups of axioms, we may add the following one, which, although not of a purely geometrical nature, merits particular attention from a theoretical point of view." 在前面五组公理之外，还可以加上下面这一条，它虽然不纯粹是几何性质的，但从理论上看值得特别注意。 Hilbert, 1902, § 8 Axiom of Completeness 完备公理 "To a system of points, straight lines, and planes, it is impossible to add other elements in such a manner that the system thus generalized shall form a new geometry obeying all of the five groups of axioms." 不可能在点、直线、平面的系统中再添加其他元素，使扩充后的系统仍满足全部五组公理：几何的元素已经“满了”。 Hilbert, 1902, § 8 References Euclid. math/axioms/4-probability.html.summary: 4 Probability Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 4 Probability 概率 "Probability axioms state that, given an event E in a sample space S which is either finite with N elements or countably infinite with N=∞ elements, we can write S=⋃_(i=1)^N E_i, and a quantity P(E_i), called the probability of event E_i, is defined such that" 概率公理说：给定样本空间 S（有限，有 N 个元素；或可数无限，N = ∞）中的事件 E，可以写成 S = ⋃ Eᵢ，并且定义一个量 P(Eᵢ)，称为事件 Eᵢ 的概率，使得 Weisstein, n.d., "Probability axioms" entry Probability axiom 1 概率公理 1（非负且不超过 1） "0≤P(E_i)≤1." 每个事件的概率在 0 和 1 之间。 Weisstein, n.d., "Probability axioms" entry Probability axiom 2 概率公理 2（规范性） "P(S)=1." 整个样本空间的概率是 1。 Weisstein, n.d., "Probability axioms" entry Additivity 可加性 "P(E_1 ∪ E_2)=P(E_1)+P(E_2), where E_1 and E_2 are mutually exclusive." E₁、E₂ 互斥时，P(E₁ ∪ E₂) = P(E₁) + P(E₂)。 Weisstein, n.d., "Probability axioms" entry Countable additivity 可数可加性 "P(⋃(i=1)^n E_i)=∑(i=1)^n P(E_i) for n=1, 2, ..., N where E_1, E_2, ... are mutually exclusive (i.e., E_1 ∩ E_2=∅)." E₁、E₂、…两两互斥时，并集的概率等于各自概率之和（n 可以到 N，包括无穷）。 Weisstein, n.d., "Probability axioms" entry References Megill, N. (2026). Metamath Proof Explorer home page (last updated January 19, 2026). Metamath. ℂ ∧ 𝐶 ∈ ℂ) → ((𝐴 + 𝐵) + 𝐶) = (𝐴 + (𝐵 + 𝐶)))" 复数加法结合律。 Megill, n.d.-c, "The 22 Axioms for Complex Numbers" table Complex number axiom 10 复数公理 10 "⊢ ((𝐴 ∈ ℂ ∧ 𝐵 ∈ ℂ ∧ 𝐶 ∈ ℂ) → ((𝐴 ⋅ 𝐵) ⋅ 𝐶) = (𝐴 ⋅ (𝐵 ⋅ math/axioms/6-logic/1-propositional-calc.summary: Propositional Calculus Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 6 Logic 逻辑 (No definition) （无定义） Megill, 2026, "The Axioms" section Propositional Calculus 命题演算 "Our system of propositional calculus consists of three axioms and the modus ponens inference rule." 我们的命题演算系统由三条公理和肯定前件推理规则组成。 Megill, 2026, "The Axioms" section Axiom Simp 简化公理 "⊢ (𝜑 → (𝜓 → 𝜑))" 若 𝜑 成立，则无论 𝜓 如何，𝜑 都成立。 Megill, 2026, "The Axioms" section Axiom Frege 弗雷格公理 "⊢ ((𝜑 → (𝜓 → 𝜒)) → ((𝜑 → 𝜓) → (𝜑 → 𝜒)))" 蕴涵对蕴涵可以分配：若 𝜑 推出“𝜓 推出 𝜒”，则“𝜑 推出 𝜓”推出“𝜑 推出 𝜒”。 Megill, 2026, "The Axioms" section Axiom Transp 换位公理 "⊢ ((¬ 𝜑 → ¬ 𝜓) → (𝜓 → 𝜑))" 若“非 𝜑”推出“非 𝜓”，则 𝜓 推出 𝜑（逆否）。 Megill, 2026, "The Axioms" section Rule of Modus Ponens 肯定前件规则 "⊢ 𝜑 & ⊢ (𝜑 → 𝜓) ⇒ ⊢ 𝜓" 由 𝜑 和“𝜑 推出 𝜓”，得到 𝜓。 Megill, 2026, "The Axioms" section References Megill, N. (2026). Metamath Proof Explorer home page (last updated January 19, 2026). Metamath. Retrieved October 29, 2026, from https://us.metamath.org/mpeuni/mmset.html

math/axioms/6-logic/2-predicate-calculus.title: Predicate Calculus | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
math/axioms/6-logic/2-predicate-calculus.summary: Predicate Calculus Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 6 Logic 逻辑 (No definition) （无定义） Megill, 2026, "The Axioms" section Predicate Calculus 谓词演算 "The axioms of predicate calculus express the logical properties of these new symbols that are universally true, independent from any theory (like set theory) making use of them." 谓词演算的公理表达这些新符号普遍成立的逻辑性质，与使用它们的任何理论（如集合论）无关。 Megill, 2026, "The Axioms" section Rule of Generalization 概括规则 "⊢ 𝜑 ⇒ ⊢ ∀𝑥 𝜑" 由 𝜑，得到“对一切 𝑥，𝜑”。 Megill, 2026, "The Axioms" section Quantified Implication 量化蕴涵 "⊢ (∀𝑥 (𝜑 → 𝜓) → (∀𝑥 𝜑 → ∀𝑥 𝜓))" 若对一切 𝑥 都有 𝜑 推出 𝜓，则“对一切 𝑥，𝜑”推出“对一切 𝑥，𝜓”。 Megill, 2026, "The Axioms" section Distinctness 不出现 "⊢ (𝜑 → ∀𝑥 𝜑), where 𝑥 does not occur in 𝜑" 𝑥 不出现在 𝜑 中时，𝜑 推出“对一切 𝑥，𝜑”。 Megill, 2026, "The Axioms" section Existence 存在 "⊢ ¬ ∀𝑥 ¬ 𝑥 = 𝑦" 并非对一切 𝑥 都有 𝑥 ≠ 𝑦，即存在等于 𝑦 的 𝑥。 Megill, 2026, "The Axioms" section Equality 相等 "⊢ (𝑥 = 𝑦 → (𝑥 = 𝑧 → 𝑦 = 𝑧))" 若 𝑥 = 𝑦 且 𝑥 = 𝑧，则 𝑦 = 𝑧。 Megill, 2026, "The Axioms" section Left Equality for Binary Predicate 二元谓词的左相等 "⊢ (𝑥 = 𝑦 → (𝑥 ∈ 𝑧 → 𝑦 ∈ 𝑧))" 若 𝑥 = 𝑦 且 𝑥 ∈ 𝑧，则 𝑦 ∈ 𝑧。 Megill, 2026, "The Axioms" section Right Equality for Binary Predicate 二元谓词的右相等 "⊢ (𝑥 = 𝑦 → (𝑧 ∈ 𝑥 → 𝑧 ∈ 𝑦))" 若 𝑥 = 𝑦 且 𝑧 ∈ 𝑥，则 𝑧 ∈ 𝑦。 Megill, 2026, "The Axioms" section Quantified Negation 量化否定 "⊢ (¬ ∀𝑥 𝜑 → ∀𝑥 ¬ ∀𝑥 𝜑)" 若并非对一切 𝑥 都有 𝜑，则对一切 𝑥，“并非对一切 𝑥 都有 𝜑”。 Megill, 2026, "The Axioms" section Quantifier Commutation 量词交换 "⊢ (∀𝑥 ∀𝑦 𝜑 → ∀𝑦 ∀𝑥 𝜑)" “对一切 𝑥、对一切 𝑦”可以交换为“对一切 𝑦、对一切 𝑥”。 Megill, 2026, "The Axioms" section Substitution 代入 "⊢ (𝑥 = 𝑦 → (∀𝑦 𝜑 → ∀𝑥 (𝑥 = 𝑦 → 𝜑)))" 若 𝑥 = 𝑦 且对一切 𝑦 有 𝜑，则对一切 𝑥，𝑥 = 𝑦 推出 𝜑。 Megill, 2026, "The Axioms" section Quantified Equality 量化相等 "⊢ (¬ 𝑥 = 𝑦 → (𝑦 = 𝑧 → ∀𝑥 𝑦 = 𝑧))" 若 𝑥 ≠ 𝑦 且 𝑦 = 𝑧，则对一切 𝑥，𝑦 = 𝑧。 Megill, 2026, "The Axioms" section References Megill, N. math/axioms/7-set-theory/1-zermelo-fraen.title: Zermelo-Fraenkel Set Theory with Choice (ZFC) | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
math/axioms/7-set-theory/1-zermelo-fraen.summary: Zermelo-Fraenkel Set Theory with Choice (ZFC) Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 7 Set Theory 集合论 (No definition) （无定义） Megill, 2026, "The Axioms" section Zermelo-Fraenkel Set Theory with Choice (ZFC) 带选择公理的策梅洛-弗兰克尔集合论（ZFC） "Set theory uses the formalism of propositional and predicate calculus to assert properties of arbitrary mathematical objects called "sets."" 集合论用命题演算和谓词演算的形式体系，来断言称为“集合”的任意数学对象的性质。 Megill, 2026, "The Axioms" section Axiom of Extensionality 外延公理 "⊢ (∀𝑧 (𝑧 ∈ 𝑥 ↔ 𝑧 ∈ 𝑦) → 𝑥 = 𝑦)" 两个集合的元素完全相同，它们就相等。 Megill, 2026, "The Axioms" section Axiom of Replacement 替换公理 "⊢ (∀𝑤 ∃𝑦 ∀𝑧 (∀𝑦 𝜑 → 𝑧 = 𝑦) → ∃𝑦 ∀𝑧 (𝑧 ∈ 𝑦 ↔ ∃𝑤 (𝑤 ∈ 𝑥 ∧ ∀𝑦 𝜑)))" 集合在一个函数关系下的像也是集合。 Megill, 2026, "The Axioms" section Axiom of Power Sets 幂集公理 "⊢ ∃𝑦 ∀𝑧 (∀𝑤 (𝑤 ∈ 𝑧 → 𝑤 ∈ 𝑥) → 𝑧 ∈ 𝑦)" 存在一个集合，包含 𝑥 的所有子集。 Megill, 2026, "The Axioms" section Axiom of Union 并集公理 "⊢ ∃𝑦 ∀𝑧 (∃𝑤 (𝑧 ∈ 𝑤 ∧ 𝑤 ∈ 𝑥) → 𝑧 ∈ 𝑦)" 存在一个集合，包含 𝑥 的各元素的所有元素。 Megill, 2026, "The Axioms" section Axiom of Regularity (Foundation) 正则公理（基础公理） "⊢ (∃𝑦 𝑦 ∈ 𝑥 → ∃𝑦 (𝑦 ∈ 𝑥 ∧ ∀𝑧 (𝑧 ∈ 𝑦 → ¬ 𝑧 ∈ 𝑥)))" 每个非空集合 𝑥 都有一个元素 𝑦，𝑦 与 𝑥 没有公共元素。 Megill, 2026, "The Axioms" section Axiom of Infinity 无穷公理 "⊢ ∃𝑦 (𝑥 ∈ 𝑦 ∧ ∀𝑧 (𝑧 ∈ 𝑦 → ∃𝑤 (𝑧 ∈ 𝑤 ∧ 𝑤 ∈ 𝑦)))" 存在一个包含 𝑥 的集合 𝑦，𝑦 的每个元素都属于 𝑦 的另一个元素，所以 𝑦 是无穷的。 Megill, 2026, "The Axioms" section Axiom of Choice 选择公理 "⊢ ∃𝑦 ∀𝑧 ∀𝑤 ((𝑧 ∈ 𝑤 ∧ 𝑤 ∈ 𝑥) → ∃𝑣 ∀𝑢 (∃𝑡 ((𝑢 ∈ 𝑤 ∧ 𝑤 ∈ 𝑡) ∧ (𝑢 ∈ 𝑡 ∧ 𝑡 ∈ 𝑦)) ↔ 𝑢 = 𝑣))" 可以从 𝑥 的每个非空元素中恰好选出一个元素。 Megill, 2026, "The Axioms" section References Megill, N. (2026). Metamath Proof Explorer home page (last updated January 19, 2026). Metamath. Retrieved October 29, 2026, from https://us.metamath.org/mpeuni/mmset.html

math/axioms/7-set-theory/2-the-tarski-gr.summary: The Tarski–Grothendieck Axiom Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 7 Set Theory 集合论 (No definition) （无定义） Megill, 2026, "The Axioms" section The Tarski–Grothendieck Axiom 塔斯基-格罗滕迪克公理 "The main important missing piece is the ability to do category theory, which requires huge sets (inaccessible cardinals) larger than those postulated by the ZFC axioms. math/cs2023/calculus/derivatives/3-3-dif.title: 3.3 Differentiation Rules | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
math/cs2023/calculus/derivatives/3-3-dif.summary: 3.3 Differentiation Rules Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 3 Derivatives 导数 (No definition) （无定义） Strang & Herman, 2016a, chapter 3 3.3 Differentiation Rules 求导法则 (No definition) （无定义） Strang & Herman, 2016a, section 3.3 Constant Multiple Rule 常数倍法则 "the derivative of a constant c multiplied by a function f is the same as the constant multiplied by the derivative: \(\frac{d}{dx}(cf(x))=cf^{'}(x)\)" 常数 c 乘以函数 f 的导数，等于该常数乘以导数：\(\frac{d}{dx}(cf(x))=cf^{'}(x)\) Strang & Herman, 2016a, chapter 3 Key Terms Constant Rule 常数法则 "the derivative of a constant function is zero: \(\frac{d}{dx}(c)=0,\) where c is a constant" 常函数的导数为零：\(\frac{d}{dx}(c)=0,\) 其中 c 为常数 Strang & Herman, 2016a, chapter 3 Key Terms Difference Rule 差法则 "the derivative of the difference of a function f and a function g is the same as the difference of the derivative of f and the derivative of g: \(\frac{d}{dx}(f(x)-g(x))=f^{'}(x)-g^{'}(x)\)" 函数 f 与函数 g 之差的导数，等于 f 的导数与 g 的导数之差：\(\frac{d}{dx}(f(x)-g(x))=f^{'}(x)-g^{'}(x)\) Strang & Herman, 2016a, chapter 3 Key Terms Power Rule 幂法则 "the derivative of a power function is a function in which the power on \(x\) becomes the coefficient of the term and the power on \(x\) in the derivative decreases by 1: If \(n\) is an integer, then \(\frac{d}{dx}x^{n}=nx^{n-1}\)" 幂函数的导数是这样一个函数：\(x\) 的幂次成为该项的系数，导数中 \(x\) 的幂次减 1：若 \(n\) 为整数，则 \(\frac{d}{dx}x^{n}=nx^{n-1}\) Strang & Herman, 2016a, chapter 3 Key Terms Product Rule 乘积法则 "the derivative of a product of two functions is the derivative of the first function times the second function plus the derivative of the second function times the first function: \(\frac{d}{dx}(f(x)g(x))=f^{'}(x)g(x)+g^{'}(x)f(x)\)" 两个函数之积的导数，是第一个函数的导数乘以第二个函数，加上第二个函数的导数乘以第一个函数：\(\frac{d}{dx}(f(x)g(x))=f^{'}(x)g(x)+g^{'}(x)f(x)\) Strang & Herman, 2016a, chapter 3 Key Terms Quotient Rule 商法则 "the derivative of the quotient of two functions is the derivative of the first function times the second function minus the derivative of the second function times the first function, all divided by the square of the second function: \(\frac{d}{dx}(\frac{f(x)}{g(x)})=\frac{f^{'}(x)g(x)-g^{'}(x)f(x)}{(g(x))^{2}}\)" 两个函数之商的导数，是第一个函数的导数乘以第二个函数，减去第二个函数的导数乘以第一个函数，再全部除以第二个函数的平方：\(\frac{d}{dx}(\frac{f(x)}{g(x)})=\frac{f^{'}(x)g(x)-g^{'}(x)f(x)}{(g(x))^{2}}\) Strang & Herman, 2016a, chapter 3 Key Terms Sum Rule 和法则 "the derivative of the sum of a function f and a function g is the same as the sum of the derivative of f and the derivative of g: \(\frac{d}{dx}(f(x)+g(x))=f^{'}(x)+g^{'}(x)\)" 函数 f 与函数 g 之和的导数，等于 f 的导数与 g 的导数之和：\(\frac{d}{dx}(f(x)+g(x))=f^{'}(x)+g^{'}(x)\) Strang & Herman, 2016a, chapter 3 Key Terms References Strang, G., & Herman, E. (2016a). Calculus volume 1. OpenStax. Retrieved October 29, 2026, from https://openstax.org/details/books/calculus-volume-1
