math/cs2023/calculus/integration/5-1-app.summary: 5.1 Approximating Areas Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 5 Integration 积分 (No definition) （无定义） Strang & Herman, 2016a, chapter 5 5.1 Approximating Areas 面积的近似 (No definition) （无定义） Strang & Herman, 2016a, section 5.1 Left-endpoint Approximation 左端点近似 "an approximation of the area under a curve computed by using the left endpoint of each subinterval to calculate the height of the vertical sides of each rectangle" 曲线下面积的一种近似，用每个子区间的左端点计算每个矩形竖边的高 Strang & Herman, 2016a, chapter 5 Key Terms Lower Sum 下和 "a sum obtained by using the minimum value of \(f(x)\) on each subinterval" 在每个子区间上用 \(f(x)\) 的最小值得到的和 Strang & Herman, 2016a, chapter 5 Key Terms Partition 分划 "a set of points that divides an interval into subintervals" 把区间分成子区间的一组点 Strang & Herman, 2016a, chapter 5 Key Terms Regular Partition 等距分划 "a partition in which the subintervals all have the same width" 各子区间都有相同宽度的分划 Strang & Herman, 2016a, chapter 5 Key Terms Riemann Sum 黎曼和 "an estimate of the area under the curve of the form \(A\approx \sum_{i=1}^{n}f(x_{i}^{*})\Delta x\)" 曲线下面积的一种估计，形如 \(A\approx \sum_{i=1}^{n}f(x_{i}^{*})\Delta x\) Strang & Herman, 2016a, chapter 5 Key Terms Right-endpoint Approximation 右端点近似 "the right-endpoint approximation is an approximation of the area of the rectangles under a curve using the right endpoint of each subinterval to construct the vertical sides of each rectangle" 右端点近似是曲线下矩形面积的一种近似，用每个子区间的右端点构造每个矩形的竖边 Strang & Herman, 2016a, chapter 5 Key Terms Sigma Notation Σ 记号 "(also, summation notation) the Greek letter sigma (Σ) indicates addition of the values; the values of the index above and below the sigma indicate where to begin the summation and where to end it" （也称求和记号）希腊字母 sigma（Σ）表示把各值相加；sigma 上下方的指标值表示从哪里开始求和、到哪里结束 Strang & Herman, 2016a, chapter 5 Key Terms Upper Sum 上和 "a sum obtained by using the maximum value of \(f(x)\) on each subinterval" 在每个子区间上用 \(f(x)\) 的最大值得到的和 Strang & Herman, 2016a, chapter 5 Key Terms Method of Exhaustion 穷竭法 "He used a process that has come to be known as the method of exhaustion, which used smaller and smaller shapes, the areas of which could be calculated exactly, to fill an irregular region and thereby obtain closer and closer approximations to the total area." 他使用了一种后来被称为穷竭法的方法，用越来越小、面积可以精确计算的图形填满一个不规则区域，从而得到越来越接近总面积的近似。 Strang & Herman, 2016a, section 5.1 Summation Notation 求和记号 "To make it easier to write down these lengthy sums, we look at some new notation here, called sigma notation (also known as summation notation)." 为了更容易写出这些冗长的和，我们在这里看一种新记号，称为 sigma 记号（也称求和记号）。 Strang & Herman, 2016a, section 5.1 Dummy Variable 哑变量 "The index is therefore called a dummy variable." 因此这个指标称为哑变量。 Strang & Herman, 2016a, section 5.1 Area Under the Curve 曲线下面积 "Then, the area under the curve \(y=f(x)\) on \([a,b]\) is given by" 于是，曲线下面积 \(y=f(x)\) 在 \([a,b]\) 上由下式给出 Strang & Herman, 2016a, section 5.1 References Strang, G., & Herman, E. (2016a). Calculus volume 1. OpenStax. Retrieved October 29, 2026, from https://openstax.org/details/books/calculus-volume-1

math/cs2023/calculus/integration/5-2-the.summary: 5.2 The Definite Integral Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 5 Integration 积分 (No definition) （无定义） Strang & Herman, 2016a, chapter 5 5.2 The Definite Integral 定积分 (No definition) （无定义） Strang & Herman, 2016a, section 5.2 Average Value of a Function 函数的平均值 "(or fave) the average value of a function on an interval can be found by calculating the definite integral of the function and dividing that value by the length of the interval" （或 fave）函数在区间上的平均值可以这样求：计算函数的定积分，再把这个值除以区间长度 Strang & Herman, 2016a, chapter 5 Key Terms Definite Integral 定积分 "a primary operation of calculus; the area between the curve and the x-axis over a given interval is a definite integral" 微积分的一种基本运算；给定区间上曲线与 x 轴之间的面积就是定积分 Strang & Herman, 2016a, chapter 5 Key Terms Integrable Function 可积函数 "a function is integrable if the limit defining the integral exists; in other words, if the limit of the Riemann sums as n goes to infinity exists" 如果定义积分的极限存在，函数就是可积的；换句话说，就是 n 趋于无穷时黎曼和的极限存在 Strang & Herman, 2016a, chapter 5 Key Terms Integrand 被积函数 "the function to the right of the integration symbol; the integrand includes the function being integrated" 积分号右边的函数；被积函数包括被积分的函数 Strang & Herman, 2016a, chapter 5 Key Terms Limits of Integration 积分限 "these values appear near the top and bottom of the integral sign and define the interval over which the function should be integrated" 这些值出现在积分号的顶部和底部附近，规定函数在哪个区间上积分 Strang & Herman, 2016a, chapter 5 Key Terms Net Signed Area 有向面积 "the area between a function and the x-axis such that the area below the x-axis is subtracted from the area above the x-axis; the result is the same as the definite integral of the function" 函数与 x 轴之间的面积，其中从 x 轴上方的面积中减去 x 轴下方的面积；结果与函数的定积分相同 Strang & Herman, 2016a, chapter 5 Key Terms Total Area 总面积 "total area between a function and the x-axis is calculated by adding the area above the x-axis and the area below the x-axis; the result is the same as the definite integral of the absolute value of the function" 函数与 x 轴之间的总面积，由x 轴上方的面积与 x 轴下方的面积相加算出；结果与函数绝对值的定积分相同 Strang & Herman, 2016a, chapter 5 Key Terms Variable of Integration 积分变量 "indicates which variable you are integrating with respect to; if it is x, then the function in the integrand is followed by dx" 表示对哪个变量积分；若为 x，则被积函数后跟 dx Strang & Herman, 2016a, chapter 5 Key Terms Displacement 位移 "One application of the definite integral is finding displacement when given a velocity function." 定积分的一个应用是在给定速度函数时求位移。 Strang & Herman, 2016a, section 5.2 References Strang, G., & Herman, E. (2016a). Calculus volume 1. OpenStax. Retrieved October 29, 2026, from https://openstax.org/details/books/calculus-volume-1

math/cs2023/calculus/sequences-and-serie.summary: 9.4 Comparison Tests Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 9 Sequences and Series 数列与级数 (No definition) （无定义） Strang & Herman, 2016b, chapter 5 9.4 Comparison Tests 比较检验 (No definition) （无定义） Strang & Herman, 2016b, section 5.4 Comparison Test 比较检验 "if \(0\le a_{n}\le b_{n}\) for all \(n\ge N\) and \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty }b_{n}\) converges, then \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty }a_{n}\) converges; if \(a_{n}\ge b_{n}\ge 0\) for all \(n\ge N\) and \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty }b_{n}\) diverges, then \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty }a_{n}\) diverges" 若对所有 \(n\ge N\) 有 \(0\le a_{n}\le b_{n}\) 且 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty }b_{n}\) 收敛，则 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty }a_{n}\) 收敛；若对所有 \(n\ge N\) 有 \(a_{n}\ge b_{n}\ge 0\) 且 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty }b_{n}\) 发散，则 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty }a_{n}\) 发散 Strang & Herman, 2016b, chapter 5 Key Terms Limit Comparison Test 极限比较检验 "suppose \(a_{n},\,b_{n}\ge 0\) for all \(n\ge 1.\) If \(\lim_{n\to \infty }a_{n}/b_{n}\to L\ne 0,\) then \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty }a_{n}\) and \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty }b_{n}\) both converge or both diverge; if \(\lim_{n\to \infty }a_{n}/b_{n}\to 0\) and \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty }b_{n}\) converges, then \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty }a_{n}\) converges. If \(\lim_{n\to \infty }a_{n}/b_{n}\to \infty ,\) and \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty }b_{n}\) diverges, then \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty }a_{n}\) diverges" 设对所有 \(n\ge 1.\) 有 \(a_{n},\,b_{n}\ge 0\)。若 \(\lim_{n\to \infty }a_{n}/b_{n}\to L\ne 0,\) 则 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty }a_{n}\) 和 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty }b_{n}\) 都收敛或都发散；若 \(\lim_{n\to \infty }a_{n}/b_{n}\to 0\) 且 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty }b_{n}\) 收敛，则 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty }a_{n}\) 收敛。若 \(\lim_{n\to \infty }a_{n}/b_{n}\to \infty ,\) 且 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty }b_{n}\) 发散，则 \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty }a_{n}\) 发散 Strang & Herman, 2016b, chapter 5 Key Terms References Strang, G., & Herman, E. 逆元性质 "Let \(*\) be a binary operation on a set \(S\text{.}\) We say that \(*\) has the inverse property if and only if for each \(a \in S\text{,}\) there exists \(b \in S\) such that \(a*b = b*a = e\text{.}\) We call \(b\) an inverse of \(a\text{.}\)" 设 \(*\) 为集合 \(S\)。 上的二元运算。我们说 \(*\) 具有逆元性质，当且仅当对每个 \(a \in S\)，存在 \(b \in S\) 使得 \(a*b = b*a = e\)。我们称 \(b\) 为 \(a\)。 的逆元。 Doerr & Levasseur, If \(a, b \in \mathbb{Z}_n\text{,}\)" 若 \(n\) 是正整数，我们如下定义模 \(n\) 加法 \(\left(+_n\right.\))。若 \(a, b \in \mathbb{Z}_n\)， Doerr & Levasseur, n.d., Definition 11.4.14 Modular Multiplication 模乘法 "If \(n\) is a positive integer, we define multiplication modulo \(n\) \(\left(\times_n\right.\)) as follows. If \(a, b \in \mathbb{Z}_n\text{,}\)" 若 \(n\) 是正整数，我们如下定义模 \(n\) 乘法 \(\left(\times_n\right.\))。若 \(a, b \in \mathbb{Z}_n\)， Doerr & Levasseur, n.d., Definition 11.4.15 Additive Inverses in ℤn ℤn 中的加法逆元 "If \(a \in \mathbb{Z}_n\), \(a\neq 0\), then the additive inverse of a is \(n - a\)." 若 \(a \in \mathbb{Z}_n\)，\(a\neq 0\)，则 a 的加法逆元是 \(n - a\)。 Doerr & Levasseur, n.d., Theorem 11.4.18 The Additive Group of Integers Modulo n 模 n 整数加法群 "The Additive Group of Integers Modulo \(n\) is the group with domain \(\{0, 1, 2, \dots, n-1\}\) and with the operation of mod \(n\) addition. It is denoted as \(\mathbb{Z}_n\text{.}\)" 模 \(n\) 整数加法群是以 \(\{0, 1, 2, \dots, n-1\}\) 为定义域、运算为模 \(n\) 加法的群。记作 \(\mathbb{Z}_n\)。 Doerr & Levasseur, n.d., Definition 11.4.19 The Multiplicative Group of Integers Modulo n 模 n 整数乘法群 "The Multiplicative Group of Integers Modulo \(n\) is the group with domain \(\{k\in \mathbb{Z} \vert 1 \leq k \leq n-1 \textrm{ and }\gcd(n,k)=1\}\) and with the operation of mod \(n\) multiplication. It is denoted as \(\mathbb{U}_n\text{.}\)" 模 \(n\) 整数乘法群是以 \(\{k\in \mathbb{Z} \vert 1 \leq k \leq n-1 \textrm{ and }\gcd(n,k)=1\}\) 为定义域、运算为模 \(n\) 乘法的群。记作 \(\mathbb{U}_n\)。 Doerr & Levasseur, n.d., Definition 11.4.20 Modular arithmetic 模运算 "Modular arithmetic is the arithmetic of congruences, sometimes known informally as 'clock arithmetic.'" 模运算是同余的算术，非正式地也称为“时钟算术”。 Weisstein, n.d., "Modular arithmetic" entry, para. 1 References Doerr, A., & Levasseur, K. math/cs2023/discrete-mathematics/algebra.summary: 11.5 Subsystems Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 11.5 Subsystems 子系统 (No definition) （无定义） Doerr & Levasseur, n.d., section 11.5 Subsystem 子系统 "If \(\left[V; *_1, \ldots,*_n\right]\) is an algebraic system of a certain kind and \(W\) is a subset of \(V\text{,}\) then \(W\) is a subsystem of \(V\) if \(\left[W; *_1, \ldots,*_n\right]\) is an algebraic system of the same kind as \(V\text{.}\) The usual notation for “\(W\) is a subsystem of \(V\)” is \(W \leq V\text{.}\)" 若 \(\left[V; *_1, \ldots,*_n\right]\) 是某一类代数系统，\(W\) 是 \(V\) 的子集，且 \(\left[W; *_1, \ldots,*_n\right]\) 是与 \(V\) 同类的代数系统，则称 \(W\) 是 \(V\) 的子系统。“\(W\) 是 \(V\) 的子系统”的通常记法是 \(W \leq V\)。 Doerr & Levasseur, n.d., Definition 11.5.1 Subgroup Conditions 子群的条件 "To determine whether H, a subset of group \([G;*]\), is a subgroup, it is sufficient to prove: H is closed under \(*\); that is, \(a, b \in H \Rightarrow a * b \in H\); H contains the identity element for \(*\); and H contains the inverse of each of its elements; that is, \(a\in H \Rightarrow a^{-1}\in H\)." 要判断群 \([G;*]\) 的子集 H 是否为子群，只需证明：H 对 \(*\) 封闭，即 \(a, b \in H \Rightarrow a * b \in H\)；H 包含 \(*\) 的单位元；并且 H 包含其每个元素的逆元，即 \(a\in H \Rightarrow a^{-1}\in H\)。 Doerr & Levasseur, n.d., Theorem 11.5.3 Condition for a Subgroup of a Finite Group 有限群的子群条件 "Given that \([G; * ]\) is a finite group and \(H\) is a nonempty subset of \(G\), if \(H\) is closed under \(*\) , then \(H\) is a subgroup of \(G\)." 已知 \([G; * ]\) 是有限群，\(H\) 是 \(G\) 的非空子集，若 \(H\) 对 \(*\) 封闭，则 \(H\) 是 \(G\) 的子群。 Doerr & Levasseur, n.d., Theorem 11.5.5 Cyclic Subgroup 循环子群 "If \(G\) is a group and \(a \in G\text{,}\) the cyclic subgroup generated by \(a\text{,}\) \(\langle a \rangle\text{,}\) is the set of all powers of \(a\text{:}\)" 若 \(G\) 是群且 \(a \in G\)， 则由 \(a\)， 生成的循环子群 \(\langle a \rangle\)， 是 \(a\)： 的所有幂的集合 Doerr & Levasseur, n.d., Definition 11.5.6 Cyclic Group 循环群 "A group \(G\) is cyclic if there exists \(\beta \in G\) such that \(\langle \beta \rangle=G\text{.}\)" 若存在 \(\beta \in G\) 使得 \(\langle \beta \rangle=G\)。 则群 \(G\) 是循环群。 Doerr & Levasseur, n.d., Definition 11.5.7 Order of a Group Element 群元素的阶 "The order of an element \(a\) of group \(G\) is the number of elements in the cyclic subgroup of \(G\) generated by \(a\text{.}\) The order of \(a\) is denoted \(ord(a)\text{.}\)" 群 \(G\) 的元素 \(a\) 的阶是 \(G\) 中由 \(a\) 生成的循环子群的元素个数。\(a\) 的阶记作 \(ord(a)\)。 Doerr & Levasseur, n.d., Definition 11.5.9 References Doerr, A., & Levasseur, K. math/cs2023/discrete-mathematics/algebra.title: 11.6 Direct Products | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
math/cs2023/discrete-mathematics/algebra.summary: 11.6 Direct Products Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 11.6 Direct Products 直积 (No definition) （无定义） Doerr & Levasseur, n.d., section 11.6 Direct Product 直积 "If \(\left[V_i;*_i, \diamond_i, \ldots \right]\text{,}\) \(i = 1, 2, \ldots, n\) are algebraic systems of the same kind, then the direct product of these systems is \(V =V_1\times V_2\times \cdots \times V_n\), with operations defined below. The elements of \(V\) are \(n\)-tuples of the form \(\left(a_1, a_2, \dots, a _n \right)\text{,}\) where \(a_k \in V_k\text{,}\) \(k = 1, \dots, n\text{.}\) The systems \(V_1\text{,}\) \(V_2, \dots, V_n\) are called the factors of \(V\text{.}\) There are as many operations on \(V\) as there are in the factors. Each of these operations is defined componentwise:" 若 \(\left[V_i;*_i, \diamond_i, \ldots \right]\)， \(i = 1, 2, \ldots, n\) 是同类的代数系统，则这些系统的直积是 \(V =V_1\times V_2\times \cdots \times V_n\)，其运算定义如下。\(V\) 的元素是形如 \(\left(a_1, a_2, \dots, a _n \right)\)， 的 \(n\) 元组，其中 \(a_k \in V_k\)， \(k = 1, \dots, n\)。 系统 \(V_1\)， \(V_2, \dots, V_n\) 称为 \(V\) 的因子。\(V\) 上的运算与各因子中的运算一样多。其中每个运算都按分量定义： Doerr & Levasseur, n.d., Definition 11.6.1 Direct Product of Two Groups 两个群的直积 "Let \([G_1;*_1]\) and \([G_2;*_2]\) be two groups. Their direct product is the system \([G_1 \times G_2; *]\) with domain equal to the Cartesian product of the domains of the two groups and with the coordinatewise operation \(*\) defined by" 设 \([G_1;*_1]\) 和 \([G_2;*_2]\) 为两个群。它们的直积是系统 \([G_1 \times G_2; *]\)，其定义域等于这两个群的定义域的笛卡尔积，其按坐标运算 \(*\) 定义为 Doerr & Levasseur, n.d., Definition 11.6.3 The Direct Product of Groups is a Group 群的直积是群 "The direct product of two or more groups is a group; that is, the algebraic properties of a system obtained by taking the direct product of two or more groups includes the group axioms." 两个或多个群的直积是群；即，取两个或多个群的直积所得到的系统，其代数性质包含群公理。 Doerr & Levasseur, n.d., Theorem 11.6.6 Properties of Direct Products of Groups 群直积的性质 "If \(G = G_1\times G_2 \times \cdots \times G_n\) is a direct product of \(n\) groups and \(\left(a_1, a_2 , \dots , a_n\right) \in G\), then: The identity of \(G\) is \(\left(e_1, e_2 , . . . , e_n\right)\), where \(e_k\) is the identity of \(G_k\). \(\left(a_1, a_2 , . . . , a_n\right) {}^{-1}= \left(a_1{}^{-1}, a_2{}^{-1} , . . . , a_n{}^{-1}\right)\). \(\left(a_1, a_2 , . . . , a_n\right) {}^m= \left(a_1{}^m, a_2{}^m , . . . , a_n{}^m\right)\) for all \(m\in \mathbb{Z}\). \(G\) is abelian if and only if each of the factors \(G_1, G_2, \ldots , G_n\) is abelian. lf \(H_1, H_2, \ldots , H_n\) are subgroups of the corresponding factors, then \(H_1\times H_2 \times \cdots \times H_n\) is a subgroup of \(G\)." 若 \(G = G_1\times G_2 \times \cdots \times G_n\) 是 \(n\) 个群的直积，且 \(\left(a_1, a_2 , \dots , a_n\right) \in G\)，则：\(G\) 的单位元是 \(\left(e_1, e_2 , . . . , e_n\right)\)，其中 \(e_k\) 是 \(G_k\) 的单位元。\(\left(a_1, a_2 , . . . , a_n\right) {}^{-1}= \left(a_1{}^{-1}, a_2{}^{-1} , . . . , a_n{}^{-1}\right)\)。对所有 \(m\in \mathbb{Z}\)，\(\left(a_1, a_2 , . . . , a_n\right) {}^m= \left(a_1{}^m, a_2{}^m , . . . , a_n{}^m\right)\)。\(G\) 是阿贝尔群，当且仅当每个因子 \(G_1, G_2, \ldots , G_n\) 都是阿贝尔群。若 \(H_1, H_2, \ldots , H_n\) 是相应因子的子群，则 \(H_1\times H_2 \times \cdots \times H_n\) 是 \(G\) 的子群。 Doerr & Levasseur, n.d., Theorem 11.6.9 References Doerr, A., & Levasseur, K. (n.d.). Applied discrete structures. Retrieved October 28, 2026, from https://discretemath.org/ads/index-ads.html

math/cs2023/discrete-mathematics/algebra.summary: 11.7 Isomorphisms Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 11.7 Isomorphisms 同构 (No definition) （无定义） Doerr & Levasseur, n.d., section 11.7 Isomorphic Systems/Isomorphism - Informal Version 同构系统／同构（非形式化版本） "Two algebraic systems are isomorphic if there exists a translation rule between them so that any true statement in one system can be translated to a true statement in the other." 若两个代数系统之间存在一种翻译规则，使得其中一个系统中的任何真命题都能翻译为另一个系统中的真命题，则这两个代数系统同构。 Doerr & Levasseur, n.d., Definition 11.7.1 Group Isomorphism 群同构 "If \(\left[G_1; *_1\right]\) and \(\left[G_2; *_2\right]\) are groups, \(f: G_1 \to G_2\) is an isomorphism from \(G_1\) into \(G_2\) if and only if:" 若 \(\left[G_1; *_1\right]\) 和 \(\left[G_2; *_2\right]\) 是群，则 \(f: G_1 \to G_2\) 是从 \(G_1\) 到 \(G_2\) 的同构，当且仅当： Doerr & Levasseur, n.d., Definition 11.7.9 Properties of Isomorphisms 同构的性质 "If \([G;*]\) and \([H;\diamond ]\) are groups with identities \(e\) and \(e'\), respectively, and \(T:G \to H\) is an isomorphism from \(G\) into \(H\), then: \(\displaystyle T(e) = e'\) \(T(a)^{-1} = T\left(a^{-1}\right)\) for all \(a \in G\), and If \(K\) is a subgroup of \(G\), then \(T(K) = \{T(a) : a \in K\}\) is a subgroup of \(H\) and is isomorphic to \(K\)." 若 \([G;*]\) 和 \([H;\diamond ]\) 是群，单位元分别为 \(e\) 和 \(e'\)，且 \(T:G \to H\) 是从 \(G\) 到 \(H\) 的同构，则：\(\displaystyle T(e) = e'\)；对所有 \(a \in G\)，\(T(a)^{-1} = T\left(a^{-1}\right)\)；并且若 \(K\) 是 \(G\) 的子群，则 \(T(K) = \{T(a) : a \in K\}\) 是 \(H\) 的子群，且与 \(K\) 同构。 Doerr & Levasseur, n.d., Theorem 11.7.14 Order Sequence 阶序列 "The order sequence of a finite group is the sequence whose terms are the respective orders of all the elements of the group, arranged in increasing order." 有限群的阶序列是这样的序列：其各项分别是该群所有元素的阶，并按递增顺序排列。 Doerr & Levasseur, n.d., Definition 11.7.15 References Doerr, A., & Levasseur, K. (n.d.). Applied discrete structures. Retrieved October 28, 2026, from https://discretemath.org/ads/index-ads.html

math/cs2023/discrete-mathematics/an-intr.summary: 16.1 Rings, Basic Definitions and Concepts Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 16.1 Rings, Basic Definitions and Concepts 环：基本定义与概念 (No definition) （无定义） Doerr & Levasseur, n.d., section 16.1 Ring 环 "A ring is a set \(R\) together with two binary operations, addition and multiplication, denoted by the symbols \(+\) and \(\cdot\) such that the following axioms are satisfied:" 环是带有两个二元运算（加法与乘法，分别记作符号 \(+\) 和 \(\cdot\)）的集合 \(R\)，使得下列公理成立： Doerr & Levasseur, n.d., Definition 16.1.1 Commutative Ring 交换环 "A ring in which multiplication is a commutative operation is called a commutative ring." 乘法为交换运算的环称为交换环。 Doerr & Levasseur, n.d., Definition 16.1.5 Unity of a Ring 环的单位元 "A ring \([R; +, \cdot ]\) that has a multiplicative identity is called a ring with unity. The multiplicative identity itself is called the unity of the ring. More formally, if there exists an element \(1 \in R\text{,}\) such that for all \(x \in R\text{,}\) \(x\cdot 1 = 1\cdot x = x\text{,}\) then \(R\) is called a ring with unity." 具有乘法单位元的环 \([R; +, \cdot ]\) 称为含幺环。该乘法单位元本身称为环的幺元。更正式地说，若存在元素 \(1 \in R\)， 使得对所有 \(x \in R\)， 有 \(x\cdot 1 = 1\cdot x = x\)， 则称 \(R\) 为含幺环。 Doerr & Levasseur, n.d., Definition 16.1.6 Multiplicative Inverses 乘法逆元 "Let \([R; +, \cdot ]\) be a ring with unity, 1. If \(u \in R\) and there exists an element \(v \in R\) such that \(u\cdot v = v\cdot u = 1\text{,}\) then \(u\) is said to have a multiplicative inverse, \(v\text{.}\) A ring element that possesses a multiplicative inverse is a unit of the ring. The set of all units of a ring \(R\) is denoted by \(U(R)\text{.}\)" 设 \([R; +, \cdot ]\) 为含幺（幺元为 1）的环。若 \(u \in R\) 且存在元素 \(v \in R\) 使得 \(u\cdot v = v\cdot u = 1\)， 则称 \(u\) 有乘法逆元 \(v\)。 具有乘法逆元的环元素是环的单位。环 \(R\) 的所有单位的集合记作 \(U(R)\)。 Doerr & Levasseur, n.d., Definition 16.1.10 Ring Isomorphism 环同构 "Let \([R; +, \cdot ]\) and \([R'; +', \cdot']\) be rings. Then \(R\) is isomorphic to \(R'\) if and only if there exists a function, \(f:R \to R'\text{,}\) called a ring isomorphism, such that" 设 \([R; +, \cdot ]\) 和 \([R'; +', \cdot']\) 为环。则 \(R\) 同构于 \(R'\)，当且仅当存在函数 \(f:R \to R'\)， 称为环同构，使得 Doerr & Levasseur, n.d., Definition 16.1.13 Some Basic Properties 一些基本性质 "Let \([R; +, \cdot]\) be a ring, with \(a, b \in R\). Then \(\displaystyle a \cdot 0 = 0 \cdot a = 0\) \(\displaystyle a\cdot (-b) = (-a) \cdot b = -(a\cdot b)\) \(\displaystyle (-a) \cdot (-b) = a\cdot b\)" 设 \([R; +, \cdot]\) 是环，\(a, b \in R\)。则 \(\displaystyle a \cdot 0 = 0 \cdot a = 0\) \(\displaystyle a\cdot (-b) = (-a) \cdot b = -(a\cdot b)\) \(\displaystyle (-a) \cdot (-b) = a\cdot b\) Doerr & Levasseur, n.d., Theorem 16.1.18 Zero Divisor 零因子 "Let \([R; +, \cdot ]\) be a ring. If \(a\) and \(b\) are two nonzero elements of \(R\) such that \(a \cdot b = 0\text{,}\) then \(a\) and \(b\) are called zero divisors." 设 \([R; +, \cdot ]\) 为环。若 \(a\) 和 \(b\) 是 \(R\) 的两个满足 \(a \cdot b = 0\)， 的非零元素，则称 \(a\) 和 \(b\) 为零因子。 Doerr & Levasseur, n.d., Definition 16.1.20 Multiplicative Cancellation 乘法消去律 "The multiplicative cancellation laws hold in a ring \([R; +, \cdot ]\) if and only if \(R\) has no zero divisors." 环 \([R; +, \cdot ]\) 中乘法消去律成立，当且仅当 \(R\) 没有零因子。 Doerr & Levasseur, n.d., Theorem 16.1.22 Integral Domain 整环 "A commutative ring with unity containing no zero divisors is called an integral domain." 不含零因子的含幺交换环称为整环。 Doerr & Levasseur, n.d., Definition 16.1.23 References Doerr, A., & Levasseur, K. (n.d.). Applied discrete structures. Retrieved October 28, 2026, from https://discretemath.org/ads/index-ads.html

We could prove by induction that the relation \(r^k\text{,}\) \(k\geq 1\text{,}\) is defined by \(v r^k w\) if and only if there is a path of length \(k\) from \(v\) to \(w\text{.}\) Since the transitive closure, \(r^+\text{,}\) is the union of \(r\text{,}\) \(r^2\) \(,r^3,\ldots\text{,}\) we can answer our connectivity question by determining the transitive closure of \(r\text{,}\) which can be done most easily by keeping our relation in matrix form. Theorem 9.3.2 is significant in our calculations because it tells us that we need only go as far as \(G^n\) to determine the matrix of the transitive closure." 设图中的边信息存储在邻接矩阵 \(G\) 中。\(G\) 所定义的关系 \(r\) 为：若有边连接 \(v\) 与 \(w\)，则 \(v r w\)。回忆 \(r\) 与自身的复合 \(r^2\) 定义为：若存在顶点 \(y\) 使得 \(v r y\) 且 \(y r w\)，则 \(v r^2 w\)；也就是说，\(v\) 通过长度为 2 的路径与 \(w\) 相连。我们可以用归纳法证明，关系 \(r^k\)，（\(k\geq 1\)）定义为：\(v r^k w\) 当且仅当存在从 \(v\) 到 \(w\) 长度为 \(k\) 的路径。由于传递闭包 \(r^+\)， 是 \(r\), \(r^2\) \(,r^3,\ldots\)， 的并，我们可以通过求 \(r\) 的传递闭包来回答连通性问题，而这在把关系保存为矩阵形式时最容易做到。定理 9.3.2 对我们的计算很重要，因为它告诉我们，只需计算到 \(G^n\) 就能确定传递闭包的矩阵。 Doerr & Levasseur, n.d., Algorithm 9.3.3 Breadth-first Search 广度优先搜索 "A broadcasting algorithm for finding a path between vertex \(i\) and vertex \(j\) of a graph having \(n\) vertices. That stack is the output of the algorithm." 一种在有 \(n\) 个顶点的图中寻找顶点 \(i\) 与顶点 \(j\) 之间路径的广播算法。列表 \(V=\left\{V_1, V_2, \ldots, V_n\right\}\)， 的每一项 \(V_k\) 由一个布尔字段 \(V_k.\text{found}\) 和一个整数字段 \(V_k.\text{from}\)。 组成。集合 \(D_1\)，, \(D_2, \dots\)，称为深度集，具有如下性质：若 \(k \in D_r\)，则从顶点 \(i\) 到顶点 \(k\) 的最短路径长度为 \(r\)。在第 5 步中，用栈把从顶点 \(i\) 到顶点 \(j\) 的路径顶点表按正确顺序排列。该栈就是算法的输出。 Doerr & Levasseur, n.d., Algorithm 9.3.8 Connectivity 连通性 "Vertex \(v\) is connected to vertex \(w\) if there is a path from \(v\) to \(w\text{.}\) Two vertices are strongly connected if they are connected in both directions to one another." 如果存在从 \(v\) 到 \(w\) 的路径，则顶点 \(v\) 与顶点 \(w\) 连通。如果两个顶点彼此在两个方向上都连通，则它们强连通。 Doerr & Levasseur, n.d., section 9.3 References Doerr, A., & Levasseur, K. A proposition generated by \(S\) is any valid combination of propositions in \(S\) with conjunction, disjunction, and negation. Or, to be more precise," 设 \(S\) 是任意命题集。由 \(S\) 生成的命题是 \(S\) 中命题通过合取、析取和否定得到的任何有效组合。更精确地说， Doerr & Levasseur, n.d., Definition 3.2.2 Truth Table 真值表 "A truth table is a two-dimensional array with n+1 columns. The first n columns correspond to the possible values of n inputs, and the last column to the operation being performed. The rows list all possible combinations of inputs together with the corresponding outputs." 真值表是一个有 n+1 列的二维数组。前 n 列对应 n 个输入的可能取值，最后一列对应所执行的运算。各行列出所有可能的输入组合以及对应的输出。 Weisstein, n.d.-f, "Truth table" entry, para. 1 Formula 公式 "The term 'formula' is also commonly used in the theory of logic to mean sentential formula (also called a propositional formula), i.e., a formula in propositional calculus." “公式”一词在逻辑理论中也常用来指语句公式（也称为命题公式），即命题演算中的公式。 Weisstein, n.d.-b, "Formula" entry, para. 2 References Doerr, A., & Levasseur, K. A proposition over \(U\) is a sentence that contains a variable that can take on any value in \(U\) and that has a definite truth value as a result of any such substitution." 设 \(U\) 是非空集合。\(U\) 上的命题是含有可取 \(U\) 中任意值的变量的句子，并且对任何这样的代入都具有确定的真值。 Doerr & Levasseur, n.d., Definition 3.6.1 Truth Set 真值集 "If \(p\) is a proposition over \(U\text{,}\) the truth set of \(p\) is \(T_p = \{a \in U \mid p(a) \textrm{ is true}\}\text{.}\)" 若 \(p\) 是 \(U\)， 上的命题，则 \(p\) 的真值集是 \(T_p = \{a \in U \mid p(a) \textrm{ is true}\}\)。 Doerr & Levasseur, n.d., Definition 3.6.3 Tautologies and Contradictions over a Universe 全集上的重言式与矛盾式 "A proposition over \(U\) is a tautology if its truth set is \(U\text{.}\) It is a contradiction if its truth set is empty." 若 \(U\) 上的命题的真值集为 \(U\)，则它是重言式。若其真值集为空，则它是矛盾式。 Doerr & Levasseur, n.d., Definition 3.6.6 Equivalence of propositions over a universe 全集上命题的等价 "Two propositions, \(p\) and \(q\text{,}\) are equivalent if \(p \leftrightarrow q\) is a tautology. math/cs2023/linear-algebra/invertibility.summary: 3.1 Invertibility Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 3.1 Invertibility 可逆性 (No definition) （无定义） Austin, 2023, section 3.1 Invertible 可逆 "An \(n\times n\) matrix \(A\) is called invertible if there is a matrix \(B\) such that \(AB = I_n\), where \(I_n\) is the \(n\times n\) identity matrix." 对于 \(n\times n\) 矩阵 \(A\)，如果存在矩阵 \(B\) 使得 \(AB = I_n\)，其中 \(I_n\) 是 \(n\times n\) 单位矩阵，就称 \(A\) 可逆。 Austin, 2023, Definition 3.1.2 Properties of Invertible Matrices 可逆矩阵的性质 "An \(n\times n\) matrix \(A\) is invertible if and only if \(A\sim I\). If \(A\) is invertible, then the solution to the equation \(A\mathbf{x} = \mathbf{b}\) is given by \(\mathbf{x} = A^{-1}\mathbf{b}\). We can find \(A^{-1}\) by finding the reduced row echelon form of \(\left[\begin{array}{r\|r} A & I \end{array}\right]\); namely, \(\left[\begin{array}{r\|r} A & I \end{array}\right] \sim \left[\begin{array}{r\|r} I & A^{-1} \end{array}\right]\). If \(A\) and \(B\) are two invertible \(n\times n\) matrices, then their product \(AB\) is also invertible and \((AB)^{-1} = B^{-1}A^{-1}\)." \(n\times n\) 矩阵 \(A\) 可逆，当且仅当 \(A\sim I\)。若 \(A\) 可逆，则方程 \(A\mathbf{x} = \mathbf{b}\) 的解为 \(\mathbf{x} = A^{-1}\mathbf{b}\)。求 \(\left[\begin{array}{r\|r} A & I \end{array}\right]\) 的行最简形就能得到 \(A^{-1}\)，即 \(\left[\begin{array}{r\|r} A & I \end{array}\right] \sim \left[\begin{array}{r\|r} I & A^{-1} \end{array}\right]\)。若 \(A\) 与 \(B\) 是两个可逆的 \(n\times n\) 矩阵，则它们的乘积 \(AB\) 也可逆，且 \((AB)^{-1} = B^{-1}A^{-1}\)。 Austin, 2023, Proposition 3.1.10 Lower Triangular Matrix 下三角矩阵 "We say that a matrix \(A\) is lower triangular if all its entries above the diagonal are zero." 如果矩阵 \(A\) 的对角线上方的元素全为零，就称 \(A\) 是下三角矩阵。 Austin, 2023, Definition 3.1.11 Elementary Matrix 初等矩阵 "The following are examples of matrices, known as elementary matrices, that perform the row operations on a matrix having three rows." 下面是一些称为初等矩阵的矩阵的例子，它们对有三行的矩阵施行行变换。 Austin, 2023, section 3.1 Inverse 逆矩阵 "The matrix \(B\) is called the inverse of \(A\) and denoted \(A^{-1}\)." 矩阵 \(B\) 称为 \(A\) 的逆矩阵，记作 \(A^{-1}\)。 Austin, 2023, Definition 3.1.2 Square Matrix 方阵 "Notice that we only define invertibility for matrices that have the same number of rows and columns in which case we say that the matrix is square." 注意，我们只对行数与列数相同的矩阵定义可逆性，此时称该矩阵为方阵。 Austin, 2023, section 3.1 Upper Triangular Matrix 上三角矩阵 "Similarly, \(A\) is upper triangular if all the entries below the diagonal are zero." 类似地，如果 \(A\) 的对角线下方的元素全为零，就称 \(A\) 是上三角矩阵。 Austin, 2023, Definition 3.1.11 Permutation Matrix 置换矩阵 "Find a matrix \(P\), usually called a permutation matrix that performs this operation." 求一个完成这一运算的矩阵 \(P\)，它通常称为置换矩阵。 Austin, 2023, section 3.1 Diagonal Matrix 对角矩阵 "The matrix \(D=\begin{bmatrix} 2 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & -1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & -4 \\ \end{bmatrix}\) is called diagonal since the only nonzero entries are on the diagonal of the matrix." 矩阵 \(D=\begin{bmatrix} 2 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & -1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & -4 \\ \end{bmatrix}\) 称为对角矩阵，因为它仅有的非零元素都在矩阵的对角线上。 Austin, 2023, section 3.1 References Austin, D. (2023). Understanding linear algebra (2023 update). Retrieved October 29, 2026, from https://understandinglinearalgebra.org/home.html

math/cs2023/linear-algebra/invertibility.summary: 3.4 Determinants Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 3.4 Determinants 行列式 (No definition) （无定义） Austin, 2023, section 3.4 Determinant 行列式 "If the pair of vectors is positively oriented, then the determinant of \(A\), denoted \(\det(A)\), is the area of the parallelogram formed by \(\mathbf{v}_1\) and \(\mathbf{v}_2\)." 如果这对向量是正定向的，那么 \(A\) 的行列式（记作 \(\det(A)\)）就是由 \(\mathbf{v}_1\) 和 \(\mathbf{v}_2\) 构成的平行四边形的面积。 Austin, 2023, Definition 3.4.4 Cofactor Expansion 余因子展开 "There is another way to compute determinants, using what are called cofactor expansions, that will be important for us in the next chapter." 还有另一种计算行列式的方法，即使用所谓的余因子展开，它在下一章中对我们很重要。 Austin, 2023, section 3.4 The Effect of Row Operations on the Determinant 行变换对行列式的影响 "If \(A'\) is obtained from \(A\) by scaling a row by \(k\), then \(\det(A') = k\det(A)\). If \(A'\) is obtained from \(A\) by interchanging two rows, then \(\det(A') = -\det(A)\). If \(A'\) is obtained from \(A\) by performing a row replacement operation, then \(\det(A') = \det(A)\)." 若 \(A'\) 由 \(A\) 把某一行乘以 \(k\) 得到，则 \(\det(A') = k\det(A)\)。若 \(A'\) 由 \(A\) 交换两行得到，则 \(\det(A') = -\det(A)\)。若 \(A'\) 由 \(A\) 经过一次倍加变换得到，则 \(\det(A') = \det(A)\)。 Austin, 2023, Proposition 3.4.13 References Austin, D. math/cs2023/linear-algebra/orthogonality.summary: 6.1 The Dot Product Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 6.1 The Dot Product 点积 (No definition) （无定义） Austin, 2023, section 6.1 Dot Product 点积 "The dot product is defined, more generally, for any two \(m\)-dimensional vectors: \(\mathbf{v}\cdot\mathbf{w} = \left[ \begin{array}{c} v_1 \\ v_2 \\ \vdots \\ v_m \\ \end{array} \right] \cdot \left[ \begin{array}{c} w_1 \\ w_2 \\ \vdots \\ w_m \\ \end{array} \right] = v_1w_1 + v_2w_2 + \ldots + v_mw_m\). The important thing to remember is that the dot product will produce a scalar." 更一般地，点积对任意两个 \(m\) 维向量都有定义：\(\mathbf{v}\cdot\mathbf{w} = \left[ \begin{array}{c} v_1 \\ v_2 \\ \vdots \\ v_m \\ \end{array} \right] \cdot \left[ \begin{array}{c} w_1 \\ w_2 \\ \vdots \\ w_m \\ \end{array} \right] = v_1w_1 + v_2w_2 + \ldots + v_mw_m\)。需要记住的重要一点是，点积产生一个标量。 Austin, 2023, section 6.1 Orthogonal 正交 "We say that vectors \(\mathbf{v}\) and \(\mathbf{w}\) are orthogonal if \(\mathbf{v}\cdot\mathbf{w}=0\)." 如果 \(\mathbf{v}\cdot\mathbf{w}=0\)，则称向量 \(\mathbf{v}\) 与 \(\mathbf{w}\) 正交。 Austin, 2023, Definition 6.1.9 Time Series 时间序列 "When interpreted in this way, we call the vector a time series." 按这种方式解释时，我们称该向量为时间序列。 Austin, 2023, section 6.1 Correlated 相关 "We often say that they are correlated, and we would like to measure the degree to which they are correlated." 我们常说它们是相关的，并且我们希望度量它们相关的程度。 Austin, 2023, section 6.1 Demean 去均值 "In order to compare the ways in which they rise and fall, we will first demean the time series; that is, for each time series, we will subtract its average value to obtain a new time series." 为了比较它们升降的方式，我们首先对时间序列去均值；也就是说，对每个时间序列，减去其平均值，得到一个新的时间序列。 Austin, 2023, section 6.1 Clustering 聚类 "We call the result a clustering." 我们称这个结果为一个聚类。 Austin, 2023, section 6.1 Centroid 质心 "To begin, we identify the centroid, or the average, of a set of vectors \(\mathbf{v}_1, \mathbf{v}_2, \ldots,\mathbf{v}_n\) as \(\frac1n\left(\mathbf{v}_1+\mathbf{v}_2+\ldots+\mathbf{v}_n\right)\)." 首先，我们将一组向量 \(\mathbf{v}_1, \mathbf{v}_2, \ldots,\mathbf{v}_n\) 的质心（即平均值）定义为 \(\frac1n\left(\mathbf{v}_1+\mathbf{v}_2+\ldots+\mathbf{v}_n\right)\)。 Austin, 2023, section 6.1 Objective 目标函数 "If we have a clustering, we therefore define a function, called the objective, which measures the average of the square of the distance from each point to the centroid of the cluster to which that point belongs." 因此，如果有一个聚类，我们就定义一个称为目标函数的函数，它度量每个点到其所属簇的质心的距离平方的平均值。 Austin, 2023, section 6.1 Elbow Plot 肘部图 "This plot is called an elbow plot due to its shape." 这种图因其形状而称为肘部图。 Austin, 2023, section 6.1 References Austin, D. (2023). Understanding linear algebra (2023 update). Retrieved October 29, 2026, from https://understandinglinearalgebra.org/home.html

math/cs2023/linear-algebra/orthogonality.summary: 6.2 Orthogonal Complements and the Matrix Transpose Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 6.2 Orthogonal Complements and the Matrix Transpose 正交补与矩阵的转置 (No definition) （无定义） Austin, 2023, section 6.2 Orthogonal Complement 正交补 "Given a subspace \(W\) of \(\mathbb{R}^m\), the orthogonal complement of \(W\) is the set of vectors in \(\mathbb{R}^m\) each of which is orthogonal to every vector in \(W\). We denote the orthogonal complement by \(W^\perp\)." 给定 \(\mathbb{R}^m\) 的子空间 \(W\)，\(W\) 的正交补是 \(\mathbb{R}^m\) 中与 \(W\) 中每个向量都正交的向量所组成的集合。我们用 \(W^\perp\) 表示正交补。 Austin, 2023, Definition 6.2.4 Transpose 转置 "The transpose of the \(m\times n\) matrix \(A\) is the \(n\times m\) matrix \(A^T\) whose rows are the columns of \(A\)." \(m\times n\) 矩阵 \(A\) 的转置是 \(n\times m\) 矩阵 \(A^T\)，其各行是 \(A\) 的各列。 Austin, 2023, Definition 6.2.8 References Austin, D. (2023). Understanding linear algebra (2023 update). Retrieved October 29, 2026, from https://understandinglinearalgebra.org/home.html

math/cs2023/linear-algebra/orthogonality.summary: 6.3 Orthogonal Bases and Projections Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 6.3 Orthogonal Bases and Projections 正交基与投影 (No definition) （无定义） Austin, 2023, section 6.3 Orthogonal Matrix 正交矩阵 "A square \(m\times m\) matrix \(Q\) whose columns form an orthonormal basis for \(\mathbb{R}^m\) is called orthogonal." 各列构成 \(\mathbb{R}^m\) 的标准正交基的 \(m\times m\) 方阵 \(Q\) 称为正交矩阵。 Austin, 2023, Definition 6.3.26 Orthogonal Projection 正交投影 "Given a vector \(\mathbf{b}\) in \(\mathbb{R}^m\) and a subspace \(W\) of \(\mathbb{R}^m\), the orthogonal projection of \(\mathbf{b}\) onto \(W\) is the vector \(\widehat{\mathbf{b}}\) in \(W\) that is closest to \(\mathbf{b}\)." 给定 \(\mathbb{R}^m\) 中的向量 \(\mathbf{b}\) 和 \(\mathbb{R}^m\) 的子空间 \(W\)，\(\mathbf{b}\) 在 \(W\) 上的正交投影是 \(W\) 中最接近 \(\mathbf{b}\) 的向量 \(\widehat{\mathbf{b}}\)。 Austin, 2023, Definition 6.3.14 Orthogonal Set 正交集 "By an orthogonal set of vectors, we mean a set of nonzero vectors each of which is orthogonal to the others." 所谓向量的正交集，是指由非零向量组成、其中每个向量都与其他向量正交的集合。 Austin, 2023, Definition 6.3.2 Orthonormal Set 标准正交集 "An orthonormal set is an orthogonal set of vectors each of which has unit length." 标准正交集是其中每个向量都具有单位长度的正交向量集。 Austin, 2023, Definition 6.3.8 Unit Vector 单位向量 "Such vectors are called unit vectors." 这样的向量称为单位向量。 Austin, 2023, section 6.3 Projection Formula 投影公式 "If \(W\) is a subspace of \(\mathbb{R}^m\) having an orthogonal basis \(\mathbf{w}_1,\mathbf{w}_2,\ldots, \mathbf{w}_n\) and \(\mathbf{b}\) is a vector in \(\mathbb{R}^m\), then the orthogonal projection of \(\mathbf{b}\) onto \(W\) is \(\widehat{\mathbf{b}}= \frac{\mathbf{b}\cdot\mathbf{w}_1}{\mathbf{w}_1\cdot\mathbf{w}_1}~\mathbf{w}_1 + \frac{\mathbf{b}\cdot\mathbf{w}_2}{\mathbf{w}_2\cdot\mathbf{w}_2}~\mathbf{w}_2 + \cdots + \frac{\mathbf{b}\cdot\mathbf{w}_n}{\mathbf{w}_n\cdot\mathbf{w}_n}~\mathbf{w}_n\)." 如果 \(W\) 是 \(\mathbb{R}^m\) 的子空间，具有正交基 \(\mathbf{w}_1,\mathbf{w}_2,\ldots, \mathbf{w}_n\)，且 \(\mathbf{b}\) 是 \(\mathbb{R}^m\) 中的向量，则 \(\mathbf{b}\) 在 \(W\) 上的正交投影为 \(\widehat{\mathbf{b}}= \frac{\mathbf{b}\cdot\mathbf{w}_1}{\mathbf{w}_1\cdot\mathbf{w}_1}~\mathbf{w}_1 + \frac{\mathbf{b}\cdot\mathbf{w}_2}{\mathbf{w}_2\cdot\mathbf{w}_2}~\mathbf{w}_2 + \cdots + \frac{\mathbf{b}\cdot\mathbf{w}_n}{\mathbf{w}_n\cdot\mathbf{w}_n}~\mathbf{w}_n\)。 Austin, 2023, Proposition 6.3.18 References Austin, D. (2023). Understanding linear algebra (2023 update). Retrieved October 29, 2026, from https://understandinglinearalgebra.org/home.html

math/cs2023/linear-algebra/orthogonality.summary: 6.4 Finding Orthogonal Bases Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 6.4 Finding Orthogonal Bases 求正交基 (No definition) （无定义） Austin, 2023, section 6.4 Gram-Schmidt Orthogonalization 格拉姆-施密特正交化 "The preview activity illustrates the main idea behind an algorithm, known as Gram-Schmidt orthogonalization, that begins with a basis for some subspace of \(\mathbb{R}^m\) and produces an orthogonal or orthonormal basis." 预备活动说明了一个算法的主要思想，这个算法称为格拉姆-施密特正交化，它从 \(\mathbb{R}^m\) 的某个子空间的一组基出发，得到一组正交基或标准正交基。 Austin, 2023, section 6.4 QR Factorization QR 分解 "If \(A\) is an \(m\times n\) matrix whose columns are linearly independent, we may write \(A=QR\) where \(Q\) is an \(m\times n\) matrix whose columns form an orthonormal basis for \(\text{Col}(A)\) and \(R\) is an \(n\times n\) upper triangular matrix." 如果 \(A\) 是各列线性无关的 \(m\times n\) 矩阵，则可以写成 \(A=QR\)，其中 \(Q\) 是 \(m\times n\) 矩阵，其各列构成 \(\text{Col}(A)\) 的标准正交基，\(R\) 是 \(n\times n\) 上三角矩阵。 Austin, 2023, Proposition 6.4.9 References Austin, D. (2023). Understanding linear algebra (2023 update). Retrieved October 29, 2026, from https://understandinglinearalgebra.org/home.html

math/cs2023/linear-algebra/orthogonality.summary: 6.5 Orthogonal Least Squares Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 6.5 Orthogonal Least Squares 正交最小二乘 (No definition) （无定义） Austin, 2023, section 6.5 Coefficient of Determination 决定系数 "The coefficient of determination is \(R^2 = 1 - \frac{\vert \mathbf{b} - A\widehat{\mathbf{x}}\vert ^2} {\vert \widetilde{\mathbf{b}}\vert ^2}\), where \(\widetilde{\mathbf{b}}\) is the vector obtained by demeaning \(\mathbf{b}\)." 决定系数为 \(R^2 = 1 - \frac{\vert \mathbf{b} - A\widehat{\mathbf{x}}\vert ^2} {\vert \widetilde{\mathbf{b}}\vert ^2}\)，其中 \(\widetilde{\mathbf{b}}\) 是对 \(\mathbf{b}\) 去均值得到的向量。 Austin, 2023, Definition 6.5.12 Normal Equation 正规方程 "Because the least-squares approximate solution is the vector \(\widehat{\mathbf{x}}\) such that \(A\widehat{\mathbf{x}} = \widehat{\mathbf{b}}\), we can rearrange this equation to see that \(\begin{aligned} A^T(A\widehat{\mathbf{x}} - \mathbf{b}) & = \mathbf{0}\\ A^TA\widehat{\mathbf{x}} - A^T\mathbf{b} & = \mathbf{0}\\ A^TA\widehat{\mathbf{x}} & = A^T\mathbf{b} \end{aligned}\). This equation is called the normal equation, and we have the following proposition." 由于最小二乘近似解是满足 \(A\widehat{\mathbf{x}} = \widehat{\mathbf{b}}\) 的向量 \(\widehat{\mathbf{x}}\)，我们可以把这个方程整理为 \(\begin{aligned} A^T(A\widehat{\mathbf{x}} - \mathbf{b}) & = \mathbf{0}\\ A^TA\widehat{\mathbf{x}} - A^T\mathbf{b} & = \mathbf{0}\\ A^TA\widehat{\mathbf{x}} & = A^T\mathbf{b} \end{aligned}\)。这个方程称为正规方程，由此得到下面的命题。 Austin, 2023, section 6.5 Orthogonal Least Squares 正交最小二乘 "This activity illustrates the idea behind a technique known as orthogonal least squares, which we have been working toward throughout this chapter." 这个活动说明了一种称为正交最小二乘的技术背后的思想，本章一直在为它做准备。 Austin, 2023, section 6.5 Least-squares Problem 最小二乘问题 "Our approach finds the values for \(b\) and \(m\) that make this sum of squares as small as possible, which is why we call this a least-squares problem." 我们的方法求出使这个平方和尽可能小的 \(b\) 和 \(m\) 的值，这就是我们称之为最小二乘问题的原因。 Austin, 2023, section 6.5 Least-squares Approximate Solution 最小二乘近似解 "We will usually denote the solution of \(A\mathbf{x} = \widehat{\mathbf{b}}\) by \(\widehat{\mathbf{x}}\) and call this vector the least-squares approximate solution of \(A\mathbf{x}=\mathbf{b}\) to distinguish it from a (possibly non-existent) solution of \(A\mathbf{x}=\mathbf{b}\)." 我们通常把 \(A\mathbf{x} = \widehat{\mathbf{b}}\) 的解记为 \(\widehat{\mathbf{x}}\)，并称这个向量为 \(A\mathbf{x}=\mathbf{b}\) 的最小二乘近似解，以区别于 \(A\mathbf{x}=\mathbf{b}\) 的（可能不存在的）解。 Austin, 2023, section 6.5 Linear Regression 线性回归 "This example demonstrates an approach, called linear regression, in which a collection of data is modeled using a linear function found by solving a least-squares problem." 这个例子展示了一种称为线性回归的方法，在这种方法中，一组数据用通过求解最小二乘问题得到的线性函数来建模。 Austin, 2023, section 6.5 Overfitting 过拟合 "Fitting the data with a polynomial whose degree is too high is called overfitting, a phenomenon that can appear in many machine learning applications." 用次数过高的多项式拟合数据称为过拟合，这种现象可能出现在许多机器学习应用中。 Austin, 2023, section 6.5 Noise 噪声 "The error built in to the data is called noise, and its presence means that we shouldn’t expect our polynomial to fit the data perfectly." 数据中固有的误差称为噪声，它的存在意味着我们不应指望多项式能完美地拟合数据。 Austin, 2023, section 6.5 Vandermonde Matrix 范德蒙德矩阵 "This is called a Vandermonde matrix of degree \(k\)." 这称为 \(k\) 次范德蒙德矩阵。 Austin, 2023, section 6.5 References Austin, D. math/cs2023/linear-algebra/singular-valu.title: 7.1 Symmetric Matrices and Variance | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
math/cs2023/linear-algebra/singular-valu.summary: 7.1 Symmetric Matrices and Variance Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 7.1 Symmetric Matrices and Variance 对称矩阵与方差 (No definition) （无定义） Austin, 2023, section 7.1 Orthogonal Diagonalization 正交对角化 "If there is an orthonormal basis of \(\mathbb{R}^n\) consisting of eigenvectors of the matrix \(A\), we say that \(A\) is orthogonally diagonalizable." 如果 \(\mathbb{R}^n\) 存在一组由矩阵 \(A\) 的特征向量构成的标准正交基，则称 \(A\) 可正交对角化。 Austin, 2023, Definition 7.1.6 Symmetric Matrix 对称矩阵 "A symmetric matrix \(A\) is one for which \(A=A^T\)." 对称矩阵 \(A\) 是满足 \(A=A^T\) 的矩阵。 Austin, 2023, Definition 7.1.7 Covariance Matrix 协方差矩阵 "In general, the matrix \(C=\frac1N~AA^T\) is called the covariance matrix of the dataset, and it is useful because the variance \(V_\mathbf{u} = \mathbf{u}\cdot(C\mathbf{u})\), as we have just seen." 一般地，矩阵 \(C=\frac1N~AA^T\) 称为数据集的协方差矩阵，它很有用，因为正如我们刚才看到的，方差 \(V_\mathbf{u} = \mathbf{u}\cdot(C\mathbf{u})\)。 Austin, 2023, section 7.1 The Spectral Theorem 谱定理 "The matrix \(A\) is orthogonally diagonalizable if and only if \(A\) is symmetric." 矩阵 \(A\) 可正交对角化当且仅当 \(A\) 是对称的。 Austin, 2023, Theorem 7.1.11 Additivity of Variance 方差的可加性 "If \(W\) is a subspace with orthonormal basis \(\mathbf{u}_1\),\(\mathbf{u}_2\),\(\ldots\), \(\mathbf{u}_n\), then the variance of the points projected onto \(W\) is the sum of the variances in the \(\mathbf{u}_j\) directions: \(V_W = V_{\mathbf{u}_1} + V_{\mathbf{u}_2} + \ldots + V_{\mathbf{u}_n}\)." 如果 \(W\) 是具有标准正交基 \(\mathbf{u}_1\)、\(\mathbf{u}_2\)、\(\ldots\)、\(\mathbf{u}_n\) 的子空间，那么投影到 \(W\) 上的点的方差等于各 \(\mathbf{u}_j\) 方向上的方差之和：\(V_W = V_{\mathbf{u}_1} + V_{\mathbf{u}_2} + \ldots + V_{\mathbf{u}_n}\)。 Austin, 2023, Proposition 7.1.20 References Austin, D. (2023). Understanding linear algebra (2023 update). Retrieved October 29, 2026, from https://understandinglinearalgebra.org/home.html

math/cs2023/linear-algebra/singular-valu.title: 7.2 Quadratic Forms | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
math/cs2023/linear-algebra/singular-valu.summary: 7.2 Quadratic Forms Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 7.2 Quadratic Forms 二次型 (No definition) （无定义） Austin, 2023, section 7.2 Quadratic Form 二次型 "If \(A\) is a symmetric \(m\times m\) matrix, the quadratic form defined by \(A\) is the function \(q_A(\mathbf{x}) = \mathbf{x}\cdot(A\mathbf{x})\)." 若 \(A\) 是 \(m\times m\) 对称矩阵，则由 \(A\) 定义的二次型是函数 \(q_A(\mathbf{x}) = \mathbf{x}\cdot(A\mathbf{x})\)。 Austin, 2023, Definition 7.2.4 Principal Axes Theorem 主轴定理 "If \(A\) is a symmetric \(m\times m\) matrix with eigenvalues \(\lambda_1,\lambda_2,\ldots,\lambda_m\), then the quadratic form \(q_A\) can be written, after an orthogonal change of coordinates \(\mathbf{y}=Q^T\mathbf{x}\), as \(q_A(\mathbf{x}) = \lambda_1y_1^2 + \lambda_2y_2^2 + \ldots + \lambda_my_m^2\)." 若 \(A\) 是 \(m\times m\) 对称矩阵，其特征值为 \(\lambda_1,\lambda_2,\ldots,\lambda_m\)，则经过正交坐标变换 \(\mathbf{y}=Q^T\mathbf{x}\) 后，二次型 \(q_A\) 可写成 \(q_A(\mathbf{x}) = \lambda_1y_1^2 + \lambda_2y_2^2 + \ldots + \lambda_my_m^2\)。 Austin, 2023, Theorem 7.2.13 Positive Definite 正定 "A symmetric matrix \(A\) is called positive definite if its associated quadratic form satisfies \(q_A(\mathbf{x}) \gt 0\) for any nonzero vector \(\mathbf{x}\). If \(q_A(\mathbf{x}) \geq 0\) for all nonzero vectors \(\mathbf{x}\), we say that \(A\) is positive semidefinite. Likewise, we say that \(A\) is negative definite if \(q_A(\mathbf{x}) \lt 0\) for all nonzero vectors \(\mathbf{x}\). Finally, \(A\) is called indefinite if \(q_A(\mathbf{x}) \gt 0\) for some \(\mathbf{x}\) and \(q_A(\mathbf{x}) \lt 0\) for others." 如果对称矩阵 \(A\) 的相应二次型满足对任意非零向量 \(\mathbf{x}\) 都有 \(q_A(\mathbf{x}) \gt 0\)，则称 \(A\) 为正定的。如果对所有非零向量 \(\mathbf{x}\) 都有 \(q_A(\mathbf{x}) \geq 0\)，则称 \(A\) 为半正定的。类似地，如果对所有非零向量 \(\mathbf{x}\) 都有 \(q_A(\mathbf{x}) \lt 0\)，则称 \(A\) 为负定的。最后，如果对某些 \(\mathbf{x}\) 有 \(q_A(\mathbf{x}) \gt 0\)，而对另一些 \(\mathbf{x}\) 有 \(q_A(\mathbf{x}) \lt 0\)，则称 \(A\) 为不定的。 Austin, 2023, Definition 7.2.14 Second Derivative Test 二阶导数判别法 "The nature of a critical point of a multivariable function is determined by the Hessian \(H\) of the function at the critical point. If \(H\) has all positive eigenvalues, the critical point is a local minimum. \(H\) has all negative eigenvalues, the critical point is a local maximum. \(H\) has both positive and negative eigenvalues, the critical point is neither a local maximum nor minimum." 多元函数临界点的性质由该函数在临界点处的黑塞矩阵 \(H\) 决定。如果 \(H\) 的特征值全为正，则临界点是局部极小值点。如果 \(H\) 的特征值全为负，则临界点是局部极大值点。如果 \(H\) 既有正特征值又有负特征值，则临界点既不是局部极大值点也不是局部极小值点。 Austin, 2023, Proposition 7.2.18 Hessian 黑塞矩阵 "The matrix \(H = \begin{bmatrix} f_{xx}(x_0,y_0) & f_{xy}(x_0,y_0) \\ f_{yx}(x_0,y_0) & f_{yy}(x_0,y_0) \end{bmatrix}\) is called the Hessian of \(f\), and we see now that the eigenvalues of this symmetric matrix determine the nature of the critical point \((x_0,y_0)\)." 矩阵 \(H = \begin{bmatrix} f_{xx}(x_0,y_0) & f_{xy}(x_0,y_0) \\ f_{yx}(x_0,y_0) & f_{yy}(x_0,y_0) \end{bmatrix}\) 称为 \(f\) 的黑塞矩阵，我们现在看到，这个对称矩阵的特征值决定了临界点 \((x_0,y_0)\) 的性质。 Austin, 2023, section 7.2 References Austin, D. (2023). Understanding linear algebra (2023 update). Retrieved October 29, 2026, from https://understandinglinearalgebra.org/home.html

math/cs2023/linear-algebra/systems-of-eq.summary: 1.1 What Can We Expect Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 1.1 What Can We Expect 我们能期待什么 (No definition) （无定义） Austin, 2023, section 1.1 Linear Equation 线性方程 "A linear equation in the unknowns \(x_1,x_2,\ldots,x_n\) may be written in the form \(a_1x_1 + a_2x_2 + \ldots + a_nx_n = b\), where \(a_1,a_2,\ldots,a_n\) are real numbers known as coefficients." 关于未知量 \(x_1,x_2,\ldots,x_n\) 的线性方程可以写成形如 \(a_1x_1 + a_2x_2 + \ldots + a_nx_n = b\) 的形式，其中 \(a_1,a_2,\ldots,a_n\) 是称为系数的实数。 Austin, 2023, Definition 1.1.13 Linear System 线性方程组 "By a system of linear equations or a linear system, we mean a set of linear equations written in a common set of unknowns." 我们所说的线性方程组，是指用一组共同的未知量写出的一组线性方程。 Austin, 2023, Definition 1.1.13 Solution 解 "A solution to a linear system is simply a set of numbers \(x_1 = s_1, x_2 = s_2, \ldots, x_n=s_n\) that satisfy all the equations in the system." 线性方程组的一个解就是满足方程组中所有方程的一组数 \(x_1 = s_1, x_2 = s_2, \ldots, x_n=s_n\)。 Austin, 2023, Definition 1.1.14 Solution Space 解空间 "We call the set of all solutions the solution space of the linear system." 我们把全体解构成的集合称为线性方程组的解空间。 Austin, 2023, Definition 1.1.15 Coefficient 系数 "A linear equation in the unknowns \(x_1,x_2,\ldots,x_n\) may be written in the form \(a_1x_1 + a_2x_2 + \ldots + a_nx_n = b\), where \(a_1,a_2,\ldots,a_n\) are real numbers known as coefficients." 关于未知量 \(x_1,x_2,\ldots,x_n\) 的线性方程可以写成形如 \(a_1x_1 + a_2x_2 + \ldots + a_nx_n = b\) 的形式，其中 \(a_1,a_2,\ldots,a_n\) 是称为系数的实数。 Austin, 2023, section 1.1 Variable 变量 "We also say that \(x_1,x_2,\ldots,x_n\) are the variables in the equation." 我们也称 \(x_1,x_2,\ldots,x_n\) 为方程中的变量。 Austin, 2023, section 1.1 References Austin, D. (2023). Understanding linear algebra (2023 update). Retrieved October 29, 2026, from https://understandinglinearalgebra.org/home.html

math/cs2023/linear-algebra/vectors-matri.summary: 2.2 Matrix Multiplication and Linear Combinations Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 2.2 Matrix Multiplication and Linear Combinations 矩阵乘法与线性组合 (No definition) （无定义） Austin, 2023, section 2.2 Matrix Addition 矩阵加法 "This means that we may define scalar multiplication and matrix addition operations using the corresponding column-wise vector operations." 这意味着我们可以利用相应的按列向量运算来定义数乘和矩阵加法运算。 Austin, 2023, section 2.2 Identity Matrix 单位矩阵 "The matrix \(I_n\), which we call the identity matrix, is the \(n\times n\) matrix whose entries are zero except for the diagonal entries, all of which are 1." 矩阵 \(I_n\) 称为单位矩阵，它是除对角元全为 1 外其余元素都为零的 \(n\times n\) 矩阵。 Austin, 2023, Exploration 2.2.1 Scalar Multiplication of Matrices 矩阵的数乘 "This means that we may define scalar multiplication and matrix addition operations using the corresponding column-wise vector operations." 这意味着我们可以利用相应的按列向量运算来定义数乘和矩阵加法运算。 Austin, 2023, section 2.2 Shape of a Matrix 矩阵的形状 "If we say that the shape of a matrix is \(m\times n\), we mean that it has \(m\) rows and \(n\) columns." 说一个矩阵的形状是 \(m\times n\)，是指它有 \(m\) 行 \(n\) 列。 Austin, 2023, section 2.2 Matrix-vector Multiplication 矩阵与向量的乘法 "The product of a matrix \(A\) by a vector \(\mathbf{x}\) will be the linear combination of the columns of \(A\) using the components of \(\mathbf{x}\) as weights. More specifically, if \(A=\left[\begin{array}{rrrr} \mathbf{v}_1 & \mathbf{v}_2 & \ldots & \mathbf{v}_n \end{array}\right],~~~ \mathbf{x} = \left[\begin{array}{r} c_1 \\ c_2 \\ \vdots \\ c_n \end{array}\right]\), then \(A\mathbf{x} = c_1\mathbf{v}_1 + c_2\mathbf{v}_2 + \ldots + c_n\mathbf{v}_n\). If \(A\) is an \(m\times n\) matrix, then \(\mathbf{x}\) must be an \(n\)-dimensional vector, and the product \(A\mathbf{x}\) will be an \(m\)-dimensional vector." 矩阵 \(A\) 与向量 \(\mathbf{x}\) 的乘积将是以 \(\mathbf{x}\) 的分量为权重的 \(A\) 的各列的线性组合。更具体地说，如果 \(A=\left[\begin{array}{rrrr} \mathbf{v}_1 & \mathbf{v}_2 & \ldots & \mathbf{v}_n \end{array}\right],~~~ \mathbf{x} = \left[\begin{array}{r} c_1 \\ c_2 \\ \vdots \\ c_n \end{array}\right]\)，那么 \(A\mathbf{x} = c_1\mathbf{v}_1 + c_2\mathbf{v}_2 + \ldots + c_n\mathbf{v}_n\)。如果 \(A\) 是 \(m\times n\) 矩阵，那么 \(\mathbf{x}\) 必须是 \(n\) 维向量，而乘积 \(A\mathbf{x}\) 将是 \(m\) 维向量。 Austin, 2023, Definition 2.2.3 Matrix-matrix Multiplication 矩阵乘法 "Given matrices \(A\) and \(B\), we form their product \(AB\) by first writing \(B\) in terms of its columns \(B = \left[\begin{array}{rrrr} \mathbf{v}_1 & \mathbf{v}_2 & \cdots & \mathbf{v}_p \end{array}\right]\) and then defining \(AB = \left[\begin{array}{rrrr} A\mathbf{v}_1 & A\mathbf{v}_2 & \cdots & A\mathbf{v}_p \end{array}\right]\)." 给定矩阵 \(A\) 和 \(B\)，我们这样构造它们的乘积 \(AB\)：先把 \(B\) 按列写成 \(B = \left[\begin{array}{rrrr} \mathbf{v}_1 & \mathbf{v}_2 & \cdots & \mathbf{v}_p \end{array}\right]\)，然后定义 \(AB = \left[\begin{array}{rrrr} A\mathbf{v}_1 & A\mathbf{v}_2 & \cdots & A\mathbf{v}_p \end{array}\right]\)。 Austin, 2023, Definition 2.2.10 Linearity of Matrix Multiplication 矩阵乘法的线性性 "If \(A\) is a matrix, \(\mathbf{v}\) and \(\mathbf{w}\) vectors of the appropriate dimensions, and \(c\) a scalar, then \(A\mathbf{0} = \mathbf{0}\). \(A(c\mathbf{v}) = cA\mathbf{v}\). \(A(\mathbf{v}+\mathbf{w}) = A\mathbf{v} + A\mathbf{w}\)." 若 \(A\) 是矩阵，\(\mathbf{v}\) 和 \(\mathbf{w}\) 是维数适当的向量，\(c\) 是标量，则 \(A\mathbf{0} = \mathbf{0}\)。\(A(c\mathbf{v}) = cA\mathbf{v}\)。\(A(\mathbf{v}+\mathbf{w}) = A\mathbf{v} + A\mathbf{w}\)。 Austin, 2023, Proposition 2.2.6 References Austin, D. (2023). Understanding linear algebra (2023 update). Retrieved October 29, 2026, from https://understandinglinearalgebra.org/home.html

math/cs2023/linear-algebra/vectors-matri.summary: 2.3 The Span of a Set of Vectors Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 2.3 The Span of a Set of Vectors 向量组的张成 (No definition) （无定义） Austin, 2023, section 2.3 Span 张成 "The span of a set of vectors \(\mathbf{v}_1,\mathbf{v}_2,\ldots,\mathbf{v}_n\) is the set of all linear combinations that can be formed from the vectors. Alternatively, if \(A = \begin{bmatrix} \mathbf{v}_1 & \mathbf{v}_2 & \cdots & \mathbf{v}_n \end{bmatrix}\), then the span of the vectors consists of all vectors \(\mathbf{b}\) for which the equation \(A\mathbf{x} = \mathbf{b}\) is consistent." 向量组 \(\mathbf{v}_1,\mathbf{v}_2,\ldots,\mathbf{v}_n\) 的张成是由这些向量所能构成的全体线性组合的集合。另一种说法是，如果 \(A = \begin{bmatrix} \mathbf{v}_1 & \mathbf{v}_2 & \cdots & \mathbf{v}_n \end{bmatrix}\)，那么这些向量的张成由使方程 \(A\mathbf{x} = \mathbf{b}\) 相容的所有向量 \(\mathbf{b}\) 组成。 Austin, 2023, Definition 2.3.2 References Austin, D. (2023). Understanding linear algebra (2023 update). Retrieved October 29, 2026, from https://understandinglinearalgebra.org/home.html

math/cs2023/linear-algebra/vectors-matri.summary: 2.5 Matrix Transformations Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 2.5 Matrix Transformations 矩阵变换 (No definition) （无定义） Austin, 2023, section 2.5 Discrete Dynamical System 离散动力系统 "We call this situation where the state of a system evolves from one time to the next according to the rule \(\mathbf{x}_{k+1}=A\mathbf{x}_k\) a discrete dynamical system." 我们把这种系统状态按规则 \(\mathbf{x}_{k+1}=A\mathbf{x}_k\) 从一个时刻演化到下一个时刻的情形称为离散动力系统。 Austin, 2023, section 2.5 Matrix Transformation 矩阵变换 "The matrix transformation associated to the matrix \(A\) is the function that assigns to the vector \(\mathbf{x}\) the vector \(A\mathbf{x}\); that is, \(T(\mathbf{x}) = A\mathbf{x}\)." 与矩阵 \(A\) 相关联的矩阵变换是把向量 \(\mathbf{x}\) 对应到向量 \(A\mathbf{x}\) 的函数；即 \(T(\mathbf{x}) = A\mathbf{x}\)。 Austin, 2023, Definition 2.5.4 State Vector 状态向量 "We call \(\mathbf{x}\) the state vector and \(T\) the transition function, as it describes the transition of the state vector from one time to the next." 我们称 \(\mathbf{x}\) 为状态向量，称 \(T\) 为转移函数，因为它描述了状态向量从一个时刻到下一个时刻的转移。 Austin, 2023, section 2.5 Transition Function 转移函数 "We call \(\mathbf{x}\) the state vector and \(T\) the transition function, as it describes the transition of the state vector from one time to the next." 我们称 \(\mathbf{x}\) 为状态向量，称 \(T\) 为转移函数，因为它描述了状态向量从一个时刻到下一个时刻的转移。 Austin, 2023, section 2.5 Composition 复合 "This process is called function composition and likely appeared in an earlier algebra course." 这一过程称为函数复合，你很可能在以前的代数课程中见过。 Austin, 2023, section 2.5 References Austin, D. (2023). Understanding linear algebra (2023 update). Retrieved October 29, 2026, from https://understandinglinearalgebra.org/home.html

math/cs2023/probability/basic-concepts/1.title: 1.2 Review of Set Theory | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
math/cs2023/probability/basic-concepts/1.summary: 1.2 Review of Set Theory Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 1.2 Review of Set Theory 集合论回顾 (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 1.2 1.2.0 Review 回顾 (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 1.2.0 Subset 子集 "Set \(A\) is a subset of set \(B\) if every element of \(A\) is also an element of \(B\)." 若 \(A\) 的每个元素也都是 \(B\) 的元素，则称集合 \(A\) 是集合 \(B\) 的子集。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 1.2.0 Superset 超集 "Equivalently, we say \(B\) is a superset of \(A\), or \(B \supset A\)." 等价地，我们称 \(B\) 是 \(A\) 的超集，或写作 \(B \supset A\)。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 1.2.0 Null Set (Empty Set) 空集 "The set with no elements, i.e., \(\emptyset=\{ \}\) is the null set or the empty set." 没有任何元素的集合，即 \(\emptyset=\{ \}\)，称为零集或空集。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 1.2.0 Universal Set 全集 "The universal set is the set of all things that we could possibly consider in the context we are studying." 全集是在我们所研究的情境中可能考虑的所有事物构成的集合。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 1.2.0 1.2.1 Venn Diagrams 维恩图 (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 1.2.1 Venn Diagram 韦恩图（Venn 图） "Venn diagrams are very useful in visualizing relation between sets. In a Venn diagram any set is depicted by a closed region." 韦恩图非常适合直观表示集合之间的关系。在韦恩图中，任何集合都用一个封闭区域表示。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 1.2.1 1.2.2 Set Operations 集合运算 (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 1.2.2 De Morgan's Law 德摩根律 "De Morgan's law For any sets \(A_1\), \(A_2\), \(\cdots\), \(A_n\), we have \((A_1 \cup A_2 \cup A_3 \cup \cdots A_n)^c=A_1^c \cap A_2^c \cap A_3^c\cdots \cap A_n^c\); \((A_1 \cap A_2 \cap A_3 \cap \cdots A_n)^c=A_1^c \cup A_2^c \cup A_3^c\cdots \cup A_n^c\)." 德摩根律 对任意集合 \(A_1\)、\(A_2\)、\(\cdots\)、\(A_n\)，有 \((A_1 \cup A_2 \cup A_3 \cup \cdots A_n)^c=A_1^c \cap A_2^c \cap A_3^c\cdots \cap A_n^c\)；\((A_1 \cap A_2 \cap A_3 \cap \cdots A_n)^c=A_1^c \cup A_2^c \cup A_3^c\cdots \cup A_n^c\)。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 1.2.2 Union 并集 "The union of two sets is a set containing all elements that are in \(A\) or in \(B\) (possibly both)." 两个集合的并集是包含所有属于 \(A\) 或属于 \(B\)（可以两者都属于）的元素的集合。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 1.2.2 Intersection 交集 "The intersection of two sets \(A\) and \(B\), denoted by \(A \cap B\), consists of all elements that are both in \(A\) \(\underline{\textrm{and}}\) \(B\)." 集合 \(A\) 与 \(B\) 的交集记作 \(A \cap B\)，由既属于 \(A\) 又属于 \(B\) 的所有元素组成。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 1.2.2 Complement 补集 "The complement of a set \(A\), denoted by \(A^c\) or \(\bar{A}\), is the set of all elements that are in the universal set \(S\) but are not in \(A\)." 集合 \(A\) 的补集记作 \(A^c\) 或 \(\bar{A}\)，是全集 \(S\) 中不属于 \(A\) 的所有元素构成的集合。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 1.2.2 Difference (Subtraction) 差集 "The difference (subtraction) is defined as follows. The set \(A-B\) consists of elements that are in \(A\) but not in \(B\)." 差集（减法）定义如下。集合 \(A-B\) 由属于 \(A\) 但不属于 \(B\) 的元素组成。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 1.2.2 Mutually Exclusive (Disjoint) Sets 互斥集合（不相交集合） "Two sets \(A\) and \(B\) are mutually exclusive or disjoint if they do not have any shared elements; i.e., their intersection is the empty set, \(A \cap B=\emptyset\)." 若两个集合 \(A\) 和 \(B\) 没有任何公共元素，即它们的交集为空集 \(A \cap B=\emptyset\)，则称它们互斥或不相交。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 1.2.2 Partition 划分 "In general, a collection of nonempty sets \(A_1, A_2,\cdots\) is a partition of a set \(A\) if they are disjoint and their union is \(A\)." 一般地，若一族非空集合 \(A_1, A_2,\cdots\) 互不相交且它们的并集为 \(A\)，则称其为集合 \(A\) 的一个划分。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 1.2.2 Distributive Law 分配律 "Distributive law For any sets \(A\), \(B\), and \(C\) we have \(A \cap (B \cup C)=(A \cap B) \cup (A\cap C)\); \(A \cup (B \cap C)=(A \cup B) \cap (A\cup C)\)." 分配律 对任意集合 \(A\)、\(B\) 和 \(C\)，有 \(A \cap (B \cup C)=(A \cap B) \cup (A\cap C)\)；\(A \cup (B \cap C)=(A \cup B) \cap (A\cup C)\)。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 1.2.2 Cartesian Product 笛卡尔积 "A Cartesian product of two sets \(A\) and \(B\), written as \(A\times B\), is the set containing ordered pairs from \(A\) and \(B\)." 集合 \(A\) 与 \(B\) 的笛卡尔积记作 \(A\times B\)，是由来自 \(A\) 和 \(B\) 的有序对构成的集合。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 1.2.2 Multiplication Principle 乘法原理 "If you have two finite sets \(A\) and \(B\), where \(A\) has \(M\) elements and \(B\) has \(N\) elements, then \(A \times B\) has \(M \times N\) elements. This rule is called the multiplication principle and is very useful in counting the numbers of elements in sets." 若有两个有限集合 \(A\) 和 \(B\)，其中 \(A\) 有 \(M\) 个元素，\(B\) 有 \(N\) 个元素，则 \(A \times B\) 有 \(M \times N\) 个元素。这一规则称为乘法原理，在计算集合的元素个数时非常有用。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 1.2.2 1.2.3 Cardinality 基数 (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 1.2.3 Countable and Uncountable Sets 可数集与不可数集 "Set \(A\) is called countable if one of the following is true if it is a finite set, \(\mid A \mid < \infty\); or it can be put in one-to-one correspondence with natural numbers \(\mathbb{N}\), in which case the set is said to be countably infinite. A set is called uncountable if it is not countable." 若满足下列条件之一，则称集合 \(A\) 可数：它是有限集，\(\mid A \mid < \infty\)；或者它可与自然数集 \(\mathbb{N}\) 建立一一对应，此时称该集合为可数无限集。若集合不可数，则称其为不可数集。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 1.2.3 Cardinality 基数 "Here we need to talk about cardinality of a set, which is basically the size of the set. The cardinality of a set is denoted by \(\vert A\vert\)." 这里需要谈谈集合的基数，它基本上就是集合的大小。集合的基数记作 \(\vert A\vert\)。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 1.2.3 Inclusion-Exclusion Principle 容斥原理 "Before discussing infinite sets, which is the main discussion of this section, we would like to talk about a very useful rule: the inclusion-exclusion principle. For two finite sets \(A\) and \(B\), we have \(\vert A \cup B \vert =\vert A\vert +\vert B\vert -\vert A \cap B\vert .\)" 在讨论无限集（这是本节的主要内容）之前，我们先谈一条非常有用的规则：容斥原理。对于两个有限集合 \(A\) 和 \(B\)，有 \(\vert A \cup B \vert =\vert A\vert +\vert B\vert -\vert A \cap B\vert .\) Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 1.2.3 1.2.4 Functions 函数 (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 1.2.4 Domain 定义域 "A function \(f\) is a rule that takes an input from a specific set, called the domain, and produces an output from another set, called co-domain." 函数 \(f\) 是一条规则，它从某个特定集合（称为定义域）中取一个输入，并在另一个集合（称为陪域）中产生一个输出。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 1.2.4 Co-domain 陪域 "A function \(f\) is a rule that takes an input from a specific set, called the domain, and produces an output from another set, called co-domain." 函数 \(f\) 是一条规则，它从某个特定集合（称为定义域）中取一个输入，并在另一个集合（称为陪域）中产生一个输出。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 1.2.4 Range of a Function 值域 "We define the range of a function as the set containing all the possible values of \(f(x)\). Thus, the range of a function is always a subset of its co-domain." 我们将函数的值域定义为包含 \(f(x)\) 所有可能取值的集合。因此，函数的值域总是其陪域的子集。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 1.2.4 1.2.5 Solved Problems 例题详解 (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 1.2.5 References Pishro-Nik, H. math/cs2023/probability/basic-concepts/1.summary: 1.3 Random Experiments and Probabilities Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 1.3 Random Experiments and Probabilities 随机试验与概率 (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 1.3 1.3.1 Random Experiments 随机试验 (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 1.3.1 Random Experiment 随机试验 "In particular, a random experiment is a process by which we observe something uncertain." 具体地说，随机试验是我们观察某种不确定事物的一个过程。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 1.3.1 Outcome 结果（样本点） "An outcome is a result of a random experiment." 结果（样本点）是随机试验的一个结果。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 1.3.1 Sample Space 样本空间 "The set of all possible outcomes is called the sample space." 所有可能结果构成的集合称为样本空间。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 1.3.1 Trial 试验（一次） "When we repeat a random experiment several times, we call each one of them a trial." 当我们把一个随机试验重复若干次时，把其中每一次称为一次试验。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 1.3.1 Event 事件 "Thus an event is a collection of possible outcomes. In other words, an event is a subset of the sample space to which we assign a probability." 因此，事件是可能结果的一个集合。换言之，事件是样本空间的一个子集，我们为它指派一个概率。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 1.3.1 Sample space 样本空间 "Informally, the sample space for a given set of events is the set of all possible values the events may assume." 非正式地说，一组给定事件的样本空间是这些事件可能取的所有可能值的集合。 Weisstein, n.d.-e, "Sample space" entry, para. 1 Event 事件 "An event is a certain subset of a probability space. Events are therefore collections of outcomes on which probabilities have been assigned." 事件是概率空间的某个子集。因此，事件是一些已被赋予概率的结果的汇集。 Weisstein, n.d.-c, "Event" entry, para. 1 1.3.2 Probability 概率 (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 1.3.2 Axioms of Probability 概率公理 "Axiom 1: For any event \(A\), \(P(A) \geq 0\). Axiom 2: Probability of the sample space \(S\) is \(P(S)=1\). Axiom 3: If \(A_1, A_2, A_3, \cdots\) are disjoint events, then \(P(A_1 \cup A_2 \cup A_3 \cdots)=P(A_1)+P(A_2)+P(A_3)+\cdots\)" 公理 1：对任意事件 \(A\)，\(P(A) \geq 0\)。公理 2：样本空间 \(S\) 的概率为 \(P(S)=1\)。公理 3：若 \(A_1, A_2, A_3, \cdots\) 为互不相交的事件，则 \(P(A_1 \cup A_2 \cup A_3 \cdots)=P(A_1)+P(A_2)+P(A_3)+\cdots\) Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 1.3.2 Probability Measure 概率测度 "We assign a probability measure \(P(A)\) to an event \(A\). This is a value between \(0\) and \(1\) that shows how likely the event is." 我们为事件 \(A\) 指派一个概率测度 \(P(A)\)。它是介于 \(0\) 和 \(1\) 之间的值，表示该事件有多大可能发生。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 1.3.2 Probability 概率 "In common usage, the word 'probability' is used to mean the chance that a particular event (or set of events) will occur expressed on a linear scale from 0 (impossibility) to 1 (certainty), also expressed as a percentage between 0 and 100%." 在日常用法中，“概率”一词指某个特定事件（或一组事件）发生的可能性，用从 0（不可能）到 1（必然）的线性刻度表示，也可表示为 0 到 100% 之间的百分比。 Weisstein, n.d.-d, "Probability" entry, para. 1 1.3.3 Finding Probabilities 求概率 (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 1.3.3 1.3.4 Discrete Models 离散模型 (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 1.3.4 Discrete Probability Model 离散概率模型 "If \(S\) is a countable set, this refers to a discrete probability model." 若 \(S\) 是可数集，则称为离散概率模型。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 1.3.4 Finite Sample Spaces with Equally Likely Outcomes 等可能的有限样本空间（古典概型） "An important special case of discrete probability models is when we have a finite sample space \(S\), where each outcome is equally likely, i.e., \(S=\{s_1,s_2,\cdots,s_N\}, \textrm{ where } P(s_i)=P(s_j) \textrm{ for all }i,j \in \{1,2,\cdots,N\}.\)" 离散概率模型的一个重要特例是：有一个有限样本空间 \(S\)，其中每个结果都等可能，即 \(S=\{s_1,s_2,\cdots,s_N\}, \textrm{ where } P(s_i)=P(s_j) \textrm{ for all }i,j \in \{1,2,\cdots,N\}.\) Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 1.3.4 1.3.5 Continuous Models 连续模型 (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 1.3.5 1.3.6 Solved Problems 例题详解 (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 1.3.6 References Pishro-Nik, H. should be larger than the original \(P(R)\), which is called the prior probability of \(R\)." 在这个例子中，可以合理地假定 \(P(R \vert C)\) 应当大于原来的 \(P(R)\)，后者称为 \(R\) 的先验概率。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 1.4.0 Conditional Probability 条件概率 "If \(A\) and \(B\) are two events in a sample space \(S\), then the conditional probability of \(A\) given \(B\) is defined as" 若 \(A\) 和 \(B\) 是样本空间 \(S\) 中的两个事件，则给定 \(B\) 时 \(A\) 的条件概率定义为 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 1.4.0 Chain Rule for Conditional Probability 乘法公式（链式法则） "Chain rule for conditional probability: Let us write the formula for conditional probability in the following format \(\hspace{100pt} P(A \cap B)=P(A)P(B\vert A)=P(B)P(A\vert B) \hspace{100pt} (1.5)\)" 条件概率的链式法则：把条件概率公式写成如下形式 \(\hspace{100pt} P(A \cap B)=P(A)P(B\vert A)=P(B)P(A\vert B) \hspace{100pt} (1.5)\) Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 1.4.0 Conditional probability 条件概率 "The conditional probability of an event A assuming that B has occurred with P(B)>0, denoted P(A|B), equals P(A|B) = We often draw a sample at random from a given set in which each element of the set has equal chance of being chosen." 从一个集合中抽样是指从该集合中选取一个元素。我们常从给定集合中随机抽取样本，集合中每个元素被选中的机会均等。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 2.1.0 Sampling with Replacement 有放回抽样 "If we put each object back after each draw, we call this sampling with replacement. In this case a single object can be possibly chosen multiple times." 如果每次抽取后都把对象放回，我们称之为有放回抽样。此时同一个对象可能被多次选中。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 2.1.0 Sampling without Replacement 无放回抽样 "On the other hand, if repetition is not allowed, we call it sampling without replacement." 另一方面，如果不允许重复，我们称之为无放回抽样。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 2.1.0 Ordered and Unordered Sampling 有序抽样与无序抽样 "If ordering matters (i.e.: \(a_1, a_2, a_3

This is because the coefficients in the binomial theorem are given by \({n \choose k}\)." \({n \choose k}\) 也称为二项式系数。这是因为二项式定理中的系数由 \({n \choose k}\) 给出。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 2.1.3 Bernoulli Trial 伯努利试验 "A Bernoulli Trial is a random experiment that has two possible outcomes which we can label as "success" and "failure,"" 伯努利试验是只有两种可能结果的随机试验，这两种结果可记为“成功”和“失败”。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 2.1.3 Binomial Experiment 二项试验 "If we have an experiment in which we perform \(n\) independent Bernoulli trials and count the total number of successes, we call it a binomial experiment." 如果我们进行 \(n\) 次独立的伯努利试验并统计成功的总次数，就称其为二项试验。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 2.1.3 Binomial Formula 二项公式 "Binomial Formula: For \(n\) independent Bernoulli trials where each trial has success probability \(p\), the probability of \(k\) successes is given by \(P(k)={n \choose k}p^k(1-p)^{n-k}.\)" 二项公式：对于 \(n\) 次独立的伯努利试验，每次试验的成功概率为 \(p\)，则 \(k\) 次成功的概率为 \(P(k)={n \choose k}p^k(1-p)^{n-k}.\) Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 2.1.3 Multinomial Coefficients 多项式系数 "The number of ways in this case is given by the multinomial coefficients. It is called the law of the unconscious statistician (LOTUS)." 但还有另一种通常更简便的方法，称为无意识统计学家法则（LOTUS）。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 3.2.3 3.2.4 Variance 方差 (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 3.2.4 Variance 方差 "The variance of a random variable \(X\), with mean \(EX=\mu_X\), is defined as \(\textrm{Var}(X)=E\big[ (X-\mu_X)^2\big].\)" 均值为 \(EX=\mu_X\) 的随机变量 \(X\) 的方差定义为 \(\textrm{Var}(X)=E\big[ (X-\mu_X)^2\big].\) Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 3.2.4 Standard Deviation 标准差 "To solve this issue, we define another measure, called the standard deviation, usually shown as \(\sigma_X\), which is simply the square root of variance." 为解决这一问题，我们定义另一个度量，称为标准差，通常记作 \(\sigma_X\)，它就是方差的平方根。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 3.2.4 Variance 方差 "For a single variate X having a distribution P(x) with known population mean μ, the population variance var(X), commonly also written σ2, is defined as σ2 = ⟨(X − μ)2⟩." 对于一个分布为 P(x)、总体均值 μ 已知的单个变量 X，其总体方差 var(X)（通常也写作 σ2）定义为 σ2 = ⟨(X − μ)2⟩。 Weisstein, n.d.-d, "Variance" entry, para. 1 3.2.5 Solved Problems 例题详解 (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 3.2.5 References Pishro-Nik, H. math/cs2023/probability/introduction-to-.summary: 10.1 Basic Concepts Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 10.1 Basic Concepts 基本概念 (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 10.1 10.1.0 Basic Concepts 基本概念 (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 10.1.0 Random Process 随机过程 "A random process is a collection of random variables usually indexed by time." 随机过程是通常以时间为指标的随机变量集合。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 10.1.0 Random Process 随机过程 "When we consider the values of \(S(t)\) for \(t \in [0,\infty)\) collectively, we say \(S(t)\) is a random process or a stochastic process." 当我们把 \(S(t)\) 在 \(t \in [0,\infty)\) 上的取值作为一个整体来考虑时，我们说 \(S(t)\) 是随机过程（又称 stochastic process）。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 10.1.0 Continuous-Time Random Process 连续时间随机过程 "In general, when we have a random process \(X(t)\) where \(t\) can take real values in an interval on the real line, then \(X(t)\) is a continuous-time random process." 一般地，若随机过程 \(X(t)\) 中的 \(t\) 可取实直线上某个区间内的实数值，则 \(X(t)\) 是连续时间随机过程。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 10.1.0 Discrete-Time Random Process 离散时间随机过程 "On the other hand, you can have a discrete-time random process." 另一方面，也可以有离散时间随机过程。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 10.1.0 Random Sequence 随机序列 "Therefore, a discrete-time random process is just a sequence of random variables. For this reason, discrete-time random processes are sometimes referred to as random sequences." 因此，离散时间随机过程就是一个随机变量序列。正因为如此，离散时间随机过程有时也称为随机序列。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 10.1.0 Sample Function 样本函数 "We call each of these possible functions of \(X(t)\) a sample function or sample path. It is also called a realization of \(X(t)\)." 我们把 \(X(t)\) 的每一个这样的可能函数称为样本函数或样本路径。它也称为 \(X(t)\) 的一次实现。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 10.1.0 10.1.1 PDFs and CDFs 概率密度函数与累积分布函数 (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 10.1.1 10.1.2 Mean and Correlation Functions 均值函数与相关函数 (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 10.1.2 Mean Function of a Random Process 随机过程的均值函数 "For a random process \(\big\{X(t), t \in J \big\}\), the mean function \(\mu_X(t):J \rightarrow \mathbb{R}\), is defined as \(\begin{align} \mu_X(t)=E[X(t)] \end{align}\)" 对于随机过程 \(\big\{X(t), t \in J \big\}\)，其均值函数 \(\mu_X(t):J \rightarrow \mathbb{R}\) 定义为 \(\begin{align} \mu_X(t)=E[X(t)] \end{align}\) Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 10.1.2 Autocovariance Function 自协方差函数 "For a random process \(\big\{X(t), t \in J \big\}\), the autocovariance function or, simply, the covariance function, \(C_X(t_1,t_2)\), is defined by \(\begin{align} C_X(t_1,t_2)&=\textrm{Cov}\big(X(t_1),X(t_2)\big)\\ &=R_X(t_1,t_2)-\mu_X(t_1) \mu_X(t_2), \quad \textrm{for }t_1,t_2 \in J. \end{align}\)" 对于随机过程 \(\big\{X(t), t \in J \big\}\)，自协方差函数或简称协方差函数 \(C_X(t_1,t_2)\) 定义为 \(\begin{align} C_X(t_1,t_2)&=\textrm{Cov}\big(X(t_1),X(t_2)\big)\\ &=R_X(t_1,t_2)-\mu_X(t_1) \mu_X(t_2), \quad \textrm{for }t_1,t_2 \in J. \end{align}\) Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 10.1.2 10.1.3 Multiple Random Processes 多个随机过程 (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 10.1.3 Cross-Correlation Function 互相关函数 "the cross-correlation function \(R_{XY}(t_1,t_2)\), is defined by" 互相关函数 \(R_{XY}(t_1,t_2)\) 定义为 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 10.1.3 Cross-Correlation Function 互相关函数 "For two random processes \(\big\{X(t), t \in J \big\}\) and \(\big\{Y(t), t \in J \big\}\): \(-\) the cross-correlation function \(R_{XY}(t_1,t_2)\), is defined by \(\begin{align} R_{XY}(t_1,t_2)=E[X(t_1)Y(t_2)], \quad \textrm{for }t_1,t_2 \in J; \end{align}\)" 对于两个随机过程 \(\big\{X(t), t \in J \big\}\) 和 \(\big\{Y(t), t \in J \big\}\)：\(-\) 互相关函数 \(R_{XY}(t_1,t_2)\) 定义为 \(\begin{align} R_{XY}(t_1,t_2)=E[X(t_1)Y(t_2)], \quad \textrm{for }t_1,t_2 \in J; \end{align}\) Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 10.1.3 Cross-Covariance Function 互协方差函数 "the cross-covariance function \(C_{XY}(t_1,t_2)\), is defined by \(\begin{align} C_{XY}(t_1,t_2)&=\textrm{Cov}\big(X(t_1),Y(t_2)\big)\\ &=R_{XY}(t_1,t_2)-\mu_X(t_1) \mu_Y(t_2), \quad \textrm{for }t_1,t_2 \in J. \end{align}\)" 互协方差函数 \(C_{XY}(t_1,t_2)\) 定义为 \(\begin{align} C_{XY}(t_1,t_2)&=\textrm{Cov}\big(X(t_1),Y(t_2)\big)\\ &=R_{XY}(t_1,t_2)-\mu_X(t_1) \mu_Y(t_2), \quad \textrm{for }t_1,t_2 \in J. \end{align}\) Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 10.1.3 10.1.4 Stationary Processes 平稳过程 (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 10.1.4 Strict-Sense Stationary Process 严平稳过程 "A continuous-time random process \(\big\{X(t), t \in \mathbb{R}\big\}\) is strict-sense stationary or simply stationary if, for all \(t_1,t_2,\cdots, t_r \in \mathbb{R}\) and all \(\Delta \in \mathbb{R}\), the joint CDF of" 连续时间随机过程 \(\big\{X(t), t \in \mathbb{R}\big\}\) 称为严平稳或简称平稳的，若对所有 \(t_1,t_2,\cdots, t_r \in \mathbb{R}\) 和所有 \(\Delta \in \mathbb{R}\)，其联合累积分布函数 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 10.1.4 Wide-Sense Cyclostationary Process 广义循环平稳过程 "A continuous-time random process \(\big\{X(t), t \in \mathbb{R}\big\}\) is weak-sense cyclostationary or wide-sense cyclostationary if there exists a positive real number \(T\) such that \(\mu_X(t+T)=\mu_X(t)\), for all \(t\in \mathbb{R}\); \(R_X(t_1+T,t_2+T)=R_X(t_1,t_2)\), for all \(t_1,t_2 \in \mathbb{R}\)." 连续时间随机过程 \(\big\{X(t), t \in \mathbb{R}\big\}\) 称为弱循环平稳或广义循环平稳，如果存在正实数 \(T\)，使得 \(\mu_X(t+T)=\mu_X(t)\)，对所有 \(t\in \mathbb{R}\) 成立；\(R_X(t_1+T,t_2+T)=R_X(t_1,t_2)\)，对所有 \(t_1,t_2 \in \mathbb{R}\) 成立。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 10.1.4 Stationary Process 平稳过程 "Intuitively, a random process \(\big\{X(t), t \in J \big\}\) is stationary if its statistical properties do not change by time." 直观地说，若随机过程 \(\big\{X(t), t \in J \big\}\) 的统计性质不随时间改变，则它是平稳的。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 10.1.4 Weak-Sense Stationary Process 弱平稳过程（宽平稳过程） "A random process is called weak-sense stationary or wide-sense stationary (WSS) if its mean function and its correlation function do not change by shifts in time." 若一个随机过程的均值函数和相关函数不随时间平移而改变，则称其为弱平稳或宽平稳（WSS）过程。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 10.1.4 Expected (Average) Power 期望（平均）功率 "The quantity \(E[X(t)^2]\) is called the expected (average) power in \(X(t)\) at time \(t\)." 量 \(E[X(t)^2]\) 称为 \(X(t)\) 在时刻 \(t\) 的期望（平均）功率。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 10.1.4 Cyclostationary Process 循环平稳过程 "In other words, the random variables \(\begin{align} X(t_1), X(t_2), \cdots, X(t_r) \end{align}\) have the same joint CDF as the random variables \(\begin{align} X(t_1+T), X(t_2+T), \cdots, X(t_r+T). \end{align}\) Such random variables are called cyclostationary." 换言之，随机变量 \(\begin{align} X(t_1), X(t_2), \cdots, X(t_r) \end{align}\) 与随机变量 \(\begin{align} X(t_1+T), X(t_2+T), \cdots, X(t_r+T). \end{align}\) 具有相同的联合 CDF。这样的随机变量称为循环平稳的。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 10.1.4 Mean-Square Continuity 均方连续 "Let \(X(t)\) be a continuous-time random process.
