math/cs2023/probability/some-important-r.summary: 11.1 Poisson Processes Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 11.1 Poisson Processes 泊松过程 (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 11.1 11.1.0 Introduction 介绍 (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 11.1.0 11.1.1 Counting Processes 计数过程 (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 11.1.1 Counting Process 计数过程 "A random process \(\{N(t), t \in [0,\infty) \}\) is said to be a counting process if \(N(t)\) is the number of events occurred from time \(0\) up to and including time \(t\)." 若 \(N(t)\) 表示从时刻 \(0\) 起至（含）时刻 \(t\) 为止发生的事件数，则称随机过程 \(\{N(t), t \in [0,\infty) \}\) 为计数过程。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 11.1.1 Stationary Increments 平稳增量 "A counting process has stationary increments if, for all \(t_2>t_1\geq0\), \(N(t_2)-N(t_1)\) has the same distribution as \(N(t_2-t_1)\)." 若对所有 \(t_2>t_1\geq0\)，\(N(t_2)-N(t_1)\) 与 \(N(t_2-t_1)\) 具有相同的分布，则称计数过程具有平稳增量。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 11.1.1 Independent Increments 独立增量 "We say that \(X(t)\) has independent increments if, for all \(0 \leq t_1 \lt t_2 \lt t_3 \cdots \lt t_n\), the random variables \(\begin{align*} X(t_2)-X(t_1), \; X(t_3)-X(t_2), \; \cdots, \; X(t_n)-X(t_{n-1}) \end{align*}\) are independent." 若对所有 \(0 \leq t_1 \lt t_2 \lt t_3 \cdots \lt t_n\)，随机变量 \(\begin{align*} X(t_2)-X(t_1), \; X(t_3)-X(t_2), \; \cdots, \; X(t_n)-X(t_{n-1}) \end{align*}\) 相互独立，则称 \(X(t)\) 具有独立增量。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 11.1.1 11.1.2 Basic Concepts of the Poisson Process 泊松过程的基本概念 (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 11.1.2 Poisson Process 泊松过程 "Let \(\lambda>0\) be fixed. The counting process \(\{N(t), t \in [0, \infty)\}\) is called a Poisson process with rate s \(\lambda\) if all the following conditions hold: \(N(0)=0\); \(N(t)\) has independent increments; the number of arrivals in any interval of length \(\tau>0\) has \(Poisson(\lambda \tau)\) distribution." 设 \(\lambda>0\) 为定值。若计数过程 \(\{N(t), t \in [0, \infty)\}\) 满足以下全部条件，则称其为速率为 \(\lambda\) 的泊松过程：\(N(0)=0\)；\(N(t)\) 具有独立增量；任意长度为 \(\tau>0\) 的区间内的到达数服从 \(Poisson(\lambda \tau)\) 分布。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 11.1.2 Poisson Process (Second Definition) 泊松过程（第二定义） "Let \(\lambda>0\) be fixed. The counting process \(\{N(t), t \in [0, \infty)\}\) is called a Poisson process with rate \(\lambda\) if all the following conditions hold: \(N(0)=0\); \(N(t)\) has independent and stationary increments we have \(\begin{align*} &P(N(\Delta)=0) =1-\lambda \Delta+ o(\Delta),\\ &P(N(\Delta)=1)=\lambda \Delta+o(\Delta),\\ &P(N(\Delta) \geq 2)=o(\Delta). \end{align*}\)" 设 \(\lambda>0\) 为定值。若计数过程 \(\{N(t), t \in [0, \infty)\}\) 满足以下全部条件，则称其为速率为 \(\lambda\) 的泊松过程：\(N(0)=0\)；\(N(t)\) 具有独立且平稳的增量，我们有 \(\begin{align*} &P(N(\Delta)=0) =1-\lambda \Delta+ o(\Delta),\\ &P(N(\Delta)=1)=\lambda \Delta+o(\Delta),\\ &P(N(\Delta) \geq 2)=o(\Delta). \end{align*}\) Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 11.1.2 Interarrival Times 到达间隔时间 "If \(N(t)\) is a Poisson process with rate \(\lambda\), then the interarrival times \(X_1\), \(X_2\), \(\cdots\) are independent and \(\begin{align*} X_i \sim Exponential(\lambda), \; \textrm{ for }i=1,2,3, \cdots. \end{align*}\)" 若 \(N(t)\) 是速率为 \(\lambda\) 的泊松过程，则到达间隔时间 \(X_1\)，\(X_2\)，\(\cdots\) 相互独立，且 \(\begin{align*} X_i \sim Exponential(\lambda), \; \textrm{ for }i=1,2,3, \cdots. \end{align*}\) Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 11.1.2 Arrival Times 到达时间 "If \(N(t)\) is a Poisson process with rate \(\lambda\), then the arrival times \(T_1\), \(T_2\), \(\cdots\) have \(Gamma(n, \lambda)\) distribution. In particular, for \(n=1,2,3,\cdots\), we have \(\begin{align*} E[T_n]=\frac{n}{\lambda}, \; \textrm{and} \; \textrm{Var}(T_n)=\frac{n}{\lambda^2}. \end{align*}\)" 若 \(N(t)\) 是速率为 \(\lambda\) 的泊松过程，则到达时间 \(T_1\)，\(T_2\)，\(\cdots\) 服从 \(Gamma(n, \lambda)\) 分布。特别地，对 \(n=1,2,3,\cdots\)，有 \(\begin{align*} E[T_n]=\frac{n}{\lambda}, \; \textrm{and} \; \textrm{Var}(T_n)=\frac{n}{\lambda^2}. \end{align*}\) Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 11.1.2 Poisson Random Variable 泊松随机变量 "Remember that a discrete random variable \(X\) is said to be a Poisson random variable with parameter \(\mu\), shown as \(X \sim Poisson(\mu)\), if its range is \(R_X=\{0,1,2,3,...\}\), and its PMF is given by \(\begin{equation} \nonumber P_X(k) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \frac{e^{-\mu} \mu^k}{k!}& \quad \text{for } k \in R_X\\ 0 & \quad \text{ otherwise} \end{array} \right. \end{equation}\)" 若离散型随机变量 \(X\) 的取值范围为 \(R_X=\{0,1,2,3,...\}\)，且其 PMF 为 \(\begin{equation} \nonumber P_X(k) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \frac{e^{-\mu} \mu^k}{k!}& \quad \text{for } k \in R_X\\ 0 & \quad \text{ otherwise} \end{array} \right. \end{equation}\)，则称 \(X\) 为参数为 \(\mu\) 的泊松随机变量，记作 \(X \sim Poisson(\mu)\)。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 11.1.2 Erlang Distribution 爱尔朗分布 "The \(Gamma(n, \lambda)\) is also called Erlang distribution, i.e, we can write \(\begin{align*} T_n \sim Erlang(n,\lambda)=Gamma(n, \lambda), \; \textrm{ for }n=1,2,3, \cdots. \end{align*}\)" \(Gamma(n, \lambda)\) 也称为爱尔朗分布，即我们可以写成 \(\begin{align*} T_n \sim Erlang(n,\lambda)=Gamma(n, \lambda), \; \textrm{ for }n=1,2,3, \cdots. \end{align*}\) Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 11.1.2 11.1.3 Merging and Splitting Poisson Processes 泊松过程的合并与分解 (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 11.1.3 Merging Independent Poisson Processes 独立泊松过程的合并 "Let also \(\begin{align*} N(t)=N_1(t)+N_2(t)+\cdots+N_m(t), \quad \textrm{for all } t \in [0, \infty). \end{align*}\) Then, \(N(t)\) is a Poisson process with rate \(\lambda_1+\lambda_2+\cdots+\lambda_m\)." 再令 \(\begin{align*} N(t)=N_1(t)+N_2(t)+\cdots+N_m(t), \quad \textrm{for all } t \in [0, \infty). \end{align*}\) 则 \(N(t)\) 是速率为 \(\lambda_1+\lambda_2+\cdots+\lambda_m\) 的泊松过程。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 11.1.3 Splitting a Poisson Process 泊松过程的分流 "For each arrival, a coin with \(P(H)=p\) is tossed. If the coin lands heads up, the arrival is sent to the first process (\(N_1(t)\)), otherwise it is sent to the second process." 对每一次到达，抛一枚满足 \(P(H)=p\) 的硬币。若硬币正面朝上，则该到达被送入第一个过程（\(N_1(t)\)），否则被送入第二个过程。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 11.1.3 11.1.4 Nonhomogeneous Poisson Processes 非齐次泊松过程 (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 11.1.4 Nonhomogeneous Poisson Process 非齐次泊松过程 "Let \(\lambda(t):[0,\infty) \mapsto [0,\infty)\) be an integrable function. The counting process \(\{N(t), t \in [0, \infty)\}\) is called a nonhomogeneous Poisson process with rate \(\lambda(t)\) if all the following conditions hold." 设 \(\lambda(t):[0,\infty) \mapsto [0,\infty)\) 为可积函数。若计数过程 \(\{N(t), t \in [0, \infty)\}\) 满足下列全部条件，则称其为速率为 \(\lambda(t)\) 的非齐次泊松过程。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 11.1.4 11.1.5 Solved Problems 例题详解 (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 11.1.5 References Pishro-Nik, H. (2014). Introduction to probability, statistics, and random processes. Kappa Research. Retrieved October 28, 2026, from https://www.probabilitycourse.com/

math/cs2023/probability/some-important-r.summary: 11.2 Discrete-Time Markov Chains Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 11.2 Discrete-Time Markov Chains 离散时间马尔可夫链 (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 11.2 11.2.1 Introduction 介绍 (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 11.2.1 Markov Chain 马尔可夫链 "We say that this process is a Markov chain if \(\begin{align*} &P(X_{m+1}=j \vert X_{m}=i, X_{m-1}=i_{m-1}, \cdots, X_{0}=i_{0})\\ &\hspace{80pt}= P(X_{m+1}=j \vert X_{m}=i), \end{align*}\) for all \(m, j, i, i_0, i_1, \cdots i_{m-1}\)." 若 \(\begin{align*} &P(X_{m+1}=j \vert X_{m}=i, X_{m-1}=i_{m-1}, \cdots, X_{0}=i_{0})\\ &\hspace{80pt}= P(X_{m+1}=j \vert X_{m}=i), \end{align*}\) 对所有 \(m, j, i, i_0, i_1, \cdots i_{m-1}\) 成立，则称该过程为马尔可夫链。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 11.2.1 Transition Probabilities 转移概率 "The numbers \(P(X_{m+1}=j \vert X_{m}=i)\) are called the transition probabilities." 数 \(P(X_{m+1}=j \vert X_{m}=i)\) 称为转移概率。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 11.2.1 11.2.2 State Transition Matrix and Diagram 状态转移矩阵与状态转移图 (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 11.2.2 State Transition Matrix 状态转移矩阵 "We often list the transition probabilities in a matrix. The matrix is called the state transition matrix or transition probability matrix and is usually shown by \(P\)." 我们常把转移概率列成一个矩阵。该矩阵称为状态转移矩阵或转移概率矩阵，通常记为 \(P\)。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 11.2.2 State Transition Diagram 状态转移图 "A Markov chain is usually shown by a state transition diagram." 马尔可夫链通常用状态转移图表示。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 11.2.2 11.2.3 Probability Distributions 概率分布 (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 11.2.3 Chapman-Kolmogorov Equation 查普曼-柯尔莫哥洛夫方程 "To obtain \(p^{(m+n)}_{ij}\), we sum over all possible intermediate states: \(\begin{align*} p^{(m+n)}_{ij}&=P(X_{m+n}=j \vert X_0=i)\\ &=\sum_{k \in S} p^{(m)}_{ik}p^{(n)}_{kj}. \end{align*}\) The above equation is called the Chapman-Kolmogorov equation." 为得到 \(p^{(m+n)}_{ij}\)，我们对所有可能的中间状态求和：\(\begin{align*} p^{(m+n)}_{ij}&=P(X_{m+n}=j \vert X_0=i)\\ &=\sum_{k \in S} p^{(m)}_{ik}p^{(n)}_{kj}. \end{align*}\) 上述方程称为查普曼-柯尔莫哥洛夫方程。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 11.2.3 11.2.4 Classification of States 状态的分类 (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 11.2.4 Accessible State 可达状态 "We say that state \(j\) is accessible from state \(i\), written as \(i \rightarrow j\), if \(p^{(n)}_{ij}>0\) for some \(n\)." 若对某个 \(n\) 有 \(p^{(n)}_{ij}>0\)，则称状态 \(j\) 从状态 \(i\) 可达，记作 \(i \rightarrow j\)。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 11.2.4 11.2.5 Using the Law of Total Probability with Recursion 结合递推使用全概率公式 (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 11.2.5 Absorption Probabilities 吸收概率 "Let \(l\in S\) be an absorbing state. Define \(\begin{align*} a_i&=P(\textrm{absorption in }l \vert X_0=i), \quad \textrm{ for all }i \in S. \end{align*}\)" 设 \(l\in S\) 为一个吸收态。定义 \(\begin{align*} a_i&=P(\textrm{absorption in }l \vert X_0=i), \quad \textrm{ for all }i \in S. \end{align*}\) Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 11.2.5 Mean Hitting Times 平均击中时间 "Let \(T\) be the first time the chain visits a state in \(A\). For all \(i \in S\), define \(\begin{align*} t_i&=E[T \vert X_0=i]. \end{align*}\)" 设 \(T\) 为链访问 \(A\) 中某一状态的首次时间。对所有 \(i \in S\)，定义 \(\begin{align*} t_i&=E[T \vert X_0=i]. \end{align*}\) Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 11.2.5 Mean Return Times 平均返回时间 "Let \(r_l\) be the mean return time to state \(l\)." 设 \(r_l\) 为状态 \(l\) 的平均返回时间。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 11.2.5 Absorbing State 吸收态 "Note that states \(0\) and \(3\) have the following property: once you enter those states, you never leave them. For this reason, we call them absorbing states." 注意状态 \(0\) 和 \(3\) 具有如下性质：一旦进入这些状态，就永远不会离开。因此我们称它们为吸收态。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 11.2.5 11.2.6 Stationary and Limiting Distributions 平稳分布与极限分布 (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 11.2.6 Limiting Distribution 极限分布 "The probability distribution \(\pi=[\pi_0, \pi_1, \pi_2, \cdots ]\) is called the limiting distribution of the Markov chain \(X_n\) if \(\begin{align*} \pi_j=\lim_{n \rightarrow \infty} P(X_n=j \vert X_0=i) \end{align*}\) for all \(i, j \in S\), and we have \(\begin{align*} \sum_{j \in S} \pi_j=1. \end{align*}\)" 若 \(\begin{align*} \pi_j=\lim_{n \rightarrow \infty} P(X_n=j \vert X_0=i) \end{align*}\) 对所有 \(i, j \in S\) 成立，且有 \(\begin{align*} \sum_{j \in S} \pi_j=1. \end{align*}\)，则称概率分布 \(\pi=[\pi_0, \pi_1, \pi_2, \cdots ]\) 为马尔可夫链 \(X_n\) 的极限分布。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 11.2.6 Limiting Distribution of a Finite Markov Chain 有限马尔可夫链的极限分布 "The unique solution to the above equations is the limiting distribution of the Markov chain, i.e.," 上述方程的唯一解即为该马尔可夫链的极限分布，即 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 11.2.6 11.2.7 Solved Problems 例题详解 (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 11.2.7 References Pishro-Nik, H. math/cs2023/probability/some-important-r.summary: 11.4 Brownian Motion (Wiener Process) Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 11.4 Brownian Motion (Wiener Process) 布朗运动（维纳过程） (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 11.4 11.4.0 Brownian Motion (Wiener Process) 布朗运动（维纳过程） (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 11.4.0 11.4.1 Brownian Motion as the Limit of a Symmetric Random Walk 布朗运动作为对称随机游走的极限 (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 11.4.1 11.4.2 Definition and Some Properties 定义与一些性质 (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 11.4.2 Standard Brownian Motion 标准布朗运动 "A Gaussian random process \(\{W(t), t \in [0, \infty) \}\) is called a (standard) Brownian motion or a (standard) Wiener process if W(0)=0; for all \(0 \leq t_1 \lt t_2\), \(W(t_2)-W(t_1) \sim N(0, t_2-t_1)\); W(t) has independent increments. That is, for all \(0 \leq t_1 \lt t_2 \lt t_3 \cdots \lt t_n\), the random variables \(\begin{align*} W(t_2)-W(t_1), \; W(t_3)-W(t_2), \; \cdots, \; W(t_n)-W(t_{n-1}) \end{align*}\) are independent; W(t) has continuous sample paths." 若高斯随机过程 \(\{W(t), t \in [0, \infty) \}\) 满足 W(0)=0；对所有 \(0 \leq t_1 \lt t_2\) 有 \(W(t_2)-W(t_1) \sim N(0, t_2-t_1)\)；W(t) 具有独立增量，即对所有 \(0 \leq t_1 \lt t_2 \lt t_3 \cdots \lt t_n\)，随机变量 \(\begin{align*} W(t_2)-W(t_1), \; W(t_3)-W(t_2), \; \cdots, \; W(t_n)-W(t_{n-1}) \end{align*}\) 相互独立；W(t) 具有连续样本路径，则称其为（标准）布朗运动或（标准）维纳过程。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 11.4.2 11.4.3 Solved Problems 例题详解 (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 11.4.3 References Pishro-Nik, H. (2014). Introduction to probability, statistics, and random processes. Kappa Research. Retrieved October 28, 2026, from https://www.probabilitycourse.com/

That is, \(\theta\) is a deterministic (non-random) quantity that is to be estimated by the observed data." 在这种方法中，未知量 \(\theta\) 被假定为固定量。也就是说，\(\theta\) 是一个确定性的（非随机的）量，需要由观测数据来估计。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 8.1.0 Bayesian Inference 贝叶斯推断 "In the Bayesian approach the unknown quantity \(\Theta\) is assumed to be a random variable, and we assume that we have some initial guess about the distribution of \(\Theta\). After observing the data, we update the distribution of \(\Theta\) using Bayes' Rule." 在贝叶斯方法中，未知量 \(\Theta\) 被假定为随机变量，并假定我们对 \(\Theta\) 的分布有某种初始猜测。观测到数据后，我们利用贝叶斯法则更新 \(\Theta\) 的分布。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 8.1.0 Statistics (as a subject) 统计（作为学科） "The mathematical study of the likelihood and probability of events occurring based on known information and inferred by taking a limited number of samples." 对事件发生的可能性和概率所作的数学研究，依据已知信息，并通过抽取有限数量的样本来推断。 Weisstein, n.d., "Statistics" entry, para. 1 8.1.1 Random Sampling 随机抽样 (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 8.1.1 Random Sample 随机样本 "The collection of random variables \(X_1\), \(X_2\), \(X_3\), \(...\), \(X_n\) is said to be a random sample of size \(n\) if they are independent and identically distributed (i.i.d.)," 若随机变量集合 \(X_1\), \(X_2\), \(X_3\), \(...\), \(X_n\) 独立同分布（i.i.d.），则称其为容量为 \(n\) 的随机样本， Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 8.1.1 Point Estimator 点估计量 "In general, a point estimator is a function of the random sample \(\hat{\Theta}=h(X_1,X_2,\cdots,X_n)\) that is used to estimate an unknown quantity." 一般地，点估计量是随机样本的函数 \(\hat{\Theta}=h(X_1,X_2,\cdots,X_n)\)，用来估计未知量。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 8.1.1 Estimate 估计值 "Here, \(\hat{\theta}\) is called an estimate of the average height in the population." 这里 \(\hat{\theta}\) 称为总体平均身高的估计值。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 8.1.1 Order Statistics 顺序统计量 "Thus, we often order the observed data from the smallest to the largest. We call the resulting ordered random variables order statistics." 因此，我们常把观测数据从小到大排序。我们把得到的有序随机变量称为顺序统计量。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 8.1.1 References Pishro-Nik, H. (2014). 8.4 8.4.1 Introduction 介绍 (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 8.4.1 8.4.2 General Setting and Definitions 一般设定与定义 (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 8.4.2 Statistic 统计量 "A statistic is a real-valued function of the data." 统计量是数据的实值函数。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 8.4.2 Statistic 统计量 "A statistic is a real-valued function of the data." 统计量是数据的实值函数。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 8.4.2 Alternative Hypothesis 备择假设 "\(H_0\) (the null hypothesis): \(\theta \in S_0\). \(\quad\) \(H_1\) (the alternative hypothesis): \(\theta \in S_1\)." \(H_0\)（原假设）：\(\theta \in S_0\)。\(\quad\) \(H_1\)（备择假设）：\(\theta \in S_1\)。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 8.4.2 Simple Hypothesis 简单假设 "Here, \(H_0\) is an example of a simple hypothesis because \(S_0\) contains only one value of \(\theta\)." 这里，\(H_0\) 是简单假设的一个例子，因为 \(S_0\) 只包含 \(\theta\) 的一个值。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 8.4.2 Composite Hypothesis 复合假设 "On the other hand, \(H_1\) is an example of composite hypothesis since \(S_1\) contains more than one element." 另一方面，\(H_1\) 是复合假设的一个例子，因为 \(S_1\) 包含不止一个元素。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 8.4.2 Acceptance Region 接受域 "The set \(A\) is called the acceptance region, while the set \(R=\mathbb{R}-A\) is said to be the rejection region." 集合 \(A\) 称为接受域，而集合 \(R=\mathbb{R}-A\) 称为拒绝域。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 8.4.2 Rejection Region 拒绝域 "The set \(A\) is called the acceptance region, while the set \(R=\mathbb{R}-A\) is said to be the rejection region." 集合 \(A\) 称为接受域，而集合 \(R=\mathbb{R}-A\) 称为拒绝域。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 8.4.2 Hypothesis 假设 "A hypothesis is a statement such as \(\theta=1\), \(\theta>1.3\), \(\theta \neq 0.5\), etc. In hypothesis testing problems, we need to decide between two contradictory hypotheses." 假设是形如 \(\theta=1\)、\(\theta>1.3\)、\(\theta \neq 0.5\) 等的陈述。在假设检验问题中，我们需要在两个相互矛盾的假设之间做出决定。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 8.4.2 Significance Level 显著性水平 "then we say the test has significance level \(\alpha\) or simply the test is a level \(\alpha\) test." 则称该检验的显著性水平为 \(\alpha\)，或简称该检验是水平 \(\alpha\) 检验。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 8.4.2 Type II Error 第二类错误 "The second possible error that we can make is to accept \(H_0\) when \(H_0\) is false. This is called the type II error." 我们可能犯的第二种错误是在 \(H_0\) 为假时接受 \(H_0\)。这称为第二类错误。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 8.4.2 Trade-off Between Type I and Type II Error 第一类与第二类错误的权衡 "However, there is in fact a trade-off between \(\alpha\) and \(\beta\). That is, if we want to decrease the probability of type I error (\(\alpha\)), then the probability of type II error (\(\beta\)) increases, and vise versa." 然而，\(\alpha\) 与 \(\beta\) 之间实际上存在权衡。也就是说，如果我们想减小第一类错误的概率（\(\alpha\)），则第二类错误的概率（\(\beta\)）会增大，反之亦然。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 8.4.2 8.4.3 Hypothesis Testing for the Mean 均值的假设检验 (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 8.4.3 8.4.4 P-Values P值 (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 8.4.4 P-Value P 值 "P-value is the lowest significance level \(\alpha\) that results in rejecting the null hypothesis." P 值是导致拒绝原假设的最低显著性水平 \(\alpha\)。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 8.4.4 P-Value P值 "The \(P\)-value is \(P(\textrm{type I error})\) when the test threshold \(c\) is chosen to be \(c=w_1\)." 当检验阈值 \(c\) 取为 \(c=w_1\) 时，\(P\) 值就是 \(P(\textrm{type I error})\)。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 8.4.4 8.4.5 Likelihood Ratio Tests 似然比检验 (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 8.4.5 Likelihood Ratio Test 似然比检验 "To perform a likelihood ratio test (LRT), we choose a constant \(c\). We reject \(H_0\) if \(\lambda \lt c\) and accept it if \(\lambda \geq c\)." 为进行似然比检验（LRT），我们选取一个常数 \(c\)。若 \(\lambda \lt c\) 则拒绝 \(H_0\)，若 \(\lambda \geq c\) 则接受 \(H_0\)。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 8.4.5 8.4.6 Solved Problems 例题详解 (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 8.4.6 References Pishro-Nik, H. (2014). Introduction to probability, statistics, and random processes. Kappa Research. Retrieved October 28, 2026, from https://www.probabilitycourse.com/

math/cs2023/probability/statistical-infe.summary: 9.1 Bayesian Inference Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 9.1 Bayesian Inference 贝叶斯推断 (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 9.1 9.1.0 Bayesian Inference 贝叶斯推断 (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 9.1.0 Bayesian Statistical Inference 贝叶斯统计推断 "The posterior distribution is usually found using Bayes' formula. Using the posterior distribution, we can then find point or interval estimates of \(X\)." 后验分布通常用贝叶斯公式求得。利用后验分布，我们就可以求出 \(X\) 的点估计或区间估计。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 9.1.0 Frequentist Approach 频率学派方法 "In the previous chapter, we discussed the frequentist approach to this problem. In that approach, the unknown quantity \(\theta\) is assumed to be a fixed (non-random) quantity that is to be estimated by the observed data." 在上一章中，我们讨论了解决这一问题的频率学派方法。在该方法中，未知量 \(\theta\) 被假定为一个固定的（非随机的）量，由观测数据对其进行估计。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 9.1.0 Bayesian Approach 贝叶斯方法 "In the Bayesian framework, we treat the unknown quantity, \(\Theta\), as a random variable. More specifically, we assume that we have some initial guess about the distribution of \(\Theta\)." 在贝叶斯框架中，我们把未知量 \(\Theta\) 视为一个随机变量。更具体地说，我们假定对 \(\Theta\) 的分布有某种初始猜测。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 9.1.0 9.1.1 Prior and Posterior 先验与后验 (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 9.1.1 9.1.2 Maximum A Posteriori (MAP) Estimation 最大后验（MAP）估计 (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 9.1.2 Maximum A Posteriori (MAP) Estimation 最大后验概率估计 "The MAP estimate of the random variable \(X\), given that we have observed \(Y=y\), is given by the value of \(x\) that maximizes" 在已观测到 \(Y=y\) 的条件下，随机变量 \(X\) 的MAP 估计由使下式最大化的 \(x\) 值给出 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 9.1.2 Maximum A Posteriori (MAP) Estimation 最大后验估计 "To find the MAP estimate of \(X\) given that we have observed \(Y=y\), we find the value of \(x\) that maximizes" 要在已观测到 \(Y=y\) 的条件下求 \(X\) 的 MAP 估计，需找到使下式最大的 \(x\) 值 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 9.1.2 9.1.3 Comparison to ML Estimation 与最大似然估计的比较 (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 9.1.3 9.1.4 Conditional Expectation (MMSE) 条件期望（MMSE） (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 9.1.4 Minimum Mean Squared Error (MMSE) Estimation 最小均方误差估计 "The minimum mean squared error (MMSE) estimate of the random variable \(X\), given that we have observed \(Y=y\), is given by \(\begin{align} \hat{x}_{M}=E[X\vert Y=y]. \end{align}\)" 在已观测到 \(Y=y\) 的条件下，随机变量 \(X\) 的最小均方误差（MMSE）估计为 \(\begin{align} \hat{x}_{M}=E[X\vert Y=y]. \end{align}\) Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 9.1.4 9.1.5 Mean Squared Error (MSE) 均方误差（MSE） (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 9.1.5 Mean Squared Error (MSE) of an Estimator 估计量的均方误差 "Let \(\hat{X}=g(Y)\) be an estimator of the random variable \(X\), given that we have observed the random variable \(Y\). The mean squared error (MSE) of this estimator is defined as \(\begin{align} E[(X-\hat{X})^2]=E[(X-g(Y))^2]. \end{align}\)" 设 \(\hat{X}=g(Y)\) 为在已观测到随机变量 \(Y\) 的条件下对随机变量 \(X\) 的一个估计量。该估计量的均方误差（MSE）定义为 \(\begin{align} E[(X-\hat{X})^2]=E[(X-g(Y))^2]. \end{align}\) Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 9.1.5 9.1.6 Linear MMSE Estimation of Random Variables 随机变量的线性最小均方误差估计 (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 9.1.6 Linear MMSE Estimator 线性最小均方误差估计量 "The linear MMSE estimator of the random variable \(X\), given that we have observed \(Y\), is given by \(\begin{align} \hat{X}_L&=\frac{\textrm{Cov}(X,Y)}{\textrm{Var}(Y)} (Y-EY)+ EX\\ &=\frac{\rho \sigma_X}{\sigma_Y} (Y-EY)+ EX. \end{align}\)" 在已观测到 \(Y\) 的条件下，随机变量 \(X\) 的线性 MMSE 估计量为 \(\begin{align} \hat{X}_L&=\frac{\textrm{Cov}(X,Y)}{\textrm{Var}(Y)} (Y-EY)+ EX\\ &=\frac{\rho \sigma_X}{\sigma_Y} (Y-EY)+ EX. \end{align}\) Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 9.1.6 9.1.7 Estimation for Random Vectors 随机向量的估计 (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 9.1.7 Orthogonality Principle 正交性原理 "However, it is sometimes easier to use the orthogonality principle to find \(\hat{\mathbf{X}}_L\). We now explain how to use the orthogonality principle to find linear MMSE estimators." 然而，利用正交性原理来求 \(\hat{\mathbf{X}}_L\) 有时更为简便。下面我们说明如何用正交性原理求线性 MMSE 估计量。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 9.1.7 9.1.8 Bayesian Hypothesis Testing 贝叶斯假设检验 (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 9.1.8 MAP Hypothesis Test 最大后验概率假设检验 "Choose the hypothesis with the highest posterior probability, \(P(H_i\vert Y=y)\). Equivalently, choose hypothesis \(H_i\) with the highest \(f_{Y}(y\vert H_i)P(H_i)\)." 选择具有最高后验概率 \(P(H_i\vert Y=y)\) 的假设。等价地，选择假设 \(H_i\)，使 \(f_{Y}(y\vert H_i)P(H_i)\) 最大。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 9.1.8 Minimum Cost Hypothesis Test 最小代价假设检验 "We choose \(H_0\) if and only if \(\begin{align} \frac{f_{Y}(y\vert H_0)}{f_{Y}(y\vert H_1)} \geq \frac{P(H_1)C_{01}}{P(H_0) C_{10}}. \end{align}\) Equivalently, we choose \(H_0\) if and only if \(\begin{align} P(H_0\vert y) C_{10} \geq P(H_1\vert y) C_{01}. \end{align}\)" 我们选择 \(H_0\) 当且仅当 \(\begin{align} \frac{f_{Y}(y\vert H_0)}{f_{Y}(y\vert H_1)} \geq \frac{P(H_1)C_{01}}{P(H_0) C_{10}}. \end{align}\) 等价地，我们选择 \(H_0\) 当且仅当 \(\begin{align} P(H_0\vert y) C_{10} \geq P(H_1\vert y) C_{01}. \end{align}\) Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 9.1.8 Posterior Risk 后验风险 "Note that \(P(H_0\vert y) C_{10}\) is the expected cost of accepting \(H_1\). We call this the posterior risk of accepting \(H_1\)." 注意，\(P(H_0\vert y) C_{10}\) 是接受 \(H_1\) 的期望代价。我们称之为接受 \(H_1\) 的后验风险。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 9.1.8 9.1.9 Bayesian Interval Estimation 贝叶斯区间估计 (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 9.1.9 Bayesian Credible Interval 贝叶斯可信区间 "Given the observation \(Y=y\), the interval \([a,b]\) is said to be a \((1-\alpha)100\%\) credible interval for \(X\), if the posterior probability of \(X\) being in \([a,b]\) is equal to \(1-\alpha\)." 给定观测 \(Y=y\)，若 \(X\) 落在 \([a,b]\) 内的后验概率等于 \(1-\alpha\)，则称区间 \([a,b]\) 为 \(X\) 的 \((1-\alpha)100\%\) 可信区间。 Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 9.1.9 9.1.10 Solved Problems 例题详解 (No definition) （无定义） Pishro-Nik, 2014, section 9.1.10 References Pishro-Nik, H. (2014). Introduction to probability, statistics, and random processes. Kappa Research. Retrieved October 28, 2026, from https://www.probabilitycourse.com/

Inferential statistics are computed from sample data in order to make inferences about the population." 总体是研究者所关注的全部观测的集合。与之相对，样本是总体的子集。总体可以按便于研究者的方式来定义。例如，可以把总体定义为得克萨斯州休斯敦所有四年级女生。或者，另一个不同的总体是美国所有四年级女生的集合。推断统计由样本数据计算得出，以便对总体作出推断。 Online Statistics Education, n.d., glossary Random Assignment 随机分配 "Random assignment occurs when the subjects in an experiment are randomly assigned to conditions. Random sampling means that every member of the population is equally likely to be chosen. See also: stratified random sampling." 为统计推断的目的而从总体中选取一个子集的过程。随机抽样意味着总体的每个成员被选中的可能性相等。另见：分层随机抽样。 Online Statistics Education, n.d., glossary Representative Sample 代表性样本 "A representative sample is a sample chosen to match the qualities of the population from which it is drawn. Generally, one uses a random sample. See also: bias, stratified random sample." 样本是总体的子集，常为统计推断的目的而抽取。通常使用随机样本。另见：偏倚、分层随机样本。 Online Statistics Education, n.d., glossary Stratified Random Sampling 分层随机抽样 "In stratified random sampling, the population is divided into a number of subgroups (or strata). Random samples are then taken from each subgroup with sample sizes proportional to the size of the subgroup in the population. For instance, if a population contained equal numbers of men and women, and the variable of interest is suspected to vary by gender, one might conduct stratified random sampling to insure a representative sample." 在分层随机抽样中，总体被划分为若干个子群（或层）。然后从每个子群中抽取随机样本，样本量与该子群在总体中的大小成比例。例如，如果总体中男女人数相等，并且怀疑所关注的变量因性别而异，就可以进行分层随机抽样，以确保样本具有代表性。 Online Statistics Education, n.d., glossary References Online statistics education: An interactive multimedia course of study. Occasionally, numeric values are nominal: for instance, if a variable were coded as Female = 1, Male = 2, the set {1,2} is still nominal." 名义量表是四种常用测量水平之一。它不蕴含任何顺序，对名义量表上的变量进行加减乘除是不合适的。{女性，男性}和{佛教徒，基督徒，印度教徒，穆斯林}没有自然顺序（除字母顺序外）。有时，数值也是名义的：例如，如果把变量编码为女性 = 1，男性 = 2，则集合 {1,2} 仍然是名义的。 Online Statistics Education, n.d., glossary Ordinal Scales 顺序量表 "One of four commonly used levels of measurement, an ordinal scale is a set of ordered values. However, there is no set distance between scale values. For instance, for the scale: (Very Poor, Poor, Average, Good, Very Good) is an ordinal scale. You can assign numerical values to an ordinal scale: rating performance such as 1 for "Very Poor," 2 for "Poor," etc, but there is no assurance that the difference between a score of 1 and 2 means the same thing as the difference between a score of 2 and 3." 作为四种常用测量水平之一，顺序量表是一组有序的值。然而，量表值之间没有固定的距离。例如，量表（很差，差，一般，好，很好）就是顺序量表。可以给顺序量表赋予数值：对表现评分，如“很差”为 1，“差”为 2，等等，但无法保证得分 1 与 2 之差和得分 2 与 3 之差意义相同。 Online Statistics Education, n.d., glossary Ratio Scale 定比量表 "One of the four basic levels of measurement, a ratio scale is a numerical scale with a true zero point and in which a given size interval has the same interpretation for the entire scale. See also: histogram." 分组频数分布是按数据范围而非单个值显示频数的频数分布。例如，可以通过定义一英寸的范围来计算身高的分布，然后列出身高四舍五入到最近一英寸的各类个体的频数。另见：直方图。 Online Statistics Education, n.d., glossary Leptokurtic 尖峰态 "A distribution with long tails relative to a normal distribution is leptokurtic. The sum of all densities is always 1.0 and the value of the function is always greater or equal to zero." 对于离散随机变量，概率分布包含每个可能结果的概率。然而，对于连续随机变量，任何单一结果的概率都为零（如果将其精确到足够多的小数位）。概率密度函数是可用于计算连续随机变量某一范围结果的概率的公式。所有密度之和始终为 1.0，且该函数的值始终大于或等于零。 Online Statistics Education, n.d., glossary References Online statistics education: An interactive multimedia course of study. It is typically the hypothesis that a parameter is zero or that a difference between parameters is zero. For example, the null hypothesis might be that the difference between population means is zero. Experimenters typically design experiments to allow the null hypothesis to be rejected." 零假设是在显著性检验中被检验的假设。它通常是认为某个参数为零或参数之间的差为零的假设。例如，零假设可能是总体均值之差为零。实验者通常设计实验以便能够拒绝零假设。 Online Statistics Education, n.d., glossary Probability Value 概率值 "In significance testing, the probability value (sometimes called the \(p\) value) is the probability of obtaining a statistic as different or more different from the parameter specified in the null hypothesis as the statistic obtained in the experiment. The probability value is computed assuming the null hypothesis is true. The lower the probability value, the stronger the evidence that the null hypothesis is false. Traditionally, the null hypothesis is rejected if the probability value is below 0.05. Probability values can be either one tailed or two tailed." 在显著性检验中，概率值（有时称为 \(p\) 值）是获得与零假设所指定的参数的差异达到或超过实验所得统计量的差异的统计量的概率。概率值是在假定零假设为真的前提下计算的。概率值越低，零假设为假的证据就越强。传统上，如果概率值低于 0.05，则拒绝零假设。概率值可以是单尾的，也可以是双尾的。 Online Statistics Education, n.d., glossary Significance Testing 显著性检验 "A statistical procedure that tests the viability of the null hypothesis. If data (or more extreme data) are very unlikely given that the null hypothesis is true, then the null hypothesis is rejected. If the data or more extreme data are not unlikely, then the null hypothesis is not rejected. If the null hypothesis is rejected, then the result of the test is said to be significant. A statistically significant effect does not mean the effect is important." 一种检验零假设可行性的统计程序。如果在零假设为真的前提下，这些数据（或更极端的数据）非常不可能出现，则拒绝零假设。如果这些数据或更极端的数据并非不可能出现，则不拒绝零假设。如果零假设被拒绝，则称检验结果是显著的。统计上显著的效应并不意味着该效应是重要的。 Online Statistics Education, n.d., glossary References Online statistics education: An interactive multimedia course of study. math/cs2023/statistics/logic-of-hypothes.summary: 11.4 One- and Two-Tailed Tests Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 11.4 One- and Two-Tailed Tests 单尾检验与双尾检验 (No definition) （无定义） Online Statistics Education, n.d., section 11.4 One Tailed 单尾 "The last step in significance testing involves calculating the probability that a statistic would differ as much or more from the parameter specified in the null hypothesis as does the statistics obtained in the experiment. A probability computed considering differences in only one direction, such as the statistic is larger than the parameter, is called a one-tailed probability. For example, if a parameter is 0 and the statistic is 12, a one-tailed probability (the positive tail) would be the probability of a statistic being \(\geq\) to 12. Compare with the two-tailed probability which would be the probability of being either \(\leq -12\) or \(\geq 12\)." 显著性检验的最后一步是计算一个统计量与零假设所指定的参数的差异达到或超过实验所得统计量的差异的概率。仅考虑一个方向上的差异（例如统计量大于参数）所计算的概率称为单尾概率。例如，若参数为 0，统计量为 12，则单尾概率（正尾）就是统计量 \(\geq\) 12 的概率。与之对比的双尾概率是 \(\leq -12\) 或 \(\geq 12\) 的概率。 Online Statistics Education, n.d., glossary Two Tailed 双侧 "The last step in significance testing involves calculating the probability that a statistic would differ as much or more from the parameter specified in the null hypothesis as does the statistics obtained in the experiment. A probability computed considering differences in both direction (statistic either larger or smaller than the parameter) is called two-tailed probability. For example, if a parameter is 0 and the statistic is 12, a two-tailed probability would be the he probability of being either \(\le -12\) or \(\ge 12\). Compare with the one-tailed probability which would be the probability of a statistic being \(\ge\) to 12 if that were the direction specified in advance." 显著性检验的最后一步是计算统计量与零假设中指定的参数之间的差异达到或超过实验中所得统计量的概率。考虑两个方向上的差异（统计量比参数大或小）而计算的概率称为双侧概率。例如，如果参数为 0，统计量为 12，则双侧概率是取值 \(\le -12\) 或 \(\ge 12\) 的概率。与单侧概率相比较，如果预先指定的方向是这个方向，单侧概率是统计量 \(\ge\) 12 的概率。 Online Statistics Education, n.d., glossary References Online statistics education: An interactive multimedia course of study. math/cs2023/statistics/probability/5-2-b.summary: 5.2 Basic Concepts Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 5.2 Basic Concepts 基本概念 (No definition) （无定义） Online Statistics Education, n.d., section 5.2 Conditional Probability 条件概率 "The probability that event \(A\) occurs given that event \(B\) has already occurred is called the conditional probability of \(A\) given \(B\). Symbolically, this is written as \(P(A \vert B)\). The probability it rains on Monday given that it rained on Sunday would be written as \(P(\text{Rain on Monday} \vert \text{Rain on Sunday})\)." 在事件 \(B\) 已经发生的条件下事件 \(A\) 发生的概率称为给定 \(B\) 时 \(A\) 的条件概率。用符号表示为 \(P(A \vert B)\)。在周日下雨的条件下周一下雨的概率应写作 \(P(\text{Rain on Monday} \vert \text{Rain on Sunday})\)。 Online Statistics Education, n.d., glossary Favorable Outcome 有利结果 "A favorable outcome is the outcome of interest. For example one could define a favorable outcome in the flip of a coin as a head. The term "favorable outcome" does not necessarily mean that the outcome is desirable – in some experiments, the favorable outcome could be the failure of a test, or the occurrence of an undesirable event." 有利结果是所关注的结果。例如，可以把抛硬币时的有利结果定义为正面。“有利结果”一词不一定意味着该结果是令人满意的——在某些实验中，有利结果可能是测试失败，或不良事件的发生。 Online Statistics Education, n.d., glossary Independent Events 独立事件 "Events \(A\) and \(B\) are independent events if the probability of Event \(B\) occurring is the same whether or not Event \(A\) occurs. For example, if you throw two dice, the probability that the second die comes up 1 is independent of whether the first die came up 1. Formally, this can be stated in terms of conditional probabilities : \(P(A \vert B) = P(A)\) and \(P(B \vert A) = P(B)\)." 如果事件 \(B\) 发生的概率无论事件 \(A\) 是否发生都相同，则事件 \(A\) 与 \(B\) 是独立事件。例如，如果掷两个骰子，第二个骰子出现 1 的概率与第一个骰子是否出现 1 无关。形式上，这可以用条件概率表述为：\(P(A \vert B) = P(A)\) 且 \(P(B \vert A) = P(B)\)。 Online Statistics Education, n.d., glossary References Online statistics education: An interactive multimedia course of study. math/green-book/0-common-symbols/0-5-gre.summary: 0.5 Greek Letters Classification Glossary Symbol Description 中文翻译 Source Mathematical Symbols 数学符号 (No definition) （无定义） Cohen et al., 2007 0 Common Symbols 常用符号 (No definition) （无定义） (none) 0.5 Greek Letters 希腊字母 (No definition) （无定义） (none) \(\alpha\) 显著性水平 "The significance level \(\alpha\) in hypothesis testing is the prescribed probability of rejecting the null hypothesis when that hypothesis is true." 假设检验中的显著性水平 \(\alpha\) 是在原假设为真时拒绝原假设的规定概率。 Weisstein, n.d., "significance level" entry \(\gamma\) 欧拉-马斯刻若尼常数 "The Euler-Mascheroni constant \(\gamma\), sometimes also called 'Euler's constant' or 'the Euler constant' (but not to be confused with the constant e, whose value is \(2.718281...\)), is defined as the limit of the sequence \(\gamma = \lim_{n \to \infty}\left(\sum_{k=1}^{n} \frac{1}{k} - \ln n\right)\)" 欧拉-马斯刻若尼常数 \(\gamma\)，有时也称“欧拉常数”（不要与值为 \(2.718281…\) 的常数 e 混淆），定义为数列的极限 \(\gamma = \lim_{n \to \infty}\left(\sum_{k=1}^{n} \frac{1}{k} - \ln n\right)\)。 Weisstein, n.d., "Euler-Mascheroni constant" entry \(\Gamma(n)\) 伽马函数 "The (complete) gamma function \(\Gamma(n)\) is defined to be an extension of the factorial to complex and real number arguments." （完全）伽马函数 \(\Gamma(n)\) 定义为阶乘向复数和实数自变量的推广。 Weisstein, n.d., "gamma function" entry; also in 3 Functions \(\varepsilon,\ \delta\) ε-δ 定义 ""for all neighborhoods \(U\) of \(y_0\) there is a neighborhood \(V\) of \(x_0\) such that, whenever \(x \in V\), then \(f(x) \in U\)" is rephrased as "for all \(\varepsilon > 0\) there is \(\delta > 0\) such that, whenever \(0 < \lvert x - x_0 \rvert < \delta\), then \(\lvert f(x) - y_0 \rvert < \varepsilon\)."" “对 \(y_0\) 的每个邻域 \(U\)，存在 \(x_0\) 的邻域 \(V\)，使只要 \(x \in V\) 就有 \(f(x) \in U\)”被改写为“对所有 \(\varepsilon > 0\)，存在 \(\delta > 0\)，使只要 \(0 < \lvert x - x_0 \rvert < \delta\)，就有 \(\lvert f(x) - y_0 \rvert < \varepsilon\)。” Weisstein, n.d., "epsilon-delta definition" entry \(\zeta(s)\) 黎曼 ζ 函数 "The Riemann zeta function is denoted \(\zeta(s)\)" 黎曼 ζ 函数记作 \(\zeta(s)\)。 Weisstein, n.d., "riemann zeta function" entry \(\eta(s)\) 狄利克雷 η 函数 "The Dirichlet eta function is the entire function \(\eta(s)\) whose series representation for \(\operatorname{Re}[s] > 0\) is \(\eta(s) = \sum_{k=1}^{\infty} \frac{(-1)^{k-1}}{k^s}\)" 狄利克雷 η 函数是整函数 \(\eta(s)\)，它在 \(\operatorname{Re}[s] > 0\) 时的级数表示为 \(\eta(s) = \sum_{k=1}^{\infty} \frac{(-1)^{k-1}}{k^s}\)。 Weisstein, n.d., "Dirichlet eta function" entry \(\theta\) 角 "An angle \(\theta\) between two intersecting lines or line segments is the amount of rotation about their point of intersection (the vertex) required to bring one into correspondence with the other." 两条相交直线或线段之间的角 \(\theta\)，是使其中一条与另一条重合所需绕交点（顶点）旋转的量。 Weisstein, n.d., "angle" entry \(\lambda\) 特征值 "If there is a vector \(X \in \mathbb{R}^n \neq 0\) such that \(AX = \lambda X\) for some scalar \(\lambda\), then \(\lambda\) is called the eigenvalue of \(A\) with corresponding (right) eigenvector \(X\)." 如果存在向量 \(X \in \mathbb{R}^n \neq 0\)，对某个标量 \(\lambda\) 使 \(AX = \lambda X\)，则 \(\lambda\) 称为 \(A\) 的特征值，\(X\) 为对应的（右）特征向量。 Weisstein, n.d., "eigenvalue" entry \(\mu,\ \sigma^2\) 均值与方差 "A normal distribution in a variate \(X\) with mean \(\mu\) and variance \(\sigma^2\) is a statistical distribution with probability density function" 变量 \(X\) 的正态分布以 \(\mu\) 为均值、\(\sigma^2\) 为方差，是具有如下概率密度函数的统计分布。 Weisstein, n.d., "normal distribution" entry \(\pi(x)\) 素数计数函数 "The prime counting function is the function \(\pi(x)\) giving the number of primes less than or equal to a given number \(x\)" 素数计数函数是给出不大于给定数 \(x\) 的素数个数的函数 \(\pi(x)\)。 Weisstein, n.d., "prime counting function" entry \(\sigma\) 标准差 "The standard deviation \(\sigma\) of a probability distribution is defined as the square root of the variance \(\sigma^2\)" 概率分布的标准差 \(\sigma\) 定义为方差 \(\sigma^2\) 的平方根。 Weisstein, n.d., "standard deviation" entry \(\phi\) 黄金比 "The golden ratio, also known as the divine proportion, golden mean, or golden section, is a number often encountered when taking the ratios of distances in simple geometric figures such as the pentagon, pentagram, decagon and dodecahedron. It is denoted \(\phi\), or sometimes \(\tau\)." 黄金比，又称神圣比例、黄金均值或黄金分割，是在五边形、五角星、十边形和十二面体等简单几何图形中取距离之比时常遇到的数。它记作 \(\phi\)，有时记作 \(\tau\)。 Weisstein, n.d., "golden ratio" entry \(\phi(n)\) 欧拉函数 "The totient function \(\phi(n)\), also called Euler's totient function, is defined for a positive integer \(n\) as the number of positive integers \(\leq n\) that are relatively prime to (i.e., share no common divisor other than 1 with) \(n\)" 欧拉函数 \(\phi(n)\) 对正整数 \(n\) 定义为不大于 \(n\) 且与 \(n\) 互素（即除 1 外没有公因数）的正整数的个数。 Weisstein, n.d., "totient function" entry \(\Phi(z)\) 正态分布函数 "The normal distribution function \(\Phi(z)\) is used here in the centered convention" 正态分布函数 \(\Phi(z)\) 在这里采用中心化的约定。 Weisstein, n.d., "normal distribution" entry \(\chi^2\) 卡方分布 "If \(Y_i\) have normal independent distributions with mean 0 and variance 1, then \(\chi^2 = \sum_{i=1}^r Y_i^2\) is distributed as \(\chi^2\) with \(r\) degrees of freedom." 若 \(Y_i\) 是均值为 0、方差为 1 的独立正态分布，则 \(\chi^2 = \sum_{i=1}^r Y_i^2\) 服从自由度为 \(r\) 的 \(\chi^2\) 分布。 Weisstein, n.d., "chi-squared distribution" entry \(\omega(n)\) 不同素因数的个数 "The distinct prime factors of a positive integer \(n \geq 2\) are defined as the \(\omega(n)\) numbers \(p_1\), ..., \(p_{\omega(n)}\) in the prime factorization" 正整数 \(n \geq 2\) 的不同素因数定义为其素因数分解中的 \(\omega(n)\) 个数 \(p_1, …, p_{\omega(n)}\)。 Weisstein, n.d., "distinct prime factors" entry References Weisstein, E. math/intermediate/number-theory/an-intro.title: 11.1 What is Cryptography? | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
math/intermediate/number-theory/an-intro.summary: 11.1 What is Cryptography? Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 11.1 What is Cryptography? 什么是密码学？ (No definition) （无定义） Crisman, 2024, section 11.1 Cryptography 密码学 "Cryptography is not just the science of making (and breaking) codes, as a dictionary might have it. It is the mathematical analysis of the tools of secrecy, from both the perspective of someone keeping a secret and that of the person trying to figure it out. Sometimes it is also called cryptology, while sometimes that term is reserved for a wider meaning." 密码学不只是词典上说的那种编制（和破解）密码的科学。它是对保密工具的数学分析，既从保守秘密的人的角度，也从试图破解秘密的人的角度。有时它也称为密码术（cryptology），不过有时这个词留作更广的含义。 Crisman, 2024, section 11.1 Code 代码 "Mathematicians use the word code to indicate information is being stored, reserving the term cipher to talk about a way to protect that information." 数学家用代码一词表示信息被存储起来，而把密码一词留给保护这些信息的方法。 Crisman, 2024, section 11.1 Cipher 密码 "Mathematicians use the word code to indicate information is being stored, reserving the term cipher to talk about a way to protect that information." 数学家用代码一词表示信息被存储起来，而把密码一词留给保护这些信息的方法。 Crisman, 2024, section 11.1 Encode 编码 "There are many ways to encode a message. The easiest one for us (though not used in practice in exactly this way) will be to simply represent each letter of the English alphabet by an integer from 1 to 26." 编码一条消息的方法有很多。对我们来说最简单的（虽然实际中并不完全这样用）是把英文字母表的每个字母简单地用 1 到 26 的一个整数表示。 Crisman, 2024, subsection 11.1.1 def def "The code def followed by a function name and input variable name (and colon) just tells Sage to define a new (computer, not necessarily mathematical) function." 代码 def 后面跟函数名和输入变量名（以及冒号），就是告诉 Sage 定义一个新的（计算机的，不一定是数学的）函数。 Crisman, 2024, Sage note 11.1.1 Decode 解码 "The process of decoding (or to decode) is similar." 解码（即解码这个动作）的过程是类似的。 Crisman, 2024, subsection 11.1.1 References Crisman, K.-D. (2024). Number theory: In context and interactive (June 26, 2024 edition). Gordon College. Retrieved October 29, 2026, from https://math.gordon.edu/ntic/ntic/

math/intermediate/number-theory/an-intro.title: 11.2 Encryption | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
math/intermediate/number-theory/an-intro.summary: 11.2 Encryption Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 11.2 Encryption 加密 "We will spend most of our time talking about enciphering, or encrypting, messages. Such encryption is the difficult part, after all, the details of which we want to keep secret." 我们大部分时间会讨论如何对消息进行加密（enciphering 或 encrypting）。毕竟，这种加密是困难的部分，它的细节是我们要保密的。 Crisman, 2024, section 11.2 Key 密钥 "What is cool about modern ciphers is that we actually expect that any eavesdropper will know how we do the encryption; they just don’t know the key, which is the specific numbers we use to perform our mathematical encryption." 现代密码的妙处在于，我们其实预料任何窃听者都知道我们怎样加密；他们只是不知道密钥，即我们用来进行数学加密的那些具体的数。 Crisman, 2024, section 11.2 Decryption 解密 "Reversing this process (hopefully only done by the person you want to receive your message!) is called decryption." 把这个过程反过来（但愿只有你想让他收到消息的人才这样做！）称为解密。 Crisman, 2024, section 11.2 Encryption Key 加密密钥 "Sometimes you need a different set of numbers to decrypt, in which case we distinguish between the encryption key and the decryption key." 有时解密需要另一组数，这时我们区分加密密钥和解密密钥。 Crisman, 2024, section 11.2 Decryption Key 解密密钥 "Sometimes you need a different set of numbers to decrypt, in which case we distinguish between the encryption key and the decryption key." 有时解密需要另一组数，这时我们区分加密密钥和解密密钥。 Crisman, 2024, section 11.2 Symmetric Key Cryptography 对称密钥密码学 "In the past, one would usually assume that both the sender and the receiver keep their keys secret (seems reasonable!), which is called symmetric key cryptography. The symmetry is that both people need to keep it secret." 过去人们通常假定发送者和接收者都对各自的密钥保密（似乎很合理！），这称为对称密钥密码学。对称之处在于双方都需要保密。 Crisman, 2024, subsection 11.2.1 Asymmetric Key Cryptography 非对称密钥密码学 "There exists the possibility that everybody knows the key to encrypt, while only the legitimate person knows how to decrypt. This is called asymmetric key cryptography." 存在这样的可能：加密的密钥人人都知道，而只有合法的人知道怎样解密。这称为非对称密钥密码学。 Crisman, 2024, subsection 11.2.5 Public-Key Cryptography 公钥密码学 "In theory, anyone who wants to send Person XYZ a secure message could use this key, but only Person XYZ can decrypt it – convenient! Such an implementation of an asymmetric system is called public-key cryptography, although of course it’s only the encryption key that is actually public." 理论上，任何想给 XYZ 发安全消息的人都可以用这个密钥，但只有 XYZ 能解密，很方便！这种非对称体系的实现称为公钥密码学，当然，真正公开的只是加密密钥。 Crisman, 2024, subsection 11.2.5 References Crisman, K.-D. (2024). Number theory: In context and interactive (June 26, 2024 edition). Gordon College. Retrieved October 29, 2026, from https://math.gordon.edu/ntic/ntic/

math/intermediate/number-theory/an-intro.title: 11.3 A Modular Exponentiation Cipher | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
math/intermediate/number-theory/an-intro.summary: 11.3 A Modular Exponentiation Cipher Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 11.3 A Modular Exponentiation Cipher 模幂密码 (No definition) （无定义） Crisman, 2024, section 11.3 Diffie-Hellman Encryption 迪菲-赫尔曼加密 "To encrypt using this method, do the following. Turn your message into a number \(x\). Pick a prime \(p\) (presumably greater than \(x\)). Pick an exponent \(e\) such that \(\gcd(e,p-1)=1\). Encrypt to a secret message by taking \(m=x^e\text{ (mod }p)\)." 用这种方法加密，按下面做。把消息变成一个数 \(x\)。取一个素数 \(p\)（大概要大于 \(x\)）。取一个指数 \(e\)，使 \(\gcd(e,p-1)=1\)。取 \(m=x^e\text{ (mod }p)\)，加密成秘密消息。 Crisman, 2024, Algorithm 11.3.3 References Crisman, K.-D. (2024). Number theory: In context and interactive (June 26, 2024 edition). Gordon College. Retrieved October 29, 2026, from https://math.gordon.edu/ntic/ntic/

math/intermediate/number-theory/an-intro.title: 11.4 An Interesting Application: Key Exchange | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
math/intermediate/number-theory/an-intro.summary: 11.4 An Interesting Application: Key Exchange Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 11.4 An Interesting Application: Key Exchange 一个有趣的应用：密钥交换 (No definition) （无定义） Crisman, 2024, section 11.4 Key Exchange 密钥交换 "There is a quite useful application of Diffie-Hellman called key exchange." 迪菲-赫尔曼方法有一个很有用的应用，称为密钥交换。 Crisman, 2024, section 11.4 Diffie-Hellman Key Exchange 迪菲-赫尔曼密钥交换 "First, Alice and Bob jointly pick a big prime \(p\) and a base for exponentiation \(g\), presumably with \(1<g<p\). This doesn’t need to be secret. Now, they each secretly choose an exponent; maybe Alice chooses \(m\) and Bob chooses \(n\). The key step: Each of them exponentiates \(g\) to their secret power, modulo \(p\). Then they pass off these numbers to each other, and once again exponentiate the other person’s number to their own secret power, modulo \(p\). The resulting numbers are the same and give the secret key." 首先，Alice 和 Bob 共同选一个大素数 \(p\) 和一个求幂的底数 \(g\)，大概取 \(1<g<p\)。这些不需要保密。然后，他们各自秘密地选一个指数；比如 Alice 选 \(m\)，Bob 选 \(n\)。关键一步：每人把 \(g\) 求自己的秘密次幂，模 \(p\)。然后他们把这些数交给对方，再把对方的数求自己本人的秘密次幂，模 \(p\)。得到的两个数相同，就是秘密密钥。 Crisman, 2024, Algorithm 11.4.2 Man in the Middle Attack 中间人攻击 "Eve can in this situation add her own exponent, \(\ell\), to the game, so that she pretends to have secret key \(g^{m\ell}\) with Alice and secret key \(g^{n\ell}\) with Bob. Both of their keys’ security is now compromised. Such a situation is historically known as a “Man in the Middle” attack." 这时 Eve 可以把她自己的指数 \(\ell\) 加进来，从而假装与 Alice 共有秘密密钥 \(g^{m\ell}\)，与 Bob 共有秘密密钥 \(g^{n\ell}\)。两人密钥的安全都被破坏了。这种情形历来称为“中间人”攻击。 Crisman, 2024, subsection 11.4.2 References Crisman, K.-D. (2024). Number theory: In context and interactive (June 26, 2024 edition). Gordon College. Retrieved October 29, 2026, from https://math.gordon.edu/ntic/ntic/

math/intermediate/number-theory/basic-in.summary: 2.2 The Greatest Common Divisor Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 2.2 The Greatest Common Divisor 最大公约数 (No definition) （无定义） Crisman, 2024, section 2.2 Common Divisor 公因数 "If we consider the various divisors of two numbers \(a\) and \(b\), we say that \(d\) is a common divisor of \(a\) and \(b\) if \(d\mid a\) and \(d\mid b\)." 考虑两个数 \(a\) 与 \(b\) 的各个因数时，若 \(d\mid a\) 且 \(d\mid b\)，则称 \(d\) 是 \(a\) 与 \(b\) 的公因数。 Crisman, 2024, Definition 2.2.1 Greatest Common Divisor 最大公约数 "If we consider the various divisors of two numbers \(a\) and \(b\), we say that \(d\) is a common divisor of \(a\) and \(b\) if \(d\mid a\) and \(d\mid b\). If \(d\) is the biggest such common divisor, it is called the greatest common divisor, or gcd, of \(a\) and \(b\), written \(d=\gcd(a,b)\)." 考虑两个数 \(a\) 与 \(b\) 的各个因数时，若 \(d\mid a\) 且 \(d\mid b\)，则称 \(d\) 是 \(a\) 与 \(b\) 的公因数。若 \(d\) 是最大的这样的公因数，就称它为 \(a\) 与 \(b\) 的最大公约数（gcd），记作 \(d=\gcd(a,b)\)。 Crisman, 2024, Definition 2.2.1 Characterizing the Greatest Common Divisor 最大公约数的刻画 "Let \(a\) and \(b\) be integers, not both zero. Then the greatest common divisor of \(a\) and \(b\) is all of the following: The largest integer \(d\) such that \(d\mid a\) and \(d\mid b\). (This is Definition 2.2.1.) The number achieved by applying the Euclidean algorithm (a repeated division algorithm) to \(a\) and \(b\). (See Section 2.3.) The smallest positive number which can be written as \(ax+by\) for some integers \(x\) and \(y\). (See Section 2.4 and Subsection 2.4.2.)" 设 \(a\) 与 \(b\) 是不全为零的整数。则 \(a\) 与 \(b\) 的最大公约数同时是下面三者：使 \(d\mid a\) 且 \(d\mid b\) 的最大整数 \(d\)。（即定义 2.2.1。）对 \(a\) 与 \(b\) 施行欧几里得算法（反复做带余除法）得到的数。（见 2.3 节。）能对某些整数 \(x\) 与 \(y\) 写成 \(ax+by\) 的最小正数。（见 2.4 节和 2.4.2 小节。） Crisman, 2024, Theorem 2.2.4 References Crisman, K.-D. (2024). Number theory: In context and interactive (June 26, 2024 edition). Gordon College. Retrieved October 29, 2026, from https://math.gordon.edu/ntic/ntic/

math/intermediate/number-theory/basic-in.summary: 2.3 The Euclidean Algorithm Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 2.3 The Euclidean Algorithm 欧几里得算法 (No definition) （无定义） Crisman, 2024, section 2.3 Euclidean Algorithm 欧几里得算法 "The Euclidean algorithm says that to find the gcd of \(a\) and \(b\), one performs the division algorithm until zero is the remainder, each time replacing the previous divisor by the previous remainder, and the previous number to be divided (sometimes called dividend) by the previous divisor. It is closely related to integer programming, something with industrial applications." 这与导子问题类似。它与整数规划密切相关，后者有工业上的应用。 Crisman, 2024, section 3.3 Pythagorean Theorem 勾股定理 "Then, using our technique from last time, from the solution \((x_0,y_0)\) we get a new solution \((x_0+b,y_0-a)\), so the distance between any two solutions is, by the Pythagorean Theorem, \(\sqrt{[(x_0+b)-x_0]^2+[(y_0-a)+y_0]^2}=\sqrt{a^2+b^2}\)." 然后，用上次的技巧，由解 \((x_0,y_0)\) 得到新解 \((x_0+b,y_0-a)\)，所以由勾股定理，任意两个解之间的距离是 \(\sqrt{[(x_0+b)-x_0]^2+[(y_0-a)+y_0]^2}=\sqrt{a^2+b^2}\)。 Crisman, 2024, subsection 3.3.1 Greatest Integer Function 最大整数函数 "The greatest integer function (also called the floor function) is the function which takes a real number \(x\) and returns the largest integer below it (or equal to it). We notate it \(\lfloor x\rfloor\)." 最大整数函数（也称下取整函数）是把实数 \(x\) 映到不超过它的最大整数的函数。记作 \(\lfloor x\rfloor\)。 Crisman, 2024, Definition 3.3.3 References Crisman, K.-D. (2024). math/intermediate/number-theory/from-lin.summary: 3.4 Pythagorean Triples Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 3.4 Pythagorean Triples 毕达哥拉斯三元组 (No definition) （无定义） Crisman, 2024, section 3.4 Diophantine Equations 丢番图方程 "There are a lot of other interesting questions that one can ask about pure integers, and polynomial equations they might satisfy (so-called Diophantine equations)." 关于纯整数，以及它们可能满足的多项式方程（即所谓的丢番图方程），还可以问许多别的有趣问题。 Crisman, 2024, subsection 3.4.1 Pythagorean Triple 毕达哥拉斯三元组 "We call a triple of integers \(x,y,z\) such that \(x^2+y^2=z^2\) a Pythagorean triple." 我们把满足 \(x^2+y^2=z^2\) 的整数三元组 \(x,y,z\) 称为毕达哥拉斯三元组（勾股数）。 Crisman, 2024, Definition 3.4.2 Primitive Pythagorean Triple 本原毕达哥拉斯三元组 "A Pythagorean triple with \(x,y,z\) mutually relatively prime is called a primitive Pythagorean triple." \(x,y,z\) 两两互素的毕达哥拉斯三元组称为本原毕达哥拉斯三元组。 Crisman, 2024, Definition 3.4.3 Opposite Parity 奇偶性相反 "We say two integers \(p,q\) have opposite parity if one is even and the other is odd, and we say they have the same parity otherwise." 若两个整数 \(p,q\) 中一个是偶数、另一个是奇数，就说它们奇偶性相反；否则说它们奇偶性相同。 Crisman, 2024, Definition 3.4.5 Same Parity 奇偶性相同 "We say two integers \(p,q\) have opposite parity if one is even and the other is odd, and we say they have the same parity otherwise." 若两个整数 \(p,q\) 中一个是偶数、另一个是奇数，就说它们奇偶性相反；否则说它们奇偶性相同。 Crisman, 2024, Definition 3.4.5 Characterization of Primitive Pythagorean Triples 本原毕达哥拉斯三元组的刻画 "For a primitive triple \(x,y,z\), where \(x\) is odd, there exist integers \(p,q\) such that \(z=p^2+q^2,\; x=q^2-p^2,\; \text{ and }y=2pq\). Further, \(p\) and \(q\) must have opposite parity as well as be coprime." 对 \(x\) 为奇数的本原三元组 \(x,y,z\)，存在整数 \(p,q\) 使得 \(z=p^2+q^2,\; x=q^2-p^2,\; \text{ and }y=2pq\)。此外，\(p\) 与 \(q\) 必须奇偶性相反且互素。 Crisman, 2024, Theorem 3.4.6 Congruent Number Problem 同余数问题 "This linked news update from the American Institute of Mathematics gives some background on the congruent number problem, which asks the related question of which Pythagorean triangles with rational side lengths give integer areas." 这篇来自美国数学研究所的新闻介绍了同余数问题的一些背景，它问的是一个相关的问题：哪些边长为有理数的直角三角形面积是整数。 Crisman, 2024, subsection 3.4.3 Infinite Descent 无穷递降法 "Now we will do something very clever. It is a proof strategy, similar to something the Greeks used occasionally, which Fermat used for many of his proofs, called infinite descent. We are going to take that (hypothetical) triangle, and produce a triangle with strictly smaller sides but otherwise with the same properties – including integer sides and square area!" 现在我们来做一件非常巧妙的事。这是一种证明策略，与希腊人偶尔用过的方法类似，费马在他的许多证明中都用过，称为无穷递降法。我们要取那个（假设存在的）三角形，造出一个边严格更小、其他性质都相同的三角形，包括边为整数、面积为平方数！ Crisman, 2024, subsection 3.4.3 Fermat’s Last Theorem 费马大定理 "In Exercise 3.6.17 you will use this to prove the famous first case of Fermat’s Last Theorem: There are no three positive integers \(x,y,z\) such that \(x^4+y^4=z^4\)." 在习题 3.6.17 中，你将用它来证明费马大定理著名的第一个情形：不存在三个正整数 \(x,y,z\) 使得 \(x^4+y^4=z^4\)。 Crisman, 2024, subsection 3.4.3 References Crisman, K.-D. (2024). Number theory: In context and interactive (June 26, 2024 edition). Gordon College. Retrieved October 29, 2026, from https://math.gordon.edu/ntic/ntic/

math/intermediate/number-theory/linear-c.summary: 5.2 A Strategy For the First Solution Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 5.2 A Strategy For the First Solution 求第一个解的策略 (No definition) （无定义） Crisman, 2024, section 5.2 Strategies That Work for Simplifying Congruences 化简同余方程的有效策略 "We can do two main types of simplification. First, there are two types of cancellation. If \(a\), \(b\), and \(n\) all are divisible by a common divisor, we can cancel that divisor out (keeping in mind that we still will need our final solution to be modulo \(n\)). If \(a\) and \(b\) share a common divisor which is coprime to the modulus, we can cancel that divisor from \(a,b\) (only). See Propositions 5.2.6 and 5.2.7 for precise statements and proofs. Secondly, there are two counterintuitive operations that may lead to a simpler congruence (using least nonnegative residues). We could multiply \(a\) and \(b\) by something coprime to \(n\). If, after reducing modulo \(n\), that makes \(a\) or \(b\) smaller, then that was a good idea! We can add some multiple of \(n\) to \(b\). Again, if that happens to make \(a\) and (the new) \(b\) share a factor, then it was a good idea!" 我们可以做两大类化简。第一类是两种约去。若 \(a\)、\(b\) 和 \(n\) 都能被一个公因数整除，就可以把这个因数约去（记住最终的解仍要模 \(n\)）。若 \(a\) 与 \(b\) 有一个与模互素的公因数，就可以（只）从 \(a,b\) 中约去这个因数。准确的陈述和证明见命题 5.2.6 和 5.2.7。第二类是两种反直觉的操作，它们可能得到更简单的同余方程（用最小非负剩余）。我们可以把 \(a\) 和 \(b\) 乘上某个与 \(n\) 互素的数。如果模 \(n\) 约化后这使 \(a\) 或 \(b\) 变小了，那就是个好主意！我们可以给 \(b\) 加上 \(n\) 的某个倍数。同样，如果这恰好使 \(a\) 与（新的）\(b\) 有公因子，那就是个好主意！ Crisman, 2024, Fact 5.2.1 References Crisman, K.-D. (2024). Number theory: In context and interactive (June 26, 2024 edition). Gordon College. Retrieved October 29, 2026, from https://math.gordon.edu/ntic/ntic/

math/intermediate/number-theory/primitiv.summary: 10.1 Primitive Roots Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 10.1 Primitive Roots 原根 (No definition) （无定义） Crisman, 2024, section 10.1 Primitive Root 原根 "We say that \(a\in U_n\) is a primitive root of \(n\) when \(a^b\) runs through all elements of \(U_n\) for \(1\leq b\leq \phi(n)\)." 若当 \(1\leq b\leq \phi(n)\) 时 \(a^b\) 取遍 \(U_n\) 的所有元素，就称 \(a\in U_n\) 是 \(n\) 的一个原根。 Crisman, 2024, Definition 10.1.1 Filtered List Comprehension 带过滤的列表推导式 "The syntax [x for y in range(1,mod) if func(x)] takes list comprehensions to another level, by ‘filtering’. This allows us to remove from the list anything which doesn’t fit what we want." 语法 [x for y in range(1,mod) if func(x)] 通过“过滤”把列表推导式提升了一个层次。它让我们能从列表中去掉任何不符合要求的东西。 Crisman, 2024, Sage note 10.1.3 Characterization of a Primitive Root 原根的刻画 "There are two equivalent ways to characterize/define a primitive root of \(n\) among numbers such that \(\gcd(a,n)=1\). We say that \(a\) is a primitive root of \(n\) if \(a^b\) yields every element of \(U_n\). We say that \(a\) is a primitive root of \(n\) if the order of \(a\) is \(\phi(n)\)." 在满足 \(\gcd(a,n)=1\) 的数中，有两种等价的方式来刻画（定义）\(n\) 的原根。若 \(a^b\) 能得到 \(U_n\) 的每个元素，就称 \(a\) 是 \(n\) 的原根。若 \(a\) 的阶是 \(\phi(n)\)，就称 \(a\) 是 \(n\) 的原根。 Crisman, 2024, Proposition 10.1.4 References Crisman, K.-D. (2024). Number theory: In context and interactive (June 26, 2024 edition). Gordon College. Retrieved October 29, 2026, from https://math.gordon.edu/ntic/ntic/

It is equivalent to checking whether \(3\) is a primitive root of \(2^{2^n}+1\)." 有一种称为佩潘检验的专门检验，用来检验费马数是否为素数。它等价于检验 \(3\) 是否是 \(2^{2^n}+1\) 的原根。 Crisman, 2024, subsection 12.1.1 Fermat Numbers Are Coprime 费马数两两互素 "\(F_n=2^{2^n}+1\) and \(F_m=2^{2^m}+1\) are coprime if \(m\neq n\)." 若 \(m\neq n\)，则 \(F_n=2^{2^n}+1\) 与 \(F_m=2^{2^m}+1\) 互素。 Crisman, 2024, Proposition 12.1.4 Mersenne Number 梅森数 "In general, numbers of the form \(M_n=2^n-1\) are called Mersenne numbers. If they are prime, they are called Mersenne primes." 一般地，形如 \(M_n=2^n-1\) 的数称为梅森数。如果它们是素数，就称为梅森素数。 Crisman, 2024, Definition 12.1.6 Mersenne Prime 梅森素数 "In general, numbers of the form \(M_n=2^n-1\) are called Mersenne numbers. If they are prime, they are called Mersenne primes." 一般地，形如 \(M_n=2^n-1\) 的数称为梅森数。如果它们是素数，就称为梅森素数。 Crisman, 2024, Definition 12.1.6 Great Internet Mersenne Prime Search 因特网梅森素数大搜索 "You can help the world search for more Mersenne primes if you leave your personal computer on and connected to the Internet, via the Great Internet Mersenne Prime Search (GIMPS)." 只要让你的个人电脑开着并连上因特网，你就可以通过因特网梅森素数大搜索（GIMPS）帮助全世界寻找更多的梅森素数。 Crisman, 2024, Historical remark 12.1.7 Hardware Bugs Found Using Number Theory 用数论发现的硬件缺陷 "A less obvious but interesting application is that searching for very large primes can also help more mundane hardware testing." 一个不那么明显但有趣的应用是，寻找非常大的素数也能帮助更日常的硬件测试。 Crisman, 2024, Historical remark 12.1.8 Lucas-Lehmer Test 卢卡斯-莱默检验 "Let \(x_0=4\) and let \(p\) be prime (greater than \(2\)). To test whether \(2^p-1\) is prime, create the list of numbers \(x_{n+1}=\text{residue of }x_n^2-2\text{ modulo }2^p-1\) Do this \(p-2\) times; if the result \(x_{p-2}\) is divisible by \(2^p-1\) (i.e., is zero modulo \(2^p-1\)), then \(2^p-1\) is in fact prime." 令 \(x_0=4\)，\(p\) 为素数（大于 \(2\)）。要检验 \(2^p-1\) 是否为素数，构造数列 \(x_{n+1}=\text{residue of }x_n^2-2\text{ modulo }2^p-1\)（\(x_n^2-2\) 模 \(2^p-1\) 的余数）。这样做 \(p-2\) 次；若结果 \(x_{p-2}\) 能被 \(2^p-1\) 整除（即模 \(2^p-1\) 为零），那么 \(2^p-1\) 就是素数。 Crisman, 2024, Algorithm 12.1.9 Mersenne Numbers Are Coprime 梅森数互素 "Mersenne numbers \(2^p-1\) and \(2^q-1\) with coprime exponents are themselves coprime." 指数互素的梅森数 \(2^p-1\) 与 \(2^q-1\) 本身也互素。 Crisman, 2024, Proposition 12.1.11 References Crisman, K.-D. (2024). Number theory: In context and interactive (June 26, 2024 edition). Gordon College. Retrieved October 29, 2026, from https://math.gordon.edu/ntic/ntic/

math/intermediate/number-theory/some-the.summary: 12.2 Primes – Probably Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 12.2 Primes – Probably 可能是素数 (No definition) （无定义） Crisman, 2024, section 12.2 Base a Test 以 a 为底的检验 "If \(a^n\equiv a\) (mod \(n\)), we say \(n\) passes the base \(a\) test." 若 \(a^n\equiv a\)（mod \(n\)），就说 \(n\) 通过了以 \(a\) 为底的检验。 Crisman, 2024, Definition 12.2.3 Pseudoprime 伪素数 "If \(a^n\equiv a\) (mod \(n\)) but \(n\) is not prime, we say it is a pseudoprime base \(a\)." 若 \(a^n\equiv a\)（mod \(n\)）但 \(n\) 不是素数，就说它是以 \(a\) 为底的伪素数。 Crisman, 2024, Definition 12.2.5 Carmichael Number 卡迈克尔数 "We call a number which is pseudoprime to every base \(a\), but is not a prime number a Carmichael number, in honor of the first person to actually produce such numbers, Robert Carmichael (in 1912)." 我们把对每个底 \(a\) 都是伪素数、但本身不是素数的数称为卡迈克尔数，以纪念第一个真正造出这种数的人罗伯特卡迈克尔（1912 年）。 Crisman, 2024, Definition 12.2.9 Korselt’s Theorem 科塞特定理 "Carmichael numbers are precisely those composite \(n\) for which \(n\) is a product of at least two distinct primes \(p_i\) (no squares) \(n=p_1p_2p_3\cdots p_k\text{ with }p_i\neq p_j\) such that \(p_i-1\mid n-1\) for all the prime factors." 卡迈克尔数恰好是这样的合数 \(n\)：\(n\) 是至少两个不同素数 \(p_i\) 之积（无平方因子），\(n=p_1p_2p_3\cdots p_k\text{ with }p_i\neq p_j\)，并且对所有素因数都有 \(p_i-1\mid n-1\)。 Crisman, 2024, Proposition 12.2.10 References Crisman, K.-D. (2024). Number theory: In context and interactive (June 26, 2024 edition). Gordon College. Retrieved October 29, 2026, from https://math.gordon.edu/ntic/ntic/

math/intermediate/number-theory/some-the.summary: 12.3 Another Primality Test Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 12.3 Another Primality Test 另一种素性检验 (No definition) （无定义） Crisman, 2024, section 12.3 The Square Root of Fermat’s Little Theorem 费马小定理的平方根 "\(\text{For any odd prime modulus }p\nmid a\text{, we have }a^{(p-1)/2}\equiv \pm 1\text{ (mod }p)\)." \(\text{For any odd prime modulus }p\nmid a\text{, we have }a^{(p-1)/2}\equiv \pm 1\text{ (mod }p)\)（对任意不整除 \(a\) 的奇素数模 \(p\)，有 \(a^{(p-1)/2}\equiv \pm 1\)）。 Crisman, 2024, Theorem 12.3.2 Miller’s Test Base a 以 a 为底的米勒检验 "A slightly stronger variant of this test is called Miller’s test base \(a\) for primality, after American computer scientist Gary Miller." 这种检验的一个稍强的变体称为素性的以 \(a\) 为底的米勒检验，以美国计算机科学家加里米勒命名。 Crisman, 2024, subsection 12.3.2 References Crisman, K.-D. math/intermediate/number-theory/some-the.summary: 12.4 Strong Pseudoprimes Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 12.4 Strong Pseudoprimes 强伪素数 (No definition) （无定义） Crisman, 2024, section 12.4 Strong Pseudoprime 强伪素数 "We call a composite number \(n\) that passes Miller’s test base \(a\) a strong pseudoprime base \(a\)." 我们把通过以 \(a\) 为底的米勒检验的合数 \(n\) 称为以 \(a\) 为底的强伪素数。 Crisman, 2024, Definition 12.4.1 Infinitely Many Pseudoprimes 无穷多个伪素数 "There are infinitely many strong pseudoprimes (and hence pseudoprimes) base 2." 以 2 为底的强伪素数（因而伪素数）有无穷多个。 Crisman, 2024, Corollary 12.4.4 Miller-Rabin Primality Test 米勒-拉宾素性检验 "Run Miller’s test for \(k\) different bases less than \(n-1\). If a number passes all of them, the probability of failure is less than \(\left(\frac{1}{4}\right)^k\)." 对小于 \(n-1\) 的 \(k\) 个不同的底运行米勒检验。若一个数全部通过，失败的概率小于 \(\left(\frac{1}{4}\right)^k\)。 Crisman, 2024, Algorithm 12.4.7 Certificate of Primality 素性证明 "You can also always use some slow test to prove primality. That is what is called a certificate of primality, and although you may not believe it, programs that reliably generate reasonably large (100-200 digits, right now) primes and can verify it are hot items on the virtual shelves of those who care about such things." 你也总可以用某种较慢的检验来证明素性。这就是所谓的素性证明；说来你可能不信，能可靠地生成相当大的素数（目前是 100 到 200 位）并能验证它的程序，在关心这些事的人的虚拟货架上是抢手货。 Crisman, 2024, section 12.4 References Crisman, K.-D. (2024). Number theory: In context and interactive (June 26, 2024 edition). Gordon College. Retrieved October 29, 2026, from https://math.gordon.edu/ntic/ntic/

math/intermediate/number-theory/some-the.summary: 12.5 Introduction to Factorization Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 12.5 Introduction to Factorization 因数分解简介 (No definition) （无定义） Crisman, 2024, section 12.5 Factorization in Cryptography 密码学中的因数分解 "We will focus on the main attack on the RSA algorithm, namely finding nontrivial factorizations, or factorization." 我们将关注对 RSA 算法的主要攻击，即寻找非平凡的因数分解，也就是因数分解。 Crisman, 2024, section 12.5 Trial Division 试除法 "The first, and oldest, method of factoring is one you already know, and maybe used a few minutes ago – trial factorization, or trial division. It is the method we used with the Sieve of Eratosthenes; you just try each prime number, one by one." 第一种、也是最古老的因数分解方法你已经知道，也许几分钟前还用过，那就是试除分解，或试除法。它就是我们用埃拉托色尼筛法时的方法：逐个试每个素数。 Crisman, 2024, subsection 12.5.2 Fermat Factorization 费马分解法 "To find a factor for a number \(n\), begin by seeking a perfect square \(s^2\) bigger than \(n\), but still as close as possible. Now, do the following until you succeed, increasing \(s\) by one each time. Check whether \(s^2-n\) is itself a perfect square \(t^2\)." 要找数 \(n\) 的一个因数，先找一个比 \(n\) 大但尽量接近的完全平方数 \(s^2\)。然后每次把 \(s\) 加一，重复下面的步骤直到成功。检验 \(s^2-n\) 本身是否是完全平方数 \(t^2\)。 Crisman, 2024, Algorithm 12.5.9 References Crisman, K.-D. (2024). Number theory: In context and interactive (June 26, 2024 edition). Gordon College. Retrieved October 29, 2026, from https://math.gordon.edu/ntic/ntic/

math/intermediate/number-theory/some-the.summary: 12.6 A Taste of Modernity Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 12.6 A Taste of Modernity 现代方法一瞥 (No definition) （无定义） Crisman, 2024, section 12.6 Continued Fraction 连分数 "There are many answers to this question, some of which involve cool things called continued fractions or number fields." 这个问题有很多答案，其中一些涉及称为连分数或数域的有趣东西。 Crisman, 2024, section 12.6 Number Field 数域 "There are many answers to this question, some of which involve cool things called continued fractions or number fields." 这个问题有很多答案，其中一些涉及称为连分数或数域的有趣东西。 Crisman, 2024, section 12.6 Shor’s Algorithm 肖尔算法 "A rather less elementary, but potentially extremely important, technique for factoring is Shor’s algorithm. Explaining this quantum computational algorithm in any detail goes well beyond this text; its main significance is that if a sizable quantum computer implementing this algorithm could be built, it could perform the specific tasks of factoring large RSA moduli in polynomial (rather than exponential) time." 一种远不那么初等、但可能极其重要的因数分解技术是肖尔算法。详细解释这种量子计算算法远远超出了本书的范围；它的主要意义在于，如果能造出实现该算法的相当规模的量子计算机，它就能在多项式（而非指数）时间内完成分解大的 RSA 模数这一特定任务。 Crisman, 2024, section 12.6 Pollard Rho Factoring Algorithm 波拉德 rho 因数分解算法 "Pick some polynomial \(f(x)\) that will be easy to compute (mod \(n\)) (such as \(x^2+1\), though other quadratics might be used). Plug in an essentially random seed value \(x_0\). (Often the seed is \(2\) or \(3\).) Compute the polynomial’s value at the seed, \(f(x_0)=x_1\). Continue plugging in \(f(x_i)=x_{i+1}\), modulo \(n\). For each \(k\) we check whether \(1<\gcd(x_{2k}-x_k,n)=d<n\)." 取某个容易（模 \(n\)）计算的多项式 \(f(x)\)（如 \(x^2+1\)，也可用其他二次多项式）。代入一个基本随机的种子值 \(x_0\)（种子常取 \(2\) 或 \(3\)）。计算多项式在种子处的值 \(f(x_0)=x_1\)。继续代入 \(f(x_i)=x_{i+1}\)，模 \(n\)。对每个 \(k\) 检验是否 \(1<\gcd(x_{2k}-x_k,n)=d<n\)。 Crisman, 2024, Algorithm 12.6.3 @interact @interact "An interact is just a Sage/Python function, except with @interact before it." 一个交互就是一个前面加了 @interact 的 Sage/Python 函数。 Crisman, 2024, Sage note 12.6.8 References Crisman, K.-D. (2024). Number theory: In context and interactive (June 26, 2024 edition). Gordon College. Retrieved October 29, 2026, from https://math.gordon.edu/ntic/ntic/

math/intermediate/number-theory/sums-of-.summary: 13.3 A Lemma About Square Roots Modulo n Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 13.3 A Lemma About Square Roots Modulo n 关于模 n 平方根的一个引理 (No definition) （无定义） Crisman, 2024, section 13.3 Square Root Modulo n 模 n 平方根 "We say that a number \(a\) has a square root modulo \(n\) if there is some number \(x\) with \(x^2\equiv a\text{ (mod }n)\)." 若存在某个数 \(x\) 使 \(x^2\equiv a\text{ (mod }n)\)，就说数 \(a\) 有模 \(n\) 平方根。 Crisman, 2024, Definition 13.3.1 Ideal Class Group 理想类群 "Foreshadowing Definition 14.1.2, if we define the number system \(\{a+b\frac{1+\sqrt{-p}}{2}\mid a,b\in\mathbb{Z}\}\) (ignoring whether that actually makes sense to do), one can define a special group (recall Definition 8.3.3) called the ideal class group of this number system. math/intermediate/number-theory/sums-of-.title: 13.4 Primes as Sum of Squares | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
math/intermediate/number-theory/sums-of-.summary: 13.4 Primes as Sum of Squares Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 13.4 Primes as Sum of Squares 素数表为平方和 "Every prime \(p\) of the form \(4k+1\) can be written as a sum of squares." 每个形如 \(4k+1\) 的素数 \(p\) 都能写成平方和。 Crisman, 2024, Theorem 13.4.5 Minkowski’s Theorem 闵可夫斯基定理 "We roughly follow [E.2.1, Chapter 10.6], but expanded greatly to avoid any direct reference to Hermann Minkowski’s theorem on lattice points in a convex symmetric set." 我们大致沿用 [E.2.1, Chapter 10.6]，但作了大幅展开，以避免直接引用赫尔曼闵可夫斯基关于凸对称集中的格点的闵可夫斯基定理。 Crisman, 2024, Remark 13.4.1 General Lattice 一般的格 "Sometimes we call things like the set of blue dots a lattice, though in this text I will usually use the word lattice only to refer to the usual integer lattice of the black dots. A general lattice is something related to a concept from linear algebra – vectors generated by a basis, except instead of being vectors over \(\mathbb{Q}\) or \(\mathbb{R}\), they are over \(\mathbb{Z}\)." 有时我们把蓝点组成的这类集合称为格，不过本书中我通常只用格这个词指黑点组成的通常的整数格。一般的格与线性代数中的一个概念有关：由一组基生成的向量，只是这些向量不是在 \(\mathbb{Q}\) 或 \(\mathbb{R}\) 上，而是在 \(\mathbb{Z}\) 上。 Crisman, 2024, Remark 13.4.3 Norm 范数 "We call the norm of a point \((x,y)\) the sum of squares, \(N(x,y)=x^2+y^2\)." 我们把平方和 \(N(x,y)=x^2+y^2\) 称为点 \((x,y)\) 的范数。 Crisman, 2024, Definition 13.4.4 Sublattice 子格 "What we do now is to create a sublattice of the blue dots, which we will color green. (This is just a subset of a lattice which still otherwise satisfies the conditions for being a lattice.)" 现在我们构造蓝点的一个子格，把它涂成绿色。（这只是格的一个子集，它在其他方面仍满足作为格的条件。） Crisman, 2024, subsection 13.4.3 Fundamental Region 基本区域 "Because all points inside the parallelogram (not just green, blue, or lattice points) will “repeat” outside of it in another parallelogram, \(4p\) is the biggest area of a region that you can have and not “repeat” some point. (This parallelogram is often called a fundamental region in more general treatments.)" 由于平行四边形内的所有点（不只是绿点、蓝点或格点）都会在它外面的另一个平行四边形中“重复”，\(4p\) 是一个区域在不“重复”任何点的情况下所能有的最大面积。（在更一般的论述中，这个平行四边形常称为基本区域。） Crisman, 2024, subsection 13.4.4 Repeated Points 重复点 "We say that two distinct points \(v,w\) in a plane region are “repeated” if they are both rigid translations of the same point in \(L\), where the allowed translations are those described in Fact 13.4.9." 若平面区域中两个不同的点 \(v,w\) 都是 \(L\) 中同一个点的刚性平移（允许的平移是事实 13.4.9 所描述的那些），就说它们是“重复”的。 Crisman, 2024, Definition 13.4.10 References Crisman, K.-D. math/intermediate/number-theory/the-grou.summary: 8.3 Essential Group Facts for Number Theory Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 8.3 Essential Group Facts for Number Theory 数论必需的群论事实 (No definition) （无定义） Crisman, 2024, section 8.3 Set 集合 "Sets are just what you think. They are collections of (mathematical) stuff." 集合就是你想的那样，是 （数学）对象的汇集。 Crisman, 2024, subsubsection 8.3.1.1 Binary Operation 二元运算 "A binary operation is a set with a multiplication table on it. That’s it." 二元运算就是带有一张乘法表的集合。仅此而已。 Crisman, 2024, subsubsection 8.3.1.2 Closed 封闭的 "A binary operation is called closed if you don’t get anything outside the set with your operation." 若运算的结果不会跑到集合之外，就称这个二元运算是封闭的。 Crisman, 2024, subsubsection 8.3.1.3 Associative 结合的 "An operation is associative if it doesn’t matter how you put parentheses in." 若括号怎么加都无所谓，就称运算是结合的。 Crisman, 2024, subsubsection 8.3.1.4 Identity Element 单位元 "Much more important is whether your operation has an identity element. You have seen this many times before in addition and multiplication. \(a+0=a=0+a\text{ and }a\cdot 1=a=1\cdot a\). When we turn this into abstract math, we say that an identity for a general operation \(*\) on a set \(S\) is an element, conveniently called \(e\), which has the very nice property that if you \(*\) by it, you get the same thing back." 更重要的是你的运算是否有单位元。你以前在加法和乘法中已经多次见过它。\(a+0=a=0+a\text{ and }a\cdot 1=a=1\cdot a\)。把它变成抽象数学时，我们说集合 \(S\) 上一般运算 \(*\) 的单位元是一个元素，方便起见记作 \(e\)，它有一个很好的性质：用它去 \(*\)，得到的还是原来的东西。 Crisman, 2024, subsubsection 8.3.1.5 Inverse of a Group Element 群元素的逆 "Generalizing this, if \(a\) is an element of your set \(S\) and there is another element \(a'\) such that \(a*a'=e=a'*a\), then we call \(a'\) an inverse of \(a\)." 推广一下，若 \(a\) 是集合 \(S\) 的元素，且有另一个元素 \(a'\) 使 \(a*a'=e=a'*a\)，就称 \(a'\) 是 \(a\) 的逆。 Crisman, 2024, subsubsection 8.3.1.6 Group 群 "If a set and binary operation on that set is closed and associative with identity and inverses for every element, we call that set a group." 若一个集合及其上的二元运算封闭、满足结合律、有单位元，并且每个元素都有逆，就称这个集合为群。 Crisman, 2024, Definition 8.3.3 Socks and Shoes Property 袜子与鞋子性质 "The inverse of \(ab\) is \(b^{-1}a^{-1}\)." \(ab\) 的逆是 \(b^{-1}a^{-1}\)。 Crisman, 2024, Fact 8.3.7 Finite Group 有限群 "A group with finitely many elements is called, unimaginatively, a finite group." 元素个数有限的群，被毫无想象力地称为有限群。 Crisman, 2024, subsubsection 8.3.3.3 Order of a Group 群的阶 "The number of elements of a finite group is called the order of the group. For any old group \(G\), we use \(\vert G\vert\) as notation for its order." 有限群的元素个数称为这个群的阶。对任意一个群 \(G\)，我们用 \(\vert G\vert\) 表示它的阶。 Crisman, 2024, Definition 8.3.8 Pigeonhole Principle 鸽巢原理 "(This argument, that if you fit \(n+1\) objects into \(n\) slots then there must be a repeat, is called the pigeonhole principle, among other names.)" （这个论证，即把 \(n+1\) 个物体放进 \(n\) 个格子里必然有重复，称为鸽巢原理，也有别的名字。） Crisman, 2024, subsubsection 8.3.3.5 Order of an Element 元素的阶 "For a group element \(x\in G\), the least (positive) integer \(k\) such that \(x^k = e\) is called the order of the element \(x\). We write it \(\vert x\vert\), by analogy with the order of a group." 对群元素 \(x\in G\)，使 \(x^k = e\) 的最小（正）整数 \(k\) 称为元素 \(x\) 的阶，记作 \(\vert x\vert\)，与群的阶类比。 Crisman, 2024, Definition 8.3.10 Lagrange’s Theorem on Group Order 关于群的阶的拉格朗日定理 "The order of any element \(x\) of \(G\) divides the order of the group itself. We can write this as \(\vert x\vert\mid \vert G\vert\)" \(G\) 的任何元素 \(x\) 的阶都整除群本身的阶。可以写成 \(\vert x\vert\mid \vert G\vert\) Crisman, 2024, Theorem 8.3.12 Generator 生成元 "This element, whose powers run through all \(n\) elements of \(G\), is called a generator of the group." 这个其幂遍历 \(G\) 的全部 \(n\) 个元素的元素，称为群的生成元。 Crisman, 2024, subsubsection 8.3.3.7 Cyclic Group 循环群 "Any group that has a generator (again, an element whose powers hit all elements of the group) is called a cyclic group." 任何有生成元的群（再说一遍，生成元是其幂能取遍群的所有元素的元素）称为循环群。 Crisman, 2024, subsubsection 8.3.3.7 Commutative 交换的 "Namely, it doesn’t matter what order you do the operation in. (Such an operation is called commutative.)" 也就是说，运算的先后顺序无所谓。（这样的运算称为交换的。） Crisman, 2024, subsubsection 8.3.3.8 Abelian Group 阿贝尔群 "Any group which has this property, that \(a*b=b*a\) for all \(a,b\in G\), is called an Abelian group." 任何具有这个性质，即对所有 \(a,b\in G\) 都有 \(a*b=b*a\) 的群，称为阿贝尔群。 Crisman, 2024, subsubsection 8.3.3.8 References Crisman, K.-D. (2024). Number theory: In context and interactive (June 26, 2024 edition). Gordon College. Retrieved October 29, 2026, from https://math.gordon.edu/ntic/ntic/
