math/intermediate/real-analysis/continuo.title: 3.1 Limits of functions | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
math/intermediate/real-analysis/continuo.summary: 3.1 Limits of functions Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 3.1 Limits of functions 函数的极限 (No definition) （无定义） Lebl, 2026, section 3.1 Limit of a Function 函数的极限 "Let \(f \colon S \to \mathbb{R}\) be a function and \(c\) a cluster point of \(S \subset \mathbb{R}\). Suppose there exists an \(L \in \mathbb{R}\) and for every \(\epsilon > 0\), there exists a \(\delta > 0\) such that whenever \(x \in S \setminus \{ c \}\) and \(\lvert x - c \rvert < \delta\), we have \(\bigl\lvert f(x) - L \bigr\rvert < \epsilon\). We then say \(f(x)\) converges to \(L\) as \(x\) goes to \(c\)." 设 \(f \colon S \to \mathbb{R}\) 是函数，\(c\) 是 \(S \subset \mathbb{R}\) 的聚点。假设存在 \(L \in \mathbb{R}\)，使得对每个 \(\epsilon > 0\)，存在 \(\delta > 0\)，只要 \(x \in S \setminus \{ c \}\) 且 \(\lvert x - c \rvert < \delta\)，就有 \(\bigl\lvert f(x) - L \bigr\rvert < \epsilon\)。这时就说当 \(x\) 趋于 \(c\) 时 \(f(x)\) 收敛到 \(L\)。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 3.1.3 Diverges 发散 "If no such \(L\) exists, then we say that the limit does not exist or that \(f\) diverges at \(c\)." 若这样的 \(L\) 不存在，就说极限不存在，或说 \(f\) 在 \(c\) 处发散。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 3.1.3 Restriction 限制 "Let \(f \colon S \to \mathbb{R}\) be a function and \(A \subset S\). Define the function \(f|_A \colon A \to \mathbb{R}\) by \(f|_A (x) := f(x) \qquad \text{for } x \in A.\) We call \(f|_A\) the restriction of \(f\) to \(A\)." 设 \(f \colon S \to \mathbb{R}\) 是函数，\(A \subset S\)。定义函数 \(f|_A \colon A \to \mathbb{R}\) 为 \(f|_A (x) := f(x) \qquad \text{for } x \in A.\) 称 \(f|_A\) 为 \(f\) 在 \(A\) 上的限制。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 3.1.14 One-Sided Limit 单侧极限 "Let \(f \colon S \to \mathbb{R}\) be a function and let \(c \in \mathbb{R}\). If \(c\) is a cluster point of \(S \cap (c,\infty)\) and the limit of the restriction of \(f\) to \(S \cap (c,\infty)\) as \(x \to c\) exists, define \(\lim_{x \to c^+} f(x) := \lim_{x\to c} f|_{S \cap (c,\infty)}(x)\)." 设 \(f \colon S \to \mathbb{R}\) 是函数，\(c \in \mathbb{R}\)。若 \(c\) 是 \(S \cap (c,\infty)\) 的聚点，且 \(f\) 在 \(S \cap (c,\infty)\) 上的限制当 \(x \to c\) 时的极限存在，就定义 \(\lim_{x \to c^+} f(x) := \lim_{x\to c} f|_{S \cap (c,\infty)}(x)\)。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 3.1.16 References Lebl, J. (2026). Basic analysis I & II: Introduction to real analysis (May 22, 2026 edition). Retrieved October 29, 2026, from https://www.jirka.org/ra/html/

math/intermediate/real-analysis/continuo.title: 3.2 Continuous functions | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
math/intermediate/real-analysis/continuo.summary: 3.2 Continuous functions Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 3.2 Continuous functions 连续函数 (No definition) （无定义） Lebl, 2026, section 3.2 Continuous at c 在 c 处连续 "Suppose \(S \subset \mathbb{R}\) and \(c \in S\). We say \(f \colon S \to \mathbb{R}\) is continuous at \(c\) if for every \(\epsilon > 0\) there is a \(\delta > 0\) such that whenever \(x \in S\) and \(\lvert x-c \rvert < \delta\), we have \(\bigl\lvert f(x)-f(c) \bigr\rvert < \epsilon\)." 设 \(S \subset \mathbb{R}\)，\(c \in S\)。若对每个 \(\epsilon > 0\)，存在 \(\delta > 0\)，只要 \(x \in S\) 且 \(\lvert x-c \rvert < \delta\)，就有 \(\bigl\lvert f(x)-f(c) \bigr\rvert < \epsilon\)，则称 \(f \colon S \to \mathbb{R}\) 在 \(c\) 处连续。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 3.2.1 Continuous Function 连续函数 "When \(f \colon S \to \mathbb{R}\) is continuous at all \(c \in S\), then we simply say \(f\) is a continuous function." 当 \(f \colon S \to \mathbb{R}\) 在所有 \(c \in S\) 处连续时，就简单地说 \(f\) 是连续函数。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 3.2.1 Continuous on A 在 A 上连续 "If \(f\) is continuous for all \(c \in A\), we say \(f\) is continuous on \(A \subset S\)." 若 \(f\) 对所有 \(c \in A\) 都连续，就说 \(f\) 在 \(A \subset S\) 上连续。 Lebl, 2026, section 3.2 Polynomial 多项式 "Let \(f \colon \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}\) be a polynomial. That is, \(f(x) = a_d x^d + a_{d-1} x^{d-1} + \cdots + a_1 x + a_0\), for some constants \(a_0, a_1, \ldots, a_d\)." 设 \(f \colon \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}\) 是多项式，即对某些常数 \(a_0, a_1, \ldots, a_d\) 有 \(f(x) = a_d x^d + a_{d-1} x^{d-1} + \cdots + a_1 x + a_0\)。 Lebl, 2026, Proposition 3.2.4 Discontinuity 间断 "When \(f\) is not continuous at \(c\), we say \(f\) is discontinuous at \(c\), or that it has a discontinuity at \(c\)." 当 \(f\) 在 \(c\) 处不连续时，就说 \(f\) 在 \(c\) 处间断，或说它在 \(c\) 处有一个间断点。 Lebl, 2026, section 3.2 Dirichlet Function 狄利克雷函数 "For an extreme example, consider the Dirichlet function. \(f(x) := \begin{cases} 1 & \text{if } x \text{ is rational,} \\ 0 & \text{if } x \text{ is irrational.} \end{cases}\)" 作为一个极端的例子，考虑狄利克雷函数：\(f(x) := \begin{cases} 1 & \text{if } x \text{ is rational,} \\ 0 & \text{if } x \text{ is irrational.} \end{cases}\) Lebl, 2026, Example 3.2.11 Thomae Function 托马函数 "Can there exist a function continuous at all irrational numbers, but discontinuous at all rational numbers? There are rational numbers arbitrarily close to any irrational number. Perhaps strangely, the answer is yes, such a function exists. The following example is called the Thomae function or the popcorn function." 能否存在在所有无理数处连续、在所有有理数处间断的函数？任何无理数附近都有任意接近的有理数。也许奇怪，答案是肯定的，这样的函数存在。下面的例子称为托马函数或爆米花函数。 Lebl, 2026, section 3.2 Removable Discontinuity 可去间断点 "The point \(x=0\) is called a removable discontinuity. That is because if we would change the definition of \(g\), by insisting that \(g(0)\) be \(0\), we would obtain a continuous function." 点 \(x=0\) 称为可去间断点。这是因为如果改变 \(g\) 的定义，令 \(g(0)\) 为 \(0\)，就会得到一个连续函数。 Lebl, 2026, Example 3.2.13 Convex 凸 "A function \(f \colon I \to \mathbb{R}\) is convex if whenever \(a \leq x \leq b\) for \(a,x,b\) in \(I\), we have \(f(x) \leq f(a) \frac{b-x}{b-a} + f(b) \frac{x-a}{b-a}\)." 函数 \(f \colon I \to \mathbb{R}\) 称为凸的，如果对 \(I\) 中满足 \(a \leq x \leq b\) 的 \(a,x,b\)，总有 \(f(x) \leq f(a) \frac{b-x}{b-a} + f(b) \frac{x-a}{b-a}\)。 Lebl, 2026, Exercise 3.2.19 References Lebl, J. (2026). Basic analysis I & II: Introduction to real analysis (May 22, 2026 edition). Retrieved October 29, 2026, from https://www.jirka.org/ra/html/

math/intermediate/real-analysis/continuo.title: 3.3 Extreme and intermediate value theorems | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
math/intermediate/real-analysis/continuo.summary: 3.3 Extreme and intermediate value theorems Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 3.3 Extreme and intermediate value theorems 最值定理与介值定理 (No definition) （无定义） Lebl, 2026, section 3.3 Absolute Minimum 绝对最小值 "Recall from calculus that \(f \colon S \to \mathbb{R}\) achieves an absolute minimum at \(c \in S\) if \(f(x) \geq f(c) \qquad \text{for all } x \in S.\)" 回忆微积分：若 \(f(x) \geq f(c) \qquad \text{for all } x \in S.\)，则 \(f \colon S \to \mathbb{R}\) 在 \(c \in S\) 处取得绝对最小值。 Lebl, 2026, section 3.3 Absolute Maximum 绝对最大值 "On the other hand, \(f\) achieves an absolute maximum at \(c \in S\) if \(f(x) \leq f(c) \qquad \text{for all } x \in S.\)" 另一方面，若 \(f(x) \leq f(c) \qquad \text{for all } x \in S.\)，则 \(f\) 在 \(c \in S\) 处取得绝对最大值。 Lebl, 2026, section 3.3 Extreme Value Theorem 最值定理 "A continuous function \(f \colon [a,b] \to \mathbb{R}\) achieves both an absolute minimum and an absolute maximum on \([a,b]\)." 连续函数 \(f \colon [a,b] \to \mathbb{R}\) 在 \([a,b]\) 上既取得绝对最小值，也取得绝对最大值。 Lebl, 2026, Theorem 3.3.2 Bolzano’s Intermediate Value Theorem 波尔查诺介值定理 "Let \(f \colon [a,b] \to \mathbb{R}\) be a continuous function. Suppose \(y \in \mathbb{R}\) is such that \(f(a) < y < f(b)\) or \(f(a) > y > f(b)\). Then there exists a \(c \in (a,b)\) such that \(f(c) = y\)." 设 \(f \colon [a,b] \to \mathbb{R}\) 是连续函数，\(y \in \mathbb{R}\) 满足 \(f(a) < y < f(b)\) 或 \(f(a) > y > f(b)\)，则存在 \(c \in (a,b)\) 使得 \(f(c) = y\)。 Lebl, 2026, Theorem 3.3.8 Bisection Method 二分法 "The proof of the lemma tells us how to find the root \(c\). The proof is not only useful for us pure mathematicians, it is a useful idea in applied mathematics, where it is called the bisection method." 引理的证明告诉我们如何找到根 \(c\)。这个证明不仅对纯粹数学家有用，在应用数学里也是一个有用的思想，在那里称为二分法。 Lebl, 2026, section 3.3 Monic Polynomial 首一多项式 "We divide by \(a_d\) to obtain a monic polynomial. The word monic means that the coefficient of \(x^d\) is 1." 用 \(a_d\) 去除，得到一个首一多项式。“首一”是指 \(x^d\) 的系数为 1。 Lebl, 2026, Proposition 3.3.10, proof References Lebl, J. (2026). Basic analysis I & II: Introduction to real analysis (May 22, 2026 edition). Retrieved October 29, 2026, from https://www.jirka.org/ra/html/

math/intermediate/real-analysis/continuo.title: 3.4 Uniform continuity | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
math/intermediate/real-analysis/continuo.summary: 3.4 Uniform continuity Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 3.4 Uniform continuity 一致连续 (No definition) （无定义） Lebl, 2026, section 3.4 Uniformly Continuous 一致连续 "Let \(S \subset \mathbb{R}\), and let \(f \colon S \to \mathbb{R}\) be a function. Suppose for every \(\epsilon > 0\) there exists a \(\delta > 0\) such that whenever \(x, c \in S\) and \(\lvert x-c \rvert < \delta\), then \(\bigl\lvert f(x)-f(c) \bigr\rvert < \epsilon\). Then we say \(f\) is uniformly continuous." 设 \(S \subset \mathbb{R}\)，\(f \colon S \to \mathbb{R}\) 是函数。若对每个 \(\epsilon > 0\)，存在 \(\delta > 0\)，只要 \(x, c \in S\) 且 \(\lvert x-c \rvert < \delta\)，就有 \(\bigl\lvert f(x)-f(c) \bigr\rvert < \epsilon\)，则称 \(f\) 一致连续。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 3.4.1 Removable Singularity 可去奇点 "If \(f \colon (-1,0) \cup (0,1) \to \mathbb{R}\) is uniformly continuous, then \(\lim_{x\to 0} f(x)\) exists and the function has a removable singularity. That is, we can extend the function to a continuous function on \((-1,1)\)." 若 \(f \colon (-1,0) \cup (0,1) \to \mathbb{R}\) 一致连续，则 \(\lim_{x\to 0} f(x)\) 存在，该函数有一个可去奇点。也就是说，可以把这个函数延拓成 \((-1,1)\) 上的连续函数。 Lebl, 2026, section 3.4 Lipschitz Continuous 利普希茨连续 "A function \(f \colon S \to \mathbb{R}\) is Lipschitz continuous if there exists a \(K \in \mathbb{R}\) such that \(\bigl\lvert f(x)-f(y) \bigr\rvert \leq K \lvert x-y \rvert \qquad \text{for all } x \text{ and } y \text{ in } S.\)" 若存在 \(K \in \mathbb{R}\) 使得 \(\bigl\lvert f(x)-f(y) \bigr\rvert \leq K \lvert x-y \rvert \qquad \text{for all } x \text{ and } y \text{ in } S.\)，则称函数 \(f \colon S \to \mathbb{R}\) 利普希茨连续。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 3.4.7 Secant Line 割线 "The quantity \(\frac{f(x)-f(y)}{x-y}\) is the slope of the line between the points \(\bigl(x,f(x)\bigr)\) and \(\bigl(y,f(y)\bigr)\), that is, a secant line." 量 \(\frac{f(x)-f(y)}{x-y}\) 是点 \(\bigl(x,f(x)\bigr)\) 与 \(\bigl(y,f(y)\bigr)\) 之间直线的斜率，这条直线就是割线。 Lebl, 2026, section 3.4 References Lebl, J. (2026). Basic analysis I & II: Introduction to real analysis (May 22, 2026 edition). Retrieved October 29, 2026, from https://www.jirka.org/ra/html/

math/intermediate/real-analysis/continuo.title: 3.5 Limits at infinity | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
math/intermediate/real-analysis/continuo.summary: 3.5 Limits at infinity Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 3.5 Limits at infinity 无穷远处的极限 (No definition) （无定义） Lebl, 2026, section 3.5 Limit of a Function at Infinity 函数在无穷远处的极限 "Let \(f \colon S \to \mathbb{R}\) be a function, where \(\infty\) is a cluster point of \(S\). If there exists an \(L \in \mathbb{R}\) with the property that for every \(\epsilon > 0\), there is an \(M \in \mathbb{R}\) such that \(\bigl\lvert f(x) - L \bigr\rvert < \epsilon\) whenever \(x \in S\) and \(x \geq M\), then we say \(f(x)\) converges to \(L\) as \(x\) goes to \(\infty\)." 设 \(f \colon S \to \mathbb{R}\) 是函数，\(\infty\) 是 \(S\) 的聚点。若存在 \(L \in \mathbb{R}\)，使得对每个 \(\epsilon > 0\)，存在 \(M \in \mathbb{R}\)，只要 \(x \in S\) 且 \(x \geq M\)，就有 \(\bigl\lvert f(x) - L \bigr\rvert < \epsilon\)，则说当 \(x\) 趋于 \(\infty\) 时 \(f(x)\) 收敛到 \(L\)。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 3.5.1 Infinite Limit of a Function 函数的无穷极限 "Let \(f \colon S \to \mathbb{R}\) be a function and suppose \(S\) has \(\infty\) as a cluster point. We say \(f(x)\) diverges to infinity as \(x\) goes to \(\infty\) if for every \(N \in \mathbb{R}\) there exists an \(M \in \mathbb{R}\) such that \(f(x) > N\) whenever \(x \in S\) and \(x \geq M\)." 设 \(f \colon S \to \mathbb{R}\) 是函数，\(S\) 以 \(\infty\) 为聚点。若对每个 \(N \in \mathbb{R}\)，存在 \(M \in \mathbb{R}\)，只要 \(x \in S\) 且 \(x \geq M\)，就有 \(f(x) > N\)，则说当 \(x\) 趋于 \(\infty\) 时 \(f(x)\) 发散到无穷。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 3.5.6 References Lebl, J. (2026). Basic analysis I & II: Introduction to real analysis (May 22, 2026 edition). Retrieved October 29, 2026, from https://www.jirka.org/ra/html/

math/intermediate/real-analysis/continuo.title: 3.6 Monotone functions and continuity | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
math/intermediate/real-analysis/continuo.summary: 3.6 Monotone functions and continuity Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 3.6 Monotone functions and continuity 单调函数与连续性 (No definition) （无定义） Lebl, 2026, section 3.6 Increasing 递增 "Let \(S \subset \mathbb{R}\). We say \(f \colon S \to \mathbb{R}\) is increasing (resp. strictly increasing) if \(x,y \in S\) with \(x < y\) implies \(f(x) \leq f(y)\) (resp. \(f(x) < f(y)\))." 设 \(S \subset \mathbb{R}\)。若 \(x,y \in S\) 且 \(x < y\) 蕴含 \(f(x) \leq f(y)\)（相应地 \(f(x) < f(y)\)），则称 \(f \colon S \to \mathbb{R}\) 递增（相应地严格递增）。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 3.6.1 Strictly Increasing 严格递增 "Let \(S \subset \mathbb{R}\). We say \(f \colon S \to \mathbb{R}\) is increasing (resp. strictly increasing) if \(x,y \in S\) with \(x < y\) implies \(f(x) \leq f(y)\) (resp. \(f(x) < f(y)\))." 设 \(S \subset \mathbb{R}\)。若 \(x,y \in S\) 且 \(x < y\) 蕴含 \(f(x) \leq f(y)\)（相应地 \(f(x) < f(y)\)），则称 \(f \colon S \to \mathbb{R}\) 递增（相应地严格递增）。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 3.6.1 Decreasing 递减 "We define decreasing and strictly decreasing in the same way by switching the inequalities for \(f\)." 把关于 \(f\) 的不等式反过来，以同样方式定义递减和严格递减。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 3.6.1 Strictly Decreasing 严格递减 "We define decreasing and strictly decreasing in the same way by switching the inequalities for \(f\)." 把关于 \(f\) 的不等式反过来，以同样方式定义递减和严格递减。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 3.6.1 Monotone Function 单调函数 "If a function is either increasing or decreasing, we say it is monotone." 若函数递增或递减，就说它是单调的。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 3.6.1 Strictly Monotone Function 严格单调函数 "If it is strictly increasing or strictly decreasing, we say it is strictly monotone." 若它严格递增或严格递减，就说它是严格单调的。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 3.6.1 Nondecreasing 不减 "Sometimes nondecreasing (resp. nonincreasing) is used for increasing (resp. decreasing) function to emphasize it is not strictly increasing (resp. strictly decreasing)." 有时用不减（相应地不增）来称呼递增（相应地递减）函数，以强调它不是严格递增的（相应地严格递减的）。 Lebl, 2026, section 3.6 Nonincreasing 不增 "Sometimes nondecreasing (resp. nonincreasing) is used for increasing (resp. decreasing) function to emphasize it is not strictly increasing (resp. strictly decreasing)." 有时用不减（相应地不增）来称呼递增（相应地递减）函数，以强调它不是严格递增的（相应地严格递减的）。 Lebl, 2026, section 3.6 References Lebl, J. (2026). Basic analysis I & II: Introduction to real analysis (May 22, 2026 edition). Retrieved October 29, 2026, from https://www.jirka.org/ra/html/

math/intermediate/real-analysis/function.summary: 11.1 Complex numbers Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 11.1 Complex numbers 复数 (No definition) （无定义） Lebl, 2026, section 11.1 Complex Number 复数 "A complex number is just a pair \((x,y) \in \mathbb{R}^2\) on which we define multiplication. We call the set the complex numbers and denote it by \(\mathbb{C}\)." 复数就是在其上定义了乘法的数对 \((x,y) \in \mathbb{R}^2\)。这个集合称为复数集，记作 \(\mathbb{C}\)。 Lebl, 2026, section 11.1 Real Axis 实轴 "We identify \(x \in \mathbb{R}\) with \((x,0) \in \mathbb{C}\). The \(x\)-axis is then called the real axis and the \(y\)-axis is called the imaginary axis." 把 \(x \in \mathbb{R}\) 等同于 \((x,0) \in \mathbb{C}\)。于是 \(x\) 轴称为实轴，\(y\) 轴称为虚轴。 Lebl, 2026, section 11.1 Imaginary Axis 虚轴 "The \(x\)-axis is then called the real axis and the \(y\)-axis is called the imaginary axis." 于是 \(x\) 轴称为实轴，\(y\) 轴称为虚轴。 Lebl, 2026, section 11.1 Complex Plane 复平面 "As \(\mathbb{C}\) is just the plane, we also call the set \(\mathbb{C}\) the complex plane." 由于 \(\mathbb{C}\) 就是平面，也把集合 \(\mathbb{C}\) 称为复平面。 Lebl, 2026, section 11.1 Real Part 实部 "Suppose \(z= x+iy\). We call \(x\) the real part of \(z\), and we call \(y\) the imaginary part of \(z\). We write \(\operatorname{Re}\, z := x , \qquad \operatorname{Im}\, z := y .\)" 设 \(z= x+iy\)。称 \(x\) 为 \(z\) 的实部，称 \(y\) 为 \(z\) 的虚部，记作 \(\operatorname{Re}\, z := x , \qquad \operatorname{Im}\, z := y .\) Lebl, 2026, Definition 11.1.1 Imaginary Part 虚部 "We call \(x\) the real part of \(z\), and we call \(y\) the imaginary part of \(z\)." 称 \(x\) 为 \(z\) 的实部，称 \(y\) 为 \(z\) 的虚部。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 11.1.1 Triangle Inequality for Complex Numbers 复数的三角不等式 "As \(\lvert z \rvert\) is the euclidean norm on \(\mathbb{R}^2\), we have the triangle inequality of both flavors: \(\lvert z+w \rvert \leq \lvert z \rvert+\lvert w \rvert \qquad \text{and} \qquad \big\lvert \lvert z \rvert-\lvert w \rvert \big\rvert \leq \lvert z-w \rvert\)." 由于 \(\lvert z \rvert\) 是 \(\mathbb{R}^2\) 上的欧几里得范数，两种三角不等式都成立：\(\lvert z+w \rvert \leq \lvert z \rvert+\lvert w \rvert \qquad \text{and} \qquad \big\lvert \lvert z \rvert-\lvert w \rvert \big\rvert \leq \lvert z-w \rvert\)。 Lebl, 2026, section 11.1 Convergent Complex Series 收敛的复级数 "Let \(\{ z_n \}_{n=1}^\infty\) be a sequence of complex numbers. The series \(\sum_{n=1}^\infty z_n\) converges if the sequence of partial sums converges, that is, if \(\lim_{k\to\infty} \sum_{n=1}^k z_n \qquad \text{exists.}\)" 设 \(\{ z_n \}_{n=1}^\infty\) 是复数序列。若部分和序列收敛，即 \(\lim_{k\to\infty} \sum_{n=1}^k z_n \qquad \text{exists.}\)，则级数 \(\sum_{n=1}^\infty z_n\) 收敛。 Lebl, 2026, section 11.1 Absolute Convergence of Complex Series 复级数的绝对收敛 "A series converges absolutely if \(\sum_{n=1}^\infty \lvert z_n \rvert\) converges." 若 \(\sum_{n=1}^\infty \lvert z_n \rvert\) 收敛，则称级数绝对收敛。 Lebl, 2026, section 11.1 Cauchy Complex Series 柯西复级数 "We say a series is Cauchy if the sequence of partial sums is Cauchy." 若部分和序列是柯西序列，则称级数是柯西的。 Lebl, 2026, section 11.1 Riemann Integrable Complex-Valued Function 黎曼可积的复值函数 "Suppose we wish to integrate \(f \colon [a,b] \to \mathbb{C}\). We write \(f = u+i\,v\) for real-valued \(u\) and \(v\). We say that \(f\) is Riemann integrable if \(u\) and \(v\) are Riemann integrable, and in this case we define \(\int_a^b f := \int_a^b u + i \int_a^b v\)." 要对 \(f \colon [a,b] \to \mathbb{C}\) 积分，写 \(f = u+i\,v\)，其中 \(u\)、\(v\) 是实值函数。若 \(u\) 与 \(v\) 黎曼可积，则称 \(f\) 黎曼可积，并定义 \(\int_a^b f := \int_a^b u + i \int_a^b v\)。 Lebl, 2026, section 11.1 Derivative of a Complex-Valued Function 复值函数的导数 "Similarly when we differentiate, write \(f \colon [a,b] \to \mathbb{C}\) as \(f = u+i\,v\). Thinking of \(\mathbb{C}\) as \(\mathbb{R}^2\), we say that \(f\) is differentiable if \(u\) and \(v\) are differentiable. In other words, we write the derivative as \(f'(t) := u'(t) + i \, v'(t)\)." 类似地，求导时把 \(f \colon [a,b] \to \mathbb{C}\) 写成 \(f = u+i\,v\)。把 \(\mathbb{C}\) 看作 \(\mathbb{R}^2\)，若 \(u\) 与 \(v\) 可微，则称 \(f\) 可微。换言之，把导数写成 \(f'(t) := u'(t) + i \, v'(t)\)。 Lebl, 2026, section 11.1 References Lebl, J. (2026). Basic analysis I & II: Introduction to real analysis (May 22, 2026 edition). Retrieved October 29, 2026, from https://www.jirka.org/ra/html/

math/intermediate/real-analysis/function.title: 11.2 Swapping limits | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
math/intermediate/real-analysis/function.summary: 11.2 Swapping limits Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 11.2 Swapping limits 交换极限 (No definition) （无定义） Lebl, 2026, section 11.2 Pointwise Convergence of a Complex Series 复函数项级数的逐点收敛 "For \(Y=\mathbb{C}\), a series of functions converges pointwise to \(f\) if for every \(x \in X\), we have \(f(x) = \lim_{n\to \infty} \sum_{k=1}^n f_k(x) = \sum_{k=1}^\infty f_k(x)\)." 对 \(Y=\mathbb{C}\)，若对每个 \(x \in X\) 有 \(f(x) = \lim_{n\to \infty} \sum_{k=1}^n f_k(x) = \sum_{k=1}^\infty f_k(x)\)，则称函数项级数逐点收敛到 \(f\)。 Lebl, 2026, section 11.2 Supremum Norm 上确界范数 "For \(f \colon X \to \mathbb{C}\), we write \(\lVert f \rVert_X := \sup_{x \in X} \bigl\lvert f(x) \bigr\rvert\). We call \(\lVert \cdot \rVert_X\) the supremum norm or uniform norm, and the subscript denotes the set over which the supremum is taken." 对 \(f \colon X \to \mathbb{C}\)，记 \(\lVert f \rVert_X := \sup_{x \in X} \bigl\lvert f(x) \bigr\rvert\)。称 \(\lVert \cdot \rVert_X\) 为上确界范数或一致范数，下标表示取上确界的集合。 Lebl, 2026, section 11.2 Weierstrass M-Test 魏尔斯特拉斯 M 判别法 "Let \(X\) be a set. Suppose \(f_n \colon X \to \mathbb{C}\) are functions and \(M_n > 0\) numbers such that \(\bigl\lvert f_n(x) \bigr\rvert\leq M_n \quad \text{for all } x \in X, \qquad \text{and} \qquad \sum_{n=1}^\infty M_n \quad \text{converges}.\) Then \(\sum_{n=1}^\infty f_n(x) \quad \text{converges uniformly}.\)" 设 \(X\) 是集合，\(f_n \colon X \to \mathbb{C}\) 是函数，\(M_n > 0\) 是数，满足 \(\bigl\lvert f_n(x) \bigr\rvert\leq M_n \quad \text{for all } x \in X, \qquad \text{and} \qquad \sum_{n=1}^\infty M_n \quad \text{converges}.\) 则 \(\sum_{n=1}^\infty f_n(x) \quad \text{converges uniformly}.\) Lebl, 2026, Theorem 11.2.4 Weierstrass Function 魏尔斯特拉斯函数 "There exist continuous nowhere differentiable functions. Such functions are often called Weierstrass functions, although this particular one, essentially due to Takagi, is a different example than what Weierstrass gave." 存在处处连续而处处不可微的函数。这样的函数常被称为魏尔斯特拉斯函数，不过这里这个例子本质上出自高木，与魏尔斯特拉斯给出的例子不同。 Lebl, 2026, Example 11.2.15 References Lebl, J. (2026). Basic analysis I & II: Introduction to real analysis (May 22, 2026 edition). Retrieved October 29, 2026, from https://www.jirka.org/ra/html/

math/intermediate/real-analysis/function.title: 11.3 Power series and analytic functions | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
math/intermediate/real-analysis/function.summary: 11.3 Power series and analytic functions Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 11.3 Power series and analytic functions 幂级数与解析函数 (No definition) （无定义） Lebl, 2026, section 11.3 Convergent Complex Power Series 收敛的复幂级数 "A (complex) power series is a series of the form \(\sum_{n=0}^\infty c_n {(z-a)}^n\) for \(c_n, z, a \in \mathbb{C}\). We say the series converges if the series converges for some \(z \neq a\)." （复）幂级数是形如 \(\sum_{n=0}^\infty c_n {(z-a)}^n\) 的级数，其中 \(c_n, z, a \in \mathbb{C}\)。若级数对某个 \(z \neq a\) 收敛，则称该级数收敛。 Lebl, 2026, section 11.3 Analytic 解析 "Let \(U \subset \mathbb{C}\) be an open set and \(f \colon U \to \mathbb{C}\) a function. Suppose that for every \(a \in U\) there exists a \(\rho > 0\) and a power series that converges to the function \(f(z) = \sum_{n=0}^\infty c_n {(z-a)}^n\) for all \(z \in B(a,\rho)\). Then we say \(f\) is an analytic function." 设 \(U \subset \mathbb{C}\) 是开集，\(f \colon U \to \mathbb{C}\) 是函数。若对每个 \(a \in U\)，存在 \(\rho > 0\) 以及一个幂级数，对所有 \(z \in B(a,\rho)\) 收敛到函数 \(f(z) = \sum_{n=0}^\infty c_n {(z-a)}^n\)，则称 \(f\) 是解析函数。 Lebl, 2026, section 11.3 Real-Analytic 实解析 "Similarly, given an interval \((a,b) \subset \mathbb{R}\), we say that \(f \colon (a,b) \to \mathbb{C}\) is analytic or perhaps real-analytic if for each point \(c \in (a,b)\) there is a power series around \(c\) that converges in some \((c-\rho,c+\rho)\) for some \(\rho > 0\)." 类似地，给定区间 \((a,b) \subset \mathbb{R}\)，若对每个点 \(c \in (a,b)\)，都有一个以 \(c\) 为中心、在某个 \((c-\rho,c+\rho)\)（\(\rho > 0\)）内收敛的幂级数，则称 \(f \colon (a,b) \to \mathbb{C}\) 是解析的，或实解析的。 Lebl, 2026, section 11.3 Taylor’s Theorem for Real-Analytic Functions 实解析函数的泰勒定理 "Let \(f(x) := \sum_{k=0}^\infty a_k x^k\) be a power series converging in \((-\rho,\rho)\) for some \(\rho > 0\). Given any \(a \in (-\rho,\rho)\), and \(x\) such that \(\lvert x-a \rvert < \rho-\lvert a \rvert\), we have \(f(x) = \sum_{k=0}^\infty \frac{f^{(k)}(a)}{k!} {(x-a)}^{k}\)." 设 \(f(x) := \sum_{k=0}^\infty a_k x^k\) 是在某个 \((-\rho,\rho)\)（\(\rho > 0\)）内收敛的幂级数。对任意 \(a \in (-\rho,\rho)\) 及满足 \(\lvert x-a \rvert < \rho-\lvert a \rvert\) 的 \(x\)，有 \(f(x) = \sum_{k=0}^\infty \frac{f^{(k)}(a)}{k!} {(x-a)}^{k}\)。 Lebl, 2026, Theorem 11.3.6 Identity Theorem 恒等定理 "Let \(U \subset \mathbb{C}\) be open and connected. If \(f \colon U \to \mathbb{C}\) and \(g \colon U \to \mathbb{C}\) are analytic functions that are equal on a set \(E \subset U\), and \(E\) has a cluster point in \(U\), then \(f(z) = g(z)\) for all \(z \in U\)." 设 \(U \subset \mathbb{C}\) 是连通开集。若解析函数 \(f \colon U \to \mathbb{C}\) 与 \(g \colon U \to \mathbb{C}\) 在集合 \(E \subset U\) 上相等，且 \(E\) 在 \(U\) 中有聚点，则对所有 \(z \in U\) 有 \(f(z) = g(z)\)。 Lebl, 2026, Theorem 11.3.9 References Lebl, J. (2026). Basic analysis I & II: Introduction to real analysis (May 22, 2026 edition). Retrieved October 29, 2026, from https://www.jirka.org/ra/html/

math/intermediate/real-analysis/function.title: 11.4 Complex exponential and trigonometric functions | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
math/intermediate/real-analysis/function.summary: 11.4 Complex exponential and trigonometric functions Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 11.4 Complex exponential and trigonometric functions 复指数函数与三角函数 (No definition) （无定义） Lebl, 2026, section 11.4 Law of Exponents 指数律 "Let \(z,w \in \mathbb{C}\) be complex numbers. Then \(e^{z+w} = e^z e^w\)." 设 \(z,w \in \mathbb{C}\) 是复数，则 \(e^{z+w} = e^z e^w\)。 Lebl, 2026, Proposition 11.4.1 Cosine 余弦 "In fact, we define sine and cosine for all complex \(z\): \(\cos(z) := \frac{e^{iz} + e^{-iz}}{2}\) and \(\sin(z) := \frac{e^{iz} - e^{-iz}}{2i}\)." 实际上，我们对所有复数 \(z\) 定义正弦与余弦：\(\cos(z) := \frac{e^{iz} + e^{-iz}}{2}\)，\(\sin(z) := \frac{e^{iz} - e^{-iz}}{2i}\)。 Lebl, 2026, section 11.4 Sine 正弦 "In fact, we define sine and cosine for all complex \(z\): \(\cos(z) := \frac{e^{iz} + e^{-iz}}{2}\) and \(\sin(z) := \frac{e^{iz} - e^{-iz}}{2i}\)." 实际上，我们对所有复数 \(z\) 定义正弦与余弦：\(\cos(z) := \frac{e^{iz} + e^{-iz}}{2}\)，\(\sin(z) := \frac{e^{iz} - e^{-iz}}{2i}\)。 Lebl, 2026, section 11.4 Euler’s Formula 欧拉公式 "For all \(z \in \mathbb{C}\), \(e^{iz} = \cos(z) + i\sin(z)\) (Euler's formula)." 对所有 \(z \in \mathbb{C}\)，\(e^{iz} = \cos(z) + i\sin(z)\)（欧拉公式）。 Lebl, 2026, Proposition 11.4.2 Unimodular 单模 "In particular, \(e^{ix}\) is unimodular for real \(x\); the values lie on the unit circle." 特别地，对实数 \(x\)，\(e^{ix}\) 是单模的；它的值位于单位圆上。 Lebl, 2026, section 11.4 Hyperbolic Sine 双曲正弦 "Define the hyperbolic sine and hyperbolic cosine by \(\sinh(z) := \frac{e^z-e^{-z}}{2}\), \(\cosh(z) := \frac{e^z+e^{-z}}{2}\)." 定义双曲正弦和双曲余弦为 \(\sinh(z) := \frac{e^z-e^{-z}}{2}\)，\(\cosh(z) := \frac{e^z+e^{-z}}{2}\)。 Lebl, 2026, Exercises 11.4 Hyperbolic Cosine 双曲余弦 "Define the hyperbolic sine and hyperbolic cosine by \(\sinh(z) := \frac{e^z-e^{-z}}{2}\), \(\cosh(z) := \frac{e^z+e^{-z}}{2}\)." 定义双曲正弦和双曲余弦为 \(\sinh(z) := \frac{e^z-e^{-z}}{2}\)，\(\cosh(z) := \frac{e^z+e^{-z}}{2}\)。 Lebl, 2026, Exercises 11.4 References Lebl, J. (2026). Basic analysis I & II: Introduction to real analysis (May 22, 2026 edition). Retrieved October 29, 2026, from https://www.jirka.org/ra/html/

math/intermediate/real-analysis/function.title: 11.5 Maximum principle and the fundamental theorem of algebra | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
math/intermediate/real-analysis/function.summary: 11.5 Maximum principle and the fundamental theorem of algebra Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 11.5 Maximum principle and the fundamental theorem of algebra 最大模原理与代数基本定理 (No definition) （无定义） Lebl, 2026, section 11.5 Minimum Modulus Principle 最小模原理 "What the lemma says is that the only minima the modulus of analytic functions has are precisely at the zeros. It is sometimes called the minimum modulus principle." 这个引理说的是：解析函数的模的极小值只出现在零点处。它有时称为最小模原理。 Lebl, 2026, section 11.5 Maximum Modulus Principle 最大模原理 "If \(U \subset \mathbb{C}\) is open and connected, \(f \colon U \to \mathbb{C}\) is analytic, and \(\bigl\lvert f(z) \bigr\rvert\) attains a relative maximum at \(z_0 \in U\), then \(f\) is constant." 若 \(U \subset \mathbb{C}\) 是连通开集，\(f \colon U \to \mathbb{C}\) 解析，且 \(\bigl\lvert f(z) \bigr\rvert\) 在 \(z_0 \in U\) 处取得相对极大值，则 \(f\) 是常数。 Lebl, 2026, Theorem 11.5.2 Fundamental Theorem of Algebra 代数基本定理 "Let \(p(z)\) be a nonconstant complex polynomial, then there exists a \(z_0 \in \mathbb{C}\) such that \(p(z_0) = 0\)." 设 \(p(z)\) 是非常数的复多项式，则存在 \(z_0 \in \mathbb{C}\) 使得 \(p(z_0) = 0\)。 Lebl, 2026, Theorem 11.5.5 Rational Function 有理函数 "A rational function is a function \(f(z) := \frac{p(z)}{q(z)}\) where \(p\) and \(q\) are polynomials and \(q\) is not identically zero." 有理函数是形如 \(f(z) := \frac{p(z)}{q(z)}\) 的函数，其中 \(p\)、\(q\) 是多项式且 \(q\) 不恒为零。 Lebl, 2026, Exercises 11.5 Zero of a Function 函数的零点 "A point \(z_0 \in \mathbb{C}\) where \(f(z_0) = 0\) (and therefore \(p(z_0) = 0\)) is called a zero." 使 \(f(z_0) = 0\) 的点 \(z_0 \in \mathbb{C}\)（因而 \(p(z_0) = 0\)）称为零点。 Lebl, 2026, Exercises 11.5 Singularity 奇点 "A point \(z_0 \in \mathbb{C}\) is called a singularity of \(f\) if \(q(z_0) = 0\)." 若 \(q(z_0) = 0\)，则点 \(z_0 \in \mathbb{C}\) 称为 \(f\) 的奇点。 Lebl, 2026, Exercises 11.5 Isolated Singularity 孤立奇点 "As zeros of polynomials are isolated, singularities of rational functions are isolated and so are called isolated singularities." 由于多项式的零点是孤立的，有理函数的奇点是孤立的，因而称为孤立奇点。 Lebl, 2026, Exercises 11.5 Pole 极点 "An isolated singularity is called a pole if \(\lim_{z \to z_0} \bigl\lvert f(z) \bigr\rvert = \infty\)." 若 \(\lim_{z \to z_0} \bigl\lvert f(z) \bigr\rvert = \infty\)，则孤立奇点称为极点。 Lebl, 2026, Exercises 11.5 References Lebl, J. (2026). Basic analysis I & II: Introduction to real analysis (May 22, 2026 edition). Retrieved October 29, 2026, from https://www.jirka.org/ra/html/

math/intermediate/real-analysis/function.title: 11.6 Equicontinuity and the Arzelà–Ascoli theorem | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
math/intermediate/real-analysis/function.summary: 11.6 Equicontinuity and the Arzelà–Ascoli theorem Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 11.6 Equicontinuity and the Arzelà–Ascoli theorem 等度连续与阿尔泽拉–阿斯科利定理 (No definition) （无定义） Lebl, 2026, section 11.6 Pointwise Bounded 逐点有界 "Let \(X\) be a set and \(f_n \colon X \to \mathbb{C}\) be a sequence of functions. We say that \(\{ f_n \}_{n=1}^\infty\) is pointwise bounded if for every \(x \in X\), there is an \(M_x \in \mathbb{R}\) such that \(\bigl\lvert f_n(x) \bigr\rvert \leq M_x \qquad \text{for all } n \in \mathbb{N} .\)" 设 \(X\) 是集合，\(f_n \colon X \to \mathbb{C}\) 是函数序列。若对每个 \(x \in X\)，存在 \(M_x \in \mathbb{R}\) 使得 \(\bigl\lvert f_n(x) \bigr\rvert \leq M_x \qquad \text{for all } n \in \mathbb{N} .\)，则称 \(\{ f_n \}_{n=1}^\infty\) 逐点有界。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 11.6.1 Uniformly Bounded 一致有界 "We say that \(\{ f_n \}_{n=1}^\infty\) is uniformly bounded if there is an \(M \in \mathbb{R}\) such that \(\bigl\lvert f_n(x) \bigr\rvert \leq M \qquad \text{for all } n \in \mathbb{N} \text{ and all } x \in X.\)" 若存在 \(M \in \mathbb{R}\) 使得 \(\bigl\lvert f_n(x) \bigr\rvert \leq M \qquad \text{for all } n \in \mathbb{N} \text{ and all } x \in X.\)，则称 \(\{ f_n \}_{n=1}^\infty\) 一致有界。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 11.6.1 Uniformly Equicontinuous 一致等度连续 "Let \((X,d)\) be a metric space. A set \(S\) of functions \(f \colon X \to \mathbb{C}\) is uniformly equicontinuous if for every \(\epsilon > 0\), there is a \(\delta > 0\) such that if \(x,y \in X\) with \(d(x,y) < \delta\), we have \(\bigl\lvert f(x)-f(y) \bigr\rvert < \epsilon \qquad \text{for all } f \in S .\)" 设 \((X,d)\) 是度量空间。若对每个 \(\epsilon > 0\)，存在 \(\delta > 0\)，使得只要 \(x,y \in X\) 且 \(d(x,y) < \delta\)，就有 \(\bigl\lvert f(x)-f(y) \bigr\rvert < \epsilon \qquad \text{for all } f \in S .\)，则称函数 \(f \colon X \to \mathbb{C}\) 的集合 \(S\) 一致等度连续。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 11.6.6 Equicontinuous 等度连续 "Just as for continuity, one can define equicontinuity at a point. That is, \(S\) is equicontinuous at \(x \in X\) if for every \(\epsilon > 0\), there is a \(\delta > 0\) such that for \(y \in X\) with \(d(x,y) < \delta\), we have \(\bigl\lvert f(x)-f(y) \bigr\rvert < \epsilon\) for all \(f \in S\)." 和连续性一样，可以定义在一点处的等度连续性：若对每个 \(\epsilon > 0\)，存在 \(\delta > 0\)，使得对满足 \(d(x,y) < \delta\) 的 \(y \in X\)，对所有 \(f \in S\) 有 \(\bigl\lvert f(x)-f(y) \bigr\rvert < \epsilon\)，则称 \(S\) 在 \(x \in X\) 处等度连续。 Lebl, 2026, section 11.6 Arzelà–Ascoli Theorem 阿尔泽拉–阿斯科利定理 "Let \((X,d)\) be a compact metric space, and let \(\{ f_n \}_{n=1}^\infty\) be pointwise bounded and uniformly equicontinuous sequence of functions \(f_n \in C(X,\mathbb{C})\). Then \(\{f_n\}_{n=1}^\infty\) is uniformly bounded and \(\{ f_n \}_{n=1}^\infty\) contains a uniformly convergent subsequence." 设 \((X,d)\) 是紧度量空间，\(\{ f_n \}_{n=1}^\infty\) 是逐点有界且一致等度连续的函数序列，\(f_n \in C(X,\mathbb{C})\)，则 \(\{f_n\}_{n=1}^\infty\) 一致有界，且含有一致收敛的子序列。 Lebl, 2026, Theorem 11.6.9 Compact Operator 紧算子 "Via Arzelà–Ascoli, we also find (exercise) that the image of the unit ball of functions \(T\bigl( B(0,1) \bigr)\) has compact closure, usually called relatively compact. Such an operator is called a compact operator." 借助阿尔泽拉–阿斯科利定理还可以得到（习题）：函数单位球的像 \(T\bigl( B(0,1) \bigr)\) 有紧闭包，通常称为相对紧。这样的算子称为紧算子。 Lebl, 2026, section 11.6 Kronecker Density Theorem 克罗内克稠密性定理 "Hint: Feel free to use the Kronecker density theorem: The sequence \(\{ e^{in} \}_{n=1}^\infty\) is dense in the unit circle." 提示：可以使用克罗内克稠密性定理：序列 \(\{ e^{in} \}_{n=1}^\infty\) 在单位圆中稠密。 Lebl, 2026, Exercise 11.6.10 Peano Existence Theorem 皮亚诺存在定理 "Prove the Peano existence theorem (note the weaker hypotheses than Picard, but also the lack of uniqueness in this theorem): Theorem: Suppose \(F \colon I \times J \to \mathbb{R}\) is a continuous function where \(I, J \subset \mathbb{R}\) are closed bounded intervals, let \(I^\circ\) and \(J^\circ\) be their interiors, and let \((x_0,y_0) \in I^\circ \times J^\circ\). Then there exists an \(h > 0\) and a differentiable function \(f \colon [x_0 - h, x_0 + h] \to J \subset \mathbb{R}\), such that \(f'(x) = F\bigl(x,f(x)\bigr)\) and \(f(x_0) = y_0\)." 证明皮亚诺存在定理（注意它的假设比皮卡定理弱，但也没有唯一性）：定理：设 \(F \colon I \times J \to \mathbb{R}\) 是连续函数，\(I, J \subset \mathbb{R}\) 是有界闭区间，\(I^\circ\)、\(J^\circ\) 是它们的内部，\((x_0,y_0) \in I^\circ \times J^\circ\)，则存在 \(h > 0\) 和可微函数 \(f \colon [x_0 - h, x_0 + h] \to J \subset \mathbb{R}\)，满足 \(f'(x) = F\bigl(x,f(x)\bigr)\) 且 \(f(x_0) = y_0\)。 Lebl, 2026, Exercise 11.6.11 References Lebl, J. (2026). Basic analysis I & II: Introduction to real analysis (May 22, 2026 edition). Retrieved October 29, 2026, from https://www.jirka.org/ra/html/

11.7 The Stone–Weierstrass theorem Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 11.7 The Stone–Weierstrass theorem 斯通–魏尔斯特拉斯定理 (No definition) （无定义） Lebl, 2026, section 11.7 Approximate Delta Function 近似 δ 函数 "The idea of the proof is a very common approximation or “smoothing” idea (convolution with an approximate delta function) that has applications far beyond pure mathematics." 证明的思路是一种非常常见的逼近或“光滑化”思想（与近似 δ 函数作卷积），它的应用远远超出纯粹数学。 Lebl, 2026, section 11.7 Weierstrass Approximation Theorem 魏尔斯特拉斯逼近定理 "If \(f \colon [a,b] 	o \mathbb{C}\) is continuous, then there exists a sequence \(\{ p_n \}_{n=1}^\infty\) of polynomials converging to \(f\) uniformly on \([a,b]\). Furthermore, if \(f\) is real-valued, we can find \(p_n\) with real coefficients." 若 \(f \colon [a,b] 	o \mathbb{C}\) 连续，则存在在 \([a,b]\) 上一致收敛到 \(f\) 的多项式序列 \(\{ p_n \}_{n=1}^\infty\)。此外，若 \(f\) 是实值的，可以取实系数的 \(p_n\)。 Lebl, 2026, Theorem 11.7.1 Complex Algebra 复代数 "A set \(\mathcal{A}\) of complex-valued functions \(f \colon X 	o \mathbb{C}\) is said to be an algebra (sometimes complex algebra or algebra over \(\mathbb{C}\)) if for all \(f, g \in \mathcal{A}\) and \(c \in \mathbb{C}\), we have \(f+g \in \mathcal{A}\). \(fg \in \mathcal{A}\). \(cg \in \mathcal{A}\)." 若对所有 \(f, g \in \mathcal{A}\) 和 \(c \in \mathbb{C}\)，有 \(f+g \in \mathcal{A}\)、\(fg \in \mathcal{A}\)、\(cg \in \mathcal{A}\)，则复值函数 \(f \colon X 	o \mathbb{C}\) 的集合 \(\mathcal{A}\) 称为代数（有时称为复代数或 \(\mathbb{C}\) 上的代数）。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 11.7.5 Real Algebra 实代数 "A real algebra or an algebra over \(\mathbb{R}\) is a set of real-valued functions that satisfies the three properties above for \(c \in \mathbb{R}\)." 实代数或 \(\mathbb{R}\) 上的代数是对 \(c \in \mathbb{R}\) 满足上述三条性质的实值函数集合。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 11.7.5 Separates Points 分离点 "Let \(\mathcal{A}\) be a set of complex-valued functions defined on a set \(X\). \(\mathcal{A}\) separates points if for every \(x,y \in X\) with \(x 
eq y\), there is an \(f \in \mathcal{A}\) such that \(f(x) 
eq f(y)\)." 设 \(\mathcal{A}\) 是定义在集合 \(X\) 上的复值函数的集合。若对每对 \(x 
eq y\) 的 \(x,y \in X\)，存在 \(f \in \mathcal{A}\) 使得 \(f(x) 
eq f(y)\)，则称 \(\mathcal{A}\) 分离点。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 11.7.7 Vanishes at No Point 处处不为零 "\(\mathcal{A}\) vanishes at no point if for every \(x \in X\) there is an \(f \in \mathcal{A}\) such that \(f(x) 
eq 0\)." 若对每个 \(x \in X\)，存在 \(f \in \mathcal{A}\) 使得 \(f(x) 
eq 0\)，则称 \(\mathcal{A}\) 处处不为零。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 11.7.7 Stone–Weierstrass Theorem, Real Version 斯通–魏尔斯特拉斯定理（实版本） "Let \(X\) be a compact metric space and \(\mathcal{A}\) a real algebra of real-valued continuous functions on \(X\), such that \(\mathcal{A}\) separates points and vanishes at no point. Then the closure \(\overline{\mathcal{A}} = C(X,\mathbb{R})\)." 设 \(X\) 是紧度量空间，\(\mathcal{A}\) 是 \(X\) 上实值连续函数构成的实代数，且 \(\mathcal{A}\) 分离点、处处不为零，则闭包 \(\overline{\mathcal{A}} = C(X,\mathbb{R})\)。 Lebl, 2026, Theorem 11.7.12 Generate an Algebra 生成代数 "In general, given a set of functions that separates points and does not vanish at any point, we let these functions generate an algebra by considering all the linear combinations of arbitrary multiples of such functions." 一般地，给定一组分离点且处处不为零的函数，通过考虑这些函数的任意乘积的全部线性组合，让它们生成一个代数。 Lebl, 2026, section 11.7 Self-Adjoint 自伴 "An algebra \(\mathcal{A}\) is self-adjoint if for all \(f \in \mathcal{A}\), the function \( ar{f}\) defined by \( ar{f}(x) := \overline{f(x)}\) is in \(\mathcal{A}\), where by the bar we mean the complex conjugate." 若对所有 \(f \in \mathcal{A}\)，由 \( ar{f}(x) := \overline{f(x)}\) 定义的函数 \( ar{f}\) 也属于 \(\mathcal{A}\)（横线表示复共轭），则称代数 \(\mathcal{A}\) 自伴。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 11.7.15 Stone–Weierstrass Theorem, Complex Version 斯通–魏尔斯特拉斯定理（复版本） "Let \(X\) be a compact metric space and \(\mathcal{A}\) an algebra of complex-valued continuous functions on \(X\), such that \(\mathcal{A}\) separates points, vanishes at no point, and is self-adjoint. Then the closure \(\overline{\mathcal{A}} = C(X,\mathbb{C})\)." 设 \(X\) 是紧度量空间，\(\mathcal{A}\) 是 \(X\) 上复值连续函数构成的代数，且 \(\mathcal{A}\) 分离点、处处不为零并且自伴，则闭包 \(\overline{\mathcal{A}} = C(X,\mathbb{C})\)。 Lebl, 2026, Theorem 11.7.16 Harmonic Polynomials 调和多项式 "Show that functions of the form \(c_0 + \sum_{k=1}^n c_k \, z^k + \sum_{k=1}^n c_{-k}\,  ar{z}^k\) are dense in \(C(S^1,\mathbb{C})\). These functions are called harmonic polynomials." 证明形如 \(c_0 + \sum_{k=1}^n c_k \, z^k + \sum_{k=1}^n c_{-k}\,  ar{z}^k\) 的函数在 \(C(S^1,\mathbb{C})\) 中稠密。这些函数称为调和多项式。 Lebl, 2026, Exercise 11.7.7 References Lebl, J. (2026). Basic analysis I & II: Introduction to real analysis (May 22, 2026 edition). Retrieved October 29, 2026, from https://www.jirka.org/ra/html/

math/intermediate/real-analysis/function.summary: 11.8 Fourier series Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 11.8 Fourier series 傅里叶级数 (No definition) （无定义） Lebl, 2026, section 11.8 Trigonometric Polynomial 三角多项式 "A trigonometric polynomial is an expression of the form \(a_0 + \sum_{n=1}^N \bigl(a_n \cos(nx) + b_n \sin(nx) \bigr)\), or equivalently, thanks to Euler’s formula (\(e^{i\theta} = \cos(\theta) + i \sin(\theta)\)): \(\sum_{n=-N}^N c_n e^{inx}\)." 三角多项式是形如 \(a_0 + \sum_{n=1}^N \bigl(a_n \cos(nx) + b_n \sin(nx) \bigr)\) 的表达式，借助欧拉公式（\(e^{i\theta} = \cos(\theta) + i \sin(\theta)\)），等价地写成 \(\sum_{n=-N}^N c_n e^{inx}\)。 Lebl, 2026, section 11.8 Fourier Series 傅里叶级数 "We now take limits. The series \(\sum_{n=-\infty}^\infty c_n \, e^{inx}\) is called the Fourier series and the numbers \(c_n\) the Fourier coefficients." 现在取极限。级数 \(\sum_{n=-\infty}^\infty c_n \, e^{inx}\) 称为傅里叶级数，数 \(c_n\) 称为傅里叶系数。 Lebl, 2026, section 11.8 Fourier Coefficients 傅里叶系数 "The series \(\sum_{n=-\infty}^\infty c_n \, e^{inx}\) is called the Fourier series and the numbers \(c_n\) the Fourier coefficients." 级数 \(\sum_{n=-\infty}^\infty c_n \, e^{inx}\) 称为傅里叶级数，数 \(c_n\) 称为傅里叶系数。 Lebl, 2026, section 11.8 Symmetric Partial Sums 对称部分和 "In light of this, define the symmetric partial sums \(s_N(f;x) := \sum_{n=-N}^N c_n \,e^{inx}\)." 据此，定义对称部分和 \(s_N(f;x) := \sum_{n=-N}^N c_n \,e^{inx}\)。 Lebl, 2026, section 11.8 Inner Product 内积 "Let \(f\) and \(g\) be complex-valued Riemann integrable functions on \([a,b]\) and define the inner product \(\langle f , g \rangle := \int_a^b f(x) \overline{g(x)} \, dx\)." 设 \(f\) 与 \(g\) 是 \([a,b]\) 上黎曼可积的复值函数，定义内积 \(\langle f , g \rangle := \int_a^b f(x) \overline{g(x)} \, dx\)。 Lebl, 2026, section 11.8 Orthonormal System 规范正交系 "Let \(\{ \varphi_n \}_{n=1}^\infty\) be a sequence of integrable complex-valued functions on \([a,b]\). We say that this is an orthonormal system if \(\langle \varphi_n , \varphi_m \rangle = \int_a^b \varphi_n(x) \, \overline{\varphi_m(x)} \, dx = \begin{cases} 1 & \text{if } n=m, \\ 0 & \text{otherwise.} \end{cases}\)" 设 \(\{ \varphi_n \}_{n=1}^\infty\) 是 \([a,b]\) 上可积复值函数的序列。若 \(\langle \varphi_n , \varphi_m \rangle = \int_a^b \varphi_n(x) \, \overline{\varphi_m(x)} \, dx = \begin{cases} 1 & \text{if } n=m, \\ 0 & \text{otherwise.} \end{cases}\)，则称它是规范正交系。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 11.8.7 Orthogonal System 正交系 "If we only require that \(\langle \varphi_n , \varphi_m \rangle = 0\) for \(m \neq n\), then the system would be called an orthogonal system." 若只要求当 \(m \neq n\) 时 \(\langle \varphi_n , \varphi_m \rangle = 0\)，则该函数系称为正交系。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 11.8.7 Bessel’s Inequality 贝塞尔不等式 "Suppose \(f\) is a Riemann integrable function on \([a,b]\). Let \(\{ \varphi_n \}_{n=1}^\infty\) be an orthonormal system on \([a,b]\) and suppose \(f(x) \sim \sum_{n=1}^\infty c_n \varphi_n(x)\). Then \(\sum_{n=1}^\infty \lvert c_n \rvert^2 \leq \int_a^b \lvert f \rvert^2 = \lVert f \rVert_2^2\)." 设 \(f\) 是 \([a,b]\) 上的黎曼可积函数，\(\{ \varphi_n \}_{n=1}^\infty\) 是 \([a,b]\) 上的规范正交系，且 \(f(x) \sim \sum_{n=1}^\infty c_n \varphi_n(x)\)，则 \(\sum_{n=1}^\infty \lvert c_n \rvert^2 \leq \int_a^b \lvert f \rvert^2 = \lVert f \rVert_2^2\)。 Lebl, 2026, Theorem 11.8.9 Dirichlet Kernel 狄利克雷核 "Let the Dirichlet kernel be \(D_N(x) := \sum_{n=-N}^N e^{inx}\)." 令狄利克雷核为 \(D_N(x) := \sum_{n=-N}^N e^{inx}\)。 Lebl, 2026, section 11.8 Piecewise Smooth 分段光滑 "A function \(f \colon [a,b] \to \mathbb{C}\) is continuous piecewise smooth if it is continuous and there exist points \(x_0 = a < x_1 < x_2 < \cdots < x_k = b\) such that for every \(j\), \(f\) restricted to \([x_j,x_{j+1}]\) is continuously differentiable (up to the endpoints)." 若函数 \(f \colon [a,b] \to \mathbb{C}\) 连续，且存在点 \(x_0 = a < x_1 < x_2 < \cdots < x_k = b\)，使得对每个 \(j\)，\(f\) 在 \([x_j,x_{j+1}]\) 上的限制（直到端点）连续可微，则称 \(f\) 是连续分段光滑的。 Lebl, 2026, section 11.8 Parseval’s Theorem 帕塞瓦尔定理 "Let \(f\) and \(g\) be \(2\pi\)-periodic functions, Riemann integrable on \([-\pi,\pi]\) with \(f(x) \sim \sum_{n=-\infty}^\infty c_n \,e^{inx}\) and \(g(x) \sim \sum_{n=-\infty}^\infty d_n \,e^{inx}\). Then \(\lim_{N\to\infty} \bigl\lVert f-s_N(f) \bigr\rVert_2^2 = 0\). Also \(\langle f , g \rangle = \sum_{n=-\infty}^\infty c_n \overline{d_n}\), and \(\lVert f \rVert_2^2 = \sum_{n=-\infty}^\infty \lvert c_n \rvert^2\)." 设 \(f\) 与 \(g\) 是以 \(2\pi\) 为周期、在 \([-\pi,\pi]\) 上黎曼可积的函数，\(f(x) \sim \sum_{n=-\infty}^\infty c_n \,e^{inx}\)，\(g(x) \sim \sum_{n=-\infty}^\infty d_n \,e^{inx}\)，则 \(\lim_{N\to\infty} \bigl\lVert f-s_N(f) \bigr\rVert_2^2 = 0\)；并且 \(\langle f , g \rangle = \sum_{n=-\infty}^\infty c_n \overline{d_n}\)，\(\lVert f \rVert_2^2 = \sum_{n=-\infty}^\infty \lvert c_n \rvert^2\)。 Lebl, 2026, Theorem 11.8.13 References Lebl, J. (2026). Basic analysis I & II: Introduction to real analysis (May 22, 2026 edition). Retrieved October 29, 2026, from https://www.jirka.org/ra/html/

0.3 Basic set theory Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 0.3 Basic set theory 基本集合论 (No definition) （无定义） Lebl, 2026, section 0.3 Naïve Set Theory 朴素集合论 "We talk about sets in a rather informal way, using what is usually called “naïve set theory.”" 我们以一种相当非正式的方式谈论集合，用的是通常所说的“朴素集合论”。 Lebl, 2026, section 0.3 Set 集合 "A set is a collection of objects called elements or members." 集合是由称为元素或成员的对象组成的一个总体。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 0.3.1 Element 元素 "A set is a collection of objects called elements or members." 集合是由称为元素或成员的对象组成的一个总体。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 0.3.1 Empty Set 空集 "A set with no objects is called the empty set and is denoted by \(\emptyset\) (or sometimes by \(\{ \}\))." 不含任何对象的集合称为空集，记作 \(\emptyset\)（有时也记作 \(\{ \}\)）。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 0.3.1 Universe 全集 "The elements of all sets under consideration come from some set we call the universe." 所考虑的一切集合的元素都来自某个集合，我们称之为全集。 Lebl, 2026, section 0.3 Subset 子集 "A set \(A\) is a subset of a set \(B\) if \(x \in A\) implies \(x \in B\), and we write \(A \subset B\)." 若 \(x \in A\) 蕴含 \(x \in B\)，则集合 \(A\) 是集合 \(B\) 的子集，记作 \(A \subset B\)。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 0.3.2 Equal 相等 "Two sets \(A\) and \(B\) are equal if \(A \subset B\) and \(B \subset A\)." 若 \(A \subset B\) 且 \(B \subset A\)，则两个集合 \(A\) 与 \(B\) 相等。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 0.3.2 Proper Subset 真子集 "A set \(A\) is a proper subset of \(B\) if \(A \subset B\) and \(A 
eq B\)." 若 \(A \subset B\) 且 \(A 
eq B\)，则集合 \(A\) 是 \(B\) 的真子集。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 0.3.2 Set Building Notation 集合构造记号 "To define new sets, one often uses the set building notation, \( igl\{ x \in A : P(x)  igr\}\). This notation refers to a subset of the set \(A\) containing all elements of \(A\) that satisfy the property \(P(x)\)." 定义新集合时常用集合构造记号 \( igl\{ x \in A : P(x)  igr\}\)。这个记号表示集合 \(A\) 中由满足性质 \(P(x)\) 的全部元素组成的子集。 Lebl, 2026, section 0.3 Natural Numbers 自然数 "The set of natural numbers, \(\mathbb{N} := \{ 1, 2, 3, \ldots \}\)." 自然数集，\(\mathbb{N} := \{ 1, 2, 3, \ldots \}\)。 Lebl, 2026, Example 0.3.3 Integers 整数 "The set of integers, \(\mathbb{Z} := \{ 0, -1, 1, -2, 2, \ldots \}\)." 整数集，\(\mathbb{Z} := \{ 0, -1, 1, -2, 2, \ldots \}\)。 Lebl, 2026, Example 0.3.3 Rational Numbers 有理数 "The set of rational numbers, \(\mathbb{Q} :=  igl\{  rac{m}{n} : m, n \in \mathbb{Z} 	ext{ and } n 
eq 0  igr\}\)." 有理数集，\(\mathbb{Q} :=  igl\{  rac{m}{n} : m, n \in \mathbb{Z} 	ext{ and } n 
eq 0  igr\}\)。 Lebl, 2026, Example 0.3.3 Union 并集 "A union of two sets \(A\) and \(B\) is defined as \(A \cup B := \{ x : x \in A 	ext{ or } x \in B \}\)." 两个集合 \(A\) 与 \(B\) 的并集定义为 \(A \cup B := \{ x : x \in A 	ext{ or } x \in B \}\)。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 0.3.4 Intersection 交集 "An intersection of two sets \(A\) and \(B\) is defined as \(A \cap B := \{ x : x \in A 	ext{ and } x \in B \}\)." 两个集合 \(A\) 与 \(B\) 的交集定义为 \(A \cap B := \{ x : x \in A 	ext{ and } x \in B \}\)。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 0.3.4 Set-Theoretic Difference 差集 "A complement of \(B\) relative to \(A\) (or set-theoretic difference of \(A\) and \(B\)) is defined as \(A \setminus B := \{ x : x \in A 	ext{ and } x 
otin B \}\)." \(B\) 相对于 \(A\) 的补集（或 \(A\) 与 \(B\) 的差集）定义为 \(A \setminus B := \{ x : x \in A 	ext{ and } x 
otin B \}\)。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 0.3.4 Complement 补集 "We say complement of \(B\) and write \(B^c\) instead of \(A \setminus B\) if the set \(A\) is either the entire universe or if it is the obvious set containing \(B\), and is understood from context." 如果集合 \(A\) 是整个全集，或者是包含 \(B\) 的显而易见的集合，并且从上下文可以明白，我们就说 \(B\) 的补集，记作 \(B^c\) 而不写 \(A \setminus B\)。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 0.3.4 Disjoint 不相交 "We say sets \(A\) and \(B\) are disjoint if \(A \cap B = \emptyset\)." 若 \(A \cap B = \emptyset\)，则称集合 \(A\) 与 \(B\) 不相交。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 0.3.4 Venn Diagram 维恩图 "We illustrate the operations on the Venn diagrams in Figure 2." 我们在图 2 的维恩图上图示这些运算。 Lebl, 2026, section 0.3 DeMorgan’s Theorem 德摩根定理 "Let \(A, B, C\) be sets. Then \({(B \cup C)}^c = B^c \cap C^c , \qquad {(B \cap C)}^c = B^c \cup C^c ,\) or, more generally, \(A \setminus (B \cup C) = (A \setminus B) \cap (A \setminus C) , \qquad A \setminus (B \cap C) = (A \setminus B) \cup (A \setminus C) .\)" 设 \(A, B, C\) 是集合，则 \({(B \cup C)}^c = B^c \cap C^c , \qquad {(B \cap C)}^c = B^c \cup C^c ,\) 更一般地，\(A \setminus (B \cup C) = (A \setminus B) \cap (A \setminus C) , \qquad A \setminus (B \cap C) = (A \setminus B) \cup (A \setminus C) .\) Lebl, 2026, Theorem 0.3.5 Least Element 最小元 "By \(S \subset \mathbb{N}\) having a least element, we mean that there exists an \(x \in S\), such that for every \(y \in S\), we have \(x \leq y\)." 说 \(S \subset \mathbb{N}\) 有最小元，是指存在 \(x \in S\)，使得对每个 \(y \in S\) 都有 \(x \leq y\)。 Lebl, 2026, section 0.3 Well Ordering Property 良序性 "Every nonempty subset of \(\mathbb{N}\) has a least (smallest) element" \(\mathbb{N}\) 的每个非空子集都有最小元 Lebl, 2026, Axiom (Well ordering property of ℕ) Axiom 公理 "The natural numbers \(\mathbb{N}\) ordered in the natural way possess the well ordering property. We take this property as an axiom; we simply assume it is true." 按自然顺序排列的自然数 \(\mathbb{N}\) 具有良序性。我们把这个性质当作公理，即直接假定它成立。 Lebl, 2026, section 0.3 Principle of Induction 归纳原理 "Let \(P(n)\) be a statement depending on a natural number \(n\). Suppose that (basis statement) \(P(1)\) is true. (induction step) If \(P(n)\) is true, then \(P(n+1)\) is true. Then \(P(n)\) is true for all \(n \in \mathbb{N}\)." 设 \(P(n)\) 是依赖于自然数 \(n\) 的命题。假设（基础命题）\(P(1)\) 为真；（归纳步骤）若 \(P(n)\) 为真，则 \(P(n+1)\) 为真。那么对所有 \(n \in \mathbb{N}\)，\(P(n)\) 为真。 Lebl, 2026, Theorem 0.3.6 Basis Statement 基础命题 "(basis statement) \(P(1)\) is true." （基础命题）\(P(1)\) 为真。 Lebl, 2026, Theorem 0.3.6 Induction Step 归纳步骤 "(induction step) If \(P(n)\) is true, then \(P(n+1)\) is true." （归纳步骤）若 \(P(n)\) 为真，则 \(P(n+1)\) 为真。 Lebl, 2026, Theorem 0.3.6 Induction Hypothesis 归纳假设 "The assumption that \(P(n)\) is true in “if \(P(n)\) is true, then \(P(n+1)\) is true” is usually called the induction hypothesis." “若 \(P(n)\) 为真，则 \(P(n+1)\) 为真”中假定 \(P(n)\) 为真的那个假设，通常称为归纳假设。 Lebl, 2026, section 0.3 Strong Induction 强归纳法 "Sometimes, it is easier to use in the inductive step that \(P(k)\) is true for all \(k = 1,2,\ldots,n\), not just for \(k=n\). This principle is called strong induction and is equivalent to the normal induction above." 有时在归纳步骤中用对所有 \(k = 1,2,\ldots,n\)（而不只是 \(k=n\)）\(P(k)\) 都为真会更方便。这个原理称为强归纳法，它与上面的普通归纳法等价。 Lebl, 2026, section 0.3 Function 函数 "Informally, a set-theoretic function \(f\) taking a set \(A\) to a set \(B\) is a mapping that to each \(x \in A\) assigns a unique \(y \in B\)." 非正式地说，把集合 \(A\) 带到集合 \(B\) 的集合论函数 \(f\) 是一个给每个 \(x \in A\) 指定唯一 \(y \in B\) 的映射。 Lebl, 2026, section 0.3 Cartesian Product 笛卡儿积 "Let \(A\) and \(B\) be sets. The Cartesian product is the set of tuples defined as \(A 	imes B :=  igl\{ (x,y) : x \in A, y \in B  igr\}\)." 设 \(A\) 与 \(B\) 是集合。笛卡儿积是如下定义的有序组的集合：\(A 	imes B :=  igl\{ (x,y) : x \in A, y \in B  igr\}\)。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 0.3.10 Graph 图像 "If we consider \(f\) simply as a subset in \(A 	imes B\), then we call this set the graph of the function." 如果把 \(f\) 单纯看作 \(A 	imes B\) 中的一个子集，就称这个集合为函数的图像。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 0.3.11 Domain 定义域 "The set \(A\) is called the domain of \(f\) (and sometimes confusingly denoted \(D(f)\))." 集合 \(A\) 称为 \(f\) 的定义域（有时也容易混淆地记作 \(D(f)\)）。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 0.3.11 Range 值域 "The set \(R(f) := \{ y \in B : 	ext{there exists an } x \in A 	ext{ such that } f(x)=y \}\) is called the range of \(f\)." 集合 \(R(f) := \{ y \in B : 	ext{there exists an } x \in A 	ext{ such that } f(x)=y \}\) 称为 \(f\) 的值域。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 0.3.11 Codomain 陪域 "The set \(B\) is called the codomain of \(f\)." 集合 \(B\) 称为 \(f\) 的陪域。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 0.3.11 Image 像 "Define the image (or direct image) of a subset \(C \subset A\) as \(f(C) :=  igl\{ f(x) \in B : x \in C  igr\}\)." 子集 \(C \subset A\) 的像（或正像）定义为 \(f(C) :=  igl\{ f(x) \in B : x \in C  igr\}\)。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 0.3.13 Inverse Image 原像 "Define the inverse image of a subset \(D \subset B\) as \(f^{-1}(D) :=  igl\{ x \in A : f(x) \in D  igr\}\)." 子集 \(D \subset B\) 的原像定义为 \(f^{-1}(D) :=  igl\{ x \in A : f(x) \in D  igr\}\)。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 0.3.13 Injective 单射的 "Let \(f \colon A 	o B\) be a function. The function \(f\) is said to be injective or one-to-one if \(f(x_1) = f(x_2)\) implies \(x_1 = x_2\). In other words, \(f\) is injective if for all \(y \in B\), the set \(f^{-1}(\{y\})\) is empty or consists of a single element. We call such an \(f\) an injection." 设 \(f \colon A 	o B\) 是函数。若 \(f(x_1) = f(x_2)\) 蕴含 \(x_1 = x_2\)，则称 \(f\) 是单射的或一对一的。换句话说，若对所有 \(y \in B\)，集合 \(f^{-1}(\{y\})\) 为空或只含一个元素，则 \(f\) 是单射的。这样的 \(f\) 称为单射。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 0.3.17 Surjective 满射的 "If \(f(A) = B\), then we say \(f\) is surjective or onto. In other words, \(f\) is surjective if the range and the codomain of \(f\) are equal. We call such an \(f\) a surjection." 若 \(f(A) = B\)，则称 \(f\) 是满射的或映上的。换句话说，若 \(f\) 的值域与陪域相等，则 \(f\) 是满射的。这样的 \(f\) 称为满射。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 0.3.17 Bijective 双射的 "If \(f\) is both surjective and injective, then we say \(f\) is bijective or that \(f\) is a bijection." 若 \(f\) 既是满射的又是单射的，则称 \(f\) 是双射的，或称 \(f\) 是一个双射。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 0.3.17 Inverse Function 反函数 "When \(f \colon A 	o B\) is a bijection, then the inverse image of a single element, \(f^{-1}(\{y\})\), is always a unique element of \(A\). We then consider \(f^{-1}\) as a function \(f^{-1} \colon B 	o A\) and we write simply \(f^{-1}(y)\). In this case, we call \(f^{-1}\) the inverse function of \(f\)." 当 \(f \colon A 	o B\) 是双射时，单个元素的原像 \(f^{-1}(\{y\})\) 总是 \(A\) 中唯一的一个元素。这时我们把 \(f^{-1}\) 看作函数 \(f^{-1} \colon B 	o A\)，并简单地写作 \(f^{-1}(y)\)。在这种情况下，称 \(f^{-1}\) 为 \(f\) 的反函数。 Lebl, 2026, section 0.3 Composition of Functions 函数的复合 "Consider \(f \colon A 	o B\) and \(g \colon B 	o C\). The composition of the functions \(f\) and \(g\) is the function \(g \circ f \colon A 	o C\) defined as \((g \circ f)(x) := g igl(f(x) igr)\)." 考虑 \(f \colon A 	o B\) 与 \(g \colon B 	o C\)。函数 \(f\) 与 \(g\) 的复合是如下定义的函数 \(g \circ f \colon A 	o C\)：\((g \circ f)(x) := g igl(f(x) igr)\)。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 0.3.18 Binary Relation 二元关系 "Given a set \(A\), a binary relation on \(A\) is a subset \(\mathcal{R} \subset A 	imes A\), which consists of those pairs where the relation is said to hold." 给定集合 \(A\)，\(A\) 上的二元关系是一个子集 \(\mathcal{R} \subset A 	imes A\)，由关系成立的那些有序对组成。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 0.3.19 Reflexive Relation 自反关系 "A relation \(\mathcal{R}\) on a set \(A\) is said to be Reflexive if \(a\, \mathcal{R} \, a\) for all \(a \in A\)." 集合 \(A\) 上的关系 \(\mathcal{R}\) 称为自反的，如果对所有 \(a \in A\) 有 \(a\, \mathcal{R} \, a\)。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 0.3.21 Symmetric Relation 对称关系 "A relation \(\mathcal{R}\) on a set \(A\) is said to be Symmetric if \(a\, \mathcal{R} \, b\) implies \(b \, \mathcal{R} \, a\)." 集合 \(A\) 上的关系 \(\mathcal{R}\) 称为对称的，如果 \(a\, \mathcal{R} \, b\) 蕴含 \(b \, \mathcal{R} \, a\)。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 0.3.21 Transitive Relation 传递关系 "A relation \(\mathcal{R}\) on a set \(A\) is said to be Transitive if \(a\, \mathcal{R} \, b\) and \(b \, \mathcal{R} \, c\) implies \(a\, \mathcal{R} \, c\)." 集合 \(A\) 上的关系 \(\mathcal{R}\) 称为传递的，如果 \(a\, \mathcal{R} \, b\) 且 \(b \, \mathcal{R} \, c\) 蕴含 \(a\, \mathcal{R} \, c\)。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 0.3.21 Equivalence Relation 等价关系 "If \(\mathcal{R}\) is reflexive, symmetric, and transitive, then it is said to be an equivalence relation." 若 \(\mathcal{R}\) 是自反的、对称的和传递的，则称它为等价关系。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 0.3.21 Equivalence Class 等价类 "Let \(A\) be a set and \(\mathcal{R}\) an equivalence relation. An equivalence class of \(a \in A\), often denoted by \([a]\), is the set \(\{ x \in A : a\, \mathcal{R} \, x \}\)." 设 \(A\) 是集合，\(\mathcal{R}\) 是等价关系。\(a \in A\) 的等价类常记作 \([a]\)，它是集合 \(\{ x \in A : a\, \mathcal{R} \, x \}\)。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 0.3.23 Cardinality 基数 "Let \(A\) and \(B\) be sets. We say \(A\) and \(B\) have the same cardinality when there exists a bijection \(f \colon A 	o B\). We denote by \(\lvert A vert\) the equivalence class of all sets with the same cardinality as \(A\), and we simply call \(\lvert A vert\) the cardinality of \(A\)." 设 \(A\) 与 \(B\) 是集合。当存在双射 \(f \colon A 	o B\) 时，称 \(A\) 与 \(B\) 有相同的基数。用 \(\lvert A vert\) 表示与 \(A\) 有相同基数的全体集合构成的等价类，并简单地称 \(\lvert A vert\) 为 \(A\) 的基数。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 0.3.26 Finite 有限 "If \(A\) has the same cardinality as \(\{ 1,2,3,\ldots,n \}\) for some \(n \in \mathbb{N}\), we write \(\lvert A vert := n\). If \(A\) is empty, we write \(\lvert A vert := 0\). In either case, we say that \(A\) is finite." 若对某个 \(n \in \mathbb{N}\)，\(A\) 与 \(\{ 1,2,3,\ldots,n \}\) 有相同的基数，就写 \(\lvert A vert := n\)。若 \(A\) 为空，就写 \(\lvert A vert := 0\)。在这两种情况下，都称 \(A\) 是有限的。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 0.3.27 Infinite 无限 "We say \(A\) is infinite or “of infinite cardinality” if \(A\) is not finite." 若 \(A\) 不是有限的，则称 \(A\) 是无限的或“具有无限基数”。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 0.3.27 Cantor–Bernstein–Schröder Theorem 康托尔–伯恩斯坦–施罗德定理 "We state without proof that \(A\) and \(B\) have the same cardinality if and only if \(\lvert A vert \leq \lvert B vert\) and \(\lvert B vert \leq \lvert A vert\). This result is the Cantor–Bernstein–Schröder theorem." 我们不加证明地指出：\(A\) 与 \(B\) 有相同的基数，当且仅当 \(\lvert A vert \leq \lvert B vert\) 且 \(\lvert B vert \leq \lvert A vert\)。这个结果就是康托尔–伯恩斯坦–施罗德定理。 Lebl, 2026, section 0.3 Countably Infinite 可数无穷 "If \(\lvert A vert = \lvert \mathbb{N} vert\), then we say \(A\) is countably infinite." 若 \(\lvert A vert = \lvert \mathbb{N} vert\)，则称 \(A\) 是可数无穷的。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 0.3.29 Countable 可数 "If \(A\) is finite or countably infinite, then we say \(A\) is countable." 若 \(A\) 是有限的或可数无穷的，则称 \(A\) 是可数的。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 0.3.29 Uncountable 不可数 "If \(A\) is not countable, then \(A\) is said to be uncountable." 若 \(A\) 不是可数的，则称 \(A\) 是不可数的。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 0.3.29 Power Set 幂集 "The power set of a set \(A\), denoted by \(\mathcal{P}(A)\), is the set of all subsets of \(A\)." 集合 \(A\) 的幂集记作 \(\mathcal{P}(A)\)，是 \(A\) 的全部子集构成的集合。 Lebl, 2026, Definition 0.3.33 Cantor’s Theorem 康托尔定理 "Let \(A\) be a set. Then \(\lvert A vert <  igl\lvert \mathcal{P}(A)  igrvert\). In particular, there exists no surjection from \(A\) onto \(\mathcal{P}(A)\)." 设 \(A\) 是集合，则 \(\lvert A vert <  igl\lvert \mathcal{P}(A)  igrvert\)。特别地，不存在从 \(A\) 到 \(\mathcal{P}(A)\) 的满射。 Lebl, 2026, Theorem 0.3.34 Symmetric Difference 对称差 "Let \(A \Delta B\) denote the symmetric difference, that is, the set of all elements that belong to either \(A\) or \(B\), but not to both \(A\) and \(B\)." 用 \(A \Delta B\) 表示对称差，即属于 \(A\) 或 \(B\)、但不同时属于 \(A\) 和 \(B\) 的全部元素构成的集合。 Lebl, 2026, Exercise 0.3.7 References Lebl, J. (2026). Basic analysis I & II: Introduction to real analysis (May 22, 2026 edition). Retrieved October 29, 2026, from https://www.jirka.org/ra/html/
