A relation R from the set \(\boldsymbol{A}\) to the set \(\boldsymbol{B}\) is a subset of \(A \times B\text{.}\)" 设 \(A\) 和 \(B\) 是集合。从集合 \(\boldsymbol{A}\) 到集合 \(\boldsymbol{B}\) 的关系 R 是 \(A \times B\) 的子集。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 7.1 Domain of a Relation 关系的定义域 "If \(R\) is a relation from the set \(A\) to the set \(B\text{,}\) then the subset of \(A\) consisting of all the first coordinates of the ordered pairs in \(R\) is called the domain of \(R\text{.}\)" 如果 \(R\) 是从集合 \(A\) 到集合 \(B\) 的关系，那么由 \(R\) 中所有有序对的第一个坐标组成的 \(A\) 的子集称为 \(R\) 的定义域。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 7.1 Range of a Relation 关系的值域 "The subset of \(B\) consisting of all the second coordinates of the ordered pairs in \(R\) is called the range of \(R\text{.}\)" 由 \(R\) 中所有有序对的第二个坐标组成的 \(B\) 的子集称为 \(R\) 的值域。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 7.1 Divides Relation 整除关系 "Whenever we have spoken about one integer dividing another integer, we have worked with the “divides” relation on \(\mathbb{Z}\text{.}\) In particular, we can write \(D = \left\{ { {\left( {m, n} \right) \in \mathbb{Z} \times \mathbb{Z} } \mid m \text{ divides } n} \right\}\!\text{.}\)" 每当谈到一个整数整除另一个整数时，我们用的就是 \(\mathbb{Z}\) 上的“整除”关系。具体地，可以写成 \(D = \left\{ { {\left( {m, n} \right) \in \mathbb{Z} \times \mathbb{Z} } \mid m \text{ divides } n} \right\}\!\)。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 7.1 Directed Graph 有向图 "A convenient way to represent such a relation is to draw a point in the plane for each of the elements of \(A\) and then for each \(\left( {x, y} \right) \in R\) (or \(x \mathrel{R} y\)), we draw an arrow starting at the point \(x\) and pointing to the point \(y\text{.}\) If \(\left( {x, x} \right) \in R\) (or \(x \mathrel{R} x\)), we draw a loop at the point \(x\text{.}\) The resulting diagram is called a directed graph or a digraph." 表示这种关系的一种方便方法是：在平面上画一个点，对应 \(A\) 的每个元素；然后对每个 \(\left( {x, y} \right) \in R\)（即 \(x \mathrel{R} y\)），画一条箭头，从点 \(x\) 出发指向点 \(y\)。如果 \(\left( {x, x} \right) \in R\)（即 \(x \mathrel{R} x\)），就在点 \(x\) 处画一个环。所得的图称为有向图（directed graph 或 digraph）。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 7.1 Digraph 有向图（简称） "The resulting diagram is called a directed graph or a digraph." 所得的图称为有向图（directed graph 或 digraph）。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 7.1 Vertex 顶点 "In a directed graph, the points are called the vertices. So each element of \(A\) corresponds to a vertex." 在有向图中，这些点称为顶点。所以 \(A\) 的每个元素对应一个顶点。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 7.1 Directed Edge 有向边 "The arrows, including the loops, are called the directed edges of the directed graph." 这些箭头（包括环）称为有向图的有向边。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 7.1 Inverse of a Relation 逆关系 "Let \(R\) be a relation from the set \(A\) to the set \(B\text{.}\) The inverse of \(\boldsymbol{R}\), written \(R^{ - 1}\) and read “\(R\) inverse,” is the relation from \(B\) to \(A\) defined by" 设 \(R\) 是从集合 \(A\) 到集合 \(B\) 的关系。\(\boldsymbol{R}\) 的逆记作 \(R^{ - 1}\)，读作“\(R\) 逆”，是如下定义的从 \(B\) 到 \(A\) 的关系 Sundstrom, 2022, section 7.1 References Sundstrom, T. math/proof-techniques/equivalence-relati.title: 7.2 Equivalence Relations | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
math/proof-techniques/equivalence-relati.summary: 7.2 Equivalence Relations Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 7 Equivalence Relations 等价关系 (No definition) （无定义） Sundstrom, 2022, chapter 7 7.2 Equivalence Relations 等价关系 (No definition) （无定义） Sundstrom, 2022, section 7.2 Reflexive 自反 "The relation \(R\) is reflexive on \(\boldsymbol{A}\) provided that for each \(x \in A\text{,}\) \(x \mathrel{R} x\) or, equivalently, \(\left( {x, x} \right) \in R\text{.}\)" 如果对每个 \(x \in A\)，\(x \mathrel{R} x\)（等价地，\(\left( {x, x} \right) \in R\)），关系 \(R\) 就称为在 \(\boldsymbol{A}\) 上自反。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 7.2 Symmetric 对称 "The relation \(R\) is symmetric provided that for every \(x, y \in A\text{,}\) if \(x \mathrel{R} y\text{,}\) then \(y \mathrel{R} x\)" 如果对每个 \(x, y \in A\)，若 \(x \mathrel{R} y\)，则 \(y \mathrel{R} x\)，关系 \(R\) 就是对称的 Sundstrom, 2022, section 7.2 Transitive 传递 "The relation \(R\) is transitive provided that for every \(x, y, z \in A\text{,}\) if \(x \mathrel{R} y\) and \(y \mathrel{R} z\text{,}\) then \(x \mathrel{R} z\)" 如果对每个 \(x, y, z \in A\)，若 \(x \mathrel{R} y\) 且 \(y \mathrel{R} z\)，则 \(x \mathrel{R} z\)，关系 \(R\) 就是传递的 Sundstrom, 2022, section 7.2 Equivalence Relation 等价关系 "A relation \(\sim\) on the set \(A\) is an equivalence relation provided that \(\sim\) is reflexive, symmetric, and transitive." 如果集合 \(A\) 上的关系 \(\sim\) 是自反、对称且传递的，它就是等价关系。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 7.2 Identity Relation 恒等关系 "This relation is also called the identity relation on \(\boldsymbol{A}\) and is denoted by \(I_A\text{,}\) where \(I_A = \left\{ {\left( {x, x} \right) \mid x \in A} \right\}\!\text{.}\)" 这个关系也称为 \(\boldsymbol{A}\) 上的恒等关系，记作 \(I_A\)，其中 \(I_A = \left\{ {\left( {x, x} \right) \mid x \in A} \right\}\!\)。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 7.2 Equality Relation 相等关系 "Let \(A\) be a nonempty set. The equality relation on \(\boldsymbol{A}\) is an equivalence relation." 设 \(A\) 是非空集合。\(\boldsymbol{A}\) 上的相等关系是一个等价关系。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 7.2 Antisymmetric Relation 反对称关系 "A relation \(R\) on a set \(A\) is an antisymmetric relation provided that for all \(x, y \in A\text{,}\) if \(x \mathrel{R} y\) and \(y \mathrel{R} x\text{,}\) then \(x = y\text{.}\)" 如果对所有 \(x, y \in A\)，若 \(x \mathrel{R} y\) 且 \(y \mathrel{R} x\)，则 \(x = y\)，集合 \(A\) 上的关系 \(R\) 就是反对称关系。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 7.2 Circular Relation 循环关系 "A relation \(R\) on a set \(A\) is a circular relation provided that for all \(x\text{,}\) \(y\text{,}\) and \(z\) in \(A\text{,}\) if \(x \mathrel{R} y\) and \(y \mathrel{R} z\text{,}\) then \(z \mathrel{R} x\text{.}\)" 如果对所有 \(A\) 中的 \(x\)、\(y\) 和 \(z\)，若 \(x \mathrel{R} y\) 且 \(y \mathrel{R} z\)，则 \(z \mathrel{R} x\)，集合 \(A\) 上的关系 \(R\) 就是循环关系。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 7.2 References Sundstrom, T. (2022). Mathematical reasoning: Writing and proof (Version 2.1; PreTeXt edition by Grand Valley State University). math/proof-techniques/equivalence-relati.title: 7.3 Equivalence Classes | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
math/proof-techniques/equivalence-relati.summary: 7.3 Equivalence Classes Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 7 Equivalence Relations 等价关系 (No definition) （无定义） Sundstrom, 2022, chapter 7 7.3 Equivalence Classes 等价类 (No definition) （无定义） Sundstrom, 2022, section 7.3 Equivalence Class 等价类 "For each \(a \in A\text{,}\) the equivalence class of \(\boldsymbol{a}\) determined by \(\sim\) is the subset of \(A\text{,}\) denoted by \([ a ]\text{,}\) consisting of all the elements of \(A\) that are equivalent to \(a\text{.}\)" 对每个 \(a \in A\)，由 \(\sim\) 确定的 \(\boldsymbol{a}\) 的等价类是 \(A\) 的子集，记作 \([ a ]\)，由 \(A\) 中与 \(a\) 等价的全部元素组成。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 7.3 Congruence Class 同余类 "So for \(a \in \mathbb{Z}\text{,}\) \([ a ] = \left\{ { {x \in \mathbb{Z} } \mid x \equiv a \pmod n} \right\}\!\text{.}\) In this case, \([ a ]\) is called the congruence class of \(\boldsymbol{a}\) modulo \(\boldsymbol{n}\)." 所以对 \(a \in \mathbb{Z}\)，\([ a ] = \left\{ { {x \in \mathbb{Z} } \mid x \equiv a \pmod n} \right\}\!\)。这时 \([ a ]\) 称为 \(\boldsymbol{a}\) 模 \(\boldsymbol{n}\) 的同余类。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 7.3 Properties of Equivalence Classes 等价类的性质 "The properties of equivalence classes that we will prove are as follows: (1) Every element of \(A\) is in its own equivalence class; (2) two elements are equivalent if and only if their equivalence classes are equal; and (3) two equivalence classes are either identical or they are disjoint." 我们要证明的等价类性质如下：(1) 每个元素（\(A\) 的）都在它自己的等价类中；(2) 两个元素等价当且仅当它们的等价类相等；(3) 两个等价类要么相同，要么不相交。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 7.3 Partition 划分 "The collection of subsets \(\mathcal{C}\) is a partition of \(\boldsymbol{A}\) provided that For each \(V \in \mathcal{C}\text{,}\) \(V \ne \emptyset\text{.}\) For each \(x \in A\text{,}\) there exists a \(V \in \mathcal{C}\) such that \(x \in V\text{.}\) For every \(V, W \in \mathcal{C}\text{,}\) \(V = W\) or \(V \cap W = \emptyset\text{.}\)" 子集族 \(\mathcal{C}\) 是 \(\boldsymbol{A}\) 的划分，如果：对每个 \(V \in \mathcal{C}\)，\(V \ne \emptyset\)；对每个 \(x \in A\)，存在 \(V \in \mathcal{C}\) 使得 \(x \in V\)；对每个 \(V, W \in \mathcal{C}\)，\(V = W\) 或 \(V \cap W = \emptyset\)。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 7.3 References Sundstrom, T. (2022). Mathematical reasoning: Writing and proof (Version 2.1; PreTeXt edition by Grand Valley State University). If gives a necessary and sufficient condition for a natural number to be divisible by 9." 定理 7.27 的第 3 项称为一个整除判别法。它给出了一个自然数能被 9 整除的充分必要条件。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 7.4 References Sundstrom, T. math/proof-techniques/finite-and-infinit.summary: 9.1 Finite Sets Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 9 Finite and Infinite Sets 有限集与无限集 (No definition) （无定义） Sundstrom, 2022, chapter 9 9.1 Finite Sets 有限集 (No definition) （无定义） Sundstrom, 2022, section 9.1 Equivalent Sets 等势集合 "The set \(A\) is equivalent to the set \(B\) provided that there exists a bijection from the set \(A\) onto the set \(B\text{.}\) In this case, we write \(A \approx B\text{.}\)" 如果存在从集合 \(A\) 到集合 \(B\) 上的双射，集合 \(A\) 就与集合 \(B\) 等势。这时记作 \(A \approx B\)。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 9.1 One-to-One Correspondence 一一对应 "When \(A \approx B\text{,}\) we also say that the set \(A\) is in one-to-one correspondence with the set \(B\) and that the set \(A\) has the same cardinality as the set \(B\text{.}\)" 当 \(A \approx B\) 时，也说集合 \(A\) 与集合 \(B\) 一一对应，并且集合 \(A\) 与集合 \(B\) 有相同的势。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 9.1 Finite Set 有限集 "A set \(A\) is a finite set provided that \(A = \emptyset\) or there exists a natural number \(k\) such that \(A \approx \mathbb{N}_k\text{.}\)" 如果 \(A = \emptyset\)，或存在自然数 \(k\) 使得 \(A \approx \mathbb{N}_k\)，集合 \(A\) 就是有限集。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 9.1 Infinite Set 无限集 "A set is an infinite set provided that it is not a finite set." 如果一个集合不是有限集，它就是无限集。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 9.1 Cardinal Number 基数 "If \(A \approx \mathbb{N}_k\text{,}\) we say that the set \(A\) has cardinality \(\boldsymbol{k}\) (or cardinal number \(\boldsymbol{k}\)), and we write \(\text{ card} \left( A \right) = k\text{.}\)" 若 \(A \approx \mathbb{N}_k\)，就说集合 \(A\) 的势为 \(\boldsymbol{k}\)（或基数为 \(\boldsymbol{k}\)），记作 \(\text{ card} \left( A \right) = k\)。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 9.1 Properties of Finite Sets 有限集的性质 "If \(A \approx \mathbb{N}_k\text{,}\) we say that the set \(A\) has cardinality \(\boldsymbol{k}\) (or cardinal number \(\boldsymbol{k}\)), and we write \(\text{ card} \left( A \right) = k\text{.}\) In addition, we say that the empty set has cardinality 0 (or cardinal number 0), and we write \(\text{ card} \left( \emptyset \right) = 0\text{.}\)" 若 \(A \approx \mathbb{N}_k\)，就说集合 \(A\) 的势为 \(\boldsymbol{k}\)（或基数为 \(\boldsymbol{k}\)），记作 \(\text{ card} \left( A \right) = k\)。此外，空集的势为 0（或基数为 0），记作 \(\text{ card} \left( \emptyset \right) = 0\)。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 9.1 Pigeonhole Principle 鸽巢原理 "Let \(A\) and \(B\) be finite sets. If \(\text{ card} ( A ) > \text{ card} ( B )\text{,}\) then any function \(f: A \to B\) is not an injection." 设 \(A\) 和 \(B\) 是有限集。如果 \(\text{ card} ( A ) > \text{ card} ( B )\)，那么任何函数 \(f: A \to B\) 都不是单射。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 9.1 References Sundstrom, T. (2022). Mathematical reasoning: Writing and proof (Version 2.1; PreTeXt edition by Grand Valley State University). math/proof-techniques/finite-and-infinit.summary: 9.2 Countable Sets Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 9 Finite and Infinite Sets 有限集与无限集 (No definition) （无定义） Sundstrom, 2022, chapter 9 9.2 Countable Sets 可数集 (No definition) （无定义） Sundstrom, 2022, section 9.2 Aleph 阿列夫 "The cardinality of \(\boldsymbol{\mathbb N}\) is denoted by \(\aleph_0\text{.}\) The symbol \(\aleph\) is the first letter of the Hebrew alphabet, aleph." \(\boldsymbol{\mathbb N}\) 的势记作 \(\aleph_0\)。符号 \(\aleph\) 是希伯来字母表的第一个字母，读作 aleph（阿列夫）。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 9.2 Countably Infinite Set 可数无限集 "A set \(A\) is countably infinite provided that \(A \approx \mathbb{N}\text{.}\)" 如果 \(A \approx \mathbb{N}\)，集合 \(A\) 就是可数无限的。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 9.2 Denumerable Set 可列集 "A set that is countably infinite is sometimes called a denumerable set." 可数无限的集合有时称为可列集。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 9.2 Countable Set 可数集 "A set is countable provided that it is finite or countably infinite." 如果一个集合是有限的或可数无限的，它就是可数集。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 9.2 Uncountable Set 不可数集 "An infinite set that is not countably infinite is called an uncountable set." 不是可数无限的无限集称为不可数集。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 9.2 References Sundstrom, T. (2022). Mathematical reasoning: Writing and proof (Version 2.1; PreTeXt edition by Grand Valley State University). math/proof-techniques/finite-and-infinit.summary: 9.3 Uncountable Sets Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 9 Finite and Infinite Sets 有限集与无限集 (No definition) （无定义） Sundstrom, 2022, chapter 9 9.3 Uncountable Sets 不可数集 (No definition) （无定义） Sundstrom, 2022, section 9.3 Dodge Ball 躲避球 "Dodge Ball is a game for two players." 躲避球是一种两人游戏。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 9.3 Decimal Expression for a Real Number 实数的小数表示 "In its decimal form, any real number \(a\) in the interval \(( 0, 1 )\) can be written as \(a = 0.a_1 a_2 a_3 a_4 \ldots \text{,}\) where each \(a_i\) is an integer with \(0 \leq a_i \leq 9\text{.}\)" 区间 \(( 0, 1 )\) 中的任意实数 \(a\) 的小数形式可以写成 \(a = 0.a_1 a_2 a_3 a_4 \ldots\)，其中每个 \(a_i\) 都是满足 \(0 \leq a_i \leq 9\) 的整数。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 9.3 Normalized Form of a Decimal Expression 小数表示的规范形式 "That is, the decimal representation of \(a\) is in normalized form if and only if it does not end with an infinite string of 9's." 也就是说，\(a\) 的小数表示是规范形式，当且仅当它不以无穷个 9 结尾。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 9.3 Cantor's Diagonal Argument 康托尔对角线论证 "The proof of Theorem 9.27 is often referred to as Cantor's diagonal argument." 定理 9.27 的证明常称为康托尔对角线论证。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 9.3 Continuum 连续统 "The cardinal number of \(( 0, 1 )\) is defined to be \(\boldsymbol{c}\text{,}\) which stands for the cardinal number of the continuum." \(( 0, 1 )\) 的基数定义为 \(\boldsymbol{c}\)，它代表连续统的基数。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 9.3 Cardinality c 基数 c "A set \(A\) is said to have cardinality \(\boldsymbol{c}\) provided that \(A\) is equivalent to \(( 0, 1 )\text{.}\)" 如果 \(A\) 与 \(( 0, 1 )\) 等势，就说集合 \(A\) 的势为 \(\boldsymbol{c}\)。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 9.3 Cantor's Theorem 康托尔定理 "For every set \(A\text{,}\) \(A\) and \(\mathcal{P} ( A )\) do not have the same cardinality." 对每个集合 \(A\)，\(A\) 与 \(\mathcal{P} ( A )\) 的势不相同。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 9.3 Cantor-Schröder-Bernstein Theorem 康托尔-施罗德-伯恩斯坦定理 "Let \(A\) and \(B\) be sets. If there exist injections \(f: A \to B\) and \(g: B \to A\text{,}\) then \(A \approx B\text{.}\)" 设 \(A\) 和 \(B\) 是集合。如果存在单射 \(f: A \to B\) 和 \(g: B \to A\)，那么 \(A \approx B\)。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 9.3 Continuum Hypothesis 连续统假设 "This conjecture has come to be known as the Continuum Hypothesis. Stated somewhat more formally, the Continuum Hypothesis is There is no set \(X\) such that \(\aleph_0 \lt \text{ card} ( X ) \lt \boldsymbol{c}\text{.}\)" 这个猜想后来称为连续统假设。更正式地说，连续统假设是：不存在集合 \(X\) 使得 \(\aleph_0 \lt \text{ card} ( X ) \lt \boldsymbol{c}\)。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 9.3 References Sundstrom, T. (2022). Mathematical reasoning: Writing and proof (Version 2.1; PreTeXt edition by Grand Valley State University). We will call this the birthday function." 设 \(b\) 是给每个人指定其生日（月和日）的函数。函数 \(b\) 的定义域是所有人的集合，\(b\) 的陪域是闰年中所有日子的集合（即 1 月 1 日到 12 月 31 日，包括 2 月 29 日）。(a) 解释为什么 \(b\) 确实是函数。我们把它称为生日函数。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 6.1 Sum of Divisors Function 因数和函数 "Let \(s\) be the function that associates with each natural number the sum of its distinct natural number divisors. associates with each element \(x\) of the set \(A\) exactly one element of the set \(B\text{.}\)" 从集合 \(A\) 到集合 \(B\) 的函数是一种规则，它让集合 \(A\) 中的每个元素 \(x\) 对应恰好一个元素（集合 \(B\) 中的）。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 6.1 Mapping 映射 "A function from \(A\) to \(B\) is also called a mapping from \(A\) to \(B\text{.}\)" 从 \(A\) 到 \(B\) 的函数也称为映射（从 \(A\) 到 \(B\)）。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 6.1 Domain of a Function 函数的定义域 "Let \(f \colon A \to B\text{.}\) (This is read, “Let \(f\) be a function from \(A\) to \(B\text{.}\)”) The set \(A\) is called the domain of the function \(f\text{,}\) and we write \(A = \text{ dom} ( f )\text{.}\)" 设 \(f \colon A \to B\)（读作“设 \(f\) 是从 \(A\) 到 \(B\) 的函数”）。集合 \(A\) 称为函数的定义域 \(f\)，记作 \(A = \text{ dom} ( f )\)。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 6.1 Codomain 陪域 "The set \(B\) is called the codomain of the function \(f\text{,}\) and we write \(B = \text{ codom} ( f )\text{.}\)" 集合 \(B\) 称为函数的陪域 \(f\)，记作 \(B = \text{ codom} ( f )\)。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 6.1 Image of an Element 元素的像 "If \(a \in A\text{,}\) then the element of \(B\) that is associated with \(a\) is denoted by \(f( a )\) and is called the image of \(\boldsymbol{a}\) under \(\boldsymbol{f}\)." 若 \(a \in A\)，则 \(B\) 中对应于 \(a\) 的元素记作 \(f( a )\)，称为 \(\boldsymbol{a}\) 在 \(\boldsymbol{f}\) 下的像。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 6.1 Preimage of an Element 元素的原像 "If \(f( a ) = b\text{,}\) with \(b \in B\text{,}\) then \(a\) is called a preimage of \(\boldsymbol{b}\) for \(\boldsymbol{f}\)." 若 \(f( a ) = b\)，其中 \(b \in B\)，则 \(a\) 称为原像，即 \(\boldsymbol{b}\) 关于 \(\boldsymbol{f}\) 的原像。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 6.1 Independent Variable 自变量 "In this case, we consider \(x\) to be an unspecified object that can be chosen from the set \(A\text{,}\) and we would say that \(x\) is the independent variable of the function \(f\) and \(y\) is the dependent variable of the function \(f\text{.}\)" 这时我们把 \(x\) 看作可以从集合中选取的未指定对象 \(A\)，说 \(x\) 是函数 \(f\) 的自变量，\(y\) 是函数 \(f\) 的因变量。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 6.1 Dependent Variable 因变量 "When we have a function \(f \colon A \to B\text{,}\) we often write \(y = f(x)\text{.}\) In this case, we consider \(x\) to be an unspecified object that can be chosen from the set \(A\text{,}\) and we would say that \(x\) is the independent variable of the function \(f\) and \(y\) is the dependent variable of the function \(f\text{.}\)" 当有函数 \(f \colon A \to B\) 时，常写成 \(y = f(x)\)。这时我们把 \(x\) 看作可以从集合 \(A\) 中选取的未指定对象，说 \(x\) 是函数 \(f\) 的自变量，\(y\) 是因变量（函数 \(f\) 的）。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 6.1 Range 值域 "The set \(\left\{ {f( x ) \mid x \in A} \right\}\) is called the range of the function Sundstrom, 2022, section 6.1 Real Function 实函数 "Because we use the Cartesian plane when drawing this type of graph, we can only use this type of graph when both the domain and the codomain of the function are subsets of the real numbers \(\mathbb R\text{.}\) Such a function is sometimes called a real function." 由于画这类图要用笛卡尔平面，所以只有当函数的定义域和陪域都是实数集的子集（\(\mathbb R\)）时才能用这类图。这样的函数有时称为实函数。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 6.1 Arrow Diagram 箭头图 "A convenient way to illustrate or visualize this type of function is with a so-called arrow diagram as shown in Figure 6.6." 说明或直观展示这类函数的一种方便方法是所谓的箭头图，如图 6.6 所示。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 6.1 Number of Divisors Function 因数个数函数 "Let \(d\) be the function that associates with each natural number the number of its natural number divisors." 设 \(d\) (2022). Mathematical reasoning: Writing and proof (Version 2.1; PreTeXt edition by Grand Valley State University). 多边形是由三条或更多直线首尾相接形成的封闭平面图形。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 6.2 Regular Polygon 正多边形 "A regular polygon is one that has equal-length sides and congruent interior angles." 正多边形是各边等长且各内角全等的多边形。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 6.2 Diagonal of a Polygon 多边形的对角线 "A diagonal of a polygon is a line segment that connects two nonadjacent vertices of the polygon." 多边形的对角线是连接多边形两个不相邻顶点的线段。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 6.2 Triangle 三角形 "For example, a triangle is a polygon that has three sides" 例如，三角形是有三条边的多边形 Sundstrom, 2022, section 6.2 Quadrilateral 四边形 "a quadrilateral is a polygon that has four sides and includes the domain of \(f\) (which equals the domain of \(g\)), \(f( x ) = g( x )\text{.}\)" 两个函数 \(f\) 和 \(g\) 相等，如果：\(f\) 的定义域等于 \(g\) 的定义域，即 \(\text{ dom} ( f ) = \text{ dom} ( g )\)；\(f\) 的陪域等于 \(g\) 的陪域，即 \(\text{ codom} ( f ) = \text{ codom} ( g )\)；对 \(f\) 定义域中的每个 \(x\)（它也等于 \(g\) 的定义域），\(f( x ) = g( x )\)。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 6.2 Identity Function 恒等函数 "Let \(A\) be a nonempty set. the output is always equal to the input." 设 \(A\) 是非空集合。集合 \(\boldsymbol{A}\) 上的恒等函数记作 \(I_A\)，是由 \(I_A ( x ) = x\)（对 \(A\) 中的每个 \(x\)）定义的函数 \(I_A: A \to A\)。也就是说，对恒等映射，输出总是等于输入。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 6.2 Average of a Finite Set of Numbers 有限数集的平均数 "Let \(A = \left\{ a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n \right\}\) be a finite set whose elements are the distinct real numbers \(a_1, a_2, \ldots, \right\}\) 是有限集，其元素是互不相同的实数 \(a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n\)。定义集合 \(A\) 的平均数为实数 \(\bar{A}\)，其中 \(\bar{A} = \frac{a_1 + a_2 + \cdots + a_n}{n}\)。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 6.2 Sequence 数列 "An (infinite) sequence is a function whose domain is \(\mathbb{N}\) or some infinite subset of \(\mathbb{N} \cup \left\{ 0 \right\}\text{.}\)" （无穷）数列是一个函数，其定义域是 \(\mathbb{N}\)，或 \(\mathbb{N} \cup \left\{ 0 \right\}\) 的某个无穷子集。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 6.2 Function of Two Variables 二元函数 "Since the domain of this function is \(\mathbb Z \times \mathbb Z\) and each element of \(\mathbb Z \times \mathbb Z\) matrix \(\boldsymbol{A}\), denoted by \(A^T\text{,}\) is the 2 by 2 matrix over \(\mathbb{R}\) defined by \(A^T = \left[ {\begin{array}{*{20}c} a & c \\ b & d \end{array} } \right]\text{.}\)" 矩阵 Calculus 微积分基本定理 "In fact, one form of the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus states that \(\int_a^b {f( x ) \, dx} = F( b ) - F( a )\text{,}\) where \(F\) is any antiderivative of \(f\text{,}\) that is, where \(F \,' = f\text{.}\)" 事实上，微积分基本定理的一种形式是 \(\int_a^b {f( x ) \, dx} = F( b ) - F( a )\)，其中 \(F\) 是 \(f\) 的任意一个原函数，即 \(F \,' = f\)。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 6.2 References Sundstrom, T. (2022). Mathematical reasoning: Writing and proof (Version 2.1; PreTeXt edition by Grand Valley State University). math/proof-techniques/introduction-to-wr.title: 1.1 Statements and Conditional Statements | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
math/proof-techniques/introduction-to-wr.summary: 1.1 Statements and Conditional Statements Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 1 Introduction to Writing Proofs in Mathematics 数学证明写作入门 (No definition) （无定义） Sundstrom, 2022, chapter 1 1.1 Statements and Conditional Statements 陈述与条件陈述 (No definition) （无定义） Sundstrom, 2022, section 1.1 Statement 陈述 "In mathematics, a statement is a declarative sentence that must have a definite truth value, either true or false but not both." 在数学中，陈述是必须有确定真值的陈述句，要么真要么假，不能两者都是。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 1.1 Proposition 命题 "A statement is sometimes called a proposition." 陈述有时也称为命题。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 1.1 Conjecture 猜想 "When we make a guess in mathematics, we usually call it a conjecture." 当我们在数学中做出猜测时，通常称它为猜想。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 1.1 Counterexample 反例 "In this way, we can gather information that provides evidence that a statement is true, or we might find an example that shows the statement is false. This type of example is called a counterexample." 这样我们可以收集证据说明某个陈述为真，也可能找到说明该陈述为假的例子。这类例子称为反例。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 1.1 Conditional Statement 条件陈述 "A conditional statement is a statement that can be written in the form “If \(P\) then \(Q\text{,}\)” where \(P\) and \(Q\) are sentences." 条件陈述是能写成“如果 \(P\) 那么 \(Q\)”形式的陈述，其中 \(P\) 和 \(Q\) 是语句。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 1.1 Hypothesis 假设 "For this conditional statement, \(P\) is called the hypothesis and \(Q\) is called the conclusion." 对这个条件陈述，\(P\) 称为假设，\(Q\) 称为结论。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 1.1 Conclusion 结论 "For this conditional statement, \(P\) is called the hypothesis and \(Q\) is called the conclusion." 对这个条件陈述，\(P\) 称为假设，\(Q\) 称为结论。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 1.1 Truth Table 真值表 "This is summarized in Table 1.3, which is called a truth table for the conditional statement \(P \to Q\text{.}\)" 这一点总结在表 1.3 中，它称为条件陈述 \(P \to Q\) 的真值表。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 1.1 Real Number System 实数系 "The primary number system used in algebra and calculus is the real number system. We usually use the symbol \(\mathbb{R}\) to stand for the set of all real numbers. The real numbers consist of the rational numbers and the irrational numbers." 代数和微积分中使用的主要数系是实数系。我们通常用符号 \(\mathbb{R}\) 表示全体实数的集合。实数由有理数和无理数组成。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 1.1 Closure Properties 封闭性 "Notice that these so-called closure properties are defined in terms of conditional statements." 注意，这些所谓的封闭性是用条件陈述来定义的。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 1.1 Natural Numbers 自然数 "The natural numbers consist of the positive whole numbers such as 1, 2, 3, 107, and 203." 自然数由正整数组成，例如 1、2、3、107 和 203。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 1.1 Integers 整数 "The integers consist of zero, the natural numbers, and the negatives of the natural numbers." 整数由零、自然数和自然数的相反数组成。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 1.1 Closed under Addition 对加法封闭 "Three of the basic properties of the integers are that the set \(\mathbb{Z}\) is closed under addition, the set \(\mathbb{Z}\) is closed under multiplication, and the set of integers is closed under subtraction. This means that If \(x\) and \(y\) are integers, then \(x + y\) is an integer;" 整数的三个基本性质是：集合 \(\mathbb{Z}\) 对加法封闭，对乘法封闭，整数集对减法封闭。这意味着：如果 \(x\) 和 \(y\) 是整数，那么 \(x + y\) 是整数； Sundstrom, 2022, section 1.1 Closed under Multiplication 对乘法封闭 "Three of the basic properties of the integers are that the set \(\mathbb{Z}\) is closed under addition, the set \(\mathbb{Z}\) is closed under multiplication, and the set of integers is closed under subtraction. This means that If \(x\) and \(y\) are integers, then \(x + y\) is an integer; If \(x\) and \(y\) are integers, then \(x \cdot y\) is an integer;" 整数的三个基本性质是：集合 \(\mathbb{Z}\) 对加法封闭，对乘法封闭，整数集对减法封闭。这意味着：如果 \(x\) 和 \(y\) 是整数，那么 \(x + y\) 是整数；如果 \(x\) 和 \(y\) 是整数，那么 \(x \cdot y\) 是整数； Sundstrom, 2022, section 1.1 Closed under Subtraction 对减法封闭 "Three of the basic properties of the integers are that the set \(\mathbb{Z}\) is closed under addition, the set \(\mathbb{Z}\) is closed under multiplication, and the set of integers is closed under subtraction. This means that If \(x\) and \(y\) are integers, then \(x + y\) is an integer; If \(x\) and \(y\) are integers, then \(x \cdot y\) is an integer; and If \(x\) and \(y\) are integers, then \(x - y\) is an integer." 整数的三个基本性质是：集合 \(\mathbb{Z}\) 对加法封闭，对乘法封闭，整数集对减法封闭。这意味着：如果 \(x\) 和 \(y\) 是整数，那么 \(x + y\) 是整数；如果 \(x\) 和 \(y\) 是整数，那么 \(x \cdot y\) 是整数；如果 \(x\) 和 \(y\) 是整数，那么 \(x - y\) 是整数。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 1.1 References Sundstrom, T. (2022). Mathematical reasoning: Writing and proof (Version 2.1; PreTeXt edition by Grand Valley State University). Retrieved October 30, 2026, from https://gvsuoer.github.io/sundstrom-textbook/frontmatter.html

math/proof-techniques/introduction-to-wr.title: 1.2 Constructing Direct Proofs | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
math/proof-techniques/introduction-to-wr.summary: 1.2 Constructing Direct Proofs Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 1 Introduction to Writing Proofs in Mathematics 数学证明写作入门 (No definition) （无定义） Sundstrom, 2022, chapter 1 1.2 Constructing Direct Proofs 构造直接证明 (No definition) （无定义） Sundstrom, 2022, section 1.2 Definition 定义 "A definition is an agreement that a particular word or phrase will stand for some object, property, or other concept that we expect to refer to often." 定义是约定某个词或短语代表某个对象、性质或其他概念，这些是我们预计会经常提到的。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 1.2 Even Integer 偶数 "An integer \(a\) is an even integer provided that there exists an integer \(n\) such that \(a = 2n\text{.}\)" 如果存在整数 \(n\) 使得 \(a = 2n\)，整数 \(a\) 就是偶数。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 1.2 Odd Integer 奇数 "An integer \(a\) is an odd integer provided there exists an integer \(n\) such that \(a = 2n + 1\text{.}\)" 如果存在整数 \(n\) 使得 \(a = 2n + 1\)，整数 \(a\) 就是奇数。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 1.2 Direct Proof 直接证明 "A direct proof of a conditional statement is a demonstration that the conclusion of the conditional statement follows logically from the hypothesis of the conditional statement." 条件陈述的直接证明是说明条件陈述的结论可以从假设逻辑地推出。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 1.2 Know-Show Table 已知-求证表 "This method will involve working forward from the hypothesis, \(P\text{,}\) and backward from the conclusion, \(Q\text{.}\) We will use a device called the know-show table to help organize our thoughts and the steps of the proof." 这种方法包括从假设出发向前推（\(P\)）和从结论出发向后推（\(Q\)）。我们用一种叫已知-求证表的工具来帮助整理思路和证明步骤。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 1.2 Backward Question 逆向问题 "We usually start with the conclusion that we are trying to prove by asking a so-called backward question. The basic form of the question is, “Under what conditions can we conclude that \(Q\) is true?”" 我们通常从要证明的结论出发，提出所谓的逆向问题。问题的基本形式是：“在什么条件下可以断定 \(Q\) 为真？” Sundstrom, 2022, section 1.2 Forward Question 正向问题 "To do this, we work forward from step \(P\text{,}\) and this involves asking a forward question. The basic form of this type of question is, “What can we conclude from the fact that \(P\) is true?”" 为此，我们从步骤 \(P\) 向前推，这需要提出正向问题。这类问题的基本形式是：“从 \(P\) 为真这一事实能得出什么结论？” Sundstrom, 2022, section 1.2 Writing Guidelines 写作指南 "At the risk of oversimplification, doing mathematics can be considered to have two distinct stages. The first stage is to convince yourself that you have solved the problem or proved a conjecture." 冒着过于简化的风险，可以认为做数学有两个不同阶段。第一阶段是让自己相信已经解决了问题或证明了猜想。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 1.2 Mathematical Proof 数学证明 "A mathematical proof is a convincing argument (within the accepted standards of the mathematical community) that a certain mathematical statement is necessarily true." 数学证明是一个令人信服的论证（符合数学界公认的标准），说明某个数学陈述必然为真。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 1.2 Pythagorean Theorem 勾股定理 "The Pythagorean Theorem for right triangles states that if \(a\) and \(b\) are the lengths of the legs of a right triangle and \(c\) is the length of the hypotenuse, then \(a^2 + b^2 = c^2\)" 直角三角形的勾股定理指出：如果 \(a\) 和 \(b\) 是直角三角形两条直角边的长，\(c\) 是斜边的长，那么 \(a^2 + b^2 = c^2\) Sundstrom, 2022, section 1.2 Type 0 Integer 0 型整数 "An integer \(a\) is said to be a type 0 integer if there exists an integer \(n\) such that \(a=3n\text{.}\)" 如果存在整数 \(n\) 使得 \(a=3n\)，就说整数 \(a\) 是 0 型整数。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 1.2 Type 1 Integer 1 型整数 "An integer \(a\) is said to be a type 1 integer if there exists an integer \(n\) such that \(a=3n+1\text{.}\)" 如果存在整数 \(n\) 使得 \(a=3n+1\)，就说整数 \(a\) 是 1 型整数。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 1.2 Type 2 Integer 2 型整数 "An integer \(a\) is said to be a type 2 integer if there exists an integer \(m\) such that \(a=3m+2\text{.}\)" 如果存在整数 \(m\) 使得 \(a=3m+2\)，就说整数 \(a\) 是 2 型整数。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 1.2 Quadratic Equation 二次方程 "Let \(a\text{,}\) \(b\text{,}\) and \(c\) be real numbers with \(a \ne 0\text{.}\) The solutions of the quadratic equation \(ax^2 + bx + c = 0\) are given by the quadratic formula" 设 \(a\)、\(b\) 和 \(c\) 是实数，\(a \ne 0\)。二次方程 \(ax^2 + bx + c = 0\) 的解由求根公式给出 Sundstrom, 2022, section 1.2 Quadratic Formula 二次方程求根公式 "The solutions of the quadratic equation \(ax^2 + bx + c = 0\) are given by the quadratic formula, which states that the solutions are \(x_1\) and \(x_2\text{,}\) where \(x_1 = \frac{-b + \sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a} \text{ and } x_2 = \frac{-b - \sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a}\text{.}\)" 二次方程 \(ax^2 + bx + c = 0\) 的解由求根公式给出，该公式指出方程的解为 \(x_1\) 和 \(x_2\)，其中 \(x_1 = \frac{-b + \sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a} \text{ and } x_2 = \frac{-b - \sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a}\)。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 1.2 Pythagorean Triple 勾股数组 "Three natural numbers \(a\text{,}\) \(b\text{,}\) and \(c\) with \(a \lt b \lt c\) are said to form a Pythagorean triple provided that \(a^2 + b^2 = c^2\text{.}\)" 三个自然数 \(a\)、\(b\) 和 \(c\)（\(a \lt b \lt c\)），如果满足 \(a^2 + b^2 = c^2\)，就说它们构成勾股数组。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 1.2 References Sundstrom, T. (2022). Mathematical reasoning: Writing and proof (Version 2.1; PreTeXt edition by Grand Valley State University). math/proof-techniques/logical-reasoning/.summary:
2.1 Statements and Logical Operators Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 2 Logical Reasoning 逻辑推理 (No definition) （无定义） Sundstrom, 2022, chapter 2 2.1 Statements and Logical Operators 陈述与逻辑运算符 (No definition) （无定义） Sundstrom, 2022, section 2.1 Logical Operator 逻辑运算符 "A logical operator (or connective) on mathematical statements is a word or combination of words that combines one or more mathematical statements to make a new mathematical statement." 数学陈述上的逻辑运算符（或联结词）是把一个或多个数学陈述组合成新数学陈述的词或词组。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 2.1 Compound Statement 复合陈述 "A compound statement is a statement that contains one or more operators." 复合陈述是含有一个或多个运算符的陈述。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 2.1 Connective 联结词 "A logical operator (or connective) on mathematical statements is a word or combination of words that combines one or more mathematical statements to make a new mathematical statement." 数学陈述上的逻辑运算符（或联结词）是把一个或多个数学陈述组合成新数学陈述的词或词组。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 2.1 Conjunction 合取 "The conjunction of the statements \(P\) and \(Q\) is the statement “\(P\) and \(Q\)” and its denoted by \(P \wedge Q\). The statement \(P \wedge Q\) is true only when both \(P\) and \(Q\) are true." 陈述 \(P\) 与 \(Q\) 的合取是陈述“\(P\) 且 \(Q\)”，记作 \(P \wedge Q\)。陈述 \(P \wedge Q\) 只有在两者都为真时才为真，即 \(P\) 和 \(Q\) 都为真。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 2.1 Disjunction 析取 "The disjunction of the statements \(P\) and \(Q\) is the statement “\(P\) or \(Q\)” and its denoted by \(P \vee Q	ext{.}\) The statement \(P \vee Q\) is true only when at least one of \(P\) or \(Q\) is true." 陈述 \(P\) 与 \(Q\) 的析取是陈述“\(P\) 或 \(Q\)”，记作 \(P \vee Q\)。陈述 \(P \vee Q\) 只有在至少一个为真时才为真，即 \(P\) 或 \(Q\) 中至少一个为真。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 2.1 Negation 否定 "The negation of the statement \(P\) is the statement “not \(P\)” and is denoted by \(
eg P\). The negation of \(P\) is true only when \(P\) is false, and \(
eg P\) is false only when \(P\) is true." 陈述 \(P\) 的否定是陈述“非 \(P\)”，记作 \(
eg P\)。\(P\) 的否定只有在 \(P\) 为假时才为真，而 \(
eg P\) 只有在 \(P\) 为真时才为假。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 2.1 Conditional 条件式 "The implication or conditional is the statement “If \(P\) then \(Q\)” and is denoted by \(P 	o Q\). The statement \(P 	o Q\) is often read as “\(P\) implies \(Q	ext{,}\)” and we have seen in Section 1.1 that \(P 	o Q\) is false only when \(P\) is true and \(Q\) is false." 蕴涵或条件式是陈述“如果 \(P\) 那么 \(Q\)”，记作 \(P 	o Q\)。陈述 \(P 	o Q\) 常读作“\(P\) 蕴涵 \(Q\)”，我们在 1.1 节看到 \(P 	o Q\) 只有在 \(P\) 为真且 \(Q\) 为假时才为假。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 2.1 Implication 蕴涵 "The implication or conditional is the statement “If \(P\) then \(Q\)” and is denoted by \(P 	o Q\). The statement \(P 	o Q\) is often read as “\(P\) implies \(Q	ext{,}\)”" 蕴涵或条件式是陈述“如果 \(P\) 那么 \(Q\)”，记作 \(P 	o Q\)。陈述 \(P 	o Q\) 常读作“\(P\) 蕴涵 \(Q\)”。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 2.1 Exclusive Or 不可兼或 "A different use of the word “or” is the “exclusive or.” For the exclusive or, the resulting statement is false when both statements are true. That is, “\(P\) exclusive or \(Q\)” is true only when exactly one of \(P\) or \(Q\) is true." “或”的另一种用法是“不可兼或”。对不可兼或，两个陈述都为真时，所得陈述为假。也就是说，“\(P\) 不可兼或 \(Q\)”只有在恰好一个为真时才为真，即 \(P\) 或 \(Q\) 中恰好一个为真。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 2.1 Inclusive Or 可兼或 "In mathematics, we use the “inclusive or” unless stated otherwise. This means that \(P \vee Q\) is true when both \(P\) and \(Q\) are true and also when only one of them is true." 在数学中，除非另有说明，我们使用“可兼或”。这意味着 \(P \vee Q\) 在两者都为真时为真（\(P\) 和 \(Q\) 都为真），在只有其中一个为真时也为真。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 2.1 Only If 仅当 "Following are some common ways to express the conditional statement \(P 	o Q\) in the English language: If \(P	ext{,}\) then \(Q	ext{.}\) \(P\) implies \(Q	ext{.}\) \(P\) only if \(Q	ext{.}\)" 下面是英语中表达条件陈述 \(P 	o Q\) 的一些常见方式：如果 \(P\)，那么 \(Q\)。\(P\) 蕴涵 \(Q\)。\(P\) 仅当 \(Q\)。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 2.1 Necessary Condition 必要条件 "\(Q\) is necessary for \(P	ext{.}\) (This means that if \(P\) is true, then \(Q\) is necessarily true.)" \(Q\) 对 \(P\) 是必要的。（这意味着如果 \(P\) 为真，那么 \(Q\) 必然为真。） Sundstrom, 2022, section 2.1 Sufficient Condition 充分条件 "\(P\) is sufficient for \(Q	ext{.}\) (This means that if you want \(Q\) to be true, it is sufficient to show that \(P\) is true.)" \(P\) 对 \(Q\) 是充分的。（这意味着如果要 \(Q\) 为真，只需证明 \(P\) 为真。） Sundstrom, 2022, section 2.1 Biconditional Statement 双条件陈述 "The symbolic form for the biconditional statement “\(P\) if and only if \(Q\)” is \(P \leftrightarrow Q	ext{.}\)" 双条件陈述“\(P\) 当且仅当 \(Q\)”的符号形式是 \(P \leftrightarrow Q\)。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 2.1 Tautology 重言式 "A tautology is a compound statement \(S\) that is true for all possible combinations of truth values of the component statements that are part of \(S	ext{.}\)" 重言式是一个复合陈述 \(S\)，它对所有可能的真值组合都为真（指构成 \(S\) 的各分陈述的真值）。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 2.1 Contradiction 矛盾式 "A contradiction is a compound statement that is false for all possible combinations of truth values of the component statements that are part of \(S	ext{.}\)" 矛盾式是一个复合陈述，它对所有可能的真值组合都为假（指构成 \(S\) 的各分陈述的真值）。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 2.1 Modus Ponens 肯定前件式 "Show that \(\left[ (P 	o Q) \wedge P ight] 	o Q\) is a tautology. Note: In symbolic logic, this is an important logical argument form called modus ponens." 证明 \(\left[ (P 	o Q) \wedge P ight] 	o Q\) 是重言式。注：在符号逻辑中，这是一种称为肯定前件式的重要逻辑论证形式。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 2.1 Syllogism 三段论 "Show that \(\left[ (P 	o Q) \wedge (Q 	o R) ight] 	o (P 	o R)\) is a tautology. Note: In symbolic logic, this is an important logical argument form called syllogism." 证明 \(\left[ (P 	o Q) \wedge (Q 	o R) ight] 	o (P 	o R)\) 是重言式。注：在符号逻辑中，这是一种称为三段论的重要逻辑论证形式。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 2.1 References Sundstrom, T. (2022). Mathematical reasoning: Writing and proof (Version 2.1; PreTeXt edition by Grand Valley State University). math/proof-techniques/logical-reasoning/.summary: 2.3 Open Sentences and Sets Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 2 Logical Reasoning 逻辑推理 (No definition) （无定义） Sundstrom, 2022, chapter 2 2.3 Open Sentences and Sets 开语句与集合 (No definition) （无定义） Sundstrom, 2022, section 2.3 Roster Method 列举法 "Listing the elements of a set inside braces is called the roster method of specifying the elements of the set." 把集合的元素列在花括号内，称为表示集合元素的列举法。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 2.3 Variable 变量 "A variable is a symbol representing an unspecified object that can be chosen from a given set \(U\text{.}\)" 变量是代表一个未指定对象的符号，该对象可以从给定集合 \(U\) 中选取。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 2.3 Constant 常量 "A constant is a specific member of the universal set." 常量是全集中的一个特定成员。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 2.3 Universal Set 全集 "The set \(U\) is called the universal set for the variable. It is the set of specified objects from which objects may be chosen to substitute for the variable." 集合 \(U\) 称为该变量的全集。它是一组指定的对象，可从中选取对象来代入变量。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 2.3 Real Numbers 实数 "Recall that we use the symbol \(\mathbb{R}\) to stand for the set of all real numbers" 回想一下，我们用符号 \(\mathbb{R}\) 表示全体实数的集合 Sundstrom, 2022, section 2.3 Equal Sets 相等集合 "Two sets, \(A\) and \(B\text{,}\) are equal when they have precisely the same elements. In this case, we write \(A = B\)." 两个集合 \(A\) 和 \(B\) 的元素完全相同时，它们相等。这时记作 \(A = B\)。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 2.3 Set Equality 集合相等 "Two sets, \(A\) and \(B\text{,}\) are equal when they have precisely the same elements. In this case, we write \(A = B\)." 两个集合 \(A\) 和 \(B\) 的元素完全相同时，它们相等。这时记作 \(A = B\)。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 2.3 Subset 子集 "The set \(A\) is a subset of a set \(B\) provided that each element of \(A\) is an element of \(B\text{.}\) In this case, we write \(A \subseteq B\) and also say that \(A\) is contained in \(B\text{.}\)" 如果 \(A\) 的每个元素都是 \(B\) 的元素，集合 \(A\) 就是集合 \(B\) 的子集。这时记作 \(A \subseteq B\)，也说 \(A\) 包含于 \(B\)。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 2.3 Contained in a Set 包含于集合 "In this case, we write \(A \subseteq B\) and also say that \(A\) is contained in \(B\text{.}\)" 这时记作 \(A \subseteq B\)，也说 \(A\) 包含于 \(B\)。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 2.3 Open Sentence 开语句 "An open sentence is a sentence \(P( {x_1 ,x_2 , \ldots ,x_n })\) involving variables \(x_1 ,x_2 , \ldots ,x_n\) with the property that when specific values from the universal set are assigned to \(x_1 ,x_2 , \ldots ,x_n\text{,}\) then the resulting sentence is either true or false." 开语句是含有变量 \(x_1 ,x_2 , \ldots ,x_n\) 的语句 \(P( {x_1 ,x_2 , \ldots ,x_n })\)，具有这样的性质：把全集中的具体值赋给 \(x_1 ,x_2 , \ldots ,x_n\) 后，所得语句要么真要么假。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 2.3 Predicate 谓词 "An open sentence is also called a predicate or a propositional function." 开语句也称为谓词或命题函数。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 2.3 Propositional Function 命题函数 "An open sentence is also called a predicate or a propositional function." 开语句也称为谓词或命题函数。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 2.3 Solution Set 解集 "In more formal terms, the process of solving an equation is a way to determine the truth set for the equation, which is an open sentence. In this case, we often call the truth set the solution set." 更正式地说，解方程的过程是确定该方程真值集的一种方法，而方程是开语句。这时我们常把真值集称为解集。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 2.3 Truth Set 真值集 "The truth set of an open sentence with one variable is the collection of objects in the universal set that can be substituted for the variable to make the predicate a true statement." 单变量开语句的真值集是全集中能代入该变量、使谓词成为真陈述的那些对象的全体。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 2.3 Set Builder Notation 集合构造记号 "In this case, it is sometimes convenient to use the so-called set builder notation in which the set is defined by stating a rule that all elements of the set must satisfy." 这时，有时用所谓的集合构造记号比较方便，即通过陈述集合所有元素都必须满足的规则来定义集合。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 2.3 Empty Set 空集 "When a set contains no elements, we say that the set is the empty set." 当一个集合不含任何元素时，我们说它是空集。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 2.3 References Sundstrom, T. (2022). Mathematical reasoning: Writing and proof (Version 2.1; PreTeXt edition by Grand Valley State University). math/proof-techniques/logical-reasoning/.summary: 2.4 Quantifiers and Negations Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 2 Logical Reasoning 逻辑推理 (No definition) （无定义） Sundstrom, 2022, chapter 2 2.4 Quantifiers and Negations 量词与否定 (No definition) （无定义） Sundstrom, 2022, section 2.4 Quantifier 量词 "Another way is to make some claim about the truth set of the open sentence. This is often done by using a quantifier." 另一种方法是对开语句的真值集做出某种断言。这常常通过量词来实现。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 2.4 Universal Quantifier 全称量词 "The phrase “for every” (or its equivalents) is called a universal quantifier." 短语“对每个”（或其等价说法）称为全称量词。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 2.4 Existential Quantifier 存在量词 "The phrase “there exists” (or its equivalents) is called an existential quantifier." 短语“存在”（或其等价说法）称为存在量词。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 2.4 Negation of a Quantified Statement 量化陈述的否定 "When we write \(\neg \left( {\forall x} \in U \right)\left[ {P\left( x \right)} \right]\text{,}\) we are asserting that the statement \(\left( {\forall x} \in U \right)\left[ {P( x )} \right]\) is false. This is equivalent to saying that the truth set of the open sentence \(P( x )\) is not the universal set." 当我们写 \(\neg \left( {\forall x} \in U \right)\left[ {P\left( x \right)} \right]\) 时，是在断言陈述 \(\left( {\forall x} \in U \right)\left[ {P( x )} \right]\) 为假。这等于说开语句 \(P( x )\) 的真值集不是全集。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 2.4 Perfect Square 完全平方数 "A natural number \(n\) is a perfect square provided that there exists a natural number \(k\) such that \(n = k^2\text{.}\)" 如果存在自然数 \(k\) 使得 \(n = k^2\)，自然数 \(n\) 就是完全平方数。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 2.4 Divides Property 整除性质 "An integer \(m\) is said to have the divides property provided that for all integers \(a\) and \(b\text{,}\) if \(m\) divides \(ab\text{,}\) then \(m\) divides \(a\) or \(m\) divides \(b\text{.}\)" 如果对所有整数 \(a\) 和 \(b\)，若 \(m\) 整除 \(ab\)，则 \(m\) 整除 \(a\) 或 \(m\) 整除 \(b\)，就说整数 \(m\) 具有整除性质。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 2.4 Strictly Increasing 严格递增 "In calculus, we define a function \(f\) with domain \(\mathbb{R}\) to be strictly increasing provided that for all real numbers \(x\) and \(y\text{,}\) \(f\left( x \right) \lt f\left( y \right)\) whenever \(x \lt y\text{.}\)" 在微积分中，定义域为 \(\mathbb{R}\) 的函数 \(f\) 称为严格递增，如果对所有实数 \(x\) 和 \(y\)，\(f\left( x \right) \lt f\left( y \right)\) 只要 \(x \lt y\)。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 2.4 Continuous 连续 "In calculus, we define a function \(f\) to be continuous at a real number \(a\) provided that for every \(\varepsilon > 0\text{,}\) there exists a \(\delta > 0\) such that if \(\left\vert {x - a} \right\vert \lt \delta\text{,}\) then \(\left\vert {f\left( x \right) - f\left( a \right)} \right\vert \lt \varepsilon\text{.}\)" 在微积分中，函数 \(f\) 称为在实数 \(a\) 处连续，如果对每个 \(\varepsilon > 0\)，存在 \(\delta > 0\) 使得若 \(\left\vert {x - a} \right\vert \lt \delta\)，则 \(\left\vert {f\left( x \right) - f\left( a \right)} \right\vert \lt \varepsilon\)。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 2.4 Cauchy Sequence 柯西序列 "In advanced calculus, a sequence of real numbers \(\left(x_1, x_2, \ldots, x_k, \ldots \right)\) is called a Cauchy sequence provided that for each positive real number \(\varepsilon\text{,}\) there exists a natural number \(N\) such that for all \(m, n \in \mathbb N\text{,}\) if \(m > N\) and \(n > N\text{,}\) then \(\left\vert x_n - x_m \right\vert \lt \varepsilon\text{.}\)" 在高等微积分中，实数数列 \(\left(x_1, x_2, \ldots, x_k, \ldots \right)\) 称为柯西序列，如果对每个正实数 \(\varepsilon\)，存在自然数 \(N\) 使得对所有 \(m, n \in \mathbb N\)，若 \(m > N\) 且 \(n > N\)，则 \(\left\vert x_n - x_m \right\vert \lt \varepsilon\)。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 2.4 Neighborhood 邻域 "A set \(M\) of real numbers is called a neighborhood of a real number \(a\) provided that there exists a positive real number \(\varepsilon\) such that the open interval \((a - \varepsilon, a + \varepsilon)\) is contained in \(M\text{.}\)" 实数集 \(M\) 称为实数 \(a\) 的邻域，如果存在正实数 \(\varepsilon\) 使得开区间 \((a - \varepsilon, a + \varepsilon)\) 包含于 \(M\)。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 2.4 Commutative Operation 可交换运算 "In abstract algebra, an operation \(*\) on a set \(A\) is called a commutative operation provided that for all \(x, y \in A\text{,}\) \(x * y = y * x\text{.}\)" 在抽象代数中，集合 \(A\) 上的运算 \(*\) 称为可交换运算，如果对所有 \(x, y \in A\)，\(x * y = y * x\)。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 2.4 Ring 环 "In abstract algebra, a ring consists of a nonempty set \(R\) and two operations called addition and multiplication." 在抽象代数中，环由一个非空集合 \(R\) 和两种称为加法与乘法的运算组成。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 2.4 Zero Divisor 零因子 "A nonzero element \(a\) in a ring \(R\) is called a zero divisor provided that there exists a nonzero element \(b\) in \(R\) such that \(ab = 0\) or \(ba = 0\text{.}\)" 环 \(R\) 中的非零元素 \(a\) 称为零因子，如果存在非零元素 \(b\) 属于 \(R\) 使得 \(ab = 0\) 或 \(ba = 0\)。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 2.4 Prime Number 素数 "A natural number \(p\) is a prime number provided that it is greater than 1 and the only natural numbers that are factors of \(p\) are 1 and \(p\text{.}\)" 如果自然数 \(p\) 大于 1，并且 \(p\) 的自然数因数只有 1 和 \(p\)，它就是素数。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 2.4 Composite Number 合数 "A natural number other than 1 that is not a prime number is a composite number. The number 1 is neither prime nor composite." 不等于 1 且不是素数的自然数是合数。1 既不是素数也不是合数。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 2.4 Upper Bound 上界 "Let \(A\) be a subset of the real numbers. A number \(b\) is called an upper bound for the set \(A\) provided that for each element \(x\) in \(A\text{,}\) \(x \leq b\text{.}\)" 设 \(A\) 是实数集的子集。如果对 \(A\) 中的每个元素 \(x\)，都有 \(x \leq b\)，数 \(b\) 就称为集合 \(A\) 的上界。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 2.4 Least Upper Bound 最小上界 "A real number \(\alpha\) is the least upper bound for \(A\) provided that \(\alpha\) is an upper bound for \(A\text{,}\) and if \(\beta\) is an upper bound for \(A\text{,}\) then \(\alpha \leq \beta\text{.}\)" 如果 \(\alpha\) 是 \(A\) 的一个上界，并且只要 \(\beta\) 是 \(A\) 的上界就有 \(\alpha \leq \beta\)，实数 \(\alpha\) 就是 \(A\) 的最小上界。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 2.4 References Sundstrom, T. (2022). Mathematical reasoning: Writing and proof (Version 2.1; PreTeXt edition by Grand Valley State University). math/proof-techniques/mathematical-induc.summary: 4.1 The Principle of Mathematical Induction Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 4 Mathematical Induction 数学归纳法 (No definition) （无定义） Sundstrom, 2022, chapter 4 4.1 The Principle of Mathematical Induction 数学归纳法原理 (No definition) （无定义） Sundstrom, 2022, section 4.1 Inductive Set 归纳集 "A set \(T\) that is a subset of \(\mathbb{Z}\) is an inductive set provided that for each integer \(k\text{,}\) if \(k \in T\text{,}\) then \(k + 1 \in T\text{.}\)" 如果对每个整数 \(k\)，若 \(k \in T\)，则 \(k + 1 \in T\)，那么作为 \(\mathbb{Z}\) 子集的集合 \(T\) 就是归纳集。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 4.1 Principle of Mathematical Induction 数学归纳法原理 "If \(T\) is a subset of \(\mathbb{N}\) such that \(1 \in T\text{,}\) and For every \(k \in \mathbb{N}\text{,}\) if \(k \in T\text{,}\) then \(\left( {k + 1} \right) \in T\text{,}\) then \(T = \mathbb{N}\text{.}\)" 如果 \(T\) 是 \(\mathbb{N}\) 的子集，满足 \(1 \in T\)，并且对每个 \(k \in \mathbb{N}\)，若 \(k \in T\) 则 \(\left( {k + 1} \right) \in T\)，那么 \(T = \mathbb{N}\)。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 4.1 Basis Step 基础步骤 "To verify the hypothesis of the The Principle of Mathematical Induction, we must Prove that \(1 \in T\text{.}\) That is, prove that \(P( 1 )\) is true." 要验证数学归纳法原理的假设，我们必须证明 \(1 \in T\)，也就是证明 \(P( 1 )\) 为真。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 4.1 Inductive Step 归纳步骤 "Prove that \(1 \in T\text{.}\) That is, prove that \(P( 1 )\) is true. Prove that if \(k \in T\text{,}\) then \(\left( {k + 1} \right) \in T\text{.}\) That is, prove that if \(P( k )\) is true, then \(P( {k + 1} )\) is true" 证明 \(1 \in T\)，即证明 \(P( 1 )\) 为真。证明若 \(k \in T\)，则 \(\left( {k + 1} \right) \in T\)，也就是证明若 \(P( k )\) 为真，则 \(P( {k + 1} )\) 为真 Sundstrom, 2022, section 4.1 Procedure for a Proof by Mathematical Induction 数学归纳法证明的步骤 "To prove: \(\left( {\forall n \in \mathbb{N}} \right)\left( {P\left( n \right)} \right)\) Basis step: Prove \(P( 1 )\text{.}\) Inductive step: Prove that for each \(k \in \mathbb{N}\text{,}\) if \(P( k )\) is true, then \(P( {k + 1} )\) is true. We can then conclude that \(P( n )\) is true for all \(n \in \mathbb{N}\text{.}\)" 要证明：\(\left( {\forall n \in \mathbb{N}} \right)\left( {P\left( n \right)} \right)\)。基础步骤：证明 \(P( 1 )\)。归纳步骤：证明对每个 \(k \in \mathbb{N}\)，若 \(P( k )\) 为真，则 \(P( {k + 1} )\) 为真。于是可以断定 \(P( n )\) 对所有 \(n \in \mathbb{N}\) 为真。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 4.1 Inductive Assumption 归纳假定 "So we will start the inductive step by assuming that \(P( k )\) is true. This assumption is called the inductive assumption or the inductive hypothesis." 所以我们从假设 \(P( k )\) 为真开始归纳步骤。这个假设称为归纳假定或归纳假设。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 4.1 Inductive Hypothesis 归纳假设 "So we will start the inductive step by assuming that \(P( k )\) is true. This assumption is called the inductive assumption or the inductive hypothesis." 所以我们从假设 \(P( k )\) 为真开始归纳步骤。这个假设称为归纳假定或归纳假设。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 4.1 Wallis Sine Formulas 沃利斯正弦公式 "\(\begin{aligned} \int_{0}^{\pi/2} \sin^{\,2n}x \, dx & = \frac{1 \cdot 3 \cdot 5 \cdots (2n - 1)}{2 \cdot 4 \cdot 6 \cdots (2n)} \frac{\pi}{2} \text{ and }\\ \int_{0}^{\pi/2} \sin^{\,2n+1}x \, dx & = \frac{2 \cdot 4 \cdot 6 \cdots (2n)}{1 \cdot 3 \cdot 5 \cdots (2n + 1)}\text{.} \end{aligned}\) These are known as the Wallis sine formulas." \(\begin{aligned} \int_{0}^{\pi/2} \sin^{\,2n}x \, dx & = \frac{1 \cdot 3 \cdot 5 \cdots (2n - 1)}{2 \cdot 4 \cdot 6 \cdots (2n)} \frac{\pi}{2} \text{ and }\\ \int_{0}^{\pi/2} \sin^{\,2n+1}x \, dx & = \frac{2 \cdot 4 \cdot 6 \cdots (2n)}{1 \cdot 3 \cdot 5 \cdots (2n + 1)} \end{aligned}\) 这些称为沃利斯正弦公式。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 4.1 Wallis Cosine Formulas 沃利斯余弦公式 "\(\begin{aligned} \int_{0}^{\pi/2} \cos^{\,2n}x \, dx & = \frac{1 \cdot 3 \cdot 5 \cdots (2n - 1)}{2 \cdot 4 \cdot 6 \cdots (2n)} \frac{\pi}{2} \text{ and }\\ \int_{0}^{\pi/2} \cos^{\,2n+1}x \, dx & = \frac{2 \cdot 4 \cdot 6 \cdots (2n)}{1 \cdot 3 \cdot 5 \cdots (2n+1)}\text{.} \end{aligned}\) These are known as the Wallis cosine formulas." \(\begin{aligned} \int_{0}^{\pi/2} \cos^{\,2n}x \, dx & = \frac{1 \cdot 3 \cdot 5 \cdots (2n - 1)}{2 \cdot 4 \cdot 6 \cdots (2n)} \frac{\pi}{2} \text{ and }\\ \int_{0}^{\pi/2} \cos^{\,2n+1}x \, dx & = \frac{2 \cdot 4 \cdot 6 \cdots (2n)}{1 \cdot 3 \cdot 5 \cdots (2n+1)} \end{aligned}\) 这些称为沃利斯余弦公式。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 4.1 References Sundstrom, T. (2022). Mathematical reasoning: Writing and proof (Version 2.1; PreTeXt edition by Grand Valley State University). math/proof-techniques/mathematical-induc.summary: 4.2 Other Forms of Mathematical Induction Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 4 Mathematical Induction 数学归纳法 (No definition) （无定义） Sundstrom, 2022, chapter 4 4.2 Other Forms of Mathematical Induction 数学归纳法的其他形式 (No definition) （无定义） Sundstrom, 2022, section 4.2 Factorial 阶乘 "If \(n\) is a natural number, we define \(\boldsymbol{n}\) factorial, denoted by \(n!\), to be the product of the first \(n\) natural numbers. In addition, we define \(0!\) to be equal to 1." 如果 \(n\) 是自然数，定义 \(\boldsymbol{n}\) 的阶乘（记作 \(n!\)）为前 \(n\) 个自然数的乘积。另外，定义 \(0!\) 等于 1。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 4.2 Domino Theory 多米诺理论 "Now imagine that each statement in equation (29) is a domino in a chain of dominoes. When we prove the inductive step, we are proving that if one domino is knocked over, then it will knock over the next one in the chain." 现在想象式 (29) 中的每个陈述都是一串多米诺骨牌中的一块。证明归纳步骤，就是在证明如果一块骨牌被推倒，它就会推倒链中的下一块。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 4.2 Extended Principle of Mathematical Induction 扩展数学归纳法原理 "Let \(M\) be an integer. If \(T\) is a subset of \(\mathbb{Z}\) such that \(M \in T\text{,}\) and For every \(k \in \mathbb{Z}\) with \(k \geq M\text{,}\) if \(k \in T\text{,}\) then \(\left( {k + 1} \right) \in T\text{,}\) then \(T\) contains all integers greater than or equal to \(M\text{.}\)" 设 \(M\) 是整数。如果 \(T\) 是 \(\mathbb{Z}\) 的子集，满足 \(M \in T\)，并且对每个满足 \(k \geq M\) 的 \(k \in \mathbb{Z}\)，若 \(k \in T\) 则 \(\left( {k + 1} \right) \in T\)，那么 \(T\) 包含所有大于或等于 \(M\) 的整数。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 4.2 Second Principle of Mathematical Induction 第二数学归纳法原理 "Let \(M\) be an integer. If \(T\) is a subset of \(\mathbb{Z}\) such that \(M \in T\text{,}\) and For every \(k \in \mathbb{Z}\) with \(k \geq M\text{,}\) if \(\left\{ {M, M + 1, \ldots ,k} \right\} \subseteq T\text{,}\) then \(\left( {k + 1} \right) \in T\text{,}\) then \(T\) contains all integers greater than or equal to \(M\text{.}\)" 设 \(M\) 是整数。如果 \(T\) 是 \(\mathbb{Z}\) 的子集，满足 \(M \in T\)，并且对每个满足 \(k \geq M\) 的 \(k \in \mathbb{Z}\)，若 \(\left\{ {M, M + 1, \ldots ,k} \right\} \subseteq T\) 则 \(\left( {k + 1} \right) \in T\)，那么 \(T\) 包含所有大于或等于 \(M\) 的整数。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 4.2 De Moivre's Theorem 棣莫弗定理 "One version of the theorem can be stated as follows: If \(x\) is a real number, then for each nonnegative integer \(n\text{,}\) \(\left[ {\cos x + i(\sin x)} \right]^n = \cos (nx) + i( {\sin (nx)} )\!\text{.}\)" 该定理的一种形式可以表述为：如果 \(x\) 是实数，那么对每个非负整数 \(n\)，\(\left[ {\cos x + i(\sin x)} \right]^n = \cos (nx) + i( {\sin (nx)} )\)。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 4.2 References Sundstrom, T. (2022). Mathematical reasoning: Writing and proof (Version 2.1; PreTeXt edition by Grand Valley State University). math/proof-techniques/mathematical-induc.summary: 4.3 Induction and Recursion Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 4 Mathematical Induction 数学归纳法 (No definition) （无定义） Sundstrom, 2022, chapter 4 4.3 Induction and Recursion 归纳与递归 (No definition) （无定义） Sundstrom, 2022, section 4.3 Recurrence Relation 递推关系 "The specific definition of the first term is called the initial condition, and the general definition of \(a_{n + 1}\) in terms of \(n\) and the first \(n\) terms \(a_1 ,a_2 , \ldots ,a_n\) is called the recurrence relation." 第一项的具体定义称为初始条件，而用 \(n\) 和前 \(n\) 项 \(a_1 ,a_2 , \ldots ,a_n\) 表示 \(a_{n + 1}\) 的一般定义称为递推关系。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 4.3 Initial Condition 初始条件 "The specific definition of the first term is called the initial condition" 第一项的具体定义称为初始条件 Sundstrom, 2022, section 4.3 Recursive Definition 递归定义 "Another way to define a sequence is to give a specific definition of the first term (or the first few terms) and then state, in general terms, how to determine \(a_{n + 1}\) in terms of \(n\) and the first \(n\) terms \(a_1 ,a_2 , \ldots ,a_n\text{.}\) This process is known as definition by recursion and is also called a recursive definition." 定义数列的另一种方法是给出第一项的具体定义（或前几项的），然后一般地说明如何确定 \(a_{n + 1}\)（用 \(n\) 和前 \(n\) 项 \(a_1 ,a_2 , \ldots ,a_n\) 表示）。这个过程称为递归定义法，也称为递归定义。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 4.3 Fibonacci Numbers 斐波那契数 "The Fibonacci numbers are a sequence of natural numbers \(f_1 ,f_2 ,f_3 , \ldots ,f_n , \ldots\) defined recursively as follows: \(f_1 = 1\) and \(f_2 = 1\text{,}\) and For each natural number \(n\text{,}\) \(f_{n + 2} = f_{n + 1} + f_n\text{.}\)" 斐波那契数是一个自然数数列 \(f_1 ,f_2 ,f_3 , \ldots ,f_n , \ldots\)，按如下方式递归定义：\(f_1 = 1\)，\(f_2 = 1\)，并且对每个自然数 \(n\)，\(f_{n + 2} = f_{n + 1} + f_n\)。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 4.3 Geometric Sequence 等比数列 "This is a recursive definition for a geometric sequence with initial term \(a\) and (common) ratio \(r\text{.}\) The basic idea is that the next term in the sequence is obtained by multiplying the previous term by the ratio \(r\text{.}\)" 这是首项为 \(a\)、公比为 \(r\) 的等比数列的递归定义。基本思想是：数列的下一项由前一项乘以公比得到 \(r\)。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 4.3 Geometric Series 等比级数 "For each \(n \in \mathbb{N}\text{,}\) the term \(S_n\) is a (finite) geometric series with initial term \(a\) and (common) ratio \(r\text{.}\)" 对每个 \(n \in \mathbb{N}\)，项 \(S_n\) 是首项为 \(a\) 、公比为 \(r\) 的（有限）等比级数。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 4.3 Binet's Formula 比内公式 "Use induction to prove that for each natural number \(n\text{,}\) if \(\alpha = \dfrac{1 + \sqrt{5}}{2}\) and \(\beta = \dfrac{1 - \sqrt{5}}{2}\text{,}\) then \(f_n = \dfrac{\alpha^n - \beta^n}{\alpha - \beta}\text{.}\) This formula for the \(n^{th}\) Fibonacci number is known as Binet's formula" 用归纳法证明：对每个自然数 \(n\)，若 \(\alpha = \dfrac{1 + \sqrt{5}}{2}\)，\(\beta = \dfrac{1 - \sqrt{5}}{2}\)，则 \(f_n = \dfrac{\alpha^n - \beta^n}{\alpha - \beta}\)。这个关于第 \(n^{th}\) 个斐波那契数的公式称为比内公式 Sundstrom, 2022, section 4.3 Arithmetic Sequence 等差数列 "An arithmetic sequence is defined recursively as follows: Let \(c\) and \(d\) be real numbers. Define the sequence \(a_1 ,a_2 , \ldots ,a_n , \ldots\) by \(a_1 = c\) and for each \(n \in \mathbb{N}\text{,}\) \(a_{n + 1} = a_n + d\text{.}\)" 等差数列按如下方式递归定义：设 \(c\) 和 \(d\) 是实数，定义数列 \(a_1 ,a_2 , \ldots ,a_n , \ldots\) 为 \(a_1 = c\)，并且对每个 \(n \in \mathbb{N}\)，\(a_{n + 1} = a_n + d\)。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 4.3 Lucas Numbers 卢卡斯数 "The Lucas numbers are a sequence of natural numbers \(L_1, L_2, L_3, \ldots, L_n, \ldots \text{,}\) which are defined recursively as follows: \(L_1 = 1\) and \(L_2 = 3\text{,}\) and For each natural number \(n\text{,}\) \(L_{n+2} = L_{n+1} + L_n\text{.}\)" 卢卡斯数是一个自然数数列 \(L_1, L_2, L_3, \ldots, L_n, \ldots\)，它按如下方式递归定义：\(L_1 = 1\)，\(L_2 = 3\)，并且对每个自然数 \(n\)，\(L_{n+2} = L_{n+1} + L_n\)。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 4.3 Compound Interest 复利 "Assume that \(R\) dollars is deposited in an account that has an interest rate of \(i\) for each compounding period. A compounding period is some specified time period such as a month or a year." 假设把 \(R\) 美元存入一个账户，该账户每个计息期的利率为 \(i\)。计息期是某个指定的时间段，例如一个月或一年。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 4.3 Future Value 终值 "Let \(S_t\) represent the amount in the account at the end of the \(t\) th compounding period. \(S_t\) is frequently called the future value of the ordinary annuity." 设 \(S_t\) 表示第 \(t\) 个计息期结束时账户中的金额。\(S_t\) 常称为普通年金的终值。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 4.3 Ordinary Annuity 普通年金 "For an ordinary annuity, \(R\) dollars is deposited in an account at the end of each compounding period." 对普通年金，每个计息期结束时，把 \(R\) 美元存入账户。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 4.3 References Sundstrom, T. (2022). Mathematical reasoning: Writing and proof (Version 2.1; PreTeXt edition by Grand Valley State University). 中不属于 \(A\) 的所有元素组成的集合。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 5.1 Relative Complement 相对补集 "The set difference of \(A\) and \(B\text{,}\) or relative complement of \(B\) with respect to \(A\text{,}\) written \(A - B\) and read “\(A\) minus \(B\)” or “the complement of \(B\) with respect to \(A\text{,}\)” is the set of all elements in \(A\) that are not in \(B\text{.}\)" \(A\) 与 \(B\) 的差集，或 \(B\) 相对于 \(A\) 的相对补集，记作 \(A - B\)，读作“\(A\) 减 \(B\)”或“\(B\) 相对于 \(A\) 的补集”，是属于 \(A\) 但不属于 \(B\) 的所有元素组成的集合。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 5.1 Venn Diagram 维恩图 "Venn diagrams are used to represent sets by circles (or some 的真子集时，记作 \(A \subset B\)。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 5.1 Power Set 幂集 "If \(A\) is a subset of a universal set \(U\text{,}\) then the set whose members are all the subsets of \(A\) is called the power math/proof-techniques/topics-in-number-t.summary: 8.1 The Greatest Common Divisor Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 8 Topics in Number Theory 数论专题 (No definition) （无定义） Sundstrom, 2022, chapter 8 8.1 The Greatest Common Divisor 最大公因数 (No definition) （无定义） Sundstrom, 2022, section 8.1 Common Divisor 公因数 "A common divisor of \(a\) and \(b\) is any nonzero integer that divides both \(a\) and \(b\text{.}\)" \(a\) 与 \(b\) 的公因数是同时整除 \(a\) 和 \(b\) 的任意非零整数。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 8.1 Greatest Common Divisor 最大公因数 "The largest natural number that divides both \(a\) and \(b\) is called the greatest common divisor of \(a\) and \(b\text{.}\)" 同时整除 \(a\) 和 \(b\) 的最大自然数称为 \(a\) 与 \(b\) 的最大公因数。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 8.1 System of Integers 整数系 "Number theory is a study of the system of integers, which consists of the set of integers, \(\mathbb{Z} = \left\{ \ldots , - 3, - 2, - 1, 0, 1, 2, 3, \ldots \right\}\) and the various properties of this set under the usual operations of addition and multiplication and under the usual ordering relation of “less than.”" 数论研究整数系，整数系由整数集组成，即 \(\mathbb{Z} = \left\{ \ldots , - 3, - 2, - 1, 0, 1, 2, 3, \ldots \right\}\)，以及这个集合在通常的加法、乘法运算和通常的“小于”顺序关系下的各种性质。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 8.1 Euclidean Algorithm 欧几里得算法 "The example in Progress Check 8.4 illustrates the main idea of the Euclidean Algorithm for finding \(\gcd( {a, b} )\text{,}\) which is explained in the proof of the following theorem." 进度检查 8.4 中的例子说明了欧几里得算法的主要思想，该算法用于求 \(\gcd( {a, b} )\)，具体在下面定理的证明中说明。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 8.1 Linear Combination 线性组合 "A linear combination of \(a\) and \(b\) is an integer of the form \(ax + by\text{,}\) where \(x\) and \(y\) are integers." \(a\) 与 \(b\) 的线性组合是形如 \(ax + by\) 的整数，其中 \(x\) 和 \(y\) 是整数。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 8.1 Well-Ordering Principle 良序原理 "The Well-Ordering Principle for the natural numbers states that any nonempty set of natural numbers must contain a least element." 自然数的良序原理指出：任何非空自然数集都必定含有最小元素。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 8.1 References Sundstrom, T. (2022). Mathematical reasoning: Writing and proof (Version 2.1; PreTeXt edition by Grand Valley State University). Retrieved October 30, 2026, from https://gvsuoer.github.io/sundstrom-textbook/frontmatter.html

math/proof-techniques/topics-in-number-t.title: 8.2 Prime Numbers and Prime Factorizations | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
math/proof-techniques/topics-in-number-t.summary: 8.2 Prime Numbers and Prime Factorizations Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 8 Topics in Number Theory 数论专题 (No definition) （无定义） Sundstrom, 2022, chapter 8 8.2 Prime Numbers and Prime Factorizations 素数与素因数分解 (No definition) （无定义） Sundstrom, 2022, section 8.2 Prime Factorization 素因数分解 (context) "Recall that a natural number \(p\) is a prime number provided that it is greater than 1 and the only natural numbers that divide \(p\) are 1 and \(p\text{.}\)" （语境）回想一下，如果自然数 \(p\) 大于 1，并且能整除 \(p\) 的自然数只有 1 和 \(p\)，它就是素数。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 8.2 Relatively Prime Integers 互素整数 "Two nonzero integers \(a\) and \(b\) are relatively prime provided that \(\gcd( {a, b} ) = 1\text{.}\)" 如果 \(\gcd( {a, b} ) = 1\)，两个非零整数 \(a\) 和 \(b\) 就是互素的。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 8.2 Euclid's Lemma 欧几里得引理 "Item 1 of Corollary 8.16 is known as Euclid's Lemma." 推论 8.16 的第 1 项称为欧几里得引理。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 8.2 Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic 算术基本定理 "Each natural number greater than 1 is either a prime number or is a product of prime numbers." 每个大于 1 的自然数要么是素数，要么是素数的乘积。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 8.2 Unique Factorization 唯一分解 "Note: We often shorten the result of the Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic by simply saying that each natural number greater than one that is not a prime has a unique factorization as a product of primes. This simply means that if \(n \in \mathbb{N}\text{,}\) \(n > 1\text{,}\) and \(n\) is not prime, then no matter how we choose to factor \(n\) into a product of primes, we will always have the same prime factors." 注：我们常把算术基本定理简述为：每个大于 1 且不是素数的自然数都有唯一的分解，分解为素数的乘积。这就是说，如果 \(n \in \mathbb{N}\)，\(n > 1\)，且 \(n\) 不是素数，那么无论怎样把 \(n\) 分解为素数的乘积，得到的素因数总是相同的。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 8.2 Distribution of Prime Numbers 素数分布 "There are infinitely many primes, but when we write a list of the prime numbers, we can see some long sequences of consecutive natural numbers that contain no prime numbers." 素数有无穷多个，但列出素数时，可以看到一些很长的、不含素数的连续自然数序列。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 8.2 Twin Prime Conjecture 孪生素数猜想 "The Twin Prime Conjecture states that there are infinitely many twin primes." 孪生素数猜想指出：孪生素数有无穷多对。 Sundstrom, 2022, section 8.2 References Sundstrom, T. (2022). Mathematical reasoning: Writing and proof (Version 2.1; PreTeXt edition by Grand Valley State University). Retrieved October 30, 2026, from https://gvsuoer.github.io/sundstrom-textbook/frontmatter.html

math/theorems/9-open-problems.html.title: 9 Open Problems | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
math/theorems/9-open-problems.html.summary: 9 Open Problems Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source Theorems and Conjectures 定理与猜想 (No definition) （无定义） Wiedijk, n.d. 9 Open Problems 未解决问题 (No definition) （无定义） Clay Mathematics Institute, n.d.-a 9.1 Millennium Prize Problems 千禧年大奖难题 "The seven Millennium Prize Problems were chosen by the founding Scientific Advisory Board of CMI, which conferred with leading experts worldwide. The focus of the board was on important classic questions that have resisted solution for many years." 七个千禧年大奖难题由 CMI（克雷数学研究所）创始科学顾问委员会与世界各地的顶尖专家商议后选定。委员会关注的是多年来未被解决的重要经典问题。 Clay Mathematics Institute, n.d.-a P vs NP P 与 NP 问题 "one of the outstanding problems in computer science is determining whether questions exist whose answer can be quickly checked, but which require an impossibly long time to solve by any direct procedure." 计算机科学中悬而未决的问题之一，是判定是否存在答案能被快速验证、却需要长得不可能的时间才能解出的问题（用任何直接的方法）。 Clay Mathematics Institute, n.d.-b Hodge Conjecture 霍奇猜想 "The Hodge conjecture asserts that for particularly nice types of spaces called projective algebraic varieties, the pieces called Hodge cycles are actually (rational linear) combinations of geometric pieces called algebraic cycles." 霍奇猜想断言，对于称为射影代数簇的一类特别好的空间，称为霍奇闭链的部分实际上是称为代数闭链的几何部分的（有理线性）组合。 Clay Mathematics Institute, n.d.-c Poincaré Conjecture 庞加莱猜想（已解决） "Poincaré, almost a hundred years ago, knew that a two dimensional sphere is essentially characterized by this property of simple connectivity, and asked the corresponding question for the three dimensional sphere." 近一百年前，庞加莱就知道二维球面本质上由单连通这一性质刻画，并对三维球面提出了相应的问题。 Clay Mathematics Institute, n.d.-d Riemann Hypothesis 黎曼猜想 "The Riemann hypothesis asserts that all interesting solutions of the equation ζ(s) = 0 lie on a certain vertical straight line." 黎曼猜想断言，方程 ζ(s) = 0 的所有有意义的解都位于某条竖直的直线上。 Clay Mathematics Institute, n.d.-e Yang-Mills and Mass Gap 杨-米尔斯与质量间隙 "Progress in establishing the existence of the Yang-Mills theory and a mass gap will require the introduction of fundamental new ideas both in physics and in mathematics." 要在确立杨-米尔斯理论和质量间隙的存在性上取得进展，需要在物理和数学两方面引入全新的基本思想。 Clay Mathematics Institute, n.d.-f Navier-Stokes Equation 纳维-斯托克斯方程 "The challenge is to make substantial progress toward a mathematical theory which will unlock the secrets hidden in the Navier-Stokes equations." 挑战在于取得实质性进展，建立一套能揭开纳维-斯托克斯方程中隐藏秘密的数学理论。 Clay Mathematics Institute, n.d.-g Birch and Swinnerton-Dyer Conjecture 贝赫和斯维讷通-戴尔猜想 "the Birch and Swinnerton-Dyer conjecture asserts that the size of the group of rational points is related to the behavior of an associated zeta function ζ(s) near the point s=1." 贝赫和斯维讷通-戴尔猜想断言，有理点群的大小与相应的 zeta 函数 ζ(s) 在 s=1 附近的性态有关。 Clay Mathematics Institute, n.d.-h References Clay Mathematics Institute. medical-health-sciences/mesh/a-anatomy/i.summary: A Anatomy Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source A Anatomy 解剖学 (No definition) （无定义） National Library of Medicine, 2026 A01 Body Regions 身体部位 "Anatomical areas of the body." 身体的解剖区域。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Body Regions" scope note A02 Musculoskeletal System 肌肉骨骼系统 "The MUSCLES, bones (BONE AND BONES), and CARTILAGE of the body." 身体的肌肉（MUSCLES）、骨骼（BONE AND BONES）和软骨（CARTILAGE）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Musculoskeletal System" scope note A03 Digestive System 消化系统 "A group of organs stretching from the MOUTH to the ANUS, serving to breakdown foods, assimilate nutrients, and eliminate waste. In humans, the digestive system includes the GASTROINTESTINAL TRACT and the accessory glands (LIVER; BILIARY TRACT; PANCREAS)." 一组从口（MOUTH）延伸到肛门（ANUS）的器官，用于分解食物、吸收营养和排出废物。在人体中，消化系统包括胃肠道（GASTROINTESTINAL TRACT）和附属腺体（肝脏 LIVER；胆道 BILIARY TRACT；胰腺 PANCREAS）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Digestive System" scope note A04 Respiratory System 呼吸系统 "The tubular and cavernous organs and structures, by means of which pulmonary ventilation and gas exchange between ambient air and the blood are brought about." 管状和腔状的器官与结构，借助它们实现肺通气以及环境空气与血液之间的气体交换。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Respiratory System" scope note A05 Urogenital System 泌尿生殖系统 "All the organs involved in reproduction and the formation and release of URINE." 参与生殖以及尿液（URINE）生成和排出的全部器官。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Urogenital System" scope note A06 Endocrine System 内分泌系统 "The system of glands that release their secretions (hormones) directly into the circulatory system. In addition to the ENDOCRINE GLANDS, included are the CHROMAFFIN SYSTEM and the NEUROSECRETORY SYSTEMS." 由腺体组成的系统，这些腺体把分泌物（激素）直接释放进循环系统。除内分泌腺（ENDOCRINE GLANDS）外，还包括嗜铬系统（CHROMAFFIN SYSTEM）和神经分泌系统（NEUROSECRETORY SYSTEMS）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Endocrine System" scope note A07 Cardiovascular System 心血管系统 "The HEART and the BLOOD VESSELS by which BLOOD is pumped and circulated through the body." 心脏（HEART）和血管（BLOOD VESSELS），血液（BLOOD）借助它们被泵出并在全身循环。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Cardiovascular System" scope note A08 Nervous System 神经系统 "The entire nerve apparatus, composed of a central part, the brain and spinal cord, and a peripheral part, the cranial and spinal nerves, autonomic ganglia, and plexuses. (Stedman, 26th ed)" 整个神经装置，由中枢部分（脑和脊髓）和周围部分（脑神经和脊神经、自主神经节和神经丛）组成。（Stedman，第 26 版） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Nervous System" scope note A09 Sense Organs 感觉器官 "Specialized organs adapted for the reception of stimuli by the NERVOUS SYSTEM." 为神经系统（NERVOUS SYSTEM）接收刺激而特化的器官。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Sense Organs" scope note A10 Tissues 组织 "Collections of differentiated CELLS, such as EPITHELIUM; CONNECTIVE TISSUE; MUSCLES; and NERVE TISSUE. Tissues are cooperatively arranged to form organs with specialized functions such as RESPIRATION; DIGESTION; REPRODUCTION; MOVEMENT; and others." 分化细胞（CELLS）的集合，如上皮（EPITHELIUM）、结缔组织（CONNECTIVE TISSUE）、肌肉（MUSCLES）和神经组织（NERVE TISSUE）。组织协同排列，构成具有特定功能的器官，如呼吸（RESPIRATION）、消化（DIGESTION）、生殖（REPRODUCTION）、运动（MOVEMENT）等。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Tissues" scope note A11 Cells 细胞 "The fundamental, structural, and functional units or subunits of living organisms. They are composed of CYTOPLASM containing various ORGANELLES and a CELL MEMBRANE boundary." 生物体的基本结构和功能单位或亚单位。它们由含有各种细胞器（ORGANELLES）的细胞质（CYTOPLASM）和作为边界的细胞膜（CELL MEMBRANE）组成。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Cells" scope note A12 Fluids and Secretions 体液和分泌物 "Liquid substances produced by living organisms to fulfill specific functions or excreted as waste." 由生物体产生的液态物质，用于完成特定功能或作为废物排出。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Fluids and Secretions" scope note A13 Animal Structures 动物结构 "Organs and other anatomical structures of non-human vertebrate and invertebrate animals." 非人类脊椎动物和无脊椎动物的器官及其他解剖结构。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Animal Structures" scope note A14 Stomatognathic System 口颌系统 "The mouth, teeth, jaws, pharynx, and related structures as they relate to mastication, deglutition, and speech." 口、牙、颌、咽及相关结构，就其与咀嚼、吞咽和言语的关系而言。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Stomatognathic System" scope note A15 Hemic and Immune Systems 血液和免疫系统 "Organs involved in the production of BLOOD, including the cellular and the molecular components essential in providing defense against foreign organisms or substances." 参与血液（BLOOD）生成的器官，包括在抵御外来生物或物质中必不可少的细胞成分和分子成分。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Hemic and Immune Systems" scope note A16 Embryonic Structures 胚胎结构 "The anatomical parts that make up an organism in the early stages of development." 生物体在发育早期阶段的各个解剖部分。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Embryonic Structures" scope note A17 Integumentary System 皮肤系统 "The outer covering of the body composed of the SKIN and the skin appendages, which are the HAIR, the NAILS; and the SEBACEOUS GLANDS and the SWEAT GLANDS and their ducts." 身体的外层覆盖物，由皮肤（SKIN）及皮肤附属器组成，附属器即毛发（HAIR）、指（趾）甲（NAILS），以及皮脂腺（SEBACEOUS GLANDS）、汗腺（SWEAT GLANDS）和它们的导管。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Integumentary System" scope note A18 Plant Structures 植物结构 "The parts of plants, including SEEDS." 植物的各部分，包括种子（SEEDS）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Plant Structures" scope note A19 Fungal Structures 真菌结构 "The parts of fungi." 真菌的各部分。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Fungal Structures" scope note A20 Bacterial Structures 细菌结构 "The parts of bacteria." 细菌的各部分。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Bacterial Structures" scope note A21 Viral Structures 病毒结构 "The structural parts of the VIRION." 病毒体（VIRION）的结构部分。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Viral Structures" scope note References National Library of Medicine. (2026). MeSH 2026 descriptor records [Data set]. Retrieved October 28, 2026, from https://www.nlm.nih.gov/databases/download/mesh.html

medical-health-sciences/mesh/b-organisms.summary: B Organisms Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source B Organisms 生物体 (No definition) （无定义） National Library of Medicine, 2026 B01 Eukaryota 真核生物 "One of the three domains of life (the others being BACTERIA and ARCHAEA), also called Eukarya. These are organisms whose cells are enclosed in membranes and possess a nucleus." 生命三域之一（另两个是细菌 BACTERIA 和古菌 ARCHAEA），也称真核域（Eukarya）。这类生物的细胞由膜包裹并具有细胞核。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Eukaryota" scope note B02 Archaea 古菌 "One of the three domains of life (the others being BACTERIA and Eukarya), formerly called Archaebacteria under the taxon Bacteria, but now considered separate and distinct." 生命三域之一（另两个是细菌 BACTERIA 和真核域 Eukarya），过去在细菌分类单元下称为古细菌（Archaebacteria），现在被认为是独立且不同的一类。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Archaea" scope note B03 Bacteria 细菌 "One of the three domains of life (the others being Eukarya and ARCHAEA), also called Eubacteria. They are unicellular prokaryotic microorganisms which generally possess rigid cell walls, multiply by cell division, and exhibit three principal forms: round or coccal, rodlike or bacillary, and spiral or spirochetal." 生命三域之一（另两个是真核域 Eukarya 和古菌 ARCHAEA），也称真细菌（Eubacteria）。它们是单细胞原核微生物，通常具有坚硬的细胞壁，以细胞分裂方式繁殖，呈现三种主要形态：圆形或球状、杆状或杆菌状、螺旋形或螺旋体状。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Bacteria" scope note B04 Viruses 病毒 "Minute infectious agents whose genomes are composed of DNA or RNA, but not both. They are characterized by a lack of independent metabolism and the inability to replicate outside living host cells." 微小的感染因子，其基因组由 DNA 或 RNA 构成，但不会两者兼有。它们的特征是没有独立的代谢，并且不能在活宿主细胞之外复制。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Viruses" scope note B05 Organism Forms 生物体形态 "Specific states or life cycle stages of organisms. These include post-embryonic stages of insects, symbiotic relationships between organisms, and reproductive elements such as spores." 生物体的特定状态或生命周期阶段。包括昆虫的胚后阶段、生物之间的共生关系，以及孢子等生殖要素。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Organism Forms" scope note References National Library of Medicine. (2026). MeSH 2026 descriptor records [Data set]. Retrieved October 28, 2026, from https://www.nlm.nih.gov/databases/download/mesh.html

medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.summary: C07 Stomatognathic Diseases Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source C07 Stomatognathic Diseases 口颌系统疾病 "General or unspecified diseases of the stomatognathic system, comprising the mouth, teeth, jaws, and pharynx." 一般性或未特指的口颌系统疾病，口颌系统包括口、牙、颌骨和咽。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Stomatognathic Diseases" scope note C07.160 Ankyloglossia 舌系带短缩 "A severe congenital restriction of TONGUE movement, resulting from fusion or adherence of the tongue to the floor of the mouth. In partial ankyloglossia (tongue-tie) the LINGUAL FRENUM is abnormally short, or is attached too close to the tip of the tongue. OMIM: 106280" 由舌与口底融合或粘连所致的一种严重的先天性舌（TONGUE）运动受限。在部分性舌系带短缩（舌系带过短）中，舌系带（LINGUAL FRENUM）异常短小，或附着处过于靠近舌尖。OMIM：106280 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Ankyloglossia" scope note C07.320 Jaw Diseases 颌疾病 "Diseases involving the JAW." 累及颌（JAW）的疾病。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Jaw Diseases" scope note C07.320.086 Bisphosphonate-Associated Osteonecrosis of the Jaw 双膦酸盐相关性颌骨坏死 "Necrotic jaws or other maxillofacial skeleton necrosis associated with bisphosphonate use (see BISPHOSPHONATES). Injury, dental procedures, and trauma can trigger the necrotic process." 颌骨坏死或其他颌面骨骼坏死，与双膦酸盐使用相关（见双膦酸盐（BISPHOSPHONATES））。损伤、牙科操作和创伤可触发坏死过程。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Bisphosphonate-Associated Osteonecrosis of the Jaw" scope note C07.320.173 Cherubism 巨颌症 "A fibro-osseous hereditary disease of the jaws. The swollen jaws and raised eyes give a cherubic appearance; multiple radiolucencies are evident upon radiographic examination." 一种颌骨的纤维骨性遗传病。肿大的颌骨与上抬的眼部使患者呈小天使样面容；放射学检查可见多发性透射区。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Cherubism" scope note C07.320.391 Granuloma, Giant Cell 巨细胞肉芽肿 "A non-neoplastic inflammatory lesion, usually of the jaw or gingiva, containing large, multinucleated cells. It includes reparative giant cell granuloma. Peripheral giant cell granuloma refers to the gingiva (giant cell epulis); central refers to the jaw." 一种非肿瘤性炎性病变，通常见于颌骨或牙龈，含有大的多核细胞。包括修复性巨细胞肉芽肿。周围性巨细胞肉芽肿指发生于牙龈者（巨细胞龈瘤）；中央性指发生于颌骨者。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Granuloma, Giant Cell" scope note C07.320.440 Jaw Abnormalities 颌骨畸形 "Congenital absence of or defects in structures of the jaw." 颌骨结构的先天性缺失或缺陷。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Jaw Abnormalities" scope note C07.320.440.185 Cleft Palate 腭裂 "Congenital fissure of the soft and/or hard palate, due to faulty fusion." 因融合异常所致的软腭和/或硬腭先天性裂隙。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Cleft Palate" scope note C07.320.440.457 Micrognathism 小颌畸形 "Abnormally small jaw." 颌骨异常短小。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Micrognathism" scope note C07.320.440.606 Pierre Robin Syndrome 皮埃尔罗班综合征 "Congenital malformation characterized by MICROGNATHIA or RETROGNATHIA; GLOSSOPTOSIS and CLEFT PALATE. The mandibular abnormalities often result in difficulties in sucking and swallowing. The syndrome may be isolated or associated with other syndromes (e.g., ANDERSEN SYNDROME; CAMPOMELIC DYSPLASIA). Developmental mis-expression of SOX9 TRANSCRIPTION FACTOR gene on chromosome 17q and its surrounding region is associated with the syndrome." 一种先天性畸形，特征为小颌畸形（MICROGNATHIA）或下颌后缩（RETROGNATHIA）；舌后坠（GLOSSOPTOSIS）和腭裂（CLEFT PALATE）。下颌异常常导致吮吸和吞咽困难。该综合征可单独出现，或与其他综合征相关（如安德森综合征（ANDERSEN SYNDROME）；弯肢发育不良（CAMPOMELIC DYSPLASIA））。染色体 17q 上 SOX9 转录因子（SOX9 TRANSCRIPTION FACTOR）基因及其周围区域的发育性错误表达与该综合征相关。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Pierre Robin Syndrome" scope note C07.320.440.655 Prognathism 下颌前突 "A condition marked by abnormal protrusion of the mandible.
