(From Boucher's Clinical Dental Terminology, 4th ed, p312)" 牙齿从其牙槽支持结构中部分或完全移位。通常由创伤所致。（引自 Boucher's Clinical Dental Terminology，第 4 版，第 312 页） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Tooth Avulsion" scope note C07.793.850.750 Tooth Fractures 牙折 "Break or rupture of a tooth or tooth root." 牙齿或牙根的折断或破裂。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Tooth Fractures" scope note C07.793.850.750.300 Cracked Tooth Syndrome 牙隐裂综合征 "Incomplete fracture of any part of a tooth, characterized by pain during mastication and sensitivity to heat, cold, sweet or sour tastes, and alcohol; it is often undiagnosed because the tooth is usually X-ray negative and normal to pulp vitality tests." 牙齿任何部位的不完全折裂，其特征为咀嚼时疼痛以及对冷热、甜酸味和酒精敏感；由于牙齿通常 X 线阴性且牙髓活力测试正常，常被漏诊。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Cracked Tooth Syndrome" scope note C07.793.870 Tooth Loss 牙缺失 "The failure to retain teeth as a result of disease or injury." 由于疾病或损伤而未能保留牙齿。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Tooth Loss" scope note C07.793.901 Tooth Resorption 牙吸收 "Resorption of calcified dental tissue, involving demineralization due to reversal of the cation exchange and lacunar resorption by osteoclasts. There are two types: external (as a result of tooth pathology) and internal (apparently initiated by a peculiar inflammatory hyperplasia of the pulp). (From Jablonski, Dictionary of Dentistry, 1992, p676)" 钙化牙组织的吸收，涉及因阳离子交换逆转而发生的脱矿以及破骨细胞的陷窝性吸收。分两型：外吸收（由牙齿病变引起）和内吸收（显然由牙髓的一种特殊炎性增生引发）。（引自 Jablonski，Dictionary of Dentistry，1992，第 676 页） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Tooth Resorption" scope note C07.793.901.653 Root Resorption 牙根吸收 "Resorption in which cementum or dentin is lost from the root of a tooth owing to cementoclastic or osteoclastic activity in conditions such as trauma of occlusion or neoplasms. (Dorland, 27th ed)" 一种吸收，其中在咬合创伤或肿瘤等情况下，由于破牙骨质细胞或破骨细胞活动，牙骨质或牙本质从牙根丢失。（Dorland，第 27 版） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Root Resorption" scope note C07.793.905 Tooth, Impacted 阻生牙 "A tooth that is prevented from erupting by a physical barrier, usually other teeth. Impaction may also result from orientation of the tooth in an other than vertical position in the periodontal structures." 因物理障碍（通常为其他牙齿）而不能萌出的牙齿。阻生也可由于牙齿在牙周结构中呈非垂直方向排列所致。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Tooth, Impacted" scope note C07.793.915 Tooth, Unerupted 未萌出牙 "A normal developing tooth which has not yet perforated the oral mucosa or one that fails to erupt in the normal sequence or time interval expected for the type of tooth in a given gender, age, or population group." 一颗正常发育但尚未穿破口腔黏膜的牙齿，或在特定性别、年龄或人群中，未能按该类牙齿预期的正常顺序或时间间隔萌出的牙齿。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Tooth, Unerupted" scope note C07.793.929 Toothache 牙痛 "Pain in the adjacent areas of the teeth." 牙齿邻近区域的疼痛。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Toothache" scope note References National Library of Medicine. medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.summary: C17.300 Connective Tissue Diseases Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source C17.300 Connective Tissue Diseases 结缔组织疾病 "A heterogeneous group of disorders, some hereditary, others acquired, characterized by abnormal structure or function of one or more of the elements of connective tissue, i.e., collagen, elastin, or the mucopolysaccharides." 一组异质性疾病，有些为遗传性，另一些为获得性，其特征是结缔组织一种或多种成分的结构或功能异常，这些成分即胶原、弹性蛋白或黏多糖。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Connective Tissue Diseases" scope note C17.300.116 Anetoderma 皮肤松弛症（斑状萎缩） "Benign DERMATOSIS caused by a loss of dermal ELASTIC TISSUE resulting in localized sac-like areas of flaccid skin. It can be either primary (idiopathic) or secondary to other skin conditions, PENICILLAMINE use, or premature birth." 一种良性皮肤病（DERMATOSIS），由真皮弹性组织（ELASTIC TISSUE）缺失引起，导致局部出现囊袋状的松弛皮肤区域。它可以是原发性（特发性）的，也可以继发于其他皮肤病、青霉胺（PENICILLAMINE）的使用或早产。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Anetoderma" scope note C17.300.182 Cartilage Diseases 软骨疾病 "Pathological processes involving the chondral tissue (CARTILAGE)." 累及软骨组织的病理过程（CARTILAGE）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Cartilage Diseases" scope note C17.300.182.100 Chondromalacia Patellae 髌骨软化症 "A degeneration of the ARTICULAR CARTILAGE of the PATELLA, caused by a decrease in sulfated MUCOPOLYSACCHARIDES in the ground substance. When accompanied by pain, it is sometimes considered part of or confused with PATELLOFEMORAL PAIN SYNDROME." 髌骨（PATELLA）关节软骨（ARTICULAR CARTILAGE）的退变，由基质中硫酸化黏多糖（MUCOPOLYSACCHARIDES）减少所致。伴有疼痛时，有时被视为髌股疼痛综合征（PATELLOFEMORAL PAIN SYNDROME）的一部分或与之混淆。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Chondromalacia Patellae" scope note C17.300.182.310 Laryngomalacia 喉软化 "A congenital or acquired condition of underdeveloped or degeneration of CARTILAGE in the LARYNX. This results in a floppy laryngeal wall making patency difficult to maintain." 一种先天性或后天性病症，喉（LARYNX）内软骨（CARTILAGE）发育不全或退化。其结果是喉壁松软，难以维持通畅。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Laryngomalacia" scope note C17.300.182.520 Osteochondritis 骨软骨炎 "Inflammation of a bone and its overlaying CARTILAGE." 骨及其覆盖的软骨（CARTILAGE）的炎症。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Osteochondritis" scope note C17.300.182.525 Pectus Carinatum 鸡胸 "A developmental anomaly characterized by abnormal anterior protrusion of the STERNUM and adjacent COSTAL CARTILAGE." 一种发育异常，特征为胸骨（STERNUM）异常向前突出及相邻的肋软骨（COSTAL CARTILAGE）异常前突。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Pectus Carinatum" scope note C17.300.182.531 Polychondritis, Relapsing 复发性多软骨炎 "An acquired disease of unknown etiology, chronic course, and tendency to recur. It is characterized by inflammation and degeneration of cartilage and can result in deformities such as floppy ear and saddle nose. Loss of cartilage in the respiratory tract can lead to respiratory obstruction." 一种病因不明、病程慢性、有复发倾向的获得性疾病。其特征为软骨的炎症和变性，可导致松软耳、鞍鼻等畸形。呼吸道软骨丧失可导致呼吸道阻塞。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Polychondritis, Relapsing" scope note C17.300.182.790 Tietze's Syndrome 蒂策综合征 "Idiopathic painful nonsuppurative swellings of one or more costal cartilages, especially of the second rib. The anterior chest pain may mimic that of coronary artery disease. (Dorland, 27th ed.)" 一处或多处肋软骨的特发性疼痛性非化脓性肿胀，尤其是第二肋。前胸痛可类似冠状动脉疾病的胸痛。（Dorland，第 27 版） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Tietze's Syndrome" scope note C17.300.182.895 Tracheobronchomalacia 气管支气管软化 "A congenital or acquired condition of underdeveloped or degeneration of CARTILAGE in the TRACHEA and the BRONCHI. This results in a floppy non-rigid airway making patency difficult to maintain." 一种先天性或后天性病症，气管（TRACHEA）和支气管（BRONCHI）内软骨（CARTILAGE）发育不全或退化。其结果是气道松软、缺乏刚性，难以维持通畅。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Tracheobronchomalacia" scope note C17.300.182.895.249 Bronchomalacia 支气管软化 "A congenital or acquired condition of underdeveloped or degeneration of CARTILAGE in the BRONCHI. This results in a floppy bronchial wall making patency difficult to maintain. It is characterized by wheezing and difficult breathing." 一种先天性或获得性病症，表现为支气管（BRONCHI）内软骨（CARTILAGE）发育不全或退化。这导致支气管壁松软，难以维持通畅。其特征为喘鸣和呼吸困难。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Bronchomalacia" scope note C17.300.182.895.500 Tracheomalacia 气管软化 "A congenital or acquired condition of underdeveloped or degeneration of CARTILAGE in the TRACHEA. This results in a floppy tracheal wall making patency difficult to maintain. It is characterized by wheezing and difficult breathing." 一种先天性或后天性疾病，表现为气管（TRACHEA）内软骨（CARTILAGE）发育不全或退化。这导致气管壁松软，难以维持通畅。其特征为喘鸣和呼吸困难。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Tracheomalacia" scope note C17.300.185 Cellulitis 蜂窝织炎 "An acute, diffuse, and suppurative inflammation of loose connective tissue, particularly the deep subcutaneous tissues, and sometimes muscle, which is most commonly seen as a result of infection of a wound, ulcer, or other skin lesions." 一种急性、弥漫性、疏松结缔组织的化脓性炎症，尤其累及皮下深部组织，有时累及肌肉，最常见于伤口、溃疡或其他皮肤病变感染之后。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Cellulitis" scope note C17.300.185.500 Orbital Cellulitis 眶蜂窝织炎 "Inflammation of the loose connective tissues around the ORBIT, bony structure around the eyeball. It is characterized by PAIN; EDEMA of the CONJUNCTIVA; swelling of the EYELIDS; EXOPHTHALMOS; limited eye movement; and loss of vision." 眼眶（ORBIT）周围疏松结缔组织的炎症，眼眶即眼球周围的骨性结构。其特征为疼痛（PAIN）、结膜（CONJUNCTIVA）水肿（EDEMA）、眼睑（EYELIDS）肿胀、眼球突出（EXOPHTHALMOS）、眼球运动受限及视力丧失。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Orbital Cellulitis" scope note C17.300.200 Collagen Diseases 胶原病 "Historically, a heterogeneous group of acute and chronic diseases, including rheumatoid arthritis, systemic lupus erythematosus, progressive systemic sclerosis, dermatomyositis, etc. This classification was based on the notion that collagen was equivalent to connective tissue, but with the present recognition of the different types of collagen and the aggregates derived from them as distinct entities, the term collagen diseases now pertains exclusively to those inherited conditions in which the primary defect is at the gene level and affects collagen biosynthesis, post-translational modification, or extracellular processing directly. (From Cecil Textbook of Medicine, 19th ed, p1494)" 历史上指一组异质性的急性和慢性疾病，包括类风湿关节炎、系统性红斑狼疮、进行性系统性硬化症、皮肌炎等。这一分类基于胶原等同于结缔组织的观念；但随着现在认识到不同类型的胶原及其衍生的聚集体是不同的实体，胶原病一词现在专指那些原发缺陷位于基因水平、直接影响胶原生物合成、翻译后修饰或细胞外加工的遗传性病症。（引自 Cecil Textbook of Medicine，第 19 版，第 1494 页） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Collagen Diseases" scope note C17.300.200.310 Ehlers-Danlos Syndrome 埃勒斯-当洛斯综合征 "A heterogeneous group of autosomally inherited COLLAGEN DISEASES caused by defects in the synthesis or structure of FIBRILLAR COLLAGEN. There are numerous subtypes: classical, hypermobility, vascular, and others. Common clinical features include hyperextensible skin and joints, skin fragility and reduced wound healing capability." 一组异质性的常染色体遗传性胶原病（COLLAGEN DISEASES），由纤维状胶原（FIBRILLAR COLLAGEN）合成或结构缺陷所致。有众多亚型：经典型、过度活动型、血管型及其他。常见临床特征包括皮肤和关节过度伸展、皮肤脆弱以及伤口愈合能力降低。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Ehlers-Danlos Syndrome" scope note C17.300.200.310.500 Ehlers-Danlos Syndrome, Type IV 埃勒斯-当洛综合征IV型（血管型） "A subtype of Ehlers-Danlos syndrome (EDS) characterized by vascular pathologies, e.g., AORTIC DISSECTION in addition to common EDS findings, e.g., hyperextensible skin and joints, skin fragility and reduced wound healing capability. It is associated with mutations in collagen type III alpha 1 chain gene (COLLAGEN TYPE III)." 埃勒斯-当洛综合征（EDS）的一个亚型，除常见的 EDS 表现（如皮肤和关节过度伸展、皮肤脆弱及伤口愈合能力下降）外，还以血管病变为特征，如主动脉夹层（AORTIC DISSECTION）。它与III 型胶原 α1 链基因（COLLAGEN TYPE III）的突变有关。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Ehlers-Danlos Syndrome, Type IV" scope note C17.300.200.367 Epidermolysis Bullosa Dystrophica 营养不良型大疱性表皮松解症 "Form of epidermolysis bullosa characterized by atrophy of blistered areas, severe scarring, and nail changes. It is most often present at birth or in early infancy and occurs in both autosomal dominant and recessive forms. All forms of dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa result from mutations in COLLAGEN TYPE VII, a major component fibrils of BASEMENT MEMBRANE and EPIDERMIS." 大疱性表皮松解症的一种类型，特征为水疱区萎缩、严重瘢痕形成及甲改变。多于出生时或婴儿早期出现，有常染色体显性和隐性两种遗传形式。所有营养不良型大疱性表皮松解症均由 VII 型胶原（COLLAGEN TYPE VII）突变所致，VII 型胶原是基底膜（BASEMENT MEMBRANE）和表皮（EPIDERMIS）纤维的主要成分。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Epidermolysis Bullosa Dystrophica" scope note C17.300.200.425 Keloid 瘢痕疙瘩 "A sharply elevated, irregularly shaped, progressively enlarging scar resulting from formation of excessive amounts of collagen in the dermis during connective tissue repair. It is differentiated from a hypertrophic scar (CICATRIX, HYPERTROPHIC) in that the former does not spread to surrounding tissues." 一种明显隆起、形状不规则、逐渐增大的瘢痕，由结缔组织修复过程中真皮内形成过量胶原所致。它与增生性瘢痕（CICATRIX, HYPERTROPHIC）的区别在于前者不向周围组织扩展。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Keloid" scope note C17.300.200.425.125 Acne Keloid 瘢痕疙瘩性痤疮 "A type of acneiform disorder in which secondary pyogenic infection in and around pilosebaceous structures ends in keloidal scarring. It manifests as persistent folliculitis of the back of the neck associated with occlusion of the follicular orifices. It is most often encountered in black or Asian men." 一种痤疮样疾病，其毛囊皮脂腺结构内及周围的继发性化脓性感染最终形成瘢痕疙瘩性瘢痕。表现为颈后部持续性毛囊炎，伴毛囊口闭塞。最常见于黑人或亚洲男性。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Acne Keloid" scope note C17.300.200.495 Necrobiotic Disorders 渐进性坏死性疾病 "A group of disorders characterized by swelling, basophilia, and distortion of collagen bundles in the dermis." 一组疾病，其特征为真皮内胶原束的肿胀、嗜碱性变和扭曲。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Necrobiotic Disorders" scope note C17.300.200.495.380 Granuloma Annulare 环状肉芽肿 "Benign granulomatous disease of unknown etiology characterized by a ring of localized or disseminated papules or nodules on the skin and palisading histiocytes surrounding necrobiotic tissue resulting from altered collagen structures." 一种病因不明的良性肉芽肿性疾病，特征为皮肤上出现局限性或播散性丘疹或结节组成的环，以及栅栏状排列的组织细胞包绕渐进性坏死组织，后者源于胶原结构的改变。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Granuloma Annulare" scope note C17.300.200.495.545 Necrobiosis Lipoidica 类脂质渐进性坏死 "A degenerative disease of the dermal connective tissue characterized by the development of erythematous papules or nodules in the pretibial area. The papules form plaques covered with telangiectatic vessels. More than half of the affected patients have diabetes." 一种真皮结缔组织的变性疾病，特征为胫前区出现红斑性丘疹或结节。丘疹融合成斑块，表面覆有毛细血管扩张的血管。半数以上患者患有糖尿病。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Necrobiosis Lipoidica" scope note C17.300.200.495.772 Necrobiotic Xanthogranuloma 坏死性黄色肉芽肿 "A cutaneous necrobiotic disorder characterized by firm, yellow plaques or nodules, often in a periorbital distribution. It is often accompanied by an elevated ERYTHROCYTE SEDIMENTATION RATE; LEUKOPENIA; and MONOCLONAL GAMMOPATHY (IgG-kappa type) and systemic involvement." 一种皮肤渐进性坏死性疾病，特征为质硬的黄色斑块或结节，常分布于眶周。常伴有红细胞沉降率（ERYTHROCYTE SEDIMENTATION RATE）升高、白细胞减少症（LEUKOPENIA）、单克隆丙种球蛋白病（MONOCLONAL GAMMOPATHY）（IgG-kappa 型）及全身受累。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Necrobiotic Xanthogranuloma" scope note C17.300.200.517 Nephritis, Hereditary 遗传性肾炎 "A group of inherited conditions characterized initially by HEMATURIA and slowly progressing to RENAL INSUFFICIENCY. The most common form is the Alport syndrome (hereditary nephritis with HEARING LOSS) which is caused by mutations in genes for TYPE IV COLLAGEN and defective GLOMERULAR BASEMENT MEMBRANE." 一组遗传性病症，初期以血尿（HEMATURIA）为特征，缓慢进展为肾功能不全（RENAL INSUFFICIENCY）。最常见的形式是 Alport 综合征（伴听力损失（HEARING LOSS）的遗传性肾炎），由 IV 型胶原（TYPE IV COLLAGEN）基因突变及肾小球基底膜（GLOMERULAR BASEMENT MEMBRANE）缺陷引起。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Nephritis, Hereditary" scope note C17.300.200.540 Osteogenesis Imperfecta 成骨不全 "COLLAGEN DISEASES characterized by brittle, osteoporotic, and easily fractured bones. It may also present with blue sclerae, loose joints, and imperfect dentin formation. Most types are autosomal dominant and are associated with mutations in COLLAGEN TYPE I." 胶原病（COLLAGEN DISEASES），其特征为骨质脆弱、骨质疏松且容易骨折。也可表现为蓝色巩膜、关节松弛和牙本质形成不全。大多数类型为常染色体显性遗传，并与 I 型胶原（COLLAGEN TYPE I）的突变相关。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Osteogenesis Imperfecta" scope note C17.300.230 Cutis Laxa 皮肤松垂 "A group of connective tissue diseases in which skin hangs in loose pendulous folds. It is believed to be associated with decreased elastic tissue formation as well as an abnormality in elastin formation. Cutis laxa is usually a genetic disease, but acquired cases have been reported. (From Dorland, 27th ed)" 一组结缔组织病，其中皮肤呈松弛下垂的皱褶。据认为它与弹性组织形成减少以及弹性蛋白形成异常有关。皮肤松垂通常是遗传性疾病，但也有后天获得性病例的报道。（引自 Dorland，第 27 版） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Cutis Laxa" scope note C17.300.250 Dermatomyositis 皮肌炎 "A subacute or chronic inflammatory disease of muscle and skin, marked by proximal muscle weakness and a characteristic skin rash. The illness occurs with approximately equal frequency in children and adults. The skin lesions usually take the form of a purplish rash (or less often an exfoliative dermatitis) involving the nose, cheeks, forehead, upper trunk, and arms. Noonan syndrome occurs in both males and females with a normal karyotype (46,XX and 46,XY). Mutations in a several genes (PTPN11, KRAS, SOS1, NF1 and RAF1) have been associated the NS phenotype. In addition, there is overlap with the syndrome called neurofibromatosis-Noonan syndrome due to mutations in NF1." 一种遗传异质性、多方面表现的疾病，特征为身材矮小、颈蹼、上睑下垂、骨骼畸形、眼距过宽、激素失衡、隐睾（CRYPTORCHIDISM）、多种心脏异常（最常见的包括肺动脉瓣狭窄（PULMONARY VALVE STENOSIS））以及一定程度的智力障碍（INTELLECTUAL DISABILITY）。其表型与特纳综合征（TURNER SYNDROME）相似，后者仅见于女性，基础为 45,X 核型异常。努南综合征在男性和女性中均可发生，核型正常（46,XX 和 46,XY）。多个基因（PTPN11、KRAS、SOS1、NF1 和 RAF1）的突变与 NS 表型相关，其中 PTPN11 突变最常见。豹斑综合征（LEOPARD SYNDROME）的临床特征与努南综合征重叠，也是由 PTPN11 突变所致。此外，它还与由 NF1 突变引起的神经纤维瘤病-努南综合征存在重叠。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Noonan Syndrome" scope note C17.300.705 Osteopoikilosis 脆弱性骨硬化 "An asymptomatic, autosomal dominant trait in which pea-sized sclerotic spots, prominent in the metaphyseal area, are accompanied by unique cutaneous lesions. These are yellowish papules or plaques with increased elastin content. (From Cecil Textbook of Medicine, 19th ed, pp1434-35)" 一种无症状的常染色体显性性状，表现为豌豆大小的硬化斑（以干骺端区域显著），并伴有独特的皮肤病变。这些皮损为弹性蛋白含量增高的淡黄色丘疹或斑块。（引自《Cecil 内科学》，第 19 版，第 1434-1435 页） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Osteopoikilosis" scope note C17.300.710 Panniculitis 脂膜炎 "General term for inflammation of adipose tissue, usually of the skin, characterized by reddened subcutaneous nodules." 脂肪组织炎症的总称，通常发生于皮肤，特征为发红的皮下结节。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Panniculitis" scope note C17.300.710.329 Erythema Induratum 硬红斑 "A type of panniculitis characterized histologically by the presence of granulomas, vasculitis, and necrosis. It is traditionally considered to be the tuberculous counterpart of nodular vasculitis, but is now known to occur without tuberculous precedent. It is seen most commonly in adolescent and menopausal women, is initiated or exacerbated by cold weather, and typically presents as one or more recurrent erythrocyanotic nodules or plaques on the calves. The nodules may progress to form indurations, ulcerations, and scars." 一种脂膜炎，组织学特征为存在肉芽肿、血管炎和坏死。传统上认为它是结节性血管炎的结核性对应病，但现已知其可在无结核前驱的情况下发生。最常见于青春期和绝经期女性，由寒冷天气诱发或加重，典型表现为小腿上一个或多个复发性红绀色结节或斑块。结节可进展形成硬结、溃疡和瘢痕。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Erythema Induratum" scope note C17.300.710.400 Panniculitis, Lupus Erythematosus 狼疮性脂膜炎 "A type of lupus erythematosus characterized by deep dermal or subcutaneous nodules, most often on the head, face, or upper arms. It is generally chronic and occurs most often in women between the ages of 20 and 45." 一种红斑狼疮，特征为真皮深层或皮下结节，最常见于头部、面部或上臂。通常呈慢性，最常发生于 20 至 45 岁的女性。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Panniculitis, Lupus Erythematosus" scope note C17.300.710.500 Panniculitis, Nodular Nonsuppurative 结节性非化脓性脂膜炎 "A form of panniculitis characterized by recurrent episodes of fever accompanied by the eruption of single or multiple erythematous subcutaneous nodules on the lower extremities. They normally resolve, but tend to leave depressions in the skin. The condition is most often seen in women, alone or in association with other disorders." 一种脂膜炎，其特征为反复发热，伴下肢出现单发或多发的红斑性皮下结节。结节通常会消退，但往往在皮肤上留下凹陷。本病最常见于女性，可单独发生或与其他疾病相关。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Panniculitis, Nodular Nonsuppurative" scope note C17.300.710.600 Panniculitis, Peritoneal 腹膜脂膜炎 "INFLAMMATION of the underlying layer of ADIPOSE TISSUE (panniculus) of the PERITONEUM, usually of the MESENTERY or the OMENTUM. There are several forms with various names and are usually characterized by infiltration of LYMPHOCYTES and NEUTROPHILS, fat NECROSIS, and FIBROSIS." 腹膜（PERITONEUM）下层脂肪组织（ADIPOSE TISSUE）（脂膜）的炎症（INFLAMMATION），通常发生于肠系膜（MESENTERY）或网膜（OMENTUM）。它有多种形式和名称，通常以淋巴细胞（LYMPHOCYTES）和中性粒细胞（NEUTROPHILS）浸润、脂肪坏死（NECROSIS）和纤维化（FIBROSIS）为特征。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Panniculitis, Peritoneal" scope note C17.300.715 Penile Induration 阴茎硬结症 "A condition characterized by hardening of the PENIS due to the formation of fibrous plaques on the dorsolateral aspect of the PENIS, usually involving the membrane (tunica albuginea) surrounding the erectile tissue (corpus cavernosum penis). This may eventually cause a painful deformity of the shaft or constriction of the urethra, or both." 一种以阴茎（PENIS）因纤维斑块形成而硬化为特征的病症，纤维斑块位于阴茎（PENIS）背外侧，通常累及包绕勃起组织（阴茎海绵体）的膜（白膜）。最终可导致阴茎体疼痛性畸形或尿道狭窄，或两者兼有。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Penile Induration" scope note C17.300.766 Pseudoxanthoma Elasticum 弹性纤维假黄瘤 "An inherited disorder of connective tissue with extensive degeneration and calcification of ELASTIC TISSUE primarily in the skin, eye, and vasculature. At least two forms exist, autosomal recessive and autosomal dominant. This disorder is caused by mutations of one of the ATP-BINDING CASSETTE TRANSPORTERS. Patients are predisposed to MYOCARDIAL INFARCTION and GASTROINTESTINAL HEMORRHAGE." 一种遗传性结缔组织疾病，主要在皮肤、眼和血管系统中出现广泛的弹性组织（ELASTIC TISSUE）变性和钙化。至少存在两种类型：常染色体隐性型和常染色体显性型。本病由某种 ATP 结合盒转运蛋白（ATP-BINDING CASSETTE TRANSPORTERS）的突变所致。患者易发生心肌梗死（MYOCARDIAL INFARCTION）和胃肠道出血（GASTROINTESTINAL HEMORRHAGE）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Pseudoxanthoma Elasticum" scope note C17.300.775 Rheumatic Diseases 风湿性疾病 "Disorders of connective tissue, especially the joints and related structures, characterized by inflammation, degeneration, or metabolic derangement." 结缔组织的疾病，尤其是关节及相关结构的疾病，特征为炎症、退行性变或代谢紊乱。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Rheumatic Diseases" scope note C17.300.775.049 Arthritis, Juvenile 幼年型关节炎 "Arthritis in children, with onset before 16 years of age. The terms juvenile rheumatoid arthritis (JRA) and juvenile idiopathic arthritis (JIA) refer to classification systems for chronic arthritis in children. Only one subtype of juvenile arthritis (polyarticular-onset, rheumatoid factor-positive) clinically resembles adult rheumatoid arthritis and is considered its childhood equivalent." 儿童关节炎，于 16 岁前发病。幼年类风湿关节炎（JRA）和幼年特发性关节炎（JIA）这两个术语指儿童慢性关节炎的分类体系。幼年关节炎中只有一种亚型（多关节型、类风湿因子阳性）在临床上类似成人类风湿关节炎，并被视为其儿童期对应疾病。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Arthritis, Juvenile" scope note C17.300.775.099 Arthritis, Rheumatoid 类风湿关节炎 "A chronic systemic disease, primarily of the joints, marked by inflammatory changes in the synovial membranes and articular structures, widespread fibrinoid degeneration of the collagen fibers in mesenchymal tissues, and by atrophy and rarefaction of bony structures. Etiology is unknown, but autoimmune mechanisms have been implicated." 一种主要累及关节的慢性全身性疾病，以滑膜及关节结构的炎症性改变、间充质组织中胶原纤维广泛的纤维素样变性以及骨结构的萎缩和稀疏为特征。病因不明，但自身免疫机制被认为与之有关。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Arthritis, Rheumatoid" scope note C17.300.775.099.219 Caplan Syndrome 卡普兰综合征 "A condition characterized by the presence of RHEUMATOID ARTHRITIS associated with a specific form of pneumoconiosis, often in coal miners and asbestos workers." 一种以类风湿关节炎（RHEUMATOID ARTHRITIS）伴发特定类型尘肺为特征的病症，常见于煤矿工人和石棉工人。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Caplan Syndrome" scope note C17.300.775.099.389 Felty Syndrome 费尔蒂综合征 "A rare complication of rheumatoid arthritis with autoimmune NEUTROPENIA; and SPLENOMEGALY." 一种类风湿关节炎的罕见并发症，伴有自身免疫性中性粒细胞减少症（NEUTROPENIA）和脾大（SPLENOMEGALY）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Felty Syndrome" scope note C17.300.775.099.683 Rheumatoid Nodule 类风湿结节 "Subcutaneous nodules seen in 20-30% of rheumatoid arthritis patients. They may arise anywhere on the body, but are most frequently found over the bony prominences. The nodules are characterized histologically by dense areas of fibrinoid necrosis with basophilic streaks and granules, surrounded by a palisade of cells, mainly fibroblasts and histiocytes." 见于 20% 至 30% 类风湿关节炎患者的皮下结节。可出现在身体任何部位，但最常见于骨突处。组织学特征为致密的纤维素样坏死区，伴嗜碱性条纹和颗粒，周围环绕栅栏状排列的细胞，主要为成纤维细胞和组织细胞。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Rheumatoid Nodule" scope note C17.300.775.099.728 Rheumatoid Vasculitis 类风湿血管炎 "Necrotizing VASCULITIS of small and medium size vessels, developing as a complication in RHEUMATOID ARTHRITIS patients. It is characterized by peripheral vascular lesions, cutaneous ULCERS, peripheral GANGRENE, and MONONEURITIS MULTIPLEX." 中小血管的坏死性血管炎（VASCULITIS），作为类风湿关节炎（RHEUMATOID ARTHRITIS）患者的并发症而发生。其特征为周围血管病变、皮肤溃疡（ULCERS）、周围性坏疽（GANGRENE）和多发性单神经炎（MONONEURITIS MULTIPLEX）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Rheumatoid Vasculitis" scope note C17.300.775.099.774 Sjogren's Syndrome 干燥综合征 "Chronic inflammatory and autoimmune disease in which the salivary and lacrimal glands undergo progressive destruction by lymphocytes and plasma cells resulting in decreased production of saliva and tears. The primary form, often called sicca syndrome, involves both KERATOCONJUNCTIVITIS SICCA and XEROSTOMIA. The secondary form includes, in addition, the presence of a connective tissue disease, usually rheumatoid arthritis." 一种慢性炎症性自身免疫病，其中唾液腺和泪腺被淋巴细胞和浆细胞进行性破坏，导致唾液和泪液分泌减少。原发型常称为干燥症候群，同时累及干燥性角结膜炎（KERATOCONJUNCTIVITIS SICCA）和口干症（XEROSTOMIA）。继发型除此之外还伴有一种结缔组织病，通常为类风湿关节炎。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Sjogren's Syndrome" scope note C17.300.775.099.870 Still's Disease, Adult-Onset 成人斯蒂尔病 "Systemic-onset rheumatoid arthritis in adults. It differs from classical rheumatoid arthritis in that it is more often marked by acute febrile onset, and generalized lymphadenopathy and hepatosplenomegaly are more prominent." 成人的全身型类风湿关节炎。与经典类风湿关节炎不同，该病更常以急性发热起病，全身淋巴结肿大和肝脾肿大更为突出。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Still's Disease, Adult-Onset" scope note C17.300.775.440 Hyperostosis, Sternocostoclavicular 胸肋锁骨骨肥厚 "A rare, benign rheumatologic disorder or syndrome characterized by hyperostosis and soft tissue ossification between the clavicles and the anterior part of the upper ribs. It is often associated with the dermatologic disorder palmoplantar pustulosis, particularly in Japan. Careful diagnosis is required to distinguish it from psoriatic arthritis, OSTEITIS DEFORMANS, and other diseases. Spondylitis of pustulosis palmaris et plantaris is one of the possible causes; also, evidence suggests one origin may be bone infection. Bone imaging is especially useful for diagnosis. It was originally described by Sonozaki in 1974." 一种罕见的良性风湿性疾病或综合征，特征为锁骨之间及上部肋骨前部的骨肥厚和软组织骨化。常伴有皮肤病掌跖脓疱病，在日本尤为多见。需仔细诊断以与银屑病关节炎、畸形性骨炎（OSTEITIS DEFORMANS）及其他疾病相鉴别。掌跖脓疱病的脊柱炎是可能的病因之一；另有证据表明其一种起源可能是骨感染。骨显像对诊断尤其有用。本病最初由 Sonozaki 于 1974 年描述。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Hyperostosis, Sternocostoclavicular" scope note C17.300.775.720 Polymyalgia Rheumatica 风湿性多肌痛 "A syndrome in the elderly characterized by proximal joint and muscle pain, high erythrocyte sedimentation rate, and a self-limiting course. Pain is usually accompanied by evidence of an inflammatory reaction. Women are affected twice as commonly as men and Caucasians more frequently than other groups. The condition is frequently associated with GIANT CELL ARTERITIS and some theories pose the possibility that the two diseases arise from a single etiology or even that they are the same entity." 一种见于老年人的综合征，特征为近端关节和肌肉疼痛、红细胞沉降率增高以及自限性病程。疼痛通常伴有炎症反应的证据。女性患病率是男性的两倍，白种人比其他人群更常见。该病常与巨细胞动脉炎（GIANT CELL ARTERITIS）相关，有理论提出两种疾病可能源于同一病因，甚至是同一实体。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Polymyalgia Rheumatica" scope note C17.300.775.860 Rheumatic Fever 风湿热 "A febrile disease occurring as a delayed sequela of infections with STREPTOCOCCUS PYOGENES. It is characterized by multiple focal inflammatory lesions of the connective tissue structures, such as the heart, blood vessels, and joints (POLYARTHRITIS) and brain, and by the presence of ASCHOFF BODIES in the myocardium and skin." 一种发热性疾病，作为化脓性链球菌（STREPTOCOCCUS PYOGENES）感染的迟发性后遗症而发生。其特征为结缔组织结构的多发局灶性炎症病变，如心脏、血管、关节（多关节炎，POLYARTHRITIS）和脑，以及心肌和皮肤中存在阿绍夫小体（ASCHOFF BODIES）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Rheumatic Fever" scope note C17.300.787 Scleroderma, Localized 局限性硬皮病 "A term used to describe a variety of localized asymmetrical SKIN thickening that is similar to those of SYSTEMIC SCLERODERMA but without the disease features in the multiple internal organs and BLOOD VESSELS. Lesions may be characterized as patches or plaques (morphea), bands (linear), or nodules." 用于描述多种局限性不对称皮肤（SKIN）增厚的术语，类似于系统性硬皮病（SYSTEMIC SCLERODERMA）的皮肤增厚，但没有多个内脏器官和血管（BLOOD VESSELS）的病变特征。皮损可表现为斑片或斑块（硬斑病）、带状（线状）或结节。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Scleroderma, Localized" scope note C17.300.799 Scleroderma, Systemic 系统性硬皮病 "A chronic multi-system disorder of CONNECTIVE TISSUE. It is characterized by SCLEROSIS in the SKIN, the LUNGS, the HEART, the GASTROINTESTINAL TRACT, the KIDNEYS, and the MUSCULOSKELETAL SYSTEM. Other important features include diseased small BLOOD VESSELS and AUTOANTIBODIES. The disorder is named for its most prominent feature (hard skin), and classified into subsets by the extent of skin thickening: LIMITED SCLERODERMA and DIFFUSE SCLERODERMA." 一种结缔组织（CONNECTIVE TISSUE）的慢性多系统疾病。其特征为皮肤（SKIN）、肺（LUNGS）、心脏（HEART）、胃肠道（GASTROINTESTINAL TRACT）、肾（KIDNEYS）和肌肉骨骼系统（MUSCULOSKELETAL SYSTEM）的硬化（SCLEROSIS）。其他重要特征包括小血管（BLOOD VESSELS）病变和自身抗体（AUTOANTIBODIES）。该病以其最突出的特征（皮肤变硬）命名，并按皮肤增厚的范围分为亚型：局限性硬皮病（LIMITED SCLERODERMA）和弥漫性硬皮病（DIFFUSE SCLERODERMA）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Scleroderma, Systemic" scope note C17.300.799.602 Scleroderma, Diffuse 弥漫性硬皮病 "A rapid onset form of SYSTEMIC SCLERODERMA with progressive widespread SKIN thickening over the arms, the legs and the trunk, resulting in stiffness and disability." 一种快速起病的系统性硬皮病（SYSTEMIC SCLERODERMA）类型，伴有手臂、腿部和躯干进行性广泛的皮肤（SKIN）增厚，导致僵硬和残疾。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Scleroderma, Diffuse" scope note C17.300.799.801 Scleroderma, Limited 局限性硬皮病 "The least progressive form of SYSTEMIC SCLERODERMA with skin thickening restricted to the face, neck and areas distal to the elbows and/or knees, sparing the trunk. The CREST SYNDROME is a form of limited scleroderma." 系统性硬皮病（SYSTEMIC SCLERODERMA）进展最慢的形式，皮肤增厚局限于面部、颈部以及肘和/或膝远端区域，躯干不受累。CREST 综合征（CREST SYNDROME）是局限性硬皮病的一种形式。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Scleroderma, Limited" scope note C17.300.799.801.500 CREST Syndrome CREST 综合征 "A mild form of LIMITED SCLERODERMA, a multi-system disorder. Its features include symptoms of CALCINOSIS; RAYNAUD DISEASE; ESOPHAGEAL MOTILITY DISORDERS; sclerodactyly, and TELANGIECTASIS. When the defect in esophageal function is not prominent, it is known as CRST syndrome." 局限性硬皮病（LIMITED SCLERODERMA）的一种轻型，是一种多系统疾病。其特征包括钙质沉着（CALCINOSIS）、雷诺病（RAYNAUD DISEASE）、食管动力障碍（ESOPHAGEAL MOTILITY DISORDERS）、指端硬化和毛细血管扩张（TELANGIECTASIS）等症状。当食管功能缺陷不明显时，称为 CRST 综合征。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "CREST Syndrome" scope note C17.300.849 Undifferentiated Connective Tissue Diseases 未分化结缔组织病 "Diseases that exhibit signs and symptoms suggestive of a connective tissue disease that do not fulfill clinical or diagnostic criteria for any one defined disease but overlap with criteria of multiple such diseases. Commonly overlapping diseases include systemic autoimmune connective tissue diseases such as RHEUMATOID ARTHRITIS; SYSTEMIC LUPUS ERYTHEMATOSUS; and SYSTEMIC SCLEROSIS." 表现出提示结缔组织病的体征和症状，但不符合任何一种明确疾病的临床或诊断标准、而与多种此类疾病的标准相重叠的疾病。常见的重叠疾病包括系统性自身免疫性结缔组织病，如类风湿关节炎（RHEUMATOID ARTHRITIS）、系统性红斑狼疮（SYSTEMIC LUPUS ERYTHEMATOSUS）和系统性硬化症（SYSTEMIC SCLEROSIS）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Undifferentiated Connective Tissue Diseases" scope note C17.300.899 Weill-Marchesani Syndrome Weill-Marchesani 综合征 "Rare congenital disorder of connective tissue characterized by brachydactyly, joint stiffness, childhood onset of ocular abnormalities (e.g., microspherophakia, ECTOPIA LENTIS; GLAUCOMA), and proportionate short stature. Cardiovascular anomalies are occasionally seen." 一种罕见的先天性结缔组织疾病，特征为短指、关节僵硬、儿童期发病的眼部异常（如小球形晶状体、晶状体异位（ECTOPIA LENTIS）、青光眼（GLAUCOMA））以及匀称性身材矮小。偶见心血管异常。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Weill-Marchesani Syndrome" scope note References National Library of Medicine. medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.summary: C17.800.030 Acneiform Eruptions Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source C17.800.030 Acneiform Eruptions 痤疮样疹 "Visible efflorescent lesions of the skin caused by acne or resembling acne. (Dorland, 28th ed, p18, 575)" 由痤疮引起或类似痤疮的可见的皮肤发疹性损害。（Dorland，第 28 版，第 18、575 页） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Acneiform Eruptions" scope note C17.800.030.030 Acne Keloid 瘢痕疙瘩性痤疮 "A type of acneiform disorder in which secondary pyogenic infection in and around pilosebaceous structures ends in keloidal scarring. It manifests as persistent folliculitis of the back of the neck associated with occlusion of the follicular orifices. It is most often encountered in black or Asian men." 一种痤疮样疾病，其毛囊皮脂腺结构内及周围的继发性化脓性感染最终形成瘢痕疙瘩性瘢痕。表现为颈后部持续性毛囊炎，伴毛囊口闭塞。最常见于黑人或亚洲男性。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Acne Keloid" scope note C17.800.030.150 Acne Vulgaris 寻常痤疮 "A chronic disorder of the pilosebaceous apparatus associated with an increase in sebum secretion. It is characterized by open comedones (blackheads), closed comedones (whiteheads), and pustular nodules. The cause is unknown, but heredity and age are predisposing factors." 一种毛囊皮脂腺单位的慢性疾病，与皮脂分泌增加相关。其特征为开放性粉刺（黑头）、闭合性粉刺（白头）和脓疱性结节。病因不明，但遗传和年龄是易感因素。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Acne Vulgaris" scope note C17.800.030.150.500 Acne Conglobata 聚合性痤疮 "Severe and chronic form of acne characterized by large, burrowing abscesses associated with disfigurement." 痤疮的一种严重慢性类型，特征为大的、潜行性脓肿，并伴有毁容。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Acne Conglobata" scope note C17.800.030.575 Chloracne 氯痤疮 "ACNE-like skin eruptions caused by exposure to CHLORINE-containing compounds. Exposure can be by inhalation, ingestion, or through the skin. Chloracne is often seen in people who have occupational contact with chlorinated pesticides, wood preservatives, and sealants." 由接触含氯（CHLORINE）化合物引起的痤疮（ACNE）样皮疹。可经吸入、食入或皮肤接触。氯痤疮常见于职业性接触含氯农药、木材防腐剂和密封剂的人群。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Chloracne" scope note References National Library of Medicine. (2026). MeSH 2026 descriptor records [Data set]. Retrieved October 28, 2026, from https://www.nlm.nih.gov/databases/download/mesh.html

medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.summary: C17.800.060 Angiolymphoid Hyperplasia with Eosinophilia Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source C17.800.060 Angiolymphoid Hyperplasia with Eosinophilia 血管淋巴样增生伴嗜酸性粒细胞增多 "Solitary or multiple benign cutaneous nodules comprised of immature and mature vascular structures intermingled with endothelial cells and a varied infiltrate of eosinophils, histiocytes, lymphocytes, and mast cells." 单发或多发的良性皮肤结节，由未成熟和成熟的血管结构组成，其间混杂内皮细胞以及由嗜酸性粒细胞、组织细胞、淋巴细胞和肥大细胞构成的多样浸润。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Angiolymphoid Hyperplasia with Eosinophilia" scope note References National Library of Medicine. medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.title: C17.800.090 Breast Diseases | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.summary: C17.800.090 Breast Diseases Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source C17.800.090 Breast Diseases 乳腺疾病 "Pathological processes of the BREAST." 乳房的病理过程（BREAST）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Breast Diseases" scope note C17.800.090.249 Breast Cyst 乳腺囊肿 "A fluid-filled closed cavity or sac that is lined by an EPITHELIUM and found in the BREAST. It may appear as a single large cyst in one breast, multifocal, or bilateral in FIBROCYSTIC BREAST DISEASE." 一种充满液体的封闭腔或囊，内衬上皮（EPITHELIUM），见于乳房（BREAST）。可表现为一侧乳房单个大囊肿、多灶性，或在乳腺纤维囊性病（FIBROCYSTIC BREAST DISEASE）中为双侧性。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Breast Cyst" scope note C17.800.090.500 Breast Neoplasms 乳腺肿瘤 "Tumors or cancer of the human BREAST." 人类乳房（BREAST）的肿瘤或癌。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Breast Neoplasms" scope note C17.800.090.500.130 Breast Carcinoma In Situ 乳腺原位癌 "A condition in which abnormal cells have not spread outside the duct, lobule, or nipple to other tissues of the breast. There are 3 types of breast carcinoma in situ: DUCTAL CARCINOMA IN SITU; LOBULAR CARCINOMA IN SITU; and PAGET DISEASE OF THE NIPPLE." 一种异常细胞尚未扩散到导管、小叶或乳头之外、未累及乳房其他组织的病症。乳腺原位癌有 3 种类型：导管原位癌（DUCTAL CARCINOMA IN SITU）、小叶原位癌（LOBULAR CARCINOMA IN SITU）和乳头佩吉特病（PAGET DISEASE OF THE NIPPLE）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Breast Carcinoma In Situ" scope note C17.800.090.500.260 Breast Neoplasms, Male 男性乳腺肿瘤 "Any neoplasms of the male breast. These occur infrequently in males in developed countries, the incidence being about 1% of that in females." 男性乳腺的任何肿瘤。在发达国家男性中少见，发病率约为女性的 1%。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Breast Neoplasms, Male" scope note C17.800.090.500.390 Carcinoma, Ductal, Breast 乳腺导管癌 "An invasive (infiltrating) CARCINOMA of the mammary ductal system (MAMMARY GLANDS) in the human BREAST." 人类乳房（BREAST）中乳腺导管系统（MAMMARY GLANDS）的浸润性癌（CARCINOMA）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Carcinoma, Ductal, Breast" scope note C17.800.090.500.437 Carcinoma, Lobular 小叶癌 "A type of BREAST CANCER where the abnormal malignant cells form in the lobules, or milk-producing glands, of the breast." 一种乳腺癌（BREAST CANCER），其异常恶性细胞形成于乳腺小叶（即产乳腺体）中。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Carcinoma, Lobular" scope note C17.800.090.500.483 Hereditary Breast and Ovarian Cancer Syndrome 遗传性乳腺癌卵巢癌综合征 "Autosomal dominant HEREDITARY CANCER SYNDROME in which a mutation most often in either BRCA1 or BRCA2 is associated with a significantly increased risk for breast and ovarian cancers." 一种常染色体显性遗传性癌症综合征（HEREDITARY CANCER SYNDROME），其中最常见于 BRCA1 或 BRCA2 的突变与乳腺癌和卵巢癌风险显著增加相关。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Hereditary Breast and Ovarian Cancer Syndrome" scope note C17.800.090.500.576 Inflammatory Breast Neoplasms 炎性乳腺肿瘤 "Metastatic breast cancer characterized by EDEMA and ERYTHEMA of the affected breast due to LYMPHATIC METASTASIS and eventual obstruction of LYMPHATIC VESSELS by the cancer cells." 一种以受累乳房水肿（EDEMA）和红斑（ERYTHEMA）为特征的转移性乳腺癌，由淋巴转移（LYMPHATIC METASTASIS）及癌细胞最终阻塞淋巴管（LYMPHATIC VESSELS）所致。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Inflammatory Breast Neoplasms" scope note C17.800.090.500.682 Unilateral Breast Neoplasms 单侧乳腺肿瘤 "Tumors or cancer found specifically in one human BREAST, but not in both." 仅见于一侧人类乳房（BREAST）的肿瘤或癌，而非双侧。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Unilateral Breast Neoplasms" scope note C17.800.090.500.788 Triple Negative Breast Neoplasms 三阴性乳腺肿瘤 "Breast neoplasms that do not express ESTROGEN RECEPTORS; PROGESTERONE RECEPTORS; and do not overexpress the NEU RECEPTOR/HER-2 PROTO-ONCOGENE PROTEIN." 不表达雌激素受体（ESTROGEN RECEPTORS）、孕激素受体（PROGESTERONE RECEPTORS），且不过度表达 NEU 受体/HER-2 原癌基因蛋白（NEU RECEPTOR/HER-2 PROTO-ONCOGENE PROTEIN）的乳腺肿瘤。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Triple Negative Breast Neoplasms" scope note C17.800.090.750 Fibrocystic Breast Disease 乳腺纤维囊性病 "A common and benign breast disease characterized by varying degree of fibrocystic changes in the breast tissue. There are three major patterns of morphological changes, including FIBROSIS, formation of CYSTS, and proliferation of glandular tissue (adenosis). The fibrocystic breast has a dense irregular, lumpy, bumpy consistency." 一种常见的良性乳腺疾病，特征为乳腺组织中不同程度的纤维囊性改变。形态学改变有三种主要模式，包括纤维化（FIBROSIS）、囊肿（CYSTS）形成和腺组织增生（腺病）。纤维囊性乳房质地致密、不规则、呈团块状和凹凸不平。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Fibrocystic Breast Disease" scope note C17.800.090.875 Gynecomastia 男子乳腺发育 "Enlargement of the BREAST in the males, caused by an excess of ESTROGENS. Physiological gynecomastia is normally observed in NEWBORNS; ADOLESCENT; and AGING males." 男性乳房（BREAST）增大，由雌激素（ESTROGENS）过多引起。生理性男子乳腺发育通常见于新生儿（NEWBORNS）、青春期（ADOLESCENT）和老年（AGING）男性。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Gynecomastia" scope note C17.800.090.937 Lactation Disorders 泌乳障碍 "Disturbances of MILK secretion in either SEX, not necessarily related to PREGNANCY." 任一性别（SEX）的乳汁（MILK）分泌紊乱，不一定与妊娠（PREGNANCY）有关。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Lactation Disorders" scope note C17.800.090.937.439 Galactorrhea 溢乳 "Excessive or inappropriate LACTATION in females or males, and not necessarily related to PREGNANCY. Galactorrhea can occur either unilaterally or bilaterally, and be profuse or sparse. Its most common cause is HYPERPROLACTINEMIA." 女性或男性过度或不适当的泌乳（LACTATION），且不一定与妊娠（PREGNANCY）有关。溢乳可为单侧或双侧，量可多可少。其最常见原因是高催乳素血症（HYPERPROLACTINEMIA）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Galactorrhea" scope note C17.800.090.937.439.500 Chiari-Frommel Syndrome 希-弗综合征 "A POSTPARTUM condition consists of persistent lactation (GALACTORRHEA) and AMENORRHEA in patients not BREAST FEEDING." 一种产后（POSTPARTUM）病症，表现为未进行母乳喂养（BREAST FEEDING）的患者出现持续泌乳（GALACTORRHEA）和闭经（AMENORRHEA）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Chiari-Frommel Syndrome" scope note C17.800.090.968 Mastitis 乳腺炎 "INFLAMMATION of the BREAST, or MAMMARY GLAND." 乳房（BREAST）的炎症（INFLAMMATION），或乳腺（MAMMARY GLAND）的炎症。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Mastitis" scope note C17.800.090.968.400 Granulomatous Mastitis 肉芽肿性乳腺炎 "A rare, benign, inflammatory breast disease occurring in premenopausal women shortly after a recent pregnancy. The origin is unknown but it is commonly mistaken for malignancy and sometimes associated with BREAST FEEDING and the use of ORAL CONTRACEPTIVES." 一种罕见的良性炎症性乳腺疾病，发生于近期妊娠后不久的绝经前女性。其起源不明，但常被误认为恶性肿瘤，有时与母乳喂养（BREAST FEEDING）和口服避孕药（ORAL CONTRACEPTIVES）的使用有关。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Granulomatous Mastitis" scope note References National Library of Medicine. (2026). MeSH 2026 descriptor records [Data set]. Retrieved October 28, 2026, from https://www.nlm.nih.gov/databases/download/mesh.html

medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.title: C17.800.113 Calcinosis Cutis | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.summary: C17.800.113 Calcinosis Cutis Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source C17.800.113 Calcinosis Cutis 皮肤钙质沉着症 "Pathological deposition of calcium in the skin and subcutaneous tissue. Excessive calcification of the skin may be associated with underlying diseases that cause tissue damage (e.g. EHLERS-DANLOS SYNDROME; PSEUDOXANTHOMA ELASTICUM; ROTHMUND-THOMSON SYNDROME; and WERNER SYNDROME) or that cause abnormal calcium and phosphate metabolism (e.g., CALCIPHYLAXIS; CHRONIC KIDNEY FAILURE; HYPERPARATHYROIDISM; and SARCOIDOSIS)." 钙在皮肤和皮下组织中的病理性沉积。皮肤过度钙化可能与引起组织损伤的基础疾病（如埃勒斯-当洛斯综合征（EHLERS-DANLOS SYNDROME）、弹性纤维假黄瘤（PSEUDOXANTHOMA ELASTICUM）、罗特蒙德-汤姆森综合征（ROTHMUND-THOMSON SYNDROME）和沃纳综合征（WERNER SYNDROME））有关，或与引起钙磷代谢异常的疾病（如钙化防御（CALCIPHYLAXIS）、慢性肾衰竭（CHRONIC KIDNEY FAILURE）、甲状旁腺功能亢进（HYPERPARATHYROIDISM）和结节病（SARCOIDOSIS））有关。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Calcinosis Cutis" scope note References National Library of Medicine. (2026). MeSH 2026 descriptor records [Data set]. Retrieved October 28, 2026, from https://www.nlm.nih.gov/databases/download/mesh.html

medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.title: C17.800.174 Dermatitis | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.summary: C17.800.174 Dermatitis Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source C17.800.174 Dermatitis 皮炎 "Any inflammation of the skin." 任何皮肤的炎症。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Dermatitis" scope note C17.800.174.100 Acrodermatitis 肢端皮炎 "Inflammation involving the skin of the extremities, especially the hands and feet. Several forms are known, some idiopathic and some hereditary. The infantile form is called Gianotti-Crosti syndrome." 累及四肢皮肤的炎症，尤其是手和足。已知有多种类型，有些为特发性，有些为遗传性。婴儿型称为 Gianotti-Crosti 综合征。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Acrodermatitis" scope note C17.800.174.146 Dandruff 头皮屑 "Excessive shedding of dry scaly material from the scalp in humans." 人类头皮过度脱落干燥鳞屑状物质。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Dandruff" scope note C17.800.174.193 Dermatitis, Atopic 特应性皮炎 "A chronic inflammatory genetically determined disease of the skin marked by increased ability to form reagin (IgE), with increased susceptibility to allergic rhinitis and asthma, and hereditary disposition to a lowered threshold for pruritus. It is manifested by lichenification, excoriation, and crusting, mainly on the flexural surfaces of the elbow and knee. In infants it is known as infantile eczema." 一种遗传决定的慢性炎症性皮肤病，特征为形成反应素（IgE）的能力增强，对过敏性鼻炎和哮喘的易感性增加，并有瘙痒阈值降低的遗传素质。表现为苔藓样变、表皮剥脱和结痂，主要位于肘、膝屈侧。在婴儿中称为婴儿湿疹。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Dermatitis, Atopic" scope note C17.800.174.255 Dermatitis, Contact 接触性皮炎 "A type of acute or chronic skin reaction in which sensitivity is manifested by reactivity to materials or substances coming in contact with the skin. It may involve allergic or non-allergic mechanisms." 一类急性或慢性皮肤反应，其敏感性表现为对接触皮肤的材料或物质产生反应。可涉及变应性或非变应性机制。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Dermatitis, Contact" scope note C17.800.174.255.100 Dermatitis, Allergic Contact 变应性接触性皮炎 "A contact dermatitis due to allergic sensitization to various substances. These substances subsequently produce inflammatory reactions in the skin of those who have acquired hypersensitivity to them as a result of prior exposure." 一种因对各种物质发生变应性致敏而引起的接触性皮炎。这些物质随后在因既往接触而获得超敏性的人的皮肤中引起炎症反应。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Dermatitis, Allergic Contact" scope note C17.800.174.255.100.600 Dermatitis, Photoallergic 光变应性皮炎 "A delayed hypersensitivity involving the reaction between sunlight or other radiant energy source and a chemical substance to which the individual has been previously exposed and sensitized. It manifests as a papulovesicular, eczematous, or exudative dermatitis occurring chiefly on the light-exposed areas of the skin." 一种迟发型超敏反应，涉及日光或其他辐射能源与化学物质之间的反应，个体此前已接触该化学物质并致敏。表现为丘疹水疱性、湿疹样或渗出性皮炎，主要发生于皮肤的曝光部位。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Dermatitis, Photoallergic" scope note C17.800.174.255.100.700 Dermatitis, Toxicodendron 毒漆树皮炎 "An allergic contact dermatitis caused by exposure to plants of the genus Toxicodendron (formerly Rhus). These include poison ivy, poison oak, and poison sumac, all plants that contain the substance urushiol, a potent skin sensitizing agent. (From Dorland, 27th ed)" 一种变应性接触性皮炎，由接触漆树属（Toxicodendron）植物（旧称 Rhus）引起。这些植物包括毒常春藤、毒橡树和毒漆树，均含有漆酚这种强效皮肤致敏物质。（引自 Dorland，第 27 版） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Dermatitis, Toxicodendron" scope note C17.800.174.255.400 Dermatitis, Irritant 刺激性皮炎 "A non-allergic contact dermatitis caused by prolonged exposure to irritants and not explained by delayed hypersensitivity mechanisms." 一种由长期接触刺激物引起的非过敏性接触性皮炎，不能用迟发型超敏反应机制解释。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Dermatitis, Irritant" scope note C17.800.174.255.400.225 Dermatitis, Phototoxic 光毒性皮炎 "A nonimmunologic, chemically induced type of photosensitivity producing a sometimes vesiculating dermatitis. It results in hyperpigmentation and desquamation of the light-exposed areas of the skin." 一种非免疫性、化学诱发的光敏感类型，可产生有时伴水疱的皮炎。导致皮肤曝光部位色素沉着过度和脱屑。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Dermatitis, Phototoxic" scope note C17.800.174.255.400.250 Diaper Rash 尿布疹 "A type of irritant dermatitis localized to the area in contact with a diaper and occurring most often as a reaction to prolonged contact with urine, feces, or retained soap or detergent." 一种局限于与尿布接触部位的刺激性皮炎，最常因长时间接触尿液、粪便或残留的肥皂或洗涤剂而发生。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Diaper Rash" scope note C17.800.174.255.700 Dermatitis, Occupational 职业性皮炎 "A recurrent contact dermatitis caused by substances found in the work place." 一种由工作场所中存在的物质引起的复发性接触性皮炎。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Dermatitis, Occupational" scope note C17.800.174.318 Dermatitis, Exfoliative 剥脱性皮炎 "The widespread involvement of the skin by a scaly, erythematous dermatitis occurring either as a secondary or reactive process to an underlying cutaneous disorder (e.g., atopic dermatitis, psoriasis, etc.), or as a primary or idiopathic disease. It is often associated with the loss of hair and nails, hyperkeratosis of the palms and soles, and pruritus. (From Dorland, 27th ed)" 鳞屑性红斑性皮炎对皮肤的广泛累及，可作为基础皮肤病（如特应性皮炎、银屑病等）的继发或反应性过程发生，也可作为原发或特发性疾病发生。它常伴有毛发和指（趾）甲脱落、掌跖角化过度及瘙痒。（引自 Dorland，第 27 版） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Dermatitis, Exfoliative" scope note C17.800.174.360 Dermatitis Herpetiformis 疱疹样皮炎 "Rare, chronic, papulo-vesicular disease characterized by an intensely pruritic eruption consisting of various combinations of symmetrical, erythematous, papular, vesicular, or bullous lesions. The disease is strongly associated with the presence of HLA-B8 and HLA-DR3 antigens. A variety of different autoantibodies has been detected in small numbers in patients with dermatitis herpetiformis." 一种罕见的慢性丘疹水疱性疾病，特征为剧烈瘙痒的皮疹，由对称性红斑、丘疹、水疱或大疱性病变的各种组合构成。该病与 HLA-B8 和 HLA-DR3 抗原的存在密切相关。在疱疹样皮炎患者中已检出少量多种不同的自身抗体。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Dermatitis Herpetiformis" scope note C17.800.174.550 Dermatitis, Perioral 口周皮炎 "A papular eruption of unknown etiology that progresses to residual papular erythema and scaling usually confined to the area of the mouth, and almost exclusively occurring in young women. It may also be localized or extend to involve the eyelids and adjacent glabella area of the forehead (periocular dermatitis). (Dorland, 28th ed)" 一种病因不明的丘疹性皮疹，进展为残留的丘疹性红斑和鳞屑，通常局限于口周区域，几乎只发生于年轻女性。也可局限于或扩展累及眼睑及前额邻近的眉间区域（眼周皮炎）。（Dorland，第 28 版） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Dermatitis, Perioral" scope note C17.800.174.580 Dermatitis, Seborrheic 脂溢性皮炎 "A chronic inflammatory disease of the skin with unknown etiology. It is characterized by moderate ERYTHEMA, dry, moist, or greasy (SEBACEOUS GLAND) scaling and yellow crusted patches on various areas, especially the scalp, that exfoliate as dandruff. Seborrheic dermatitis is common in children and adolescents with HIV INFECTIONS." 一种病因不明的慢性炎症性皮肤病。特征为中度红斑（ERYTHEMA）、干性、湿性或油腻性（皮脂腺（SEBACEOUS GLAND））鳞屑，以及身体各部位尤其是头皮上的黄色结痂斑片，后者以头皮屑形式脱落。脂溢性皮炎常见于患有 HIV 感染（HIV INFECTIONS）的儿童和青少年。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Dermatitis, Seborrheic" scope note C17.800.174.600 Drug Eruptions 药疹 "Adverse cutaneous reactions caused by ingestion, parenteral use, or local application of a drug. These may assume various morphologic patterns and produce various types of lesions." 因口服、胃肠外使用或局部应用药物而引起的皮肤不良反应。这些反应可呈现多种形态模式，并产生多种类型的皮损。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Drug Eruptions" scope note C17.800.174.600.174 Acute Generalized Exanthematous Pustulosis 急性泛发性发疹性脓疱病 "Rare skin eruption characterized by acute formation of pustules filled with NEUTROPHILS, fever, and peripheral blood LEUKOCYTOSIS. Most cases are associated with the use of antibiotics (e.g., BETA-LACTAMS)." 一种罕见的皮疹，特征为急性形成充满中性粒细胞（NEUTROPHILS）的脓疱、发热及外周血白细胞增多（LEUKOCYTOSIS）。大多数病例与抗生素（如 β-内酰胺类（BETA-LACTAMS））的使用有关。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Acute Generalized Exanthematous Pustulosis" scope note C17.800.174.600.262 Drug Hypersensitivity Syndrome 药物超敏反应综合征 "Severe drug eruption characterized by high fever, erythematous rash and inflammation of internal organ(s)." 严重的药疹，特征为高热、红斑性皮疹及内脏器官炎症。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Drug Hypersensitivity Syndrome" scope note C17.800.174.600.375 Erythema Nodosum 结节性红斑 "An erythematous eruption commonly associated with drug reactions or infection and characterized by inflammatory nodules that are usually tender, multiple, and bilateral. These nodules are located predominantly on the shins with less common occurrence on the thighs and forearms. They undergo characteristic color changes ending in temporary bruise-like areas. This condition usually subsides in 3-6 weeks without scarring or atrophy." 一种常与药物反应或感染相关的红斑性皮疹，特征为通常有触痛、多发且双侧分布的炎性结节。这些结节主要位于胫前，较少见于大腿和前臂。结节会经历特征性的颜色变化，最终形成暂时性的瘀伤样区域。本病通常在 3 至 6 周内消退，不留瘢痕或萎缩。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Erythema Nodosum" scope note C17.800.174.600.587 Hand-Foot Syndrome 手足综合征 "Chemotherapy-induced dermal side effects that are associated with the use of various CYTOSTATIC AGENTS. Symptoms range from mild ERYTHEMA and/or PARESTHESIA to severe ulcerative dermatitis with debilitating pain involving typically palmoplantar and intertriginous areas. These cutaneous manifestations are sometimes accompanied by nail anomalies." 与使用各种细胞抑制剂（CYTOSTATIC AGENTS）相关的化疗所致皮肤副作用。症状从轻度红斑（ERYTHEMA）和/或感觉异常（PARESTHESIA）到严重的溃疡性皮炎伴致残性疼痛，典型累及掌跖和皱褶部位。这些皮肤表现有时伴有甲异常。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Hand-Foot Syndrome" scope note C17.800.174.600.693 Nicolau Syndrome 尼古拉综合征 "An uncommon complication of INTRAMUSCULAR INJECTION leading to variable degrees of necrosis of skin and underlying tissue." 肌内注射（INTRAMUSCULAR INJECTION）的一种少见并发症，导致不同程度的皮肤及皮下组织坏死。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Nicolau Syndrome" scope note C17.800.174.600.800 Serum Sickness 血清病 "Immune complex disease caused by the administration of foreign serum or serum proteins and characterized by fever, lymphadenopathy, arthralgia, and urticaria. When they are complexed to protein carriers, some drugs can also cause serum sickness when they act as haptens inducing antibody responses." 一种免疫复合物病，由给予异种血清或血清蛋白引起，特征为发热、淋巴结肿大、关节痛和荨麻疹。某些药物与蛋白质载体结合后作为半抗原诱导抗体应答时，也可引起血清病。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Serum Sickness" scope note C17.800.174.600.900 Stevens-Johnson Syndrome 史蒂文斯-约翰逊综合征 "Rare cutaneous eruption characterized by extensive KERATINOCYTE apoptosis resulting in skin detachment with mucosal involvement. It is often provoked by the use of drugs (e.g., antibiotics and anticonvulsants) or associated with PNEUMONIA, MYCOPLASMA. It is considered a continuum of Toxic Epidermal Necrolysis." 一种罕见的皮疹，特征为广泛的角质形成细胞（KERATINOCYTE）凋亡，导致皮肤剥脱并累及黏膜。常由药物（如抗生素和抗惊厥药）诱发，或与支原体肺炎（PNEUMONIA, MYCOPLASMA）相关。它被视为与中毒性表皮坏死松解症构成同一连续谱。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Stevens-Johnson Syndrome" scope note C17.800.174.620 Eczema 湿疹 "A dermatitis characterized by a spongiotic tissue reaction pattern occurring as a reaction to many endogenous and exogenous agents." 一种皮炎，特征为海绵水肿性组织反应模式，作为对多种内源性和外源性因素的反应而发生。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Eczema" scope note C17.800.174.620.300 Eczema, Dyshidrotic 汗疱疹 "A recurrent eczematous reaction characterized by the development of vesicular eruptions on the palms and soles, particularly along the sides and between the digits. It is accompanied by pruritus, a burning sensation, and hyperhidrosis. The disease is self-limiting, lasting only a few weeks. (Dorland, 27th ed)" 一种复发性湿疹样反应，特征为手掌和足底出现水疱性皮疹，尤其是沿指（趾）侧缘和指（趾）间。伴有瘙痒、烧灼感和多汗。该病为自限性，仅持续数周。（Dorland，第 27 版） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Eczema, Dyshidrotic" scope note C17.800.174.640 Intertrigo 擦烂 "A superficial dermatitis occurring on skin surfaces in contact with each other, such as the axillae, neck creases, intergluteal fold, between the toes, etc. Obesity is a predisposing factor. The condition is caused by moisture and friction and is characterized by erythema, maceration, burning, and exudation." 一种发生于相互接触的皮肤表面的浅表性皮炎，如腋窝、颈部皱褶、臀间沟、趾间等。肥胖是易感因素。本病由潮湿和摩擦引起，特征为红斑、浸渍、烧灼感和渗出。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Intertrigo" scope note C17.800.174.640.500 Tinea Cruris 股癣 "Fungal infection of the groin. The main causative fungus is TRICHOPHYTON." 腹股沟的真菌感染。主要致病真菌为毛癣菌（TRICHOPHYTON）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Tinea Cruris" scope note C17.800.174.660 Neurodermatitis 神经性皮炎 "An extremely variable eczematous skin disease that is presumed to be a response to prolonged vigorous scratching, rubbing, or pinching to relieve intense pruritus. It varies in intensity, severity, course, and morphologic expression in different individuals. Neurodermatitis is believed by some to be psychogenic. The circumscribed or localized form is often referred to as lichen simplex chronicus." 一种表现极为多变的湿疹样皮肤病，被认为是为缓解剧烈瘙痒而长期用力搔抓、摩擦或掐捏所致的反应。其强度、严重程度、病程和形态表现因人而异。有人认为神经性皮炎属心因性。局限型常称为慢性单纯性苔藓。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Neurodermatitis" scope note C17.800.174.826 Radiodermatitis 放射性皮炎 "A cutaneous inflammatory reaction occurring as a result of exposure to ionizing radiation." 一种因暴露于电离辐射而发生的皮肤炎症反应。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Radiodermatitis" scope note References National Library of Medicine. (2026). MeSH 2026 descriptor records [Data set]. Retrieved October 28, 2026, from https://www.nlm.nih.gov/databases/download/mesh.html

medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.title: C17.800.185 Dermatomyositis | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.summary: C17.800.185 Dermatomyositis Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source C17.800.185 Dermatomyositis 皮肌炎 "A subacute or chronic inflammatory disease of muscle and skin, marked by proximal muscle weakness and a characteristic skin rash. The illness occurs with approximately equal frequency in children and adults. The skin lesions usually take the form of a purplish rash (or less often an exfoliative dermatitis) involving the nose, cheeks, forehead, upper trunk, and arms. The disease is associated with a complement mediated intramuscular microangiopathy, leading to loss of capillaries, muscle ischemia, muscle-fiber necrosis, and perifascicular atrophy. The childhood form of this disease tends to evolve into a systemic vasculitis. Dermatomyositis may occur in association with malignant neoplasms. (From Adams et al., Principles of Neurology, 6th ed, pp1405-6)" 一种亚急性或慢性的肌肉和皮肤炎症性疾病，以近端肌无力和特征性皮疹为特点。该病在儿童和成人中的发病率大致相等。皮肤病变通常表现为紫红色皮疹（较少为剥脱性皮炎），累及鼻、面颊、前额、上躯干和上肢。该病与补体介导的肌内微血管病有关，导致毛细血管丧失、肌肉缺血、肌纤维坏死和束周萎缩。儿童型往往发展为系统性血管炎。皮肌炎可伴发恶性肿瘤。（引自 Adams 等，《神经病学原理》，第 6 版，第 1405-1406 页） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Dermatomyositis" scope note References National Library of Medicine. (2026). MeSH 2026 descriptor records [Data set]. Retrieved October 28, 2026, from https://www.nlm.nih.gov/databases/download/mesh.html

medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.title: C17.800.229 Erythema | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.summary: C17.800.229 Erythema Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source C17.800.229 Erythema 红斑 "Redness of the skin produced by congestion of the capillaries. This condition may result from a variety of disease processes." 由毛细血管充血引起的皮肤发红。此病症可由多种疾病过程引起。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Erythema" scope note C17.800.229.100 Erythema Ab Igne 火激红斑 "A cutaneous finding caused by prolonged heat exposure (e.g., space heater) and local heat injury (e.g., caused by LASER THERAPY). It is characterized by epidermal atrophy, reticular hyperpigmentation, and telangiectatic dermatosis." 一种由长期热暴露（例如取暖器）和局部热损伤（例如由激光治疗，LASER THERAPY，所致）引起的皮肤表现。其特征为表皮萎缩、网状色素沉着和毛细血管扩张性皮肤病。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Erythema Ab Igne" scope note C17.800.229.200 Erythema Chronicum Migrans 慢性游走性红斑 "A deep type of gyrate erythema that follows a bite by an ixodid tick; it is a stage-1 manifestation of LYME DISEASE. The site of the bite is characterized by a red papule that expands peripherally as a nonscaling, palpable band that clears centrally. This condition is often associated with systemic symptoms such as chills, fever, headache, malaise, nausea, vomiting, fatigue, backache, and stiff neck." 一种深在型回状红斑，发生于硬蜱叮咬之后；它是莱姆病（LYME DISEASE）的第 1 期表现。叮咬部位特征为一个红色丘疹，向外周扩展为一条无鳞屑、可触及、中央消退的环带。该病常伴有全身症状，如寒战、发热、头痛、不适、恶心、呕吐、疲劳、背痛和颈项强直。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Erythema Chronicum Migrans" scope note C17.800.229.329 Erythema Induratum 硬红斑 "A type of panniculitis characterized histologically by the presence of granulomas, vasculitis, and necrosis. It is traditionally considered to be the tuberculous counterpart of nodular vasculitis, but is now known to occur without tuberculous precedent. It is seen most commonly in adolescent and menopausal women, is initiated or exacerbated by cold weather, and typically presents as one or more recurrent erythrocyanotic nodules or plaques on the calves. The nodules may progress to form indurations, ulcerations, and scars." 一种脂膜炎，组织学特征为存在肉芽肿、血管炎和坏死。传统上认为它是结节性血管炎的结核性对应病，但现已知其可在无结核前驱的情况下发生。最常见于青春期和绝经期女性，由寒冷天气诱发或加重，典型表现为小腿上一个或多个复发性红绀色结节或斑块。结节可进展形成硬结、溃疡和瘢痕。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Erythema Induratum" scope note C17.800.229.335 Erythema Infectiosum 传染性红斑 "Contagious infection with HUMAN PAROVIRUS B19 most commonly seen in school age children and characterized by fever, headache, and rashes of the face, trunk, and extremities. It is often confused with RUBELLA." 一种人细小病毒 B19（HUMAN PAROVIRUS B19）的传染性感染，最常见于学龄儿童，特征为发热、头痛及面部、躯干和四肢皮疹。常与风疹（RUBELLA）混淆。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Erythema Infectiosum" scope note C17.800.229.400 Erythema Multiforme 多形红斑 "A skin and mucous membrane disease characterized by an eruption of macules, papules, nodules, vesicles, and/or bullae with characteristic bull's-eye lesions usually occurring on the dorsal aspect of the hands and forearms." 一种皮肤和黏膜疾病，特征为出现斑疹、丘疹、结节、水疱和（或）大疱，伴有特征性的靶形皮损，通常发生于手背和前臂背侧。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Erythema Multiforme" scope note C17.800.229.400.683 Stevens-Johnson Syndrome 史蒂文斯-约翰逊综合征 "Rare cutaneous eruption characterized by extensive KERATINOCYTE apoptosis resulting in skin detachment with mucosal involvement. It is often provoked by the use of drugs (e.g., antibiotics and anticonvulsants) or associated with PNEUMONIA, MYCOPLASMA. It is considered a continuum of Toxic Epidermal Necrolysis." 一种罕见的皮疹，特征为广泛的角质形成细胞（KERATINOCYTE）凋亡，导致皮肤剥脱并累及黏膜。常由药物（如抗生素和抗惊厥药）诱发，或与支原体肺炎（PNEUMONIA, MYCOPLASMA）相关。它被视为与中毒性表皮坏死松解症构成同一连续谱。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Stevens-Johnson Syndrome" scope note C17.800.229.413 Erythema Nodosum 结节性红斑 "An erythematous eruption commonly associated with drug reactions or infection and characterized by inflammatory nodules that are usually tender, multiple, and bilateral. These nodules are located predominantly on the shins with less common occurrence on the thighs and forearms. They undergo characteristic color changes ending in temporary bruise-like areas. This condition usually subsides in 3-6 weeks without scarring or atrophy." 一种常与药物反应或感染相关的红斑性皮疹，特征为通常有触痛、多发且双侧分布的炎性结节。这些结节主要位于胫前，较少见于大腿和前臂。结节会经历特征性的颜色变化，最终形成暂时性的瘀伤样区域。本病通常在 3 至 6 周内消退，不留瘢痕或萎缩。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Erythema Nodosum" scope note C17.800.229.606 Erythrokeratodermia Variabilis 可变性红斑角化病 "An autosomal dominant skin disease characterized by transient and variable noninflammatory ERYTHEMA and hyperkeratosis. It has been associated with mutations in the genes that code for CONNEXINS. Erythrokeratodermia variabilis inherited in an autosomal recessive fashion has also been reported. Affected individuals often develop PALMOPLANTAR KERATODERMA." 一种常染色体显性遗传皮肤病，特征为短暂且多变的非炎症性红斑（ERYTHEMA）和角化过度。它与编码连接蛋白（CONNEXINS）的基因突变相关。也有以常染色体隐性方式遗传的可变性红斑角化病的报道。患者常发生掌跖角皮病（PALMOPLANTAR KERATODERMA）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Erythrokeratodermia Variabilis" scope note C17.800.229.800 Sweet Syndrome 斯威特综合征 "Condition characterized by large, rapidly extending, erythematous, tender plaques on the upper body usually accompanied by fever and dermal infiltration of neutrophilic leukocytes. It occurs mostly in middle-aged women, is often preceded by an upper respiratory infection, and clinically resembles ERYTHEMA MULTIFORME. Sweet syndrome is associated with LEUKEMIA." 一种病症，其特征为上半身出现大的、迅速扩展的红斑性触痛斑块，通常伴有发热和真皮中性粒细胞浸润。多见于中年女性，常在上呼吸道感染后发生，临床上类似多形红斑（ERYTHEMA MULTIFORME）。斯威特综合征与白血病（LEUKEMIA）相关。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Sweet Syndrome" scope note References National Library of Medicine. (2026). MeSH 2026 descriptor records [Data set]. Retrieved October 28, 2026, from https://www.nlm.nih.gov/databases/download/mesh.html

medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.title: C17.800.257 Exanthema | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.summary: C17.800.257 Exanthema Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source C17.800.257 Exanthema 疹病 "Diseases in which skin eruptions or rashes are a prominent manifestation. Classically, six such diseases were described with similar rashes; they were numbered in the order in which they were reported. Only the fourth (Duke's disease), fifth (ERYTHEMA INFECTIOSUM), and sixth (EXANTHEMA SUBITUM) numeric designations survive as occasional synonyms in current terminology." 以皮疹或出疹为突出表现的疾病。传统上曾描述过六种皮疹相似的此类疾病，按报道顺序编号。在当前术语中，只有第四病（杜克病）、第五病（传染性红斑（ERYTHEMA INFECTIOSUM））和第六病（幼儿急疹（EXANTHEMA SUBITUM））的数字名称仍偶尔作为同义词使用。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Exanthema" scope note C17.800.257.335 Exanthema Subitum 幼儿急疹 "An acute, short-lived, viral disease of infants and young children characterized by a high fever at onset that drops to normal after 3-4 days and the concomitant appearance of a macular or maculopapular rash that appears first on the trunk and then spreads to other areas. It is the sixth of the classical exanthematous diseases and is caused by HHV-6; (HERPESVIRUS 6, HUMAN). (From Dorland, 27th ed)" 一种急性、短暂的婴幼儿病毒性疾病，特征为起病时高热，3 至 4 天后降至正常，同时出现斑疹或斑丘疹，先见于躯干，后扩散至其他部位。它是第六种经典出疹性疾病，由 HHV-6（人疱疹病毒 6 型（HERPESVIRUS 6, HUMAN））引起。（引自 Dorland，第 27 版） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Exanthema Subitum" scope note References National Library of Medicine. (2026). MeSH 2026 descriptor records [Data set]. Retrieved October 28, 2026, from https://www.nlm.nih.gov/databases/download/mesh.html

medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.title: C17.800.271 Facial Dermatoses | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.summary: C17.800.271 Facial Dermatoses Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source C17.800.271 Facial Dermatoses 面部皮肤病 "Skin diseases involving the FACE." 累及面部（FACE）的皮肤疾病。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Facial Dermatoses" scope note C17.800.271.250 Dermatitis, Perioral 口周皮炎 "A papular eruption of unknown etiology that progresses to residual papular erythema and scaling usually confined to the area of the mouth, and almost exclusively occurring in young women. It may also be localized or extend to involve the eyelids and adjacent glabella area of the forehead (periocular dermatitis). (Dorland, 28th ed)" 一种病因不明的丘疹性皮疹，进展为残留的丘疹性红斑和鳞屑，通常局限于口周区域，几乎只发生于年轻女性。也可局限于或扩展累及眼睑及前额邻近的眉间区域（眼周皮炎）。（Dorland，第 28 版） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Dermatitis, Perioral" scope note References National Library of Medicine. (2026). MeSH 2026 descriptor records [Data set]. Retrieved October 28, 2026, from https://www.nlm.nih.gov/databases/download/mesh.html

medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.title: C17.800.321 Foot Diseases | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.summary: C17.800.321 Foot Diseases Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source C17.800.321 Foot Diseases 足疾病 "Anatomical and functional disorders affecting the foot." 累及足部的解剖和功能障碍。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Foot Diseases" scope note C17.800.321.063 Fibromatosis, Plantar 足底纤维瘤病 "A fibromatosis of the plantar fascia characterized by thickening of the fibrous bands on the plantar aponeurosis in the sole of the foot and toes." 一种足底筋膜的纤维瘤病，特征为足底及足趾处足底腱膜上的纤维束增厚。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Fibromatosis, Plantar" scope note C17.800.321.125 Foot Dermatoses 足部皮肤病 "Skin diseases of the foot, general or unspecified." 足部的皮肤疾病，泛指或未特指者。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Foot Dermatoses" scope note C17.800.321.125.500 Tinea Pedis 足癣 "Dermatological pruritic lesion in the feet, caused by Trichophyton rubrum, T. mentagrophytes, or Epidermophyton floccosum." 足部的瘙痒性皮肤病变，由红色毛癣菌、须癣毛癣菌或絮状表皮癣菌引起。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Tinea Pedis" scope note C17.800.321.250 Foot Ulcer 足溃疡 "Lesion on the surface of the skin of the foot, usually accompanied by inflammation. The lesion may become infected or necrotic and is frequently associated with diabetes or leprosy." 足部皮肤表面的病变，通常伴有炎症。病变可发生感染或坏死，常与糖尿病或麻风相关。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Foot Ulcer" scope note C17.800.321.500 Immersion Foot 浸渍足 "A condition of the feet produced by prolonged exposure of the feet to water. Exposure for 48 hours or more to warm water causes tropical immersion foot or warm-water immersion foot common in Vietnam where troops were exposed to prolonged or repeated wading in paddy fields or streams. Trench foot results from prolonged exposure to cold, without actual freezing. It was common in trench warfare during World War I, when soldiers stood, sometimes for hours, in trenches with a few inches of cold water in them. (Andrews' Diseases of the Skin, 8th ed, p27)" 一种因足部长时间浸泡于水中而产生的足部病症。暴露于温水 48 小时或以上可导致热带浸渍足或温水浸渍足，常见于越南，当时部队长时间或反复在稻田或溪流中涉水。战壕足由长时间暴露于寒冷而未实际冻结所致。它在第一次世界大战的堑壕战中很常见，士兵在积有几英寸冷水的战壕中站立，有时长达数小时。（Andrews 皮肤病学，第 8 版，第 27 页） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Immersion Foot" scope note References National Library of Medicine. (2026). MeSH 2026 descriptor records [Data set]. Retrieved October 28, 2026, from https://www.nlm.nih.gov/databases/download/mesh.html

medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.title: C17.800.329 Hair Diseases | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.summary: C17.800.329 Hair Diseases Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source C17.800.329 Hair Diseases 毛发疾病 "Diseases affecting the orderly growth and persistence of hair." 影响毛发有序生长和存续的疾病。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Hair Diseases" scope note C17.800.329.500 Folliculitis 毛囊炎 "Inflammation of follicles, primarily hair follicles." 毛囊的炎症，主要指毛发的毛囊。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Folliculitis" scope note C17.800.329.500.261 Acne Keloid 瘢痕疙瘩性痤疮 "A type of acneiform disorder in which secondary pyogenic infection in and around pilosebaceous structures ends in keloidal scarring. It manifests as persistent folliculitis of the back of the neck associated with occlusion of the follicular orifices. It is most often encountered in black or Asian men." 一种痤疮样疾病，其毛囊皮脂腺结构内及周围的继发性化脓性感染最终形成瘢痕疙瘩性瘢痕。表现为颈后部持续性毛囊炎，伴毛囊口闭塞。最常见于黑人或亚洲男性。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Acne Keloid" scope note C17.800.329.750 Hirsutism 多毛症 "A condition observed in WOMEN and CHILDREN when there is excess coarse body hair of an adult male distribution pattern, such as facial and chest areas. It is the result of elevated ANDROGENS from the OVARIES, the ADRENAL GLANDS, or exogenous sources. The concept does not include HYPERTRICHOSIS, which is an androgen-independent excessive hair growth." 见于女性（WOMEN）和儿童（CHILDREN）的一种情况，表现为呈成年男性分布模式的粗硬体毛过多，如面部和胸部。它是卵巢（OVARIES）、肾上腺（ADRENAL GLANDS）或外源性来源的雄激素（ANDROGENS）升高所致。该概念不包括毛增多症（HYPERTRICHOSIS），后者是不依赖雄激素的毛发过度生长。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Hirsutism" scope note C17.800.329.875 Hypertrichosis 多毛症 "Excessive hair growth at inappropriate locations, such as on the extremities, the head, and the back. It is caused by genetic or acquired factors, and is an androgen-independent process. This concept does not include HIRSUTISM which is an androgen-dependent excess hair growth in WOMEN and CHILDREN." 在不适当部位的毛发过度生长，如四肢、头部和背部。由遗传或获得性因素引起，是一种不依赖雄激素的过程。本概念不包括女性（WOMEN）和儿童（CHILDREN）中依赖雄激素的毛发过多，即多毛（HIRSUTISM）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Hypertrichosis" scope note C17.800.329.937 Hypotrichosis 毛发稀少症 "Presence of less than the normal amount of hair. (Dorland, 27th ed)" 毛发量少于正常。（Dorland，第 27 版） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Hypotrichosis" scope note C17.800.329.937.122 Alopecia 脱发 "Absence of hair from areas where it is normally present." 正常应有毛发的部位毛发缺失。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Alopecia" scope note C17.800.329.937.122.147 Alopecia Areata 斑秃 "Loss of scalp and body hair involving microscopically inflammatory patchy areas." 头皮和体毛脱落，累及在显微镜下呈炎症性的斑片状区域。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Alopecia Areata" scope note C17.800.329.937.122.348 Loose Anagen Hair Syndrome 生长期毛发松动综合征 "Benign childhood alopecia that improves spontaneously with aging. It is characterized by anagen hairs (misshapen hair bulbs and absent inner and outer root sheaths), thin, and sparse hairs that pulls out easily." 随年龄增长自发改善的良性儿童脱发。其特征为生长期毛发（毛球变形，内外根鞘缺失），毛发细而稀疏，易被拔出。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Loose Anagen Hair Syndrome" scope note C17.800.329.937.122.550 Mucinosis, Follicular 毛囊黏蛋白病 "A disease of the pilosebaceous unit, presenting clinically as grouped follicular papules or plaques with associated hair loss. It is caused by mucinous infiltration of tissues, and usually involving the scalp, face, and neck. It may be primary (idiopathic) or secondary to mycosis fungoides or reticulosis." 一种毛囊皮脂腺单位的疾病，临床表现为成群的毛囊性丘疹或斑块，伴脱发。由组织黏蛋白浸润引起，通常累及头皮、面部和颈部。可为原发性（特发性），或继发于蕈样肉芽肿或网状细胞增多症。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Mucinosis, Follicular" scope note C17.800.329.968 Menkes Kinky Hair Syndrome Menkes 卷发综合征 "An inherited disorder of copper metabolism transmitted as an X-linked trait and characterized by the infantile onset of HYPOTHERMIA, feeding difficulties, hypotonia, SEIZURES, bony deformities, pili torti (twisted hair), and severely impaired intellectual development. Defective copper transport across plasma and endoplasmic reticulum membranes results in copper being unavailable for the synthesis of several copper containing enzymes, including PROTEIN-LYSINE 6-OXIDASE; CERULOPLASMIN; and SUPEROXIDE DISMUTASE. Pathologic changes include defects in arterial elastin, neuronal loss, and gliosis. (From Menkes, Textbook of Child Neurology, 5th ed, p125)" 一种遗传性铜代谢障碍，以 X 连锁性状遗传，特征为婴儿期出现低体温（HYPOTHERMIA）、喂养困难、肌张力减退、癫痫发作（SEIZURES）、骨骼畸形、扭曲发（扭转的毛发）及严重智力发育障碍。铜跨质膜和内质网膜的转运缺陷，使铜无法用于合成多种含铜酶，包括蛋白赖氨酸 6-氧化酶（PROTEIN-LYSINE 6-OXIDASE）、铜蓝蛋白（CERULOPLASMIN）和超氧化物歧化酶（SUPEROXIDE DISMUTASE）。病理改变包括动脉弹性蛋白缺陷、神经元丢失和胶质增生。（引自 Menkes，《儿童神经病学教科书》，第 5 版，第 125 页） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Menkes Kinky Hair Syndrome" scope note C17.800.329.984 Monilethrix 念珠状发 "Rare autosomal dominant disorder of the hair shaft. The clinical features of the disease include HYPOTRICHOSIS, dry, and/or brittle hair, with varying degrees of ALOPECIA. Mutations in the hair-specific keratin genes KRTHB1, KRTHB3, or KRTHB6 are associated with monilethrix. Autosomal recessive monilethrix with limited HYPOTRICHOSIS are also known. Mutations in Dsg4, Liph, and P2ry5 protein genes are associated with the recessive form of monilethrix." 罕见的常染色体显性遗传毛干疾病。本病临床特征包括毛发稀少症（HYPOTRICHOSIS）、干燥和（或）易脆的毛发，以及不同程度的脱发（ALOPECIA）。毛发特异性角蛋白基因 KRTHB1、KRTHB3 或 KRTHB6 的突变与念珠状发相关。伴有局限性毛发稀少症（HYPOTRICHOSIS）的常染色体隐性念珠状发亦有报道。Dsg4、Liph 和 P2ry5 蛋白基因的突变与隐性型念珠状发相关。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Monilethrix" scope note C17.800.329.992 Piedra 毛结节菌病 "Either of two diseases resulting from fungal infection of the hair shafts. Black piedra occurs mainly in and on the hairs of the scalp and is caused by Piedraia hortae; white piedra occurs in and on the hairs of the scalp, beard, moustache and genital areas and is caused by Trichosporon species." 由毛干真菌感染引起的两种疾病中的任一种。黑毛结节菌病主要发生于头皮毛发内和毛发上，由何德毛结节菌（Piedraia hortae）引起；白毛结节菌病发生于头皮、胡须、髭须和生殖器部位的毛发内和毛发上，由毛孢子菌属（Trichosporon）菌种引起。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Piedra" scope note References National Library of Medicine. (2026). MeSH 2026 descriptor records [Data set]. Retrieved October 28, 2026, from https://www.nlm.nih.gov/databases/download/mesh.html

medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.summary: C17.800.417 Keratoacanthoma Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source C17.800.417 Keratoacanthoma 角化棘皮瘤 "A benign, non-neoplastic, usually self-limiting epithelial lesion closely resembling squamous cell carcinoma clinically and histopathologically. It occurs in solitary, multiple, and eruptive forms. The solitary and multiple forms occur on sunlight exposed areas and are identical histologically; they affect primarily white males. The eruptive form usually involves both sexes and appears as a generalized papular eruption." 一种良性、非肿瘤性、通常具有自限性的上皮病变，在临床和组织病理学上与鳞状细胞癌极为相似。它有单发型、多发型和发疹型。单发型和多发型发生于日光暴露部位，组织学上相同，主要累及白人男性。发疹型通常两性均可累及，表现为泛发性丘疹样皮疹。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Keratoacanthoma" scope note References National Library of Medicine. (2026). MeSH 2026 descriptor records [Data set]. Retrieved October 28, 2026, from https://www.nlm.nih.gov/databases/download/mesh.html
