medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.summary: C17.800.428 Keratosis Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source C17.800.428 Keratosis 角化病 "Any horny growth such as a wart or callus." 任何角质增生物，如疣或胼胝。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Keratosis" scope note C17.800.428.200 Callosities 胼胝 "Localized hyperplasia of the horny layer of the epidermis due to pressure or friction. (Dorland, 27th ed)" 表皮角质层的局限性增生，由压力或摩擦所致。（Dorland，第 27 版） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Callosities" scope note C17.800.428.260 Cholesteatoma 胆脂瘤 "A non-neoplastic mass of keratin-producing squamous EPITHELIUM, frequently occurring in the MENINGES; bones of the skull, and most commonly in the MIDDLE EAR and MASTOID region. Cholesteatoma can be congenital or acquired. Cholesteatoma is not a tumor nor is it associated with high CHOLESTEROL." 一种产生角蛋白的鳞状上皮（EPITHELIUM）构成的非肿瘤性肿块，常发生于脑膜（MENINGES）、颅骨，最常见于中耳（MIDDLE EAR）和乳突（MASTOID）区。胆脂瘤可为先天性或后天性。胆脂瘤不是肿瘤，也与高胆固醇（CHOLESTEROL）无关。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Cholesteatoma" scope note C17.800.428.260.300 Cholesteatoma, Middle Ear 中耳胆脂瘤 "A mass of KERATIN-producing squamous EPITHELIUM that resembles an inverted (suck-in) bag of skin in the MIDDLE EAR. It arises from the eardrum (TYMPANIC MEMBRANE) and grows into the MIDDLE EAR causing erosion of EAR OSSICLES and MASTOID that contains the INNER EAR." 一团产生角蛋白（KERATIN）的鳞状上皮（EPITHELIUM），类似中耳（MIDDLE EAR）内一个内陷（吸入）的皮肤囊袋。它起源于鼓膜（TYMPANIC MEMBRANE），长入中耳（MIDDLE EAR），导致听小骨（EAR OSSICLES）和容纳内耳（INNER EAR）的乳突（MASTOID）受侵蚀。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Cholesteatoma, Middle Ear" scope note C17.800.428.275 Darier Disease 毛囊角化病（达里埃病） "An autosomal dominantly inherited skin disorder characterized by warty malodorous papules that coalesce into plaques. It is caused by mutations in the ATP2A2 gene encoding SERCA2 protein, one of the SARCOPLASMIC RETICULUM CALCIUM-TRANSPORTING ATPASES. The condition is similar, clinically and histologically, to BENIGN FAMILIAL PEMPHIGUS, another autosomal dominant skin disorder. Both diseases have defective calcium pumps (CALCIUM-TRANSPORTING ATPASES) and unstable desmosomal adhesion junctions (DESMOSOMES) between KERATINOCYTES." 一种常染色体显性遗传性皮肤病，特征为融合成斑块的疣状恶臭丘疹。它由编码 SERCA2 蛋白的 ATP2A2 基因突变引起，SERCA2 是肌质网钙转运 ATP 酶（SARCOPLASMIC RETICULUM CALCIUM-TRANSPORTING ATPASES）之一。该病在临床和组织学上与另一种常染色体显性皮肤病家族性良性天疱疮（BENIGN FAMILIAL PEMPHIGUS）相似。两种疾病都存在钙泵缺陷（钙转运 ATP 酶（CALCIUM-TRANSPORTING ATPASES））以及角质形成细胞（KERATINOCYTES）之间桥粒黏附连接（桥粒（DESMOSOMES））不稳定。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Darier Disease" scope note C17.800.428.304 Erythrokeratodermia Variabilis 可变性红斑角化病 "An autosomal dominant skin disease characterized by transient and variable noninflammatory ERYTHEMA and hyperkeratosis. It has been associated with mutations in the genes that code for CONNEXINS. Erythrokeratodermia variabilis inherited in an autosomal recessive fashion has also been reported. Affected individuals often develop PALMOPLANTAR KERATODERMA." 一种常染色体显性遗传皮肤病，特征为短暂且多变的非炎症性红斑（ERYTHEMA）和角化过度。它与编码连接蛋白（CONNEXINS）的基因突变相关。也有以常染色体隐性方式遗传的可变性红斑角化病的报道。患者常发生掌跖角皮病（PALMOPLANTAR KERATODERMA）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Erythrokeratodermia Variabilis" scope note C17.800.428.333 Ichthyosis 鱼鳞病 "Any of several generalized skin disorders characterized by dryness, roughness, and scaliness, due to hypertrophy of the stratum corneum epidermis. Most are genetic, but some are acquired, developing in association with other systemic disease or genetic syndrome." 几种泛发性皮肤病的统称，特征为干燥、粗糙和鳞屑，由表皮角质层肥厚所致。多数为遗传性，但也有获得性者，伴发于其他系统性疾病或遗传综合征。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Ichthyosis" scope note C17.800.428.333.250 Ichthyosiform Erythroderma, Congenital 先天性鱼鳞病样红皮病 "Designation for several severe forms of ichthyosis, present at birth, that are characterized by hyperkeratotic scaling. Infants may be born encased in a collodion membrane which begins shedding within 24 hours. This is followed in about two weeks by persistent generalized scaling. The forms include bullous (HYPERKERATOSIS, EPIDERMOLYTIC), non-bullous (ICHTHYOSIS, LAMELLAR), wet type, and dry type." 对出生时即存在的几种严重鱼鳞病类型的统称，特征为角化过度性鳞屑。婴儿出生时可包裹于火棉胶样膜中，该膜在 24 小时内开始脱落。约两周后继之以持续性全身鳞屑。其类型包括大疱型（HYPERKERATOSIS, EPIDERMOLYTIC）、非大疱型（ICHTHYOSIS, LAMELLAR）、湿型和干型。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Ichthyosiform Erythroderma, Congenital" scope note C17.800.428.333.250.375 Hyperkeratosis, Epidermolytic 表皮松解性角化过度症 "A form of congenital ichthyosis inherited as an autosomal dominant trait and characterized by ERYTHRODERMA and severe hyperkeratosis. It is manifested at birth by blisters followed by the appearance of thickened, horny, verruciform scales over the entire body, but accentuated in flexural areas. Mutations in the genes that encode KERATIN-1 and KERATIN-10 have been associated with this disorder." 一种以常染色体显性性状遗传的先天性鱼鳞病，特征为红皮病（ERYTHRODERMA）和严重角化过度。出生时即表现为水疱，随后全身出现增厚、角质、疣状鳞屑，但在屈侧部位更为明显。编码角蛋白 1（KERATIN-1）和角蛋白 10（KERATIN-10）的基因突变与该病相关。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Hyperkeratosis, Epidermolytic" scope note C17.800.428.333.250.410 Ichthyosis, Lamellar 板层状鱼鳞病 "A chronic, congenital ichthyosis inherited as an autosomal recessive trait. Infants are usually born encased in a collodion membrane which sheds within a few weeks. Scaling is generalized and marked with grayish-brown quadrilateral scales, adherent at their centers and free at the edges. In some cases, scales are so thick that they resemble armored plate." 一种以常染色体隐性性状遗传的慢性先天性鱼鳞病。婴儿出生时通常包裹于火棉胶膜中，该膜在数周内脱落。鳞屑泛发，呈灰褐色四边形，中央黏着、边缘游离。某些病例中鳞屑厚到类似铠甲板。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Ichthyosis, Lamellar" scope note C17.800.428.333.250.705 Netherton Syndrome 内瑟顿综合征 "Rare autosomal recessive disease with variable expressions. Clinical features of the disease include variable ICHTHYOSIFORM ERYTHRODERMA, CONGENITAL; bamboo hair (trichorrhexis invaginata); and ATOPIC DERMATITIS. The disease is caused by mutations in the SPINK5 gene." 一种表现多样的罕见常染色体隐性遗传病。该病的临床特征包括不同程度的先天性鱼鳞病样红皮病（ICHTHYOSIFORM ERYTHRODERMA, CONGENITAL）、竹节状发（套叠性脆发症）和特应性皮炎（ATOPIC DERMATITIS）。该病由 SPINK5 基因突变引起。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Netherton Syndrome" scope note C17.800.428.333.330 Ichthyosis Bullosa of Siemens Siemens 大疱性鱼鳞病 "An autosomal dominant form of ichthyosis characterized by generalized reddening of the skin (ERYTHEMA) and widespread blistering. The disease shows similar, but somewhat milder, clinical and histopathological findings to those in HYPERKERATOSIS, EPIDERMOLYTIC and is associated with the gene that encodes KERATIN-2A." 一种常染色体显性遗传的鱼鳞病，特征为皮肤泛发性发红（红斑（ERYTHEMA））和广泛水疱形成。该病的临床和组织病理学表现与表皮松解性角化过度（HYPERKERATOSIS, EPIDERMOLYTIC）相似但稍轻，并与编码角蛋白 2A（KERATIN-2A）的基因相关。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Ichthyosis Bullosa of Siemens" scope note C17.800.428.333.410 Ichthyosis Vulgaris 寻常型鱼鳞病 "Most common form of ICHTHYOSIS characterized by prominent scaling especially on the exterior surfaces of the extremities. It is inherited as an autosomal dominant trait." 鱼鳞病（ICHTHYOSIS）最常见的类型，特征为明显的鳞屑，尤其见于四肢伸侧。以常染色体显性性状遗传。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Ichthyosis Vulgaris" scope note C17.800.428.333.420 Ichthyosis, X-Linked X 连锁鱼鳞病 "Chronic form of ichthyosis that is inherited as a sex-linked recessive trait carried on the X-chromosome and transmitted to the male offspring. It is characterized by severe scaling, especially on the extremities, and is associated with steroid sulfatase deficiency." 一种慢性鱼鳞病，以位于 X 染色体上的性连锁隐性性状遗传并传给男性后代。特征为严重脱屑，尤其在四肢，并与类固醇硫酸酯酶缺乏相关。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Ichthyosis, X-Linked" scope note C17.800.428.333.723 Sjogren-Larsson Syndrome 舍格伦-拉松综合征 "An autosomal recessive neurocutaneous disorder characterized by severe ichthyosis MENTAL RETARDATION; SPASTIC PARAPLEGIA; and congenital ICHTHYOSIS. It is caused by mutation of gene encoding microsomal fatty ALDEHYDE DEHYDROGENASE leading to defect in fatty alcohol metabolism." 一种常染色体隐性遗传的神经皮肤疾病，其特征为重度鱼鳞病、精神发育迟滞（MENTAL RETARDATION）、痉挛性截瘫（SPASTIC PARAPLEGIA）和先天性鱼鳞病（ICHTHYOSIS）。由编码微粒体脂肪醛脱氢酶（ALDEHYDE DEHYDROGENASE）的基因突变引起，导致脂肪醇代谢缺陷。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Sjogren-Larsson Syndrome" scope note C17.800.428.435 Keratoderma, Palmoplantar 掌跖角化病 "Group of mostly hereditary disorders characterized by thickening of the palms and soles as a result of excessive keratin formation leading to hypertrophy of the stratum corneum (hyperkeratosis)." 一组大多为遗传性的疾病，特征为手掌和足底增厚，原因是角蛋白形成过多，导致角质层肥厚（角化过度）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Keratoderma, Palmoplantar" scope note C17.800.428.435.440 Keratoderma, Palmoplantar, Diffuse 弥漫性掌跖角化病 "An autosomal dominant disorder characterized by a widely distributed, well-demarcated hyperkeratosis of the palms and soles. There is more than one genotypically distinct form, each of which is clinically similar but histologically distinguishable. Diffuse palmoplantar keratoderma is distinct from palmoplantar keratoderma (KERATODERMA, PALMOPLANTAR), as the former exhibits autosomal dominant inheritance and hyperhidrosis is frequently present." 一种常染色体显性遗传病，特征为广泛分布、边界清楚的掌跖角化过度。存在不止一种基因型不同的类型，各型临床相似但组织学上可区分。弥漫性掌跖角化病不同于掌跖角化病（KERATODERMA, PALMOPLANTAR），前者呈常染色体显性遗传，且常伴多汗。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Keratoderma, Palmoplantar, Diffuse" scope note C17.800.428.435.440.500 Keratoderma, Palmoplantar, Epidermolytic 表皮松解性掌跖角化病 "An autosomal dominant hereditary skin disease characterized by epidermolytic hyperkeratosis that is strictly confined to the palms and soles. It has been associated with mutations in the gene that codes for KERATIN-9." 一种常染色体显性遗传性皮肤病，特征为严格局限于手掌和足底的表皮松解性角化过度。与编码角蛋白-9（KERATIN-9）的基因突变相关。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Keratoderma, Palmoplantar, Epidermolytic" scope note C17.800.428.435.600 Papillon-Lefevre Disease 掌跖角化-牙周破坏综合征 "Rare, autosomal recessive disorder occurring between the first and fifth years of life. It is characterized by palmoplantar keratoderma with periodontitis followed by the premature shedding of both deciduous and permanent teeth. Mutations in the gene for CATHEPSIN C have been associated with this disease." 一种罕见的常染色体隐性疾病，发生于 1 至 5 岁之间。特征为掌跖角皮病伴牙周炎，随后乳牙和恒牙均过早脱落。组织蛋白酶 C（CATHEPSIN C）基因突变与该病相关。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Papillon-Lefevre Disease" scope note C17.800.428.570 Keratosis, Actinic 光线性角化病 "White or pink lesions on the arms, hands, face, or scalp that arise from sun-induced DNA DAMAGE to KERATINOCYTES in exposed areas. They are considered precursor lesions to superficial SQUAMOUS CELL CARCINOMA." 手臂、手、面部或头皮上的白色或粉红色皮损，源于暴露部位日光诱导的角质形成细胞（KERATINOCYTES）DNA 损伤（DNA DAMAGE）。它们被视为浅表鳞状细胞癌（SQUAMOUS CELL CARCINOMA）的癌前病变。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Keratosis, Actinic" scope note C17.800.428.580 Keratosis, Seborrheic 脂溢性角化病 "Benign eccrine poromas that present as multiple oval, brown-to-black plaques, located mostly on the chest and back. The age of onset is usually in the fourth or fifth decade." 良性外泌汗腺汗孔瘤，表现为多发卵圆形、棕色至黑色斑块，主要位于胸部和背部。发病年龄通常在四十或五十多岁。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Keratosis, Seborrheic" scope note C17.800.428.736 Parakeratosis 角化不全 "Persistence of the nuclei of the keratinocytes into the stratum corneum of the skin. This is a normal state only in the epithelium of true mucous membranes in the mouth and vagina. (Dorland, 27th ed)" 角质形成细胞的细胞核残留至皮肤角质层。这仅在口腔和阴道真正黏膜的上皮中属正常状态。（Dorland，第 27 版） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Parakeratosis" scope note C17.800.428.750 Porokeratosis 汗孔角化症 "A heritable disorder of faulty keratinization characterized by the proliferation of abnormal clones of KERATINOCYTES and lesions showing varying atrophic patches surrounded by an elevated, keratotic border. These keratotic lesions can progress to overt cutaneous neoplasm. Several clinical variants are recognized, including porokeratosis of Mibelli, linear porokeratosis, disseminated superficial actinic porokeratosis, palmoplantar porokeratosis, and punctate porokeratosis." 一种遗传性角化异常疾病，特征为角质形成细胞（KERATINOCYTES）异常克隆增生，皮损表现为不同的萎缩性斑片，周围有隆起的角化性边缘。这些角化性皮损可进展为明显的皮肤肿瘤。已知若干临床变异型，包括 Mibelli 汗孔角化症、线状汗孔角化症、播散性浅表性光线性汗孔角化症、掌跖汗孔角化症和点状汗孔角化症。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Porokeratosis" scope note References National Library of Medicine. (2026). MeSH 2026 descriptor records [Data set]. Retrieved October 28, 2026, from https://www.nlm.nih.gov/databases/download/mesh.html

medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.title: C17.800.463 Lipomatosis | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.summary: C17.800.463 Lipomatosis Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source C17.800.463 Lipomatosis 脂肪过多症 "A disorder characterized by the accumulation of encapsulated or unencapsulated tumor-like fatty tissue resembling LIPOMA." 一种疾病，其特征为类似脂肪瘤（LIPOMA）的有包膜或无包膜的肿瘤样脂肪组织蓄积。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Lipomatosis" scope note C17.800.463.249 Adiposis Dolorosa 痛性肥胖病 "A rare disease characterized by multiple tumor-like fatty deposits that press on nerves in various sites causing pain and weakness. Often these lipoma-like structures are located on the trunk and limbs but not on the face and hands." 一种罕见疾病，特征为多发的瘤样脂肪沉积压迫神经，在多个部位引起疼痛和无力。这些脂肪瘤样结构常位于躯干和四肢，而不见于面部和手部。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Adiposis Dolorosa" scope note C17.800.463.375 Familial Multiple Lipomatosis 家族性多发性脂肪瘤病 "A rare autosomal disorder characterized by numerous encapsulated lipomas on the trunk and extremities. The lipomas are usually not painful but can cause pain when growing. In rare cases, one lipoma can become painful and progress to multiple painful lipomas; it is then referred to as Dercum's Disease Type III" 一种罕见的常染色体疾病，特征为躯干和四肢多发的有包膜脂肪瘤。脂肪瘤通常不痛，但生长时可引起疼痛。少数情况下，一个脂肪瘤可变得疼痛并进展为多发性痛性脂肪瘤，此时称为 III 型 Dercum 病 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Familial Multiple Lipomatosis" scope note C17.800.463.500 Lipomatosis, Multiple Symmetrical 多发性对称性脂肪瘤病 "A condition characterized by the growth of unencapsulated masses of ADIPOSE TISSUE symmetrically deposited around the neck, shoulders, or other sites around the body." 一种病症，特征为无包膜的脂肪组织（ADIPOSE TISSUE）团块对称沉积于颈部、肩部或身体其他部位周围。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Lipomatosis, Multiple Symmetrical" scope note References National Library of Medicine. (2026). MeSH 2026 descriptor records [Data set]. Retrieved October 28, 2026, from https://www.nlm.nih.gov/databases/download/mesh.html

medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.title: C17.800.480 Lupus Erythematosus, Cutaneous | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.summary: C17.800.480 Lupus Erythematosus, Cutaneous Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source C17.800.480 Lupus Erythematosus, Cutaneous 皮肤型红斑狼疮 "A form of lupus erythematosus in which the skin may be the only organ involved or in which skin involvement precedes the spread into other body systems. It has been classified into three forms - acute (= LUPUS ERYTHEMATOSUS, SYSTEMIC with skin lesions), subacute, and chronic (= LUPUS ERYTHEMATOSUS, DISCOID)." 红斑狼疮的一种类型，其中皮肤可能是唯一受累的器官，或皮肤受累先于向其他身体系统的扩散。分为三型：急性（即伴有皮肤病变的系统性红斑狼疮（LUPUS ERYTHEMATOSUS, SYSTEMIC））、亚急性和慢性（即盘状红斑狼疮（LUPUS ERYTHEMATOSUS, DISCOID））。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Lupus Erythematosus, Cutaneous" scope note C17.800.480.479 Lupus Erythematosus, Discoid 盘状红斑狼疮 "A chronic form of cutaneous lupus erythematosus (LUPUS ERYTHEMATOSUS, CUTANEOUS) in which the skin lesions mimic those of the systemic form but in which systemic signs are rare. It is characterized by the presence of discoid skin plaques showing varying degrees of edema, erythema, scaliness, follicular plugging, and skin atrophy. Lesions are surrounded by an elevated erythematous border. The condition typically involves the face and scalp, but widespread dissemination may occur." 一种皮肤型红斑狼疮的慢性类型（LUPUS ERYTHEMATOSUS, CUTANEOUS），其皮损类似系统型，但全身征象少见。其特征为出现盘状皮肤斑块，表现不同程度的水肿、红斑、鳞屑、毛囊角栓和皮肤萎缩。皮损周围有隆起的红斑性边缘。本病通常累及面部和头皮，但也可广泛播散。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Lupus Erythematosus, Discoid" scope note C17.800.480.479.400 Panniculitis, Lupus Erythematosus 狼疮性脂膜炎 "A type of lupus erythematosus characterized by deep dermal or subcutaneous nodules, most often on the head, face, or upper arms. It is generally chronic and occurs most often in women between the ages of 20 and 45." 一种红斑狼疮，特征为真皮深层或皮下结节，最常见于头部、面部或上臂。通常呈慢性，最常发生于 20 至 45 岁的女性。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Panniculitis, Lupus Erythematosus" scope note References National Library of Medicine. (2026). MeSH 2026 descriptor records [Data set]. Retrieved October 28, 2026, from https://www.nlm.nih.gov/databases/download/mesh.html

medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.summary: C17.800.518 Morgellons Disease Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source C17.800.518 Morgellons Disease 莫吉隆斯病 "An unexplained illness which is characterized by skin manifestations including non-healing lesions, itching, and the appearance of fibers." 一种不明原因的疾病，特征为皮肤表现，包括不愈合的损害、瘙痒以及纤维出现。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Morgellons Disease" scope note References National Library of Medicine. medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.title: C17.800.529 Nail Diseases | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.summary: C17.800.529 Nail Diseases Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source C17.800.529 Nail Diseases 甲疾病 "Diseases of the nail plate and tissues surrounding it. The concept is limited to primates." 甲板及其周围组织的疾病。该概念限于灵长类。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Nail Diseases" scope note C17.800.529.400 Nail-Patella Syndrome 甲髌综合征 "A syndrome of multiple abnormalities characterized by the absence or hypoplasia of the PATELLA and congenital nail dystrophy. It is a genetically determined autosomal dominant trait." 一种多发异常的综合征，特征为髌骨（PATELLA）缺如或发育不全以及先天性甲营养不良。它是一种由遗传决定的常染色体显性性状。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Nail-Patella Syndrome" scope note C17.800.529.406 Nails, Ingrown 嵌甲 "Excessive lateral nail growth into the nail fold. Because the lateral margin of the nail acts as a foreign body, inflammation and granulation may result. It is caused by improperly fitting shoes and by improper trimming of the nail." 指（趾）甲侧缘过度长入甲襞。由于甲侧缘起到异物作用，可导致炎症和肉芽形成。由鞋不合脚及修甲不当引起。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Nails, Ingrown" scope note C17.800.529.478 Onycholysis 甲剥离 "Separation of nail plate from the underlying nail bed. It can be a sign of skin disease, infection (such as ONYCHOMYCOSIS) or tissue injury." 甲板与其下方甲床的分离。可为皮肤病、感染（如甲真菌病（ONYCHOMYCOSIS））或组织损伤的征象。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Onycholysis" scope note C17.800.529.550 Onychomycosis 甲真菌病 "A fungal infection of the nail, usually caused by DERMATOPHYTES; YEASTS; or nondermatophyte MOLDS." 甲的真菌感染，通常由皮肤癣菌（DERMATOPHYTES）、酵母菌（YEASTS）或非皮肤癣菌霉菌（MOLDS）引起。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Onychomycosis" scope note C17.800.529.594 Pachyonychia Congenita 先天性厚甲 "A group of inherited ectodermal dysplasias whose most prominent clinical feature is hypertrophic nail dystrophy resulting in PACHYONYCHIA. Several specific subtypes of pachyonychia congenita have been associated with mutations in genes that encode KERATINS." 一组遗传性外胚层发育不良，最突出的临床特征是导致厚甲（PACHYONYCHIA）的肥厚性甲营养不良。先天性厚甲的若干特定亚型与编码角蛋白（KERATINS）的基因突变相关。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Pachyonychia Congenita" scope note C17.800.529.594.500 Steatocystoma Multiplex 多发性脂囊瘤 "A disorder characterized by multiple, wide spread cutaneous cysts that often become inflamed and rupture. It is caused by the same mutations in the gene coding for KRT-17 that are causative mutations for Pachyonychia congenita, Type 2. Natal teeth involvement is sometimes associated with steatocystoma multiplex." 一种以多发、广泛分布的皮肤囊肿为特征的疾病，这些囊肿常发炎和破裂。它由编码 KRT-17 的基因突变引起，这些突变与 2 型先天性厚甲症的致病突变相同。多发性脂囊瘤有时伴有胎生牙。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Steatocystoma Multiplex" scope note C17.800.529.639 Paronychia 甲沟炎 "An inflammatory reaction involving the folds of the skin surrounding the fingernail. It is characterized by acute or chronic purulent, tender, and painful swellings of the tissues around the nail, caused by an abscess of the nail fold. The pathogenic yeast causing paronychia is most frequently Candida albicans. Saprophytic fungi may also be involved. The causative bacteria are usually Staphylococcus, Pseudomonas aeruginosa, or Streptococcus. (Andrews' Diseases of the Skin, 8th ed, p271)" 一种累及指甲周围皮肤皱襞的炎症反应。特征为甲周组织急性或慢性的化脓性、触痛性和疼痛性肿胀，由甲襞脓肿所致。引起甲沟炎的致病酵母菌最常为白念珠菌，也可有腐生真菌参与。致病细菌通常为葡萄球菌、铜绿假单胞菌或链球菌。（《Andrews 皮肤病学》，第 8 版，第 271 页） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Paronychia" scope note C17.800.529.819 Yellow Nail Syndrome 黄甲综合征 "A rare condition characterized by the presence of yellow nails, LYMPHEDEMA, and/or PLEURAL EFFUSION with respiratory tract involvement. Abnormal lymphatic network may play a role in its etiology. Occasionally inherited, yellow nail syndrome mostly is sporadic without apparent family history." 一种罕见病症，特征为出现黄甲、淋巴水肿（LYMPHEDEMA）和（或）胸腔积液（PLEURAL EFFUSION），伴呼吸道受累。异常的淋巴网络可能在其病因中起作用。黄甲综合征偶有遗传，多数为散发且无明显家族史。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Yellow Nail Syndrome" scope note References National Library of Medicine. (2026). MeSH 2026 descriptor records [Data set]. Retrieved October 28, 2026, from https://www.nlm.nih.gov/databases/download/mesh.html

medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.title: C17.800.550 Necrobiotic Disorders | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.summary: C17.800.550 Necrobiotic Disorders Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source C17.800.550 Necrobiotic Disorders 渐进性坏死性疾病 "A group of disorders characterized by swelling, basophilia, and distortion of collagen bundles in the dermis." 一组疾病，其特征为真皮内胶原束的肿胀、嗜碱性变和扭曲。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Necrobiotic Disorders" scope note C17.800.550.380 Granuloma Annulare 环状肉芽肿 "Benign granulomatous disease of unknown etiology characterized by a ring of localized or disseminated papules or nodules on the skin and palisading histiocytes surrounding necrobiotic tissue resulting from altered collagen structures." 一种病因不明的良性肉芽肿性疾病，特征为皮肤上出现局限性或播散性丘疹或结节组成的环，以及栅栏状排列的组织细胞包绕渐进性坏死组织，后者源于胶原结构的改变。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Granuloma Annulare" scope note C17.800.550.545 Necrobiosis Lipoidica 类脂质渐进性坏死 "A degenerative disease of the dermal connective tissue characterized by the development of erythematous papules or nodules in the pretibial area. The papules form plaques covered with telangiectatic vessels. More than half of the affected patients have diabetes." 一种真皮结缔组织的变性疾病，特征为胫前区出现红斑性丘疹或结节。丘疹融合成斑块，表面覆有毛细血管扩张的血管。半数以上患者患有糖尿病。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Necrobiosis Lipoidica" scope note C17.800.550.772 Necrobiotic Xanthogranuloma 坏死性黄色肉芽肿 "A cutaneous necrobiotic disorder characterized by firm, yellow plaques or nodules, often in a periorbital distribution. It is often accompanied by an elevated ERYTHROCYTE SEDIMENTATION RATE; LEUKOPENIA; and MONOCLONAL GAMMOPATHY (IgG-kappa type) and systemic involvement." 一种皮肤渐进性坏死性疾病，特征为质硬的黄色斑块或结节，常分布于眶周。常伴有红细胞沉降率（ERYTHROCYTE SEDIMENTATION RATE）升高、白细胞减少症（LEUKOPENIA）、单克隆丙种球蛋白病（MONOCLONAL GAMMOPATHY）（IgG-kappa 型）及全身受累。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Necrobiotic Xanthogranuloma" scope note References National Library of Medicine. (2026). MeSH 2026 descriptor records [Data set]. Retrieved October 28, 2026, from https://www.nlm.nih.gov/databases/download/mesh.html

medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.title: C17.800.551 Necrolytic Migratory Erythema | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.summary: C17.800.551 Necrolytic Migratory Erythema Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source C17.800.551 Necrolytic Migratory Erythema 坏死松解性游走性红斑 "Recurrent cutaneous manifestation of GLUCAGONOMA characterized by necrolytic polycyclic migratory lesions with scaling borders. It is associated with elevated secretion of GLUCAGON by the tumor. Other conditions with elevated serum glucagon levels such as HEPATIC CIRRHOSIS may also result in similar skin lesions, which are referred to as pseudoglucagonoma syndrome." 胰高血糖素瘤（GLUCAGONOMA）的复发性皮肤表现，特征为坏死松解性、多环状、游走性损害，边缘有鳞屑。它与肿瘤分泌胰高血糖素（GLUCAGON）增多相关。其他血清胰高血糖素水平升高的病症如肝硬化（HEPATIC CIRRHOSIS）也可引起类似皮肤损害，称为假性胰高血糖素瘤综合征。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Necrolytic Migratory Erythema" scope note References National Library of Medicine. (2026). MeSH 2026 descriptor records [Data set]. Retrieved October 28, 2026, from https://www.nlm.nih.gov/databases/download/mesh.html

medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.title: C17.800.553 Nephrogenic Fibrosing Dermopathy | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.summary: C17.800.553 Nephrogenic Fibrosing Dermopathy Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source C17.800.553 Nephrogenic Fibrosing Dermopathy 肾源性纤维化皮病 "A chronic, acquired, idiopathic, progressive eruption of the skin that occurs in the context of RENAL FAILURE. It is sometimes accompanied by systemic fibrosis. The pathogenesis seems to be multifactorial, with postulated involvement of circulating fibrocytes. There is a strong association between this disorder and the use of gadolinium-based contrast agents." 一种慢性、获得性、特发性、在肾衰竭（RENAL FAILURE）背景下发生的进行性皮疹。有时伴有系统性纤维化。其发病机制似为多因素，推测与循环纤维细胞有关。本病与使用钆基造影剂之间存在密切关联。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Nephrogenic Fibrosing Dermopathy" scope note References National Library of Medicine. medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.title: C17.800.566 Panniculitis | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.summary: C17.800.566 Panniculitis Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source C17.800.566 Panniculitis 脂膜炎 "General term for inflammation of adipose tissue, usually of the skin, characterized by reddened subcutaneous nodules." 脂肪组织炎症的总称，通常发生于皮肤，特征为发红的皮下结节。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Panniculitis" scope note C17.800.566.329 Erythema Induratum 硬红斑 "A type of panniculitis characterized histologically by the presence of granulomas, vasculitis, and necrosis. It is traditionally considered to be the tuberculous counterpart of nodular vasculitis, but is now known to occur without tuberculous precedent. It is seen most commonly in adolescent and menopausal women, is initiated or exacerbated by cold weather, and typically presents as one or more recurrent erythrocyanotic nodules or plaques on the calves. The nodules may progress to form indurations, ulcerations, and scars." 一种脂膜炎，组织学特征为存在肉芽肿、血管炎和坏死。传统上认为它是结节性血管炎的结核性对应病，但现已知其可在无结核前驱的情况下发生。最常见于青春期和绝经期女性，由寒冷天气诱发或加重，典型表现为小腿上一个或多个复发性红绀色结节或斑块。结节可进展形成硬结、溃疡和瘢痕。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Erythema Induratum" scope note C17.800.566.400 Panniculitis, Lupus Erythematosus 狼疮性脂膜炎 "A type of lupus erythematosus characterized by deep dermal or subcutaneous nodules, most often on the head, face, or upper arms. It is generally chronic and occurs most often in women between the ages of 20 and 45." 一种红斑狼疮，特征为真皮深层或皮下结节，最常见于头部、面部或上臂。通常呈慢性，最常发生于 20 至 45 岁的女性。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Panniculitis, Lupus Erythematosus" scope note C17.800.566.500 Panniculitis, Nodular Nonsuppurative 结节性非化脓性脂膜炎 "A form of panniculitis characterized by recurrent episodes of fever accompanied by the eruption of single or multiple erythematous subcutaneous nodules on the lower extremities. They normally resolve, but tend to leave depressions in the skin. The condition is most often seen in women, alone or in association with other disorders." 一种脂膜炎，其特征为反复发热，伴下肢出现单发或多发的红斑性皮下结节。结节通常会消退，但往往在皮肤上留下凹陷。本病最常见于女性，可单独发生或与其他疾病相关。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Panniculitis, Nodular Nonsuppurative" scope note References National Library of Medicine. (2026). MeSH 2026 descriptor records [Data set]. Retrieved October 28, 2026, from https://www.nlm.nih.gov/databases/download/mesh.html

medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.title: C17.800.600 Photosensitivity Disorders | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.summary: C17.800.600 Photosensitivity Disorders Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source C17.800.600 Photosensitivity Disorders 光敏性疾病 "Abnormal responses to sunlight or artificial light due to extreme reactivity of light-absorbing molecules in tissues. It refers almost exclusively to skin photosensitivity, including sunburn, reactions due to repeated prolonged exposure in the absence of photosensitizing factors, and reactions requiring photosensitizing factors such as photosensitizing agents and certain diseases. With restricted reference to skin tissue, it does not include photosensitivity of the eye to light, as in photophobia or photosensitive epilepsy." 对日光或人工光的异常反应，由组织中吸光分子的极端反应性所致。它几乎专指皮肤光敏性，包括晒伤、无光敏因素时反复长时间暴露引起的反应，以及需要光敏因素（如光敏剂和某些疾病）的反应。由于仅限于皮肤组织，它不包括眼对光的光敏性，如畏光或光敏性癫痫。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Photosensitivity Disorders" scope note C17.800.600.325 Dermatitis, Photoallergic 光变应性皮炎 "A delayed hypersensitivity involving the reaction between sunlight or other radiant energy source and a chemical substance to which the individual has been previously exposed and sensitized. It manifests as a papulovesicular, eczematous, or exudative dermatitis occurring chiefly on the light-exposed areas of the skin." 一种迟发型超敏反应，涉及日光或其他辐射能源与化学物质之间的反应，个体此前已接触该化学物质并致敏。表现为丘疹水疱性、湿疹样或渗出性皮炎，主要发生于皮肤的曝光部位。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Dermatitis, Photoallergic" scope note C17.800.600.335 Dermatitis, Phototoxic 光毒性皮炎 "A nonimmunologic, chemically induced type of photosensitivity producing a sometimes vesiculating dermatitis. It results in hyperpigmentation and desquamation of the light-exposed areas of the skin." 一种非免疫性、化学诱发的光敏感类型，可产生有时伴水疱的皮炎。导致皮肤曝光部位色素沉着过度和脱屑。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Dermatitis, Phototoxic" scope note C17.800.600.425 Hydroa Vacciniforme 种痘样水疱病 "A vesicular and bullous eruption having a tendency to recur in summer during childhood and commonly appearing on sun-exposed skin. The lesions are surrounded by an erythematous zone and resemble a vaccination. (From Dorland, 27th ed)" 一种水疱和大疱性皮疹，儿童期易在夏季复发，常见于日光暴露部位皮肤。皮损周围有红斑带，形似种痘。（引自 Dorland，第 27 版） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Hydroa Vacciniforme" scope note C17.800.600.725 Sunburn 晒伤 "An injury to the skin causing erythema, tenderness, and sometimes blistering and resulting from excessive exposure to the sun. The reaction is produced by the ultraviolet radiation in sunlight." 一种皮肤损伤，引起红斑、触痛，有时起疱，由过度日晒所致。该反应由日光中的紫外线辐射引起。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Sunburn" scope note C17.800.600.825 Urticaria, Solar 日光性荨麻疹 "Chromophore-dependent photodermatosis triggered by UV and visible light." 由紫外线和可见光诱发的依赖发色团的光照性皮肤病。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Urticaria, Solar" scope note C17.800.600.925 Xeroderma Pigmentosum 着色性干皮病 "A rare, pigmentary, and atrophic autosomal recessive disease. It is manifested as an extreme photosensitivity to ULTRAVIOLET RAYS as the result of a deficiency in the enzyme that permits excisional repair of ultraviolet-damaged DNA." 一种罕见的色素性、萎缩性常染色体隐性遗传病。表现为对紫外线（ULTRAVIOLET RAYS）极度光敏，其原因是缺乏能够对紫外线损伤的 DNA 进行切除修复的酶。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Xeroderma Pigmentosum" scope note References National Library of Medicine. (2026). MeSH 2026 descriptor records [Data set]. Retrieved October 28, 2026, from https://www.nlm.nih.gov/databases/download/mesh.html

medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.title: C17.800.621 Pigmentation Disorders | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.summary: C17.800.621 Pigmentation Disorders Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source C17.800.621 Pigmentation Disorders 色素沉着障碍 "Diseases affecting PIGMENTATION, including SKIN PIGMENTATION." 影响色素沉着（PIGMENTATION）的疾病，包括皮肤色素沉着（SKIN PIGMENTATION）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Pigmentation Disorders" scope note C17.800.621.166 Argyria 银质沉着症 "A permanent ashen-gray discoloration of the skin, conjunctiva, and internal organs resulting from long-continued use of silver salts. (Dorland, 27th ed)" 皮肤、结膜和内脏器官的永久性灰蓝色变色，由长期使用银盐所致。（Dorland，第 27 版） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Argyria" scope note C17.800.621.250 Cafe-au-Lait Spots 咖啡牛奶斑 "Light brown pigmented macules associated with NEUROFIBROMATOSIS and Albright's syndrome (see FIBROUS DYSPLASIA, POLYOSTOTIC)." 浅褐色色素斑，与神经纤维瘤病（NEUROFIBROMATOSIS）及 Albright 综合征（见 FIBROUS DYSPLASIA, POLYOSTOTIC）相关。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Cafe-au-Lait Spots" scope note C17.800.621.340 Cronkhite-Canada Syndrome Cronkhite-Canada 综合征 "A nonfamilial polyposis syndrome that is characterized by the presence of diffuse gastrointestinal polyposis, skin hyperpigmentation, ALOPECIA; DIARRHEA, and PROTEIN-LOSING ENTEROPATHY. It was first reported by Cronkhite and Canada in 1955." 一种非家族性息肉病综合征，特征为存在弥漫性胃肠道息肉病、皮肤色素沉着、脱发（ALOPECIA）、腹泻（DIARRHEA）和蛋白丢失性肠病（PROTEIN-LOSING ENTEROPATHY）。由 Cronkhite 和 Canada 于 1955 年首次报道。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Cronkhite-Canada Syndrome" scope note C17.800.621.430 Hyperpigmentation 色素沉着过度 "Excessive pigmentation of the skin, usually as a result of increased epidermal or dermal melanin pigmentation, hypermelanosis. Hyperpigmentation can be localized or generalized. The condition may arise from exposure to light, chemicals or other substances, or from a primary metabolic imbalance." 皮肤色素过度沉着，通常是表皮或真皮黑色素沉着增加（黑色素沉着过度）的结果。色素沉着过度可为局限性或泛发性。可因暴露于光、化学品或其他物质，或因原发性代谢失衡而发生。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Hyperpigmentation" scope note C17.800.621.430.530 Melanosis 黑变病 "Disorders of increased melanin pigmentation that develop without preceding inflammatory disease." 在无先前炎症性疾病情况下发生的黑色素沉着增加的疾病。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Melanosis" scope note C17.800.621.430.530.100 Acanthosis Nigricans 黑棘皮病 "A circumscribed melanosis consisting of a brown-pigmented, velvety verrucosity or fine papillomatosis appearing in the axillae and other body folds. It occurs in association with endocrine disorders, underlying malignancy, administration of certain drugs, or as in inherited disorder." 一种局限性黑变病，表现为棕色色素沉着的天鹅绒样疣状增生或细小乳头瘤样增生，出现于腋窝和其他身体皱褶处。它伴发于内分泌疾病、潜在恶性肿瘤、某些药物的使用，或作为遗传性疾病出现。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Acanthosis Nigricans" scope note C17.800.621.430.530.550 Lentigo 雀斑样痣 "Small circumscribed melanoses resembling, but differing histologically from, freckles. The concept includes senile lentigo ('liver spots') and nevoid lentigo (nevus spilus, lentigo simplex) and may also occur in association with multiple congenital defects or congenital syndromes (e.g., Peutz-Jeghers syndrome)." 小的局限性黑变病，外观类似雀斑但组织学上不同。本概念包括老年性雀斑样痣（“肝斑”）和痣样雀斑样痣（斑痣、单纯性雀斑样痣），也可伴发于多种先天性缺陷或先天性综合征（如 Peutz-Jeghers 综合征）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Lentigo" scope note C17.800.621.430.530.550.525 LEOPARD Syndrome LEOPARD 综合征 "An autosomal dominant disorder with an acronym of its seven features (LENTIGO; ELECTROCARDIOGRAM abnormalities; ocular HYPERTELORISM; PULMONARY STENOSIS; abnormal genitalia; retardation of growth; and DEAFNESS or SENSORINEURAL HEARING LOSS). This syndrome is caused by mutations of PTPN11 gene encoding the non-receptor PROTEIN TYROSINE PHOSPHATASE, type 11, and is an allelic to NOONAN SYNDROME. Features of LEOPARD syndrome overlap with those of NEUROFIBROMATOSIS 1 which is caused by mutations in the NEUROFIBROMATOSIS 1 GENES." 一种常染色体显性疾病，其名称为七个特征的首字母缩写（雀斑样痣（LENTIGO）；心电图（ELECTROCARDIOGRAM）异常；眼距过宽（HYPERTELORISM）；肺动脉狭窄（PULMONARY STENOSIS）；生殖器异常；生长迟缓；以及耳聋（DEAFNESS）或感音神经性听力损失（SENSORINEURAL HEARING LOSS））。该综合征由编码 11 型非受体蛋白酪氨酸磷酸酶（PROTEIN TYROSINE PHOSPHATASE）的 PTPN11 基因突变引起，与努南综合征（NOONAN SYNDROME）为等位基因病。LEOPARD 综合征的特征与神经纤维瘤病 1 型（NEUROFIBROMATOSIS 1）重叠，后者由神经纤维瘤病 1 型基因（NEUROFIBROMATOSIS 1 GENES）突变引起。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "LEOPARD Syndrome" scope note C17.800.621.430.530.550.625 Peutz-Jeghers Syndrome 波伊茨-耶格综合征 "A hereditary disease caused by autosomal dominant mutations involving CHROMOSOME 19. It is characterized by the presence of INTESTINAL POLYPS, consistently in the JEJUNUM, and mucocutaneous pigmentation with MELANIN spots of the lips, buccal MUCOSA, and digits." 一种由涉及 19 号染色体（CHROMOSOME 19）的常染色体显性突变引起的遗传病。其特征为存在肠息肉（INTESTINAL POLYPS），恒定见于空肠（JEJUNUM），以及唇、颊黏膜（MUCOSA）和指（趾）的含黑色素（MELANIN）斑点的皮肤黏膜色素沉着。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Peutz-Jeghers Syndrome" scope note C17.800.621.440 Hypopigmentation 色素减退 "A condition caused by a deficiency or a loss of melanin pigmentation in the epidermis, also known as hypomelanosis. Hypopigmentation can be localized or generalized, and may result from genetic defects, trauma, inflammation, or infections." 一种由表皮黑色素沉着缺乏或丧失引起的情况，又称黑色素减少症。色素减退可为局限性或泛发性，可由遗传缺陷、外伤、炎症或感染引起。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Hypopigmentation" scope note C17.800.621.440.102 Albinism 白化病 "General term for a number of inherited defects of amino acid metabolism in which there is a deficiency or absence of pigment in the eyes, skin, or hair." 多种遗传性氨基酸代谢缺陷的总称，表现为眼、皮肤或毛发中色素缺乏或缺失。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Albinism" scope note C17.800.621.440.102.090 Albinism, Ocular 眼白化病 "Albinism affecting the eye in which pigment of the hair and skin is normal or only slightly diluted. The classic type is X-linked (Nettleship-Falls), but an autosomal recessive form also exists. Ocular abnormalities may include reduced pigmentation of the iris, nystagmus, photophobia, strabismus, and decreased visual acuity." 累及眼的白化病，毛发和皮肤色素正常或仅轻度变淡。经典型为 X 连锁（Nettleship-Falls），但也存在常染色体隐性型。眼部异常可包括虹膜色素减少、眼球震颤、畏光、斜视和视力下降。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Albinism, Ocular" scope note C17.800.621.440.102.100 Albinism, Oculocutaneous 眼皮肤白化病 "Heterogeneous group of autosomal recessive disorders comprising at least four recognized types, all having in common varying degrees of hypopigmentation of the skin, hair, and eyes. The two most common are the tyrosinase-positive and tyrosinase-negative types." 一组异质性的常染色体隐性疾病，至少包括四种公认类型，共同特点是不同程度的皮肤、毛发和眼睛色素减退。最常见的两种是酪氨酸酶阳性型和酪氨酸酶阴性型。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Albinism, Oculocutaneous" scope note C17.800.621.440.102.100.400 Hermanski-Pudlak Syndrome 赫曼斯基-普德拉克综合征 "Syndrome characterized by the triad of oculocutaneous albinism (ALBINISM, OCULOCUTANEOUS); PLATELET STORAGE POOL DEFICIENCY; and lysosomal accumulation of ceroid lipofuscin." 一种综合征，其特征为眼皮肤白化病三联征（眼皮肤白化病，ALBINISM, OCULOCUTANEOUS）、血小板贮存池缺陷（PLATELET STORAGE POOL DEFICIENCY），以及溶酶体内蜡样脂褐素蓄积。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Hermanski-Pudlak Syndrome" scope note C17.800.621.440.102.600 Piebaldism 斑驳病 "Autosomal dominant, congenital disorder characterized by localized hypomelanosis of the skin and hair. The most familiar feature is a white forelock presenting in 80 to 90 percent of the patients. The underlying defect is possibly related to the differentiation and migration of melanoblasts, as well as to defective development of the neural crest (neurocristopathy). Piebaldism may be closely related to WAARDENBURG SYNDROME." 一种常染色体显性先天性疾病，特征为皮肤和毛发的局限性黑色素减少。最常见的特征是白色额发，见于 80% 至 90% 的患者。潜在缺陷可能与黑色素母细胞的分化和迁移以及神经嵴发育缺陷（神经嵴病）有关。斑驳病可能与瓦登伯格综合征（WAARDENBURG SYNDROME）密切相关。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Piebaldism" scope note C17.800.621.440.895 Vitiligo 白癜风 "A disorder consisting of areas of macular depigmentation, commonly on extensor aspects of extremities, on the face or neck, and in skin folds. Age of onset is often in young adulthood and the condition tends to progress gradually with lesions enlarging and extending until a quiescent state is reached." 一种以斑状色素脱失区为表现的疾病，常见于四肢伸侧、面部或颈部以及皮肤皱褶处。发病年龄多在青年期，病情往往逐渐进展，皮损扩大蔓延，直至进入静止状态。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Vitiligo" scope note C17.800.621.497 Incontinentia Pigmenti 色素失禁症 "A genodermatosis occurring mostly in females and characterized by skin changes in three phases - vesiculobullous, verrucous papillomatous, and macular melanodermic. Hyperpigmentation is bizarre and irregular. Sixty percent of patients have abnormalities of eyes, teeth, central nervous system, and skin appendages." 一种主要发生于女性的遗传性皮肤病，特征为皮肤改变分三期：水疱大疱期、疣状乳头瘤期和斑状黑皮期。色素沉着过度形态怪异且不规则。百分之六十的患者有眼、牙齿、中枢神经系统和皮肤附属器的异常。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Incontinentia Pigmenti" scope note C17.800.621.893 Urticaria Pigmentosa 色素性荨麻疹 "The most common form of cutaneous mastocytosis (MASTOCYTOSIS, CUTANEOUS) that occurs primarily in children. It is characterized by the multiple small reddish-brown pigmented pruritic macules and papules." 皮肤肥大细胞增多症最常见的形式（皮肤肥大细胞增多症（MASTOCYTOSIS, CUTANEOUS）），主要发生于儿童。特征为多发性小的红棕色色素性瘙痒性斑疹和丘疹。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Urticaria Pigmentosa" scope note C17.800.621.936 Xeroderma Pigmentosum 着色性干皮病 "A rare, pigmentary, and atrophic autosomal recessive disease. It is manifested as an extreme photosensitivity to ULTRAVIOLET RAYS as the result of a deficiency in the enzyme that permits excisional repair of ultraviolet-damaged DNA." 一种罕见的色素性、萎缩性常染色体隐性遗传病。表现为对紫外线（ULTRAVIOLET RAYS）极度光敏，其原因是缺乏能够对紫外线损伤的 DNA 进行切除修复的酶。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Xeroderma Pigmentosum" scope note C17.800.621.968 Yellow Nail Syndrome 黄甲综合征 "A rare condition characterized by the presence of yellow nails, LYMPHEDEMA, and/or PLEURAL EFFUSION with respiratory tract involvement. Abnormal lymphatic network may play a role in its etiology. Occasionally inherited, yellow nail syndrome mostly is sporadic without apparent family history." 一种罕见病症，特征为出现黄甲、淋巴水肿（LYMPHEDEMA）和（或）胸腔积液（PLEURAL EFFUSION），伴呼吸道受累。异常的淋巴网络可能在其病因中起作用。黄甲综合征偶有遗传，多数为散发且无明显家族史。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Yellow Nail Syndrome" scope note References National Library of Medicine. (2026). MeSH 2026 descriptor records [Data set]. Retrieved October 28, 2026, from https://www.nlm.nih.gov/databases/download/mesh.html

medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.summary: C17.800.685 Pruritus Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source C17.800.685 Pruritus 瘙痒 "An intense itching sensation that produces the urge to rub or scratch the skin to obtain relief." 一种强烈的痒感，使人产生想要摩擦或搔抓皮肤的冲动以求缓解。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Pruritus" scope note C17.800.685.544 Pruritus Ani 肛门瘙痒症 "Intense chronic itching in the anal area." 肛门区域的剧烈慢性瘙痒。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Pruritus Ani" scope note C17.800.685.710 Pruritus Vulvae 外阴瘙痒 "Intense itching of the external female genitals." 女性外生殖器的剧烈瘙痒。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Pruritus Vulvae" scope note References National Library of Medicine. medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.title: C17.800.695 Pyoderma | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.summary: C17.800.695 Pyoderma Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source C17.800.695 Pyoderma 脓皮病 "Any purulent skin disease (Dorland, 27th ed)." 任何化脓性皮肤病（Dorland，第 27 版）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Pyoderma" scope note C17.800.695.210 Ecthyma 臁疮 "An ulcerative pyoderma usually caused by group A beta-hemolytic streptococcal infection at the site of minor trauma. (Dorland, 27th ed)" 一种溃疡性脓皮病，通常由轻微外伤部位的A 组β溶血性链球菌感染引起。（Dorland，第 27 版） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Ecthyma" scope note C17.800.695.675 Pyoderma Gangrenosum 坏疽性脓皮病 "An idiopathic, rapidly evolving, and severely debilitating disease occurring most commonly in association with chronic ulcerative colitis. It is characterized by the presence of boggy, purplish ulcers with undermined borders, appearing mostly on the legs. The majority of cases are in people between 40 and 60 years old. Its etiology is unknown." 一种特发性、进展迅速且严重致衰弱的疾病，最常与慢性溃疡性结肠炎相伴发生。其特征为出现边缘潜行的松软紫色溃疡，多见于腿部。大多数病例为 40 至 60 岁的人。其病因不明。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Pyoderma Gangrenosum" scope note References National Library of Medicine. (2026). MeSH 2026 descriptor records [Data set]. Retrieved October 28, 2026, from https://www.nlm.nih.gov/databases/download/mesh.html

medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.title: C17.800.716 Rosacea | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.summary: C17.800.716 Rosacea Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source C17.800.716 Rosacea 酒渣鼻 "A cutaneous disorder primarily of convexities of the central part of the FACE, such as FOREHEAD; CHEEK; NOSE; and CHIN. It is characterized by FLUSHING; ERYTHEMA; EDEMA; RHINOPHYMA; papules; and ocular symptoms. It may occur at any age but typically after age 30. There are various subtypes of rosacea: erythematotelangiectatic, papulopustular, phymatous, and ocular (National Rosacea Society's Expert Committee on the Classification and Staging of Rosacea, J Am Acad Dermatol 2002; 46:584-7)." 一种主要累及面部（FACE）中央凸出部位的皮肤病，如前额（FOREHEAD）、面颊（CHEEK）、鼻（NOSE）和下颏（CHIN）。其特征为潮红（FLUSHING）、红斑（ERYTHEMA）、水肿（EDEMA）、鼻赘（RHINOPHYMA）、丘疹及眼部症状。可发生于任何年龄，但通常在 30 岁以后。酒渣鼻有多种亚型：红斑毛细血管扩张型、丘疹脓疱型、肥大增生型和眼型（美国国家酒渣鼻协会酒渣鼻分类与分期专家委员会，J Am Acad Dermatol 2002；46:584-7）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Rosacea" scope note C17.800.716.500 Rhinophyma 肥大性酒渣鼻 "A manifestation of severe ROSACEA resulting in significant enlargement of the NOSE and occurring primarily in men. It is caused by hypertrophy of the SEBACEOUS GLANDS and surrounding CONNECTIVE TISSUE. The nose is reddened and marked with TELANGIECTASIS." 一种重度酒渣鼻（ROSACEA）的表现，导致鼻（NOSE）显著增大，主要发生于男性。由皮脂腺（SEBACEOUS GLANDS）及周围结缔组织（CONNECTIVE TISSUE）肥大所致。鼻部发红并伴有毛细血管扩张（TELANGIECTASIS）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Rhinophyma" scope note References National Library of Medicine. (2026). MeSH 2026 descriptor records [Data set]. Retrieved October 28, 2026, from https://www.nlm.nih.gov/databases/download/mesh.html

medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.title: C17.800.738 Scalp Dermatoses | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.summary: C17.800.738 Scalp Dermatoses Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source C17.800.738 Scalp Dermatoses 头皮皮肤病 "Skin diseases involving the SCALP." 累及头皮的皮肤病（SCALP）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Scalp Dermatoses" scope note C17.800.738.353 Dandruff 头皮屑 "Excessive shedding of dry scaly material from the scalp in humans." 人类头皮过度脱落干燥鳞屑状物质。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Dandruff" scope note C17.800.738.708 Tinea Capitis 头癣 "Ringworm of the scalp and associated hair mainly caused by species of MICROSPORUM; TRICHOPHYTON; and EPIDERMOPHYTON, which may occasionally involve the eyebrows and eyelashes." 头皮及相关毛发的癣，主要由小孢子菌属（MICROSPORUM）、毛癣菌属（TRICHOPHYTON）和表皮癣菌属（EPIDERMOPHYTON）的菌种引起，偶可累及眉毛和睫毛。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Tinea Capitis" scope note C17.800.738.708.708 Tinea Favosa 黄癣 "A disease of the scalp that may affect the glabrous skin and the nails and is recognized by the concave sulfur-yellow crusts that form around loose, wiry hairs. Atrophy ensues, leaving a smooth, glossy, thin, paper-white patch. This type of disease is rare in the United States and more frequently seen in the Middle East, Africa, Southeastern Europe, and other countries bordering the Mediterranean Sea. (Arnold, Odom, and James, Andrew's Diseases of the Skin, 8th ed, p319)" 一种头皮疾病，可累及无毛皮肤和指（趾）甲，其识别特征为在松动、硬直的毛发周围形成凹陷的硫黄色痂。随后出现萎缩，留下光滑、有光泽、菲薄、纸白色的斑片。此类疾病在美国罕见，较多见于中东、非洲、东南欧及地中海沿岸其他国家。（Arnold、Odom 和 James，《Andrew's Diseases of the Skin》，第 8 版，第 319 页） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Tinea Favosa" scope note References National Library of Medicine. (2026). MeSH 2026 descriptor records [Data set]. Retrieved October 28, 2026, from https://www.nlm.nih.gov/databases/download/mesh.html

medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.title: C17.800.751 Scleredema Adultorum | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.summary: C17.800.751 Scleredema Adultorum Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source C17.800.751 Scleredema Adultorum 成人硬肿病 "A diffuse, non-pitting induration of the skin of unknown etiology that occurs most commonly in association with diabetes mellitus, predominantly in females. It typically begins on the face or head and spreads to other areas of the body, sometimes involving noncutaneous tissues. Often it is preceded by any of various infections, notably staphylococcal infections. The condition resolves spontaneously, usually within two years of onset. (From Dorland, 27th ed)" 一种病因不明的弥漫性、非凹陷性皮肤硬肿，最常与糖尿病相伴发生，以女性为主。它通常始于面部或头部，并扩展到身体其他部位，有时累及皮肤以外的组织。发病前常有各种感染，尤其是葡萄球菌感染。该病可自发消退，通常在发病后两年内。（引自 Dorland，第 27 版） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Scleredema Adultorum" scope note References National Library of Medicine. (2026). MeSH 2026 descriptor records [Data set]. Retrieved October 28, 2026, from https://www.nlm.nih.gov/databases/download/mesh.html

medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.title: C17.800.767 Scleroderma, Localized | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.summary: C17.800.767 Scleroderma, Localized Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source C17.800.767 Scleroderma, Localized 局限性硬皮病 "A term used to describe a variety of localized asymmetrical SKIN thickening that is similar to those of SYSTEMIC SCLERODERMA but without the disease features in the multiple internal organs and BLOOD VESSELS. Lesions may be characterized as patches or plaques (morphea), bands (linear), or nodules." 用于描述多种局限性不对称皮肤（SKIN）增厚的术语，类似于系统性硬皮病（SYSTEMIC SCLERODERMA）的皮肤增厚，但没有多个内脏器官和血管（BLOOD VESSELS）的病变特征。皮损可表现为斑片或斑块（硬斑病）、带状（线状）或结节。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Scleroderma, Localized" scope note References National Library of Medicine. (2026). MeSH 2026 descriptor records [Data set]. Retrieved October 28, 2026, from https://www.nlm.nih.gov/databases/download/mesh.html

medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.title: C17.800.784 Scleroderma, Systemic | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.summary: C17.800.784 Scleroderma, Systemic Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source C17.800.784 Scleroderma, Systemic 系统性硬皮病 "A chronic multi-system disorder of CONNECTIVE TISSUE. It is characterized by SCLEROSIS in the SKIN, the LUNGS, the HEART, the GASTROINTESTINAL TRACT, the KIDNEYS, and the MUSCULOSKELETAL SYSTEM. Other important features include diseased small BLOOD VESSELS and AUTOANTIBODIES. The disorder is named for its most prominent feature (hard skin), and classified into subsets by the extent of skin thickening: LIMITED SCLERODERMA and DIFFUSE SCLERODERMA." 一种结缔组织（CONNECTIVE TISSUE）的慢性多系统疾病。其特征为皮肤（SKIN）、肺（LUNGS）、心脏（HEART）、胃肠道（GASTROINTESTINAL TRACT）、肾（KIDNEYS）和肌肉骨骼系统（MUSCULOSKELETAL SYSTEM）的硬化（SCLEROSIS）。其他重要特征包括小血管（BLOOD VESSELS）病变和自身抗体（AUTOANTIBODIES）。该病以其最突出的特征（皮肤变硬）命名，并按皮肤增厚的范围分为亚型：局限性硬皮病（LIMITED SCLERODERMA）和弥漫性硬皮病（DIFFUSE SCLERODERMA）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Scleroderma, Systemic" scope note C17.800.784.602 Scleroderma, Diffuse 弥漫性硬皮病 "A rapid onset form of SYSTEMIC SCLERODERMA with progressive widespread SKIN thickening over the arms, the legs and the trunk, resulting in stiffness and disability." 一种快速起病的系统性硬皮病（SYSTEMIC SCLERODERMA）类型，伴有手臂、腿部和躯干进行性广泛的皮肤（SKIN）增厚，导致僵硬和残疾。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Scleroderma, Diffuse" scope note C17.800.784.801 Scleroderma, Limited 局限性硬皮病 "The least progressive form of SYSTEMIC SCLERODERMA with skin thickening restricted to the face, neck and areas distal to the elbows and/or knees, sparing the trunk. The CREST SYNDROME is a form of limited scleroderma." 系统性硬皮病（SYSTEMIC SCLERODERMA）进展最慢的形式，皮肤增厚局限于面部、颈部以及肘和/或膝远端区域，躯干不受累。CREST 综合征（CREST SYNDROME）是局限性硬皮病的一种形式。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Scleroderma, Limited" scope note C17.800.784.801.500 CREST Syndrome CREST 综合征 "A mild form of LIMITED SCLERODERMA, a multi-system disorder. Its features include symptoms of CALCINOSIS; RAYNAUD DISEASE; ESOPHAGEAL MOTILITY DISORDERS; sclerodactyly, and TELANGIECTASIS. When the defect in esophageal function is not prominent, it is known as CRST syndrome." 局限性硬皮病（LIMITED SCLERODERMA）的一种轻型，是一种多系统疾病。其特征包括钙质沉着（CALCINOSIS）、雷诺病（RAYNAUD DISEASE）、食管动力障碍（ESOPHAGEAL MOTILITY DISORDERS）、指端硬化和毛细血管扩张（TELANGIECTASIS）等症状。当食管功能缺陷不明显时，称为 CRST 综合征。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "CREST Syndrome" scope note References National Library of Medicine. (2026). MeSH 2026 descriptor records [Data set]. Retrieved October 28, 2026, from https://www.nlm.nih.gov/databases/download/mesh.html

medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.title: C17.800.794 Sebaceous Gland Diseases | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.summary: C17.800.794 Sebaceous Gland Diseases Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source C17.800.794 Sebaceous Gland Diseases 皮脂腺疾病 "Diseases of the sebaceous glands such as sebaceous hyperplasia and sebaceous cell carcinoma (SEBACEOUS GLAND NEOPLASMS)." 皮脂腺的疾病，如皮脂腺增生和皮脂腺细胞癌（皮脂腺肿瘤（SEBACEOUS GLAND NEOPLASMS））。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Sebaceous Gland Diseases" scope note C17.800.794.111 Acne Vulgaris 寻常痤疮 "A chronic disorder of the pilosebaceous apparatus associated with an increase in sebum secretion. It is characterized by open comedones (blackheads), closed comedones (whiteheads), and pustular nodules. The cause is unknown, but heredity and age are predisposing factors." 一种毛囊皮脂腺单位的慢性疾病，与皮脂分泌增加相关。其特征为开放性粉刺（黑头）、闭合性粉刺（白头）和脓疱性结节。病因不明，但遗传和年龄是易感因素。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Acne Vulgaris" scope note C17.800.794.111.500 Acne Conglobata 聚合性痤疮 "Severe and chronic form of acne characterized by large, burrowing abscesses associated with disfigurement." 痤疮的一种严重慢性类型，特征为大的、潜行性脓肿，并伴有毁容。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Acne Conglobata" scope note C17.800.794.230 Dermatitis, Seborrheic 脂溢性皮炎 "A chronic inflammatory disease of the skin with unknown etiology. It is characterized by moderate ERYTHEMA, dry, moist, or greasy (SEBACEOUS GLAND) scaling and yellow crusted patches on various areas, especially the scalp, that exfoliate as dandruff. Seborrheic dermatitis is common in children and adolescents with HIV INFECTIONS." 一种病因不明的慢性炎症性皮肤病。特征为中度红斑（ERYTHEMA）、干性、湿性或油腻性（皮脂腺（SEBACEOUS GLAND））鳞屑，以及身体各部位尤其是头皮上的黄色结痂斑片，后者以头皮屑形式脱落。脂溢性皮炎常见于患有 HIV 感染（HIV INFECTIONS）的儿童和青少年。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Dermatitis, Seborrheic" scope note C17.800.794.550 Mucinosis, Follicular 毛囊黏蛋白病 "A disease of the pilosebaceous unit, presenting clinically as grouped follicular papules or plaques with associated hair loss. It is caused by mucinous infiltration of tissues, and usually involving the scalp, face, and neck. It may be primary (idiopathic) or secondary to mycosis fungoides or reticulosis." 一种毛囊皮脂腺单位的疾病，临床表现为成群的毛囊性丘疹或斑块，伴脱发。由组织黏蛋白浸润引起，通常累及头皮、面部和颈部。可为原发性（特发性），或继发于蕈样肉芽肿或网状细胞增多症。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Mucinosis, Follicular" scope note C17.800.794.650 Rhinophyma 肥大性酒渣鼻 "A manifestation of severe ROSACEA resulting in significant enlargement of the NOSE and occurring primarily in men. It is caused by hypertrophy of the SEBACEOUS GLANDS and surrounding CONNECTIVE TISSUE. The nose is reddened and marked with TELANGIECTASIS." 一种重度酒渣鼻（ROSACEA）的表现，导致鼻（NOSE）显著增大，主要发生于男性。由皮脂腺（SEBACEOUS GLANDS）及周围结缔组织（CONNECTIVE TISSUE）肥大所致。鼻部发红并伴有毛细血管扩张（TELANGIECTASIS）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Rhinophyma" scope note C17.800.794.712 Sebaceous Gland Neoplasms 皮脂腺肿瘤 "New abnormal growth of tissue in the SEBACEOUS GLANDS." 皮脂腺（SEBACEOUS GLANDS）中组织的新的异常生长。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Sebaceous Gland Neoplasms" scope note C17.800.794.712.500 Muir-Torre Syndrome Muir-Torre 综合征 "A form of LYNCH SYNDROME II associated with cutaneous SEBACEOUS GLAND NEOPLASMS. Muir-Torre syndrome is also associated with other visceral malignant diseases include colorectal, endometrial, urological, and upper gastrointestinal neoplasms." 林奇综合征 II 型（LYNCH SYNDROME II）的一种形式，伴皮肤皮脂腺肿瘤（SEBACEOUS GLAND NEOPLASMS）。Muir-Torre 综合征还与其他内脏恶性疾病相关，包括结直肠、子宫内膜、泌尿系统和上消化道肿瘤。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Muir-Torre Syndrome" scope note References National Library of Medicine. (2026). MeSH 2026 descriptor records [Data set]. Retrieved October 28, 2026, from https://www.nlm.nih.gov/databases/download/mesh.html

medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.title: C17.800.804 Skin Abnormalities | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.summary: C17.800.804 Skin Abnormalities Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source C17.800.804 Skin Abnormalities 皮肤异常 "Congenital structural abnormalities of the skin." 皮肤的先天性结构异常。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Skin Abnormalities" scope note C17.800.804.066 Acrodermatitis 肢端皮炎 "Inflammation involving the skin of the extremities, especially the hands and feet. Several forms are known, some idiopathic and some hereditary. The infantile form is called Gianotti-Crosti syndrome." 累及四肢皮肤的炎症，尤其是手和足。已知有多种类型，有些为特发性，有些为遗传性。婴儿型称为 Gianotti-Crosti 综合征。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Acrodermatitis" scope note C17.800.804.108 Anetoderma 皮肤松弛症（斑状萎缩） "Benign DERMATOSIS caused by a loss of dermal ELASTIC TISSUE resulting in localized sac-like areas of flaccid skin. It can be either primary (idiopathic) or secondary to other skin conditions, PENICILLAMINE use, or premature birth." 一种良性皮肤病（DERMATOSIS），由真皮弹性组织（ELASTIC TISSUE）缺失引起，导致局部出现囊袋状的松弛皮肤区域。它可以是原发性（特发性）的，也可以继发于其他皮肤病、青霉胺（PENICILLAMINE）的使用或早产。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Anetoderma" scope note C17.800.804.150 Dyskeratosis Congenita 先天性角化不良 "A predominantly X-linked recessive syndrome characterized by a triad of reticular skin pigmentation, nail dystrophy and leukoplakia of mucous membranes. Oral and dental abnormalities may also be present. Complications are a predisposition to malignancy and bone marrow involvement with pancytopenia. (from Int J Paediatr Dent 2000 Dec;10(4):328-34) The X-linked form is also known as Zinsser-Cole-Engman syndrome and involves the gene which encodes a highly conserved protein called dyskerin." 一种主要为 X 连锁隐性遗传的综合征，特征为网状皮肤色素沉着、甲营养不良和黏膜白斑三联征。也可存在口腔和牙齿异常。并发症包括易患恶性肿瘤以及骨髓受累伴全血细胞减少。（引自 Int J Paediatr Dent 2000 Dec;10(4):328-34）X 连锁型又称 Zinsser-Cole-Engman 综合征，涉及编码一种高度保守蛋白（角化不良蛋白 dyskerin）的基因。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Dyskeratosis Congenita" scope note C17.800.804.350 Ectodermal Dysplasia 外胚层发育不良 "A group of hereditary disorders involving tissues and structures derived from the embryonic ectoderm. They are characterized by the presence of abnormalities at birth and involvement of both the epidermis and skin appendages. They are generally nonprogressive and diffuse. Various forms exist, including anhidrotic and hidrotic dysplasias, FOCAL DERMAL HYPOPLASIA, and aplasia cutis congenita." 一组累及源自胚胎外胚层的组织和结构的遗传性疾病。其特征为出生时即存在异常，并同时累及表皮和皮肤附属器。通常为非进行性且呈弥漫性。有多种类型，包括无汗型和有汗型发育不良、局灶性真皮发育不全（FOCAL DERMAL HYPOPLASIA）以及先天性皮肤发育不全。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Ectodermal Dysplasia" scope note C17.800.804.350.198 Ectodermal Dysplasia 1, Anhidrotic 无汗性外胚层发育不良 1 型 "An X-linked form of ectodermal dysplasia which results from mutations of the gene encoding ECTODYSPLASIN." 一种 X 连锁的外胚层发育不良，由编码外异蛋白（ECTODYSPLASIN）的基因突变所致。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Ectodermal Dysplasia 1, Anhidrotic" scope note C17.800.804.350.298 Ectodermal Dysplasia 3, Anhidrotic 无汗性外胚层发育不良 3 型 "An autosomal dominant form of ectodermal dysplasia which is due to mutations in the gene for the EDAR RECEPTOR." 一种常染色体显性形式的外胚层发育不良，由 EDAR 受体（EDAR RECEPTOR）基因突变引起。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Ectodermal Dysplasia 3, Anhidrotic" scope note C17.800.804.350.348 Ectodermal Dysplasia, Hypohidrotic, Autosomal Recessive 常染色体隐性少汗性外胚层发育不良 "An autosomal recessive form of ectodermal dysplasia which is due to mutations in the gene for the EDAR RECEPTOR or EDAR-ASSOCIATED DEATH DOMAIN PROTEIN." 一种常染色体隐性遗传形式的外胚层发育不良，由 EDAR 受体（EDAR RECEPTOR）或 EDAR 相关死亡结构域蛋白（EDAR-ASSOCIATED DEATH DOMAIN PROTEIN）的基因突变所致。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Ectodermal Dysplasia, Hypohidrotic, Autosomal Recessive" scope note C17.800.804.350.398 Ellis-Van Creveld Syndrome 埃利伟综合征（软骨外胚层发育不良） "Dwarfism occurring in association with defective development of skin, hair, and teeth, polydactyly, and defect of the cardiac septum. (Dorland, 27th ed)" 侏儒症，伴有皮肤、毛发和牙齿发育缺陷、多指（趾）以及心间隔缺损。（Dorland，第 27 版） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Ellis-Van Creveld Syndrome" scope note C17.800.804.350.424 Focal Dermal Hypoplasia 局灶性真皮发育不全 "A genetic skin disease characterized by hypoplasia of the dermis, herniations of fat, and hand anomalies. It is found exclusively in females and transmitted as an X-linked dominant trait." 一种遗传性皮肤病，特征为真皮发育不全、脂肪疝出及手部畸形。仅见于女性，以 X 连锁显性性状遗传。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Focal Dermal Hypoplasia" scope note C17.800.804.350.568 Focal Facial Dermal Dysplasias 局灶性面部真皮发育不良 "A heterogenous group of genetic disorders characterized by scar-like atrophic lesions on the temple region of the head including preauricular area. Location of skin defects is likely related to defects in fusion of embryonic facial prominences during development of the face. Focal facial dermal dysplasia (FFDD) is generally divided into four subtypes according to the location of the lesions and inheritance pattern: FFDD1 (Brauer syndrome); FFDD2 (Brauer-Setleis syndrome); FFDD3 (Setleis syndrome); and FFDD4. Mutations in TWIST2 Protein and/or CYP26C1 (see CYP26 FAMILY) are associated with FFDD3, and 4." 一组异质性遗传病，特征为头部颞区的瘢痕样萎缩性皮损，包括耳前区。皮肤缺损的部位可能与面部发育过程中胚胎面突融合缺陷有关。局灶性面部真皮发育不良（FFDD）一般根据皮损部位和遗传方式分为四个亚型：FFDD1（Brauer 综合征）；FFDD2（Brauer-Setleis 综合征）；FFDD3（Setleis 综合征）；以及 FFDD4。TWIST2 蛋白和（或）CYP26C1（见 CYP26 FAMILY）的突变与 FFDD3 和 4 相关。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Focal Facial Dermal Dysplasias" scope note C17.800.804.350.712 Neurocutaneous Syndromes 神经皮肤综合征 "A group of disorders characterized by ectodermal-based malformations and neoplastic growths in the skin, nervous system, and other organs." 一组疾病，特征为皮肤、神经系统和其他器官中源于外胚层的畸形和肿瘤性生长。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Neurocutaneous Syndromes" scope note C17.800.804.350.856 Pachyonychia Congenita 先天性厚甲 "A group of inherited ectodermal dysplasias whose most prominent clinical feature is hypertrophic nail dystrophy resulting in PACHYONYCHIA. Several specific subtypes of pachyonychia congenita have been associated with mutations in genes that encode KERATINS." 一组遗传性外胚层发育不良，最突出的临床特征是导致厚甲（PACHYONYCHIA）的肥厚性甲营养不良。先天性厚甲的若干特定亚型与编码角蛋白（KERATINS）的基因突变相关。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Pachyonychia Congenita" scope note C17.800.804.350.856.500 Steatocystoma Multiplex 多发性脂囊瘤 "A disorder characterized by multiple, wide spread cutaneous cysts that often become inflamed and rupture. It is caused by the same mutations in the gene coding for KRT-17 that are causative mutations for Pachyonychia congenita, Type 2. Natal teeth involvement is sometimes associated with steatocystoma multiplex." 一种以多发、广泛分布的皮肤囊肿为特征的疾病，这些囊肿常发炎和破裂。它由编码 KRT-17 的基因突变引起，这些突变与 2 型先天性厚甲症的致病突变相同。多发性脂囊瘤有时伴有胎生牙。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Steatocystoma Multiplex" scope note C17.800.804.428 Ehlers-Danlos Syndrome 埃勒斯-当洛斯综合征 "A heterogeneous group of autosomally inherited COLLAGEN DISEASES caused by defects in the synthesis or structure of FIBRILLAR COLLAGEN. There are numerous subtypes: classical, hypermobility, vascular, and others. Common clinical features include hyperextensible skin and joints, skin fragility and reduced wound healing capability." 一组异质性的常染色体遗传性胶原病（COLLAGEN DISEASES），由纤维状胶原（FIBRILLAR COLLAGEN）合成或结构缺陷所致。有众多亚型：经典型、过度活动型、血管型及其他。常见临床特征包括皮肤和关节过度伸展、皮肤脆弱以及伤口愈合能力降低。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Ehlers-Danlos Syndrome" scope note C17.800.804.428.500 Ehlers-Danlos Syndrome, Type IV 埃勒斯-当洛综合征IV型（血管型） "A subtype of Ehlers-Danlos syndrome (EDS) characterized by vascular pathologies, e.g., AORTIC DISSECTION in addition to common EDS findings, e.g., hyperextensible skin and joints, skin fragility and reduced wound healing capability. It is associated with mutations in collagen type III alpha 1 chain gene (COLLAGEN TYPE III)." 埃勒斯-当洛综合征（EDS）的一个亚型，除常见的 EDS 表现（如皮肤和关节过度伸展、皮肤脆弱及伤口愈合能力下降）外，还以血管病变为特征，如主动脉夹层（AORTIC DISSECTION）。它与III 型胶原 α1 链基因（COLLAGEN TYPE III）的突变有关。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Ehlers-Danlos Syndrome, Type IV" scope note C17.800.804.493 Epidermolysis Bullosa 大疱性表皮松解症 "Group of genetically determined disorders characterized by the blistering of skin and mucosae. There are four major forms: acquired, simple, junctional, and dystrophic. Each of the latter three has several varieties." 一组遗传决定的疾病，其特征为皮肤和黏膜起疱。有四种主要类型：获得性、单纯型、交界型和营养不良型。后三者各有若干变型。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Epidermolysis Bullosa" scope note C17.800.804.493.080 Epidermolysis Bullosa Acquisita 获得性大疱性表皮松解症 "Form of epidermolysis bullosa characterized by trauma-induced, subepidermal blistering with no family history of the disease. Direct immunofluorescence shows IMMUNOGLOBULIN G deposited at the dermo-epidermal junction." 大疱性表皮松解症的一种类型，特征为外伤诱发的表皮下水疱，且无该病家族史。直接免疫荧光显示免疫球蛋白 G（IMMUNOGLOBULIN G）沉积于真皮表皮交界处。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Epidermolysis Bullosa Acquisita" scope note C17.800.804.493.160 Epidermolysis Bullosa Dystrophica 营养不良型大疱性表皮松解症 "Form of epidermolysis bullosa characterized by atrophy of blistered areas, severe scarring, and nail changes. It is most often present at birth or in early infancy and occurs in both autosomal dominant and recessive forms. All forms of dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa result from mutations in COLLAGEN TYPE VII, a major component fibrils of BASEMENT MEMBRANE and EPIDERMIS." 大疱性表皮松解症的一种类型，特征为水疱区萎缩、严重瘢痕形成及甲改变。多于出生时或婴儿早期出现，有常染色体显性和隐性两种遗传形式。所有营养不良型大疱性表皮松解症均由 VII 型胶原（COLLAGEN TYPE VII）突变所致，VII 型胶原是基底膜（BASEMENT MEMBRANE）和表皮（EPIDERMIS）纤维的主要成分。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Epidermolysis Bullosa Dystrophica" scope note C17.800.804.493.170 Epidermolysis Bullosa, Junctional 交界型大疱性表皮松解症 "Form of epidermolysis bullosa having onset at birth or during the neonatal period and transmitted through autosomal recessive inheritance. It is characterized by generalized blister formation, extensive denudation, and separation and cleavage of the basal cell plasma membranes from the basement membrane." 大疱性表皮松解症的一种类型，于出生时或新生儿期发病，经常染色体隐性遗传。特征为泛发性水疱形成、大面积表皮剥脱，以及基底细胞质膜与基底膜的分离和裂开。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Epidermolysis Bullosa, Junctional" scope note C17.800.804.493.180 Epidermolysis Bullosa Simplex 单纯型大疱性表皮松解症 "A form of epidermolysis bullosa characterized by serous bullae that heal without scarring. Mutations in the genes that encode KERATIN-5 and KERATIN-14 have been associated with several subtypes of epidermolysis bullosa simplex." 一种大疱性表皮松解症，特征为愈合后不留瘢痕的浆液性大疱。编码角蛋白-5（KERATIN-5）和角蛋白-14（KERATIN-14）的基因突变与单纯型大疱性表皮松解症的若干亚型相关。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Epidermolysis Bullosa Simplex" scope note C17.800.804.512 Ichthyosis 鱼鳞病 "Any of several generalized skin disorders characterized by dryness, roughness, and scaliness, due to hypertrophy of the stratum corneum epidermis. Most are genetic, but some are acquired, developing in association with other systemic disease or genetic syndrome." 几种泛发性皮肤病的统称，特征为干燥、粗糙和鳞屑，由表皮角质层肥厚所致。多数为遗传性，但也有获得性者，伴发于其他系统性疾病或遗传综合征。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Ichthyosis" scope note C17.800.804.512.400 Ichthyosiform Erythroderma, Congenital 先天性鱼鳞病样红皮病 "Designation for several severe forms of ichthyosis, present at birth, that are characterized by hyperkeratotic scaling. Infants may be born encased in a collodion membrane which begins shedding within 24 hours. This is followed in about two weeks by persistent generalized scaling. The forms include bullous (HYPERKERATOSIS, EPIDERMOLYTIC), non-bullous (ICHTHYOSIS, LAMELLAR), wet type, and dry type." 对出生时即存在的几种严重鱼鳞病类型的统称，特征为角化过度性鳞屑。婴儿出生时可包裹于火棉胶样膜中，该膜在 24 小时内开始脱落。约两周后继之以持续性全身鳞屑。其类型包括大疱型（HYPERKERATOSIS, EPIDERMOLYTIC）、非大疱型（ICHTHYOSIS, LAMELLAR）、湿型和干型。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Ichthyosiform Erythroderma, Congenital" scope note C17.800.804.512.400.375 Hyperkeratosis, Epidermolytic 表皮松解性角化过度症 "A form of congenital ichthyosis inherited as an autosomal dominant trait and characterized by ERYTHRODERMA and severe hyperkeratosis. It is manifested at birth by blisters followed by the appearance of thickened, horny, verruciform scales over the entire body, but accentuated in flexural areas. Mutations in the genes that encode KERATIN-1 and KERATIN-10 have been associated with this disorder." 一种以常染色体显性性状遗传的先天性鱼鳞病，特征为红皮病（ERYTHRODERMA）和严重角化过度。出生时即表现为水疱，随后全身出现增厚、角质、疣状鳞屑，但在屈侧部位更为明显。编码角蛋白 1（KERATIN-1）和角蛋白 10（KERATIN-10）的基因突变与该病相关。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Hyperkeratosis, Epidermolytic" scope note C17.800.804.512.400.410 Ichthyosis, Lamellar 板层状鱼鳞病 "A chronic, congenital ichthyosis inherited as an autosomal recessive trait. Infants are usually born encased in a collodion membrane which sheds within a few weeks. Scaling is generalized and marked with grayish-brown quadrilateral scales, adherent at their centers and free at the edges. In some cases, scales are so thick that they resemble armored plate." 一种以常染色体隐性性状遗传的慢性先天性鱼鳞病。婴儿出生时通常包裹于火棉胶膜中，该膜在数周内脱落。鳞屑泛发，呈灰褐色四边形，中央黏着、边缘游离。某些病例中鳞屑厚到类似铠甲板。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Ichthyosis, Lamellar" scope note C17.800.804.512.400.705 Netherton Syndrome 内瑟顿综合征 "Rare autosomal recessive disease with variable expressions. Clinical features of the disease include variable ICHTHYOSIFORM ERYTHRODERMA, CONGENITAL; bamboo hair (trichorrhexis invaginata); and ATOPIC DERMATITIS. The disease is caused by mutations in the SPINK5 gene." 一种表现多样的罕见常染色体隐性遗传病。该病的临床特征包括不同程度的先天性鱼鳞病样红皮病（ICHTHYOSIFORM ERYTHRODERMA, CONGENITAL）、竹节状发（套叠性脆发症）和特应性皮炎（ATOPIC DERMATITIS）。该病由 SPINK5 基因突变引起。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Netherton Syndrome" scope note C17.800.804.512.405 Ichthyosis Bullosa of Siemens Siemens 大疱性鱼鳞病 "An autosomal dominant form of ichthyosis characterized by generalized reddening of the skin (ERYTHEMA) and widespread blistering. The disease shows similar, but somewhat milder, clinical and histopathological findings to those in HYPERKERATOSIS, EPIDERMOLYTIC and is associated with the gene that encodes KERATIN-2A." 一种常染色体显性遗传的鱼鳞病，特征为皮肤泛发性发红（红斑（ERYTHEMA））和广泛水疱形成。该病的临床和组织病理学表现与表皮松解性角化过度（HYPERKERATOSIS, EPIDERMOLYTIC）相似但稍轻，并与编码角蛋白 2A（KERATIN-2A）的基因相关。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Ichthyosis Bullosa of Siemens" scope note C17.800.804.512.410 Ichthyosis Vulgaris 寻常型鱼鳞病 "Most common form of ICHTHYOSIS characterized by prominent scaling especially on the exterior surfaces of the extremities. It is inherited as an autosomal dominant trait." 鱼鳞病（ICHTHYOSIS）最常见的类型，特征为明显的鳞屑，尤其见于四肢伸侧。以常染色体显性性状遗传。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Ichthyosis Vulgaris" scope note C17.800.804.512.420 Ichthyosis, X-Linked X 连锁鱼鳞病 "Chronic form of ichthyosis that is inherited as a sex-linked recessive trait carried on the X-chromosome and transmitted to the male offspring. It is characterized by severe scaling, especially on the extremities, and is associated with steroid sulfatase deficiency." 一种慢性鱼鳞病，以位于 X 染色体上的性连锁隐性性状遗传并传给男性后代。特征为严重脱屑，尤其在四肢，并与类固醇硫酸酯酶缺乏相关。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Ichthyosis, X-Linked" scope note C17.800.804.512.723 Sjogren-Larsson Syndrome 舍格伦-拉松综合征 "An autosomal recessive neurocutaneous disorder characterized by severe ichthyosis MENTAL RETARDATION; SPASTIC PARAPLEGIA; and congenital ICHTHYOSIS. It is caused by mutation of gene encoding microsomal fatty ALDEHYDE DEHYDROGENASE leading to defect in fatty alcohol metabolism." 一种常染色体隐性遗传的神经皮肤疾病，其特征为重度鱼鳞病、精神发育迟滞（MENTAL RETARDATION）、痉挛性截瘫（SPASTIC PARAPLEGIA）和先天性鱼鳞病（ICHTHYOSIS）。由编码微粒体脂肪醛脱氢酶（ALDEHYDE DEHYDROGENASE）的基因突变引起，导致脂肪醇代谢缺陷。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Sjogren-Larsson Syndrome" scope note C17.800.804.580 Incontinentia Pigmenti 色素失禁症 "A genodermatosis occurring mostly in females and characterized by skin changes in three phases - vesiculobullous, verrucous papillomatous, and macular melanodermic. Hyperpigmentation is bizarre and irregular. Sixty percent of patients have abnormalities of eyes, teeth, central nervous system, and skin appendages." 一种主要发生于女性的遗传性皮肤病，特征为皮肤改变分三期：水疱大疱期、疣状乳头瘤期和斑状黑皮期。色素沉着过度形态怪异且不规则。百分之六十的患者有眼、牙齿、中枢神经系统和皮肤附属器的异常。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Incontinentia Pigmenti" scope note C17.800.804.675 Port-Wine Stain 葡萄酒色斑 "A vascular malformation of developmental origin characterized pathologically by ectasia of superficial dermal capillaries, and clinically by persistent macular erythema. In the past, port wine stains have frequently been termed capillary hemangiomas, which they are not; unfortunately this confusing practice persists: HEMANGIOMA, CAPILLARY is neoplastic, a port-wine stain is non-neoplastic. Port-wine stains vary in color from fairly pale pink to deep red or purple and in size from a few millimeters to many centimeters in diameter. The face is the most frequently affected site and they are most often unilateral. (From Rook et al., Textbook of Dermatology, 5th ed, p483)" 一种发育起源的血管畸形，病理特征为真皮浅层毛细血管扩张，临床特征为持续性斑状红斑。过去葡萄酒色斑常被称为毛细血管瘤，但它们并非如此；遗憾的是这种混淆的做法仍在延续：毛细血管瘤（HEMANGIOMA, CAPILLARY）是肿瘤性的，而葡萄酒色斑是非肿瘤性的。葡萄酒色斑颜色从相当浅的粉红色到深红色或紫色不等，大小从数毫米到数十厘米直径不等。面部是最常受累的部位，且多为单侧。（引自 Rook 等，Textbook of Dermatology，第 5 版，第 483 页） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Port-Wine Stain" scope note C17.800.804.766 Pseudoxanthoma Elasticum 弹性纤维假黄瘤 "An inherited disorder of connective tissue with extensive degeneration and calcification of ELASTIC TISSUE primarily in the skin, eye, and vasculature. At least two forms exist, autosomal recessive and autosomal dominant. This disorder is caused by mutations of one of the ATP-BINDING CASSETTE TRANSPORTERS. Patients are predisposed to MYOCARDIAL INFARCTION and GASTROINTESTINAL HEMORRHAGE." 一种遗传性结缔组织疾病，主要在皮肤、眼和血管系统中出现广泛的弹性组织（ELASTIC TISSUE）变性和钙化。至少存在两种类型：常染色体隐性型和常染色体显性型。本病由某种 ATP 结合盒转运蛋白（ATP-BINDING CASSETTE TRANSPORTERS）的突变所致。患者易发生心肌梗死（MYOCARDIAL INFARCTION）和胃肠道出血（GASTROINTESTINAL HEMORRHAGE）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Pseudoxanthoma Elasticum" scope note C17.800.804.775 Rothmund-Thomson Syndrome 罗特蒙德-汤姆森综合征 "An autosomal recessive syndrome occurring principally in females, characterized by the presence of reticulated, atrophic, hyperpigmented, telangiectatic cutaneous plaques, often accompanied by juvenile cataracts, saddle nose, congenital bone defects, disturbances in the growth of HAIR; NAILS; and TEETH; and HYPOGONADISM." 一种主要见于女性的常染色体隐性遗传综合征，其特征为存在网状、萎缩、色素沉着过度、毛细血管扩张的皮肤斑块，常伴有幼年白内障、鞍鼻、先天性骨缺损，以及毛发（HAIR）、甲（NAILS）和牙齿（TEETH）的生长障碍和性腺功能减退（HYPOGONADISM）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Rothmund-Thomson Syndrome" scope note C17.800.804.812 Sclerema Neonatorum 新生儿硬化症 "A severe, sometimes fatal, disorder of adipose tissue occurring chiefly in preterm or debilitated infants suffering from an underlying illness and manifested by a diffuse, nonpitting induration of the affected tissue. The skin becomes cold, yellowish, mottled, and inflexible." 一种严重、有时致命的脂肪组织疾病，主要发生于患有基础疾病的早产儿或体弱婴儿，表现为受累组织弥漫性、非凹陷性硬化。皮肤变得冰冷、发黄、呈斑驳状且失去弹性。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Sclerema Neonatorum" scope note C17.800.804.874 Trichothiodystrophy Syndromes 毛发低硫营养不良综合征 "Autosomal recessive neuroectodermal disorders characterized by brittle sulfur-deficient hair associated with impaired intellect, decreased fertility, and short stature. It may include nail dystrophy, ICHTHYOSIS, and photosensitivity correlated with a NUCLEOTIDE EXCISION REPAIR defect. All individuals with this disorder have a deficiency of cysteine-rich KERATIN-ASSOCIATED PROTEINS found in the interfilamentous matrix. Photosensitive trichothiodystrophy can be caused by mutation in at least 2 separate genes: ERCC2 PROTEIN gene and the related ERCC3. Nonphotosensitive trichothiodystrophy can be caused by mutation in the TTDN1 gene." 常染色体隐性遗传的神经外胚层疾病，特征为脆性缺硫毛发，伴智力受损、生育力下降和身材矮小。可包括甲营养不良、鱼鳞病（ICHTHYOSIS）以及与核苷酸切除修复（NUCLEOTIDE EXCISION REPAIR）缺陷相关的光敏感。所有患者均缺乏存在于丝间基质中的富含半胱氨酸的角蛋白相关蛋白（KERATIN-ASSOCIATED PROTEINS）。光敏型毛发低硫营养不良可由至少 2 个不同基因的突变引起：ERCC2 蛋白（ERCC2 PROTEIN）基因及相关的 ERCC3。非光敏型毛发低硫营养不良可由 TTDN1 基因突变引起。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Trichothiodystrophy Syndromes" scope note C17.800.804.936 Xeroderma Pigmentosum 着色性干皮病 "A rare, pigmentary, and atrophic autosomal recessive disease. It is manifested as an extreme photosensitivity to ULTRAVIOLET RAYS as the result of a deficiency in the enzyme that permits excisional repair of ultraviolet-damaged DNA." 一种罕见的色素性、萎缩性常染色体隐性遗传病。表现为对紫外线（ULTRAVIOLET RAYS）极度光敏，其原因是缺乏能够对紫外线损伤的 DNA 进行切除修复的酶。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Xeroderma Pigmentosum" scope note References National Library of Medicine. (2026). MeSH 2026 descriptor records [Data set]. Retrieved October 28, 2026, from https://www.nlm.nih.gov/databases/download/mesh.html
