medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.summary: C17.800.815 Skin Diseases, Eczematous Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source C17.800.815 Skin Diseases, Eczematous 湿疹样皮肤病 "Any of a variety of eruptive skin disorders characterized by erythema, oozing, vesiculation, and scaling. Etiology is varied." 多种发疹性皮肤病中的任何一种，特征为红斑、渗出、水疱形成和鳞屑。病因多样。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Skin Diseases, Eczematous" scope note C17.800.815.193 Dermatitis, Atopic 特应性皮炎 "A chronic inflammatory genetically determined disease of the skin marked by increased ability to form reagin (IgE), with increased susceptibility to allergic rhinitis and asthma, and hereditary disposition to a lowered threshold for pruritus. It is manifested by lichenification, excoriation, and crusting, mainly on the flexural surfaces of the elbow and knee. In infants it is known as infantile eczema." 一种遗传决定的慢性炎症性皮肤病，特征为形成反应素（IgE）的能力增强，对过敏性鼻炎和哮喘的易感性增加，并有瘙痒阈值降低的遗传素质。表现为苔藓样变、表皮剥脱和结痂，主要位于肘、膝屈侧。在婴儿中称为婴儿湿疹。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Dermatitis, Atopic" scope note C17.800.815.255 Dermatitis, Contact 接触性皮炎 "A type of acute or chronic skin reaction in which sensitivity is manifested by reactivity to materials or substances coming in contact with the skin. It may involve allergic or non-allergic mechanisms." 一类急性或慢性皮肤反应，其敏感性表现为对接触皮肤的材料或物质产生反应。可涉及变应性或非变应性机制。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Dermatitis, Contact" scope note C17.800.815.255.100 Dermatitis, Allergic Contact 变应性接触性皮炎 "A contact dermatitis due to allergic sensitization to various substances. These substances subsequently produce inflammatory reactions in the skin of those who have acquired hypersensitivity to them as a result of prior exposure." 一种因对各种物质发生变应性致敏而引起的接触性皮炎。这些物质随后在因既往接触而获得超敏性的人的皮肤中引起炎症反应。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Dermatitis, Allergic Contact" scope note C17.800.815.255.100.600 Dermatitis, Photoallergic 光变应性皮炎 "A delayed hypersensitivity involving the reaction between sunlight or other radiant energy source and a chemical substance to which the individual has been previously exposed and sensitized. It manifests as a papulovesicular, eczematous, or exudative dermatitis occurring chiefly on the light-exposed areas of the skin." 一种迟发型超敏反应，涉及日光或其他辐射能源与化学物质之间的反应，个体此前已接触该化学物质并致敏。表现为丘疹水疱性、湿疹样或渗出性皮炎，主要发生于皮肤的曝光部位。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Dermatitis, Photoallergic" scope note C17.800.815.255.100.700 Dermatitis, Toxicodendron 毒漆树皮炎 "An allergic contact dermatitis caused by exposure to plants of the genus Toxicodendron (formerly Rhus). These include poison ivy, poison oak, and poison sumac, all plants that contain the substance urushiol, a potent skin sensitizing agent. (From Dorland, 27th ed)" 一种变应性接触性皮炎，由接触漆树属（Toxicodendron）植物（旧称 Rhus）引起。这些植物包括毒常春藤、毒橡树和毒漆树，均含有漆酚这种强效皮肤致敏物质。（引自 Dorland，第 27 版） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Dermatitis, Toxicodendron" scope note C17.800.815.255.400 Dermatitis, Irritant 刺激性皮炎 "A non-allergic contact dermatitis caused by prolonged exposure to irritants and not explained by delayed hypersensitivity mechanisms." 一种由长期接触刺激物引起的非过敏性接触性皮炎，不能用迟发型超敏反应机制解释。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Dermatitis, Irritant" scope note C17.800.815.255.400.225 Dermatitis, Phototoxic 光毒性皮炎 "A nonimmunologic, chemically induced type of photosensitivity producing a sometimes vesiculating dermatitis. It results in hyperpigmentation and desquamation of the light-exposed areas of the skin." 一种非免疫性、化学诱发的光敏感类型，可产生有时伴水疱的皮炎。导致皮肤曝光部位色素沉着过度和脱屑。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Dermatitis, Phototoxic" scope note C17.800.815.255.400.250 Diaper Rash 尿布疹 "A type of irritant dermatitis localized to the area in contact with a diaper and occurring most often as a reaction to prolonged contact with urine, feces, or retained soap or detergent." 一种局限于与尿布接触部位的刺激性皮炎，最常因长时间接触尿液、粪便或残留的肥皂或洗涤剂而发生。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Diaper Rash" scope note C17.800.815.255.700 Dermatitis, Occupational 职业性皮炎 "A recurrent contact dermatitis caused by substances found in the work place." 一种由工作场所中存在的物质引起的复发性接触性皮炎。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Dermatitis, Occupational" scope note C17.800.815.318 Dermatitis, Exfoliative 剥脱性皮炎 "The widespread involvement of the skin by a scaly, erythematous dermatitis occurring either as a secondary or reactive process to an underlying cutaneous disorder (e.g., atopic dermatitis, psoriasis, etc.), or as a primary or idiopathic disease. It is often associated with the loss of hair and nails, hyperkeratosis of the palms and soles, and pruritus. (From Dorland, 27th ed)" 鳞屑性红斑性皮炎对皮肤的广泛累及，可作为基础皮肤病（如特应性皮炎、银屑病等）的继发或反应性过程发生，也可作为原发或特发性疾病发生。它常伴有毛发和指（趾）甲脱落、掌跖角化过度及瘙痒。（引自 Dorland，第 27 版） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Dermatitis, Exfoliative" scope note C17.800.815.580 Dermatitis, Seborrheic 脂溢性皮炎 "A chronic inflammatory disease of the skin with unknown etiology. It is characterized by moderate ERYTHEMA, dry, moist, or greasy (SEBACEOUS GLAND) scaling and yellow crusted patches on various areas, especially the scalp, that exfoliate as dandruff. Seborrheic dermatitis is common in children and adolescents with HIV INFECTIONS." 一种病因不明的慢性炎症性皮肤病。特征为中度红斑（ERYTHEMA）、干性、湿性或油腻性（皮脂腺（SEBACEOUS GLAND））鳞屑，以及身体各部位尤其是头皮上的黄色结痂斑片，后者以头皮屑形式脱落。脂溢性皮炎常见于患有 HIV 感染（HIV INFECTIONS）的儿童和青少年。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Dermatitis, Seborrheic" scope note C17.800.815.620 Eczema 湿疹 "A dermatitis characterized by a spongiotic tissue reaction pattern occurring as a reaction to many endogenous and exogenous agents." 一种皮炎，特征为海绵水肿性组织反应模式，作为对多种内源性和外源性因素的反应而发生。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Eczema" scope note C17.800.815.620.300 Eczema, Dyshidrotic 汗疱疹 "A recurrent eczematous reaction characterized by the development of vesicular eruptions on the palms and soles, particularly along the sides and between the digits. It is accompanied by pruritus, a burning sensation, and hyperhidrosis. The disease is self-limiting, lasting only a few weeks. (Dorland, 27th ed)" 一种复发性湿疹样反应，特征为手掌和足底出现水疱性皮疹，尤其是沿指（趾）侧缘和指（趾）间。伴有瘙痒、烧灼感和多汗。该病为自限性，仅持续数周。（Dorland，第 27 版） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Eczema, Dyshidrotic" scope note C17.800.815.650 Intertrigo 擦烂 "A superficial dermatitis occurring on skin surfaces in contact with each other, such as the axillae, neck creases, intergluteal fold, between the toes, etc. Obesity is a predisposing factor. The condition is caused by moisture and friction and is characterized by erythema, maceration, burning, and exudation." 一种发生于相互接触的皮肤表面的浅表性皮炎，如腋窝、颈部皱褶、臀间沟、趾间等。肥胖是易感因素。本病由潮湿和摩擦引起，特征为红斑、浸渍、烧灼感和渗出。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Intertrigo" scope note C17.800.815.650.500 Tinea Cruris 股癣 "Fungal infection of the groin. The main causative fungus is TRICHOPHYTON." 腹股沟的真菌感染。主要致病真菌为毛癣菌（TRICHOPHYTON）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Tinea Cruris" scope note C17.800.815.660 Neurodermatitis 神经性皮炎 "An extremely variable eczematous skin disease that is presumed to be a response to prolonged vigorous scratching, rubbing, or pinching to relieve intense pruritus. It varies in intensity, severity, course, and morphologic expression in different individuals. Neurodermatitis is believed by some to be psychogenic. The circumscribed or localized form is often referred to as lichen simplex chronicus." 一种表现极为多变的湿疹样皮肤病，被认为是为缓解剧烈瘙痒而长期用力搔抓、摩擦或掐捏所致的反应。其强度、严重程度、病程和形态表现因人而异。有人认为神经性皮炎属心因性。局限型常称为慢性单纯性苔藓。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Neurodermatitis" scope note References National Library of Medicine. (2026). MeSH 2026 descriptor records [Data set]. Retrieved October 28, 2026, from https://www.nlm.nih.gov/databases/download/mesh.html

medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.summary: C17.800.827 Skin Diseases, Genetic Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source C17.800.827 Skin Diseases, Genetic 遗传性皮肤病 "Diseases of the skin with a genetic component, usually the result of various inborn errors of metabolism." 具有遗传成分的皮肤疾病，通常是各种先天性代谢缺陷的结果。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Skin Diseases, Genetic" scope note C17.800.827.080 Albinism 白化病 "General term for a number of inherited defects of amino acid metabolism in which there is a deficiency or absence of pigment in the eyes, skin, or hair." 多种遗传性氨基酸代谢缺陷的总称，表现为眼、皮肤或毛发中色素缺乏或缺失。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Albinism" scope note C17.800.827.080.090 Albinism, Ocular 眼白化病 "Albinism affecting the eye in which pigment of the hair and skin is normal or only slightly diluted. The classic type is X-linked (Nettleship-Falls), but an autosomal recessive form also exists. Ocular abnormalities may include reduced pigmentation of the iris, nystagmus, photophobia, strabismus, and decreased visual acuity." 累及眼的白化病，毛发和皮肤色素正常或仅轻度变淡。经典型为 X 连锁（Nettleship-Falls），但也存在常染色体隐性型。眼部异常可包括虹膜色素减少、眼球震颤、畏光、斜视和视力下降。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Albinism, Ocular" scope note C17.800.827.080.100 Albinism, Oculocutaneous 眼皮肤白化病 "Heterogeneous group of autosomal recessive disorders comprising at least four recognized types, all having in common varying degrees of hypopigmentation of the skin, hair, and eyes. The two most common are the tyrosinase-positive and tyrosinase-negative types." 一组异质性的常染色体隐性疾病，至少包括四种公认类型，共同特点是不同程度的皮肤、毛发和眼睛色素减退。最常见的两种是酪氨酸酶阳性型和酪氨酸酶阴性型。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Albinism, Oculocutaneous" scope note C17.800.827.080.100.400 Hermanski-Pudlak Syndrome 赫曼斯基-普德拉克综合征 "Syndrome characterized by the triad of oculocutaneous albinism (ALBINISM, OCULOCUTANEOUS); PLATELET STORAGE POOL DEFICIENCY; and lysosomal accumulation of ceroid lipofuscin." 一种综合征，其特征为眼皮肤白化病三联征（眼皮肤白化病，ALBINISM, OCULOCUTANEOUS）、血小板贮存池缺陷（PLATELET STORAGE POOL DEFICIENCY），以及溶酶体内蜡样脂褐素蓄积。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Hermanski-Pudlak Syndrome" scope note C17.800.827.080.600 Piebaldism 斑驳病 "Autosomal dominant, congenital disorder characterized by localized hypomelanosis of the skin and hair. The most familiar feature is a white forelock presenting in 80 to 90 percent of the patients. The underlying defect is possibly related to the differentiation and migration of melanoblasts, as well as to defective development of the neural crest (neurocristopathy). Piebaldism may be closely related to WAARDENBURG SYNDROME." 一种常染色体显性先天性疾病，特征为皮肤和毛发的局限性黑色素减少。最常见的特征是白色额发，见于 80% 至 90% 的患者。潜在缺陷可能与黑色素母细胞的分化和迁移以及神经嵴发育缺陷（神经嵴病）有关。斑驳病可能与瓦登伯格综合征（WAARDENBURG SYNDROME）密切相关。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Piebaldism" scope note C17.800.827.180 Cutis Laxa 皮肤松垂 "A group of connective tissue diseases in which skin hangs in loose pendulous folds. It is believed to be associated with decreased elastic tissue formation as well as an abnormality in elastin formation. Cutis laxa is usually a genetic disease, but acquired cases have been reported. (From Dorland, 27th ed)" 一组结缔组织病，其中皮肤呈松弛下垂的皱褶。据认为它与弹性组织形成减少以及弹性蛋白形成异常有关。皮肤松垂通常是遗传性疾病，但也有后天获得性病例的报道。（引自 Dorland，第 27 版） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Cutis Laxa" scope note C17.800.827.190 Darier Disease 毛囊角化病（达里埃病） "An autosomal dominantly inherited skin disorder characterized by warty malodorous papules that coalesce into plaques. It is caused by mutations in the ATP2A2 gene encoding SERCA2 protein, one of the SARCOPLASMIC RETICULUM CALCIUM-TRANSPORTING ATPASES. The condition is similar, clinically and histologically, to BENIGN FAMILIAL PEMPHIGUS, another autosomal dominant skin disorder. Both diseases have defective calcium pumps (CALCIUM-TRANSPORTING ATPASES) and unstable desmosomal adhesion junctions (DESMOSOMES) between KERATINOCYTES." 一种常染色体显性遗传性皮肤病，特征为融合成斑块的疣状恶臭丘疹。它由编码 SERCA2 蛋白的 ATP2A2 基因突变引起，SERCA2 是肌质网钙转运 ATP 酶（SARCOPLASMIC RETICULUM CALCIUM-TRANSPORTING ATPASES）之一。该病在临床和组织学上与另一种常染色体显性皮肤病家族性良性天疱疮（BENIGN FAMILIAL PEMPHIGUS）相似。两种疾病都存在钙泵缺陷（钙转运 ATP 酶（CALCIUM-TRANSPORTING ATPASES））以及角质形成细胞（KERATINOCYTES）之间桥粒黏附连接（桥粒（DESMOSOMES））不稳定。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Darier Disease" scope note C17.800.827.210 Dermatitis, Atopic 特应性皮炎 "A chronic inflammatory genetically determined disease of the skin marked by increased ability to form reagin (IgE), with increased susceptibility to allergic rhinitis and asthma, and hereditary disposition to a lowered threshold for pruritus. It is manifested by lichenification, excoriation, and crusting, mainly on the flexural surfaces of the elbow and knee. In infants it is known as infantile eczema." 一种遗传决定的慢性炎症性皮肤病，特征为形成反应素（IgE）的能力增强，对过敏性鼻炎和哮喘的易感性增加，并有瘙痒阈值降低的遗传素质。表现为苔藓样变、表皮剥脱和结痂，主要位于肘、膝屈侧。在婴儿中称为婴儿湿疹。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Dermatitis, Atopic" scope note C17.800.827.235 Dyskeratosis Congenita 先天性角化不良 "A predominantly X-linked recessive syndrome characterized by a triad of reticular skin pigmentation, nail dystrophy and leukoplakia of mucous membranes. Oral and dental abnormalities may also be present. Complications are a predisposition to malignancy and bone marrow involvement with pancytopenia. (from Int J Paediatr Dent 2000 Dec;10(4):328-34) The X-linked form is also known as Zinsser-Cole-Engman syndrome and involves the gene which encodes a highly conserved protein called dyskerin." 一种主要为 X 连锁隐性遗传的综合征，特征为网状皮肤色素沉着、甲营养不良和黏膜白斑三联征。也可存在口腔和牙齿异常。并发症包括易患恶性肿瘤以及骨髓受累伴全血细胞减少。（引自 Int J Paediatr Dent 2000 Dec;10(4):328-34）X 连锁型又称 Zinsser-Cole-Engman 综合征，涉及编码一种高度保守蛋白（角化不良蛋白 dyskerin）的基因。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Dyskeratosis Congenita" scope note C17.800.827.250 Ectodermal Dysplasia 外胚层发育不良 "A group of hereditary disorders involving tissues and structures derived from the embryonic ectoderm. They are characterized by the presence of abnormalities at birth and involvement of both the epidermis and skin appendages. They are generally nonprogressive and diffuse. Various forms exist, including anhidrotic and hidrotic dysplasias, FOCAL DERMAL HYPOPLASIA, and aplasia cutis congenita." 一组累及源自胚胎外胚层的组织和结构的遗传性疾病。其特征为出生时即存在异常，并同时累及表皮和皮肤附属器。通常为非进行性且呈弥漫性。有多种类型，包括无汗型和有汗型发育不良、局灶性真皮发育不全（FOCAL DERMAL HYPOPLASIA）以及先天性皮肤发育不全。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Ectodermal Dysplasia" scope note C17.800.827.250.198 Ectodermal Dysplasia 1, Anhidrotic 无汗性外胚层发育不良 1 型 "An X-linked form of ectodermal dysplasia which results from mutations of the gene encoding ECTODYSPLASIN." 一种 X 连锁的外胚层发育不良，由编码外异蛋白（ECTODYSPLASIN）的基因突变所致。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Ectodermal Dysplasia 1, Anhidrotic" scope note C17.800.827.250.298 Ectodermal Dysplasia 3, Anhidrotic 无汗性外胚层发育不良 3 型 "An autosomal dominant form of ectodermal dysplasia which is due to mutations in the gene for the EDAR RECEPTOR." 一种常染色体显性形式的外胚层发育不良，由 EDAR 受体（EDAR RECEPTOR）基因突变引起。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Ectodermal Dysplasia 3, Anhidrotic" scope note C17.800.827.250.348 Ectodermal Dysplasia, Hypohidrotic, Autosomal Recessive 常染色体隐性少汗性外胚层发育不良 "An autosomal recessive form of ectodermal dysplasia which is due to mutations in the gene for the EDAR RECEPTOR or EDAR-ASSOCIATED DEATH DOMAIN PROTEIN." 一种常染色体隐性遗传形式的外胚层发育不良，由 EDAR 受体（EDAR RECEPTOR）或 EDAR 相关死亡结构域蛋白（EDAR-ASSOCIATED DEATH DOMAIN PROTEIN）的基因突变所致。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Ectodermal Dysplasia, Hypohidrotic, Autosomal Recessive" scope note C17.800.827.250.398 Ellis-Van Creveld Syndrome 埃利伟综合征（软骨外胚层发育不良） "Dwarfism occurring in association with defective development of skin, hair, and teeth, polydactyly, and defect of the cardiac septum. (Dorland, 27th ed)" 侏儒症，伴有皮肤、毛发和牙齿发育缺陷、多指（趾）以及心间隔缺损。（Dorland，第 27 版） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Ellis-Van Creveld Syndrome" scope note C17.800.827.250.424 Focal Dermal Hypoplasia 局灶性真皮发育不全 "A genetic skin disease characterized by hypoplasia of the dermis, herniations of fat, and hand anomalies. It is found exclusively in females and transmitted as an X-linked dominant trait." 一种遗传性皮肤病，特征为真皮发育不全、脂肪疝出及手部畸形。仅见于女性，以 X 连锁显性性状遗传。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Focal Dermal Hypoplasia" scope note C17.800.827.250.568 Focal Facial Dermal Dysplasias 局灶性面部真皮发育不良 "A heterogenous group of genetic disorders characterized by scar-like atrophic lesions on the temple region of the head including preauricular area. Location of skin defects is likely related to defects in fusion of embryonic facial prominences during development of the face. Focal facial dermal dysplasia (FFDD) is generally divided into four subtypes according to the location of the lesions and inheritance pattern: FFDD1 (Brauer syndrome); FFDD2 (Brauer-Setleis syndrome); FFDD3 (Setleis syndrome); and FFDD4. Mutations in TWIST2 Protein and/or CYP26C1 (see CYP26 FAMILY) are associated with FFDD3, and 4." 一组异质性遗传病，特征为头部颞区的瘢痕样萎缩性皮损，包括耳前区。皮肤缺损的部位可能与面部发育过程中胚胎面突融合缺陷有关。局灶性面部真皮发育不良（FFDD）一般根据皮损部位和遗传方式分为四个亚型：FFDD1（Brauer 综合征）；FFDD2（Brauer-Setleis 综合征）；FFDD3（Setleis 综合征）；以及 FFDD4。TWIST2 蛋白和（或）CYP26C1（见 CYP26 FAMILY）的突变与 FFDD3 和 4 相关。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Focal Facial Dermal Dysplasias" scope note C17.800.827.250.712 Neurocutaneous Syndromes 神经皮肤综合征 "A group of disorders characterized by ectodermal-based malformations and neoplastic growths in the skin, nervous system, and other organs." 一组疾病，特征为皮肤、神经系统和其他器官中源于外胚层的畸形和肿瘤性生长。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Neurocutaneous Syndromes" scope note C17.800.827.250.856 Pachyonychia Congenita 先天性厚甲 "A group of inherited ectodermal dysplasias whose most prominent clinical feature is hypertrophic nail dystrophy resulting in PACHYONYCHIA. Several specific subtypes of pachyonychia congenita have been associated with mutations in genes that encode KERATINS." 一组遗传性外胚层发育不良，最突出的临床特征是导致厚甲（PACHYONYCHIA）的肥厚性甲营养不良。先天性厚甲的若干特定亚型与编码角蛋白（KERATINS）的基因突变相关。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Pachyonychia Congenita" scope note C17.800.827.250.856.500 Steatocystoma Multiplex 多发性脂囊瘤 "A disorder characterized by multiple, wide spread cutaneous cysts that often become inflamed and rupture. It is caused by the same mutations in the gene coding for KRT-17 that are causative mutations for Pachyonychia congenita, Type 2. Natal teeth involvement is sometimes associated with steatocystoma multiplex." 一种以多发、广泛分布的皮肤囊肿为特征的疾病，这些囊肿常发炎和破裂。它由编码 KRT-17 的基因突变引起，这些突变与 2 型先天性厚甲症的致病突变相同。多发性脂囊瘤有时伴有胎生牙。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Steatocystoma Multiplex" scope note C17.800.827.260 Ehlers-Danlos Syndrome 埃勒斯-当洛斯综合征 "A heterogeneous group of autosomally inherited COLLAGEN DISEASES caused by defects in the synthesis or structure of FIBRILLAR COLLAGEN. There are numerous subtypes: classical, hypermobility, vascular, and others. It is unrelated to PEMPHIGUS VULGARIS though it closely resembles that disease." 一种常染色体显性遗传的皮肤病，其特征为水疱和大疱（BULLAE）反复发作，主要见于颈部、腋窝和腹股沟。ATP2C1 基因突变（该基因编码分泌途径 Ca2++/Mn2++ ATP 酶 1（SPCA1））导致本病。其在临床和组织学上与达里埃病（DARIER DISEASE）相似，两者均有角质形成细胞（KERATINOCYTES）之间异常、不稳定的桥粒（DESMOSOMES）以及缺陷的钙转运 ATP 酶（CALCIUM-TRANSPORTING ATPASES）。本病与寻常型天疱疮（PEMPHIGUS VULGARIS）无关，尽管与之十分相似。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Pemphigus, Benign Familial" scope note C17.800.827.730 Porokeratosis 汗孔角化症 "A heritable disorder of faulty keratinization characterized by the proliferation of abnormal clones of KERATINOCYTES and lesions showing varying atrophic patches surrounded by an elevated, keratotic border. These keratotic lesions can progress to overt cutaneous neoplasm. Several clinical variants are recognized, including porokeratosis of Mibelli, linear porokeratosis, disseminated superficial actinic porokeratosis, palmoplantar porokeratosis, and punctate porokeratosis." 一种遗传性角化异常疾病，特征为角质形成细胞（KERATINOCYTES）异常克隆增生，皮损表现为不同的萎缩性斑片，周围有隆起的角化性边缘。这些角化性皮损可进展为明显的皮肤肿瘤。已知若干临床变异型，包括 Mibelli 汗孔角化症、线状汗孔角化症、播散性浅表性光线性汗孔角化症、掌跖汗孔角化症和点状汗孔角化症。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Porokeratosis" scope note C17.800.827.738 Porphyria, Erythropoietic 红细胞生成性卟啉病 "An autosomal recessive porphyria that is due to a deficiency of UROPORPHYRINOGEN III SYNTHASE in the BONE MARROW; also known as congenital erythropoietic porphyria. This disease is characterized by SPLENOMEGALY; ANEMIA; photosensitivity; cutaneous lesions; accumulation of hydroxymethylbilane; and increased excretion of UROPORPHYRINS and COPROPORPHYRINS." 一种常染色体隐性卟啉病，由骨髓（BONE MARROW）中尿卟啉原 III 合酶（UROPORPHYRINOGEN III SYNTHASE）缺乏所致，又称先天性红细胞生成性卟啉病。该病特征为脾肿大（SPLENOMEGALY）、贫血（ANEMIA）、光敏感、皮肤损害、羟甲基胆色烷蓄积以及尿卟啉（UROPORPHYRINS）和粪卟啉（COPROPORPHYRINS）排泄增加。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Porphyria, Erythropoietic" scope note C17.800.827.742 Porphyrias, Hepatic 肝性卟啉病 "A group of metabolic diseases due to deficiency of one of a number of LIVER enzymes in the biosynthetic pathway of HEME. They are characterized by the accumulation and increased excretion of PORPHYRINS or its precursors. Clinical features include neurological symptoms (PORPHYRIA, ACUTE INTERMITTENT), cutaneous lesions due to photosensitivity (PORPHYRIA CUTANEA TARDA), or both (HEREDITARY COPROPORPHYRIA). Hepatic porphyrias can be hereditary or acquired as a result of toxicity to the hepatic tissues." 一组代谢性疾病，由血红素（HEME）生物合成途径中若干肝（LIVER）酶之一的缺乏所致。特征为卟啉（PORPHYRINS）或其前体的蓄积和排泄增加。临床表现包括神经系统症状（急性间歇性卟啉病（PORPHYRIA, ACUTE INTERMITTENT））、光敏所致的皮肤病变（迟发性皮肤卟啉病（PORPHYRIA CUTANEA TARDA）），或两者兼有（遗传性粪卟啉病（HEREDITARY COPROPORPHYRIA））。肝性卟啉病可为遗传性，也可因肝组织中毒而获得。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Porphyrias, Hepatic" scope note C17.800.827.742.074 Coproporphyria, Hereditary 遗传性粪卟啉症 "An autosomal dominant porphyria that is due to a deficiency of COPROPORPHYRINOGEN OXIDASE in the LIVER, the sixth enzyme in the 8-enzyme biosynthetic pathway of HEME. Clinical features include both neurological symptoms and cutaneous lesions. Patients excrete increased levels of porphyrin precursors, 5-AMINOLEVULINATE and COPROPORPHYRINS." 一种常染色体显性遗传的卟啉症，由肝脏（LIVER）中粪卟啉原氧化酶（COPROPORPHYRINOGEN OXIDASE）缺乏所致，该酶是血红素（HEME）8 酶生物合成途径中的第六个酶。临床特征包括神经系统症状和皮肤损害。患者排出的卟啉前体 5-氨基乙酰丙酸（5-AMINOLEVULINATE）和粪卟啉（COPROPORPHYRINS）水平升高。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Coproporphyria, Hereditary" scope note C17.800.827.742.150 Porphyria, Acute Intermittent 急性间歇性卟啉病 "An autosomal dominant porphyria that is due to a deficiency of HYDROXYMETHYLBILANE SYNTHASE in the LIVER, the third enzyme in the 8-enzyme biosynthetic pathway of HEME. Clinical features are recurrent and life-threatening neurologic disturbances, ABDOMINAL PAIN, and elevated level of AMINOLEVULINIC ACID and PORPHOBILINOGEN in the urine." 一种常染色体显性卟啉病，由肝脏（LIVER）中羟甲基胆色烷合酶（HYDROXYMETHYLBILANE SYNTHASE）缺乏引起，该酶是血红素（HEME）8 酶生物合成途径中的第三个酶。临床特征为复发性且危及生命的神经系统紊乱、腹痛（ABDOMINAL PAIN），以及尿中氨基乙酰丙酸（AMINOLEVULINIC ACID）和胆色素原（PORPHOBILINOGEN）水平升高。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Porphyria, Acute Intermittent" scope note C17.800.827.742.250 Porphyria Cutanea Tarda 迟发性皮肤卟啉病 "An autosomal dominant or acquired porphyria due to a deficiency of UROPORPHYRINOGEN DECARBOXYLASE in the LIVER. It is characterized by photosensitivity and cutaneous lesions with little or no neurologic symptoms. Type I is the acquired form and is strongly associated with liver diseases and hepatic toxicities caused by alcohol or estrogenic steroids. Type II is the familial form." 一种常染色体显性遗传或获得性卟啉病，由肝脏（LIVER）中尿卟啉原脱羧酶（UROPORPHYRINOGEN DECARBOXYLASE）缺乏所致。其特征为光敏和皮肤病变，神经系统症状很少或没有。I 型为获得型，与肝病及酒精或雌激素类固醇引起的肝毒性密切相关。II 型为家族型。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Porphyria Cutanea Tarda" scope note C17.800.827.742.437 Porphyria, Hepatoerythropoietic 肝红细胞生成性卟啉病 "An autosomal recessive cutaneous porphyria that is due to a deficiency of UROPORPHYRINOGEN DECARBOXYLASE in both the LIVER and the BONE MARROW. Similar to PORPHYRIA CUTANEA TARDA, this disorder is caused by defects in the fifth enzyme in the 8-enzyme biosynthetic pathway of HEME, but is a homozygous enzyme deficiency with less than 10% of the normal enzyme activity. Cutaneous lesions are severe and mutilating." 一种常染色体隐性皮肤型卟啉病，由肝脏和骨髓中尿卟啉原脱羧酶（UROPORPHYRINOGEN DECARBOXYLASE；LIVER；BONE MARROW）缺乏所致。与迟发性皮肤卟啉病（PORPHYRIA CUTANEA TARDA）类似，该病由血红素（HEME）8 酶生物合成途径中第五个酶的缺陷引起，但属于纯合子酶缺乏，酶活性低于正常的 10%。皮肤损害严重且致残毁。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Porphyria, Hepatoerythropoietic" scope note C17.800.827.742.625 Porphyria, Variegate 混合型卟啉病 "An autosomal dominant porphyria that is due to a deficiency of protoporphyrinogen oxidase (EC 1.3.3.4) in the LIVER, the seventh enzyme in the 8-enzyme biosynthetic pathway of HEME. Clinical features include both neurological symptoms and cutaneous lesions. Patients excrete increased levels of porphyrin precursors, COPROPORPHYRINS and protoporphyrinogen." 一种常染色体显性遗传的卟啉病，由肝（LIVER）中原卟啉原氧化酶缺乏（EC 1.3.3.4）所致，该酶是血红素（HEME）8 酶生物合成途径中的第七个酶。临床表现包括神经系统症状和皮肤病变。患者排出的卟啉前体、粪卟啉（COPROPORPHYRINS）和原卟啉原水平升高。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Porphyria, Variegate" scope note C17.800.827.742.812 Protoporphyria, Erythropoietic 红细胞生成性原卟啉症 "An autosomal dominant porphyria that is due to a deficiency of FERROCHELATASE (heme synthetase) in both the LIVER and the BONE MARROW, the last enzyme in the 8-enzyme biosynthetic pathway of HEME. Clinical features include mainly neurological symptoms, rarely cutaneous lesions, and elevated levels of protoporphyrin and COPROPORPHYRINS in the feces." 一种常染色体显性遗传的卟啉症，由肝脏（LIVER）和骨髓（BONE MARROW）中亚铁螯合酶（FERROCHELATASE）缺乏（血红素合成酶）所致，该酶是血红素（HEME）8 酶生物合成途径中的最后一个酶。临床特征主要包括神经系统症状，皮肤损害少见，粪便中原卟啉和粪卟啉（COPROPORPHYRINS）水平升高。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Protoporphyria, Erythropoietic" scope note C17.800.827.750 Pseudoxanthoma Elasticum 弹性纤维假黄瘤 "An inherited disorder of connective tissue with extensive degeneration and calcification of ELASTIC TISSUE primarily in the skin, eye, and vasculature. At least two forms exist, autosomal recessive and autosomal dominant. This disorder is caused by mutations of one of the ATP-BINDING CASSETTE TRANSPORTERS. Patients are predisposed to MYOCARDIAL INFARCTION and GASTROINTESTINAL HEMORRHAGE." 一种遗传性结缔组织疾病，主要在皮肤、眼和血管系统中出现广泛的弹性组织（ELASTIC TISSUE）变性和钙化。至少存在两种类型：常染色体隐性型和常染色体显性型。本病由某种 ATP 结合盒转运蛋白（ATP-BINDING CASSETTE TRANSPORTERS）的突变所致。患者易发生心肌梗死（MYOCARDIAL INFARCTION）和胃肠道出血（GASTROINTESTINAL HEMORRHAGE）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Pseudoxanthoma Elasticum" scope note C17.800.827.775 Rothmund-Thomson Syndrome 罗特蒙德-汤姆森综合征 "An autosomal recessive syndrome occurring principally in females, characterized by the presence of reticulated, atrophic, hyperpigmented, telangiectatic cutaneous plaques, often accompanied by juvenile cataracts, saddle nose, congenital bone defects, disturbances in the growth of HAIR; NAILS; and TEETH; and HYPOGONADISM." 一种主要见于女性的常染色体隐性遗传综合征，其特征为存在网状、萎缩、色素沉着过度、毛细血管扩张的皮肤斑块，常伴有幼年白内障、鞍鼻、先天性骨缺损，以及毛发（HAIR）、甲（NAILS）和牙齿（TEETH）的生长障碍和性腺功能减退（HYPOGONADISM）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Rothmund-Thomson Syndrome" scope note C17.800.827.820 Sjogren-Larsson Syndrome 舍格伦-拉松综合征 "An autosomal recessive neurocutaneous disorder characterized by severe ichthyosis MENTAL RETARDATION; SPASTIC PARAPLEGIA; and congenital ICHTHYOSIS. It is caused by mutation of gene encoding microsomal fatty ALDEHYDE DEHYDROGENASE leading to defect in fatty alcohol metabolism." 一种常染色体隐性遗传的神经皮肤疾病，其特征为重度鱼鳞病、精神发育迟滞（MENTAL RETARDATION）、痉挛性截瘫（SPASTIC PARAPLEGIA）和先天性鱼鳞病（ICHTHYOSIS）。由编码微粒体脂肪醛脱氢酶（ALDEHYDE DEHYDROGENASE）的基因突变引起，导致脂肪醇代谢缺陷。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Sjogren-Larsson Syndrome" scope note C17.800.827.895 Trichothiodystrophy Syndromes 毛发低硫营养不良综合征 "Autosomal recessive neuroectodermal disorders characterized by brittle sulfur-deficient hair associated with impaired intellect, decreased fertility, and short stature. It may include nail dystrophy, ICHTHYOSIS, and photosensitivity correlated with a NUCLEOTIDE EXCISION REPAIR defect. All individuals with this disorder have a deficiency of cysteine-rich KERATIN-ASSOCIATED PROTEINS found in the interfilamentous matrix. Photosensitive trichothiodystrophy can be caused by mutation in at least 2 separate genes: ERCC2 PROTEIN gene and the related ERCC3. Nonphotosensitive trichothiodystrophy can be caused by mutation in the TTDN1 gene." 常染色体隐性遗传的神经外胚层疾病，特征为脆性缺硫毛发，伴智力受损、生育力下降和身材矮小。可包括甲营养不良、鱼鳞病（ICHTHYOSIS）以及与核苷酸切除修复（NUCLEOTIDE EXCISION REPAIR）缺陷相关的光敏感。所有患者均缺乏存在于丝间基质中的富含半胱氨酸的角蛋白相关蛋白（KERATIN-ASSOCIATED PROTEINS）。光敏型毛发低硫营养不良可由至少 2 个不同基因的突变引起：ERCC2 蛋白（ERCC2 PROTEIN）基因及相关的 ERCC3。非光敏型毛发低硫营养不良可由 TTDN1 基因突变引起。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Trichothiodystrophy Syndromes" scope note C17.800.827.970 Xeroderma Pigmentosum 着色性干皮病 "A rare, pigmentary, and atrophic autosomal recessive disease. It is manifested as an extreme photosensitivity to ULTRAVIOLET RAYS as the result of a deficiency in the enzyme that permits excisional repair of ultraviolet-damaged DNA." 一种罕见的色素性、萎缩性常染色体隐性遗传病。表现为对紫外线（ULTRAVIOLET RAYS）极度光敏，其原因是缺乏能够对紫外线损伤的 DNA 进行切除修复的酶。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Xeroderma Pigmentosum" scope note References National Library of Medicine. medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.summary: C17.800.838 Skin Diseases, Infectious Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source C17.800.838 Skin Diseases, Infectious 感染性皮肤病 "Skin diseases caused by bacteria, fungi, parasites, or viruses." 由细菌、真菌、寄生虫或病毒引起的皮肤病。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Skin Diseases, Infectious" scope note C17.800.838.208 Dermatomycoses 皮肤真菌病 "Superficial infections of the skin or its appendages by any of various fungi." 由各种真菌引起的皮肤或其附属器的浅表感染。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Dermatomycoses" scope note C17.800.838.208.055 Blastomycosis 芽生菌病 "A fungal infection by BLASTOMYCES that may appear in two forms: 1, a primary lesion characterized by the formation of a small cutaneous nodule and small nodules along the lymphatics that may heal within several months; and 2, chronic granulomatous lesions characterized by thick crusts, warty growths, and unusual vascularity and infection in the middle or upper lobes of the lung." 一种由芽生菌（BLASTOMYCES）引起的真菌感染，可表现为两种形式：1，原发性病变，特征为形成小的皮肤结节及沿淋巴管的小结节，可在数月内愈合；2，慢性肉芽肿性病变，特征为厚痂、疣状增生、异常血管增生以及肺中叶或上叶感染。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Blastomycosis" scope note C17.800.838.208.165 Candidiasis, Chronic Mucocutaneous 慢性黏膜皮肤念珠菌病 "A clinical syndrome characterized by development, usually in infancy or childhood, of a chronic, often widespread candidiasis of skin, nails, and mucous membranes. It may be secondary to one of the immunodeficiency syndromes, inherited as an autosomal recessive trait, or associated with defects in cell-mediated immunity, endocrine disorders, dental stomatitis, or malignancy." 一种临床综合征，特征为通常于婴儿期或儿童期发生的皮肤、指甲和黏膜的慢性、常为广泛的念珠菌病。可继发于某种免疫缺陷综合征，以常染色体隐性性状遗传，或与细胞介导免疫缺陷、内分泌疾病、义齿性口炎或恶性肿瘤相关。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Candidiasis, Chronic Mucocutaneous" scope note C17.800.838.208.170 Candidiasis, Cutaneous 皮肤念珠菌病 "Candidiasis of the skin manifested as eczema-like lesions of the interdigital spaces, perleche, or chronic paronychia. (Dorland, 27th ed)" 皮肤的念珠菌病，表现为指（趾）间隙湿疹样皮损、口角炎或慢性甲沟炎。（Dorland，第 27 版） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Candidiasis, Cutaneous" scope note C17.800.838.208.241 Chromoblastomycosis 着色芽生菌病 "Scaly papule or warty growth, caused by five fungi, that spreads as a result of satellite lesions affecting the foot or leg. The extremity may become swollen and, at its distal portion, covered with various nodular, tumorous, verrucous lesions that resemble cauliflower. In rare instances, the disease may begin on the hand or wrist and involve the entire upper extremity. (Arnold, Odom, and James, Andrew's Diseases of the Skin, 8th ed, p362)" 由五种真菌引起的鳞屑性丘疹或疣状增生，通过卫星灶扩散，累及足或腿。患肢可肿胀，其远端可覆盖各种类似菜花的结节状、肿瘤样、疣状损害。在罕见情况下，该病可始于手或腕部并累及整个上肢。（Arnold、Odom 和 James，Andrew's Diseases of the Skin，第 8 版，第 362 页） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Chromoblastomycosis" scope note C17.800.838.208.416 Hyalohyphomycosis 透明丝孢霉病 "OPPORTUNISTIC INFECTIONS caused by a heterogeneous group of MITOSPORIC FUNGI with clear (hyalo-) HYPHAE in the host. Common causative agents include ACREMONIUM; ASPERGILLUS; CHRYSOSPORIUM; FUSARIUM; PAECILOMYCES; PENICILLIUM; PSEUDALLESCHERIA; SCEDOSPORIUM; and SCOPULARIOPSIS. Normally a dermatomycoses, it can become invasive in the IMMUNOCOMPROMISED HOST." 由一组异质性的丝孢真菌（MITOSPORIC FUNGI）引起的机会性感染（OPPORTUNISTIC INFECTIONS），这些真菌在宿主体内具有透明（hyalo-）菌丝（HYPHAE）。常见病原包括枝顶孢属（ACREMONIUM）、曲霉属（ASPERGILLUS）、金孢子菌属（CHRYSOSPORIUM）、镰刀菌属（FUSARIUM）、拟青霉属（PAECILOMYCES）、青霉属（PENICILLIUM）、假阿利什霉属（PSEUDALLESCHERIA）、赛多孢属（SCEDOSPORIUM）和帚霉属（SCOPULARIOPSIS）。通常为一种皮肤真菌病，但在免疫功能低下宿主（IMMUNOCOMPROMISED HOST）中可成为侵袭性。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Hyalohyphomycosis" scope note C17.800.838.208.416.125 Alternariosis 链格孢病 "Opportunistic fungal infection by a member of ALTERNARIA genus." 由链格孢属（ALTERNARIA）成员引起的机会性真菌感染。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Alternariosis" scope note C17.800.838.208.416.375 Cerebral Phaeohyphomycosis 脑暗色丝孢霉病 "CNS infections caused by neurotropic dematiaceous fungi that contain melanin in their cell walls. The infections often result in BRAIN ABSCESS; ENCEPHALITIS; and MENINGITIS in patients who are often immunocompetent. The common causative fungi include members Cladophialophora bantiana, Exophiala dermatitidis, Rhinocladiella mackenziei, and Ochroconis gallopavum. R. mackenziei infection is seen almost exclusively in patients from the MIDDLE EAST." 由嗜神经暗色真菌引起的中枢神经系统感染，这些真菌的细胞壁含有黑色素。感染常导致脑脓肿（BRAIN ABSCESS）、脑炎（ENCEPHALITIS）和脑膜炎（MENINGITIS），患者往往免疫功能正常。常见致病真菌包括斑替枝孢瓶霉、皮炎外瓶霉、麦氏喙枝孢霉和鸡赭霉。麦氏喙枝孢霉感染几乎只见于来自中东（MIDDLE EAST）的患者。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Cerebral Phaeohyphomycosis" scope note C17.800.838.208.416.500 Fusariosis 镰刀菌病 "OPPORTUNISTIC INFECTIONS with the soil fungus FUSARIUM. Typically the infection is limited to the nail plate (ONYCHOMYCOSIS). The infection can however become systemic especially in an IMMUNOCOMPROMISED HOST (e.g., NEUTROPENIA) and results in cutaneous and subcutaneous lesions, fever, KERATITIS, and pulmonary infections." 由土壤真菌镰刀菌属（FUSARIUM）引起的机会性感染（OPPORTUNISTIC INFECTIONS）。通常感染局限于甲板（甲真菌病（ONYCHOMYCOSIS））。但感染可变为全身性，尤其在免疫功能低下宿主（IMMUNOCOMPROMISED HOST）（如中性粒细胞减少症（NEUTROPENIA））中，导致皮肤及皮下病变、发热、角膜炎（KERATITIS）和肺部感染。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Fusariosis" scope note C17.800.838.208.475 Lobomycosis 罗伯芽生菌病 "A chronic, fungal, subcutaneous infection endemic in rural regions in South America and Central America. The causal organism is Lacazia labol." 一种慢性、真菌性皮下感染，流行于南美洲和中美洲农村地区。病原体为罗伯菌（Lacazia labol）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Lobomycosis" scope note C17.800.838.208.557 Mycetoma 足菌肿 "A chronic progressive subcutaneous infection caused by species of fungi (eumycetoma), or actinomycetes (actinomycetoma). There are four major clinical types of this infection: cutaneous (Old and New World) (LEISHMANIASIS, CUTANEOUS), diffuse cutaneous (LEISHMANIASIS, DIFFUSE CUTANEOUS), mucocutaneous (LEISHMANIASIS, MUCOCUTANEOUS), and visceral (LEISHMANIASIS, VISCERAL)." 一种由利什曼原虫属（LEISHMANIA）中的多种原虫中任一种引起的疾病。该感染有四种主要临床类型：皮肤型（旧大陆和新大陆）（皮肤利什曼病，LEISHMANIASIS, CUTANEOUS）、弥漫性皮肤型（弥漫性皮肤利什曼病，LEISHMANIASIS, DIFFUSE CUTANEOUS）、黏膜皮肤型（黏膜皮肤利什曼病，LEISHMANIASIS, MUCOCUTANEOUS）和内脏型（内脏利什曼病，LEISHMANIASIS, VISCERAL）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Leishmaniasis" scope note C17.800.838.775.560.400 Leishmaniasis, Cutaneous 皮肤利什曼病 "An endemic disease that is characterized by the development of single or multiple localized lesions on exposed areas of skin that typically ulcerate. The disease has been divided into Old and New World forms. Old World leishmaniasis is separated into three distinct types according to epidemiology and clinical manifestations and is caused by species of the L. tropica and L. aethiopica complexes as well as by species of the L. major genus. New World leishmaniasis, also called American leishmaniasis, occurs in South and Central America and is caused by species of the L. mexicana or L. braziliensis complexes." 一种地方性疾病，特征为在暴露的皮肤部位出现单发或多发、通常会溃烂的局限性病变。该病分为旧大陆型和新大陆型。旧大陆利什曼病根据流行病学和临床表现分为三种不同类型，由热带利什曼原虫和埃塞俄比亚利什曼原虫复合体的种以及硕大利什曼原虫的种引起。新大陆利什曼病又称美洲利什曼病，发生于南美洲和中美洲，由墨西哥利什曼原虫或巴西利什曼原虫复合体的种引起。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Leishmaniasis, Cutaneous" scope note C17.800.838.775.560.400.350 Leishmaniasis, Diffuse Cutaneous 弥漫性皮肤利什曼病 "A form of LEISHMANIASIS, CUTANEOUS caused by Leishmania aethiopica in Ethiopia and Kenya, L. pifanoi in Venezuela, L. braziliensis in South America, and L. mexicana in Central America. This disease is characterized by massive dissemination of skin lesions without visceral involvement." 皮肤利什曼病（LEISHMANIASIS, CUTANEOUS）的一种类型，在埃塞俄比亚和肯尼亚由埃塞俄比亚利什曼原虫引起，在委内瑞拉由皮法诺利什曼原虫引起，在南美洲由巴西利什曼原虫引起，在中美洲由墨西哥利什曼原虫引起。该病的特征为皮肤病变大量播散而无内脏受累。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Leishmaniasis, Diffuse Cutaneous" scope note C17.800.838.775.560.400.385 Leishmaniasis, Mucocutaneous 黏膜皮肤利什曼病 "A disease characterized by the chronic, progressive spread of lesions from New World cutaneous leishmaniasis caused by species of the L. braziliensis complex to the nasal, pharyngeal, and buccal mucosa some time after the appearance of the initial cutaneous lesion. Nasal obstruction and epistaxis are frequent presenting symptoms." 一种疾病，特征为由 L. braziliensis 复合群菌种引起的新大陆皮肤利什曼病的皮损呈慢性、进行性扩散，在初发皮肤皮损出现一段时间后累及鼻、咽和颊黏膜。鼻塞和鼻出血是常见的首发症状。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Leishmaniasis, Mucocutaneous" scope note C17.800.838.775.580 Lice Infestations 虱病 "Parasitic attack or subsistence on the skin by members of the order Phthiraptera, especially on humans by Pediculus humanus of the family Pediculidae. The hair of the head, eyelashes, and pubis is a frequent site of infestation. (From Dorland, 28th ed; Stedman, 26th ed)" 虱目（Phthiraptera）成员在皮肤上的寄生侵袭或寄生生存，尤其是虱科（Pediculidae）的人虱（Pediculus humanus）在人体上的寄生。头发、睫毛和阴毛是常见的侵染部位。（引自 Dorland，第 28 版；Stedman，第 26 版） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Lice Infestations" scope note C17.800.838.775.690 Onchocerciasis 盘尾丝虫病 "Infection with nematodes of the genus ONCHOCERCA. Characteristics include the presence of firm subcutaneous nodules filled with adult worms, PRURITUS, and ocular lesions." 盘尾丝虫属（ONCHOCERCA）线虫的感染。特征包括存在充满成虫的坚实皮下结节、瘙痒（PRURITUS）和眼部病变。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Onchocerciasis" scope note C17.800.838.775.800 Scabies 疥疮 "A contagious cutaneous inflammation caused by the bite of the mite SARCOPTES SCABIEI. It is characterized by pruritic papular eruptions and burrows and affects primarily the axillae, elbows, wrists, and genitalia, although it can spread to cover the entire body." 一种传染性皮肤炎症，由疥螨（SARCOPTES SCABIEI）叮咬引起。其特征为瘙痒性丘疹和隧道，主要累及腋窝、肘部、腕部和生殖器，但也可扩展至全身。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Scabies" scope note C17.800.838.790 Skin Diseases, Viral 病毒性皮肤病 "Skin diseases caused by viruses." 由病毒引起的皮肤病。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Skin Diseases, Viral" scope note C17.800.838.790.260 Erythema Infectiosum 传染性红斑 "Contagious infection with HUMAN PAROVIRUS B19 most commonly seen in school age children and characterized by fever, headache, and rashes of the face, trunk, and extremities. It is often confused with RUBELLA." 一种人细小病毒 B19（HUMAN PAROVIRUS B19）的传染性感染，最常见于学龄儿童，特征为发热、头痛及面部、躯干和四肢皮疹。常与风疹（RUBELLA）混淆。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Erythema Infectiosum" scope note C17.800.838.790.290 Exanthema Subitum 幼儿急疹 "An acute, short-lived, viral disease of infants and young children characterized by a high fever at onset that drops to normal after 3-4 days and the concomitant appearance of a macular or maculopapular rash that appears first on the trunk and then spreads to other areas. It is the sixth of the classical exanthematous diseases and is caused by HHV-6; (HERPESVIRUS 6, HUMAN). (From Dorland, 27th ed)" 一种急性、短暂的婴幼儿病毒性疾病，特征为起病时高热，3 至 4 天后降至正常，同时出现斑疹或斑丘疹，先见于躯干，后扩散至其他部位。它是第六种经典出疹性疾病，由 HHV-6（人疱疹病毒 6 型（HERPESVIRUS 6, HUMAN））引起。（引自 Dorland，第 27 版） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Exanthema Subitum" scope note C17.800.838.790.320 Herpes Simplex 单纯疱疹 "A group of acute infections caused by herpes simplex virus type 1 or type 2 that is characterized by the development of one or more small fluid-filled vesicles with a raised erythematous base on the skin or mucous membrane. It occurs as a primary infection or recurs due to a reactivation of a latent infection. (Dorland, 27th ed.)" 一组由 1 型或 2 型单纯疱疹病毒引起的急性感染，特征为在皮肤或黏膜上出现一个或多个基底隆起发红的充液小水疱。可作为原发感染发生，或因潜伏感染再激活而复发。（Dorland，第 27 版） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Herpes Simplex" scope note C17.800.838.790.320.320 Herpes Labialis 唇疱疹 "Herpes simplex, caused by type 1 virus, primarily spread by oral secretions and usually occurring as a concomitant of fever. It may also develop in the absence of fever or prior illness. It commonly involves the facial region, especially the lips and the nares. (Dorland, 27th ed.)" 由 1 型病毒引起的单纯疱疹，主要通过口腔分泌物传播，通常伴随发热出现。也可在无发热或既往疾病的情况下发生。常累及面部，尤其是唇部和鼻孔。（Dorland，第 27 版） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Herpes Labialis" scope note C17.800.838.790.320.410 Kaposi Varicelliform Eruption 卡波西水痘样疹 "A disseminated vesicular-pustular eruption caused by the herpes simplex virus (HERPESVIRUS HOMINIS), the VACCINIA VIRUS, or Varicella zoster (HERPESVIRUS 3, HUMAN). It is usually superimposed on a preexisting, inactive or active, atopic dermatitis (DERMATITIS, ATOPIC)." 一种由单纯疱疹病毒（人疱疹病毒，HERPESVIRUS HOMINIS）、牛痘病毒（VACCINIA VIRUS）或水痘带状疱疹病毒（人疱疹病毒 3 型，HERPESVIRUS 3, HUMAN）引起的播散性水疱脓疱性皮疹。通常叠加于先前存在的、静止或活动的特应性皮炎（DERMATITIS, ATOPIC）之上。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Kaposi Varicelliform Eruption" scope note C17.800.838.790.550 Molluscum Contagiosum 传染性软疣 "A common, benign, usually self-limited viral infection of the skin and occasionally the conjunctivae by a poxvirus (MOLLUSCUM CONTAGIOSUM VIRUS). (Dorland, 27th ed)" 一种常见、良性、通常具有自限性的皮肤（偶尔累及结膜）病毒感染，由一种痘病毒（传染性软疣病毒（MOLLUSCUM CONTAGIOSUM VIRUS））引起。（Dorland，第 27 版） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Molluscum Contagiosum" scope note C17.800.838.790.810 Warts 疣 "Benign epidermal proliferations or tumors; some are viral in origin." 良性表皮增生或肿瘤；部分为病毒源性。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Warts" scope note C17.800.838.790.810.110 Condylomata Acuminata 尖锐湿疣 "Sexually transmitted form of anogenital warty growth caused by the HUMAN PAPILLOMAVIRUS VIRUSES." 由人乳头瘤病毒（HUMAN PAPILLOMAVIRUS VIRUSES）引起的经性传播的肛门生殖器疣状增生。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Condylomata Acuminata" scope note C17.800.838.790.810.110.500 Buschke-Lowenstein Tumor Buschke-Lowenstein 瘤 "Exophytic tumor of the anogenital region associated with HPV infections. It becomes a large cauliflower-like, hyperkeratotic, verrucous mass that is locally destructive with little atypical cells. Histologically, tumor cells are broad rete peg structures that tend to invade deeper than CONDYLOMATA ACUMINATA." 与 HPV 感染相关的肛门生殖器区外生性肿瘤。它会成为一个大的菜花样、角化过度、疣状肿块，具有局部破坏性，非典型细胞很少。组织学上，肿瘤细胞呈宽大的表皮突结构，比尖锐湿疣（CONDYLOMATA ACUMINATA）侵袭更深。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Buschke-Lowenstein Tumor" scope note C17.800.838.790.810.260 Epidermodysplasia Verruciformis 疣状表皮发育不良 "An autosomal recessive trait with impaired cell-mediated immunity. About 15 human papillomaviruses are implicated in associated infection, four of which lead to skin neoplasms. The disease begins in childhood with red papules and later spreads over the body as gray or yellow scales." 一种伴细胞介导免疫受损的常染色体隐性性状。约 15 种人乳头瘤病毒与相关感染有关，其中四种可导致皮肤肿瘤。本病始于儿童期，表现为红色丘疹，之后以灰色或黄色鳞屑形式蔓延全身。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Epidermodysplasia Verruciformis" scope note References National Library of Medicine. (2026). MeSH 2026 descriptor records [Data set]. Retrieved October 28, 2026, from https://www.nlm.nih.gov/databases/download/mesh.html

medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.summary: C17.800.849 Skin Diseases, Metabolic Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source C17.800.849 Skin Diseases, Metabolic 代谢性皮肤病 "Diseases of the skin associated with underlying metabolic disorders." 与基础代谢紊乱相关的皮肤疾病。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Skin Diseases, Metabolic" scope note C17.800.849.391 Lipodystrophy 脂肪营养不良 "A collection of heterogenous conditions resulting from defective LIPID METABOLISM and characterized by ADIPOSE TISSUE atrophy. Often there is redistribution of body fat resulting in peripheral fat wasting and central adiposity. They include generalized, localized, congenital, and acquired lipodystrophy." 一组异质性病症，由脂质代谢（LIPID METABOLISM）缺陷所致，特征为脂肪组织（ADIPOSE TISSUE）萎缩。常有身体脂肪的重新分布，导致外周脂肪消耗和向心性肥胖。包括全身性、局部性、先天性和获得性脂肪营养不良。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Lipodystrophy" scope note C17.800.849.391.400 HIV-Associated Lipodystrophy Syndrome HIV 相关脂肪代谢障碍综合征 "Defective metabolism leading to fat maldistribution in patients infected with HIV. The etiology appears to be multifactorial and probably involves some combination of infection-induced alterations in metabolism, direct effects of antiretroviral therapy, and patient-related factors." 代谢缺陷导致 HIV 感染患者的脂肪分布异常。其病因似为多因素，可能涉及感染所致代谢改变、抗逆转录病毒治疗的直接作用以及患者相关因素的某种组合。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "HIV-Associated Lipodystrophy Syndrome" scope note C17.800.849.391.550 Lipodystrophy, Congenital Generalized 先天性全身性脂肪营养不良 "Congenital disorders, usually autosomal recessive, characterized by severe generalized lack of ADIPOSE TISSUE, extreme INSULIN RESISTANCE, and HYPERTRIGLYCERIDEMIA." 先天性疾病，通常为常染色体隐性遗传，特征为严重的全身性脂肪组织（ADIPOSE TISSUE）缺乏、极度胰岛素抵抗（INSULIN RESISTANCE）和高甘油三酯血症（HYPERTRIGLYCERIDEMIA）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Lipodystrophy, Congenital Generalized" scope note C17.800.849.391.700 Lipodystrophy, Familial Partial 家族性部分性脂肪营养不良 "Inherited conditions characterized by the partial loss of ADIPOSE TISSUE, either confined to the extremities with normal or increased fat deposits on the face, neck and trunk (type 1), or confined to the loss of SUBCUTANEOUS FAT from the limbs and trunk (type 2). Type 3 is associated with mutation in the gene encoding PEROXISOME PROLIFERATOR-ACTIVATED RECEPTOR GAMMA." 遗传性病症，其特征为脂肪组织（ADIPOSE TISSUE）部分丧失：或局限于四肢，而面部、颈部和躯干脂肪沉积正常或增加（1 型）；或局限于四肢和躯干的皮下脂肪（SUBCUTANEOUS FAT）丧失（2 型）。3 型与编码过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体γ（PEROXISOME PROLIFERATOR-ACTIVATED RECEPTOR GAMMA）的基因突变相关。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Lipodystrophy, Familial Partial" scope note C17.800.849.495 Necrobiosis Lipoidica 类脂质渐进性坏死 "A degenerative disease of the dermal connective tissue characterized by the development of erythematous papules or nodules in the pretibial area. The papules form plaques covered with telangiectatic vessels. More than half of the affected patients have diabetes." 一种真皮结缔组织的变性疾病，特征为胫前区出现红斑性丘疹或结节。丘疹融合成斑块，表面覆有毛细血管扩张的血管。半数以上患者患有糖尿病。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Necrobiosis Lipoidica" scope note References National Library of Medicine. (2026). MeSH 2026 descriptor records [Data set]. Retrieved October 28, 2026, from https://www.nlm.nih.gov/databases/download/mesh.html

medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.title: C17.800.859 Skin Diseases, Papulosquamous | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.summary: C17.800.859 Skin Diseases, Papulosquamous Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source C17.800.859 Skin Diseases, Papulosquamous 丘疹鳞屑性皮肤病 "A group of dermatoses with distinct morphologic features. The primary lesion is most commonly a papule, usually erythematous, with a variable degree of scaling on the surface. Plaques form through the coalescing of primary lesions." 一组具有独特形态特征的皮肤病。原发皮损最常见为丘疹，通常为红斑性，表面有不同程度的鳞屑。原发皮损融合形成斑块。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Skin Diseases, Papulosquamous" scope note C17.800.859.350 Dermatitis, Seborrheic 脂溢性皮炎 "A chronic inflammatory disease of the skin with unknown etiology. It is characterized by moderate ERYTHEMA, dry, moist, or greasy (SEBACEOUS GLAND) scaling and yellow crusted patches on various areas, especially the scalp, that exfoliate as dandruff. Seborrheic dermatitis is common in children and adolescents with HIV INFECTIONS." 一种病因不明的慢性炎症性皮肤病。特征为中度红斑（ERYTHEMA）、干性、湿性或油腻性（皮脂腺（SEBACEOUS GLAND））鳞屑，以及身体各部位尤其是头皮上的黄色结痂斑片，后者以头皮屑形式脱落。脂溢性皮炎常见于患有 HIV 感染（HIV INFECTIONS）的儿童和青少年。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Dermatitis, Seborrheic" scope note C17.800.859.475 Lichenoid Eruptions 苔藓样疹 "Conditions in which there is histological damage to the lower epidermis along with a grouped chronic inflammatory infiltrate in the papillary dermis disturbing the interface between the epidermis and dermis. LICHEN PLANUS is the prototype of all lichenoid eruptions. (From Rook et al., Textbook of Dermatology, 4th ed, p398)" 一类病症，组织学上存在表皮下部损伤，并伴真皮乳头层成群的慢性炎症细胞浸润，扰乱表皮与真皮之间的交界面。扁平苔藓（LICHEN PLANUS）是所有苔藓样疹的原型。（引自 Rook 等，《皮肤病学教科书》，第 4 版，第 398 页） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Lichenoid Eruptions" scope note C17.800.859.475.545 Lichen Nitidus 光泽苔藓 "A chronic inflammatory disease characterized by shiny, flat-topped, usually flesh-colored micropapules no larger than the head of a pin. Lesions are localized in the early stages, found chiefly on the lower abdomen, penis, and inner surface of the thighs. Distribution may become generalized as the disease progresses." 一种慢性炎症性疾病，特征为有光泽、顶部扁平、通常呈肤色的微小丘疹，不大于针头。早期皮损局限，主要见于下腹部、阴茎和大腿内侧。随病情进展，分布可变为泛发。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Lichen Nitidus" scope note C17.800.859.475.560 Lichen Planus 扁平苔藓 "An inflammatory, pruritic disease of the skin and mucous membranes, which can be either generalized or localized. It is characterized by distinctive purplish, flat-topped papules having a predilection for the trunk and flexor surfaces. The lesions may be discrete or coalesce to form plaques. Histologically, there is a saw-tooth pattern of epidermal hyperplasia and vacuolar alteration of the basal layer of the epidermis along with an intense upper dermal inflammatory infiltrate composed predominantly of T-cells. Etiology is unknown." 一种皮肤和黏膜的炎症性瘙痒性疾病，可为泛发性或局限性。特征为独特的紫色平顶丘疹，好发于躯干和屈侧。损害可散在分布，也可融合成斑块。组织学上可见锯齿状表皮增生和表皮基底层空泡变性，伴以 T 细胞为主的真皮上部致密炎症浸润。病因不明。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Lichen Planus" scope note C17.800.859.475.560.397 Lichen Planus, Oral 口腔扁平苔藓 "Oral lesions accompanying cutaneous lichen planus or often occurring alone. The buccal mucosa, lips, gingivae, floor of the mouth, and palate are usually affected (in a descending order of frequency). Typically, oral lesions consist of radiating white or gray, velvety, threadlike lines, arranged in a reticular pattern, at the intersection of which there may be minute, white, elevated dots or streaks (Wickham's striae). (Jablonski, Illustrated Dictionary of Dentistry)" 伴随皮肤扁平苔藓或常单独发生的口腔病变。通常累及颊黏膜、唇、牙龈、口底和腭（按发生频率递减排列）。典型的口腔病变由放射状的白色或灰色、天鹅绒样、丝线状线条组成，呈网状排列，其交叉处可有微小的白色隆起小点或条纹（威克姆纹）。（Jablonski，Illustrated Dictionary of Dentistry） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Lichen Planus, Oral" scope note C17.800.859.475.605 Lichen Sclerosus et Atrophicus 硬化萎缩性苔藓 "A chronic inflammatory mucocutaneous disease usually affecting the female genitalia (VULVAR LICHEN SCLEROSUS) and BALANITIS XEROTICA OBLITERANS in males. It is also called white spot disease and Csillag's disease." 一种慢性炎症性皮肤黏膜疾病，在女性通常累及外生殖器（外阴硬化性苔藓（VULVAR LICHEN SCLEROSUS）），在男性表现为闭塞性干燥性龟头炎（BALANITIS XEROTICA OBLITERANS）。又称白点病和 Csillag 病。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Lichen Sclerosus et Atrophicus" scope note C17.800.859.475.650 Pityriasis Lichenoides 苔藓样糠疹 "A subgroup of PARAPSORIASIS itself divided into acute and chronic forms. The acute form is characterized by the abrupt onset of a generalized, reddish-brown, maculopapular eruption. Lesions may be vesicular, hemorrhagic, crusted, or necrotic. Histologically the disease is characterized by epidermal necrolysis. The chronic form shows milder skin changes with necrosis." 副银屑病（PARAPSORIASIS）的一个亚组，本身又分为急性和慢性两型。急性型特征为突然出现泛发性红棕色斑丘疹。皮损可呈水疱性、出血性、结痂性或坏死性。组织学上该病以表皮坏死松解为特征。慢性型皮肤改变较轻，伴坏死。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Pityriasis Lichenoides" scope note C17.800.859.575 Parapsoriasis 副银屑病 "The term applied to a group of relatively uncommon inflammatory, maculopapular, scaly eruptions of unknown etiology and resistant to conventional treatment. Eruptions are both psoriatic and lichenoid in appearance, but the diseases are distinct from psoriasis, lichen planus, or other recognized dermatoses. Proposed nomenclature divides parapsoriasis into two distinct subgroups, PITYRIASIS LICHENOIDES and parapsoriasis en plaques (small- and large-plaque parapsoriasis)." 用于一组相对少见的病因不明的炎症性斑丘疹性鳞屑性皮疹的术语，对常规治疗抵抗。皮疹外观兼具银屑病样和苔藓样，但这些疾病有别于银屑病、扁平苔藓或其他已知皮肤病。拟议的命名法将副银屑病分为两个不同亚组：苔藓样糠疹（PITYRIASIS LICHENOIDES）和斑块状副银屑病（小斑块和大斑块副银屑病）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Parapsoriasis" scope note C17.800.859.575.650 Pityriasis Lichenoides 苔藓样糠疹 "A subgroup of PARAPSORIASIS itself divided into acute and chronic forms. The acute form is characterized by the abrupt onset of a generalized, reddish-brown, maculopapular eruption. Lesions may be vesicular, hemorrhagic, crusted, or necrotic. Histologically the disease is characterized by epidermal necrolysis. The chronic form shows milder skin changes with necrosis." 副银屑病（PARAPSORIASIS）的一个亚组，本身又分为急性和慢性两型。急性型特征为突然出现泛发性红棕色斑丘疹。皮损可呈水疱性、出血性、结痂性或坏死性。组织学上该病以表皮坏死松解为特征。慢性型皮肤改变较轻，伴坏死。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Pityriasis Lichenoides" scope note C17.800.859.600 Pityriasis 糠疹 "A name originally applied to a group of skin diseases characterized by the formation of fine, branny scales, but now used only with a modifier. (Dorland, 27th ed)" 最初用于一组以形成细小糠状鳞屑为特征的皮肤病的名称，但现在仅与修饰语连用。（Dorland，第 27 版） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Pityriasis" scope note C17.800.859.600.650 Pityriasis Lichenoides 苔藓样糠疹 "A subgroup of PARAPSORIASIS itself divided into acute and chronic forms. The acute form is characterized by the abrupt onset of a generalized, reddish-brown, maculopapular eruption. Lesions may be vesicular, hemorrhagic, crusted, or necrotic. Histologically the disease is characterized by epidermal necrolysis. The chronic form shows milder skin changes with necrosis." 副银屑病（PARAPSORIASIS）的一个亚组，本身又分为急性和慢性两型。急性型特征为突然出现泛发性红棕色斑丘疹。皮损可呈水疱性、出血性、结痂性或坏死性。组织学上该病以表皮坏死松解为特征。慢性型皮肤改变较轻，伴坏死。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Pityriasis Lichenoides" scope note C17.800.859.600.675 Pityriasis Rosea 玫瑰糠疹 "A mild exanthematous inflammation of unknown etiology. It is characterized by the presence of salmon-colored maculopapular lesions. The most striking feature is the arrangement of the lesions such that the long axis is parallel to the lines of cleavage. The eruptions are usually generalized, affecting chiefly the trunk, and the course is often self-limiting." 一种病因不明的轻度发疹性炎症。其特征为存在橙红色斑丘疹。最显著的特点是皮损的排列，其长轴与皮肤裂纹线平行。皮疹通常泛发，主要累及躯干，病程常呈自限性。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Pityriasis Rosea" scope note C17.800.859.600.685 Pityriasis Rubra Pilaris 毛发红糠疹 "A chronic skin disease characterized by small follicular papules, disseminated reddish-brown scaly patches, and often, palmoplantar hyperkeratosis. The papules are about the size of a pin and topped by a horny plug." 一种慢性皮肤病，特征为小的毛囊性丘疹、播散的红褐色鳞屑性斑片，且常伴掌跖角化过度。丘疹约针头大小，顶端有角质栓。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Pityriasis Rubra Pilaris" scope note C17.800.859.675 Psoriasis 银屑病 "A common genetically determined, chronic, inflammatory skin disease characterized by rounded erythematous, dry, scaling patches. The lesions have a predilection for nails, scalp, genitalia, extensor surfaces, and the lumbosacral region. Accelerated epidermopoiesis is considered to be the fundamental pathologic feature in psoriasis." 一种常见的遗传决定的慢性炎症性皮肤病，特征为圆形、红斑性、干燥、覆有鳞屑的斑片。皮损好发于指甲、头皮、生殖器、伸侧面和腰骶部。表皮生成加速被认为是银屑病的基本病理特征。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Psoriasis" scope note C17.800.859.675.175 Arthritis, Psoriatic 银屑病关节炎 "A type of inflammatory arthritis associated with PSORIASIS, often involving the axial joints and the peripheral terminal interphalangeal joints. It is characterized by the presence of HLA-B27-associated SPONDYLARTHROPATHY, and the absence of rheumatoid factor." 一种与银屑病（PSORIASIS）相关的炎性关节炎，常累及中轴关节及外周远端指间关节。其特征为存在 HLA-B27 相关的脊柱关节病（SPONDYLARTHROPATHY），且类风湿因子阴性。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Arthritis, Psoriatic" scope note C17.800.859.675.587 Guttate Psoriasis 点滴状银屑病 "A skin condition, typically emerges suddenly and frequently occurs after an infection such as STREPTOCOCCAL INFECTION. While prevalent among children, it can also manifest in young adults. Its defining feature is the eruption of small, red, scaly patches that typically appear on the arms, legs, and torso." 一种皮肤病，通常突然出现，常在感染如链球菌感染（STREPTOCOCCAL INFECTION）后发生。虽在儿童中多见，也可见于年轻成人。其决定性特征是突然出现小的、红色、有鳞屑的斑片，通常见于手臂、腿部和躯干。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Guttate Psoriasis" scope note References National Library of Medicine. medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.summary: C17.800.862 Skin Diseases, Vascular Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source C17.800.862 Skin Diseases, Vascular 血管性皮肤病 "Skin diseases affecting or involving the cutaneous blood vessels and generally manifested as inflammation, swelling, erythema, or necrosis in the affected area." 影响或累及皮肤血管的皮肤疾病，通常在受累部位表现为炎症、肿胀、红斑或坏死。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Skin Diseases, Vascular" scope note C17.800.862.060 Angiomatosis, Bacillary 杆菌性血管瘤病 "A reactive vascular proliferation that is characterized by the multiple tumor-like lesions in skin, bone, brain, and other organs. Bacillary angiomatosis is caused by infection with gram-negative Bartonella bacilli (such as BARTONELLA HENSELAE), and is often seen in AIDS patients and other IMMUNOCOMPROMISED HOSTS." 一种反应性血管增生，特征为皮肤、骨、脑及其他器官的多发瘤样病变。杆菌性血管瘤病由感染革兰氏阴性巴尔通体杆菌（如汉赛巴尔通体（BARTONELLA HENSELAE））引起，常见于艾滋病患者和其他免疫功能低下宿主（IMMUNOCOMPROMISED HOSTS）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Angiomatosis, Bacillary" scope note C17.800.862.105 Anti-Neutrophil Cytoplasmic Antibody-Associated Vasculitis 抗中性粒细胞胞质抗体相关性血管炎 "Group of systemic vasculitis with a strong association with ANCA. The disorders are characterized by necrotizing inflammation of small and medium size vessels, with little or no immune-complex deposits in vessel walls." 一组与抗中性粒细胞胞质抗体（ANCA）密切相关的系统性血管炎。这些疾病的特征为中小血管的坏死性炎症，血管壁中免疫复合物沉积很少或没有。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Anti-Neutrophil Cytoplasmic Antibody-Associated Vasculitis" scope note C17.800.862.105.500 Churg-Strauss Syndrome 变应性肉芽肿性血管炎 "Widespread necrotizing angiitis with granulomas. Pulmonary involvement is frequent. Asthma or other respiratory infection may precede evidence of vasculitis. Eosinophilia and lung involvement differentiate this disease from POLYARTERITIS NODOSA." 伴肉芽肿的广泛坏死性血管炎。常有肺部受累。哮喘或其他呼吸道感染可先于血管炎的证据出现。嗜酸性粒细胞增多和肺部受累可将本病与结节性多动脉炎（POLYARTERITIS NODOSA）相区别。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Churg-Strauss Syndrome" scope note C17.800.862.105.750 Microscopic Polyangiitis 显微镜下多血管炎 "A primary systemic vasculitis of small- and some medium-sized vessels. It is characterized by a tropism for kidneys and lungs, positive association with anti-neutrophil cytoplasmic antibodies (ANCA), and a paucity of immunoglobulin deposits in vessel walls." 一种累及小血管及部分中等血管的原发性系统性血管炎。其特征为偏好累及肾和肺，与抗中性粒细胞胞质抗体（ANCA）呈正相关，血管壁中免疫球蛋白沉积稀少。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Microscopic Polyangiitis" scope note C17.800.862.105.875 Granulomatosis with Polyangiitis 肉芽肿性多血管炎 "A multisystemic disease of a complex genetic background. It is characterized by inflammation of the blood vessels (VASCULITIS) leading to damage in any number of organs. The common features include granulomatous inflammation of the RESPIRATORY TRACT and KIDNEYS. Most patients have measurable autoantibodies (ANTINEUTROPHIL CYTOPLASMIC ANTIBODIES) against MYELOBLASTIN." 一种具有复杂遗传背景的多系统疾病。其特征为血管的炎症（血管炎（VASCULITIS）），导致任意数量的器官受损。常见特征包括呼吸道（RESPIRATORY TRACT）和肾脏（KIDNEYS）的肉芽肿性炎症。大多数患者具有可测得的针对髓成细胞素（MYELOBLASTIN）的自身抗体（抗中性粒细胞胞质抗体（ANTINEUTROPHIL CYTOPLASMIC ANTIBODIES））。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Granulomatosis with Polyangiitis" scope note C17.800.862.150 Behcet Syndrome 白塞综合征 "Rare chronic inflammatory disease involving the small blood vessels. It is of unknown etiology and characterized by mucocutaneous ulceration in the mouth and genital region and uveitis with hypopyon. The neuro-ocular form may cause blindness and death. SYNOVITIS; THROMBOPHLEBITIS; gastrointestinal ulcerations; RETINAL VASCULITIS; and OPTIC ATROPHY may occur as well." 一种罕见的累及小血管的慢性炎症性疾病。其病因不明，特征为口腔和生殖器区域的皮肤黏膜溃疡以及伴前房积脓的葡萄膜炎。神经眼型可导致失明和死亡。也可发生滑膜炎（SYNOVITIS）、血栓性静脉炎（THROMBOPHLEBITIS）、胃肠道溃疡、视网膜血管炎（RETINAL VASCULITIS）和视神经萎缩（OPTIC ATROPHY）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Behcet Syndrome" scope note C17.800.862.201 Cryoglobulinemia 冷球蛋白血症 "A condition characterized by the presence of abnormal quantities of CRYOGLOBULINS in the blood. Upon cold exposure, these abnormal proteins precipitate into the microvasculature leading to restricted blood flow in the exposed areas." 一种病症，其特征为血液中存在异常数量的冷球蛋白（CRYOGLOBULINS）。遇冷时，这些异常蛋白在微血管中沉淀，导致暴露部位血流受限。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Cryoglobulinemia" scope note C17.800.862.252 Giant Cell Arteritis 巨细胞动脉炎 "A systemic autoimmune disorder that typically affects medium and large ARTERIES, usually leading to occlusive granulomatous vasculitis with transmural infiltrate containing multinucleated GIANT CELLS. The TEMPORAL ARTERY is commonly involved. This disorder appears primarily in people over the age of 50. Symptoms include FEVER; FATIGUE; HEADACHE; visual impairment; pain in the jaw and tongue; and aggravation of pain by cold temperatures. (From Adams et al., Principles of Neurology, 6th ed)" 一种系统性自身免疫病，通常累及中、大动脉（ARTERIES），常导致闭塞性肉芽肿性血管炎，伴含多核巨细胞（GIANT CELLS）的全层浸润。常累及颞动脉（TEMPORAL ARTERY）。该病主要见于 50 岁以上人群。症状包括发热（FEVER）、疲劳（FATIGUE）、头痛（HEADACHE）、视力障碍、颌部和舌部疼痛，以及寒冷使疼痛加重。（引自 Adams 等，《Principles of Neurology》，第 6 版） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Giant Cell Arteritis" scope note C17.800.862.329 IgA Vasculitis IgA 血管炎 "A systemic non-thrombocytopenic purpura caused by HYPERSENSITIVITY VASCULITIS and deposition of IGA-containing IMMUNE COMPLEXES within the blood vessels throughout the body, including those in the kidney (KIDNEY GLOMERULUS). Clinical symptoms include URTICARIA; ERYTHEMA; ARTHRITIS; GASTROINTESTINAL HEMORRHAGE; and renal involvement. Most cases are seen in children after acute upper respiratory infections." 一种全身性非血小板减少性紫癜，由超敏性血管炎（HYPERSENSITIVITY VASCULITIS）及含 IgA 的免疫复合物（IMMUNE COMPLEXES）在全身血管内沉积所致，包括肾内血管（肾小球（KIDNEY GLOMERULUS））。临床症状包括荨麻疹（URTICARIA）、红斑（ERYTHEMA）、关节炎（ARTHRITIS）、胃肠道出血（GASTROINTESTINAL HEMORRHAGE）和肾脏受累。多数病例见于儿童急性上呼吸道感染之后。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "IgA Vasculitis" scope note C17.800.862.406 Livedoid Vasculopathy 青斑样血管病 "A rare cutaneous thrombotic disease due to occlusion of dermal vessels. It is characterized by purpuric maculae and ulcerations especially during summer which form scars called atrophie blanche. It is more associated with other syndromes (e.g., PROTEIN C DEFICIENCY; HYPERHOMOCYSTEINEMIA). Livedo reticularis with systemic involvement and stroke is SNEDDON SYNDROME." 一种由真皮血管闭塞引起的罕见皮肤血栓性疾病。其特征为紫癜性斑疹和溃疡，尤其在夏季出现，形成称为白色萎缩的瘢痕。更多与其他综合征相关（如蛋白 C 缺乏症（PROTEIN C DEFICIENCY）；高同型半胱氨酸血症（HYPERHOMOCYSTEINEMIA））。伴有全身受累和卒中的网状青斑为斯内登综合征（SNEDDON SYNDROME）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Livedoid Vasculopathy" scope note C17.800.862.406.500 Livedo Reticularis 网状青斑 "A condition characterized by a reticular or fishnet pattern on the skin of lower extremities and other parts of the body. This red and blue pattern is due to deoxygenated blood in unstable dermal blood vessels. The condition is intensified by cold exposure and relieved by rewarming." 一种病症，特征为下肢及身体其他部位皮肤上出现网状或渔网状花纹。这种红蓝色花纹是由于不稳定的真皮血管中的脱氧血液所致。遇冷加重，复温后缓解。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Livedo Reticularis" scope note C17.800.862.406.750 Raynaud Disease 雷诺病 "An idiopathic vascular disorder characterized by bilateral Raynaud phenomenon, the abrupt onset of digital paleness or CYANOSIS in response to cold exposure or stress." 一种特发性血管疾病，其特征为双侧雷诺现象，即遇冷或应激时手指突然苍白或发绀（CYANOSIS）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Raynaud Disease" scope note C17.800.862.406.750.500 CREST Syndrome CREST 综合征 "A mild form of LIMITED SCLERODERMA, a multi-system disorder. Its features include symptoms of CALCINOSIS; RAYNAUD DISEASE; ESOPHAGEAL MOTILITY DISORDERS; sclerodactyly, and TELANGIECTASIS. When the defect in esophageal function is not prominent, it is known as CRST syndrome." 局限性硬皮病（LIMITED SCLERODERMA）的一种轻型，是一种多系统疾病。其特征包括钙质沉着（CALCINOSIS）、雷诺病（RAYNAUD DISEASE）、食管动力障碍（ESOPHAGEAL MOTILITY DISORDERS）、指端硬化和毛细血管扩张（TELANGIECTASIS）等症状。当食管功能缺陷不明显时，称为 CRST 综合征。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "CREST Syndrome" scope note C17.800.862.457 Malignant Atrophic Papulosis 恶性萎缩性丘疹病 "Variously described as a vasculopathy, endovasculitis, or occlusive arteriopathy, this condition occurs in a benign cutaneous form and a lethal multiorgan systemic variant. It is characterized by a narrowing and occlusion of the lumen of small to medium-sized blood vessels, leading to ischemia and infarction in the involved organ systems. The etiology and pathophysiology are unknown." 该病被不同地描述为血管病、血管内膜炎或闭塞性动脉病，有良性皮肤型和致死性多器官系统变异型。其特征为中小血管管腔狭窄和闭塞，导致受累器官系统缺血和梗死。其病因和病理生理学不明。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Malignant Atrophic Papulosis" scope note C17.800.862.560 Mucocutaneous Lymph Node Syndrome 皮肤黏膜淋巴结综合征 "An acute, febrile, mucocutaneous condition accompanied by swelling of cervical lymph nodes in infants and young children. The principal symptoms are fever, congestion of the ocular conjunctivae, reddening of the lips and oral cavity, protuberance of tongue papillae, and edema or erythema of the extremities." 一种急性、发热性、皮肤黏膜病症，伴婴幼儿颈部淋巴结肿大。主要症状为发热、眼结膜充血、口唇和口腔发红、舌乳头突出以及四肢水肿或红斑。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Mucocutaneous Lymph Node Syndrome" scope note C17.800.862.625 Polyarteritis Nodosa 结节性多动脉炎 "A form of necrotizing non-granulomatous inflammation occurring primarily in medium-sized ARTERIES, often with microaneurysms. It is characterized by muscle, joint, and abdominal pain resulting from arterial infarction and scarring in affected organs. Polyarteritis nodosa with lung involvement is called CHURG-STRAUSS SYNDROME." 一种坏死性非肉芽肿性炎症，主要发生于中等大小的动脉（ARTERIES），常伴微动脉瘤。其特征为受累器官动脉梗死和瘢痕形成所致的肌肉、关节和腹部疼痛。伴有肺部受累的结节性多动脉炎称为 Churg-Strauss 综合征（CHURG-STRAUSS SYNDROME）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Polyarteritis Nodosa" scope note C17.800.862.675 Pyoderma Gangrenosum 坏疽性脓皮病 "An idiopathic, rapidly evolving, and severely debilitating disease occurring most commonly in association with chronic ulcerative colitis. It is characterized by the presence of boggy, purplish ulcers with undermined borders, appearing mostly on the legs. The majority of cases are in people between 40 and 60 years old. Its etiology is unknown." 一种特发性、进展迅速且严重致衰弱的疾病，最常与慢性溃疡性结肠炎相伴发生。其特征为出现边缘潜行的松软紫色溃疡，多见于腿部。大多数病例为 40 至 60 岁的人。其病因不明。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Pyoderma Gangrenosum" scope note C17.800.862.775 Sneddon Syndrome Sneddon 综合征 "A systemic non-inflammatory arteriopathy primarily of middle-aged females characterized by the association of LIVEDO RETICULARIS, multiple thrombotic CEREBRAL INFARCTION; CORONARY DISEASE, and HYPERTENSION. Elevation of antiphospholipid antibody titers (see also ANTIPHOSPHOLIPID SYNDROME), cardiac valvulopathy, ISCHEMIC ATTACK, TRANSIENT; SEIZURES; DEMENTIA; and chronic ischemia of the extremities may also occur. Pathologic examination of affected arteries reveals non-inflammatory adventitial fibrosis, thrombosis, and changes in the media (From Jablonski, Dictionary of Syndromes & Eponymic Diseases, 2d ed; Adams et al., Principles of Neurology, 6th ed, p861; Arch Neurol 1997 Jan;54(1):53-60). Mutations in the CECR1 gene (ADA2 protein, human) are associated with Sneddon syndrome." 一种主要见于中年女性的全身性非炎症性动脉病，特征为网状青斑（LIVEDO RETICULARIS）、多发性血栓性脑梗死（CEREBRAL INFARCTION）、冠状动脉疾病（CORONARY DISEASE）和高血压（HYPERTENSION）合并存在。还可出现抗磷脂抗体滴度升高（另见抗磷脂综合征（ANTIPHOSPHOLIPID SYNDROME））、心脏瓣膜病、短暂性脑缺血发作（ISCHEMIC ATTACK, TRANSIENT）、癫痫发作（SEIZURES）、痴呆（DEMENTIA）以及四肢慢性缺血。受累动脉的病理检查显示非炎症性外膜纤维化、血栓形成和中膜改变（引自 Jablonski，Dictionary of Syndromes & Eponymic Diseases，第 2 版；Adams 等，Principles of Neurology，第 6 版，第 861 页；Arch Neurol 1997 Jan;54(1):53-60）。CECR1 基因（ADA2 蛋白，人）突变与 Sneddon 综合征相关。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Sneddon Syndrome" scope note C17.800.862.875 Takayasu Arteritis 大动脉炎 "A chronic inflammatory process that affects the AORTA and its primary branches, such as the brachiocephalic artery (BRACHIOCEPHALIC TRUNK) and CAROTID ARTERIES. It results in progressive arterial stenosis, occlusion, and aneurysm formation. The pulse in the arm is hard to detect. Patients with aortitis syndrome often exhibit retinopathy." 一种累及主动脉（AORTA）及其主要分支的慢性炎症过程，这些分支如头臂动脉（头臂干，BRACHIOCEPHALIC TRUNK）和颈动脉（CAROTID ARTERIES）。它导致进行性动脉狭窄、闭塞和动脉瘤形成。上肢脉搏难以触及。主动脉炎综合征患者常出现视网膜病变。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Takayasu Arteritis" scope note C17.800.862.945 Urticaria 荨麻疹 "A vascular reaction of the skin characterized by erythema and wheal formation due to localized increase of vascular permeability. The causative mechanism may be allergy, infection, or stress." 一种皮肤血管反应，特征为局部血管通透性增加所致的红斑和风团形成。致病机制可能是过敏、感染或应激。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Urticaria" scope note C17.800.862.945.066 Angioedema 血管性水肿 "Swelling involving the deep DERMIS, subcutaneous, or submucosal tissues, representing localized EDEMA. Angioedema often occurs in the face, lips, tongue, and larynx." 累及真皮（DERMIS）深层、皮下或黏膜下组织的肿胀，表现为局限性水肿（EDEMA）。血管性水肿常发生于面部、口唇、舌和喉部。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Angioedema" scope note C17.800.862.945.066.500 Angioedemas, Hereditary 遗传性血管性水肿 "Inherited disorders that are characterized by subcutaneous and submucosal EDEMA in the upper RESPIRATORY TRACT and GASTROINTESTINAL TRACT." 遗传性疾病，特征为上呼吸道（RESPIRATORY TRACT）和胃肠道（GASTROINTESTINAL TRACT）的皮下和黏膜下水肿（EDEMA）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Angioedemas, Hereditary" scope note C17.800.862.945.066.500.500 Hereditary Angioedema Type III 遗传性血管性水肿 III 型 "A form of hereditary angioedema that occurs in women and is precipitated or worsened by high ESTROGEN levels. It is associated with mutations in the gene for FACTOR XII that result in its increased activity." 一种发生于女性的遗传性血管性水肿，由高雌激素（ESTROGEN）水平诱发或加重。它与凝血因子 XII（FACTOR XII）基因突变相关，该突变导致其活性增加。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Hereditary Angioedema Type III" scope note C17.800.862.945.066.500.750 Hereditary Angioedema Types I and II I 型和 II 型遗传性血管性水肿 "Forms of hereditary angioedema that occur due to mutations in the gene for COMPLEMENT C1 INHIBITOR PROTEIN. Type I hereditary angioedema is associated with reduced serum levels of complement C1 inhibitor protein. Type II hereditary angioedema is associated with the production of a non-functional complement C1 inhibitor protein." 遗传性血管性水肿的若干类型，由补体 C1 抑制蛋白（COMPLEMENT C1 INHIBITOR PROTEIN）基因突变所致。I 型遗传性血管性水肿与血清补体 C1 抑制蛋白水平降低相关。II 型遗传性血管性水肿与产生无功能的补体 C1 抑制蛋白相关。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Hereditary Angioedema Types I and II" scope note C17.800.862.945.533 Chronic Urticaria 慢性荨麻疹 "Wheals (urticaria) and/or angioedema presented with daily symptoms lasting for more than 6 weeks. It may be classified into chronic spontaneous and chronic inducible urticaria depending on whether a specific trigger can be linked to the development of vascular reaction." 风团（荨麻疹）和/或血管性水肿，伴每日症状持续超过 6 周。根据能否将特定诱因与血管反应的发生联系起来，可分为慢性自发性荨麻疹和慢性诱导性荨麻疹。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Chronic Urticaria" scope note C17.800.862.945.533.500 Chronic Inducible Urticaria 慢性诱导性荨麻疹 "Chronic urticaria with identified triggering factor which is either physical, e.g., vibratory urticaria, or non-physical, e.g., aquagenic urticaria." 有明确诱发因素的慢性荨麻疹，诱发因素可为物理性的（如振动性荨麻疹），也可为非物理性的（如水源性荨麻疹）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Chronic Inducible Urticaria" scope note C17.800.862.945.533.500.500 Cryopyrin-Associated Periodic Syndromes 冷吡啉相关周期性综合征 "A group of rare autosomal dominant diseases, commonly characterized by atypical URTICARIA (hives) with systemic symptoms that develop into end-organ damage. The atypical hives do not involve T-cell or autoantibody. Cryopyrin-associated periodic syndrome includes three previously distinct disorders: Familial cold autoinflammatory syndrome; Muckle-Wells Syndrome; and CINCA Syndrome, that are now considered to represent a disease continuum, all caused by NLRP3 PROTEIN mutations." 一组罕见的常染色体显性遗传病，共同特征为伴全身症状的非典型荨麻疹（URTICARIA）（风团），可发展为终末器官损害。这种非典型风团不涉及 T 细胞或自身抗体。冷吡啉相关周期性综合征包括三种既往被视为独立的疾病：家族性寒冷自身炎症综合征、Muckle-Wells 综合征和 CINCA 综合征，现认为它们构成一个疾病连续谱，均由 NLRP3 蛋白（NLRP3 PROTEIN）突变引起。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Cryopyrin-Associated Periodic Syndromes" scope note C17.800.862.945.533.500.750 Urticaria, Solar 日光性荨麻疹 "Chromophore-dependent photodermatosis triggered by UV and visible light." 由紫外线和可见光诱发的依赖发色团的光照性皮肤病。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Urticaria, Solar" scope note C17.800.862.945.766 Cold Urticaria 寒冷性荨麻疹 "Various skin flares developing after exposure to cold temperature. While most are characterized by a limited episodic cutaneous condition characterized by URTICARIAL WHEALS, such as in allergic urticaria, other types are more severe and generalized and rarely familial, e.g., cryopyrin-associated periodic syndromes." 暴露于低温后出现的各种皮肤风团发作。多数表现为局限性发作性皮肤病症，特征为荨麻疹风团（URTICARIAL WHEALS），如变应性荨麻疹；其他类型则更为严重和泛发，且罕见家族性，如冷吡啉相关周期性综合征。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Cold Urticaria" scope note C17.800.862.945.766.500 Cryopyrin-Associated Periodic Syndromes 冷吡啉相关周期性综合征 "A group of rare autosomal dominant diseases, commonly characterized by atypical URTICARIA (hives) with systemic symptoms that develop into end-organ damage. The atypical hives do not involve T-cell or autoantibody. Cryopyrin-associated periodic syndrome includes three previously distinct disorders: Familial cold autoinflammatory syndrome; Muckle-Wells Syndrome; and CINCA Syndrome, that are now considered to represent a disease continuum, all caused by NLRP3 PROTEIN mutations." 一组罕见的常染色体显性遗传病，共同特征为伴全身症状的非典型荨麻疹（URTICARIA）（风团），可发展为终末器官损害。这种非典型风团不涉及 T 细胞或自身抗体。冷吡啉相关周期性综合征包括三种既往被视为独立的疾病：家族性寒冷自身炎症综合征、Muckle-Wells 综合征和 CINCA 综合征，现认为它们构成一个疾病连续谱，均由 NLRP3 蛋白（NLRP3 PROTEIN）突变引起。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Cryopyrin-Associated Periodic Syndromes" scope note C17.800.862.972 Vasculitis, Leukocytoclastic, Cutaneous 皮肤白细胞破碎性血管炎 "Disorder characterized by a vasculitic syndrome associated with exposure to an antigen such as a drug, infectious agent, or other foreign or endogenous substance. Its pathophysiology includes immune complex deposition and a wide range of skin lesions. Hypersensitivity or allergy is present in some but not all cases." 一种疾病，特征为与接触抗原相关的血管炎综合征，抗原如药物、感染因子或其他外源性或内源性物质。其病理生理包括免疫复合物沉积和多种皮肤损害。部分而非全部病例存在超敏反应或变态反应。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Vasculitis, Leukocytoclastic, Cutaneous" scope note References National Library of Medicine. (2026). MeSH 2026 descriptor records [Data set]. Retrieved October 28, 2026, from https://www.nlm.nih.gov/databases/download/mesh.html
