medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.summary: C17.800.865 Skin Diseases, Vesiculobullous Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source C17.800.865 Skin Diseases, Vesiculobullous 水疱大疱性皮肤病 "Skin diseases characterized by local or general distributions of blisters. They are classified according to the site and mode of blister formation. Lesions can appear spontaneously or be precipitated by infection, trauma, or sunlight. Etiologies include immunologic and genetic factors. (From Scientific American Medicine, 1990)" 以局部或全身分布的水疱为特征的皮肤疾病。根据水疱形成的部位和方式进行分类。皮损可自发出现，或由感染、外伤或日光诱发。病因包括免疫和遗传因素。（引自 Scientific American Medicine，1990） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Skin Diseases, Vesiculobullous" scope note C17.800.865.070 Acantholysis 棘层松解 "Separation of the prickle cells of the stratum spinosum of the epidermis, resulting in atrophy of the prickle cell layer. It is seen in diseases such as pemphigus vulgaris (see PEMPHIGUS) and DARIER DISEASE." 表皮棘层棘细胞之间的分离，导致棘细胞层萎缩。见于寻常型天疱疮（见天疱疮（PEMPHIGUS））和毛囊角化病（DARIER DISEASE）等疾病。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Acantholysis" scope note C17.800.865.187 Blister 水疱 "Visible accumulations of fluid within or beneath the epidermis." 表皮内或表皮下可见的液体积聚。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Blister" scope note C17.800.865.360 Dermatitis Herpetiformis 疱疹样皮炎 "Rare, chronic, papulo-vesicular disease characterized by an intensely pruritic eruption consisting of various combinations of symmetrical, erythematous, papular, vesicular, or bullous lesions. The disease is strongly associated with the presence of HLA-B8 and HLA-DR3 antigens. A variety of different autoantibodies has been detected in small numbers in patients with dermatitis herpetiformis." 一种罕见的慢性丘疹水疱性疾病，特征为剧烈瘙痒的皮疹，由对称性红斑、丘疹、水疱或大疱性病变的各种组合构成。该病与 HLA-B8 和 HLA-DR3 抗原的存在密切相关。在疱疹样皮炎患者中已检出少量多种不同的自身抗体。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Dermatitis Herpetiformis" scope note C17.800.865.385 Eczema, Dyshidrotic 汗疱疹 "A recurrent eczematous reaction characterized by the development of vesicular eruptions on the palms and soles, particularly along the sides and between the digits. It is accompanied by pruritus, a burning sensation, and hyperhidrosis. The disease is self-limiting, lasting only a few weeks. (Dorland, 27th ed)" 一种复发性湿疹样反应，特征为手掌和足底出现水疱性皮疹，尤其是沿指（趾）侧缘和指（趾）间。伴有瘙痒、烧灼感和多汗。该病为自限性，仅持续数周。（Dorland，第 27 版） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Eczema, Dyshidrotic" scope note C17.800.865.410 Epidermolysis Bullosa 大疱性表皮松解症 "Group of genetically determined disorders characterized by the blistering of skin and mucosae. There are four major forms: acquired, simple, junctional, and dystrophic. Each of the latter three has several varieties." 一组遗传决定的疾病，其特征为皮肤和黏膜起疱。有四种主要类型：获得性、单纯型、交界型和营养不良型。后三者各有若干变型。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Epidermolysis Bullosa" scope note C17.800.865.410.080 Epidermolysis Bullosa Acquisita 获得性大疱性表皮松解症 "Form of epidermolysis bullosa characterized by trauma-induced, subepidermal blistering with no family history of the disease. Direct immunofluorescence shows IMMUNOGLOBULIN G deposited at the dermo-epidermal junction." 大疱性表皮松解症的一种类型，特征为外伤诱发的表皮下水疱，且无该病家族史。直接免疫荧光显示免疫球蛋白 G（IMMUNOGLOBULIN G）沉积于真皮表皮交界处。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Epidermolysis Bullosa Acquisita" scope note C17.800.865.410.160 Epidermolysis Bullosa Dystrophica 营养不良型大疱性表皮松解症 "Form of epidermolysis bullosa characterized by atrophy of blistered areas, severe scarring, and nail changes. It is most often present at birth or in early infancy and occurs in both autosomal dominant and recessive forms. All forms of dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa result from mutations in COLLAGEN TYPE VII, a major component fibrils of BASEMENT MEMBRANE and EPIDERMIS." 大疱性表皮松解症的一种类型，特征为水疱区萎缩、严重瘢痕形成及甲改变。多于出生时或婴儿早期出现，有常染色体显性和隐性两种遗传形式。所有营养不良型大疱性表皮松解症均由 VII 型胶原（COLLAGEN TYPE VII）突变所致，VII 型胶原是基底膜（BASEMENT MEMBRANE）和表皮（EPIDERMIS）纤维的主要成分。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Epidermolysis Bullosa Dystrophica" scope note C17.800.865.410.170 Epidermolysis Bullosa, Junctional 交界型大疱性表皮松解症 "Form of epidermolysis bullosa having onset at birth or during the neonatal period and transmitted through autosomal recessive inheritance. It is characterized by generalized blister formation, extensive denudation, and separation and cleavage of the basal cell plasma membranes from the basement membrane." 大疱性表皮松解症的一种类型，于出生时或新生儿期发病，经常染色体隐性遗传。特征为泛发性水疱形成、大面积表皮剥脱，以及基底细胞质膜与基底膜的分离和裂开。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Epidermolysis Bullosa, Junctional" scope note C17.800.865.410.180 Epidermolysis Bullosa Simplex 单纯型大疱性表皮松解症 "A form of epidermolysis bullosa characterized by serous bullae that heal without scarring. Mutations in the genes that encode KERATIN-5 and KERATIN-14 have been associated with several subtypes of epidermolysis bullosa simplex." 一种大疱性表皮松解症，特征为愈合后不留瘢痕的浆液性大疱。编码角蛋白-5（KERATIN-5）和角蛋白-14（KERATIN-14）的基因突变与单纯型大疱性表皮松解症的若干亚型相关。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Epidermolysis Bullosa Simplex" scope note C17.800.865.475 Erythema Multiforme 多形红斑 "A skin and mucous membrane disease characterized by an eruption of macules, papules, nodules, vesicles, and/or bullae with characteristic bull's-eye lesions usually occurring on the dorsal aspect of the hands and forearms." 一种皮肤和黏膜疾病，特征为出现斑疹、丘疹、结节、水疱和（或）大疱，伴有特征性的靶形皮损，通常发生于手背和前臂背侧。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Erythema Multiforme" scope note C17.800.865.475.683 Stevens-Johnson Syndrome 史蒂文斯-约翰逊综合征 "Rare cutaneous eruption characterized by extensive KERATINOCYTE apoptosis resulting in skin detachment with mucosal involvement. It is often provoked by the use of drugs (e.g., antibiotics and anticonvulsants) or associated with PNEUMONIA, MYCOPLASMA. It is considered a continuum of Toxic Epidermal Necrolysis." 一种罕见的皮疹，特征为广泛的角质形成细胞（KERATINOCYTE）凋亡，导致皮肤剥脱并累及黏膜。常由药物（如抗生素和抗惊厥药）诱发，或与支原体肺炎（PNEUMONIA, MYCOPLASMA）相关。它被视为与中毒性表皮坏死松解症构成同一连续谱。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Stevens-Johnson Syndrome" scope note C17.800.865.575 Hydroa Vacciniforme 种痘样水疱病 "A vesicular and bullous eruption having a tendency to recur in summer during childhood and commonly appearing on sun-exposed skin. The lesions are surrounded by an erythematous zone and resemble a vaccination. (From Dorland, 27th ed)" 一种水疱和大疱性皮疹，儿童期易在夏季复发，常见于日光暴露部位皮肤。皮损周围有红斑带，形似种痘。（引自 Dorland，第 27 版） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Hydroa Vacciniforme" scope note C17.800.865.622 Linear IgA Bullous Dermatosis 线状 IgA 大疱性皮病 "Autoimmune disease characterized by subepidermal blisters and linear deposition of autoantibodies at the dermoepidermal junction. The accumulated autoantibodies are of IMMUNOGLOBULIN A and occasionally IMMUNOGLOBULIN G classes against epidermal BASEMENT MEMBRANE proteins. The dermatosis is sometimes associated with malignancies and use of certain drugs (e.g., VANCOMYCIN)." 自身免疫性疾病，特征为表皮下水疱及自身抗体在真皮表皮交界处呈线状沉积。沉积的自身抗体为免疫球蛋白 A（IMMUNOGLOBULIN A）类，偶为免疫球蛋白 G（IMMUNOGLOBULIN G）类，针对表皮基底膜（BASEMENT MEMBRANE）蛋白。本皮病有时与恶性肿瘤及使用某些药物（如万古霉素（VANCOMYCIN））相关。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Linear IgA Bullous Dermatosis" scope note C17.800.865.670 Pemphigoid, Benign Mucous Membrane 良性黏膜类天疱疮 "A chronic blistering disease with predilection for mucous membranes and less frequently the skin, and with a tendency to scarring. It is sometimes called ocular pemphigoid because of conjunctival mucous membrane involvement." 一种好发于黏膜的慢性大疱性疾病，较少累及皮肤，有形成瘢痕的倾向。由于累及结膜黏膜，有时称为眼类天疱疮。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Pemphigoid, Benign Mucous Membrane" scope note C17.800.865.690 Pemphigoid, Bullous 大疱性类天疱疮 "A chronic and relatively benign subepidermal blistering disease usually of the elderly and without histopathologic acantholysis." 一种慢性、相对良性的表皮下水疱病，通常见于老年人，组织病理学上无棘层松解。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Pemphigoid, Bullous" scope note C17.800.865.700 Pemphigoid Gestationis 妊娠类天疱疮 "An itching, autoimmune, bullous SKIN disease that occurs during the last two trimesters of PREGNANCY and PUERPERIUM. It also affects non-pregnant females with tissue of PLACENTA origin, such as CHORIOCARCINOMA; or HYDATIDIFORM MOLE. It exhibits antigenic and clinical similarity to bullous pemphigoid (PEMPHIGOID, BULLOUS). This disease does not involve herpes viruses (old name, herpes gestationis)." 一种瘙痒性、自身免疫性大疱性皮肤（SKIN）病，发生于妊娠（PREGNANCY）中晚期及产褥期（PUERPERIUM）。它也可累及含有胎盘（PLACENTA）来源组织的非妊娠女性，如绒毛膜癌（CHORIOCARCINOMA）或葡萄胎（HYDATIDIFORM MOLE）。它在抗原和临床上与大疱性类天疱疮（PEMPHIGOID, BULLOUS）相似。该病与疱疹病毒无关（旧称妊娠疱疹）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Pemphigoid Gestationis" scope note C17.800.865.716 Pemphigus 天疱疮 "Group of chronic blistering diseases characterized histologically by ACANTHOLYSIS and blister formation within the EPIDERMIS." 一组慢性大疱性疾病，组织学特征为棘层松解（ACANTHOLYSIS）及表皮（EPIDERMIS）内水疱形成。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Pemphigus" scope note C17.800.865.858 Pemphigus, Benign Familial 家族性良性天疱疮 "An autosomal dominantly inherited skin disorder characterized by recurrent eruptions of vesicles and BULLAE mainly on the neck, axillae, and groin. Mutations in the ATP2C1 gene (encoding the secretory pathway Ca2++/Mn2++ ATPase 1 (SPCA1)) cause this disease. It is clinically and histologically similar to DARIER DISEASE - both have abnormal, unstable DESMOSOMES between KERATINOCYTES and defective CALCIUM-TRANSPORTING ATPASES. It is unrelated to PEMPHIGUS VULGARIS though it closely resembles that disease." 一种常染色体显性遗传的皮肤病，其特征为水疱和大疱（BULLAE）反复发作，主要见于颈部、腋窝和腹股沟。ATP2C1 基因突变（该基因编码分泌途径 Ca2++/Mn2++ ATP 酶 1（SPCA1））导致本病。其在临床和组织学上与达里埃病（DARIER DISEASE）相似，两者均有角质形成细胞（KERATINOCYTES）之间异常、不稳定的桥粒（DESMOSOMES）以及缺陷的钙转运 ATP 酶（CALCIUM-TRANSPORTING ATPASES）。本病与寻常型天疱疮（PEMPHIGUS VULGARIS）无关，尽管与之十分相似。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Pemphigus, Benign Familial" scope note References National Library of Medicine. (2026). MeSH 2026 descriptor records [Data set]. Retrieved October 28, 2026, from https://www.nlm.nih.gov/databases/download/mesh.html

medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.summary: C17.800.882 Skin Neoplasms Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source C17.800.882 Skin Neoplasms 皮肤肿瘤 "Tumors or cancer of the SKIN." 皮肤（SKIN）的肿瘤或癌。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Skin Neoplasms" scope note C17.800.882.001 Blastic Plasmacytoid Dendritic Cell Neoplasm 母细胞性浆细胞样树突状细胞肿瘤 "A rare and aggressive hematologic malignancy derived from the precursors of PLASMACYTOID DENDRITIC CELLS. Blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasms affect bone marrow and blood in addition to the lymph nodes, spleen, central nervous system, and skin." 一种罕见的侵袭性血液系统恶性肿瘤，源自浆细胞样树突状细胞（PLASMACYTOID DENDRITIC CELLS）的前体。母细胞性浆细胞样树突状细胞肿瘤除累及淋巴结、脾、中枢神经系统和皮肤外，还累及骨髓和血液。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Blastic Plasmacytoid Dendritic Cell Neoplasm" scope note C17.800.882.356 Mastocytosis, Cutaneous 皮肤肥大细胞增多症 "Skin lesions due to abnormal infiltration of MAST CELLS. Cutaneous mastocytosis is confined to the skin without the involvement of other tissues or organs, and is mostly found in children. The three major variants are: URTICARIA PIGMENTOSA; diffuse cutaneous mastocytosis; and SOLITARY MASTOCYTOMA OF SKIN." 由肥大细胞（MAST CELLS）异常浸润所致的皮肤病变。皮肤肥大细胞增多症局限于皮肤，不累及其他组织或器官，多见于儿童。三种主要变型为：色素性荨麻疹（URTICARIA PIGMENTOSA）、弥漫性皮肤肥大细胞增多症和皮肤孤立性肥大细胞瘤（SOLITARY MASTOCYTOMA OF SKIN）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Mastocytosis, Cutaneous" scope note C17.800.882.356.500 Mastocytoma, Skin 皮肤肥大细胞瘤 "A variant of cutaneous mastocytosis which occurs as a single lesion usually in infants. It is found mostly in the wrist and trunk and there is no atypical cytomorphology." 皮肤肥大细胞增生症的一种变异型，通常以单个皮损出现于婴儿。主要见于腕部和躯干，无非典型细胞形态。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Mastocytoma, Skin" scope note C17.800.882.356.850 Urticaria Pigmentosa 色素性荨麻疹 "The most common form of cutaneous mastocytosis (MASTOCYTOSIS, CUTANEOUS) that occurs primarily in children. It is characterized by the multiple small reddish-brown pigmented pruritic macules and papules." 皮肤肥大细胞增多症最常见的形式（皮肤肥大细胞增多症（MASTOCYTOSIS, CUTANEOUS）），主要发生于儿童。特征为多发性小的红棕色色素性瘙痒性斑疹和丘疹。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Urticaria Pigmentosa" scope note C17.800.882.445 Melanoma 黑色素瘤 "A malignant neoplasm derived from cells that are capable of forming melanin, which may occur in the skin of any part of the body, in the eye, or, rarely, in the mucous membranes of the genitalia, anus, oral cavity, or other sites. It occurs mostly in adults and may originate de novo or from a pigmented nevus or malignant lentigo. Melanomas frequently metastasize widely, and the regional lymph nodes, liver, lungs, and brain are likely to be involved. The incidence of malignant skin melanomas is rising rapidly in all parts of the world. (Stedman, 25th ed; from Rook et al., Textbook of Dermatology, 4th ed, p2445)" 一种源自能形成黑色素的细胞的恶性肿瘤，可发生于身体任何部位的皮肤、眼，少数发生于生殖器、肛门、口腔或其他部位的黏膜。主要见于成人，可原发，或起源于色素痣或恶性雀斑样痣。黑色素瘤常广泛转移，区域淋巴结、肝、肺和脑易受累。全世界恶性皮肤黑色素瘤的发病率均在迅速上升。（Stedman，第 25 版；引自 Rook 等，《皮肤病学教科书》，第 4 版，第 2445 页） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Melanoma" scope note C17.800.882.534 Cutaneous Malignant Melanoma 皮肤恶性黑色素瘤 "A primary melanoma that originates from atypical skin MELANOCYTES, especially from acquired and congenital MELANOCYTIC NEVI, and DYSPLASTIC NEVI." 一种起源于非典型皮肤黑素细胞（MELANOCYTES）的原发性黑色素瘤，尤其起源于获得性和先天性黑素细胞痣（MELANOCYTIC NEVI）以及发育不良痣（DYSPLASTIC NEVI）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Cutaneous Malignant Melanoma" scope note C17.800.882.623 Non-Melanoma Skin Neoplasms 非黑色素瘤皮肤肿瘤 "Skin neoplasms that are not MELANOMA." 不属于黑色素瘤（MELANOMA）的皮肤肿瘤。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Non-Melanoma Skin Neoplasms" scope note C17.800.882.623.001 Cutaneous Squamous Cell Carcinoma 皮肤鳞状细胞癌 "A non-melanoma skin neoplasm that is one of the three principal types of skin cancer. It often presents as a hard lump or ulcer and is more likely to metastasize than BASAL CELL CARCINOMA." 一种非黑色素瘤皮肤肿瘤，是皮肤癌的三种主要类型之一。常表现为硬结或溃疡，比基底细胞癌（BASAL CELL CARCINOMA）更易转移。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Cutaneous Squamous Cell Carcinoma" scope note C17.800.882.623.001.001 Bowen's Disease 鲍恩病 "A persistent progressive non-elevated red scaly or crusted plaque which is due to an intradermal carcinoma and is potentially malignant. Atypical squamous cells proliferate through the whole thickness of the epidermis. The lesions may occur anywhere on the skin surface or on mucosal surfaces. The cause most frequently found is trivalent arsenic compounds. Freezing, cauterization or diathermy coagulation is often effective. (From Rook et al., Textbook of Dermatology, 4th ed, pp2428-9)" 一种持续进展的不隆起的红色鳞屑性或结痂性斑块，由表皮内癌引起，具有潜在恶性。非典型鳞状细胞增殖贯穿表皮全层。皮损可发生于皮肤表面或黏膜表面的任何部位。最常发现的病因是三价砷化合物。冷冻、烧灼或电热凝固常有效。（引自 Rook 等，《Textbook of Dermatology》，第 4 版，第 2428 至 2429 页） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Bowen's Disease" scope note C17.800.882.623.002 Basal Cell Carcinoma 基底细胞癌 "A malignant skin neoplasm that seldom metastasizes but has potentialities for local invasion and destruction. Clinically it is divided into types: nodular, cicatricial, morphaic, and erythematoid (pagetoid). They develop on hair-bearing skin, most commonly on sun-exposed areas. Approximately 85% are found on the head and neck area and the remaining 15% on the trunk and limbs. (From DeVita Jr et al., Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 3d ed, p1471)" 一种很少转移的恶性皮肤肿瘤，但具有局部侵袭和破坏的潜能。临床上分为结节型、瘢痕型、硬斑病样型和红斑型（佩吉特样）。发生于有毛皮肤，最常见于日光暴露部位。约 85% 位于头颈部，其余 15% 位于躯干和四肢。（引自 DeVita Jr 等，《癌症：肿瘤学原理与实践》，第 3 版，第 1471 页） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Basal Cell Carcinoma" scope note C17.800.882.623.002.001 Basal Cell Nevus Syndrome 基底细胞痣综合征 "Hereditary disorder consisting of multiple basal cell carcinomas, odontogenic keratocysts, and multiple skeletal defects, e.g., frontal and temporoparietal bossing, bifurcated and splayed ribs, kyphoscoliosis, fusion of vertebrae, and cervicothoracic spina bifida. Genetic transmission is autosomal dominant." 遗传性疾病，由多发性基底细胞癌、牙源性角化囊肿和多种骨骼缺陷组成，如额部和颞顶部隆起、分叉和张开的肋骨、脊柱后侧凸、椎骨融合及颈胸段脊柱裂。遗传方式为常染色体显性。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Basal Cell Nevus Syndrome" scope note C17.800.882.712 Sebaceous Gland Neoplasms 皮脂腺肿瘤 "New abnormal growth of tissue in the SEBACEOUS GLANDS." 皮脂腺（SEBACEOUS GLANDS）中组织的新的异常生长。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Sebaceous Gland Neoplasms" scope note C17.800.882.712.500 Muir-Torre Syndrome Muir-Torre 综合征 "A form of LYNCH SYNDROME II associated with cutaneous SEBACEOUS GLAND NEOPLASMS. Muir-Torre syndrome is also associated with other visceral malignant diseases include colorectal, endometrial, urological, and upper gastrointestinal neoplasms." 林奇综合征 II 型（LYNCH SYNDROME II）的一种形式，伴皮肤皮脂腺肿瘤（SEBACEOUS GLAND NEOPLASMS）。Muir-Torre 综合征还与其他内脏恶性疾病相关，包括结直肠、子宫内膜、泌尿系统和上消化道肿瘤。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Muir-Torre Syndrome" scope note C17.800.882.743 Sweat Gland Neoplasms 汗腺肿瘤 "New abnormal growth of tissue in the SWEAT GLANDS." 汗腺（SWEAT GLANDS）内组织新的异常生长。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Sweat Gland Neoplasms" scope note References National Library of Medicine. (2026). MeSH 2026 descriptor records [Data set]. Retrieved October 28, 2026, from https://www.nlm.nih.gov/databases/download/mesh.html

medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.title: C17.800.893 Skin Ulcer | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.summary: C17.800.893 Skin Ulcer Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source C17.800.893 Skin Ulcer 皮肤溃疡 "An ULCER of the skin and underlying tissues." 皮肤及其下组织的溃疡（ULCER）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Skin Ulcer" scope note C17.800.893.295 Buruli Ulcer 布鲁里溃疡 "A lesion in the skin and subcutaneous tissues due to infections by MYCOBACTERIUM ULCERANS. It was first reported in Uganda, Africa." 由溃疡分枝杆菌（MYCOBACTERIUM ULCERANS）感染引起的皮肤和皮下组织病变。最早报道于非洲乌干达。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Buruli Ulcer" scope note C17.800.893.592 Leg Ulcer 腿部溃疡 "Ulceration of the skin and underlying structures of the lower extremity. About 90% of the cases are due to venous insufficiency (VARICOSE ULCER), 5% to arterial disease, and the remaining 5% to other causes." 下肢皮肤及其下方结构的溃疡。约 90% 的病例由静脉功能不全（静脉曲张性溃疡（VARICOSE ULCER））引起，5% 由动脉疾病引起，其余 5% 由其他原因引起。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Leg Ulcer" scope note C17.800.893.592.450 Foot Ulcer 足溃疡 "Lesion on the surface of the skin of the foot, usually accompanied by inflammation. The lesion may become infected or necrotic and is frequently associated with diabetes or leprosy." 足部皮肤表面的病变，通常伴有炎症。病变可发生感染或坏死，常与糖尿病或麻风相关。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Foot Ulcer" scope note C17.800.893.592.450.200 Diabetic Foot 糖尿病足 "Common foot problems in persons with DIABETES MELLITUS, caused by any combination of factors such as DIABETIC NEUROPATHIES; PERIPHERAL VASCULAR DISEASES; and INFECTION. With the loss of sensation and poor circulation, injuries and infections often lead to severe foot ulceration, GANGRENE and AMPUTATION, SURGICAL." 糖尿病（DIABETES MELLITUS）患者常见的足部问题，由糖尿病神经病变（DIABETIC NEUROPATHIES）、周围血管疾病（PERIPHERAL VASCULAR DISEASES）和感染（INFECTION）等因素的任意组合所致。随着感觉丧失和循环不良，损伤和感染常导致严重的足部溃疡、坏疽（GANGRENE）和外科截肢（AMPUTATION, SURGICAL）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Diabetic Foot" scope note C17.800.893.592.730 Varicose Ulcer 静脉曲张性溃疡 "Skin breakdown or ulceration in the drainage area of a VARICOSE VEIN, usually in the leg." 静脉曲张（VARICOSE VEIN）引流区域的皮肤破损或溃疡，通常位于腿部。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Varicose Ulcer" scope note C17.800.893.665 Pressure Ulcer 压疮 "An ulceration caused by prolonged pressure on the SKIN and TISSUES when one stays in one position for a long period of time, such as lying in bed. The bony areas of the body are the most frequently affected sites which become ischemic (ISCHEMIA) under sustained and constant pressure." 一种因长时间保持一个体位（如卧床）时皮肤（SKIN）和组织（TISSUES）长期受压而引起的溃疡。身体骨突部位是最常受累的部位，在持续恒定的压力下会发生缺血（ISCHEMIA）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Pressure Ulcer" scope note C17.800.893.675 Pyoderma Gangrenosum 坏疽性脓皮病 "An idiopathic, rapidly evolving, and severely debilitating disease occurring most commonly in association with chronic ulcerative colitis. It is characterized by the presence of boggy, purplish ulcers with undermined borders, appearing mostly on the legs. The majority of cases are in people between 40 and 60 years old. Its etiology is unknown." 一种特发性、进展迅速且严重致衰弱的疾病，最常与慢性溃疡性结肠炎相伴发生。其特征为出现边缘潜行的松软紫色溃疡，多见于腿部。大多数病例为 40 至 60 岁的人。其病因不明。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Pyoderma Gangrenosum" scope note References National Library of Medicine. (2026). MeSH 2026 descriptor records [Data set]. Retrieved October 28, 2026, from https://www.nlm.nih.gov/databases/download/mesh.html

medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.title: C17.800.946 Sweat Gland Diseases | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.summary: C17.800.946 Sweat Gland Diseases Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source C17.800.946 Sweat Gland Diseases 汗腺疾病 "Diseases of the SWEAT GLANDS." 汗腺（SWEAT GLANDS）的疾病。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Sweat Gland Diseases" scope note C17.800.946.315 Hidradenitis 汗腺炎 "The inflammation of a sweat gland (usually of the apocrine type). The condition can be idiopathic or occur as a result of or in association with another underlying condition. Neutrophilic eccrine hidradenitis is a relatively rare variant that has been reported in patients undergoing chemotherapy, usually for non-Hodgkin lymphomas or leukemic conditions." 汗腺的炎症（通常为顶泌汗腺型）。该病可为特发性，或由另一种基础疾病引起或与之相关。中性粒细胞性外泌汗腺炎是一种相对罕见的变异型，见于接受化疗的患者，通常针对非霍奇金淋巴瘤或白血病。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Hidradenitis" scope note C17.800.946.315.320 Hidradenitis Suppurativa 化脓性汗腺炎 "A chronic suppurative and cicatricial disease of the apocrine glands occurring chiefly in the axillae in women and in the groin and anal regions in men. It is characterized by poral occlusion with secondary bacterial infection, evolving into abscesses which eventually rupture. As the disease becomes chronic, ulcers appear, sinus tracts enlarge, fistulas develop, and fibrosis and scarring become evident." 一种大汗腺的慢性化脓性和瘢痕性疾病，女性主要发生于腋窝，男性主要发生于腹股沟和肛周区域。其特征为毛孔闭塞继发细菌感染，发展为脓肿并最终破溃。随着疾病转为慢性，出现溃疡，窦道扩大，瘘管形成，纤维化和瘢痕变得明显。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Hidradenitis Suppurativa" scope note C17.800.946.350 Hyperhidrosis 多汗症 "Excessive sweating. In the localized type, the most frequent sites are the palms, soles, axillae, inguinal folds, and the perineal area. Its chief cause is thought to be emotional. Generalized hyperhidrosis may be induced by a hot, humid environment, by fever, or by vigorous exercise." 过度出汗。局限型最常见的部位是手掌、足底、腋窝、腹股沟皱襞和会阴区。其主要原因被认为是情绪性的。全身性多汗症可由炎热潮湿的环境、发热或剧烈运动诱发。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Hyperhidrosis" scope note C17.800.946.350.843 Sweating, Gustatory 味觉性出汗 "An autonomic disorder characterized by excessive sweating of the forehead, upper lip, perioral region, or sternum subsequent to gustatory stimuli. The auriculotemporal syndrome features facial flushing or sweating limited to the distribution of the auriculotemporal nerve and may develop after trauma to the parotid gland, in association with PAROTID NEOPLASMS, or following their surgical removal. (From Ann Neurol 1997 Dec;42(6):973-5)" 一种自主神经障碍，特征为味觉刺激后前额、上唇、口周区域或胸骨部位过度出汗。耳颞神经综合征表现为局限于耳颞神经分布区的面部潮红或出汗，可在腮腺创伤后、伴发腮腺肿瘤（PAROTID NEOPLASMS）时或腮腺肿瘤手术切除后发生。（引自 Ann Neurol 1997 Dec;42(6):973-5） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Sweating, Gustatory" scope note C17.800.946.370 Hypohidrosis 少汗症 "Abnormally diminished or absent perspiration. Both generalized and segmented (reduced or absent sweating in circumscribed locations) forms of the disease are usually associated with other underlying conditions." 出汗异常减少或缺失。本病的全身型和节段型（局限部位出汗减少或缺失）通常都与其他基础疾病相关。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Hypohidrosis" scope note C17.800.946.492 Miliaria 粟粒疹（痱子） "A syndrome of cutaneous changes associated with sweat retention and extravasation of sweat at different levels in the skin. Miliaria rubra, or prickly heat, results from apocrine duct obstruction. The sweat then seeps into the epidermis, producing pruritic erythematous papulovesicles. (From Dorland, 27th ed)" 一种与汗液潴留及汗液在皮肤不同层次外渗相关的皮肤改变综合征。红色粟粒疹即痱子，由顶泌汗腺导管阻塞引起。汗液随后渗入表皮，产生瘙痒性红斑丘疱疹。（引自 Dorland，第 27 版） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Miliaria" scope note C17.800.946.492.285 Fox-Fordyce Disease Fox-Fordyce 病 "Chronic pruritic disease, usually in women, characterized by small follicular papular eruptions in APOCRINE GLANDS areas. It is caused by obstruction and rupture of intraepidermal apocrine ducts." 一种慢性瘙痒性疾病，常见于女性，特征为顶泌汗腺（APOCRINE GLANDS）分布区的小毛囊性丘疹。由表皮内顶泌汗腺导管阻塞和破裂所致。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Fox-Fordyce Disease" scope note C17.800.946.743 Sweat Gland Neoplasms 汗腺肿瘤 "New abnormal growth of tissue in the SWEAT GLANDS." 汗腺（SWEAT GLANDS）内组织新的异常生长。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Sweat Gland Neoplasms" scope note References National Library of Medicine. (2026). MeSH 2026 descriptor records [Data set]. Retrieved October 28, 2026, from https://www.nlm.nih.gov/databases/download/mesh.html

medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.title: C17.800.973 Xanthogranuloma, Juvenile | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.summary: C17.800.973 Xanthogranuloma, Juvenile Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source C17.800.973 Xanthogranuloma, Juvenile 幼年黄色肉芽肿 "Benign disorder of infants and children caused by proliferation of HISTIOCYTES, macrophages found in tissues. These histiocytes, usually lipid-laden non-Langerhans cells, form multiple yellow-red nodules most often in the skin, the eye, and sometimes in the viscera. Patients appear to have normal lipid metabolism and are classified as a normolipemic non-Langerhans cell histiocytosis." 婴儿和儿童的良性疾病，由组织细胞（HISTIOCYTES）增生所致，组织细胞即存在于组织中的巨噬细胞。这些组织细胞通常为富含脂质的非朗格汉斯细胞，形成多发性黄红色结节，最常见于皮肤、眼，有时见于内脏。患者脂质代谢似乎正常，被归类为血脂正常的非朗格汉斯细胞组织细胞增生症。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Xanthogranuloma, Juvenile" scope note References National Library of Medicine. (2026). MeSH 2026 descriptor records [Data set]. Retrieved October 28, 2026, from https://www.nlm.nih.gov/databases/download/mesh.html

medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.title: C17.800 Skin Diseases | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.summary: C17.800 Skin Diseases Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source C17.800 Skin Diseases 皮肤疾病 "Diseases involving the DERMIS or EPIDERMIS." 累及真皮（DERMIS）或表皮（EPIDERMIS）的疾病。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Skin Diseases" scope note C17.800.030 Acneiform Eruptions 痤疮样疹 "Visible efflorescent lesions of the skin caused by acne or resembling acne. (Dorland, 28th ed, p18, 575)" 由痤疮引起或类似痤疮的可见的皮肤发疹性损害。（Dorland，第 28 版，第 18、575 页） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Acneiform Eruptions" scope note C17.800.060 Angiolymphoid Hyperplasia with Eosinophilia 血管淋巴样增生伴嗜酸性粒细胞增多 "Solitary or multiple benign cutaneous nodules comprised of immature and mature vascular structures intermingled with endothelial cells and a varied infiltrate of eosinophils, histiocytes, lymphocytes, and mast cells." 单发或多发的良性皮肤结节，由未成熟和成熟的血管结构组成，其间混杂内皮细胞以及由嗜酸性粒细胞、组织细胞、淋巴细胞和肥大细胞构成的多样浸润。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Angiolymphoid Hyperplasia with Eosinophilia" scope note C17.800.090 Breast Diseases 乳腺疾病 "Pathological processes of the BREAST." 乳房的病理过程（BREAST）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Breast Diseases" scope note C17.800.113 Calcinosis Cutis 皮肤钙质沉着症 "Pathological deposition of calcium in the skin and subcutaneous tissue. Excessive calcification of the skin may be associated with underlying diseases that cause tissue damage (e.g. EHLERS-DANLOS SYNDROME; PSEUDOXANTHOMA ELASTICUM; ROTHMUND-THOMSON SYNDROME; and WERNER SYNDROME) or that cause abnormal calcium and phosphate metabolism (e.g., CALCIPHYLAXIS; CHRONIC KIDNEY FAILURE; HYPERPARATHYROIDISM; and SARCOIDOSIS)." 钙在皮肤和皮下组织中的病理性沉积。皮肤过度钙化可能与引起组织损伤的基础疾病（如埃勒斯-当洛斯综合征（EHLERS-DANLOS SYNDROME）、弹性纤维假黄瘤（PSEUDOXANTHOMA ELASTICUM）、罗特蒙德-汤姆森综合征（ROTHMUND-THOMSON SYNDROME）和沃纳综合征（WERNER SYNDROME））有关，或与引起钙磷代谢异常的疾病（如钙化防御（CALCIPHYLAXIS）、慢性肾衰竭（CHRONIC KIDNEY FAILURE）、甲状旁腺功能亢进（HYPERPARATHYROIDISM）和结节病（SARCOIDOSIS））有关。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Calcinosis Cutis" scope note C17.800.135 Cutaneous Fistula 皮肤瘘 "An abnormal passage or communication leading from an internal organ to the surface of the body." 一种从内脏器官通向体表的异常通道或交通。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Cutaneous Fistula" scope note C17.800.174 Dermatitis 皮炎 "Any inflammation of the skin." 任何皮肤的炎症。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Dermatitis" scope note C17.800.185 Dermatomyositis 皮肌炎 "A subacute or chronic inflammatory disease of muscle and skin, marked by proximal muscle weakness and a characteristic skin rash. The illness occurs with approximately equal frequency in children and adults. The skin lesions usually take the form of a purplish rash (or less often an exfoliative dermatitis) involving the nose, cheeks, forehead, upper trunk, and arms. The disease is associated with a complement mediated intramuscular microangiopathy, leading to loss of capillaries, muscle ischemia, muscle-fiber necrosis, and perifascicular atrophy. The childhood form of this disease tends to evolve into a systemic vasculitis. Dermatomyositis may occur in association with malignant neoplasms. (From Adams et al., Principles of Neurology, 6th ed, pp1405-6)" 一种亚急性或慢性的肌肉和皮肤炎症性疾病，以近端肌无力和特征性皮疹为特点。该病在儿童和成人中的发病率大致相等。皮肤病变通常表现为紫红色皮疹（较少为剥脱性皮炎），累及鼻、面颊、前额、上躯干和上肢。该病与补体介导的肌内微血管病有关，导致毛细血管丧失、肌肉缺血、肌纤维坏死和束周萎缩。儿童型往往发展为系统性血管炎。皮肌炎可伴发恶性肿瘤。（引自 Adams 等，《神经病学原理》，第 6 版，第 1405-1406 页） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Dermatomyositis" scope note C17.800.229 Erythema 红斑 "Redness of the skin produced by congestion of the capillaries. This condition may result from a variety of disease processes." 由毛细血管充血引起的皮肤发红。此病症可由多种疾病过程引起。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Erythema" scope note C17.800.257 Exanthema 疹病 "Diseases in which skin eruptions or rashes are a prominent manifestation. Classically, six such diseases were described with similar rashes; they were numbered in the order in which they were reported. Only the fourth (Duke's disease), fifth (ERYTHEMA INFECTIOSUM), and sixth (EXANTHEMA SUBITUM) numeric designations survive as occasional synonyms in current terminology." 以皮疹或出疹为突出表现的疾病。传统上曾描述过六种皮疹相似的此类疾病，按报道顺序编号。在当前术语中，只有第四病（杜克病）、第五病（传染性红斑（ERYTHEMA INFECTIOSUM））和第六病（幼儿急疹（EXANTHEMA SUBITUM））的数字名称仍偶尔作为同义词使用。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Exanthema" scope note C17.800.271 Facial Dermatoses 面部皮肤病 "Skin diseases involving the FACE." 累及面部（FACE）的皮肤疾病。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Facial Dermatoses" scope note C17.800.321 Foot Diseases 足疾病 "Anatomical and functional disorders affecting the foot." 累及足部的解剖和功能障碍。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Foot Diseases" scope note C17.800.329 Hair Diseases 毛发疾病 "Diseases affecting the orderly growth and persistence of hair." 影响毛发有序生长和存续的疾病。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Hair Diseases" scope note C17.800.338 Hand Dermatoses 手部皮肤病 "Skin diseases involving the HANDS." 累及手部（HANDS）的皮肤疾病。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Hand Dermatoses" scope note C17.800.417 Keratoacanthoma 角化棘皮瘤 "A benign, non-neoplastic, usually self-limiting epithelial lesion closely resembling squamous cell carcinoma clinically and histopathologically. It occurs in solitary, multiple, and eruptive forms. The solitary and multiple forms occur on sunlight exposed areas and are identical histologically; they affect primarily white males. The eruptive form usually involves both sexes and appears as a generalized papular eruption." 一种良性、非肿瘤性、通常具有自限性的上皮病变，在临床和组织病理学上与鳞状细胞癌极为相似。它有单发型、多发型和发疹型。单发型和多发型发生于日光暴露部位，组织学上相同，主要累及白人男性。发疹型通常两性均可累及，表现为泛发性丘疹样皮疹。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Keratoacanthoma" scope note C17.800.428 Keratosis 角化病 "Any horny growth such as a wart or callus." 任何角质增生物，如疣或胼胝。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Keratosis" scope note C17.800.446 Leg Dermatoses 腿皮肤病 "A nonspecific term used to denote any cutaneous lesion or group of lesions, or eruptions of any type on the leg. (From Stedman, 25th ed)" 一个非特异性术语，用于指腿部的任何皮肤损害或损害群，或任何类型的皮疹。（引自 Stedman，第 25 版） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Leg Dermatoses" scope note C17.800.463 Lipomatosis 脂肪过多症 "A disorder characterized by the accumulation of encapsulated or unencapsulated tumor-like fatty tissue resembling LIPOMA." 一种疾病，其特征为类似脂肪瘤（LIPOMA）的有包膜或无包膜的肿瘤样脂肪组织蓄积。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Lipomatosis" scope note C17.800.480 Lupus Erythematosus, Cutaneous 皮肤型红斑狼疮 "A form of lupus erythematosus in which the skin may be the only organ involved or in which skin involvement precedes the spread into other body systems. It has been classified into three forms - acute (= LUPUS ERYTHEMATOSUS, SYSTEMIC with skin lesions), subacute, and chronic (= LUPUS ERYTHEMATOSUS, DISCOID)." 红斑狼疮的一种类型，其中皮肤可能是唯一受累的器官，或皮肤受累先于向其他身体系统的扩散。分为三型：急性（即伴有皮肤病变的系统性红斑狼疮（LUPUS ERYTHEMATOSUS, SYSTEMIC））、亚急性和慢性（即盘状红斑狼疮（LUPUS ERYTHEMATOSUS, DISCOID））。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Lupus Erythematosus, Cutaneous" scope note C17.800.518 Morgellons Disease 莫吉隆斯病 "An unexplained illness which is characterized by skin manifestations including non-healing lesions, itching, and the appearance of fibers." 一种不明原因的疾病，特征为皮肤表现，包括不愈合的损害、瘙痒以及纤维出现。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Morgellons Disease" scope note C17.800.529 Nail Diseases 甲疾病 "Diseases of the nail plate and tissues surrounding it. The concept is limited to primates." 甲板及其周围组织的疾病。该概念限于灵长类。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Nail Diseases" scope note C17.800.550 Necrobiotic Disorders 渐进性坏死性疾病 "A group of disorders characterized by swelling, basophilia, and distortion of collagen bundles in the dermis." 一组疾病，其特征为真皮内胶原束的肿胀、嗜碱性变和扭曲。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Necrobiotic Disorders" scope note C17.800.551 Necrolytic Migratory Erythema 坏死松解性游走性红斑 "Recurrent cutaneous manifestation of GLUCAGONOMA characterized by necrolytic polycyclic migratory lesions with scaling borders. It is associated with elevated secretion of GLUCAGON by the tumor. Other conditions with elevated serum glucagon levels such as HEPATIC CIRRHOSIS may also result in similar skin lesions, which are referred to as pseudoglucagonoma syndrome." 胰高血糖素瘤（GLUCAGONOMA）的复发性皮肤表现，特征为坏死松解性、多环状、游走性损害，边缘有鳞屑。它与肿瘤分泌胰高血糖素（GLUCAGON）增多相关。其他血清胰高血糖素水平升高的病症如肝硬化（HEPATIC CIRRHOSIS）也可引起类似皮肤损害，称为假性胰高血糖素瘤综合征。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Necrolytic Migratory Erythema" scope note C17.800.553 Nephrogenic Fibrosing Dermopathy 肾源性纤维化皮病 "A chronic, acquired, idiopathic, progressive eruption of the skin that occurs in the context of RENAL FAILURE. It is sometimes accompanied by systemic fibrosis. The pathogenesis seems to be multifactorial, with postulated involvement of circulating fibrocytes. There is a strong association between this disorder and the use of gadolinium-based contrast agents." 一种慢性、获得性、特发性、在肾衰竭（RENAL FAILURE）背景下发生的进行性皮疹。有时伴有系统性纤维化。其发病机制似为多因素，推测与循环纤维细胞有关。本病与使用钆基造影剂之间存在密切关联。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Nephrogenic Fibrosing Dermopathy" scope note C17.800.566 Panniculitis 脂膜炎 "General term for inflammation of adipose tissue, usually of the skin, characterized by reddened subcutaneous nodules." 脂肪组织炎症的总称，通常发生于皮肤，特征为发红的皮下结节。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Panniculitis" scope note C17.800.600 Photosensitivity Disorders 光敏性疾病 "Abnormal responses to sunlight or artificial light due to extreme reactivity of light-absorbing molecules in tissues. It refers almost exclusively to skin photosensitivity, including sunburn, reactions due to repeated prolonged exposure in the absence of photosensitizing factors, and reactions requiring photosensitizing factors such as photosensitizing agents and certain diseases. With restricted reference to skin tissue, it does not include photosensitivity of the eye to light, as in photophobia or photosensitive epilepsy." 对日光或人工光的异常反应，由组织中吸光分子的极端反应性所致。它几乎专指皮肤光敏性，包括晒伤、无光敏因素时反复长时间暴露引起的反应，以及需要光敏因素（如光敏剂和某些疾病）的反应。由于仅限于皮肤组织，它不包括眼对光的光敏性，如畏光或光敏性癫痫。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Photosensitivity Disorders" scope note C17.800.621 Pigmentation Disorders 色素沉着障碍 "Diseases affecting PIGMENTATION, including SKIN PIGMENTATION." 影响色素沉着（PIGMENTATION）的疾病，包括皮肤色素沉着（SKIN PIGMENTATION）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Pigmentation Disorders" scope note C17.800.674 Prurigo 痒疹 "A name applied to several itchy skin eruptions of unknown cause. The characteristic course is the formation of a dome-shaped papule with a small transient vesicle on top, followed by crusting over or lichenification. (From Dorland, 27th ed)" 对若干原因不明的瘙痒性皮疹的统称。典型病程是形成顶端带有小的一过性水疱的圆顶状丘疹，随后结痂或苔藓样变。（引自 Dorland，第 27 版） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Prurigo" scope note C17.800.685 Pruritus 瘙痒 "An intense itching sensation that produces the urge to rub or scratch the skin to obtain relief." 一种强烈的痒感，使人产生想要摩擦或搔抓皮肤的冲动以求缓解。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Pruritus" scope note C17.800.695 Pyoderma 脓皮病 "Any purulent skin disease (Dorland, 27th ed)." 任何化脓性皮肤病（Dorland，第 27 版）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Pyoderma" scope note C17.800.716 Rosacea 酒渣鼻 "A cutaneous disorder primarily of convexities of the central part of the FACE, such as FOREHEAD; CHEEK; NOSE; and CHIN. It is characterized by FLUSHING; ERYTHEMA; EDEMA; RHINOPHYMA; papules; and ocular symptoms. It may occur at any age but typically after age 30. There are various subtypes of rosacea: erythematotelangiectatic, papulopustular, phymatous, and ocular (National Rosacea Society's Expert Committee on the Classification and Staging of Rosacea, J Am Acad Dermatol 2002; 46:584-7)." 一种主要累及面部（FACE）中央凸出部位的皮肤病，如前额（FOREHEAD）、面颊（CHEEK）、鼻（NOSE）和下颏（CHIN）。其特征为潮红（FLUSHING）、红斑（ERYTHEMA）、水肿（EDEMA）、鼻赘（RHINOPHYMA）、丘疹及眼部症状。可发生于任何年龄，但通常在 30 岁以后。酒渣鼻有多种亚型：红斑毛细血管扩张型、丘疹脓疱型、肥大增生型和眼型（美国国家酒渣鼻协会酒渣鼻分类与分期专家委员会，J Am Acad Dermatol 2002；46:584-7）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Rosacea" scope note C17.800.738 Scalp Dermatoses 头皮皮肤病 "Skin diseases involving the SCALP." 累及头皮的皮肤病（SCALP）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Scalp Dermatoses" scope note C17.800.751 Scleredema Adultorum 成人硬肿病 "A diffuse, non-pitting induration of the skin of unknown etiology that occurs most commonly in association with diabetes mellitus, predominantly in females. It typically begins on the face or head and spreads to other areas of the body, sometimes involving noncutaneous tissues. Often it is preceded by any of various infections, notably staphylococcal infections. The condition resolves spontaneously, usually within two years of onset. (From Dorland, 27th ed)" 一种病因不明的弥漫性、非凹陷性皮肤硬肿，最常与糖尿病相伴发生，以女性为主。它通常始于面部或头部，并扩展到身体其他部位，有时累及皮肤以外的组织。发病前常有各种感染，尤其是葡萄球菌感染。该病可自发消退，通常在发病后两年内。（引自 Dorland，第 27 版） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Scleredema Adultorum" scope note C17.800.767 Scleroderma, Localized 局限性硬皮病 "A term used to describe a variety of localized asymmetrical SKIN thickening that is similar to those of SYSTEMIC SCLERODERMA but without the disease features in the multiple internal organs and BLOOD VESSELS. Lesions may be characterized as patches or plaques (morphea), bands (linear), or nodules." 用于描述多种局限性不对称皮肤（SKIN）增厚的术语，类似于系统性硬皮病（SYSTEMIC SCLERODERMA）的皮肤增厚，但没有多个内脏器官和血管（BLOOD VESSELS）的病变特征。皮损可表现为斑片或斑块（硬斑病）、带状（线状）或结节。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Scleroderma, Localized" scope note C17.800.784 Scleroderma, Systemic 系统性硬皮病 "A chronic multi-system disorder of CONNECTIVE TISSUE. It is characterized by SCLEROSIS in the SKIN, the LUNGS, the HEART, the GASTROINTESTINAL TRACT, the KIDNEYS, and the MUSCULOSKELETAL SYSTEM. Other important features include diseased small BLOOD VESSELS and AUTOANTIBODIES. The disorder is named for its most prominent feature (hard skin), and classified into subsets by the extent of skin thickening: LIMITED SCLERODERMA and DIFFUSE SCLERODERMA." 一种结缔组织（CONNECTIVE TISSUE）的慢性多系统疾病。其特征为皮肤（SKIN）、肺（LUNGS）、心脏（HEART）、胃肠道（GASTROINTESTINAL TRACT）、肾（KIDNEYS）和肌肉骨骼系统（MUSCULOSKELETAL SYSTEM）的硬化（SCLEROSIS）。其他重要特征包括小血管（BLOOD VESSELS）病变和自身抗体（AUTOANTIBODIES）。该病以其最突出的特征（皮肤变硬）命名，并按皮肤增厚的范围分为亚型：局限性硬皮病（LIMITED SCLERODERMA）和弥漫性硬皮病（DIFFUSE SCLERODERMA）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Scleroderma, Systemic" scope note C17.800.794 Sebaceous Gland Diseases 皮脂腺疾病 "Diseases of the sebaceous glands such as sebaceous hyperplasia and sebaceous cell carcinoma (SEBACEOUS GLAND NEOPLASMS)." 皮脂腺的疾病，如皮脂腺增生和皮脂腺细胞癌（皮脂腺肿瘤（SEBACEOUS GLAND NEOPLASMS））。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Sebaceous Gland Diseases" scope note C17.800.804 Skin Abnormalities 皮肤异常 "Congenital structural abnormalities of the skin." 皮肤的先天性结构异常。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Skin Abnormalities" scope note C17.800.815 Skin Diseases, Eczematous 湿疹样皮肤病 "Any of a variety of eruptive skin disorders characterized by erythema, oozing, vesiculation, and scaling. Etiology is varied." 多种发疹性皮肤病中的任何一种，特征为红斑、渗出、水疱形成和鳞屑。病因多样。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Skin Diseases, Eczematous" scope note C17.800.827 Skin Diseases, Genetic 遗传性皮肤病 "Diseases of the skin with a genetic component, usually the result of various inborn errors of metabolism." 具有遗传成分的皮肤疾病，通常是各种先天性代谢缺陷的结果。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Skin Diseases, Genetic" scope note C17.800.838 Skin Diseases, Infectious 感染性皮肤病 "Skin diseases caused by bacteria, fungi, parasites, or viruses." 由细菌、真菌、寄生虫或病毒引起的皮肤病。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Skin Diseases, Infectious" scope note C17.800.849 Skin Diseases, Metabolic 代谢性皮肤病 "Diseases of the skin associated with underlying metabolic disorders." 与基础代谢紊乱相关的皮肤疾病。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Skin Diseases, Metabolic" scope note C17.800.859 Skin Diseases, Papulosquamous 丘疹鳞屑性皮肤病 "A group of dermatoses with distinct morphologic features. The primary lesion is most commonly a papule, usually erythematous, with a variable degree of scaling on the surface. Plaques form through the coalescing of primary lesions." 一组具有独特形态特征的皮肤病。原发皮损最常见为丘疹，通常为红斑性，表面有不同程度的鳞屑。原发皮损融合形成斑块。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Skin Diseases, Papulosquamous" scope note C17.800.862 Skin Diseases, Vascular 血管性皮肤病 "Skin diseases affecting or involving the cutaneous blood vessels and generally manifested as inflammation, swelling, erythema, or necrosis in the affected area." 影响或累及皮肤血管的皮肤疾病，通常在受累部位表现为炎症、肿胀、红斑或坏死。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Skin Diseases, Vascular" scope note C17.800.865 Skin Diseases, Vesiculobullous 水疱大疱性皮肤病 "Skin diseases characterized by local or general distributions of blisters. They are classified according to the site and mode of blister formation. Lesions can appear spontaneously or be precipitated by infection, trauma, or sunlight. Etiologies include immunologic and genetic factors. (From Scientific American Medicine, 1990)" 以局部或全身分布的水疱为特征的皮肤疾病。根据水疱形成的部位和方式进行分类。皮损可自发出现，或由感染、外伤或日光诱发。病因包括免疫和遗传因素。（引自 Scientific American Medicine，1990） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Skin Diseases, Vesiculobullous" scope note C17.800.882 Skin Neoplasms 皮肤肿瘤 "Tumors or cancer of the SKIN." 皮肤（SKIN）的肿瘤或癌。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Skin Neoplasms" scope note C17.800.893 Skin Ulcer 皮肤溃疡 "An ULCER of the skin and underlying tissues." 皮肤及其下组织的溃疡（ULCER）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Skin Ulcer" scope note C17.800.946 Sweat Gland Diseases 汗腺疾病 "Diseases of the SWEAT GLANDS." 汗腺（SWEAT GLANDS）的疾病。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Sweat Gland Diseases" scope note C17.800.973 Xanthogranuloma, Juvenile 幼年黄色肉芽肿 "Benign disorder of infants and children caused by proliferation of HISTIOCYTES, macrophages found in tissues. These histiocytes, usually lipid-laden non-Langerhans cells, form multiple yellow-red nodules most often in the skin, the eye, and sometimes in the viscera. Patients appear to have normal lipid metabolism and are classified as a normolipemic non-Langerhans cell histiocytosis." 婴儿和儿童的良性疾病，由组织细胞（HISTIOCYTES）增生所致，组织细胞即存在于组织中的巨噬细胞。这些组织细胞通常为富含脂质的非朗格汉斯细胞，形成多发性黄红色结节，最常见于皮肤、眼，有时见于内脏。患者脂质代谢似乎正常，被归类为血脂正常的非朗格汉斯细胞组织细胞增生症。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Xanthogranuloma, Juvenile" scope note References National Library of Medicine. medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.summary: C17 Skin and Connective Tissue Diseases Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source C17 Skin and Connective Tissue Diseases 皮肤和结缔组织疾病 "A collective term for diseases of the skin and its appendages and of connective tissue." 对皮肤及其附属器以及结缔组织的疾病的统称。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Skin and Connective Tissue Diseases" scope note C17.300 Connective Tissue Diseases 结缔组织疾病 "A heterogeneous group of disorders, some hereditary, others acquired, characterized by abnormal structure or function of one or more of the elements of connective tissue, i.e., collagen, elastin, or the mucopolysaccharides." 一组异质性疾病，有些为遗传性，另一些为获得性，其特征是结缔组织一种或多种成分的结构或功能异常，这些成分即胶原、弹性蛋白或黏多糖。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Connective Tissue Diseases" scope note C17.800 Skin Diseases 皮肤疾病 "Diseases involving the DERMIS or EPIDERMIS." 累及真皮（DERMIS）或表皮（EPIDERMIS）的疾病。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Skin Diseases" scope note References National Library of Medicine. medical-health-sciences/mesh/c-diseases/.summary: C Diseases Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source C Diseases 疾病 (No definition) （无定义） National Library of Medicine, 2026 C01 Infections 感染 "Invasion of the host organism by microorganisms or their toxins or by parasites that can cause pathological conditions or diseases." 微生物或其毒素、或寄生虫对宿主生物的侵入，可引起病理状态或疾病。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Infections" scope note C04 Neoplasms 肿瘤 "New abnormal growth of tissue. Malignant neoplasms show a greater degree of anaplasia and have the properties of invasion and metastasis, compared to benign neoplasms." 组织新的异常生长。与良性肿瘤相比，恶性肿瘤表现出更高程度的间变，并具有浸润和转移的特性。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Neoplasms" scope note C05 Musculoskeletal Diseases 肌肉骨骼疾病 "Diseases of the muscles and their associated ligaments and other connective tissue and of the bones and cartilage viewed collectively." 肌肉疾病及其相关韧带和其他结缔组织的疾病，以及骨和软骨的疾病的统称。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Musculoskeletal Diseases" scope note C06 Digestive System Diseases 消化系统疾病 "Diseases in any part of the GASTROINTESTINAL TRACT or the accessory organs (LIVER; BILIARY TRACT; PANCREAS)." 发生在胃肠道（GASTROINTESTINAL TRACT）任何部位或附属器官（肝脏 LIVER；胆道 BILIARY TRACT；胰腺 PANCREAS）的疾病。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Digestive System Diseases" scope note C07 Stomatognathic Diseases 口颌疾病 "General or unspecified diseases of the stomatognathic system, comprising the mouth, teeth, jaws, and pharynx." 口颌系统的一般性或未特指的疾病，该系统包括口、牙、颌和咽。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Stomatognathic Diseases" scope note C08 Respiratory Tract Diseases 呼吸道疾病 "Diseases involving the RESPIRATORY SYSTEM." 涉及呼吸系统（RESPIRATORY SYSTEM）的疾病。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Respiratory Tract Diseases" scope note C09 Otorhinolaryngologic Diseases 耳鼻喉疾病 "Pathological processes of the ear, the nose, and the throat, also known as the ENT diseases." 耳、鼻和喉的病理过程，也称 ENT 疾病。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Otorhinolaryngologic Diseases" scope note C10 Nervous System Diseases 神经系统疾病 "Diseases of the central and peripheral nervous system. This includes disorders of the brain, spinal cord, cranial nerves, peripheral nerves, nerve roots, autonomic nervous system, neuromuscular junction, and muscle." 中枢和周围神经系统的疾病。包括脑、脊髓、脑神经、周围神经、神经根、自主神经系统、神经肌肉接头和肌肉的疾患。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Nervous System Diseases" scope note C11 Eye Diseases 眼病 "Diseases affecting the eye." 累及眼睛的疾病。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Eye Diseases" scope note C12 Urogenital Diseases 泌尿生殖疾病 "Pathological processes of the URINARY TRACT and the reproductive system (GENITALIA)." 泌尿道（URINARY TRACT）和生殖系统（生殖器 GENITALIA）的病理过程。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Urogenital Diseases" scope note C14 Cardiovascular Diseases 心血管疾病 "Pathological conditions involving the CARDIOVASCULAR SYSTEM including the HEART; the BLOOD VESSELS; or the PERICARDIUM." 涉及心血管系统（CARDIOVASCULAR SYSTEM）的病理状态，包括心脏（HEART）、血管（BLOOD VESSELS）或心包（PERICARDIUM）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Cardiovascular Diseases" scope note C15 Hemic and Lymphatic Diseases 血液和淋巴疾病 "Hematologic diseases and diseases of the lymphatic system collectively." 血液系统疾病和淋巴系统疾病的统称。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Hemic and Lymphatic Diseases" scope note C16 Congenital, Hereditary, and Neonatal Diseases and Abnormalities 先天性、遗传性和新生儿疾病及畸形 "Diseases existing at birth and often before birth, or that develop during the first month of life (INFANT, NEWBORN, DISEASES), regardless of causation. Of these diseases, those characterized by structural deformities are termed CONGENITAL ABNORMALITIES." 出生时即存在、且常在出生前就已存在的疾病，或在出生后第一个月内发生的疾病（新生儿疾病 INFANT, NEWBORN, DISEASES），不论病因。其中以结构畸形为特征的称为先天畸形（CONGENITAL ABNORMALITIES）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Congenital, Hereditary, and Neonatal Diseases and Abnormalities" scope note C17 Skin and Connective Tissue Diseases 皮肤和结缔组织疾病 "A collective term for diseases of the skin and its appendages and of connective tissue." 皮肤及其附属器疾病和结缔组织疾病的统称。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Skin and Connective Tissue Diseases" scope note C18 Nutritional and Metabolic Diseases 营养和代谢疾病 "A collective term for nutritional disorders resulting from poor absorption or nutritional imbalance, and metabolic disorders resulting from defects in biosynthesis (ANABOLISM) or breakdown (CATABOLISM) of endogenous substances." 营养障碍和代谢障碍的统称：前者由吸收不良或营养失衡引起，后者由内源性物质的合成（ANABOLISM）或分解（CATABOLISM）缺陷引起。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Nutritional and Metabolic Diseases" scope note C19 Endocrine System Diseases 内分泌系统疾病 "Pathological processes of the ENDOCRINE GLANDS, and diseases resulting from abnormal level of available HORMONES." 内分泌腺（ENDOCRINE GLANDS）的病理过程，以及由可用激素（HORMONES）水平异常引起的疾病。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Endocrine System Diseases" scope note C20 Immune System Diseases 免疫系统疾病 "Disorders caused by abnormal or absent immunologic mechanisms, whether humoral, cell-mediated, or both." 由免疫机制异常或缺失引起的疾患，无论是体液免疫、细胞介导免疫，还是两者兼有。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Immune System Diseases" scope note C21 Disorders of Environmental Origin 环境源性疾患 "Disorders caused by external forces rather than by physiologic dysfunction or by pathogens." 由外部力量而非生理功能障碍或病原体引起的疾患。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Disorders of Environmental Origin" scope note C22 Animal Diseases 动物疾病 "Diseases that occur in VERTEBRATE animals." 发生在脊椎动物（VERTEBRATE）身上的疾病。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Animal Diseases" scope note C23 Pathological Conditions, Signs and Symptoms 病理状态、体征和症状 "Abnormal anatomical or physiological conditions and objective or subjective manifestations of disease, not classified as disease or syndrome." 异常的解剖或生理状态，以及疾病的客观或主观表现，不归为疾病或综合征。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Pathological Conditions, Signs and Symptoms" scope note C24 Occupational Diseases 职业病 "Diseases caused by factors involved in one's employment." 由与本人职业有关的因素引起的疾病。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Occupational Diseases" scope note C25 Chemically-Induced Disorders 化学物质所致疾患 "Disorders caused by the intentional or unintentional ingestion or exposure to chemical substances such as PHARMACEUTICAL PREPARATIONS; NOXAE; and PESTICIDES." 由有意或无意摄入或接触化学物质引起的疾患，如药物制剂（PHARMACEUTICAL PREPARATIONS）、有害物质（NOXAE）和农药（PESTICIDES）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Chemically-Induced Disorders" scope note C26 Wounds and Injuries 创伤和损伤 "Damage inflicted on the body as the direct or indirect result of an external force, with or without disruption of structural continuity." 身体所受的损害，是外力直接或间接作用的结果，可伴有或不伴有结构连续性的破坏。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Wounds and Injuries" scope note References National Library of Medicine. medical-health-sciences/mesh/d-chemicals.summary: D Chemicals and Drugs Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source D Chemicals and Drugs 化学品和药物 (No definition) （无定义） National Library of Medicine, 2026 D01 Inorganic Chemicals 无机化学品 "A broad class of substances encompassing all those that do not include carbon and its derivatives as their principal elements. However, carbides, carbonates, cyanides, cyanates, and carbon disulfide are included in this class." 一大类物质，涵盖所有不以碳及其衍生物为主要元素的物质。不过，碳化物、碳酸盐、氰化物、氰酸盐和二硫化碳也归入此类。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Inorganic Chemicals" scope note D02 Organic Chemicals 有机化学品 "A broad class of substances containing carbon and its derivatives. Many of these chemicals will frequently contain hydrogen with or without oxygen, nitrogen, sulfur, phosphorus, and other elements. They exist in either carbon chain or carbon ring form." 一大类含有碳及其衍生物的物质。这些化学品常含氢，可含或不含氧、氮、硫、磷和其他元素。它们以碳链或碳环的形式存在。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Organic Chemicals" scope note D03 Heterocyclic Compounds 杂环化合物 "Cyclic compounds that include atoms other than carbon in their ring structure." 环结构中含有碳以外原子的环状化合物。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Heterocyclic Compounds" scope note D04 Polycyclic Compounds 多环化合物 "Compounds which contain two or more rings in their structure." 结构中含有两个或更多环的化合物。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Polycyclic Compounds" scope note D05 Macromolecular Substances 大分子物质 "Compounds and molecular complexes that consist of very large numbers of atoms and are generally over 500 kDa in size. In biological systems macromolecular substances usually can be visualized using ELECTRON MICROSCOPY and are distinguished from ORGANELLES by the lack of a membrane structure." 由极多原子组成的化合物和分子复合物，大小一般超过 500 kDa。在生物系统中，大分子物质通常可用电子显微镜（ELECTRON MICROSCOPY）观察，并因没有膜结构而与细胞器（ORGANELLES）相区别。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Macromolecular Substances" scope note D06 Hormones, Hormone Substitutes, and Hormone Antagonists 激素、激素代用品和激素拮抗剂 "A collective grouping for both naturally occurring and synthetic hormones, substitutes, and antagonists." 天然和合成的激素、代用品和拮抗剂的统称。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Hormones, Hormone Substitutes, and Hormone Antagonists" scope note D08 Enzymes and Coenzymes 酶和辅酶 "Biological catalysts and their cofactors." 生物催化剂及其辅因子。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Enzymes and Coenzymes" scope note D09 Carbohydrates 碳水化合物 "A class of organic compounds composed of carbon, hydrogen, and oxygen in a ratio of Cn(H2O)n. The largest class of organic compounds, including STARCH; GLYCOGEN; CELLULOSE; POLYSACCHARIDES; and simple MONOSACCHARIDES." 一类由碳、氢和氧按 Cn(H2O)n 比例组成的有机化合物。是最大的一类有机化合物，包括淀粉（STARCH）、糖原（GLYCOGEN）、纤维素（CELLULOSE）、多糖（POLYSACCHARIDES）和简单的单糖（MONOSACCHARIDES）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Carbohydrates" scope note D10 Lipids 脂质 "A generic term for fats and lipoids, the alcohol-ether-soluble constituents of protoplasm, which are insoluble in water." 脂肪和类脂的总称，是原生质中可溶于醇和醚的成分，不溶于水。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Lipids" scope note D12 Amino Acids, Peptides, and Proteins 氨基酸、肽和蛋白质 "Amino acids and chains of amino acids connected by peptide linkages." 氨基酸，以及由肽键连接的氨基酸链。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Amino Acids, Peptides, and Proteins" scope note D13 Nucleic Acids, Nucleotides, and Nucleosides 核酸、核苷酸和核苷 "Complex compounds of high molecular weight occurring in living cells. These are basically of two types, ribonucleic (RNA) and deoxyribonucleic (DNA) acids, both of which consist of nucleotides (nucleoside phosphates linked together by phosphate bridges)." 存在于活细胞中的高分子量复杂化合物。基本上分为两类，核糖核酸（RNA）和脱氧核糖核酸（DNA），两者都由核苷酸组成（核苷磷酸通过磷酸桥连接在一起）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Nucleic Acids, Nucleotides, and Nucleosides" scope note D20 Complex Mixtures 复杂混合物 "Mixtures of many components in inexact proportions, usually natural, such as PLANT EXTRACTS; VENOMS; and MANURE. These are distinguished from DRUG COMBINATIONS which have only a few components in definite proportions." 由多种成分按不确定比例组成的混合物，通常来自天然，如植物提取物（PLANT EXTRACTS）、毒液（VENOMS）和粪肥（MANURE）。它们有别于药物组合（DRUG COMBINATIONS），后者只有少数成分且比例确定。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Complex Mixtures" scope note D23 Biological Factors 生物因子 "Endogenously synthesized compounds that influence biological processes not otherwise classified under ENZYMES; HORMONES or HORMONE ANTAGONISTS." 内源合成的化合物，影响生物过程，且未另归入酶（ENZYMES）、激素（HORMONES）或激素拮抗剂（HORMONE ANTAGONISTS）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Biological Factors" scope note D25 Biomedical and Dental Materials 生物医学和牙科材料 "Substances used in biomedicine or dentistry predominantly for their physical, as opposed to chemical, properties." 在生物医学或牙科中使用的物质，主要利用其物理性质而非化学性质。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Biomedical and Dental Materials" scope note D26 Pharmaceutical Preparations 药物制剂 "Drugs intended for human or veterinary use, presented in their finished dosage form. Included here are materials used in the preparation and/or formulation of the finished dosage form." 供人用或兽用的药物，以最终剂型呈现。也包括制备和/或配制最终剂型所用的材料。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Pharmaceutical Preparations" scope note D27 Chemical Actions and Uses 化学作用和用途 "A group of pharmacologic activities, effects on living systems and the environment, and modes of employment of drugs and chemicals. They are broken into actions, which describe their effects, and uses, which describe how they are employed." 药物和化学品的一组药理活性、对生物系统和环境的影响以及使用方式。它们分为作用，描述其效果，和用途，描述其使用方式。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Chemical Actions and Uses" scope note References National Library of Medicine. (2026). MeSH 2026 descriptor records [Data set]. Retrieved October 28, 2026, from https://www.nlm.nih.gov/databases/download/mesh.html

medical-health-sciences/mesh/e-analytica.summary: E Analytical, Diagnostic and Therapeutic Techniques, and Equipment Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source E Analytical, Diagnostic and Therapeutic Techniques, and Equipment 分析、诊断和治疗技术及设备 (No definition) （无定义） National Library of Medicine, 2026 E01 Diagnosis 诊断 "The determination of the nature of a disease or condition, or the distinguishing of one disease or condition from another. Assessment may be made through physical examination, laboratory tests, or the likes. Computerized programs may be used to enhance the decision-making process." 确定疾病或状况的性质，或把一种疾病或状况与另一种区分开。评估可通过体格检查、实验室检查等进行。可借助计算机程序改进决策过程。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Diagnosis" scope note E02 Therapeutics 治疗学 "Procedures concerned with the remedial treatment or prevention of diseases." 涉及疾病的治疗或预防的程序。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Therapeutics" scope note E03 Anesthesia and Analgesia 麻醉和镇痛 "Medical methods of either relieving pain caused by a particular condition or removing the sensation of pain during a surgery or other medical procedure." 医学方法，或缓解特定状况引起的疼痛，或在手术或其他医疗程序中消除痛觉。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Anesthesia and Analgesia" scope note E04 Surgical Procedures, Operative 外科手术 "Operations carried out for the correction of deformities and defects, repair of injuries, and diagnosis and cure of certain diseases. (Taber, 18th ed.)." 为矫正畸形和缺陷、修复损伤以及诊断和治愈某些疾病而进行的手术。（Taber，第 18 版） National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Surgical Procedures, Operative" scope note E05 Investigative Techniques 研究技术 "Investigative techniques used in pre-clinical and clinical research, epidemiology, chemistry, immunology, genetics, etc. They do not include techniques specifically applied to DIAGNOSIS; THERAPEUTICS; anesthesia and analgesia; SURGICAL PROCEDURES, OPERATIVE; and DENTISTRY." 用于临床前和临床研究、流行病学、化学、免疫学、遗传学等的研究技术。不包括专门用于诊断（DIAGNOSIS）、治疗（THERAPEUTICS）、麻醉和镇痛、外科手术（SURGICAL PROCEDURES, OPERATIVE）和牙科（DENTISTRY）的技术。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Investigative Techniques" scope note E06 Dentistry 牙科学 "The profession concerned with the teeth, oral cavity, and associated structures, and the diagnosis and treatment of their diseases including prevention and the restoration of defective and missing tissue." 涉及牙齿、口腔及相关结构的职业，以及其疾病的诊断和治疗，包括预防以及缺损和缺失组织的修复。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Dentistry" scope note E07 Equipment and Supplies 设备和用品 "Expendable and nonexpendable equipment, supplies, apparatus, and instruments that are used in diagnostic, surgical, therapeutic, scientific, and experimental procedures." 用于诊断、外科、治疗、科研和实验程序的消耗性和非消耗性设备、用品、器械和仪器。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Equipment and Supplies" scope note References National Library of Medicine. (2026). MeSH 2026 descriptor records [Data set]. Retrieved October 28, 2026, from https://www.nlm.nih.gov/databases/download/mesh.html

medical-health-sciences/mesh/g-phenomena.summary: G Phenomena and Processes Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source G Phenomena and Processes 现象和过程 (No definition) （无定义） National Library of Medicine, 2026 G01 Physical Phenomena 物理现象 "The entities of matter and energy, and the processes, principles, properties, and relationships describing their nature and interactions." 物质和能量的实体，以及描述其本质和相互作用的过程、原理、性质和关系。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Physical Phenomena" scope note G02 Chemical Phenomena 化学现象 "The composition, structure, conformation, and properties of atoms and molecules, and their reaction and interaction processes." 原子和分子的组成、结构、构象和性质，以及它们的反应和相互作用过程。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Chemical Phenomena" scope note G03 Metabolism 代谢 "The chemical reactions in living organisms by which energy is provided for vital processes and activities and new material is assimilated." 生物体内的化学反应，通过这些反应为生命过程和活动提供能量并同化新物质。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Metabolism" scope note G04 Cell Physiological Phenomena 细胞生理现象 "Cellular processes, properties, and characteristics." 细胞的过程、性质和特征。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Cell Physiological Phenomena" scope note G05 Genetic Phenomena 遗传现象 "The biological processes, properties, and objects that are involved in maintaining, expressing, and transmitting from one organism to another, genetically encoded traits." 参与维持、表达以及在生物体之间传递遗传编码性状的生物过程、性质和对象。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Genetic Phenomena" scope note G06 Microbiological Phenomena 微生物学现象 "Physiological processes and properties of microorganisms, such as ARCHAEA; BACTERIA; RICKETTSIA; VIRUSES; and FUNGI." 微生物的生理过程和性质，如古菌（ARCHAEA）、细菌（BACTERIA）、立克次体（RICKETTSIA）、病毒（VIRUSES）和真菌（FUNGI）。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Microbiological Phenomena" scope note G07 Physiological Phenomena 生理现象 "The functions and properties of living organisms, including both the physical and chemical factors and processes, supporting life in single- or multi-cell organisms from their origin through the progression of life." 生物体的功能和性质，包括在单细胞或多细胞生物中从起源到整个生命进程支持生命的物理和化学因素及过程。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Physiological Phenomena" scope note G08 Reproductive and Urinary Physiological Phenomena 生殖和泌尿生理现象 "Physiology of the human and animal body, male or female, in the processes and characteristics of REPRODUCTION and the URINARY TRACT." 人体和动物身体（男性或女性）在生殖（REPRODUCTION）和泌尿道（URINARY TRACT）的过程和特征方面的生理学。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Reproductive and Urinary Physiological Phenomena" scope note G09 Circulatory and Respiratory Physiological Phenomena 循环和呼吸生理现象 "Functional processes and properties characteristic of the BLOOD; CARDIOVASCULAR SYSTEM; and RESPIRATORY SYSTEM." 血液（BLOOD）、心血管系统（CARDIOVASCULAR SYSTEM）和呼吸系统（RESPIRATORY SYSTEM）特有的功能过程和性质。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Circulatory and Respiratory Physiological Phenomena" scope note G10 Digestive System and Oral Physiological Phenomena 消化系统和口腔生理现象 "Properties and processes of the DIGESTIVE SYSTEM and DENTITION as a whole or of any of its parts." 消化系统（DIGESTIVE SYSTEM）和牙列（DENTITION）整体或其任何部分的性质和过程。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Digestive System and Oral Physiological Phenomena" scope note G11 Musculoskeletal and Neural Physiological Phenomena 肌肉骨骼和神经生理现象 "Properties, and processes of the MUSCULOSKELETAL SYSTEM and the NERVOUS SYSTEM or their parts." 肌肉骨骼系统（MUSCULOSKELETAL SYSTEM）和神经系统（NERVOUS SYSTEM）或其各部分的性质和过程。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Musculoskeletal and Neural Physiological Phenomena" scope note G12 Immune System Phenomena 免疫系统现象 "The characteristic properties and processes involved in IMMUNITY and an organism's immune response." 免疫（IMMUNITY）和生物体的免疫反应所涉及的特征性质和过程。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Immune System Phenomena" scope note G13 Integumentary System Physiological Phenomena 皮肤系统生理现象 "The properties and relationships and biological processes that characterize the nature and function of the SKIN and its appendages." 表征皮肤（SKIN）及其附属器本质和功能的性质、关系和生物过程。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Integumentary System Physiological Phenomena" scope note G14 Ocular Physiological Phenomena 眼生理现象 "Processes and properties of the EYE as a whole or of any of its parts." 眼（EYE）整体或其任何部分的过程和性质。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Ocular Physiological Phenomena" scope note G15 Plant Physiological Phenomena 植物生理现象 "The physiological processes, properties, and states characteristic of plants." 植物特有的生理过程、性质和状态。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Plant Physiological Phenomena" scope note G16 Biological Phenomena 生物现象 "Biological processes, properties, and characteristics of the whole organism in human, animal, microorganisms, and plants, and of the biosphere." 人类、动物、微生物和植物整个生物体的生物过程、性质和特征，以及生物圈的生物过程、性质和特征。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Biological Phenomena" scope note G17 Mathematical Concepts 数学概念 "Numeric or quantitative entities, descriptions, properties, relationships, operations, and events." 数值或定量的实体、描述、性质、关系、运算和事件。 National Library of Medicine, 2026, "Mathematical Concepts" scope note References National Library of Medicine. "Network security combines policies and technologies to protect systems and digital assets from unauthorized access, misuse, and disruption." （语境）网络服务是网络应用层上的应用，把在办公室、分支机构或远程位置工作的用户连接到网络中的应用和数据。 网络安全结合策略和技术，保护系统和数字资产免遭未授权访问、滥用和中断。 Cisco, n.d.-c, para. 1 Cisco, n.d.-g, para. 1 AI, and Network Operations and Management AI 与网络运维和管理 (context) "Network management encompasses both the essential processes and the specialized platforms used by IT and NetOps teams to configure, monitor, and optimize network performance." （语境）网络管理涵盖基本流程和专用平台，IT 和 NetOps 团队用它们来配置、监控和优化网络性能。 Cisco, n.d.-f, para. 1 Coverage Certification Skill area 200-301 CCNA v2.0 1. operating-systems/cs2023/index.html.summary: CS2023 OS Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source CS2023 OS CS2023 OS "Core topics focus on the mechanisms and policies needed to virtualize computation, memory, and Input/Output (I/O)." 核心主题侧重于机制与策略，用以虚拟化计算、内存和输入/输出（I/O）。 Joint Task Force on Computing Curricula, 2024, OS "Preamble" section, para. 1 Role and Purpose of Operating Systems 操作系统的作用和目的 (context) "Understand the objectives and functions of modern operating systems." （语境）理解现代操作系统的目标和功能。 Joint Task Force on Computing Curricula, 2024, OS-Purpose "Illustrative Learning Outcomes", 1 Principles of Operating System 操作系统原理 (context) "Understand how the application of software design approaches to operating systems design/implementation (e.g., layered, modular, etc.) affects the robustness and maintainability of an operating system." （语境）理解把软件设计方法应用于操作系统设计/实现（例如分层、模块化等）如何影响操作系统的健壮性和可维护性。 Joint Task Force on Computing Curricula, 2024, OS-Principles "Illustrative Learning Outcomes", 1 Concurrency 并发 (context) "Understand the advantages and disadvantages of concurrency as inseparable functions within the operating system framework." （语境）理解并发的优点和缺点，它们是操作系统框架中不可分割的功能。 Joint Task Force on Computing Curricula, 2024, OS-Concurrency "Illustrative Learning Outcomes", 1 Protection and Safety 保护与安全 (context) "Understand the requirement for protection and security mechanisms in operating systems." （语境）理解操作系统中对保护和安全机制的需求。 Joint Task Force on Computing Curricula, 2024, OS-Protection "Illustrative Learning Outcomes", 1 Scheduling 调度 (context) "Compare and contrast the common algorithms used for both preemptive and non-preemptive scheduling of tasks in operating systems, such as priority, performance comparison, and fair-share schemes." （语境）比较操作系统中用于任务抢占式和非抢占式调度的常见算法，例如优先级、性能比较和公平共享方案。 Joint Task Force on Computing Curricula, 2024, OS-Scheduling "Illustrative Learning Outcomes", 1 Process Model 进程模型 (context) "Understand how processes and threads use concurrency features to virtualize control." （语境）理解进程和线程如何使用并发特性来虚拟化控制。 Joint Task Force on Computing Curricula, 2024, OS-Process "Illustrative Learning Outcomes", 1 Memory Management 内存管理 (context) "Explain memory hierarchy and cost-performance tradeoffs." （语境）解释存储层次结构和成本与性能的权衡。 Joint Task Force on Computing Curricula, 2024, OS-Memory "Illustrative Learning Outcomes", 1 Device management 设备管理 (context) "Explain architecture level device control implementation and link relevant operating system mechanisms and policy (e.g., buffering strategies, direct memory access)." （语境）解释体系结构层面的设备控制实现，并联系相关的操作系统机制和策略（例如缓冲策略、直接内存访问）。 Joint Task Force on Computing Curricula, 2024, OS-Devices "Illustrative Learning Outcomes", 1 File Systems API and Implementation 文件系统 API 与实现 (context) "Explain the choices to be made in designing file systems." （语境）解释设计文件系统时要做的选择。 Joint Task Force on Computing Curricula, 2024, OS-Files "Illustrative Learning Outcomes", 1 Advanced File systems 高级文件系统 (context) "Explain how hardware developments have led to changes in the priorities for the design and the management of file systems." （语境）解释硬件的发展如何改变了文件系统设计和管理的优先事项。 Joint Task Force on Computing Curricula, 2024, OS-Advanced-Files "Illustrative Learning Outcomes", 1 Virtualization 虚拟化 (context) "Explain how hardware architecture provides support and efficiencies for virtualization." （语境）解释硬件体系结构如何为虚拟化提供支持和效率。 Joint Task Force on Computing Curricula, 2024, OS-Virtualization "Illustrative Learning Outcomes", 1 Real-time and Embedded Systems 实时与嵌入式系统 (context) "Explain what makes a system a real-time system." （语境）解释什么使一个系统成为实时系统。 Joint Task Force on Computing Curricula, 2024, OS-Real-time "Illustrative Learning Outcomes", 1 Fault tolerance 容错 (context) "Explain how operating systems can facilitate fault tolerance, reliability, and availability." （语境）解释操作系统如何促进容错、可靠性和可用性。 Joint Task Force on Computing Curricula, 2024, OS-Faults "Illustrative Learning Outcomes", 1 Society, Ethics, and the Profession 社会、伦理与职业 (context) "Explain advantages and disadvantages of finding and addressing bugs in open-source kernels." （语境）解释在开源内核中发现并修复缺陷的优点和缺点。 Joint Task Force on Computing Curricula, 2024, OS-SEP "Illustrative Learning Outcomes", 1 References Joint Task Force on Computing Curricula. (2024). Computer science curricula 2023. Association for Computing Machinery. https://doi.org/10.1145/3664191

Parts: a. Unauthorized access to files on an unencrypted drive can be achieved by moving the media to another computer. b. Operating systems enforced security can be defeated by infiltrating the boot layer before the operating system is loaded. c. Process isolation can be subverted by inadequate authorization checking at API boundaries. d. Vulnerabilities in system firmware can provide attack vectors that bypass the operating system entirely. e. Improper isolation of virtual machine memory, computing, and hardware can expose the host system to attacks from guest systems. f. The operating system may need to mitigate exploitation of hardware and firmware vulnerabilities, leading to potential performance reductions (e.g., Spectre and Meltdown mitigations). Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source Full virtualization 完全虚拟化 "In full virtualization, one or more OSs and the applications they contain are run on top of virtual hardware." 在完全虚拟化中，一个或多个 OS 及其包含的应用程序运行在虚拟硬件之上。 Scarfone et al., 2011, section 2.1, p. 2-1 Hypervisor 虚拟机管理程序 "The guest OSs on a host are managed by the hypervisor, also called the virtual machine monitor (VMM), which controls the flow of instructions between the guest OSs and the physical hardware, such as CPU, disk storage, memory, and network interface cards." 主机上的客户 OS 由 hypervisor 管理，hypervisor 也称为虚拟机监视器（VMM），它控制客户 OS 与物理硬件之间的指令流，物理硬件例如 CPU、磁盘存储、内存和网卡。 Scarfone et al., 2011, section 2.1, p. 2-1 Bare metal virtualization 裸机虚拟化 "In bare metal virtualization, also known as native virtualization, the hypervisor runs directly on the underlying hardware, without a host OS; the hypervisor can even be built into the computer's firmware." 在裸机虚拟化（也称为原生虚拟化）中，hypervisor 直接运行在底层硬件上，没有主机 OS；hypervisor 甚至可以内置在计算机固件中。 Scarfone et al., 2011, section 2.2, p. 2-2 Hosted virtualization 宿主虚拟化 "In the other form of full virtualization, known as hosted virtualization, the hypervisor runs on top of the host OS; the host OS can be almost any common operating system such as Windows, Linux, or MacOS." 另一种完全虚拟化形式称为宿主虚拟化，其中 hypervisor 运行在主机 OS 之上；主机 OS 几乎可以是任何常见操作系统，例如 Windows、Linux 或 MacOS。 Scarfone et al., 2011, section 2.2, p. 2-2 References Joint Task Force on Computing Curricula. (2024). Computer science curricula 2023. Association for Computing Machinery. https://doi.org/10.1145/3664191 Scarfone, K., Souppaya, M., & Hoffman, P. (2011). Guide to security for full virtualization technologies (NIST Special Publication 800-125). National Institute of Standards and Technology. https://doi.org/10.6028/NIST.SP.800-125

Virtualization Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source Virtualization 虚拟化 "Virtualization is the simulation of the software and/or hardware upon which other software runs." 虚拟化是对软件和/或硬件的模拟，其他软件运行在这些软件或硬件之上。 Scarfone et al., 2011, p. ES-1 Using virtualization and isolation to achieve protection and predictable performance 用虚拟化和隔离实现保护和可预测的性能 (context) "The hypervisor can partition the system's resources and isolate the guest OSs so that each has access to only its own resources, as well as possible access to shared resources such as files on the host OS." （语境）hypervisor 可以划分系统资源并隔离各个客户 OS，使每个客户 OS 只能访问自己的资源，以及可能访问主机 OS 上文件等共享资源。 Scarfone et al., 2011, p. ES-1 Advanced paging and virtual memory 高级分页和虚拟内存 (context) "The virtual memory abstracts the details of physical memory from the application software, allows to keep only needed information in the physical memory (demand paging) and provides a mechanism for the protection and controlled sharing of data between processes." （语境）虚拟内存为应用软件抽象掉物理内存的细节，只把需要的信息保留在物理内存中（按需分页），并提供在进程之间保护和受控共享数据的机制。 The kernel development community, n.d.-a, "Virtual Memory Primer" section, para. 3 Virtual file systems and virtual devices 虚拟文件系统和虚拟设备 (context) "Ensure that virtual devices for the guest OS are associated only with the appropriate physical devices on the host system, such as the mappings between virtual and physical NICs." （语境）确保客户 OS 的虚拟设备只与主机系统上相应的物理设备相关联，例如虚拟网卡和物理网卡之间的映射。 Scarfone et al., 2011, p. 4-4 Containers and their comparison to virtual machines 容器及其与虚拟机的比较 (context) "Another form of virtualization, known as operating system virtualization, provides a virtual implementation of the OS interface that can be used to run applications written for the same OS as the host, with each application in a separate VM container." （语境）另一种虚拟化形式称为操作系统虚拟化，它提供 OS 接口的虚拟实现，可用于运行为与主机相同的 OS 编写的应用程序，每个应用程序在单独的 VM 容器中运行。 Scarfone et al., 2011, p. 2-1 Thrashing (e.g., Popek and Goldberg requirements for recursively virtualizable systems) 抖动（例如 Popek 和 Goldberg 关于可递归虚拟化系统的要求） (context) "The 'full' line indicates the share of time in which all non-idle tasks are stalled on a given resource simultaneously. In this state actual CPU cycles are going to waste, and a workload that spends extended time in this state is considered to be thrashing." （语境）"full" 一行表示所有非空闲任务同时在某个资源上停滞的时间占比。在这种状态下，实际的 CPU 周期被浪费，长时间处于这种状态的工作负载被认为在抖动（thrashing）。 The kernel development community, n.d.-b, "Pressure interface" section Types of virtualizations (including hardware/software, OS, server, service, network) 虚拟化的类型（包括硬件/软件、OS、服务器、服务、网络） (context) "There are many forms of virtualization, distinguished primarily by computing architecture layer." （语境）虚拟化有多种形式，主要按计算体系结构的层次来区分。 Scarfone et al., 2011, p. ES-1 Portable virtualization; emulation vs isolation 可移植虚拟化；仿真与隔离 (context) "Also, each guest OS can be completely encapsulated, making it portable." （语境）此外，每个客户 OS 都可以被完全封装，从而可移植。 Scarfone et al., 2011, p. ES-1 Cost of virtualization 虚拟化的成本 (context) "In particular, due to the overhead required for virtualization, load testing in a virtual environment may not provide the same results as load testing in a physical environment." （语境）特别是，由于虚拟化所需的开销，在虚拟环境中做负载测试可能得不到与物理环境相同的结果。 Scarfone et al., 2011, p. 3-4 Virtual machines and container escapes, dangers from a security perspective 虚拟机和容器逃逸：安全角度的危险 (context) "Breaking out of a guest OS is also known as escape. If an attacker can successfully escape a guest OS and gain access to the hypervisor, the attacker might be able to compromise the hypervisor and gain control over all of its guest OSs." （语境）突破客户 OS 也称为逃逸。如果攻击者能成功从客户 OS 逃逸并访问 hypervisor，就可能攻破 hypervisor，并控制它的所有客户 OS。 Scarfone et al., 2011, p. 3-2 Hypervisors- hardware virtual machine extensions, hosts with kernel support, QEMU KVM 虚拟机管理程序：硬件虚拟机扩展、带内核支持的主机、QEMU KVM (context) "The guest OSs on a host are managed by the hypervisor, also called the virtual machine monitor (VMM), which controls the flow of instructions between the guest OSs and the physical hardware, such as CPU, disk storage, memory, and network interface cards." （语境）主机上的客户 OS 由 hypervisor 管理，它也称为虚拟机监视器（VMM），负责控制指令流，指令在客户 OS 与 CPU、磁盘存储、内存和网卡等物理硬件之间流动。 Scarfone et al., 2011, p. 2-1 References Joint Task Force on Computing Curricula. (2024). Computer science curricula 2023. Association for Computing Machinery. https://doi.org/10.1145/3664191 Scarfone, K., Souppaya, M., & Hoffman, P. (2011).
