programming/git/pro-git-getting-started..summary: Pro Git: Getting Started Study notes on Scott Chacon and Ben Straub, Pro Git, 2nd edition. Each section links the official page it follows. Start from the figure: the framed terms are the ones to learn, and the table below it defines them in the same order, each with a citation linked to the passage and a Chinese translation in which each key word has the same colour as in the English. The main verb of each sentence has a red wavy underline, in the English and in the Chinese. Overview What is Git? Term Definition 中文翻译 Source Git Git 版本控制 "Git is a free and open source distributed version control system designed to handle everything from small to very large projects with speed and efficiency." Git 是一个免费且开源的分布式版本控制系统，旨在处理从小型到超大型的各种项目，并做到快速、高效。 Git, n.d., para. 1 working tree 工作区 "The working tree is a single checkout of one version of the project. These files are pulled out of the compressed database in the Git directory and placed on disk for you to use or modify." 工作区是项目某一版本的单次检出。这些文件从 Git 目录中的压缩数据库中提取出来，放在磁盘上供你使用或修改。 Chacon, 2014, "The Three States" section, para. 3 modified 已修改 "Modified means that you have changed the file but have not committed it to your database yet." 已修改表示你已更改文件，但尚未将其提交到数据库。 Chacon, 2014, "The Three States" section, bullet 1 git add git add 暂存 "Add contents of new or changed files to the index. The "index" (also known as the "staging area") is what you use to prepare the contents of the next commit." 将新文件或已更改文件的内容添加到索引中。“索引”（也称为“暂存区”）是你用来准备下一次提交内容的地方。 Git, n.d., "DESCRIPTION" section, para. 1 staging area (index) 暂存区 "The staging area is a file, generally contained in your Git directory, that stores information about what will go into your next commit. Its technical name in Git parlance is the "index"..." 暂存区是一个文件，通常位于你的 Git 目录中，存储着有关下一次提交将包含哪些内容的信息。用 Git 的术语来说，它的技术名称是“索引”…… Chacon, 2014, "The Three States" section, para. 4 staged 已暂存 "Staged means that you have marked a modified file in its current version to go into your next commit snapshot." 已暂存表示你已将修改过的文件的当前版本标记为要放入下一次提交快照中。 Chacon, 2014, "The Three States" section, bullet 2 commit 提交 "With Git, every time you commit, or save the state of your project, Git basically takes a picture of what all your files look like at that moment and stores a reference to that snapshot." 在 Git 中，每当你提交，或者说保存你的项目状态时，Git 基本上会为你所有文件在那一刻的样子拍一张照片，并存储对该快照的一个引用。 Chacon, 2014, "Snapshots, Not Differences" section, para. 2 Git directory Git 目录（本地仓库） "The Git directory is where Git stores the metadata and object database for your project. This is the most important part of Git, and it is what is copied when you clone a repository from another computer." Git 目录是 Git 存储项目元数据和对象数据库的地方。这是 Git 最重要的部分，也是你从另一台计算机克隆仓库时所复制的内容。 Chacon, 2014, "The Three States" section, para. 5 committed 已提交 "Committed means that the data is safely stored in your local database." 已提交表示数据已安全地存储在本地数据库中。 Chacon, 2014, "The Three States" section, bullet 3 remote repository 远程仓库 "A repository which is used to track the same project but resides somewhere else. To communicate with remotes, see fetch or push." 一个用于跟踪同一项目、但位于其他位置的仓库。要与远程仓库通信，请参阅 fetch 或 push。 Git, n.d., "remote repository" entry push 推送 "When you have your project at a point that you want to share, you have to push it upstream." 当你的项目进展到你想要分享的程度时，你必须将它推送到上游。 Chacon, 2014, "Pushing to Your Remotes" section, para. 1 pull 拉取 "Pulling a branch means to fetch it and merge it." 拉取一个分支意味着获取它并合并它。 Git, n.d., "pull" entry clone 克隆 "If you want to get a copy of an existing Git repository — for example, a project you’d like to contribute to — the command you need is git clone." 如果你想获取一个现有 Git 仓库的副本——例如，一个你想参与贡献的项目——你需要的命令是 git clone。 Chacon, 2014, "Cloning an Existing Repository" section, para. 1

programming/github/github-docs-collabora.title: GitHub Docs: Collaborating with Pull Requests | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
programming/github/github-docs-collabora.summary: GitHub Docs: Collaborating with Pull Requests Study notes on GitHub Docs. Each section links the official page it follows. Start from the figure: the framed terms are the ones to learn, and the table below it defines them in the same order, each with a citation linked to the passage and a Chinese translation in which each key word has the same colour as in the English. The main verb of each sentence has a red wavy underline, in the English and in the Chinese. Overview About pull requests and forks Term Definition 中文翻译 Source GitHub GitHub 平台 "GitHub is a platform that supports your entire software development process, from planning work to deploying and operating software." GitHub 是一个平台，支持你的整个软件开发流程，从规划工作到部署和运营软件。 GitHub, n.d., para. 1 fork and pull model 复刻加拉取请求模式 "In the fork and pull model, anyone can fork an existing ("upstream") repository if they have read access and the owner of the upstream repository allows it." 在复刻加拉取请求模式中，任何人都可以复刻现有的（“上游”）仓库，前提是他们拥有读取权限，并且上游仓库的所有者允许这样做。 GitHub, n.d., "Fork and pull model" section, para. 1 upstream repository 上游仓库 "Forks are repositories that start as copies of another repository, called the upstream repository." 复刻是一些仓库，它们最初是另一个仓库的副本，该仓库称为上游仓库。 GitHub, n.d., para. 1 fork 复刻（Fork） "A fork is a separate repository with its own settings and collaboration space." 复刻是一个独立的仓库，拥有自己的设置和协作空间。 GitHub, n.d., "What makes forks distinct from branches" section, para. 1 shared repository model 共享仓库模式 "In the shared repository model, collaborators have push access to a single shared repository and create topic branches when they need to make changes." 在共享仓库模式中，协作者对单个共享仓库拥有推送权限，并在需要进行更改时创建主题分支。 GitHub, n.d., "Shared repository model" section, para. 1 collaborator 协作者 "A collaborator is a person with read and write access to a repository who has been invited to contribute by the repository owner." 协作者是对某个仓库拥有读写访问权限的人，此人已受仓库所有者邀请参与贡献。 GitHub, n.d., "collaborator" section, para. 1 branch 分支 "A "branch" is a line of development. The most recent commit on a branch is referred to as the tip of that branch." “分支”是一条开发线。分支上最近的一次提交被称为该分支的末端（tip）。 Git, n.d., "branch" entry pull request 拉取请求（PR） "Pull requests are proposals to merge code changes into a project." 拉取请求是一种提议：将代码更改合并到一个项目中。 GitHub, n.d., para. 1 review 代码审查 "Pull request reviews let people comment on changes, suggest improvements, and approve or request changes before code is merged." 拉取请求审查让人们可以在代码合并之前对更改发表评论、提出改进建议，以及批准或请求更改。 GitHub, n.d., para. 2 merge 合并 "Merging takes the changes from one branch (in the same repository or from a fork), and applies them into another." 合并会获取来自一个分支（位于同一仓库中或来自某个复刻）的更改，并将其应用到另一个分支中。 GitHub, n.d., "merge" section, para. 1 default branch 默认分支 "The base branch for new pull requests and code commits in a repository. Each repository has at least one branch, which Git creates when you initialize the repository. The first branch is usually called main, and is often the default branch." 仓库中新拉取请求和代码提交的基础分支。每个仓库至少有一个分支，该分支由 Git 在你初始化仓库时创建。第一个分支通常称为 main，并且通常是默认分支。 GitHub, n.d., "default branch" section, para. 1

projects/ecg-viewer.html.title: ECG Viewer Modernization | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
projects/ecg-viewer.html.summary: ECG Viewer Modernization Rebuilt a legacy ECG desktop viewer with no source code available on a tight timeline, then added real-time ECG over Bluetooth LE. Role: Lead Architect & Developer (team) Organization: Healthcare client, Korea Dates: May 2026 – Jun 2026 Stack: Python, PySide6, Bluetooth LE What it does A Windows desktop viewer for a single-channel ECG recorder, rebuilt from scratch because the original source code was not available. Password login; patient records in SQLite with search and edit Signal view: 10 or 5 mm/mV gain, 30 or 60 seconds per page, paging and side-by-side comparison Print preview and printing with page ranges Decoded the legacy recording format (verified on 200 of 200 sample files) Added real-time ECG from the device over Bluetooth LE (100 Hz), with a live waveform, BPM and recording Main window: patient records and the entry to real-time ECG (test patients only) The portable single-channel ECG recorder the viewer connects to How it's built Python + PySide6; Bluetooth LE with bleak Packaged as Windows installers with PyInstaller and NSIS 46 UI checks and 37 end-to-end tests Source code is private (client project).

projects/gangwon-portal.html.summary: Gangwon State Business Portal A B2B performance-management portal where startups submit performance data and apply for government support programs. Companies register, submit quarterly and annual performance data and apply for government support programs; administrators review and approve them in their own dashboard. projects/huantv-big-data-platform.html.summary: Smart-TV Big Data Platform A smart-TV data platform processing over a billion device records a day with sub-second queries, moved from self-managed CDH Hadoop on Tencent Cloud to Alibaba Cloud EMR, with Apache DolphinScheduler scheduling and ClickHouse queries. Role: Senior Big Data Architect: Architecture, Development & Operations Organization: Guangzhou Huan Technology (HuanTV), Guangzhou Dates: Apr 2015 – Sep 2022 Stack: CDH Hadoop (Hive, Spark), Tencent Cloud (COS, EMR), Alibaba Cloud (EMR, DataWorks, Quick BI), ClickHouse, Kafka, Apache DolphinScheduler, Kubernetes, NGINX + Lua, GitLab, Jira, Confluence, JumpServer What it does Collects, stores and analyzes smart-TV device data (viewing, advertising exposure and audience labels) for two companies: HuanTV, the employer, and Gozen Data (勾正数据), whose data business the same team and platform served. Over a billion device records a day, queried in under a second with ClickHouse and Spark. In 2022 the self-managed CDH Hadoop clusters on Tencent Cloud virtual machines were migrated to Alibaba Cloud EMR (VPC and VPN, security groups, auto-scaling), with infrastructure cost down 35%. projects/molit.html.title: Construction Equipment Anomaly Detection | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
projects/molit.html.summary: Construction Equipment Anomaly Detection Detects construction-equipment anomalies from thermal, vibration and acoustic sensors and grades equipment health in four levels. Role: Lead Architect & Developer (team) Organization: Korea Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport (MOLIT) Dates: Jun 2026 – Aug 2026 Stack: Python, PyTorch, PySide6, Payload CMS, Supabase Recognition: Top grade in data quality certification for the high-risk construction equipment thermal-imaging dataset. What it does Inspects construction equipment such as excavators and cranes with three sensors (thermal camera, vibration and acoustic) and gives each machine a 0–100 health score in four levels: Normal 80–100 Caution 60–79 Warning 40–59 Danger 0–39 Two Windows programs work as a pair: a tablet inspection app for the inspector and an analysis server that runs the models. Only results and an auto-generated PDF report leave the site. Analysis server (left) and tablet inspection app (right) running together on a fault-injected set: 34.4, Danger Models Thermal and vibration: TCN autoencoders (same architecture, separate weights) Acoustic: PANNs CNN14 embeddings + Mahalanobis distance Overall score weights: thermal 40%, vibration 35%, acoustic 25% Thermal model: AUROC 0.81, F1 0.84 (evaluation of 2 Jun 2026) Inspection app An inspection job: one thermal, sound and vibration capture for an excavator hydraulic motor Normal set: thermal 100, vibration 100, sound 94, overall 98.5 Normal Fault-injected set: 46.5, 27.5 and 24.8, overall 34.4 Danger, with a recommendation per sensor Evidence image: mel spectrogram of the sound with the verdict and score overlaid The same screen in Korean, Chinese and English, dark and light themes Analysis server Inspection history from every tablet, with job detail: files, scores and recommendations AI model coverage per machine, component and sensor, with hold-out status Recognition The project's thermal-imaging dataset for high-risk construction equipment received the top grade in data quality certification. Source code is private (client project). Screenshots from the team's demo run.

projects/offer2pr.html.title: Offer2PR | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
projects/offer2pr.html.summary: Offer2PR A daily-updated Canadian job board with 24,000+ live postings from 30 sources across all 10 provinces, tagged with immigration signals; in English, Chinese and Korean. Role: Founder: AI Agent Development & Operations Organization: offer2pr.com, Ottawa, ON Dates: Jun 2026 – Present Stack: AI agents, Claude API, TypeScript, Next.js, Payload CMS, PostgreSQL, Python, Docker, Render, Cloudflare Live site: https://offer2pr.com Source code: https://github.com/zhizhunbao/pnp-job-tracker What it does A job board for people in Canada who need an employer offer or a provincial nomination on the way to permanent residence. Every posting carries immigration signals: a rough PNP eligibility flag (TEER 0–3 or a shortage list) pay compared with the median wage for the occupation whether the employer is designated or has LMIA history The job board filters by province, occupation, pathway and experience. The employer board ranks employers and shows where they are hiring. Job board on offer2pr.com Employer board on offer2pr.com How it's built Python ETL: crawl → raw → processed → mart, then a loader fills PostgreSQL. Sources include Job Bank (all 10 provinces), Jobillico, Jobboom, GC Jobs, CareerBeacon and selected employer career sites. Jobs refresh every hour. Operations: the ETL runs unattended in Docker on a self-managed host, about 60 containers; see below. Web: Next.js + Payload CMS + PostgreSQL on Render, DNS on Cloudflare. CI: GitHub Actions type-checks and lints every push; a local pre-push hook adds Python lint, type checks and a build. AI agents in the product Advisor agent (Aug – Sep 2026). A tool-calling agent with 9 tools (occupation search, job lookup, draw history, thresholds, points and more). Its rules: it never decides, ranks or computes, and every number in an answer must appear in a tool result. An output gate rewrote drafts that broke the rules, answers cited their sources, and the tool trace streamed to the page. A 24-case gold set plus real user questions served as the evaluation. Site guide (live since Sep 2026). When the advisor was more than the job needed, I replaced it with a two-step guide on Claude Haiku: one structured call routes the question to the right page, and an optional second call answers only from database facts, with daily quotas to cap cost. Occupation resolver. An agent with search, slot-filling and give-up tools that rejects any occupation code the search didn't return, covered by 21 integration tests. Cover letters. One grounded call per job, from the job ad and the chosen résumé, with a switchable model provider and a daily limit. How I operate it One unit, one container, one check. Each ETL unit (about 60) runs in its own container with restart: unless-stopped and its own schedule: Job Bank every hour, the build step right after each Job Bank round, the database backup once a day. A failing unit turns red on its own instead of hiding behind its neighbours. Monitoring. A self-hosted healthchecks service (the hosted free tier stops at 20 checks) has one check per unit. Each unit pings after every successful round and sends an explicit failure, with the error lines, after 30 minutes of continuous failure. A separate freshness check passes only when the whole fleet's data is fresh, and a few checks on hosted healthchecks.io act as the alarm if the whole host goes down. Alerts arrive by email. Data safety. A daily pg_dump of production, with 14 days kept. Crawl ledgers are written only after a clean finish, and the mart has a fuse that holds back incomplete data instead of publishing it. Release gates. A pre-push hook runs ruff, pyrefly, a structure check and eslint; GitHub Actions runs type checks and lint with a suppression baseline that can only shrink. The web app deploys on push to Render, and I confirm each deploy by checking the live /api/version against the commit. Incidents and fixes Missing Job Bank postings (Oct 2026). An audit of 425 live postings found 28 missing from the board. The parse step was dropping about 350 older rows per round, and postings marked dead never came back. I added a daily full sweep per province and a revive path for postings that reappear. Misses went from 28 to 3 of 425 (2 waiting out a cooldown, 1 truly expired), and open postings went from 63,857 to 73,723. Bot-check fallback poisoning the cache (Oct 2026). When a direct fetch got HTTP 403 and the browser fallback succeeded, the page was still recorded as 403, which invalidated the cache for a whole government site. Fixed the status recording and now reject fallback pages that are only a bot check. Slow self-check (Oct 2026). Reusing the crawl manifest for 30 seconds cut the pathways self-check from 1,376 s to 102 s.

projects/ottawa-genai.html.title: GenAI Research Assistant | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
projects/ottawa-genai.html.summary: GenAI Research Assistant Designed and built a proof-of-concept generative AI research assistant for the City of Ottawa's Economic Development team, then continued it with City-side collaborators. Role: Architect & Developer (PoC) Organization: City of Ottawa Dates: Sep 2025 – Apr 2026 Stack: Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, FastAPI, React, JWT auth, Docker, Render Source code: https://github.com/zhizhunbao/ottawa-genai-research-assistant What it does Economic Development analysts ask questions in plain English and get grounded answers, summaries and charts from the City's Economic Development Update reports (Q1 2022 – Q4 2025), with a citation for every answer. How it's built Architecture: documents flow from Azure Blob Storage through Azure AI Search; queries go through FastAPI and a RAG orchestrator to Azure OpenAI Ingestion: PDFs in Azure Blob Storage → indexer → Azure OpenAI embeddings → Azure AI Search vector index Query: FastAPI → RAG orchestrator → semantic cache → hybrid retrieval → GPT-4o with the retrieved context → answer with sources Security: keys in Azure Key Vault; Microsoft Entra ID sign-in on the front end; JWT with admin, researcher and viewer roles on the API Local fallbacks: SQLite hybrid search and Ollama, for running without Azure React + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind front end; Docker Compose and GitHub Actions History I designed and built the proof of concept (Sep 2025 – Feb 2026), then continued it with collaborators on the City side (Mar – Apr 2026).

projects/textbook-rag.html.title: Textbook RAG | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
projects/textbook-rag.html.summary: Textbook RAG Retrieval-augmented question answering over course textbooks with hybrid retrieval (BM25 plus vector search). Role: Architect & Developer (Capstone, solo) Organization: Algonquin College Dates: Mar 2026 – Jun 2026 Stack: Python, LlamaIndex, ChromaDB, FastAPI, Ollama, Azure OpenAI, Next.js Source code: https://github.com/zhizhunbao/textbook-rag What it does Ask a question about a textbook and get an answer that cites the book, chapter and page, with the PDF open beside the chat. How it works Hybrid retrieval: BM25 and vector search fused with Reciprocal Rank Fusion (LlamaIndex QueryFusionRetriever); each chunk is tagged with the retriever that found it Cross-encoder reranking, ChromaDB vector store, all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embeddings Runs on a local LLM through Ollama by default, or on Azure OpenAI FastAPI backend, Next.js front end 83% test coverage (v1.0 test report) The repository has since grown into a broader advisor platform built on the same retrieval engine.

UNESCO 叙词表是一份受控的、结构化的概念列表，用于教育、文化、自然科学、社会与人文科学、传播与信息等领域文献和出版物的主题分析与检索。 UNESCO, n.d., para. 1 References Cambridge University Press & Assessment. (n.d.). Social science. In Cambridge Dictionary. Classification Systems Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source Classification Systems 分类体系 (context) "a system for naming and organizing things, especially plants and animals, into groups that share similar qualities" （语境）一种给事物命名并加以组织的体系，尤其用于植物和动物，把它们分成具有相似特性的组 Cambridge University Press & Assessment, n.d., "taxonomy" noun ACM CCS ACM 计算分类系统 "The 2012 ACM Computing Classification System has been developed as a poly-hierarchical ontology that can be utilized in semantic web applications. It replaces the traditional 1998 version of the ACM Computing Classification System (CCS), which has served as the de facto standard classification system for the computing field." 2012 ACM 计算分类系统被开发成一个多层级的本体，可以用于语义网应用。它取代了传统的 1998 版 ACM 计算分类系统（CCS），后者一直是计算领域事实上的标准分类系统。 Association for Computing Machinery, 2012, para. 1 AGROVOC AGROVOC（联合国粮农组织农业叙词表） "AGROVOC is a relevant Linked Open Data set about agriculture available for public use and facilitates access and visibility of data across domains and languages." AGROVOC 是一个可供公众使用的关于农业的关联开放数据集，有助于数据跨领域、跨语言的访问和可见性。 Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations, n.d., para. 1 AGU Index Terms AGU 索引词 (context) "Choose the most appropriate index terms for your paper." （语境）选择最合适的索引词，用于你的论文。 American Geophysical Union, n.d., para. 1 CAS Sections CA 类目（《化学文摘》分类） "You will find that CAS information is divided into 80 different sections. Each CA section covers only one broad area of scientific inquiry." 你会发现，CAS 信息被划分为 80 个不同的类目。每个 CA 类目只涵盖一个宽泛的科学研究领域。 Chemical Abstracts Service, n.d., 1 and list item 1 ELSST ELSST（欧洲语言社会科学叙词表） "The European Language Social Science Thesaurus (ELSST) is a broad-based, multilingual thesaurus for the social sciences." 欧洲语言社会科学叙词表（ELSST）是一套面向社会科学的覆盖面广的多语种叙词表。 Consortium of European Social Science Data Archives, n.d., para. 1 IEEE Thesaurus IEEE 叙词表 "The IEEE Thesaurus is a controlled vocabulary of about 12,770 descriptive engineering, technical, and scientific terms as well as IEEE-specific society terms." IEEE 叙词表是一套受控词表，收录约 12,770 个描述性的工程、技术和科学术语，以及 IEEE 各学会特有的术语。 Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers, n.d., "General information on the IEEE Thesaurus" section, para. 1 JEL JEL 分类体系 "The JEL classification system was developed for use in the Journal of Economic Literature (JEL), and is a standard method of classifying scholarly literature in the field of economics." JEL 分类体系是为《经济文献杂志》（JEL）而开发的，是在经济学领域中对学术文献进行分类的一种标准方法。 American Economic Association, n.d., para. 1 MeSH 医学主题词表（MeSH） "The Medical Subject Headings (MeSH) thesaurus is a controlled and hierarchically-organized vocabulary produced by the National Library of Medicine. It is used for indexing, cataloging, and searching of biomedical and health-related information." 医学主题词表（MeSH）叙词表是美国国家医学图书馆编制的一套受控且分层组织的词表。它用于对生物医学和健康相关信息进行标引、编目和检索。 National Library of Medicine, n.d., para. 1 MSC2020 MSC2020（数学学科分类 2020） "Mathematical Reviews (MR) and zbMATH collaborate on maintaining the Mathematics Subject Classification, which is used by these reviewing services, publishers, funding agencies, and others to categorize items in the mathematical sciences literature. It is a taxonomy created by and for mathematical researchers." Mathematical Reviews（MR）和 zbMATH 共同维护数学学科分类，这些评论服务、出版社、资助机构等用它来给数学科学文献分类。它是由数学研究者创建、为数学研究者服务的分类体系。 Associate Editors of Mathematical Reviews and zbMATH, 2020, para. 2 PhySH PhySH（物理学主题词表） "PhySH (Physics Subject Headings) is a physics classification scheme developed by the American Physical Society (APS) to organize journal, meeting, and other content by topic." PhySH（物理学主题词表）是美国物理学会（APS）开发的一种物理学分类方案，用于按主题组织期刊、会议及其他内容。 American Physical Society, n.d., para. 1 UNESCO Thesaurus UNESCO 叙词表 "The UNESCO Thesaurus is a controlled and structured list of concepts used in subject analysis and retrieval of documents and publications in the fields of education, culture, natural sciences, social and human sciences, communication and information." UNESCO 叙词表是一份受控的、结构化的概念列表，用于教育、文化、自然科学、社会与人文科学、传播与信息等领域文献和出版物的主题分析与检索。 UNESCO, n.d., para. 1 References American Economic Association. (n.d.). JEL classification system / EconLit subject descriptors. Open-Source Projects Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source Open-Source Projects 开源项目 (context) "Open source software or information can be obtained legally and for free from the internet, and can be used, shared or changed without paying or asking for special permission" （语境）开源软件或信息可以从互联网上合法、免费地获取，并且无需付费或特别许可就能使用、分享或修改 Cambridge University Press & Assessment, n.d., "open source" adjective Apache Software Foundation Apache 软件基金会 "ASF is a U.S. 501(c)(3) charitable organization funded by individual donations and corporate sponsors, and is run almost exclusively by volunteers that provide support for hundreds of projects." ASF 是一家美国 501(c)(3) 慈善组织，由个人捐款和企业赞助商资助，几乎完全由志愿者运营，这些志愿者为数百个项目提供支持。 The Apache Software Foundation, n.d., "Institutionalizing Open Source" section, para. 1 Farama Foundation Farama 基金会 "The Farama Foundation is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit that advances reinforcement learning through open-source tools and shared standards for researchers and industry practitioners." Farama 基金会是一家 501(c)(3) 非营利组织，通过开源工具和共享标准来推进强化学习，服务于研究人员和行业从业者。 The Farama Foundation, n.d., para. 1 Git Git "Git is a free and open source distributed version control system designed to handle everything from small to very large projects with speed and efficiency." Git 是一个免费且开源的分布式版本控制系统，旨在处理从小型到超大型的各种项目，并做到快速、高效。 Git, n.d., para. 1 GraphQL Foundation GraphQL 基金会 "The GraphQL Foundation is a neutral foundation founded by global technology and application development companies." GraphQL 基金会是一个中立的基金会，由全球技术和应用开发公司创立。 GraphQL Foundation, n.d., "What is the GraphQL Foundation?" section, para. 1 Kubernetes Kubernetes "Kubernetes is a portable, extensible, open source platform for managing containerized workloads and services that facilitate both declarative configuration and automation." Kubernetes 是一个可移植、可扩展的开源平台，用于管理容器化的工作负载和服务，可促进声明式配置和自动化。 The Kubernetes Authors, n.d., para. 1 Linux Kernel Linux 内核 "Linux is a clone of the operating system Unix, written from scratch by Linus Torvalds with assistance from a loosely-knit team of hackers across the Net." Linux 是操作系统 Unix 的克隆，由 Linus Torvalds 从零写成，并得到网络上一群松散组织的黑客的协助。 The kernel development community, n.d., "What is Linux?" section, para. 1 LLVM LLVM "The LLVM Project is a collection of modular and reusable compiler and toolchain technologies." LLVM 项目是一组模块化、可复用的编译器和工具链技术。 LLVM Project, n.d., "LLVM Overview" section, para. 1 Model Context Protocol 模型上下文协议 "MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external systems." MCP（模型上下文协议）是一种开源标准，用于连接 AI 应用程序与外部系统。 Model Context Protocol, n.d., para. 1 Mozilla Mozilla "The Mozilla Project is a global community of people who believe that openness, innovation, and opportunity are key to the continued health of the internet." Mozilla 项目是一个由人们组成的全球社区，他们相信开放、创新和机遇是互联网持续健康的关键。 Mozilla, n.d., "About Mozilla" section, para. 1 Open Robotics 开源机器人基金会（Open Robotics） "We create open software and hardware platforms for robotics." 我们为机器人打造开放的软件和硬件平台。 Open Source Robotics Foundation, n.d., "Open platforms for robotics" section, para. 1 OpenCV OpenCV "OpenCV (Open Source Computer Vision Library) is an open source computer vision and machine learning software library." OpenCV（开源计算机视觉库）是一个开源的计算机视觉和机器学习软件库。 OpenCV team, n.d., para. 1 OpenJS Foundation OpenJS 基金会 "The OpenJS Foundation is the central place to support collaborative development of JavaScript and web technologies." OpenJS 基金会是支持 JavaScript 和 Web 技术的协作开发的核心场所。 OpenJS Foundation, n.d., "Join the OpenJS Foundation" section, para. 1 OWASP Foundation OWASP 基金会 "The Open Worldwide Application Security Project (OWASP) is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit foundation that works to improve the security of software." 开放全球应用安全项目（OWASP）是一家 501(c)(3) 非营利基金会，致力于提升软件的安全性。 OWASP Foundation, n.d., "The OWASP Foundation" section, para. 1 PostgreSQL PostgreSQL "PostgreSQL is an object-relational database management system (ORDBMS) based on POSTGRES, Version 4.2, developed at the University of California at Berkeley Computer Science Department." PostgreSQL 是一个对象关系数据库管理系统（ORDBMS），基于 POSTGRES 4.2 版，由加州大学伯克利分校计算机科学系开发。 The PostgreSQL Global Development Group, n.d., "1. What Is PostgreSQL?" section, para. 1 pytest pytest "The pytest framework makes it easy to write small, readable tests, and can scale to support complex functional testing for applications and libraries." pytest 框架让编写小而易读的测试变得容易，并且可以扩展以支持面向应用程序和库的复杂功能测试。 pytest-dev, n.d., para. 1 Python Software Foundation Python 软件基金会 "The Python Software Foundation (PSF) is a non-profit membership organization devoted to advancing open source technology related to the Python programming language." Python 软件基金会（PSF）是一个非营利会员制组织，致力于推进开源技术，这些技术与 Python 编程语言相关。 Python Software Foundation, n.d., "Mission" section, para. 4 (the official mission statement) PyTorch Foundation PyTorch 基金会 "The PyTorch Foundation is the vendor-neutral home for the open source intelligence layer developers use for training, optimizing, serving, and running models on any chip in any cloud for any agent." PyTorch 基金会是供应商中立的家园，承载开源智能层，开发者用它在任何芯片、任何云上为任何智能体训练、优化、部署和运行模型。 PyTorch Foundation, n.d., para. 1 scikit-learn scikit-learn "Scikit-learn is an open source machine learning library that supports supervised and unsupervised learning." Scikit-learn 是一个开源机器学习库，支持监督学习和无监督学习。 scikit-learn developers, n.d., para. 1 Selenium Selenium "Selenium is an umbrella project for a range of tools and libraries that enable and support the automation of web browsers." Selenium 是一个伞形项目，涵盖一系列工具和库，用于实现和支持 Web 浏览器的自动化。 Selenium project, n.d., para. 1 Stable-Baselines3 Stable-Baselines3 "Stable Baselines3 (SB3) is a set of reliable implementations of reinforcement learning algorithms in PyTorch." Cambridge Dictionaries Online began offering these dictionaries completely free of charge in 1999 — and today, Cambridge Dictionary is still growing." 剑桥大学出版社自 1995 年起一直在出版面向英语学习者的词典。剑桥在线词典于 1999 年开始完全免费提供这些词典，而如今，剑桥词典仍在不断发展。 Cambridge University Press & Assessment, n.d., para. 1 MathWorld MathWorld "MathWorld is the web's most extensive mathematical resource, provided as a free service to the world's mathematics and internet communities ..." MathWorld 是网络上最全面的数学资源，作为一项免费服务提供给全世界的数学界和互联网社区…… Wolfram Research, n.d., para. 1 MITRE ATT&CK MITRE ATT&CK "MITRE ATT&CK® is a globally-accessible knowledge base of adversary tactics and techniques based on real-world observations." Standards Developing Organizations Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source Standards Developing Organizations 标准制定组织 "any organization that develops and approves standards using various methods to establish consensus among its participants." 任何以各种方法在参与者之间达成共识、以此制定并批准标准的组织。 National Institute of Standards and Technology, n.d., "standards developing organization" entry, definition 1 Ecma International Ecma 国际 "Ecma International is an industry association dedicated to the standardization of information and communication systems" Ecma 国际是一个行业协会，致力于信息与通信系统的标准化。 Ecma International, n.d., para. 1 IEC 国际电工委员会 "Founded in 1906, the IEC (International Electrotechnical Commission) is the world’s leading organization for the preparation and publication of international standards for all electrical, electronic and related technologies." IEC（国际电工委员会）成立于 1906 年，是全球领先的组织，负责编制和发布所有电气、电子及相关技术的国际标准。 International Electrotechnical Commission, n.d., para. 1 IETF 互联网工程任务组 "The Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF), founded in 1986, is the premier standards development organization (SDO) for the Internet." 互联网工程任务组（IETF）成立于 1986 年，是互联网领域首要的标准制定组织（SDO）。 Internet Engineering Task Force, n.d., para. 1 ISO 国际标准化组织 "ISO is an independent, non-governmental organization made up of members from the national standards bodies of 177 countries." ISO 是一个独立的非政府组织，由来自 177 个国家的国家标准机构的成员组成。 International Organization for Standardization, n.d., para. 1 ISO/IEC JTC 1 ISO/IEC 第一联合技术委员会 "ISO-IEC Joint Technical Committee (JTC 1) is a consensus based, voluntary international standards group focussing on information technology (IT)." Khronos Group 是一个开放且由成员驱动的联盟，为创建互操作性标准提供空间，这些标准使开发者能够充分发挥 3D 图形、XR（VR 与 AR）、并行计算、机器学习、视觉处理和元宇宙的全部能力。 The Khronos Group, n.d., para. 2 RISC-V International RISC-V 国际 "RISC-V International is the global non-profit home of the open standard RISC-V Instruction Set Architecture (ISA), related specifications, and stakeholder community." system-design/cs2023-pdc/programs/distri.title: 1.2 Distribution | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
system-design/cs2023-pdc/programs/distri.summary: 1.2 Distribution Sources: CS2023 Body of Knowledge, PDC-Programs, topic 2, p. 157. Parts: a. Defining places, as devices executing actions, including hardware components, remote hosts, may also include external, uncontrolled devices, hosts, and users. (See also: AR-IO) b. One device may time-slice or otherwise emulate multiple parallel actions by fewer processors by scheduling and virtualization. (See also: OS-Scheduling) c. Naming or identifying places (e.g., device IDs) and actions as parties (e.g., thread IDs). d. Activities across places may communicate across media. (See also: PDC-Communication) Not written yet.

system-design/cs2023-pdc/programs/execut.title: 1.4 Execution Properties | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
system-design/cs2023-pdc/programs/execut.summary: 1.4 Execution Properties Sources: CS2023 Body of Knowledge, PDC-Programs, topic 4, p. 158. Parts: a. Nondeterministic execution of unordered actions b. Consistency: Ensuring agreement among parties about values and predicates when necessary to avoid races, maintain safety and atomicity, or arrive at consensus c. Fault tolerance: Handling failures in parties or communication, including (Byzantine) misbehavior due to untrusted parties and protocols, when necessary to maintain progress or availability (See also: SF-Reliability) d. Tradeoffs are one focus of evaluation (See also: PDC-Evaluation) Not written yet.

system-design/cs2023-pdc/programs/parall.title: 1.1 Parallelism | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
system-design/cs2023-pdc/programs/parall.summary: 1.1 Parallelism Sources: CS2023 Body of Knowledge, PDC-Programs, topic 1, p. 157. Parts: a. Declarative parallelism: Determining which actions may, or must not, be performed in parallel, at the level of instructions, functions, closures, composite actions, sessions, tasks, and services is the main idea underlying PDC algorithms; failing to do so is the main source of errors. (See also: PDC-Algorithms) b. Defining order: for example, using happens-before relations or series/parallel directed acyclic graphs representing programs. c. Independence: determining when ordering does not matter, in terms of commutativity, dependencies, preconditions. d. Ensuring ordering among otherwise parallel actions when necessary, including locking, safe publication; and imposing communication – sending a message happens before receiving it; conversely relaxing when unnecessary. Not written yet.

system-design/cs2023-pdc/programs/starti.title: 1.3 Starting Activities | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
system-design/cs2023-pdc/programs/starti.summary: 1.3 Starting Activities Sources: CS2023 Body of Knowledge, PDC-Programs, topic 3, p. 157. Parts: a. Options that enable actions to be performed (eventually) at places range from hardwiring to configuration scripts; also establishing communication and resource management; these are expressed differently across languages and contexts, usually relying on automated provisioning and management by platforms (See also: SF-Resources) b. Procedural: Enabling multiple actions to start at a given program point; for example, starting new threads, possibly scoping, or otherwise organizing them in hierarchical groups c. Reactive: Enabling upon an event by installing an event handler, with less control of when actions begin or end, and may apply even on uniprocessors d. Dependent: Enabling upon completion of others; for example, sequencing sets of parallel actions (See also: PDC-Coordination) e. Granularity: Execution cost of action bodies should outweigh the overhead of arranging them Not written yet.

ui-ux/fluent-2/components-react/6-11-dia.title: 6.11 Dialog | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
ui-ux/fluent-2/components-react/6-11-dia.summary: 6.11 Dialog Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source Dialog 对话框 "A dialog is a supplemental surface that can provide helpful interactions or require someone to take an action before they can continue their task, like confirming a deletion." 对话框是一个补充界面，可以提供有用的交互，或要求用户先做一个操作才能继续手头的任务，比如确认删除。 Microsoft, n.d., "Dialog" Modal 模态 "A modal dialog disables the page content behind it and usually obscures or dims it to surface its content. Use it when someone needs to perform a focused task, like signing into an app." 模态对话框会让后面的页面内容不可操作，通常还会遮住或调暗页面来突出自己的内容。当用户需要完成一项专注的任务时使用，比如登录应用。 Microsoft, n.d., "Dialog", Types Non-modal 非模态 "A non-modal dialog allows someone to continue interacting with the page content behind the window and aids in their workflow, like find and replace. Use it as a helper in a task." 非模态对话框允许用户继续操作窗口后面的页面内容，辅助他们的工作流程，比如查找和替换。把它当作任务中的助手使用。 Microsoft, n.d., "Dialog", Types Alert 警告 "An alert dialog is a modal that requires someone to make a decision. Alert dialogs have a special role that allows assistive technologies to treat them more urgently than other dialogs, like playing a system alert sound." 警告对话框是一种要求用户做出决定的模态框。它有特殊的角色，让辅助技术比对待其他对话框更紧急地处理它，比如播放系统提示音。 Microsoft, n.d., "Dialog", Types Dismissal 关闭方式 (context) "Someone can dismiss a modal dialog by selecting an area outside of the container, using the Esc key, or selecting a footer button." （语境）用户可以通过点击容器外的区域、按 Esc 键或点击底部按钮来关闭模态对话框。 Microsoft, n.d., "Dialog", Behavior Forms in dialogs 对话框中的表单 (context) "Fields can be placed in dialogs to ask people for information that’s related to their current task." （语境）可以在对话框里放字段，向用户收集信息，且信息与他们当前的任务相关。 Microsoft, n.d., "Dialog", Behavior Header 标题栏 (context) "A header, which can contain a title and a dismiss icon" （语境）标题栏，可以包含标题和关闭图标 Microsoft, n.d., "Dialog", Layout Body 正文 (context) "Use the body content area for additional info or instructions, if needed. Don’t restate the title in the body." （语境）需要时用正文区放补充信息或说明。不要在正文里重复标题。 Microsoft, n.d., "Dialog", Content Footer 底部 (context) "Optional footer, which can contain up to three actions." （语境）可选的底部，最多可以放三个操作。 Microsoft, n.d., "Dialog", Layout Dialog focus 对话框焦点 (context) "When a dialog is opened, keyboard focus should go to the first interactive element within the container." （语境）对话框打开时，键盘焦点应移到容器内第一个可交互的元素上。 Microsoft, n.d., "Dialog", Accessibility References Microsoft. (n.d.). Fluent 2 Design System. Retrieved November 6, 2026, from https://fluent2.microsoft.design/

ui-ux/fluent-2/ux-frameworks-and-guideli.title: 2.5 Onboarding | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
ui-ux/fluent-2/ux-frameworks-and-guideli.summary: 2.5 Onboarding Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source Onboarding 引导（Onboarding） "Onboarding experiences guide people through how to get started with a product or feature." 引导体验带人了解如何开始使用某个产品或功能。 Microsoft, n.d., "Onboarding" Relevant 相关 (context) "Make sure onboarding content is presented within context of a closely related task." （语境）确保引导内容出现在情境之中，即与一项密切相关的任务放在一起。 Microsoft, n.d., "Onboarding", Principles Non-distracting 不干扰 "Avoid being a barrier to the user’s primary goal." 避免成为障碍，挡住用户的主要目标。 Microsoft, n.d., "Onboarding", Principles Optional 可选 "Allow people to exit and finish what they’re doing, but give them a way to come back to it later." 允许人们退出并完成手头的事，但给他们以后回来的途径。 Microsoft, n.d., "Onboarding", Principles Benefit-focused 突出好处 (context) "Let them know up front how they’ll benefit, so they’re motivated to pay attention." （语境）一开始就告诉他们能得到什么好处，让他们有动力去留意。 Microsoft, n.d., "Onboarding", Principles Coherent 一致 "Use standard Fluent components so that users know what to expect when interacting with your onboarding experience." 使用标准的 Fluent 组件，让用户在与引导体验互动时知道会发生什么。 Microsoft, n.d., "Onboarding", Principles Welcome 欢迎 "Welcome experiences reassure people they’re stating in the right place." 欢迎体验让人安心，确认自己来对了地方。 Microsoft, n.d., "Onboarding", Scenarios and goals Orient 定向 (context) "After welcoming the user to a new experience, it’s important to show them helpful features in context. To show where certain options appear, try empty states or teaching popovers." （语境）欢迎用户进入新体验之后，重要的是在情境中向他们展示有用的功能。要指出某些选项在哪里，可以用空状态或教学浮层。 Microsoft, n.d., "Onboarding", Scenarios and goals Notify 通知 (context) "When functionality in an app or experiences is added or changed, notify users about what they can now gain and how they might adapt their behaviors to the new UX." （语境）当应用或体验里的功能新增或改变时，告诉用户他们现在能得到什么，以及该如何调整做法来适应新的体验。 Microsoft, n.d., "Onboarding", Scenarios and goals Explain 说明 (context) "To tell people what they can do or provide details that might not be readily apparent, try putting hints in the UI that can tell people how they might move forward." （语境）要告诉人们能做什么，或提供不太显眼的细节，可以在界面里放提示，告诉人们下一步怎么走。 Microsoft, n.d., "Onboarding", Scenarios and goals Take action 采取行动 (context) "Sometimes, before they dive in, users need to complete some preliminary actions needed to use the app or feature." （语境）有时用户在深入之前，需要先完成一些准备操作，才能使用应用或功能。 Microsoft, n.d., "Onboarding", Scenarios and goals References Microsoft. (n.d.). Fluent 2 Design System. Retrieved November 6, 2026, from https://fluent2.microsoft.design/

ui-ux/fluent-2/ux-frameworks-and-guideli.title: 2.6 Wait UX | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
ui-ux/fluent-2/ux-frameworks-and-guideli.summary: 2.6 Wait UX Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source Wait UX 等待体验（Wait UX） "Wait UX refers to the design of user experiences during moments of delay—when a system is processing, loading, or retrieving data." 等待体验指用户体验的设计，针对的是延迟的时刻，即系统正在处理、加载或获取数据的时候。 Microsoft, n.d., "Wait UX" Determinate indicators 确定型指示器 (context) "When possible, use determinate indicators to show actual progress." （语境）尽可能使用确定型指示器来显示实际进度。 Microsoft, n.d., "Wait UX", Principles Indeterminate indicators 不确定型指示器 (context) "If progress cannot be measured, use indeterminate indicators only for short waits." （语境）如果进度无法衡量，就用不确定型指示器，但只用于短暂等待。 Microsoft, n.d., "Wait UX", Principles Perceived performance 感知性能 (context) "Visual feedback can reduce the perceived duration of a delay." （语境）视觉反馈可以缩短用户感觉到的延迟时长。 Microsoft, n.d., "Wait UX", Principles Spinner 旋转指示器 "Spinners are best used for short, indeterminate waits—typically under three seconds." 旋转指示器最适合短暂、无法确定时长的等待，通常不到三秒。 Microsoft, n.d., "Wait UX", Visual patterns Progress bar 进度条 "Progress bars are ideal for longer waits where progress can be tracked." 进度条最适合较长的等待，且进度可以追踪。 Microsoft, n.d., "Wait UX", Visual patterns Skeleton 骨架屏 "Skeleton screens are useful for content rendering delays. In AI-first experiences like Copilot, use the Copilot gradient shimmer to reinforce the theme and reassure users that content is loading." 骨架屏适用于内容渲染的延迟。在 Copilot 这类以 AI 为主的体验里，用 Copilot 渐变微光效果来强化主题，并让用户放心内容正在加载。 Microsoft, n.d., "Wait UX", Visual patterns Progress toast 进度通知 "Progress toasts are appropriate for long back-end processes that affect current content." 进度通知适用于耗时较长的后台处理，且这些处理会影响当前内容。 Microsoft, n.d., "Wait UX", Visual patterns Morse code 摩斯码动画 "The morse code animation is used specifically in AI-forward, Copilot scenarios. It mimics the typing dots animation in human to human chat experiences" 摩斯码动画专用于以 AI 为主的 Copilot 场景。它模仿人与人聊天里正在输入的点点动画 Microsoft, n.d., "Wait UX", Visual patterns Pulsing dot 脉冲圆点 "The pulsing dot animation is used in Chain of Thought as a lighter-weight wait animation." 脉冲圆点动画用在思维链（Chain of Thought）中，作为较轻量的等待动画。 Microsoft, n.d., "Wait UX", Visual patterns Timing thresholds 时间阈值 (context) "For waits between one and three seconds, a spinner is appropriate. If the wait exceeds three seconds, switch to a progress bar or display a content string to reassure users that the process is active." （语境）等待在一到三秒之间时，用旋转指示器合适。等待超过三秒，就换成进度条，或显示一段文字，让用户放心处理仍在进行。 Microsoft, n.d., "Wait UX", Behavior Fallback messaging 兜底提示 "When progress details are unavailable, fallback messages should still offer reassurance." 当拿不到进度细节时，兜底提示也应当让用户安心。 Microsoft, n.d., "Wait UX", Behavior Hardcoded vs. generated strings 固定文案与生成文案 "In productivity apps like Outlook, hardcoded strings ensure consistency and clarity. In AI chat experiences, dynamically generated strings allow for more personalized and context-aware feedback." 在 Outlook 这类办公应用里，固定文案保证一致和清楚。在 AI 聊天体验里，动态生成的文案能给出更个性化、更贴合情境的反馈。 Microsoft, n.d., "Wait UX", Behavior References Microsoft. (n.d.). Fluent 2 Design System. Retrieved November 6, 2026, from https://fluent2.microsoft.design/

Tree 从无障碍树中排除元素 "The following elements are not exposed via the accessibility API and user agents MUST NOT include them in the accessibility tree:" 下列元素不通过无障碍 API 公开，用户代理不得把它们包含在无障碍树中： World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 7.1 button 按钮 "An input that allows for user-triggered actions when clicked or pressed." 一种输入，在点击或按下时允许用户触发动作。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, button checkbox 复选框 "A checkable input that has three possible values: true, false, or mixed." 一种可勾选的输入，有三个可能的值：true、false 或 mixed。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, checkbox img 图像 "A container for a collection of elements that form an image." 一个容器，装着构成一幅图像的一组元素。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, img menuitemcheckbox 复选菜单项 "A menuitem with a checkable state whose possible values are true, false, or mixed." 带有可勾选状态的菜单项，可能的值为 true、false 或 mixed。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, menuitemcheckbox menuitemradio 单选菜单项 "A checkable menuitem in a set of elements with the same role, only one of which can be checked at a time." 同一角色的一组元素中的可勾选菜单项，同一时间只能选中其中一个。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, menuitemradio meter 计量器 "An element that represents a scalar measurement within a known range, or a fractional value." 表示已知范围内的标量测量值或分数值的元素。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, meter option 选项 "A selectable item in a listbox." 列表框中可选择的项目。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, option progressbar 进度条 "An element that displays the progress status for tasks that take a long time." 为耗时较长的任务显示进度状态的元素。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, progressbar radio 单选按钮 "A checkable input in a group of elements with the same role, only one of which can be checked at a time." 同一角色的一组元素中的可勾选输入，同一时间只能选中其中一个。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, radio scrollbar 滚动条 "A graphical object that controls the scrolling of content within a viewing area, regardless of whether the content is fully displayed within the viewing area." 控制内容在可视区域内滚动的图形对象，无论内容是否完整显示在可视区域内。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, scrollbar separator 分隔符 "A divider that separates and distinguishes sections of content or groups of menuitems." 一种分隔线，分开并区分内容的各节或菜单项的各组。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, separator slider 滑块 "An input where the user selects a value from within a given range." 一种输入，用户从给定范围内选择一个值。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, slider switch 开关 "A type of checkbox that represents on/off values, as opposed to checked/unchecked values." 一种复选框，表示开/关值，而不是选中/未选中值。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, switch tab 标签页 "A grouping label providing a mechanism for selecting the tab content that is to be rendered to the user." 一种分组标签，提供选择标签页内容的机制，所选内容将呈现给用户。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, tab References World Wide Web Consortium. 操作系统和其他平台提供一组接口，它们向辅助技术公开对象和事件的信息。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 2 Accessibility Subtree 无障碍子树 "An accessible object in the accessibility tree and its descendants in that tree." 无障碍树中的一个可访问对象，以及它在该树中的后代。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 2 Accessibility Tree 无障碍树 "Tree of accessible objects that represents the structure of the user interface (UI)." 由可访问对象组成的树，它表示用户界面（UI）的结构。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 2 Accessible Description 可访问描述 "An accessible description provides additional information, related to an interface element, that complements the accessible name." 可访问描述提供与界面元素相关的附加信息，用来补充可访问名称。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 2 Accessible Name 可访问名称 "The accessible name is the name of a user interface element." 可访问名称是用户界面元素的名称。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 2 Accessible object 可访问对象 "A node in the accessibility tree of a platform accessibility API." 平台无障碍 API 的无障碍树中的一个节点。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 2 Activation behavior 激活行为 "The action taken when an event, typically initiated by users through an input device, causes an element to fulfill a defined role." 当一个事件（通常由用户通过输入设备发起）使元素履行既定角色时所采取的动作。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 2 Assistive Technologies 辅助技术 "Hardware and/or software that: relies on services provided by a user agent to retrieve and render Web content works with a user agent or web content itself through the use of APIs, and provides services beyond those offered by the user agent to facilitate user interaction with web content by people with disabilities" 满足以下条件的硬件和/或软件：依靠用户代理提供的服务来获取和呈现网络内容；通过 API 与用户代理或网络内容本身协同工作；并提供用户代理之外的服务，以便利残障人士与网络内容交互 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 2 Attribute 属性（attribute） "Attributes are structural features added to elements to provide information about the states and properties of the object represented by the element." 属性是添加到元素上的结构特征，用来提供元素所代表对象的状态和属性信息。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 2 Class 类 "A set of instance objects that share similar characteristics." 一组实例对象，它们具有相似的特征。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 2 Deprecated 已弃用 "A deprecated role, state, or property is one which has been outdated by newer constructs or changed circumstances, and which may be removed in future versions of the WAI-ARIA specification." 已弃用的角色、状态或属性，是指因新结构或情况变化而过时，并可能在未来版本中移除的项，针对 WAI-ARIA 规范而言。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 2 Desktop focus event 桌面焦点事件 "Event from/to the host operating system via the accessibility API, notifying of a change of input focus." 通过无障碍 API 来自或发往宿主操作系统的事件，通知输入焦点发生变化。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 2 DOMString DOM 字符串 "Sequence of 16-bit unsigned integers, typically interpreted as UTF-16 code units." 16 位无符号整数的序列，通常解释为 UTF-16 码元。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 2 Element 元素 "Elements are the structural elements in markup language that contains the data profile for objects." 元素是标记语言中的结构元素，它包含对象的数据概况。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 2 Event 事件 "A programmatic message used to communicate discrete changes in the state of an object to other objects in a computational system." 一种程序化消息，用来向计算系统中的其他对象传达对象状态的离散变化。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 2 Expose 公开 "Translated to platform-specific accessibility APIs as defined in the Core Accessibility API Mappings." 按 Core Accessibility API Mappings 的定义，转换为特定平台的无障碍 API。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 2 Graphical Document 图形文档 "A document containing graphic representations with user-navigable parts." 一种文档，包含带有用户可导航部分的图形表示。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 2 Hidden 隐藏 "Indicates that the element is not visible, perceivable, or interactive to any user." 表示该元素对任何用户都不可见、不可感知、不可交互。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 2 Informative 信息性 "Content provided for information purposes and not required for conformance." 为提供信息而给出、不是一致性所必需的内容。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 2 Keyboard Accessible 键盘可访问 "Accessible to the user using a keyboard or assistive technologies that mimic keyboard input, such as a sip and puff tube." 用户可以通过键盘或模拟键盘输入的辅助技术（如吸吹管）访问。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 2 Landmark 地标 "A type of region on a page to which the user may want quick access." 页面上的一种区域，用户可能希望快速访问它。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 2 Live Region 实时区域 "Live regions are perceivable regions of a web page that are typically updated as a result of an external event when user focus may be elsewhere." 实时区域是网页中可感知的区域，通常因外部事件而更新，此时用户焦点可能在别处。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 2 Primary Content Element 主要内容元素 "An implementing host language's primary content element, such as the body element in HTML." 实现方宿主语言的主要内容元素，例如 HTML 中的 body 元素。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 2 Managed State 托管状态 "Accessibility API state that is controlled by the user agent, such as focus and selection." 由用户代理控制的无障碍 API 状态，例如焦点和选择。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 2 Nemeth Braille Nemeth 盲文 "The Nemeth Braille Code for Mathematics is a braille code for encoding mathematical and scientific notation." Nemeth 数学盲文码是一种盲文编码，用来编码数学和科学记号。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 2 Node 节点 "Basic type of object in the DOM tree or accessibility tree." DOM 树或无障碍树中对象的基本类型。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 2 Normative 规范性 "Required for conformance." 一致性所必需。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 2 Object 对象 "In the context of user interfaces, an item in the perceptual user experience, represented in markup languages by one or more elements, and rendered by user agents." 在用户界面语境中，指感知性用户体验中的一项，在标记语言中由一个或多个元素表示，并由用户代理呈现。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 2 Ontology 本体 "A description of the characteristics of classes and how they relate to each other." 对类的特征及其相互关系的描述。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 2 Operable 可操作 "Usable by users in ways they can control." 用户可以使用，方式是他们能够控制的。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 2 Owned Element 从属元素 "An 'owned element' is any DOM descendant of the element, any element specified as a child via aria-owns, or any DOM descendant of the owned child." “从属元素”是该元素的任何 DOM 后代、通过 aria-owns 指定为子元素的任何元素，或该从属子元素的任何 DOM 后代。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 2 Owning Element 拥有元素 "An 'owning element' is any DOM ancestor of the element, or any element with an aria-owns attribute which references the ID of the element." “拥有元素”是该元素的任何 DOM 祖先，或任何带 aria-owns 属性并引用该元素 ID 的元素。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 2 Perceivable 可感知 "Presentable to users in ways they can sense." 可以呈现给用户，方式是他们能够感知的。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 2 Property 属性（property） "Attributes that are essential to the nature of a given object, or that represent a data value associated with the object." 对给定对象的性质至关重要，或表示与对象相关的数据值的属性（attribute）。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 2 Relationship 关系 "A connection between two distinct things." 两个不同事物之间的联系。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 2 Role 角色 "Main indicator of type." 类型的主要标识。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 2 Root WAI-ARIA node WAI-ARIA 根节点 "The primary element containing non-metadata content." 包含非元数据内容的主要元素。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 2 Semantics 语义 "The meaning of something as understood by a human, defined in a way that computers can process a representation of an object, such as elements and attributes, and reliably represent the object in a way that various humans will achieve a mutually consistent understanding of the object." 人所理解的事物含义，其定义方式使计算机能够处理对象的表示（如元素和属性），并可靠地表示该对象，让不同的人对它达成一致的理解。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 2 State 状态 "A state is a dynamic property expressing characteristics of an object that may change in response to user action or automated processes." 状态是一种动态属性，表达对象的特征，这些特征可能因用户操作或自动过程而改变。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 2 Sub-document 子文档 "A sub-document may contain a document, an application or any widget such as a calendar pulled in from another server." 子文档可以包含一个文档、一个应用或任何控件，例如从另一台服务器拉取的日历。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 2 Target Element 目标元素 "An element specified in a WAI-ARIA relation." 在 WAI-ARIA 关系中指定的元素。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 2 Taxonomy 分类法 "A hierarchical definition of how the characteristics of various classes relate to each other, in which classes inherit the properties of superclasses in the hierarchy." 一种层次化定义，说明各个类的特征如何相互关联，其中类继承层次结构中超类的属性。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 2 Text node 文本节点 "Type of DOM node that represents the textual content of an attribute or an element." 一种 DOM 节点，表示属性或元素的文本内容。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 2 Tooltip attribute 工具提示属性 "Any host language attribute that would result in a user agent generating a tooltip such as in response to a mouse hover in desktop user agents." 任何宿主语言属性，它会使用户代理生成工具提示，例如在桌面用户代理中响应鼠标悬停。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 2 Understandable 可理解 "Presentable to users in ways they can construct an appropriate meaning." 可以呈现给用户，方式使他们能够建立恰当的含义。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 2 Unicode Braille Patterns Unicode 盲文图案 "In Unicode, braille is represented in a block called Braille Patterns (U+2800..U+28FF)." 在 Unicode 中，盲文由名为 Braille Patterns 的区块（U+2800..U+28FF）表示。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 2 User Agent 用户代理 "Any software that retrieves, renders and facilitates end user interaction with Web content." 任何获取、呈现网络内容并便利最终用户与之交互的软件。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 2 Valid IDREF 有效 IDREF "A reference to a target element in the same document that has a matching ID" 对同一文档中具有匹配 ID 的目标元素的引用 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 2 Widget 控件 "Discrete user interface object with which the user can interact." 用户可以与之交互的独立用户界面对象。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 2 References World Wide Web Consortium. (2023, June 6). Accessible Rich Internet Applications (WAI-ARIA) 1.2 (W3C Recommendation). https://www.w3.org/TR/wai-aria-1.2/

ui-ux/wai-aria/index.html.title: WAI-ARIA | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
ui-ux/wai-aria/index.html.summary: WAI-ARIA Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source WAI-ARIA 无障碍富互联网应用 "This specification provides an ontology of roles, states, and properties that define accessible user interface elements and can be used to improve the accessibility and interoperability of web content and applications." 本规范提供一套角色、状态和属性的本体，它们定义无障碍的用户界面元素，并可用于提升网络内容和应用的无障碍性与互操作性。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, Abstract 1. Introduction 引言 "WAI-ARIA is a technical specification that provides a framework to improve the accessibility and interoperability of web content and applications." WAI-ARIA 是一份技术规范，它提供一个提升无障碍性和互操作性的框架，面向网络内容和应用。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 1 2. Important Terms 重要术语 (context) "While some terms are defined in place, the following definitions are used throughout this document." （语境）虽然有些术语就地定义，但下列定义，在整份文档中通用。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 2 3. Conformance 一致性 (context) "The main content of Accessible Rich Internet Applications is normative and defines requirements that impact conformance claims." （语境）Accessible Rich Internet Applications 的主要内容是规范性的，并规定影响一致性声明的要求。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 3 4. Using WAI-ARIA 使用 WAI-ARIA "WAI-ARIA divides the semantics into roles (the type defining a user interface element) and states and properties supported by the roles." WAI-ARIA 把语义分为角色（定义用户界面元素的类型），以及角色所支持的状态和属性。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 4 5. The Roles Model 角色模型 "This section defines WAI-ARIA roles and describes their characteristics and properties." 本节定义 WAI-ARIA 角色，并描述它们的特征和属性。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5 6. Supported States and Properties 支持的状态和属性 "Both provide specific information about an object, and both form part of the definition of the nature of roles." 两者都提供关于对象的具体信息，也都是角色性质定义的一部分。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 6 7. Accessibility Tree 无障碍树 "The accessibility tree and the DOM tree are parallel structures." 无障碍树和 DOM 树是平行的结构。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 7 8. Implementation in Host Languages 在宿主语言中的实现 (context) "This section discusses how host languages are to implement WAI-ARIA, to ensure that the markup specified here will integrate smoothly and effectively with the host language markup." （语境）本节讨论宿主语言应如何实现 WAI-ARIA，以确保这里规定的标记能与宿主语言的标记顺畅而有效地集成。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 8 9. Handling Author Errors 处理作者错误 (context) "User agents are expected to perform validation of WAI-ARIA roles." （语境）用户代理应当对 WAI-ARIA 角色进行验证。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 9 10. IDL Interface IDL 接口 (context) "Conforming user agents MUST implement the following IDL interface." （语境）符合规范的用户代理必须实现下列 IDL 接口。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 10 11. Privacy and Security Considerations 隐私与安全考虑 (context) "This specification introduces no new security considerations." （语境）本规范没有引入新的安全考虑。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 11 References World Wide Web Consortium. (2023, June 6). Accessible Rich Internet Applications (WAI-ARIA) 1.2 (W3C Recommendation). https://www.w3.org/TR/wai-aria-1.2/

Introduction 引言 "WAI-ARIA is a technical specification that provides a framework to improve the accessibility and interoperability of web content and applications." WAI-ARIA 是一份技术规范，它提供一个提升无障碍性和互操作性的框架，面向网络内容和应用。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 1 1.1 Rich Internet Application Accessibility 富互联网应用无障碍 "The incorporation of WAI-ARIA is a way for an author to provide proper semantics for custom widgets to make these widgets accessible, usable, and interoperable with assistive technologies." 引入 WAI-ARIA 是作者为自定义控件提供恰当语义的一种方式，使这些控件无障碍、可用，并能与辅助技术互操作。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 1.1 1.2 Target Audience 目标读者 "This specification defines the basic model for WAI-ARIA, including roles, states, properties, and values." 本规范定义 WAI-ARIA 的基本模型，包括角色、状态、属性和值。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 1.2 1.3 User Agent Support 用户代理支持 "Mainstream user agents use WAI-ARIA to alter how host language features are exposed to accessibility APIs in order to improve accessibility." 主流用户代理用 WAI-ARIA 来改变宿主语言特性向无障碍 API 公开的方式，以提升无障碍性。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 1.3 1.4 Co-Evolution of WAI-ARIA and Host Languages WAI-ARIA 与宿主语言的共同演进 "WAI-ARIA is intended to augment semantics in supporting languages like [HTML] and [SVG2], or to be used as an accessibility enhancement technology in other markup-based languages that do not explicitly include support for ARIA." (2023, June 6). Accessible Rich Internet Applications (WAI-ARIA) 1.2 (W3C Recommendation). https://www.w3.org/TR/wai-aria-1.2/

aria-valuetext 值的文本 "Defines the human readable text alternative of aria-valuenow for a range widget." 定义范围控件 aria-valuenow 的人类可读文本替代。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 6.7, aria-valuetext Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, structure widget 控件 "An interactive component of a graphical user interface (GUI)." 图形用户界面（GUI）的交互式组件。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, widget ui-ux/wai-aria/the-roles-model/categoriz.summary: 5.3.3 Document Structure Roles Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 5.3.3 Document Structure Roles 文档结构角色 "The following roles describe structures that organize content in a page." 下列角色描述在页面中组织内容的结构。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.3.3 application 应用 "A structure containing one or more focusable elements requiring user input, such as keyboard or gesture events, that do not follow a standard interaction pattern supported by a widget role." 一种结构，包含一个或多个需要用户输入的可聚焦元素（如键盘或手势事件），它们不遵循控件角色所支持的标准交互模式。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, application article 文章 "A section of a page that consists of a composition that forms an independent part of a document, page, or site." 页面的一节，由一篇构成文档、页面或站点的独立部分的作品组成。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, article blockquote 块引用 "A section of content that is quoted from another source." 引自其他来源的一段内容。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, blockquote caption 标题说明 "Visible content that names, and may also describe, a figure, table, grid, or treegrid." 可见内容，用来命名并可能描述图、表格、网格或树形网格。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, caption cell 单元格 "A cell in a tabular container." 表格式容器中的单元格。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, cell columnheader 列标题 "A cell containing header information for a column." 包含列的标题信息的单元格。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, columnheader definition 定义 "A definition of a term or concept." 术语或概念的定义。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, definition deletion 删除 "A deletion contains content that is marked as removed or content that is being suggested for removal." 删除包含标记为已移除的内容，或建议移除的内容。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, deletion directory 目录 "[Deprecated in ARIA 1.2] A list of references to members of a group, such as a static table of contents." [在 ARIA 1.2 中已弃用] 指向组成员的引用列表，例如静态目录。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, directory document 文档 "An element containing content that assistive technology users may want to browse in a reading mode." 一种元素，其内容是辅助技术用户可能想要以阅读模式浏览的。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, document emphasis 强调 "One or more emphasized characters." 一个或多个被强调的字符。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, emphasis feed 信息流 "A scrollable list of articles where scrolling may cause articles to be added to or removed from either end of the list." 可滚动的文章列表，滚动可能使文章在列表任一端被添加或移除。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, feed figure 图 "A perceivable section of content that typically contains a graphical document, images, code snippets, or example text." 可感知的一段内容，通常包含图形文档、图像、代码片段或示例文本。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, figure generic 通用容器 "A nameless container element that has no semantic meaning on its own." 无名称的容器元素，它本身没有语义。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, generic group 组 "A set of user interface objects that is not intended to be included in a page summary or table of contents by assistive technologies." 一组用户界面对象，不打算被辅助技术收入页面摘要或目录。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, group heading 标题 "A heading for a section of the page." 页面中某一节的标题。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, heading img 图像 "A container for a collection of elements that form an image." 一个容器，装着构成一幅图像的一组元素。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, img insertion 插入 "An insertion contains content that is marked as added or content that is being suggested for addition." 插入包含标记为已添加的内容，或建议添加的内容。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, insertion list 列表 "A section containing listitem elements." 包含 listitem 元素的节。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, list listitem 列表项 "A single item in a list or directory." 列表或目录中的单个项目。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, listitem math 数学 "Content that represents a mathematical expression." 表示数学表达式的内容。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, math meter 计量器 "An element that represents a scalar measurement within a known range, or a fractional value." 表示已知范围内的标量测量值或分数值的元素。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, meter none 无 "An element whose implicit native role semantics will not be mapped to the accessibility API." 一种元素，其隐式原生角色语义不会映射到无障碍 API。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, none note 注释 "A section whose content is parenthetic or ancillary to the main content of the resource." 内容对资源主内容起插入或辅助作用的节。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, note paragraph 段落 "A paragraph of content." 一段内容。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, paragraph presentation 呈现 "An element whose implicit native role semantics will not be mapped to the accessibility API." 一种元素，其隐式原生角色语义不会映射到无障碍 API。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, presentation row 行 "A row of cells in a tabular container." 表格式容器中的一行单元格。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, row rowgroup 行组 "A structure containing one or more row elements in a tabular container." 表格式容器中包含一个或多个 row 元素的结构。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, rowgroup rowheader 行标题 "A cell containing header information for a row." 包含行的标题信息的单元格。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, rowheader separator (when not focusable) 分隔符 "A divider that separates and distinguishes sections of content or groups of menuitems." 一种分隔线，分开并区分内容的各节或菜单项的各组。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, separator strong 加强 "Content that is important, serious, or urgent." 重要、严肃或紧急的内容。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, strong subscript 下标 "One or more subscripted characters." 一个或多个下标字符。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, subscript superscript 上标 "One or more superscripted characters." 一个或多个上标字符。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, superscript table 表格 "A section containing data arranged in rows and columns." 包含按行和列排列的数据的节。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, table term 术语 "A word or phrase with a corresponding definition." 有对应定义的词或短语。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, term time 时间 "An element that represents a specific point in time." 表示特定时间点的元素。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, time toolbar 工具栏 "A collection of commonly used function buttons or controls represented in compact visual form." 以紧凑视觉形式呈现的一组常用功能按钮或控件。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, toolbar tooltip 工具提示 "A contextual popup that displays a description for an element." 一种上下文弹出框，显示元素的描述。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, tooltip References World Wide Web Consortium. (2023, June 6). Accessible Rich Internet Applications (WAI-ARIA) 1.2 (W3C Recommendation). https://www.w3.org/TR/wai-aria-1.2/

ui-ux/wai-aria/the-roles-model/categoriz.title: 5.3 Categorization of Roles | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
ui-ux/wai-aria/the-roles-model/categoriz.summary: 5.3 Categorization of Roles Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 5.3 Categorization of Roles 角色的分类 "To support the current user scenario, this specification categorizes roles that define user interface widgets (sliders, tree controls, etc.) and those that define page structure (sections, navigation, etc.)." 为了支持当前的用户场景，本规范把角色分类为定义用户界面控件的角色（滑块、树形控件等）和定义页面结构的角色（节、导航等）。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.3 5.3.1 Abstract Roles 抽象角色 "The following roles are used to support the WAI-ARIA Roles Model for the purpose of defining general role concepts." 下列角色用于支持 WAI-ARIA 角色模型，目的是定义一般的角色概念。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.3.1 5.3.2 Widget Roles 控件角色 "The following roles act as standalone user interface widgets or as part of larger, composite widgets." 下列角色充当独立的用户界面控件，或充当更大的复合控件的一部分。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.3.2 5.3.3 Document Structure Roles 文档结构角色 "The following roles describe structures that organize content in a page." 下列角色描述在页面中组织内容的结构。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.3.3 5.3.4 Landmark Roles 地标角色 "The following roles are regions of the page intended as navigational landmarks." 下列角色是页面中用作导航地标的区域。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.3.4 5.3.5 Live Region Roles 实时区域角色 "The following roles are live regions and may be modified by live region attributes." 下列角色是实时区域，并可以由实时区域属性修改。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.3.5 5.3.6 Window Roles 窗口角色 "The following roles act as windows within the browser or application." 下列角色充当浏览器或应用内的窗口。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.3.6 References World Wide Web Consortium. (2023, June 6). Accessible Rich Internet Applications (WAI-ARIA) 1.2 (W3C Recommendation). https://www.w3.org/TR/wai-aria-1.2/

contentinfo 内容信息 "A landmark that contains information about the parent document." 包含关于父文档的信息的地标。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, contentinfo form 表单 "A landmark region that contains a collection of items and objects that, as a whole, combine to create a form." 一种地标区域，包含一组项目和对象，它们作为整体组合成一个表单。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, form main 主内容 "A landmark containing the main content of a document." 包含文档主内容的地标。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, main navigation 导航 "A landmark containing a collection of navigational elements (usually links) for navigating the 一种地标，其内容与作者指定的特定目的相关且足够重要，用户很可能希望能轻松导航到该节，并让它列在页面摘要中。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, region search 搜索 "A landmark region that contains a collection of items and objects that, as a whole, combine to create a search facility." 一种地标区域，包含一组项目和对象，它们作为整体组合成一个搜索功能。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, search References World Wide Web Consortium. (2023, June 6). Accessible Rich Internet Applications (WAI-ARIA) 1.2 (W3C Recommendation). https://www.w3.org/TR/wai-aria-1.2/

ui-ux/wai-aria/the-roles-model/categoriz.summary: 5.3.2 Widget Roles Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 5.3.2 Widget Roles 控件角色 "The following roles act as standalone user interface 一种可勾选的输入，有三个可能的值：true、false 或 mixed。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, checkbox gridcell 网格单元格 "A cell in a grid or treegrid." 网格或树形网格中的单元格。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2023, section 5.4, gridcell link 链接 "An interactive reference to an internal or external resource that, when activated, causes the user agent to navigate to that resource." 指向内部或外部资源的交互式引用，被激活时使用户代理导航到该资源。 World Wide menuitemcheckbox menuitemradio 单选菜单项 "A checkable menuitem in a set of elements with the same role, only one of which can be checked at a time." 同一角色的一组元素中的可勾选菜单项，同一时间只能选中其中一个。 World Wide Web Recommended additional information includes:" 除上述一致性声明的必需组成外，考虑提供附加信息以帮助用户。建议的附加信息包括： World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 5.3.2 References World Wide Web Consortium. (2024, December 12). ui-ux/wcag-2-2/conformance/conformance-r.title: 5.2 Conformance Requirements | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
ui-ux/wcag-2-2/conformance/conformance-r.summary: 5.2 Conformance Requirements Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 5.2 Conformance Requirements 一致性要求 "In order for a web page to conform to WCAG 2.2, all of the following conformance requirements must be satisfied:" 网页要符合 WCAG 2.2，必须满足下列全部一致性要求： World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 5.2 5.2.1 Conformance Level 一致性级别 "One of the following levels of conformance is met in full." 完全达到下列一致性级别之一。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 5.2.1 5.2.2 Full pages 完整页面 "Conformance (and conformance level) is for full web page(s) only, and cannot be achieved if part of a web page is excluded." 一致性（和一致性级别）只针对完整的网页，如果网页的一部分被排除，则无法达到。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 5.2.2 5.2.3 Complete processes 完整流程 "When a web page is one of a series of web pages presenting a process (i.e., a sequence of steps that need to be completed in order to accomplish an activity), all web pages in the process conform at the specified level or better. (Conformance is not possible at a particular level if any page in the process does not conform at that level or better.)" 当一个网页是呈现某个流程（即为完成某项活动而需要依次完成的一系列步骤）的一系列网页之一时，该流程中的所有网页都符合指定级别或更高级别。（如果流程中任何页面不符合该级别或更高级别，则无法在该级别达到一致性。） World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 5.2.3 5.2.4 Only Accessibility-Supported Ways of Using Technologies 只以无障碍支持的方式使用技术 "Only accessibility-supported ways of using technologies are relied upon to satisfy the success criteria. Any information or functionality that is provided in a way that is not accessibility supported is also available in a way that is accessibility supported. (See Understanding accessibility support.)" 只有以无障碍支持的方式使用技术才被依赖来满足成功标准。以非无障碍支持的方式提供的任何信息或功能，也以无障碍支持的方式提供。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 5.2.4 5.2.5 Non-Interference 不干扰 "If technologies are used in a way that is not accessibility supported, or if they are used in a non-conforming way, then they do not block the ability of users to access the rest of the page. In addition, the web page as a whole continues to meet the conformance requirements under each of the following conditions:" 如果技术以非无障碍支持的方式或不符合规范的方式使用，那么它们不会阻碍用户访问页面的其余部分。此外，在下列每种情况下，整个网页仍然满足一致性要求： World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 5.2.5 References World Wide Web Consortium. (2024, December 12). Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 (W3C Recommendation). https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/

ui-ux/wcag-2-2/conformance/index.html.title: 5. Conformance | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
ui-ux/wcag-2-2/conformance/index.html.summary: 5. Conformance Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 5. Conformance 一致性 "This section lists requirements for conformance to WCAG 2.2. It also gives information about how to make conformance claims, which are optional. Finally, it describes what it means to be accessibility supported, since only accessibility-supported ways of using technologies can be relied upon for conformance. Understanding Conformance includes further explanation of the accessibility-supported concept." 本节列出符合 WCAG 2.2 的要求。它还说明如何作出一致性声明（可选）。最后，它说明“无障碍支持”的含义，因为只有以无障碍支持的方式使用技术才能被一致性所依赖。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 5 5.1 Interpreting Normative Requirements 解读规范性要求 "The main content of WCAG 2.2 is normative and defines requirements that impact conformance claims. Introductory material, appendices, sections marked as "non-normative", diagrams, examples, and notes are informative (non-normative). Non-normative material provides advisory information to help interpret the guidelines but does not create requirements that impact a conformance claim." WCAG 2.2 的主要内容是规范性的，并规定影响一致性声明的要求。引言材料、附录、标为“非规范性”的部分、图、示例和注释是信息性的（非规范性）。非规范性材料提供建议性信息以帮助解读指南，但不产生影响一致性声明的要求。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 5.1 5.2 Conformance Requirements 一致性要求 "In order for a web page to conform to WCAG 2.2, all of the following conformance requirements must be satisfied:" 网页要符合 WCAG 2.2，必须满足下列全部一致性要求： World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 5.2 5.3 Conformance Claims (Optional) 一致性声明（可选） "Conformance is defined only for web pages. However, a conformance claim may be made to cover one page, a series of pages, or multiple related web pages." 一致性只针对网页定义。不过，一致性声明可以覆盖一个页面、一系列页面或多个相关网页。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 5.3 5.4 Statement of Partial Conformance - Third Party Content 部分一致性声明：第三方内容 "Web pages that will later have additional content added can use a 'statement of partial conformance'. For example, an email program, a blog, an article that allows users to add comments, or applications supporting user-contributed content. Another example would be a page, such as a portal or news site, composed of content aggregated from multiple contributors, or sites that automatically insert content from other sources over time, such as when advertisements are inserted dynamically." 之后会添加更多内容的网页可以使用“部分一致性声明”。例如电子邮件程序、博客、允许用户添加评论的文章，或支持用户贡献内容的应用。另一个例子是由多个贡献者聚合内容组成的页面（如门户或新闻站点），或自动插入其他来源内容的站点（如动态插入的广告）。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 5.4 5.5 Statement of Partial Conformance - Language 部分一致性声明：语言 "A "statement of partial conformance due to language" may be made when the page does not conform, but would conform if accessibility support existed for (all of) the language(s) used on the page. The form of that statement would be, "This page does not conform, but would conform to WCAG 2.2 at level X if accessibility support existed for the following language(s):"" “因语言而作的部分一致性声明”可以在页面不符合、但如果页面所用（全部）语言有无障碍支持就会符合的情况下作出。该声明的形式是：“本页面不符合，但如果下列语言有无障碍支持，就会在 X 级符合 WCAG 2.2：” World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 5.5 5.6 Privacy Considerations 隐私考虑 "Success criteria within this specification which the Working Group has identified possible implications for privacy, either by providing protections for end users or which are important for website providers to take in to consideration when implementing features designed to protect user privacy, are listed below. This list reflects the current understanding of the Working Group but other Success criteria may have privacy implications that the Working Group is not aware of at the time of publishing." 本规范中工作组认定可能涉及隐私的成功标准（为最终用户提供保护，或网站提供者在实现保护用户隐私的功能时需要考虑的）列在下面。这个清单反映工作组目前的理解，但其他成功标准也可能与隐私有关。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 5.6 5.7 Security Considerations 安全考虑 "Success criteria within this specification which the Working Group has identified possible implications for security, either by providing protections for end users or which are important for website providers to take in to consideration when implementing features designed to protect user security, are listed below. This list reflects the current understanding of the Working Group but other Success criteria may have security implications that the Working Group is not aware of at the time of publishing." 本规范中工作组认定可能涉及安全的成功标准（为最终用户提供保护，或网站提供者在实现保护用户安全的功能时需要考虑的）列在下面。这个清单反映工作组目前的理解，但其他成功标准也可能与安全有关。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 5.7 References World Wide Web Consortium. (2024, December 12). Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 (W3C Recommendation). https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/
