ui-ux/wcag-2-2/glossary.html.summary: 6. Glossary Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 6. Glossary 术语表 (context) "The new success criteria may reference new terms that have also been added to the glossary and form part of the normative requirements of the success criteria." （语境）新的成功标准可能引用同样已加入术语表的新术语，这些术语构成成功标准规范性要求的一部分。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, "New Features in WCAG 2.2" abbreviation 缩写 "shortened form of a word, phrase, or name where the abbreviation has not become part of the language" 词、短语或名称的缩短形式，且该缩写尚未成为语言的一部分 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 accessibility supported 无障碍支持 "supported by users' assistive technologies as well as the accessibility features in browsers and other user agents" 受用户的辅助技术支持，也受浏览器和其他用户代理中的无障碍功能支持 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 alternative for time-based media 基于时间的媒体的替代 "document including correctly sequenced text descriptions of time-based visual and auditory information and providing a means for achieving the outcomes of any time-based interaction" 包含按正确顺序排列的、对基于时间的视觉和听觉信息的文字描述的文档，并提供实现任何基于时间的交互结果的手段 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 ambiguous to users in general 对一般用户含糊不清 "the purpose cannot be determined from the link and all information of the web page presented to the user simultaneously with the link (i.e., readers without disabilities would not know what a link would do until they activated it)" 从链接以及与链接同时呈现给用户的网页全部信息中无法确定其目的（即没有残障的读者在激活链接之前也不知道它会做什么） World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 ASCII art ASCII 艺术 "picture created by a spatial arrangement of characters or glyphs (typically from the 95 printable characters defined by ASCII)" 由字符或字形的空间排列构成的图画（通常用 ASCII 定义的 95 个可打印字符） World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 assistive technology (as used in this document) 辅助技术（本文档所用） "hardware and/or software that acts as a user agent, or along with a mainstream user agent, to provide functionality to meet the requirements of users with disabilities that go beyond those offered by mainstream user agents" 作为用户代理、或与主流用户代理一起工作的硬件和/或软件，提供功能以满足残障用户的需求，超出主流用户代理所提供的 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 audio 音频 "the technology of sound reproduction" 声音再现的技术 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 audio description 音频描述 "narration added to the soundtrack to describe important visual details that cannot be understood from the main soundtrack alone" 添加到音轨中的旁白，用来描述仅凭主音轨无法理解的重要视觉细节 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 audio-only 纯音频 "a time-based presentation that contains only audio (no video and no interaction)" 一种基于时间的呈现，只包含音频（没有视频，没有交互） World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 blinking 闪动 "switch back and forth between two visual states in a way that is meant to draw attention" 在两种视觉状态之间来回切换，目的是引起注意 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 blocks of text 文本块 "more than one sentence of text" 多于一句的文本 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 CAPTCHA 验证码 "initialism for "Completely Automated Public Turing test to tell Computers and Humans Apart"" “全自动区分计算机和人类的公开图灵测试”的首字母缩写 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 captions 字幕 "synchronized visual and/or text alternative for both speech and non-speech audio information needed to understand the media content" 同步的视觉和/或文字替代，针对理解媒体内容所需的语音和非语音音频信息 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 changes of context 上下文的改变 "major changes that, if made without user awareness, can disorient users who are not able to view the entire page simultaneously" 重大改变，如果在用户不知情时发生，会让无法同时查看整个页面的用户迷失方向 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 cognitive function test 认知功能测试 "A task that requires the user to remember, manipulate, or transcribe information. Examples include, but are not limited to:" 要求用户记忆、处理或转录信息的任务。例子包括但不限于： World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 conformance 一致性 "satisfying all the requirements of a given standard, guideline or specification" 满足全部要求，针对给定的标准、指南或规范 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 conforming alternate version 符合要求的替代版本 "version that 1. conforms at the designated level, and 2. provides all of the same information and functionality in the same human language, and 3. is as up to date as the non-conforming content, and" 这样的版本：1. 在指定级别符合要求，且 2. 以同一人类语言提供全部相同的信息和功能，且 3. 与不符合要求的内容同样及时更新，且 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 content (web content) 内容（网络内容） "information and sensory experience to be communicated to the user by means of a user agent, including code or markup that defines the content's structure, presentation, and interactions" 通过用户代理传达给用户的信息和感官体验，包括定义内容结构、呈现和交互的代码或标记 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 context-sensitive help 上下文相关帮助 "help text that provides information related to the function currently being performed" 提供与当前正在执行的功能相关信息的帮助文本 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 contrast ratio 对比度 "(L1 + 0.05) / (L2 + 0.05), where L1 is the relative luminance of the lighter of the colors, and L2 is the relative luminance of the darker of the colors." (L1 + 0.05) / (L2 + 0.05)，其中 L1 是较亮颜色的相对亮度，L2 是较暗颜色的相对亮度。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 correct reading sequence 正确的阅读顺序 "any sequence where words and paragraphs are presented in an order that does not change the meaning of the content" 任何这样的顺序：词和段落按某个次序呈现，该次序不改变内容意义 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 CSS pixel CSS 像素 "visual angle of about 0.0213 degrees" 约 0.0213 度的视角 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 down-event 按下事件 "platform event that occurs when the trigger stimulus of a pointer is depressed" 指针的触发刺激被按下时发生的平台事件 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 dragging movement 拖动操作 "an operation where the pointer engages with an element on the down-event and the element (or a representation of its position) follows the pointer until an up-event" 一种操作：指针在按下事件时与元素接合，元素（或其位置的表示）跟随指针直到抬起事件 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 emergency 紧急情况 "a sudden, unexpected situation or occurrence that requires immediate action to preserve health, safety, or property" 突然、意外的情况或事件，需要立即采取行动以保护健康、安全或财产 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 essential 必不可少 "if removed, would fundamentally change the information or functionality of the content, and information and functionality cannot be achieved in another way that would conform" 如果去掉，会从根本上改变内容的信息或功能，并且这些信息和功能无法以其他符合要求的方式实现 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 extended audio description 扩展音频描述 "audio description that is added to an audiovisual presentation by pausing the video so that there is time to add additional description" 通过暂停视频以便有时间加入更多描述而添加到视听呈现中的音频描述 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 flash 闪烁 "a pair of opposing changes in relative luminance that can cause seizures in some people if it is large enough and in the right frequency range" 一对相反的相对亮度变化，如果幅度足够大且频率在特定范围内，可能使某些人癫痫发作 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 focus indicator 焦点指示器 "pixels that are changed to visually indicate when a user interface component is in a focused state" 被改变的像素，用来在视觉上指示用户界面组件处于聚焦状态 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 functionality 功能 "processes and outcomes achievable through user action" 通过用户操作可以实现的过程和结果 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 general flash and red flash thresholds 一般闪烁和红色闪烁阈值 "a flash or rapidly changing image sequence is below the threshold (i.e., content passes) if any of the following are true:" 闪烁或快速变化的图像序列在下列任一条件为真时低于阈值（即内容通过）： World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 human language 人类语言 "language that is spoken, written or signed (through visual or tactile means) to communicate with humans" 以口头、书面或手语（通过视觉或触觉方式）与人交流的语言 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 idiom 习语 "phrase whose meaning cannot be deduced from the meaning of the individual words and the specific words cannot be changed without losing the meaning" 含义无法从单个词的含义推出的短语，且其中的具体词不能更换，否则失去含义 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 image of text 文本图像 "text that has been rendered in a non-text form (e.g., an image) in order to achieve a particular visual effect" 以非文本形式（例如图像）呈现的文本，目的是实现特定的视觉效果 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 informative 信息性 "for information purposes and not required for conformance" 为提供信息而给出，不是一致性所必需 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 input error 输入错误 "information provided by the user that is not accepted" 用户提供的、未被接受的信息 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 jargon 行话 "words used in a particular way by people in a particular field" 特定领域的人以特定方式使用的词 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 keyboard interface 键盘接口 "interface used by software to obtain keystroke input" 软件用来获取按键输入的接口 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 keyboard shortcut 键盘快捷键 "alternative means of triggering an action by the pressing of one or more keys" 通过按一个或多个键来触发动作的替代方式 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 label 标签 "text or other component with a text alternative that is presented to a user to identify a component within web content" 文本或带文本替代的其他组件，呈现给用户以标识网络内容中的某个组件 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 large scale (text) 大号（文本） "with at least 18 point or 14 point bold or font size that would yield equivalent size for Chinese, Japanese and Korean (CJK) fonts" 至少 18 磅，或 14 磅加粗，或对中日韩（CJK）字体产生同等大小的字号 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 legal commitments 法律承诺 "transactions where the person incurs a legally binding obligation or benefit" 使人承担具有法律约束力的义务或获得利益的交易 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 link purpose 链接目的 "nature of the result obtained by activating a hyperlink" 激活超链接所得结果的性质 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 live 直播 "information captured from a real-world event and transmitted to the receiver with no more than a broadcast delay" 从真实事件中捕获、以不超过广播延迟的时间传送给接收者的信息 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 lower secondary education level 初中教育水平 "the two or three year period of education that begins after completion of six years of school and ends nine years after the beginning of primary education" 两到三年的教育阶段，在完成六年学业后开始，在小学教育开始后第九年结束 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 mechanism 机制 "process or technique for achieving a result" 实现某种结果的过程或技术 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 media alternative for text 文本的媒体替代 "media that presents no more information than is already presented in text (directly or via text alternatives)" 呈现的信息不多于文本中已呈现的（直接呈现或通过文本替代）的媒体 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 motion animation 运动动画 "addition of steps between conditions to create the illusion of movement or to give a sense of a smooth transition" 在状态之间加入过渡步骤以制造运动的错觉，或给人平滑过渡的感觉 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 minimum bounding box 最小外接框 "the smallest enclosing rectangle aligned to the horizontal axis within which all the points of a shape lie. For components which wrap onto multiple lines as part of a sentence or block of text (such as hypertext links), the bounding box is based on how the component would appear on a single line." 与水平轴对齐的最小矩形，形状的所有点都在其中 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 name 名称 "text by which software can identify a component within web content to the user" 软件用来标识网络内容中某个组件的文本，面向用户 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 navigated sequentially 按顺序导航 "navigated in the order defined for advancing focus (from one element to the next) using a keyboard interface" 按为推进焦点而定义的顺序导航（从一个元素到下一个），使用键盘接口 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 non-text content 非文本内容 "any content that is not a sequence of characters that can be programmatically determined or where the sequence is not expressing something in human language" 任何不是可由程序确定的字符序列的内容，或该序列不表达人类语言的内容 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 normative 规范性 "required for conformance" 一致性所必需 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 on a full-screen window 在全屏窗口中 "on the most common sized desktop/laptop display with the viewport maximized" 在最常见尺寸的台式机/笔记本显示器上，视口最大化 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 paused 已暂停 "stopped by user request and not resumed until requested by user" 应用户请求停止，在用户请求之前不恢复 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 perimeter 周长 "continuous line forming the boundary of a shape not including shared pixels, or the minimum bounding box, whichever is shortest." 构成形状边界的连续线，不含共享像素，或最小外接框，取较短者。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 pointer input 指针输入 "input from a device that can target a specific coordinate (or set of coordinates) on a screen, such as a mouse, pen, or touch contact" 来自能够指向屏幕上特定坐标（或一组坐标）的设备的输入，例如鼠标、笔或触摸接触 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 prerecorded 预录 "information that is not live" 非直播的信息 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 presentation 呈现 "rendering of the content in a form to be perceived by users" 把内容渲染成可供用户感知的形式 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 primary education level 小学教育水平 "six year time period that begins between the ages of five and seven, possibly without any previous education" 从五到七岁之间开始的六年阶段，之前可能没有任何教育 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 process 流程 "series of user actions where each action is required in order to complete an activity" 一系列用户操作，其中每一步都是完成某项活动所必需的 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 programmatically determined (programmatically determinable) 可由程序确定 "determined by software from author-supplied data provided in a way that different user agents, including assistive technologies, can extract and present this information to users in different modalities" 由软件根据作者提供的数据确定，这些数据以不同用户代理（包括辅助技术）都能提取并呈现给用户的方式提供 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 programmatically determined link context 可由程序确定的链接上下文 "additional information that can be programmatically determined from relationships with a link, combined with the link text, and presented to users in different modalities" 可由程序从与链接的关系中确定的附加信息，与链接文本结合，以不同方式呈现给用户 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 programmatically set 由程序设置 "set by software using methods that are supported by user agents, including assistive technologies" 由软件设置，使用用户代理（包括辅助技术）支持的方法 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 pure decoration 纯装饰 "serving only an aesthetic purpose, providing no information, and having no functionality" 只起美观作用，不提供信息，也没有功能 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 real-time event 实时事件 "event that a) occurs at the same time as the viewing and b) is not completely generated by the content" a) 与观看同时发生，且 b) 不完全由内容生成的事件 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 region 区域 "perceivable, programmatically determined section of content" 可感知的、可由程序确定的一个内容部分 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 relationships 关系 "meaningful associations between distinct pieces of content" 不同内容片段之间有意义的关联 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 relative luminance 相对亮度 "the relative brightness of any point in a colorspace, normalized to 0 for darkest black and 1 for lightest white" 色彩空间中任意一点的相对明亮程度，归一化为最暗的黑为 0、最亮的白为 1 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 relied upon (technologies that are) 被依赖的（技术） "the content would not conform if that technology is turned off or is not supported" 如果该技术被关闭或不受支持，内容就不符合要求 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 role 角色 "text or number by which software can identify the function of a component within Web content" 软件用来标识网络内容中某个组件的功能的文本或数字 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 same functionality 相同功能 "same result when used" 使用时得到相同的结果 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 same relative order 相同的相对顺序 "same position relative to other items" 相对于其他项目的位置相同 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 satisfies a success criterion 满足成功标准 "the success criterion does not evaluate to 'false' when applied to the page" 该成功标准应用于页面时不判定为“false” World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 section 节 "a self-contained portion of written content that deals with one or more related topics or thoughts" 书面内容中自成一体的部分，处理一个或多个相关的主题或想法 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 set of web pages 一组网页 "collection of web pages that share a common purpose and that are created by the same author, group or organization" 有共同目的、由同一作者、团体或组织创建的网页集合 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 sign language 手语 "a language using combinations of movements of the hands and arms, facial expressions, or body positions to convey meaning" 用手和手臂的动作、面部表情或身体姿势的组合来传达意义的语言 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 sign language interpretation 手语翻译 "translation of one language, generally a spoken language, into a sign language" 把一种语言（通常是口语）翻译，译成手语 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 single pointer 单指针 "an input modality that only targets a single point on the page/screen at a time – such as a mouse, single finger on a touch screen, or stylus." 一次只指向页面/屏幕上一个点的输入方式，例如鼠标、触摸屏上的单根手指或触控笔。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 specific sensory experience 特定感官体验 "a sensory experience that is not purely decorative and does not primarily convey important information or perform a function" 不是纯装饰、也不主要传达重要信息或执行功能的感官体验 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 state 状态 "dynamic property expressing characteristics of a user interface component that may change in response to user action or automated processes" 表达用户界面组件特征的动态属性，可能因用户操作或自动过程而改变 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 status message 状态消息 "change in content that is not a change of context, and that provides information to the user on the success or results of an action, on the waiting state of an application, on the progress of a process, or on the existence of errors" 不是上下文改变的内容变化，向用户提供关于操作成功或结果、应用等待状态、流程进度或错误存在的信息 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 structure 结构 "The way the parts of a web page are organized in relation to each other; and The way a collection of web pages is organized" 网页各部分相互之间的组织方式；以及 一组网页的组织方式 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 style property 样式属性 "property whose value determines the presentation (e.g. font, color, size, location, padding, volume, synthesized speech prosody) of content elements as they are rendered (e.g. onscreen, via loudspeaker, via braille display) by user agents" 其值决定内容元素呈现方式的属性（例如字体、颜色、大小、位置、内边距、音量、合成语音的韵律），当内容被渲染时（例如屏幕、扬声器、盲文显示器）由用户代理 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 supplemental content 补充内容 "additional content that illustrates or clarifies the primary content" 说明或阐释主要内容的附加内容 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 synchronized media 同步媒体 "audio or video synchronized with another format for presenting information and/or with time-based interactive components, unless the media is a media alternative for text that is clearly labeled as such" 与另一种呈现信息的格式同步的音频或视频，和/或与基于时间的交互组件同步，除非该媒体是文本的媒体替代 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 target 目标 "region of the display that will accept a pointer action, such as the interactive area of a user interface component" 显示区域中接受指针操作的区域，例如用户界面组件的交互区 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 technology (web content) 技术（网络内容） "mechanism for encoding instructions to be rendered, played or executed by user agents" 编码指令的机制，这些指令由用户代理渲染、播放或执行 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 text 文本 "sequence of characters that can be programmatically determined, where the sequence is expressing something in human language" 可由程序确定的字符序列，且该序列表达人类语言 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 text alternative 文本替代 "Text that is programmatically associated with non-text content or referred to from text that is programmatically associated with non-text content. Programmatically associated text is text whose location can be programmatically determined from the non-text content." 与非文本内容以程序方式关联的文本，或从与非文本内容以程序方式关联的文本所引用的文本 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 up-event 抬起事件 "platform event that occurs when the trigger stimulus of a pointer is released" 指针的触发刺激被释放时发生的平台事件 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 used in an unusual or restricted way 以不常见或受限方式使用 "words used in such a way that requires users to know exactly which definition to apply in order to understand the content correctly" 以要求用户确切知道该采用哪个定义才能正确理解内容的方式使用的词 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 user agent 用户代理 "any software that retrieves and presents web content for users" 任何软件，只要它为用户获取并呈现网络内容 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 user-controllable 用户可控的 "data that is intended to be accessed by users" 供用户访问的数据 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 user interface component 用户界面组件 "a part of the content that is perceived by users as a single control for a distinct function" 内容中被用户感知为单个控件、执行某一特定功能的部分 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 user inactivity 用户无操作 "any continuous period of time where no user actions occur" 没有任何用户操作的任何连续时间段 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 video 视频 "the technology of moving or sequenced pictures or images" 运动的或连续的图片或图像的技术 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 video-only 纯视频 "a time-based presentation that contains only video (no audio and no interaction)" 一种基于时间的呈现，只包含视频（没有音频，没有交互） World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 viewport 视口 "object in which the user agent presents content" 用户代理在其中呈现内容的对象 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 visually customized 视觉上可定制 "the font, size, color, and background can be set" 字体、大小、颜色和背景都可以设置 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 web page 网页 "a non-embedded resource obtained from a single URI using HTTP plus any other resources that are used in the rendering or intended to be rendered together with it by a user agent" 通过 HTTP 从单个 URI 获取的非嵌入资源，加上用户代理渲染它时所用、或打算由用户代理与它一起渲染的任何其他资源 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 6 References World Wide Web Consortium. (2024, December 12). Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 (W3C Recommendation). https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/

ui-ux/wcag-2-2/index.html.summary: WCAG 2.2 Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source WCAG 2.2 网络内容无障碍指南 2.2 "Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 covers a wide range of recommendations for making web content more accessible." 网络内容无障碍指南（WCAG）2.2 涵盖广泛的建议，用于让网络内容更加无障碍。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Abstract 1. Perceivable 可感知 "Information and user interface components must be presentable to users in ways they can perceive." 信息和用户界面组件必须能够以用户可感知的方式呈现给用户。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Principle 1 2. Operable 可操作 "User interface components and navigation must be operable." 用户界面组件和导航必须可操作。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Principle 2 3. Understandable 可理解 "Information and the operation of the user interface must be understandable." 信息和用户界面的操作必须可理解。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Principle 3 4. Robust 健壮 "Content must be robust enough that it can be interpreted by a wide variety of user agents, including assistive technologies." 内容必须足够健壮，能够被各种各样的用户代理（包括辅助技术）解读。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Principle 4 5. Conformance 一致性 "This section lists requirements for conformance to WCAG 2.2. It also gives information about how to make conformance claims, which are optional. Finally, it describes what it means to be accessibility supported, since only accessibility-supported ways of using technologies can be relied upon for conformance. Understanding Conformance includes further explanation of the accessibility-supported concept." 本节列出符合 WCAG 2.2 的要求。它还说明如何作出一致性声明（可选）。最后，它说明“无障碍支持”的含义，因为只有以无障碍支持的方式使用技术才能被一致性所依赖。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, section 5 6. Glossary 术语表 (context) "The new success criteria may reference new terms that have also been added to the glossary and form part of the normative requirements of the success criteria." （语境）新的成功标准可能引用同样已加入术语表的新术语，这些术语构成成功标准规范性要求的一部分。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, "New Features in WCAG 2.2" References World Wide Web Consortium. (2024, December 12). Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 (W3C Recommendation). https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/

ui-ux/wcag-2-2/operable/enough-time.html.title: 2.2 Enough Time | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
ui-ux/wcag-2-2/operable/enough-time.html.summary: 2.2 Enough Time Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 2.2 Enough Time 充足的时间 "Provide users enough time to read and use content." 为用户提供足够的时间来阅读和使用内容。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Guideline 2.2 2.2.1 Timing Adjustable 可调整的时限（A 级） "For each time limit that is set by the content, at least one of the following is true:" 对于内容设定的每个时限，下列至少一项成立： World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 2.2.1 2.2.2 Pause, Stop, Hide 暂停、停止、隐藏（A 级） "For moving, blinking, scrolling, or auto-updating information, all of the following are true:" 对于移动、闪烁、滚动或自动更新的信息，下列各项成立： World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 2.2.2 2.2.3 No Timing 无时限（AAA 级） "Timing is not an essential part of the event or activity presented by the content, except for non-interactive synchronized media and real-time events." 时间限制不是内容所呈现的事件或活动的必要部分，非交互的同步媒体和实时事件除外。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 2.2.3 2.2.4 Interruptions 打断（AAA 级） "Interruptions can be postponed or suppressed by the user, except interruptions involving an emergency." 打断可以由用户推迟或抑制，涉及紧急情况的打断除外。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 2.2.4 2.2.5 Re-authenticating 重新认证（AAA 级） "When an authenticated session expires, the user can continue the activity without loss of data after re-authenticating." 当已认证的会话过期时，用户可以在重新认证后继续活动而不丢失数据。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 2.2.5 2.2.6 Timeouts 超时（AAA 级） "Users are warned of the duration of any user inactivity that could cause data loss, unless the data is preserved for more than 20 hours when the user does not take any actions." 向用户警示可能导致数据丢失的用户无操作时长，除非用户不进行任何操作时数据保留超过 20 小时。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 2.2.6 References World Wide Web Consortium. (2024, December 12). Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 (W3C Recommendation). https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/

ui-ux/wcag-2-2/operable/index.html.title: 2. Operable | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
ui-ux/wcag-2-2/operable/index.html.summary: 2. Operable Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 2. Operable 可操作 "User interface components and navigation must be operable." 用户界面组件和导航必须可操作。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Principle 2 2.1 Keyboard Accessible 键盘可访问 "Make all functionality available from a keyboard." 让所有功能都可以通过键盘使用。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Guideline 2.1 2.2 Enough Time 充足的时间 "Provide users enough time to read and use content." 为用户提供足够的时间来阅读和使用内容。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Guideline 2.2 2.3 Seizures and Physical Reactions 癫痫发作与生理反应 "Do not design content in a way that is known to cause seizures or physical reactions." 不要以已知会引起癫痫发作或生理反应的方式设计内容。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Guideline 2.3 2.4 Navigable 可导航 "Provide ways to help users navigate, find content, and determine where they are." 提供方法帮助用户导航、查找内容并确定自己所在的位置。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Guideline 2.4 2.5 Input Modalities 输入方式 "Make it easier for users to operate functionality through various inputs beyond keyboard." 让用户更容易通过键盘之外的各种输入方式操作功能。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Guideline 2.5 References World Wide Web Consortium. (2024, December 12). Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 (W3C Recommendation). https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/

ui-ux/wcag-2-2/operable/input-modalities.summary: 2.5 Input Modalities Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 2.5 Input Modalities 输入方式 "Make it easier for users to operate functionality through various inputs beyond keyboard." 让用户更容易通过键盘之外的各种输入方式操作功能。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Guideline 2.5 2.5.1 Pointer Gestures 指针手势（A 级） "All functionality that uses multipoint or path-based gestures for operation can be operated with a single pointer without a path-based gesture, unless a multipoint or path-based gesture is essential." 所有使用多点或基于路径的手势来操作的功能都可以用单指针操作，而无需基于路径的手势，除非多点或基于路径的手势是必不可少的。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 2.5.1 2.5.2 Pointer Cancellation 指针取消（A 级） "For functionality that can be operated using a single pointer, at least one of the following is true:" 对于可以用单指针操作的功能，下列至少一项成立： World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 2.5.2 2.5.3 Label in Name 名称中的标签（A 级） "For user interface components with labels that include text or images of text, the name contains the text that is presented visually." 对于标签含有文本或文本图像的用户界面组件，其名称包含视觉呈现的文本。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 2.5.3 2.5.4 Motion Actuation 运动触发（A 级） "Functionality that can be operated by device motion or user motion can also be operated by user interface components and responding to the motion can be disabled to prevent accidental actuation, except when:" 可以通过设备运动或用户运动操作的功能也可以通过用户界面组件操作，并且可以禁用对运动的响应以防误触发，除非： World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 2.5.4 2.5.5 Target Size (Enhanced) 目标大小（增强）（AAA 级） "The size of the target for pointer inputs is at least 44 by 44 CSS pixels except when:" 指针输入的目标大小至少为 44 乘 44 CSS 像素，除非： World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 2.5.5 2.5.6 Concurrent Input Mechanisms 并行输入机制（AAA 级） "Web content does not restrict use of input modalities available on a platform except where the restriction is essential, required to ensure the security of the content, or required to respect user settings." 网页内容不限制平台上可用的输入方式的使用，除非该限制是必不可少的、为确保内容安全所需，或为尊重用户设置所需。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 2.5.6 2.5.7 Dragging Movements 拖动操作（AA 级） "All functionality that uses a dragging movement for operation can be achieved by a single pointer without dragging, unless dragging is essential or the functionality is determined by the user agent and not modified by the author." 所有使用拖动操作的功能都可以用单指针不拖动来完成，除非拖动是必不可少的，或该功能由用户代理决定且未被作者修改。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 2.5.7 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum) 目标大小（最低）（AA 级） "The size of the target for pointer inputs is at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels, except when:" 指针输入的目标大小至少为 24 乘 24 CSS 像素，除非： World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 2.5.8 References World Wide Web Consortium. (2024, December 12). Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 (W3C Recommendation). https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/

ui-ux/wcag-2-2/operable/keyboard-accessi.title: 2.1 Keyboard Accessible | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
ui-ux/wcag-2-2/operable/keyboard-accessi.summary: 2.1 Keyboard Accessible Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 2.1 Keyboard Accessible 键盘可访问 "Make all functionality available from a keyboard." 让所有功能都可以通过键盘使用。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Guideline 2.1 2.1.1 Keyboard 键盘（A 级） "All functionality of the content is operable through a keyboard interface without requiring specific timings for individual keystrokes, except where the underlying function requires input that depends on the path of the user's movement and not just the endpoints." 内容的所有功能都可以通过键盘接口操作，且不要求单次按键有特定的时间限制，除非底层功能需要依赖用户移动路径的输入，而不只是终点。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 2.1.1 2.1.2 No Keyboard Trap 无键盘陷阱（A 级） "If keyboard focus can be moved to a component of the page using a keyboard interface, then focus can be moved away from that component using only a keyboard interface, and, if it requires more than unmodified arrow or tab keys or other standard exit methods, the user is advised of the method for moving focus away." 如果可以用键盘接口把键盘焦点移到页面的某个组件上，那么只用键盘接口就能把焦点从该组件移开；如果这需要的不只是未修饰的方向键或 Tab 键或其他标准退出方法，则告知用户移开焦点的方法。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 2.1.2 2.1.3 Keyboard (No Exception) 键盘（无例外）（AAA 级） "All functionality of the content is operable through a keyboard interface without requiring specific timings for individual keystrokes." 内容的所有功能都可以通过键盘接口操作，且不要求单次按键有特定的时间限制。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 2.1.3 2.1.4 Character Key Shortcuts 字符键快捷键（A 级） "If a keyboard shortcut is implemented in content using only letter (including upper- and lower-case letters), punctuation, number, or symbol characters, then at least one of the following is true:" 如果内容中的键盘快捷键只用字母（包括大小写字母）、标点、数字或符号字符实现，则下列至少一项成立： World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 2.1.4 References World Wide Web Consortium. (2024, December 12). Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 (W3C Recommendation). https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/

ui-ux/wcag-2-2/operable/navigable.html.title: 2.4 Navigable | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
ui-ux/wcag-2-2/operable/navigable.html.summary: 2.4 Navigable Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 2.4 Navigable 可导航 "Provide ways to help users navigate, find content, and determine where they are." 提供方法帮助用户导航、查找内容并确定自己所在的位置。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Guideline 2.4 2.4.1 Bypass Blocks 跳过区块（A 级） "A mechanism is available to bypass blocks of content that are repeated on multiple web pages." 提供一种机制来跳过在多个网页上重复出现的内容区块。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 2.4.1 2.4.2 Page Titled 页面标题（A 级） "Web pages have titles that describe topic or purpose." 网页有描述主题或目的的标题。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 2.4.2 2.4.3 Focus Order 焦点顺序（A 级） "If a web page can be navigated sequentially and the navigation sequences affect meaning or operation, focusable components receive focus in an order that preserves meaning and operability." 如果网页可以按顺序导航且导航顺序影响意义或操作，则可聚焦组件按保持意义和可操作性的顺序获得焦点。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 2.4.3 2.4.4 Link Purpose (In Context) 链接目的（在上下文中）（A 级） "The purpose of each link can be determined from the link text alone or from the link text together with its programmatically determined link context, except where the purpose of the link would be ambiguous to users in general." 每个链接的目的可以单从链接文本确定，或从链接文本及其由程序确定的链接上下文一起确定，除非该链接的目的对一般用户来说本来就含糊不清。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 2.4.4 2.4.5 Multiple Ways 多种方式（AA 级） "More than one way is available to locate a web page within a set of web pages except where the web page is the result of, or a step in, a process." 在一组网页中有多于一种方式可以找到某个网页，除非该网页是某个流程的结果或其中一步。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 2.4.5 2.4.6 Headings and Labels 标题与标签（AA 级） "Headings and labels describe topic or purpose." 标题和标签描述主题或目的。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 2.4.6 2.4.7 Focus Visible 焦点可见（AA 级） "Any keyboard operable user interface has a mode of operation where the keyboard focus indicator is visible." 任何可用键盘操作的用户界面都有一种键盘焦点指示器可见的操作模式。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 2.4.7 2.4.8 Location 位置（AAA 级） "Information about the user's location within a set of web pages is available." 提供用户在一组网页中所处位置的信息。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 2.4.8 2.4.9 Link Purpose (Link Only) 链接目的（仅链接）（AAA 级） "A mechanism is available to allow the purpose of each link to be identified from link text alone, except where the purpose of the link would be ambiguous to users in general." 提供一种机制，让每个链接的目的可以单从链接文本识别，除非该链接的目的对一般用户来说本来就含糊不清。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 2.4.9 2.4.10 Section Headings 章节标题（AAA 级） "Section headings are used to organize the content." 使用章节标题来组织内容。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 2.4.10 2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured (Minimum) 焦点不被遮挡（最低）（AA 级） "When a user interface component receives keyboard focus, the component is not entirely hidden due to author-created content." 当用户界面组件获得键盘焦点时，该组件不会因作者创建的内容而被完全遮挡。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 2.4.11 2.4.12 Focus Not Obscured (Enhanced) 焦点不被遮挡（增强）（AAA 级） "When a user interface component receives keyboard focus, no part of the component is hidden by author-created content." 当用户界面组件获得键盘焦点时，该组件没有任何部分被作者创建的内容遮挡。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 2.4.12 2.4.13 Focus Appearance 焦点外观（AAA 级） "When the keyboard focus indicator is visible, an area of the focus indicator meets all the following:" 当键盘焦点指示器可见时，焦点指示器的某个区域满足下列全部条件： World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 2.4.13 References World Wide Web Consortium. (2024, December 12). Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 (W3C Recommendation). https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/

ui-ux/wcag-2-2/operable/seizures-and-phy.title: 2.3 Seizures and Physical Reactions | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
ui-ux/wcag-2-2/operable/seizures-and-phy.summary: 2.3 Seizures and Physical Reactions Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 2.3 Seizures and Physical Reactions 癫痫发作与生理反应 "Do not design content in a way that is known to cause seizures or physical reactions." 不要以已知会引起癫痫发作或生理反应的方式设计内容。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Guideline 2.3 2.3.1 Three Flashes or Below Threshold 三次闪烁或低于阈值（A 级） "Web pages do not contain anything that flashes more than three times in any one second period, or the flash is below the general flash and red flash thresholds." 网页不包含任何在任意一秒内闪烁超过三次的内容，或闪烁低于一般闪烁和红色闪烁阈值。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 2.3.1 2.3.2 Three Flashes 三次闪烁（AAA 级） "Web pages do not contain anything that flashes more than three times in any one second period." 网页不包含任何在任意一秒内闪烁超过三次的内容。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 2.3.2 2.3.3 Animation from Interactions 交互触发的动画（AAA 级） "Motion animation triggered by interaction can be disabled, unless the animation is essential to the functionality or the information being conveyed." 由交互触发的运动动画可以被禁用，除非该动画对功能或所传达的信息必不可少。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 2.3.3 References World Wide Web Consortium. (2024, December 12). Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 (W3C Recommendation). https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/

ui-ux/wcag-2-2/perceivable/adaptable.htm.title: 1.3 Adaptable | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
ui-ux/wcag-2-2/perceivable/adaptable.htm.summary: 1.3 Adaptable Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 1.3 Adaptable 可适配 "Create content that can be presented in different ways (for example simpler layout) without losing information or structure." 创建可以以不同方式呈现（例如更简单的布局）而不丢失信息或结构的内容。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Guideline 1.3 1.3.1 Info and Relationships 信息与关系（A 级） "Information, structure, and relationships conveyed through presentation can be programmatically determined or are available in text." 通过呈现方式传达的信息、结构和关系可以由程序确定，或以文本形式提供。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 1.3.1 1.3.2 Meaningful Sequence 有意义的顺序（A 级） "When the sequence in which content is presented affects its meaning, a correct reading sequence can be programmatically determined." 当内容的呈现顺序影响其意义时，正确的阅读顺序可以由程序确定。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 1.3.2 1.3.3 Sensory Characteristics 感官特征（A 级） "Instructions provided for understanding and operating content do not rely solely on sensory characteristics of components such as shape, color, size, visual location, orientation, or sound." 为理解和操作内容而提供的说明不单独依赖组件的感官特征，例如形状、颜色、大小、视觉位置、方向或声音。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 1.3.3 1.3.4 Orientation 方向（AA 级） "Content does not restrict its view and operation to a single display orientation, such as portrait or landscape, unless a specific display orientation is essential." 内容不把查看和操作限制在单一显示方向（如竖屏或横屏），除非特定显示方向是必不可少的。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 1.3.4 1.3.5 Identify Input Purpose 识别输入目的（AA 级） "The purpose of each input field collecting information about the user can be programmatically determined when:" 收集用户信息的每个输入字段的目的可以由程序确定，当： World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 1.3.5 1.3.6 Identify Purpose 识别目的（AAA 级） "In content implemented using markup languages, the purpose of user interface components, icons, and regions can be programmatically determined." 在用标记语言实现的内容中，用户界面组件、图标和区域的目的可以由程序确定。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 1.3.6 References World Wide Web Consortium. (2024, December 12). Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 (W3C Recommendation). https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/

ui-ux/wcag-2-2/perceivable/distinguishab.title: 1.4 Distinguishable | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
ui-ux/wcag-2-2/perceivable/distinguishab.summary: 1.4 Distinguishable Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 1.4 Distinguishable 可辨别 "Make it easier for users to see and hear content including separating foreground from background." 让用户更容易看到和听到内容，包括把前景与背景分开。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Guideline 1.4 1.4.1 Use of Color 颜色的使用（A 级） "Color is not used as the only visual means of conveying information, indicating an action, prompting a response, or distinguishing a visual element." 颜色不作为传达信息、指示动作、提示响应或区分视觉元素的唯一视觉手段。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 1.4.1 1.4.2 Audio Control 音频控制（A 级） "If any audio on a web page plays automatically for more than 3 seconds, either a mechanism is available to pause or stop the audio, or a mechanism is available to control audio volume independently from the overall system volume level." 如果网页上的任何音频自动播放超过 3 秒，则提供一种机制来暂停或停止该音频，或提供一种机制来独立于系统总音量控制音频音量。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 1.4.2 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum) 对比度（最低）（AA 级） "The visual presentation of text and images of text has a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1, except for the following:" 文本和文本图像的视觉呈现具有至少 4.5:1 的对比度，下列情形除外： World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 1.4.3 1.4.4 Resize Text 调整文本大小（AA 级） "Except for captions and images of text, text can be resized without assistive technology up to 200 percent without loss of content or functionality." 除字幕和文本图像外，文本可以在不使用辅助技术的情况下放大到 200%，而不丢失内容或功能。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 1.4.4 1.4.5 Images of Text 文本图像（AA 级） "If the technologies being used can achieve the visual presentation, text is used to convey information rather than images of text except for the following:" 如果所用技术能够实现该视觉呈现，则用文本而不是文本图像来传达信息，下列情形除外： World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 1.4.5 1.4.6 Contrast (Enhanced) 对比度（增强）（AAA 级） "The visual presentation of text and images of text has a contrast ratio of at least 7:1, except for the following:" 文本和文本图像的视觉呈现具有至少 7:1 的对比度，下列情形除外： World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 1.4.6 1.4.7 Low or No Background Audio 低背景音或无背景音（AAA 级） "For prerecorded audio-only content that (1) contains primarily speech in the foreground, (2) is not an audio CAPTCHA or audio logo, and (3) is not vocalization intended to be primarily musical expression such as singing or rapping, at least one of the following is true:" 对于预录的纯音频内容，若其 (1) 前景主要是语音，(2) 不是音频验证码或音频标志，且 (3) 不是旨在作为音乐表达的发声（如歌唱或说唱），则下列至少一项成立： World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 1.4.7 1.4.8 Visual Presentation 视觉呈现（AAA 级） "For the visual presentation of blocks of text, a mechanism is available to achieve the following:" 对于文本块的视觉呈现，提供一种机制来实现下列各项： World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 1.4.8 1.4.9 Images of Text (No Exception) 文本图像（无例外）（AAA 级） "Images of text are only used for pure decoration or where a particular presentation of text is essential to the information being conveyed." 文本图像只用于纯装饰，或用于文本的特定呈现对所传达信息必不可少的情形。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 1.4.9 1.4.10 Reflow 重排（AA 级） "Content can be presented without loss of information or functionality, and without requiring scrolling in two dimensions for:" 内容可以在不丢失信息或功能、且无需在两个方向上滚动的情况下呈现，适用于： World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 1.4.10 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast 非文本对比度（AA 级） "The visual presentation of the following have a contrast ratio of at least 3:1 against adjacent color(s):" 下列各项的视觉呈现与相邻颜色之间具有至少 3:1 的对比度： World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 1.4.11 1.4.12 Text Spacing 文本间距（AA 级） "In content implemented using markup languages that support the following text style properties, no loss of content or functionality occurs by setting all of the following and by changing no other style property:" 在用支持下列文本样式属性的标记语言实现的内容中，设置下列全部属性而不改变其他样式属性时不会丢失内容或功能： World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 1.4.12 1.4.13 Content on Hover or Focus 悬停或聚焦时的内容（AA 级） "Where receiving and then removing pointer hover or keyboard focus triggers additional content to become visible and then hidden, the following are true:" 当指针悬停或键盘焦点的进入与移除触发附加内容显示然后隐藏时，下列各项成立： World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 1.4.13 References World Wide Web Consortium. (2024, December 12). Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 (W3C Recommendation). https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/

ui-ux/wcag-2-2/perceivable/index.html.title: 1. Perceivable | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
ui-ux/wcag-2-2/perceivable/index.html.summary: 1. Perceivable Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 1. Perceivable 可感知 "Information and user interface components must be presentable to users in ways they can perceive." 信息和用户界面组件必须能够以用户可感知的方式呈现给用户。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Principle 1 1.1 Text Alternatives 文本替代 "Provide text alternatives for any non-text content so that it can be changed into other forms people need, such as large print, braille, speech, symbols or simpler language." 为任何非文本内容提供文本替代，使其可以转换为人们需要的其他形式，例如大字、盲文、语音、符号或更简单的语言。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Guideline 1.1 1.2 Time-based Media 基于时间的媒体 "Provide alternatives for time-based media." 为基于时间的媒体提供替代。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Guideline 1.2 1.3 Adaptable 可适配 "Create content that can be presented in different ways (for example simpler layout) without losing information or structure." 创建可以以不同方式呈现（例如更简单的布局）而不丢失信息或结构的内容。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Guideline 1.3 1.4 Distinguishable 可辨别 "Make it easier for users to see and hear content including separating foreground from background." 让用户更容易看到和听到内容，包括把前景与背景分开。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Guideline 1.4 References World Wide Web Consortium. (2024, December 12). Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 (W3C Recommendation). https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/

ui-ux/wcag-2-2/perceivable/text-alternat.title: 1.1 Text Alternatives | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
ui-ux/wcag-2-2/perceivable/text-alternat.summary: 1.1 Text Alternatives Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 1.1 Text Alternatives 文本替代 "Provide text alternatives for any non-text content so that it can be changed into other forms people need, such as large print, braille, speech, symbols or simpler language." 为任何非文本内容提供文本替代，使其可以转换为人们需要的其他形式，例如大字、盲文、语音、符号或更简单的语言。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Guideline 1.1 1.1.1 Non-text Content 非文本内容（A 级） "All non-text content that is presented to the user has a text alternative that serves the equivalent purpose, except for the situations listed below." 呈现给用户的所有非文本内容都有起同等作用的文本替代，下列情形除外。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 1.1.1 References World Wide Web Consortium. (2024, December 12). Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 (W3C Recommendation). https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/

ui-ux/wcag-2-2/perceivable/time-based-me.title: 1.2 Time-based Media | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
ui-ux/wcag-2-2/perceivable/time-based-me.summary: 1.2 Time-based Media Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 1.2 Time-based Media 基于时间的媒体 "Provide alternatives for time-based media." 为基于时间的媒体提供替代。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Guideline 1.2 1.2.1 Audio-only and Video-only (Prerecorded) 纯音频和纯视频（预录）（A 级） "For prerecorded audio-only and prerecorded video-only media, the following are true, except when the audio or video is a media alternative for text and is clearly labeled as such:" 对于预录的纯音频和预录的纯视频媒体，下列各项成立，除非该音频或视频是文本的媒体替代并有明确标注： World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 1.2.1 1.2.2 Captions (Prerecorded) 字幕（预录）（A 级） "Captions are provided for all prerecorded audio content in synchronized media, except when the media is a media alternative for text and is clearly labeled as such." 为同步媒体中所有预录的音频内容提供字幕，除非该媒体是文本的媒体替代并有明确标注。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 1.2.2 1.2.3 Audio Description or Media Alternative (Prerecorded) 音频描述或媒体替代（预录）（A 级） "An alternative for time-based media or audio description of the prerecorded video content is provided for synchronized media, except when the media is a media alternative for text and is clearly labeled as such." 为同步媒体提供基于时间的媒体的替代或预录视频内容的音频描述，除非该媒体是文本的媒体替代并有明确标注。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 1.2.3 1.2.4 Captions (Live) 字幕（直播）（AA 级） "Captions are provided for all live audio content in synchronized media." 为同步媒体中所有直播的音频内容提供字幕。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 1.2.4 1.2.5 Audio Description (Prerecorded) 音频描述（预录）（AA 级） "Audio description is provided for all prerecorded video content in synchronized media." 为同步媒体中所有预录的视频内容提供音频描述。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 1.2.5 1.2.6 Sign Language (Prerecorded) 手语（预录）（AAA 级） "Sign language interpretation is provided for all prerecorded audio content in synchronized media." 为同步媒体中所有预录的音频内容提供手语翻译。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 1.2.6 1.2.7 Extended Audio Description (Prerecorded) 扩展音频描述（预录）（AAA 级） "Where pauses in foreground audio are insufficient to allow audio descriptions to convey the sense of the video, extended audio description is provided for all prerecorded video content in synchronized media." 当前景音频中的停顿不足以让音频描述传达视频的意义时，为同步媒体中所有预录的视频内容提供扩展音频描述。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 1.2.7 1.2.8 Media Alternative (Prerecorded) 媒体替代（预录）（AAA 级） "An alternative for time-based media is provided for all prerecorded synchronized media and for all prerecorded video-only media." 为所有预录的同步媒体和所有预录的纯视频媒体提供基于时间的媒体的替代。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 1.2.8 1.2.9 Audio-only (Live) 纯音频（直播）（AAA 级） "An alternative for time-based media that presents equivalent information for live audio-only content is provided." 提供一种基于时间的媒体的替代，它为直播的纯音频内容呈现同等的信息。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 1.2.9 References World Wide Web Consortium. (2024, December 12). Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 (W3C Recommendation). https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/

ui-ux/wcag-2-2/robust/compatible.html.title: 4.1 Compatible | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
ui-ux/wcag-2-2/robust/compatible.html.summary: 4.1 Compatible Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 4.1 Compatible 兼容 "Maximize compatibility with current and future user agents, including assistive technologies." 最大限度地提高与当前和未来用户代理（包括辅助技术）的兼容性。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Guideline 4.1 4.1.1 Parsing (Obsolete and removed) 解析（已废弃并移除） "This criterion was originally adopted to address problems that assistive technology had directly parsing HTML. Assistive technology no longer has any need to directly parse HTML. Consequently, these problems either no longer exist or are addressed by other criteria. This criterion no longer has utility and is removed." 本标准最初是为了解决辅助技术直接解析 HTML 的问题而采用的。辅助技术不再需要直接解析 HTML。因此，这些问题要么已不存在，要么由其他标准解决。本标准不再有用，已被移除。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 4.1.1 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value 名称、角色、值（A 级） "For all user interface components (including but not limited to: form elements, links and components generated by scripts), the name and role can be programmatically determined; states, properties, and values that can be set by the user can be programmatically set; and notification of changes to these items is available to user agents, including assistive technologies." 对于所有用户界面组件（包括但不限于表单元素、链接和脚本生成的组件），名称和角色可以由程序确定；用户可以设置的状态、属性和值可以由程序设置；这些项目的改变会通知给用户代理，包括辅助技术。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 4.1.2 4.1.3 Status Messages 状态消息（AA 级） "In content implemented using markup languages, status messages can be programmatically determined through role or properties such that they can be presented to the user by assistive technologies without receiving focus." 在用标记语言实现的内容中，状态消息可以通过角色或属性由程序确定，从而辅助技术可以在不获得焦点的情况下把它们呈现给用户。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 4.1.3 References World Wide Web Consortium. (2024, December 12). Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 (W3C Recommendation). https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/

Robust 健壮 "Content must be robust enough that it can be interpreted by a wide variety of user agents, including assistive technologies." 内容必须足够健壮，能够被各种各样的用户代理（包括辅助技术）解读。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Principle 4 4.1 Compatible 兼容 "Maximize compatibility with current and future user agents, including assistive technologies." 最大限度地提高与当前和未来用户代理（包括辅助技术）的兼容性。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Guideline 4.1 References World Wide Web Consortium. (2024, December 12). Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 (W3C Recommendation). https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/

ui-ux/wcag-2-2/understandable/index.html.summary: 3. Understandable Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 3. Understandable 可理解 "Information and the operation of the user interface must be understandable." 信息和用户界面的操作必须可理解。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Principle 3 3.1 Readable 可读 "Make text content readable and understandable." 让文本内容可读、可理解。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Guideline 3.1 3.2 Predictable 可预测 "Make web pages appear and operate in predictable ways." 让网页以可预测的方式显示和运作。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Guideline 3.2 3.3 Input Assistance 输入辅助 "Help users avoid and correct mistakes." 帮助用户避免和纠正错误。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Guideline 3.3 References World Wide Web Consortium. (2024, December 12). Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 (W3C Recommendation). https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/

ui-ux/wcag-2-2/understandable/input-assi.title: 3.3 Input Assistance | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
ui-ux/wcag-2-2/understandable/input-assi.summary: 3.3 Input Assistance Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 3.3 Input Assistance 输入辅助 "Help users avoid and correct mistakes." 帮助用户避免和纠正错误。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Guideline 3.3 3.3.1 Error Identification 错误识别（A 级） "If an input error is automatically detected, the item that is in error is identified and the error is described to the user in text." 如果自动检测到输入错误，则标识出错的项目，并以文本向用户描述该错误。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 3.3.1 3.3.2 Labels or Instructions 标签或说明（A 级） "Labels or instructions are provided when content requires user input." 当内容需要用户输入时提供标签或说明。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 3.3.2 3.3.3 Error Suggestion 错误建议（AA 级） "If an input error is automatically detected and suggestions for correction are known, then the suggestions are provided to the user, unless it would jeopardize the security or purpose of the content." 如果自动检测到输入错误且已知纠正建议，则向用户提供这些建议，除非这会危及内容的安全或目的。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 3.3.3 3.3.4 Error Prevention (Legal, Financial, Data) 错误预防（法律、财务、数据）（AA 级） "For web pages that cause legal commitments or financial transactions for the user to occur, that modify or delete user-controllable data in data storage systems, or that submit user test responses, at least one of the following is true:" 对于使用户产生法律承诺或财务交易、修改或删除数据存储系统中用户可控数据，或提交用户测试答案的网页，下列至少一项成立： World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 3.3.4 3.3.5 Help 帮助（AAA 级） "Context-sensitive help is available." 提供上下文相关的帮助。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 3.3.5 3.3.6 Error Prevention (All) 错误预防（全部）（AAA 级） "For web pages that require the user to submit information, at least one of the following is true:" 对于要求用户提交信息的网页，下列至少一项成立： World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 3.3.6 3.3.7 Redundant Entry 重复输入（A 级） "Information previously entered by or provided to the user that is required to be entered again in the same process is either:" 之前由用户输入或提供给用户、且在同一流程中需要再次输入的信息，要么： World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 3.3.7 3.3.8 Accessible Authentication (Minimum) 无障碍认证（最低）（AA 级） "A cognitive function test (such as remembering a password or solving a puzzle) is not required for any step in an authentication process unless that step provides at least one of the following:" 认知功能测试（如记住密码或解谜题）在认证流程的任何步骤中都不是必需的，除非该步骤提供下列至少一项： World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 3.3.8 3.3.9 Accessible Authentication (Enhanced) 无障碍认证（增强）（AAA 级） "A cognitive function test (such as remembering a password or solving a puzzle) is not required for any step in an authentication process unless that step provides at least one of the following:" 认知功能测试（如记住密码或解谜题）在认证流程的任何步骤中都不是必需的，除非该步骤提供下列至少一项： World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 3.3.9 References World Wide Web Consortium. (2024, December 12). Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 (W3C Recommendation). https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/

ui-ux/wcag-2-2/understandable/predictabl.title: 3.2 Predictable | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
ui-ux/wcag-2-2/understandable/predictabl.summary: 3.2 Predictable Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 3.2 Predictable 可预测 "Make web pages appear and operate in predictable ways." 让网页以可预测的方式显示和运作。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Guideline 3.2 3.2.1 On Focus 聚焦时（A 级） "When any user interface component receives focus, it does not initiate a change of context." 当任何用户界面组件获得焦点时，它不引发上下文的改变。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 3.2.1 3.2.2 On Input 输入时（A 级） "Changing the setting of any user interface component does not automatically cause a change of context unless the user has been advised of the behavior before using the component." 改变任何用户界面组件的设置不会自动引起上下文的改变，除非用户在使用该组件前已被告知这一行为。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 3.2.2 3.2.3 Consistent Navigation 一致的导航（AA 级） "Navigational mechanisms that are repeated on multiple web pages within a set of web pages occur in the same relative order each time they are repeated, unless a change is initiated by the user." 在一组网页中的多个网页上重复出现的导航机制，每次重复时都以相同的相对顺序出现，除非改变由用户发起。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 3.2.3 3.2.4 Consistent Identification 一致的识别（AA 级） "Components that have the same functionality within a set of web pages are identified consistently." 在一组网页中具有相同功能的组件以一致的方式标识。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 3.2.4 3.2.5 Change on Request 按请求改变（AAA 级） "Changes of context are initiated only by user request or a mechanism is available to turn off such changes." 上下文的改变只由用户请求发起，或提供一种机制来关闭此类改变。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 3.2.5 3.2.6 Consistent Help 一致的帮助（A 级） "If a web page contains any of the following help mechanisms, and those mechanisms are repeated on multiple web pages within a set of web pages, they occur in the same order relative to other page content, unless a change is initiated by the user:" 如果网页包含下列任何帮助机制，并且这些机制在一组网页中的多个网页上重复出现，则它们相对于其他页面内容以相同的顺序出现，除非改变由用户发起： World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 3.2.6 References World Wide Web Consortium. (2024, December 12). Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 (W3C Recommendation). https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/

ui-ux/wcag-2-2/understandable/readable.h.title: 3.1 Readable | Peng Wang Knowledge Base
ui-ux/wcag-2-2/understandable/readable.h.summary: 3.1 Readable Classification Glossary Term Definition 中文翻译 Source 3.1 Readable 可读 "Make text content readable and understandable." 让文本内容可读、可理解。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Guideline 3.1 3.1.1 Language of Page 页面语言（A 级） "The default human language of each web page can be programmatically determined." 每个网页的默认人类语言可以由程序确定。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 3.1.1 3.1.2 Language of Parts 局部语言（AA 级） "The human language of each passage or phrase in the content can be programmatically determined except for proper names, technical terms, words of indeterminate language, and words or phrases that have become part of the vernacular of the immediately surrounding text." 内容中每个段落或短语的人类语言可以由程序确定，专有名词、技术术语、语言不确定的词，以及已成为周围文本所用语言一部分的词或短语除外。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 3.1.2 3.1.3 Unusual Words 不常见的词（AAA 级） "A mechanism is available for identifying specific definitions of words or phrases used in an unusual or restricted way, including idioms and jargon." 提供一种机制，用于识别以不常见或受限方式使用的词或短语的具体定义，包括习语和行话。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 3.1.3 3.1.4 Abbreviations 缩写（AAA 级） "A mechanism for identifying the expanded form or meaning of abbreviations is available." 提供一种识别缩写的展开形式或含义的机制。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 3.1.4 3.1.5 Reading Level 阅读水平（AAA 级） "When text requires reading ability more advanced than the lower secondary education level after removal of proper names and titles, supplemental content, or a version that does not require reading ability more advanced than the lower secondary education level, is available." 当文本在去掉专有名词和标题后仍要求高于初中教育水平的阅读能力时，提供补充内容或一个不要求高于初中教育水平阅读能力的版本。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 3.1.5 3.1.6 Pronunciation 发音（AAA 级） "A mechanism is available for identifying specific pronunciation of words where meaning of the words, in context, is ambiguous without knowing the pronunciation." 提供一种机制，用于在不知道发音就无法确定词义的上下文中识别词的具体发音。 World Wide Web Consortium, 2024, Success Criterion 3.1.6 References World Wide Web Consortium. (2024, December 12). Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 (W3C Recommendation). https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/
